To propose, end your message with a final line starting with 'ACTION:' then minified JSON {\"kind\":\"<kind>\",\"args\":{...},\"label\":\"short button text\"}. Kinds:\n- resolve_action / dismiss_action — {\"id\":<agent_action id>} close a recommendation.\n- delete_file — {\"bucket\":<one of ${SAFE_DELETE.join(',')}>,\"path\":<exact path>} ONLY a specific dangerous file.\n- add_note — {\"entity\":\"supplier|customer|deal\",\"entity_id\":<id>,\"text\":<note>}.\n- approve_supplier / reject_supplier — {\"id\":<lead id>[,\"reason\":<text>]} approve or reject a supplier registration (notifies them).\n- send_message — {\"to_email\":<email>,\"to_role\":\"supplier|customer|admin\",\"subject\":<subject>,\"body\":<full message>} send an email/reply. Propose only when the founder asks to send or reply.\n- create_task — {\"title\":<title>[,\"detail\":<text>,\"priority\":\"low|normal|high\",\"due_date\":\"YYYY-MM-DD\"]} add a to-do to the founder's task list.\n- post_content — {\"channel\":\"email|whatsapp|social\",\"text\":<the full content>[,\"to\":[emails or phone numbers for email/whatsapp],\"title\":<short title>]} publish content.       const raw = await llm(sys, [...history, { role:'user', content: message }]);

          if (lead.claimed_by) await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type:'registration_approved', to_email:lead.claimed_by, to_role:'supplier', lead_id:id, subject:"You're verified on QuotesDone", body:`Good news — ${lead.company_name} has been verified and approved on QuotesDone. You can now receive inquiries and submit quotes: https://quotesdone.com/suppliers/` });

        if (mr && mr.ok && mr.campaign_id) {

          return J({ ok:true, result:'Created a PAUSED Meta campaign + ad set (campaign '+mr.campaign_id+'). Add the creative and switch it on in Ads Manager to start spending — I never activate it for you. Full plan saved as a task.' });

Add meta_access_token + meta_ad_account_id, then this can be created PAUSED.)', priority:'normal', source:'agent:'+(body.agent||'marketing'), status:'open' });
        const why = (mr && (mr.error || mr.adset_error)) || 'not connected';
        return J({ ok:true, result:'Meta Ads is not connected yet ('+why+'), so I saved the full campaign plan as a task. Once you add the Meta credentials I can create it PAUSED for your approval.' });
      }
      if (kind === 'draft_doc') {
        const title = String(args.title||'Document').slice(0,140);
        const bodyTxt = String(args.body||'').slice(0, 20000);
        const paras = esc(bodyTxt).split(/\n\n+/).map((pp)=>{ pp = pp.trim(); if(!pp) return ''; const hm = pp.match(/^(#{1,3})\s+([\s\S]+)/); if (hm) { const lvl = hm[1].length + 1; return '<h'+lvl+'>'+hm[2].replace(/\n/g,' ')+'</h'+lvl+'>'; } return '<p>'+pp.replace(/\n/g,'<br>')+'</p>'; }).join('');
        const html = '<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>'+esc(title)+'</title><style>body{font-family:Georgia,\'Times New Roman\',serif;color:#1f2937;max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:44px 30px;line-height:1.7}header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;border-bottom:3px solid #0E7C73;padding-bottom:14px;margin-bottom:26px}header img{height:38px;width:auto}header .b{font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:20px;color:#0E7C73}h1{font-size:24px;color:#0f172a;margin:0 0 14px}h2,h3,h4{color:#0E7C73;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}p{margin:10px 0}footer{margin-top:38px;border-top:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding-top:12px;color:#6b7280;font-size:12px;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}@media print{body{padding:0}}</style></head><body><header><img src="'+SUPA+'/storage/v1/object/public/brand/qd_mark.png" alt=""><span class="b">QuotesDone</span></header><h1>'+esc(title)+'</h1>'+paras+'<footer>Prepared by the '+esc(String(body.agent||'agent'))+' for QuotesDone · '+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+' · Internal draft — review before use.</footer></body></html>';
        const slug = (title.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g,'').slice(0,40)) || 'doc';
        const path = 'agent-drafts/'+Date.now()+'-'+slug+'.html';
        const { error } = await admin.storage.from('agent-docs').upload(path, new TextEncoder().encode(html), { contentType:'text/html; charset=utf-8', upsert:true });
        if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
        const { data: su } = await admin.storage.from('agent-docs').createSignedUrl(path, 3600);
        return J({ ok:true, result: 'Document drafted: '+title, url: su?.signedUrl || null });
      }
      return J({ error:'unknown_action_kind' }, 400);
    }

    return J({ error:'unknown action' }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});

// agent_autogen — when suppliers arrive from a category we don't cover yet, auto-create a full expert
// sales agent for it: persona + verified knowledge pack + intake checklist. Daily cron + callable.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'agent_autogen', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
}
let LLM_CALLS = 0, PARSE_FAILS = 0, SAVE_FAILS = 0, SPEC_FAILS = 0, EMPTY_KNOWLEDGE = 0; let LAST_ERR = '';
function summarize(results: any[], considered: number) {
  const made = results.filter((r) => r.ok);
  const genFailed = results.filter((r) => !r.ok && r.error === 'generation_failed');
  const other = results.filter((r) => !r.ok && r.error !== 'generation_failed');
  let note: string;
  if (results.length === 0) { note = 'no uncovered supplier/inquiry categories found; no new expert agents needed this run'; }
  else if (made.length === 0 && genFailed.length) { note = 'NO expert category agents created this run: the model returned nothing usable for all ' + genFailed.length + ' uncovered trade(s) [' + genFailed.map((r) => r.trade).join(', ') + '], so suppliers and inquiries in those trades stay uncovered with no persona, knowledge or intake checklist'; }
  else if (made.length === 0) { note = 'no expert category agents created this run; ' + results.length + ' candidate(s) were all skipped (' + other.map((r) => r.trade + ':' + r.error).join(', ') + ')'; }
  else { note = 'created ' + made.length + ' expert category agent(s): ' + made.map((m) => m.slug).join(', ') + (genFailed.length ? ('; ' + genFailed.length + ' trade(s) produced nothing usable from the model and remain uncovered') : ''); }
  if (EMPTY_KNOWLEDGE > 0) { note += ' | ' + EMPTY_KNOWLEDGE + ' agent(s) were created with an EMPTY knowledge pack and will talk to UAE customers with no trade expertise'; }
  if (SPEC_FAILS > 0) { note += ' | ' + SPEC_FAILS + ' intake checklist(s) failed to save, so those categories collect no quote-critical fields'; }
  if (SAVE_FAILS > 0) { note += ' | ' + SAVE_FAILS + ' database write(s) failed during provisioning'; }
  if (LAST_ERR) { note += ' | last error: ' + LAST_ERR; }
  const bad = SAVE_FAILS > 0 || SPEC_FAILS > 0 || EMPTY_KNOWLEDGE > 0 || (results.length > 0 && made.length === 0 && genFailed.length > 0);
  return { status: bad ? 'error' : 'ok', note, counts: { considered, attempted: results.length, created: made.length, generation_failed: genFailed.length, skipped: other.length, llm_calls: LLM_CALLS, parse_failures: PARSE_FAILS, empty_knowledge_packs: EMPTY_KNOWLEDGE, save_failures: SAVE_FAILS, checklist_failures: SPEC_FAILS } };
}
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { ...CORS, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
const MODELS = ['anthropic/claude-sonnet-5', 'anthropic/claude-opus-4.8']; // Sonnet-first for cost (fleet policy)

async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
function slugify(s: string) { return String(s || '').toLowerCase().replace(/&/g, ' and ').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 40); }
function tokens(s: string) { return new Set(String(s || '').toLowerCase().split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).filter((w) => w.length > 2)); }
function parseJson(txt: string) { try { return JSON.parse(txt); } catch { /* */ } const m = txt.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (m) { try { return JSON.parse(m[0]); } catch { /* */ } } return null; }

async function llm(key: string, sys: string, user: string, max = 4500) {
  LLM_CALLS++;
  const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${key}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ models: MODELS, max_tokens: max, temperature: 0.2, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: sys }, { role: 'user', content: user }] }) });
  const d = await r.json();
  if (!r.ok) { LAST_ERR = 'openrouter HTTP ' + r.status + ': ' + String(d?.error?.message || ''); throw new Error(d?.error?.message || 'openrouter error'); }
  return d?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '';
}

const GEN_SYS = `You create a new expert trade category for QuotesDone, a UAE B2B quotation marketplace where customers post jobs and verified suppliers submit anonymised fixed-price quotes. Given a supplier trade/category name, output EVERYTHING needed to launch a first-class expert sales agent for it, grounded in real UAE market practice.

Return STRICT JSON ONLY (no markdown), exact shape:
{
  "name": "Human category name (Title Case)",
  "emoji": "one relevant emoji",
  "slug": "lowercase-hyphen-slug",
  "persona": "2-4 sentences: a seasoned UAE [trade] sales estimator — warm, expert, practical, pro-SME; knows what drives price and how to guide a customer to a quotable brief without a site visit",
  "knowledge": [ { "topic": "short topic", "content": "150-350 words of verified, specific UAE trade knowledge", "priority": 1 } ],
  "checklist": [ { "key": "snake_case", "question": "short plain customer-facing question", "type": "select|multiselect|number|text", "options": ["concrete option", "Not sure"], "required": true } ]
}

RULES:
- knowledge: EXACTLY 6 topics covering: (1) what materially drives price in this trade, (2) the specifications a customer MUST provide to get a firm quote, (3) UAE compliance/authority & standards IF the trade is regulated (else market norms), (4) common customer mistakes / things they forget, (5) typical scope inclusions vs exclusions, (6) a concise quoting checklist an estimator runs through. Be specific to the UAE. Do NOT invent prices or fake statistics.
- checklist: 5-9 quote-critical fields the customer must answer for a supplier to price WITHOUT contacting them. Prefer select/multiselect with 2-6 concrete options plus a 'Not sure' option; number for quantities/sizes. required=true only when a quote genuinely depends on it.
- Keep it honest and non-hyped. Output JSON only.`;

async function generateFor(key: string, trade: string) {
  const raw = await llm(key, GEN_SYS, 'Trade / category: ' + trade + '\nCountry: United Arab Emirates.');
  const j = parseJson(raw);
  if (!j || !j.name) { PARSE_FAILS++; LAST_ERR = 'model output for trade "' + trade + '" was unparseable or had no name; agent not created'; return null; }
  const slug = slugify(j.slug || j.name || trade);
  if (!slug) { PARSE_FAILS++; LAST_ERR = 'model output for trade "' + trade + '" produced an empty slug; agent not created'; return null; }
  const knowledge = Array.isArray(j.knowledge) ? j.knowledge.filter((k: any) => k && k.topic && k.content).slice(0, 8) : [];
  const checklist = Array.isArray(j.checklist) ? j.checklist.filter((c: any) => c && c.key && c.question).slice(0, 12) : [];
  return { slug, name: String(j.name).slice(0, 80), emoji: String(j.emoji || '🧩').slice(0, 8), persona: String(j.persona || '').slice(0, 2000), knowledge, checklist };
}

async function provision(key: string, trade: string, agentSlugs: Set<string>) {
  const g = await generateFor(key, trade);
  if (!g) return { trade, ok: false, error: 'generation_failed' };
  if (agentSlugs.has(g.slug)) return { trade, ok: false, error: 'slug_exists', slug: g.slug };
  const _ca = await admin.from('category_agents').insert({ slug: g.slug, name: g.name, emoji: g.emoji, persona: g.persona, active: true });
  if (_ca && (_ca as any).error) { SAVE_FAILS++; LAST_ERR = 'category_agents insert failed for ' + g.slug + ': ' + String((_ca as any).error?.message || ''); }
  if (g.knowledge.length) { const _ak = await admin.from('agent_knowledge').insert(g.knowledge.map((k: any, i: number) => ({ agent_key: 'cat:' + g.slug, topic: String(k.topic).slice(0, 120), content: String(k.content).slice(0, 6000), priority: Number(k.priority) || (g.knowledge.length - i) }))); if (_ak && (_ak as any).error) { SAVE_FAILS++; LAST_ERR = 'agent_knowledge insert failed for ' + g.slug + ': ' + String((_ak as any).error?.message || ''); } }
  else { EMPTY_KNOWLEDGE++; LAST_ERR = 'agent ' + g.slug + ' was created with no knowledge topics from the model'; }
  try { const _cs = await admin.from('category_specs').upsert({ category: g.slug, label: g.name, fields: g.checklist }, { onConflict: 'category' }); if (_cs && (_cs as any).error) { SPEC_FAILS++; LAST_ERR = 'category_specs upsert failed for ' + g.slug + ': ' + String((_cs as any).error?.message || ''); } } catch (_e) { SPEC_FAILS++; LAST_ERR = 'category_specs upsert threw for ' + g.slug + ': ' + String(_e); }
  agentSlugs.add(g.slug);
  return { trade, ok: true, slug: g.slug, name: g.name, topics: g.knowledge.length, checklist: g.checklist.length };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) { await logRun('error', { created: 0 }, 'call rejected: wrong or missing inbound secret; no expert category agents were created'); return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403); }
    const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key'); if (!key) { await logRun('error', { created: 0 }, 'openrouter_api_key missing from app_secrets: no expert category agents created this run, uncovered supplier trades stay uncovered'); return J({ error: 'AI not configured' }, 200); }
    const max = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, Number(body.max) || 3));

    const { data: agents } = await admin.from('category_agents').select('slug,name');
    const agentSlugs = new Set((agents || []).map((a: any) => a.slug));
    const agentTokenSets = (agents || []).map((a: any) => tokens((a.slug || '') + ' ' + (a.name || '')));
    const covered = (trade: string) => { const tt = tokens(trade); for (const s of agentTokenSets) { for (const t of tt) if (s.has(t)) return true; } return false; };

    const results: any[] = [];
    if (body.category) { results.push(await provision(key, String(body.category), agentSlugs)); const sF = summarize(results, 1); await logRun(sF.status, { ...sF.counts, mode: 'forced' }, 'forced provisioning of "' + String(body.category) + '": ' + sF.note); return J({ ok: true, mode: 'forced', results }); }

    const wanted = new Map<string, number>();
    const { data: sup } = await admin.from('leads').select('sector').eq('claimed', true).not('sector', 'is', null).limit(2000);
    for (const l of (sup || [])) { const v = String(l.sector || '').trim(); if (v) wanted.set(v.toLowerCase(), (wanted.get(v.toLowerCase()) || 0) + 1); }
    const { data: inq } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('category').not('category', 'is', null).gte('created_at', new Date(Date.now() - 60 * 864e5).toISOString()).limit(2000);
    for (const i of (inq || [])) { const v = String(i.category || '').trim(); if (v) wanted.set(v.toLowerCase(), (wanted.get(v.toLowerCase()) || 0) + 1); }

    const candidates = [...wanted.entries()].filter(([t]) => t.length >= 3 && !covered(t) && !agentSlugs.has(slugify(t))).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, max);
    for (const [trade] of candidates) results.push(await provision(key, trade, agentSlugs));

    const made = results.filter((r) => r.ok);
    if (made.length) {
      const owner = String(await sec('admin_emails') || 'management@quotesdone.com').split(',')[0].trim();
      try { const _aa = await admin.from('agent_actions').insert({ agent: 'autogen', kind: 'agent_created', status: 'pending', risk: 'low', title: made.length + ' new expert category agent(s) auto-created: ' + made.map((m) => m.name).join(', '), recommendation: 'review the new agent persona/knowledge/checklist in admin; adjust if needed', target_table: 'category_agents', target_id: null, detail: { made } }); if (_aa && (_aa as any).error) { SAVE_FAILS++; LAST_ERR = 'agent_actions insert failed: ' + String((_aa as any).error?.message || ''); } } catch (_e) { SAVE_FAILS++; LAST_ERR = 'agent_actions insert threw: ' + String(_e); }
      try { const _nt = await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type: 'agent_created', to_email: owner, to_role: 'admin', channel: 'email', subject: 'QuotesDone: new expert agent(s) created for uncovered categories', body: 'Auto-created expert sales agents for: ' + made.map((m) => m.name + ' (' + m.slug + ')').join(', ') + '. Each has a persona, a verified knowledge pack and an intake checklist. Review in the admin Agents console.' }); if (_nt && (_nt as any).error) { SAVE_FAILS++; LAST_ERR = 'notifications insert failed: ' + String((_nt as any).error?.message || ''); } } catch (_e) { SAVE_FAILS++; LAST_ERR = 'notifications insert threw: ' + String(_e); }
    }
    const sS = summarize(results, candidates.length);
    await logRun(sS.status, { ...sS.counts, mode: 'scan' }, sS.note);
    return J({ ok: true, mode: 'scan', considered: candidates.length, results });
  } catch (e) { await logRun('error', { created: 0, llm_calls: LLM_CALLS, parse_failures: PARSE_FAILS }, 'agent_autogen crashed before completing; uncovered trades were not provisioned this run: ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e)); return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});

// agent_brain v17 — EMPLOYEE RUNTIME.
// Change vs v16: agents (especially the Chief of Staff — "the eyes") can now RESEARCH THE INTERNET
// to permanently fill a genuine knowledge gap. When an agent emits a `research` action, we dispatch
// the web-grounded kb_deepen engine to pull real UAE sources for those topics and ingest them into
// the agent's permanent knowledge — so the gap is closed for everyone, once, not re-answered live.
// Change vs v15: retrieve() is now category-scoped for specialist (cat:<slug>) agents — it
// pulls that specialist's OWN deep region of the knowledge base first (the "trigger that
// region of the master's brain" behaviour) and tops up with a small unscoped cross-domain
// pass; functional staff keep the relevance-ranked global pass. Feeds on the kb_deepen corpus.
// Changes vs v14: (1) context comes from fn_agent_context() — the four-layer employee
// assembly (identity+doctrine posture, L1 company, L2 profession, L3 live state, L4
// lint-filtered experience) instead of a flat 26-bullet knowledge dump + raw memory;
// (2) reasoning actually runs OPUS_FIRST (v14's comment claimed Opus but bound Sonnet);
// (3) roster extended: analytics, procurement, secretary, designer; (4) auto-learn is
// lint-gated against policy_rules so poisoned facts can never enter memory again;
// (5) assistant-posture line replaced by the chairman doctrine (default to action within
// authority; gated work is prepared and routed, not abandoned).
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, OPUS_FIRST, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const SUPA = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type' };
const J = (o:unknown,s=200)=> new Response(JSON.stringify(o),{status:s,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json',...CORS}});
async function sec(k:string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
async function cntT(t:string, mod?:(q:any)=>any){ let q=admin.from(t).select('id',{count:'exact',head:true}); if(mod) q=mod(q); const {count}=await q; return count||0; }
// Executive reasoning on Opus 4.8 (strongest), Sonnet 5 as automatic fallback — and this time the code matches the comment.
const llm = makeLlm(OPUS_FIRST, { max: 1600 });
async function llmFast(sys:string, user:string){ try{ const secret=await sec('inbound_secret'); if(!secret) return ''; const r=await fetch(SUPA+'/functions/v1/ai_gateway',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({__secret:secret,fn:'agent_brain',task_class:'memory_retrieval',sys,input:user,max:160,temperature:0}),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(20000)}); const j=await r.json(); return j?.content||''; }catch(_e){ return ''; } }

// Lint gate: a candidate memory that matches any active forbidden-language rule is refused.
async function lintClean(text:string):Promise<boolean>{
  try{
    const { data:rules } = await admin.from('policy_rules').select('forbid_regex').eq('active',true);
    for(const r of (rules||[])){
      try{ if(new RegExp(String(r.forbid_regex),'i').test(text)) return false; }catch(_e){}
    }
    return true;
  }catch(_e){ return true; }
}

// AUTO-LEARN: after a chat, capture at most one durable new fact (background, lint-gated).
async function learn(key:string, name:string, userMsg:string, assistantMsg:string){
  try{
    if(!assistantMsg || assistantMsg.length<60) return;
    if(/could not reach the AI service/i.test(assistantMsg)) return;
    if((userMsg+assistantMsg).length<160) return;
    const { data:mem } = await admin.from('agent_memory').select('content').eq('agent_key',key).order('id',{ascending:false}).limit(40);
    const known=(mem||[]).map((m:any)=>'- '+m.content).join('\n');
    const sys='You maintain the long-term MEMORY of the '+name+' agent at QuotesDone, a UAE B2B marketplace. From the latest exchange, extract AT MOST ONE durable, reusable item this agent should remember for next time and that is genuinely NOT already covered by its existing memory below. Capture only long-term-useful things: a new standard/spec/regulation, a founder preference or policy, a corrected fact, a resolved how-to, a confirmed price/figure. IGNORE: greetings, one-off data, anything already known, anything uncertain. Reply with ONE self-contained factual memory line (max 220 chars), or EXACTLY the word NONE. Do not add commentary.\n\nEXISTING MEMORY:\n'+(known||'(empty)');
    const user='FOUNDER/USER said: '+userMsg.slice(0,1200)+'\n\n'+name+' AGENT replied: '+assistantMsg.slice(0,1500);
    const out=(await llmFast(sys,user)).trim().replace(/^[-*]\s*/,'');
    if(out && out.toUpperCase()!=='NONE' && !/^none[.!]?$/i.test(out) && out.length>10 && out.length<360){
      if(await lintClean(out)){
        await admin.from('agent_memory').insert({agent_key:key,kind:'learned',content:out.slice(0,360),source:'auto_chat'});
      } else {
        await admin.from('security_events').insert({kind:'memory_lint_block',severity:'low',source:'agent_brain',subject:key,detail:{blocked:out.slice(0,300)}}).then(()=>{},()=>{});
      }
    }
  }catch(_e){}
}

const NAMES:Record<string,string>={brief:'Daily Brief / Chief of Staff',it:'IT / Uptime',security:'Security Engineer',docs:'Document Controller',onboarding:'Onboarding / KYC',followup:'Follow-up',collections:'Collections Accountant',bd:'BD Representative',bookkeeper:'Bookkeeper',cfo:'CFO',legal:'Legal Counsel',marketing:'Marketing',analytics:'Head of Analytics & Intelligence',procurement:'Head of Marketplace Operations',secretary:'Executive Secretary',designer:'Designer'};
const VALID_AGENTS=['legal','collections','cfo','bookkeeper','security','it','onboarding','docs','followup','bd','marketing','brief','analytics','procurement','secretary','designer'];
function splitActions(s:string):[string, any]{ const i=s.indexOf('@@ACTIONS@@'); if(i<0) return [s,null]; const clean=s.slice(0,i).trim(); const tail=s.slice(i+11); const mm=tail.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); let a:any=null; if(mm){ try{ a=JSON.parse(mm[0]); }catch(_e){} } return [clean,a]; }

async function meta(key:string){
  if(NAMES[key]) return { name:NAMES[key] };
  if(key.startsWith('cat:')){ const { data:ca }=await admin.from('category_agents').select('name,persona').eq('slug',key.slice(4)).maybeSingle(); if(ca) return { name:ca.name+' Sales', persona: ca.persona }; }
  const { data:oa } = await admin.from('org_agents').select('role').eq('agent_key',key).eq('active',true).maybeSingle();

}

// Semantic + keyword retrieval over the deep knowledge corpus (kb_chunks). For a category
// specialist (cat:<slug>) we scope to that slug FIRST — this is the "trigger that region of
// the master's brain" behaviour: a fit-out question pulls the fit-out deep briefs, not the
// whole company. We top up with an unscoped pass so cross-domain facts still surface.
async function retrieve(key:string, msg:string){
  try{
    const secret=await sec('inbound_secret'); if(!secret) return '';
    const cat = key.startsWith('cat:') ? key.slice(4) : null;
    const call = async (category:string|null, k:number) => {
      try{
        const r=await fetch(SUPA+'/functions/v1/kb_search',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({__secret:secret,query:msg,k,...(category?{category}:{})})});
        const j=await r.json(); return (j&&Array.isArray(j.results))?j.results:[];
      }catch(_e){ return []; }
    };
    let rows:any[] = [];
    if(cat){
      const scoped = await call(cat, 8);            // the specialist's own deep region first
      const wide   = await call(null, 4);           // + a few cross-domain hits
      const seen = new Set<number>(); rows = [];
      for(const x of [...scoped, ...wide]){ if(x && !seen.has(x.id)){ seen.add(x.id); rows.push(x); } }
    } else {
      rows = await call(null, 8);                    // functional staff: relevance-ranked, RRF surfaces their own deep chunks
    }
    if(!rows.length) return '';
    return '\n\nRETRIEVED REFERENCE KNOWLEDGE (semantic + keyword matches from the company knowledge base — UAE codes, standards, regulations, materials and internal know-how relevant to this question; use it to VERIFY, cite the reference in [brackets] when you use it):\n'+rows.slice(0,10).map((x:any)=>'- ['+(x.citation||x.category||'ref')+'] '+String(x.snippet||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,400)).join('\n');
  }catch(_e){ return ''; }
}

Your full employment context follows (identity, company canon, your professional expertise, live operational state, organizational experience) — it governs how you think and act. DOCTRINE: default to action within your delegated authority — complete work and report results; prepare and route gated work (money, publishing, legal action, security) for approval rather than abandoning it; never ask permission you already have. Be specific, practical and concise. Never invent numbers — operational figures come only from the LIVE OPERATIONAL STATE and LIVE DATA SNAPSHOT.\n\nTEAMWORK: You can hand a task to a colleague specialist when it clearly belongs to them. Your colleagues: '+teammates+'.\n\nKNOWLEDGE (your window to the world): if answering this well needs domain knowledge you do not have, you may RESEARCH THE INTERNET to fill the gap permanently — real UAE sources are pulled, verified and saved into the relevant specialist\'s knowledge so it is there for everyone next time. Use this for genuine gaps in durable domain knowledge (materials, standards, authorities, methods, market facts) — NOT for live/one-off data. Prefer answering from what you already know; reach for research only when there is a real gap worth closing.\n\nTo act, AFTER your normal reply append on a NEW LINE exactly @@ACTIONS@@ followed by compact JSON. You may include either or both keys: {"handoffs":[{"to":"<agent_key>","title":"<short task title>","details":"<what to do and why>"}],"research":[{"agent":"<specialist_slug_or_your_own_key>","topics":["<specific sub-topic to research>","<another>"]}]}. Only request real, specific, useful work. Omit the @@ACTIONS@@ line entirely if there is nothing to do. Never mention this mechanism or the word @@ACTIONS@@ in your visible reply.';
    const persona=(m as any).persona?('\n\n'+(m as any).persona):'';
    const [layered, instr, kb] = await Promise.all([layeredContext(key), instructions(key), retrieve(key, msg)]);
    const sys=base+persona+layered+instr+kb+'\n\nLIVE DATA SNAPSHOT (read-only, captured just now):\n'+JSON.stringify(ctx).slice(0,9000);
    const rawReply=await llm(sys,[...history,{role:'user',content:msg}],1700)||'I could not reach the AI service just now — please try again in a moment.';
    let [clean,acts]=splitActions(rawReply); let finalReply=clean||rawReply; const notes:string[]=[];
    if(acts&&Array.isArray(acts.handoffs)){
      for(const h of acts.handoffs.slice(0,5)){
        const to=String(h?.to||'').toLowerCase(); if(!VALID_AGENTS.includes(to)||to===key) continue;
        const title=String(h?.title||'task').slice(0,160); const details=String(h?.details||'').slice(0,800);
        try{ await admin.from('agent_actions').insert({agent:to,kind:'handoff',status:'pending',risk:'low',title:('Handoff — '+title).slice(0,200),recommendation:details,detail:{from:key,from_name:m.name,requested_at:new Date().toISOString()},target_table:null}); notes.push('→ Handed to '+(NAMES[to]||to)+': '+title); }catch(_e){}
      }
    }
    // RESEARCH: dispatch the web-grounded kb_deepen engine to pull real sources and fill a knowledge gap.
    if(acts&&Array.isArray(acts.research)){
      const internal=await sec('inbound_secret');
      for(const rq of acts.research.slice(0,3)){
        const tgt=String(rq?.agent||key).replace(/^cat:/,'').trim();
        const topics=(Array.isArray(rq?.topics)?rq.topics:[]).map((t:any)=>String(t).slice(0,80)).filter(Boolean).slice(0,4);
        if(!tgt||!topics.length||!internal) continue;
        try{
          const rp=fetch(SUPA+'/functions/v1/kb_deepen',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({__secret:internal,agent:tgt,topics_list:topics,topics:topics.length})}).catch(()=>{});
          try{ (globalThis as any).EdgeRuntime?.waitUntil?.(rp); }catch(_e){}
          notes.push('🔎 Researching to fill knowledge ('+tgt+'): '+topics.join(', '));
        }catch(_e){}
      }
    }
    if(notes.length) finalReply=finalReply+'\n\n'+notes.join('\n');
    await admin.from('agent_chats').insert([{agent_key:key,role:'user',content:msg,created_by:email},{agent_key:key,role:'assistant',content:finalReply}]);
    if(/\b(remember|always|never|from now on|for future|going forward|note that|our policy|keep in mind|prefer)\b/i.test(msg)){ try{ if(await lintClean(msg)){ await admin.from('agent_memory').insert({agent_key:key,kind:'instruction',content:msg.slice(0,600),source:'founder_chat'}); } }catch(_e){} }
    try{ const p=learn(key,m.name,msg,finalReply); (globalThis as any).EdgeRuntime?.waitUntil?.(p); }catch(_e){}
    return J({reply:finalReply});
  }catch(e){ return J({error:String((e as Error)?.message||e)},500); }
});

// agent_learnings_report — weekly 'what agents learned' PDF. __secret or admin-JWT gated. Optional notify=founder.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'agent_learnings_report', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
}
const BASE = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')! + '/functions/v1';
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' } });
const esc = (s: string) => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>]/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;' } as any)[c]);
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
async function isAdmin(email: string){ if(!email) return false; const em=email.toLowerCase(); try{const{data}=await admin.rpc('fn_role_of',{p_email:em}); if(['owner','admin'].includes(String(data||'').toLowerCase())) return true;}catch(_e){} try{const{data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key','admin_emails').maybeSingle(); const list=String((data as any)?.value||'').toLowerCase().split(/[,;\s]+/).filter(Boolean); if(list.includes(em)) return true;}catch(_e){} return false; }

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return J({ ok: true });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    let ok = false;
    if (body?.__secret && body.__secret === (await sec('inbound_secret'))) ok = true;
    else { const tok = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '').trim(); if (tok) { const { data: u } = await admin.auth.getUser(tok); const em = u?.user?.email || ''; if (em && await isAdmin(em)) ok = true; } }
    if (!ok) { if (body?.__secret) { await logRun('error', { report_generated: 0 }, 'call rejected: wrong inbound secret supplied; no weekly agent-learnings report was generated'); } return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401); }

    const since = new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 864e5).toISOString();
    const [{ data: chunks }, { data: actions }, { data: decisions }, cov] = await Promise.all([
      admin.from('kb_chunks').select('category,title,created_at').gt('created_at', since).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(800),
      admin.from('agent_actions').select('agent,title,status,created_at').gt('created_at', since).limit(800),
      admin.from('decision_log').select('actor,kind,decision,created_at').gt('created_at', since).limit(800),
      admin.rpc('fn_ws_knowledge'),
    ]);
    const ck = (cov?.data as any)?.coverage_kpis || {};

    const byCat: Record<string, { n: number; titles: string[] }> = {};
    for (const c of (chunks || [])) { const k = (c as any).category || 'general'; (byCat[k] ||= { n: 0, titles: [] }); byCat[k].n++; if (byCat[k].titles.length < 3) byCat[k].titles.push((c as any).title); }
    const catRows = Object.entries(byCat).sort((a, b) => b[1].n - a[1].n);
    const gapsFilled = (actions || []).filter((a: any) => /filled knowledge gap/i.test(a.title || ''));
    const byAgent: Record<string, number> = {}; for (const a of (actions || [])) byAgent[(a as any).agent || 'agent'] = (byAgent[(a as any).agent || 'agent'] || 0) + 1;
    const byActor: Record<string, number> = {}; for (const d of (decisions || [])) byActor[(d as any).actor || 'agent'] = (byActor[(d as any).actor || 'agent'] || 0) + 1;

    const range = `${since.slice(0,10)} → ${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}`;
    let html = `<html><head><meta charset='utf-8'><style>body{font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;color:#0f172a;margin:32px}h1{color:#0d5c5c}h2{color:#0d5c5c;border-bottom:2px solid #e2e8f0;padding-bottom:4px;margin-top:24px}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:13px}td,th{border:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:6px 8px;text-align:left}.k{display:inline-block;margin-right:18px}.k b{font-size:22px;color:#0d5c5c}.muted{color:#64748b;font-size:12px}</style></head><body>`;
    html += `<h1>QuotesDone — Weekly Agent Learnings</h1><div class='muted'>${range}</div>`;
    html += `<h2>Knowledge coverage</h2><div><span class='k'><b>${ck.covered ?? 0}</b><br>covered</span><span class='k'><b>${ck.thin ?? 0}</b><br>thin</span><span class='k'><b>${ck.gaps ?? 0}</b><br>gaps</span><span class='k'><b>${ck.total ?? 0}</b><br>categories</span></div>`;
    html += `<h2>New knowledge added (${(chunks || []).length} chunks)</h2>`;
    if (catRows.length) { html += `<table><tr><th>Category</th><th>Chunks</th><th>Examples</th></tr>`; for (const [cat, v] of catRows) html += `<tr><td>${esc(cat)}</td><td>${v.n}</td><td>${esc(v.titles.join('; '))}</td></tr>`; html += `</table>`; } else html += `<div class='muted'>No new knowledge this week.</div>`;
    html += `<h2>Knowledge gaps filled (${gapsFilled.length})</h2>`;
    if (gapsFilled.length) { html += `<ul>`; for (const g of gapsFilled) html += `<li>${esc((g as any).title)} <span class='muted'>${esc(((g as any).created_at||'').slice(0,10))}</span></li>`; html += `</ul>`; } else html += `<div class='muted'>None this week.</div>`;
    html += `<h2>Agent activity (${(actions || []).length} actions)</h2><table><tr><th>Agent</th><th>Actions</th></tr>`; for (const [a, n] of Object.entries(byAgent).sort((x, y) => y[1] - x[1])) html += `<tr><td>${esc(a)}</td><td>${n}</td></tr>`; html += `</table>`;
    html += `<h2>Decisions logged (${(decisions || []).length})</h2><table><tr><th>Actor</th><th>Decisions</th></tr>`; for (const [a, n] of Object.entries(byActor).sort((x, y) => y[1] - x[1])) html += `<tr><td>${esc(a)}</td><td>${n}</td></tr>`; html += `</table>`;
    html += `<div class='muted' style='margin-top:28px'>Generated automatically by the QuotesDone knowledge curator.</div></body></html>`;

    const baseCounts = { chunks: (chunks || []).length, gaps_filled: gapsFilled.length, actions: (actions || []).length, decisions: (decisions || []).length, categories_with_new_knowledge: catRows.length };
    const r = await fetch(`${BASE}/make_pdf`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: await sec('inbound_secret'), html, title: 'Weekly Agent Learnings', name: 'agent-learnings-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10), bucket: 'finance-reports', folder: 'learnings' }) });
    const jd = await r.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    if (!jd?.url) { await logRun('error', { ...baseCounts, report_generated: 0, make_pdf_http: r.status }, 'weekly agent-learnings report FAILED to render: make_pdf returned no URL (' + String(jd?.error || 'render_failed') + '); the founder gets no weekly visibility into what the agents learned'); return J({ error: jd?.error || 'render_failed' }, 500); }

    let notifyFailed = '';
    if (body?.notify) {
      try { const _nt = await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type: 'weekly_learnings', to_role: 'founder', subject: 'Weekly agent learnings report', body: 'Your weekly report of what the agents learned is ready: ' + jd.url, html: `<p>Your weekly agent-learnings report is ready.</p><p><a href='${jd.url}'>Download the PDF</a></p>`, status: 'pending', channel: 'email' }); if (_nt && (_nt as any).error) { notifyFailed = String((_nt as any).error?.message || 'insert error'); } } catch (_e) { notifyFailed = String(_e); }
    }
    let note: string;
    if (baseCounts.chunks === 0 && baseCounts.gaps_filled === 0) { note = 'report rendered but the agents learned NOTHING this week: zero new knowledge chunks and zero knowledge gaps filled — the knowledge pipeline is producing no content'; }
    else { note = 'weekly agent-learnings report rendered: ' + baseCounts.chunks + ' new knowledge chunks across ' + catRows.length + ' categories, ' + baseCounts.gaps_filled + ' gaps filled, ' + baseCounts.actions + ' agent actions'; }
    if (notifyFailed) { note += ' | founder notification failed to queue, so the report was generated but nobody was told: ' + notifyFailed; }
    await logRun((notifyFailed || (baseCounts.chunks === 0 && baseCounts.gaps_filled === 0)) ? 'error' : 'ok', { ...baseCounts, report_generated: 1, notified: body?.notify ? (notifyFailed ? 0 : 1) : 0 }, note);
    return J({ ok: true, url: jd.url, path: jd.path, chunks: (chunks || []).length, gaps_filled: gapsFilled.length });
  } catch (e) { await logRun('error', { report_generated: 0 }, 'agent_learnings_report crashed before completing; no weekly agent-learnings report was produced: ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e)); return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});

// agents - scheduled autonomous ops workers. Risky actions queued into agent_actions for approval; safe work auto.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
const UA = 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; QuotesDoneComplianceBot/1.0; +https://quotesdone.com)';
const CAP = 30 * 1024 * 1024; const USD_AED = 3.6725;
const FN = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')! + '/functions/v1';
const ASSET = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')! + '/storage/v1/object/public/brand';
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
async function callFn(name: string, payload: Record<string, unknown>){ try { const sk = await sec('inbound_secret'); const r = await fetch(FN + '/' + name, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: sk, ...payload }) }); return await r.json(); } catch (e) { return { error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }; } }
function parseDate(v: unknown): Date | null { if (!v) return null; const s = String(v).trim(); let d = new Date(s); if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) return d; const m = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})[\/-](\d{1,2})[\/-](\d{2,4})$/); if (m) { let yy = Number(m[3]); if (yy < 100) yy += 2000; d = new Date(yy, Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[1])); if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) return d; } return null; }
async function queue(row: Record<string, unknown>) { try { await admin.from('agent_actions').insert(row); } catch (_e) {} }
async function sha256(s: string){ const data = new TextEncoder().encode(s); const h = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data); return Array.from(new Uint8Array(h)).map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('').slice(0, 40); }
const dayAgo = (d: number) => new Date(Date.now() - d * 864e5).toISOString();
// Background AI helpers on Opus 4.8 first, Sonnet 5 fallback, iterating models individually for resilience.
const llm = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 400 }); // shared OpenRouter client (Sonnet-first ladder + 25s timeout)
async function cnt(t: string, mod?: (q: any) => any){ let q = admin.from(t).select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }); if (mod) q = mod(q); const { count } = await q; return count || 0; }

async function onboarding() {
  const counts = { reviewed: 0, queued_approval: 0, licence_alerts: 0 };
  const { data: pend } = await admin.from('leads').select('id,company_name,emirate,approval_status,registration_submitted_at,ai_review_flags,ai_review_notes,license_expiry,trade_license_no,trn,accepted_terms_at,lifecycle_stage').eq('approval_status', 'pending').not('registration_submitted_at', 'is', null).order('registration_submitted_at', { ascending: true }).limit(60);
  for (const s of (pend || [])) {
    counts.reviewed++;
    const flags = Array.isArray(s.ai_review_flags) ? s.ai_review_flags : [];
    const exp = parseDate(s.license_expiry);
    const missing: string[] = [];
    if (!s.trade_license_no) missing.push('trade licence number');
    if (!s.accepted_terms_at) missing.push('terms not accepted');
    if (!exp) missing.push('licence expiry unreadable'); else if (exp.getTime() < Date.now()) missing.push('trade licence EXPIRED');
    const clean = flags.length === 0 && missing.length === 0;
    const title = String(s.company_name || ('Supplier #' + s.id)) + (s.emirate ? ' — ' + s.emirate : '');
    await queue({ agent: 'onboarding', kind: 'approve_supplier', status: 'pending', risk: 'high', title, recommendation: clean ? 'approve' : 'review', target_table: 'leads', target_id: String(s.id), detail: { emirate: s.emirate, flags, ai_notes: String(s.ai_review_notes || '').slice(0, 500), missing, licence_expiry: s.license_expiry || null } });
    counts.queued_approval++;
    if (s.lifecycle_stage !== 'registered') await admin.from('leads').update({ lifecycle_stage: 'registered' }).eq('id', s.id);
  }
  const { data: appr } = await admin.from('leads').select('id,company_name,emirate,license_expiry,lifecycle_stage').eq('approval_status', 'approved').not('license_expiry', 'is', null).limit(400);
  for (const s of (appr || [])) {
    const exp = parseDate(s.license_expiry); if (!exp) continue;
    const days = Math.round((exp.getTime() - Date.now()) / 864e5);
    if (days <= 30) { const expired = days < 0; await queue({ agent: 'onboarding', kind: expired ? 'licence_expired' : 'licence_expiring', status: 'pending', risk: expired ? 'high' : 'low', title: String(s.company_name || s.id) + (expired ? ' — licence EXPIRED' : ' — licence expires in ' + days + ' days'), recommendation: expired ? 'suspend / chase renewal' : 'remind supplier', target_table: 'leads', target_id: String(s.id), detail: { licence_expiry: s.license_expiry, days } }); counts.licence_alerts++; }
    if (s.lifecycle_stage !== 'active') await admin.from('leads').update({ lifecycle_stage: 'active' }).eq('id', s.id);
  }
  return counts;
}

's' : '') + ' waiting on QuotesDone', body: 'Hi' + first + ', you have ' + qn + ' quote' + (qn > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' ready for your ' + (inq.category || '') + ' request' + (inq.emirate ?   const { data: revq } = await admin.from('inbound_messages').select('id,from_email,subject,created_at').eq('needs_review', true).lt('created_at', dayAgo(3)).limit(50);
  for (const m of (revq || [])) { await queue({ agent: 'followup', kind: 'sla_review', status: 'pending', risk: 'low', title: 'Inbound email awaiting review: ' + String(m.subject || m.from_email || m.id).slice(0, 60), recommendation: 'clear in the Review queue', target_table: 'inbound_messages', target_id: String(m.id), detail: { from: m.from_email } }); counts.sla++; }
  const { data: gaps } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('id,category,emirate,created_at,status').lt('created_at', dayAgo(5)).not('status', 'in', CLOSED).limit(120);
  for (const inq of (gaps || [])) { const mn = await cnt('inquiry_matches', (q) => q.eq('inquiry_id', inq.id)); if (mn) continue; await queue({ agent: 'followup', kind: 'sla_no_supply', status: 'pending', risk: 'low', title: 'No suppliers matched: ' + (inq.category || '') + (inq.emirate ? ' / ' + inq.emirate : ''), recommendation: 'check category coverage / source suppliers', target_table: 'inquiries', target_id: String(inq.id), detail: { category: inq.category, emirate: inq.emirate } }); counts.sla++; }
  return counts;
}

async function marketing(){
  const counts = { drafts: 0 };
  const { data: cats } = await admin.from('seo_categories').select('slug,name').order('sort').limit(24);
  const since90 = new Date(Date.now() - 90 * 864e5).toISOString();
  const { data: inq } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('category').gte('created_at', since90);
  const demand: Record<string, number> = {}; for (const i of (inq || [])) { const c = i.category || ''; if (c) demand[c] = (demand[c] || 0) + 1; }
  const catNames = (cats || []).map((c) => c.name).join(', ');
  const out = await llm('You are the marketing content creator for QuotesDone, a UAE B2B anonymous quotation marketplace (customers post a job, get matched to vetted suppliers, compare anonymised quotes, and pay a small reveal fee to unlock the supplier they choose). Brand voice: practical, trustworthy, pro-SME. Produce a weekly content batch as STRICT JSON ONLY: {"drafts":[{"channel":"social|seo|email","category":"<a category name or empty>","title":"...","body":"..."}]}. Make exactly 5 drafts: 3 short punchy social posts (with 2-3 hashtags) for different categories, 1 SEO cost-guide article (title + a 120-180 word intro) for a high-demand category, and 1 short email tip. Do NOT invent statistics. Reply with JSON only, no preamble.', 'Categories: ' + catNames + '\nRecent demand by category (90d): ' + JSON.stringify(demand), 1900);
  let drafts: any[] = [];
  if (out) { const m = out.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (m) { try { drafts = JSON.parse(m[0]).drafts || []; } catch (_e) {} } }
  for (const d of drafts.slice(0, 8)) { if (!d || !d.body) continue; await admin.from('content_drafts').insert({ channel: String(d.channel || 'social').slice(0, 20), category: d.category ? String(d.category).slice(0, 80) : null, title: d.title ? String(d.title).slice(0, 200) : null, body: String(d.body).slice(0, 4000), status: 'draft', source: 'marketing_agent' }); counts.drafts++; }
  if (counts.drafts) await queue({ agent: 'marketing', kind: 'content_review', status: 'pending', risk: 'low', title: counts.drafts + ' new marketing drafts ready to review', recommendation: 'open the Marketing agent, review and post the ones you like', target_table: 'content_drafts', target_id: null, detail: { count: counts.drafts } });
  return counts;
}

async function categorySales(){
  const counts = { categories: 0, hot: 0, gaps: 0 };
  const { data: cats } = await admin.from('category_agents').select('slug,name').eq('active', true);
  for (const c of (cats || [])) {
    counts.categories++; const key = 'cat:' + c.slug;
    const { data: inqs } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('id,emirate,summary,status,created_at').ilike('category', '%' + c.slug + '%').gte('created_at', dayAgo(21)).not('status', 'in', CLOSED).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(40);
    for (const inq of (inqs || [])) {
      if (counts.hot + counts.gaps >= 60) break;
      const tn = await cnt('transactions', (q) => q.eq('inquiry_id', inq.id)); if (tn) continue;
      const { data: exists } = await admin.from('agent_actions').select('id').eq('agent', key).eq('target_id', String(inq.id)).eq('status', 'pending').limit(1);
      if (exists && exists.length) continue;
      const qn = await cnt('quotes', (q) => q.eq('inquiry_id', inq.id));
      const mn = await cnt('inquiry_matches', (q) => q.eq('inquiry_id', inq.id));
      if (qn > 0) { await queue({ agent: key, kind: 'hot_lead', status: 'pending', risk: 'low', title: 'Hot lead — ' + c.name + (inq.emirate ? ' / ' + inq.emirate : '') + ': ' + qn + ' quote(s), not revealed', recommendation: 'nudge the customer to reveal', target_table: 'inquiries', target_id: String(inq.id), detail: { category: c.slug, quotes: qn } }); counts.hot++; }
      else if (mn === 0) { await queue({ agent: key, kind: 'supply_gap', status: 'pending', risk: 'low', title: 'Supply gap — ' + c.name + (inq.emirate ? ' / ' + inq.emirate : '') + ': no suppliers matched', recommendation: 'source or activate suppliers in this category', target_table: 'inquiries', target_id: String(inq.id), detail: { category: c.slug } }); counts.gaps++; }
    }
    if (counts.hot + counts.gaps >= 60) break;
  }
  return counts;
}

async function bdOutreach(){
  const counts: Record<string, unknown> = { mode: 'plan', planned: 0, sent: 0, skipped: 0 };
  const enabled = (await sec('bd_outreach_enabled')) === 'true';
  const cap = Math.max(1, Math.min(200, Number(await sec('bd_daily_cap')) || 20));
  if (enabled) {
    counts.mode = 'send';
    const { data: q } = await admin.from('outreach').select('id,lead_id,email,subject,body').eq('status', 'queued').order('id', { ascending: true }).limit(cap);
    for (const o of (q || [])) { if (!o.email) { await admin.from('outreach').update({ status: 'skipped' }).eq('id', o.id); (counts.skipped as number)++; continue; } await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type: 'bd_invite', to_email: o.email, to_role: 'supplier', lead_id: o.lead_id, channel: 'email', subject: o.subject || 'An invitation to join QuotesDone', body: o.body || '' }); await admin.from('outreach').update({ status: 'sent', sent_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', o.id); (counts.sent as number)++; }
    return counts;
  }
  const queuedPending = await cnt('outreach', (q) => q.eq('status', 'queued'));
  if (queuedPending >= cap * 5) { counts.note = 'queue already has ' + queuedPending + ' planned invites; enable sending to work them off'; return counts; }
  const { data: taken0 } = await admin.from('outreach').select('lead_id');
  const taken = new Set((taken0 || []).map((r) => r.lead_id));
  const tplSub = 'Invitation to join QuotesDone — free supplier listing';
  const tplBody = 'Dear {{COMPANY}},\n\nWe would like to introduce QuotesDone, a UAE marketplace that connects customers with trusted suppliers across every trade and service. Customers post what they need, we match them to suitable suppliers, and each supplier submits a competitive, anonymised quote. The customer compares the quotes and pays a small fee only to unlock the supplier they choose — so every enquiry that reaches you comes from someone ready to buy.\n\nFor suppliers, joining is completely free: no subscription and no commission on the work you win.\n\nHow to register:\n1. Go to quotesdone.com/suppliers and create your account.\n2. Add your trade licence and list your full range of products and services — the more complete your details, the more accurately we can match you to relevant customer requests.\n3. Once approved, you start receiving matched enquiries and can quote directly.\n\nWe would be glad to welcome {{COMPANY}} to the network.';
  const { data: leads } = await admin.from('leads').select('id,company_name,email,categories,sector,emirate,app_rating,rating,reviews').eq('permanently_closed', false).eq('claimed', false).not('email', 'is', null).neq('email', '').order('app_rating', { ascending: false, nullsFirst: false }).order('rating', { ascending: false, nullsFirst: false }).order('reviews', { ascending: false, nullsFirst: false }).limit(cap * 5);
  let made = 0;
  for (const l of (leads || [])) {
    if (made >= cap) break; if (taken.has(l.id) || !l.email) continue;
    const trade = (l.sector || (l.categories ? String(l.categories).split(/[,;]/)[0].trim() : '') || 'your services');
    const link = 'https://quotesdone.com/suppliers';
    const fill = (s: string) => String(s || '').replace(/\{\{COMPANY\}\}/g, l.company_name || 'there').replace(/\{\{TRADE\}\}/g, trade).replace(/\{\{EMIRATE\}\}/g, l.emirate || 'the UAE').replace(/\{\{LINK\}\}/g, link);
    const subject = fill(tplSub).slice(0, 160);
    let bodyTxt = fill(tplBody).slice(0, 2000);
    if (!/quotesdone\.com\/portal/.test(bodyTxt)) bodyTxt += '\n\nRegister at quotesdone.com/portal';
    await admin.from('outreach').insert({ lead_id: l.id, source: 'database', email: l.email, company: l.company_name, category: trade, emirate: l.emirate, channel: 'email', status: 'queued', subject, body: bodyTxt });
    taken.add(l.id); made++; (counts.planned as number)++;
  }
  if ((counts.planned as number) > 0) await queue({ agent: 'bd_outreach', kind: 'bd_batch', status: 'pending', risk: 'low', title: (counts.planned as number) + ' supplier invites drafted and queued (NOT sent)', recommendation: 'review in the BD / Outreach Rep agent; enable sending when ready', target_table: 'outreach', target_id: null, detail: { planned: counts.planned, mode: 'plan' } });
  return counts;
}

async function itHealth(){
  const counts: Record<string, number> = { checks: 0, up: 0, down: 0, alerts: 0 };
  const targets: [string, string][] = [['home', 'https://quotesdone.com/'], ['app', 'https://quotesdone.com/me'], ['portal', 'https://quotesdone.com/portal'], ['admin', 'https://quotesdone.com/os']];
  for (const [name, url] of targets) {
    counts.checks++; const t0 = Date.now(); let ok = false, code = 0, detail = '';
    try { const ctrl = new AbortController(); const tm = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 15000); const r = await fetch(url, { method: 'GET', redirect: 'follow', signal: ctrl.signal, headers: { 'User-Agent': UA } }); clearTimeout(tm); code = r.status; ok = r.ok; try { await r.body?.cancel(); } catch (_e) {} } catch (e) { detail = String((e as Error)?.message || e); }
    const lat = Date.now() - t0;
    await admin.from('health_checks').insert({ check_kind: 'http', target: name, ok, status_code: code, latency_ms: lat, detail });
    if (ok) counts.up++; else { counts.down++; await queue({ agent: 'it', kind: 'incident', status: 'pending', risk: 'high', title: 'Page DOWN: ' + name + ' (' + (code || detail || 'no response') + ')', recommendation: 'check the Vercel deploy / edge function; page returned non-200', target_table: 'health_checks', target_id: null, detail: { url, code, detail } }); counts.alerts++; }
  }
  const { data: fails } = await admin.from('agent_runs').select('agent,note').eq('status', 'error').gte('started_at', dayAgo(1)).order('id', { ascending: false }).limit(10);
  if (fails && fails.length) { const agents = [...new Set(fails.map((f) => f.agent))]; await admin.from('health_checks').insert({ check_kind: 'agent_runs', target: agents.join(','), ok: false, detail: fails.length + ' failed runs' }); await queue({ agent: 'it', kind: 'incident', status: 'pending', risk: 'medium', title: fails.length + ' agent run(s) failed in last 24h', recommendation: 'review failing jobs: ' + agents.join(', '), target_table: 'agent_runs', target_id: null, detail: { agents } }); counts.alerts++; }
  if (counts.down > 0) { const owner = String(await sec('admin_emails') || 'management@quotesdone.com').split(',')[0].trim(); await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type: 'it_alert', to_email: owner, to_role: 'admin', channel: 'email', subject: '⚠ QuotesDone IT alert: ' + counts.down + ' page(s) down', body: 'The IT monitor found ' + counts.down + ' page(s) returning errors. Open the IT agent in admin for details.' }); }
  return counts;
}

async function security(){
  const counts: Record<string, number> = { scanned: 0, suspicious: 0, violations7d: 0, banned: 0, events: 0 };
  const buckets = ['quote-files', 'drawing-files', 'supplier-docs', 'receipt-files'];
  const badExt = /\.(exe|bat|cmd|com|scr|msi|ps1|vbs|js|jar|sh|apk|dll|hta|wsf|docm|xlsm|pptm|iso|img|html?|svg)$/i;
  const okExt = /\.(pdf|png|jpe?g|webp|gif|heic|heif|dwg|dxf|docx?|xlsx?|csv|txt)$/i;
  const scan = async (b: string, path: string, meta: any) => {
    counts.scanned++; const sizeB = Number(meta?.size || 0); const mime = String(meta?.mimetype || ''); let sev = ''; let why = '';
    if (/\.[a-z0-9]{2,5}\.(exe|js|scr|bat|html?|svg|hta)$/i.test(path)) { sev = 'high'; why = 'double extension'; }
    else if (badExt.test(path)) { sev = 'high'; why = 'dangerous file type'; }
    else if (!okExt.test(path)) { sev = 'medium'; why = 'unexpected file type'; }
    else if (sizeB > 30 * 1024 * 1024) { sev = 'medium'; why = 'oversized (' + Math.round(sizeB / 1048576) + 'MB)'; }
    else if (sizeB === 0) { sev = 'low'; why = 'empty file'; }
    if (sev) { counts.suspicious++; counts.events++; await admin.from('security_events').insert({ kind: 'suspicious_upload', severity: sev, source: b, subject: path.slice(0, 200), detail: { mime, size: sizeB, why } }); if (sev === 'high') await queue({ agent: 'security', kind: 'security_alert', status: 'pending', risk: 'high', title: 'Suspicious upload (' + why + '): ' + path.slice(0, 80), recommendation: 'inspect/remove the file in storage; do NOT open it directly', target_table: 'security_events', target_id: null, detail: { bucket: b, path, mime, size: sizeB, why } }); }
  };
  for (const b of buckets) {
    try {
      const { data: top } = await admin.storage.from(b).list('', { limit: 80, sortBy: { column: 'created_at', order: 'desc' } });
      for (const f of (top || [])) {
        if (counts.scanned >= 250) break;
        if ((f as any).id && (f as any).metadata) { await scan(b, f.name, (f as any).metadata); }
        else { const { data: sub } = await admin.storage.from(b).list(f.name, { limit: 40, sortBy: { column: 'created_at', order: 'desc' } }); for (const s of (sub || [])) { if (counts.scanned >= 250) break; await scan(b, f.name + '/' + s.name, (s as any).metadata); } }
      }
    } catch (_e) {}
  }
  counts.violations7d = await cnt('chat_violations', (q) => q.gte('created_at', dayAgo(7)));
  const bl = await cnt('leads', (q) => q.eq('banned', true)); const bc = await cnt('customers', (q) => q.eq('banned', true)); counts.banned = bl + bc;
  if (counts.violations7d > 0) { await admin.from('security_events').insert({ kind: 'contact_disclosure', severity: 'medium', source: 'chat', subject: counts.violations7d + ' contact-sharing attempt(s) in 7d', detail: { count: counts.violations7d } }); counts.events++; }
  if (counts.suspicious > 0) { const owner = String(await sec('admin_emails') || 'management@quotesdone.com').split(',')[0].trim(); await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type: 'security_alert', to_email: owner, to_role: 'admin', channel: 'email', subject: '⚠ QuotesDone security: ' + counts.suspicious + ' suspicious file(s) flagged', body: 'The Security agent flagged ' + counts.suspicious + ' uploaded file(s) during its scan. Open the Security agent in admin for details. Do not open flagged files directly.' }); }
  return counts;
}

function isAsset(url: string){ return /\.(pdf|ashx|aspx|docx?|xlsx?)(\?|$)/i.test(url) || /\/-\/media\//i.test(url) || /\/media\//i.test(url); }
async function assetInfo(url: string){ const ctrl = new AbortController(); const t = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 25000); let ok = false, status = 0; let lastModified: string | null = null, contentLength: string | null = null, etag: string | null = null, total: string | null = null; let err = ''; try { try { const h = await fetch(url, { method: 'HEAD', headers: { 'User-Agent': UA }, redirect: 'follow', signal: ctrl.signal }); status = h.status; ok = h.ok; lastModified = h.headers.get('last-modified'); contentLength = h.headers.get('content-length'); etag = h.headers.get('etag'); } catch (_e) {} try { const g = await fetch(url, { method: 'GET', headers: { 'User-Agent': UA, 'Range': 'bytes=0-0' }, redirect: 'follow', signal: ctrl.signal }); if (g.status === 206 || g.ok) { ok = true; status = g.status; const cr = g.headers.get('content-range'); if (cr) { const m = cr.match(/\/(\d+)\s*$/); if (m) total = m[1]; } if (!etag) etag = g.headers.get('etag'); if (!lastModified) lastModified = g.headers.get('last-modified'); if (!contentLength) contentLength = g.headers.get('content-length'); } else if (!ok) { status = g.status; } try { await g.body?.cancel(); } catch (_e) {} } catch (e) { if (!ok) err = String((e as Error)?.message || e); } clearTimeout(t); return { ok, status, lastModified, contentLength, etag, total, err }; } catch (e) { clearTimeout(t); return { ok: false, status: 0, lastModified: null, contentLength: null, etag: null, total: null, err: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }; } }
function assetSignature(h: any){ const size = h.total || h.contentLength; let lm = h.lastModified; if (lm) { const lmMs = new Date(lm).getTime(); if (isNaN(lmMs) || Math.abs(Date.now() - lmMs) < 6 * 3600 * 1000) lm = null; } const parts = [ h.etag ? ('etag ' + h.etag) : '', size ? ('size ' + size) : '', lm ? ('mod ' + lm) : '' ].filter(Boolean); return 'file: ' + (parts.join(' | ') || 'reachable'); }
async function fetchHtml(url: string){ const ctrl = new AbortController(); const t = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 25000); try { const r = await fetch(url, { headers: { 'User-Agent': UA, 'Accept': 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml' }, redirect: 'follow', signal: ctrl.signal }); clearTimeout(t); if (!r.ok) return { ok: false, status: r.status, text: '' }; let body = await r.text(); body = body.replace(/<script[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi, ' ').replace(/<style[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi, ' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ').replace(/&nbsp;/g, ' ').replace(/&amp;/g, '&').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); return { ok: true, status: r.status, text: body.slice(0, 8000) }; } catch (e) { clearTimeout(t); return { ok: false, status: 0, text: '', err: String((e as Error)?.message || e) } as any; } }
async function fetchReader(url: string){ const ctrl = new AbortController(); const t = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 28000); try { const r = await fetch('https://r.jina.ai/' + url, { headers: { 'User-Agent': UA, 'Accept': 'text/plain' }, redirect: 'follow', signal: ctrl.signal }); clearTimeout(t); if (!r.ok) return { ok: false, status: r.status, text: '' }; let body = await r.text(); body = body.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); return { ok: true, status: r.status, text: body.slice(0, 8000) }; } catch (e) { clearTimeout(t); return { ok: false, status: 0, text: '', err: String((e as Error)?.message || e) } as any; } }
async function downloadAsset(url: string){ const ctrl = new AbortController(); const t = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 45000); try { const r = await fetch(url, { headers: { 'User-Agent': UA }, redirect: 'follow', signal: ctrl.signal }); clearTimeout(t); if (!r.ok) return { ok: false, status: r.status }; const ct = r.headers.get('content-type') || 'application/octet-stream'; const buf = new Uint8Array(await r.arrayBuffer()); return { ok: true, status: r.status, bytes: buf, contentType: ct }; } catch (e) { clearTimeout(t); return { ok: false, status: 0, err: String((e as Error)?.message || e) } as any; } }
async function storeDoc(id: number, oldPath: string | null, body: Uint8Array | string, contentType: string, ext: string){ const p = String(id) + '/' + Date.now() + '.' + ext; const payload = typeof body === 'string' ? new Blob([body], { type: contentType }) : body; const { error } = await admin.storage.from('compliance-docs').upload(p, payload, { contentType, upsert: true }); if (error) return null; if (oldPath && oldPath !== p) { try { await admin.storage.from('compliance-docs').remove([oldPath]); } catch (_e) {} } return p; }
async function compliance(){
  const counts = { checked: 0, reachable: 0, unreachable: 0, downloaded: 0, changes_proposed: 0 };
  const { data: srcs } = await admin.from('compliance_sources').select('*').eq('active', true).limit(60);
  if (!srcs || !srcs.length) return counts;
  for (const s of srcs) {
    counts.checked++; const mode = s.fetch_mode || 'direct'; const upd: Record<string, unknown> = { last_checked_at: new Date().toISOString() };
    let reachable = false; let sig = ''; let summary = ''; let textForStore: string | null = null; const asset = mode !== 'reader' && isAsset(s.url);
    if (mode === 'reader') { const f = await fetchReader(s.url); if (f.ok && f.text.length >= 200) { reachable = true; textForStore = f.text; sig = 'text:' + await sha256(f.text); } else upd.note = 'reader unreachable (' + (f.status || (f as any).err || '?') + ')'; }
    else if (asset) { const h = await assetInfo(s.url); if (h.ok) { reachable = true; sig = assetSignature(h); summary = 'The official published document was re-issued by the authority.'; } else upd.note = 'unreachable (' + (h.status || h.err || '?') + ')'; }
    else { const f = await fetchHtml(s.url); if (f.ok && f.text.length >= 200) { reachable = true; textForStore = f.text; sig = 'text:' + await sha256(f.text); } else upd.note = 'unreachable (' + (f.status || (f as any).err || '?') + ')'; }
    if (!reachable) { counts.unreachable++; await admin.from('compliance_sources').update(upd).eq('id', s.id); continue; }
    counts.reachable++; const firstBaseline = !s.last_signature; const diff = sig !== s.last_signature; upd.last_signature = sig; upd.note = 'ok'; let meaningful = false;
    if (!firstBaseline && diff) { if (asset) meaningful = true; else if (textForStore) { const out = await llm('You compare official UAE regulatory page snapshots. Decide if the NEW snapshot reflects a SUBSTANTIVE regulatory change (new edition, circular, effective date, changed requirement) vs cosmetic/nav/news noise. Reply ONLY JSON {"changed":true|false,"summary":"one sentence"}.', 'Authority: ' + s.authority + '\nTopic: ' + s.topic + '\nOLD signature: ' + s.last_signature + '\n\nNEW PAGE TEXT:\n' + textForStore, 300); if (out) { const m = out.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (m) { try { const pj = JSON.parse(m[0]); meaningful = pj.changed === true; summary = String(pj.summary || ''); } catch (_e) {} } } } }
    const shouldStore = !s.doc_path || diff;
    if (shouldStore) { if (asset) { const dl = await downloadAsset(s.url); if (dl.ok && dl.bytes && dl.bytes.length <= CAP) { const ext = (dl.contentType || '').includes('pdf') || /\.pdf|\.ashx/i.test(s.url) ? 'pdf' : 'bin'; const pth = await storeDoc(s.id, s.doc_path, dl.bytes, dl.contentType, ext); if (pth) { upd.doc_path = pth; upd.doc_bytes = dl.bytes.length; upd.doc_content_type = dl.contentType; upd.doc_downloaded_at = new Date().toISOString(); counts.downloaded++; } } } else if (textForStore) { const pth = await storeDoc(s.id, s.doc_path, textForStore, 'text/plain', 'txt'); if (pth) { upd.doc_path = pth; upd.doc_bytes = textForStore.length; upd.doc_content_type = 'text/plain'; upd.doc_downloaded_at = new Date().toISOString(); counts.downloaded++; } } }
    if (meaningful) { upd.last_changed_at = new Date().toISOString(); upd.last_summary = summary.slice(0, 500); const appendNote = '\n\n[Update ' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + ' — ' + s.authority + ', ' + s.topic + '] ' + (summary || 'Governing document appears updated') + ' (source: ' + s.url + '). Verify before quoting.'; await queue({ agent: 'compliance', kind: 'compliance_update', status: 'pending', risk: 'high', title: s.authority + ' — ' + s.topic + ': possible code update', recommendation: 'review & append dated note to compliance reference', target_table: 'compliance_sources', target_id: String(s.id), detail: { authority: s.authority, topic: s.topic, url: s.url, summary, append_note: appendNote } }); counts.changes_proposed++; }
    await admin.from('compliance_sources').update(upd).eq('id', s.id);
  }
  return counts;
}

function money(n: number){ return 'AED ' + Math.round(Number(n) || 0).toLocaleString('en-US'); }
function esc(s: string){ return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;'); }

  const { data: ent7 } = await admin.from('expense_entries').select('amount,currency').neq('category', 'Subscription').gte('charged_on', wkIso);
  let usage7 = 0; for (const e of (ent7 || [])) usage7 += Number(e.amount) * (String(e.currency).toUpperCase() === 'AED' ? 1 : USD_AED);
  const { data: ent30 } = await admin.from('expense_entries').select('amount,currency,vendor').neq('category', 'Subscription').gte('charged_on', m30);
  let usage30 = 0; const usageByVendor: Record<string, number> = {}; for (const e of (ent30 || [])) { const a = Number(e.amount) * (String(e.currency).toUpperCase() === 'AED' ? 1 : USD_AED); usage30 += a; usageByVendor[e.vendor] = (usageByVendor[e.vendor] || 0) + a; }
  for (const v of Object.keys(usageByVendor)) byVendor.push([v, 'Usage', 'last 30d', '—', Math.round(usageByVendor[v]) + ' AED']);
  weeklyAed += usage7; monthlyAed += usage30;
  const { data: tx } = await admin.from('transactions').select('reveal_fee,app_fee,fee_status,refund_status,revealed_at');

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
