```typescript
// ai_health - lightweight AI-provider liveness monitor. Pings OpenRouter's free /key endpoint (no tokens spent)
// to confirm the model gateway + API key are reachable. Raises a DEDUPED operator alert (founder_alerts +
// admin notification) only on the transition INTO an outage (2 consecutive failures), and logs recovery when it
// returns. Consecutive-failure state persists in app_secrets.ai_health_fails. Secret-gated (verify_jwt=false).
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
async function setSec(k: string, v: string) { try { await admin.from('app_secrets').upsert({ key: k, value: v }, { onConflict: 'key' }); } catch (_e) { /* */ } }

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  const started = new Date().toISOString();
  try {
    let body: any = {}; try { body = await req.json(); } catch (_e) { /* cron may send none */ }

    // SECURITY FIX 19 Jul 2026 ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // The gate used to read:
    //     if (body.__secret !== undefined && body.__secret !== await sec('inbound_secret')) -> 403
    // The reject branch only fired when a secret was SUPPLIED AND WRONG, so an empty POST ({})
    // skipped the check entirely. That mattered more here than on a read-only endpoint, because
    // an anonymous caller could reach setSec('ai_health_fails', ...) - a service-role WRITE into
    // app_secrets - and by hammering this endpoint while OpenRouter was healthy could drive the
    // counter to 0 and suppress the paging transition, hiding a real AI outage from the operator.
    // It could also manufacture a false 'ai_provider_down' page. Now fails CLOSED; the
    // ai_health_15min cron caller already passes the secret, so legitimate traffic is unaffected.
    const expected = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!expected) {
      try { await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'ai_health', started_at: started, finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'error', counts: { authorised: 0, secret_lookup_ok: 0 }, note: 'ai_health refused every caller because inbound_secret could not be read from app_secrets. The AI-provider liveness check did NOT run, so an absence of ai_provider_down alerts right now means the monitor is blind, not that the provider is healthy.' }); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
      return J({ error: 'secret unavailable' }, 503);
    }
    if (!secretOk(expected) || body.__secret !== expected) {
      try { await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'ai_health', started_at: started, finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'error', counts: { authorised: 0, bad_or_missing_secret: 1 }, note: 'ai_health rejected an unauthenticated caller (403). Before 19 Jul 2026 a request with no __secret was ACCEPTED and could write app_secrets.ai_health_fails, so a rejection here may be a scanner probing the old hole - or an internal caller never updated to send the secret. This run performed NO liveness check.' }); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
      return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    }

    const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key');
    const admin_email = (await sec('admin_emails') || 'management@quotesdone.com').split(',')[0].trim();
    const THRESHOLD = 2; // consecutive failures before we page

    let ok = false; let detail = '';
    if (!key) { detail = 'no openrouter_api_key configured'; }
    else {
      try {
        const ctrl = new AbortController(); const tt = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 8000);
        const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/key', { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + key }, signal: ctrl.signal });
        clearTimeout(tt);
        ok = r.ok; if (!ok) detail = 'HTTP ' + r.status + ' from OpenRouter /key';
      } catch (e) { detail = 'fetch error: ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0, 140); }
    }

    const prior = parseInt((await sec('ai_health_fails')) || '0', 10) || 0;

    // record a heartbeat run (best-effort)
    try { await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'ai_health', started_at: started, finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: ok ? 'ok' : 'error', counts: { authorised: 1, consecutive_fails: ok ? 0 : prior + 1, detail }, note: ok ? 'ai_health confirmed the OpenRouter gateway and API key are reachable. AI-dependent agents are operating normally.' : ('ai_health could not reach the AI provider (' + detail + '). This is failure ' + (prior + 1) + ' in a row; paging happens at ' + THRESHOLD + '. AI-dependent steps are degraded and intake is on keyword fallback.') }); } catch (_e) { /* */ }

    if (ok) {
      if (prior >= THRESHOLD) {
        try { await admin.from('founder_alerts').insert({ level: 'info', event: 'ai_recovered', detail: 'AI provider (OpenRouter) is reachable again after ' + prior + ' failed checks.', channel: 'system' }); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
        try { await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type: 'ai_recovered', to_email: admin_email, to_role: 'admin', channel: 'email', subject: 'AI provider recovered', body: 'The AI model gateway (OpenRouter) is reachable again. Agents can resume automatically. Any queued jobs will drain on their next scheduled run.', status: 'queued' }); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
      }
      await setSec('ai_health_fails', '0');
      return J({ ok: true, healthy: true, recovered: prior >= THRESHOLD });
    }

    const fails = prior + 1;
    await setSec('ai_health_fails', String(fails));
    if (fails === THRESHOLD) {
      try { await admin.from('founder_alerts').insert({ level: 'crit', event: 'ai_provider_down', detail: 'AI provider (OpenRouter) unreachable on ' + fails + ' consecutive checks — ' + detail + '. Agents (matching, comparison, intake reasoning) are degraded; jobs are preserved and will auto-retry on recovery. Intake keeps working on keyword fallback.', channel: 'system' }); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
      try { await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type: 'ai_provider_down', to_email: admin_email, to_role: 'admin', channel: 'email', subject: 'AI provider appears DOWN', body: 'The AI model gateway (OpenRouter) has failed ' + fails + ' consecutive health checks (' + detail + ').\n\nWhat this means: AI-dependent steps (supplier matching, quote comparison, intake reasoning) are paused. Customer intake still works on the keyword fallback, and all in-flight jobs are preserved — they will be routed automatically once the provider recovers. No customer or supplier sees a raw error.\n\nWhat to do: usually nothing — this self-recovers. If it persists, check the OpenRouter status page and the API key limit in the OS.', status: 'queued' }); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    }
    return J({ ok: true, healthy: false, consecutive_fails: fails, paged: fails === THRESHOLD, detail });
  } catch (e) {
    try { await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'ai_health', started_at: started, finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'error', counts: { unhandled_exception: 1 }, note: 'ai_health threw an unhandled exception and returned 500: ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0, 200) + ' — no liveness verdict was produced, so silence from this monitor does not mean the AI provider is healthy.' }); } catch (_e2) { /* */ }
    return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500);
  }
});
```

```typescript
  const bodyHtml = esc(bodyText).replace(/(https?:\/\/[^\s<]+)/g, '<a href="$1" style="color:#0d9488">$1</a>').replace(/\n/g,'<br>');
  return `<!doctype html><html><body style="margin:0;background:#f6f7f9;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;color:#1f2937"><div style="max-width:600px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px"><div style="background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:12px;padding:28px"><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:6px">${logoTag}<div style="font-weight:800;font-size:18px;color:#0d9488">Quotes<span style="color:#111827">Done</span></div><div style="margin-left:auto;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#b91c1c;background:#fef2f2;border:1px solid #fecaca;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px">ACTION NEEDED</div></div><h2 style="margin:14px 0 12px;font-size:19px;line-height:1.3;color:#0f172a">${esc(subject)}</h2><div style="font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;color:#1f2937">${bodyHtml}</div><div style="margin-top:22px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid #eef0f2;font-size:13px;color:#6b7280">Open the OS to act: <a href="https://quotesdone.com/os" style="color:#0d9488">quotesdone.com/os</a></div></div><div style="text-align:center;color:#9ca3af;font-size:12px;margin-top:14px">QuotesDone OS &middot; founder alert &middot; Dubai, UAE</div></div></body></html>`;
}
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error:'forbidden' }, 403);
    const event = String(body.event||'').slice(0,140); if(!event) return J({ error:'event required' }, 400);
    const detail = String(body.detail||'').slice(0,1000);
    const level = String(body.level||'info').toLowerCase();
    const force = body.force === true;
    await admin.from('founder_alerts').insert({ level, event, detail, channel:'pending' });
    const shouldNotify = force || ACTIONABLE.has(level);
    if (!shouldNotify) {
      await admin.from('founder_alerts').update({ channel: 'logged' }).eq('event', event).order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(1);
      return J({ ok:true, notified:false, logged:true, reason:'non-actionable level suppressed (no email sent)' });
    }
    // De-dupe: if the same event was emailed in the last 6h, skip a repeat email (still logged above).
    if (body.dedupe_key || event) {
      const key = String(body.dedupe_key || event);
      const since = new Date(Date.now() - 6*3600e3).toISOString();
      const { count } = await admin.from('notifications').select('id', { count:'exact', head:true }).eq('type','founder_alert').ilike('subject', '%'+key.slice(0,60)+'%').gte('created_at', since).eq('status','sent');
      if ((count||0) > 0) { await admin.from('founder_alerts').update({ channel:'deduped' }).eq('event',event).order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(1); return J({ ok:true, notified:false, deduped:true }); }
    }
    const msg = `[${level.toUpperCase()}] ${event}${detail? '\n\n'+detail : ''}`;
    let wa=false, email=false;
    const phone = await sec('admin_mfa_phone'); const inbound = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (phone && ['critical','urgent','high','danger'].includes(level)) {
      const r = await fetch(`${Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')}/functions/v1/send_whatsapp`, { method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: inbound, to: phone, body: 'QuotesDone ['+level+']: '+event+(detail?' — '+detail:'') }) });
      const jd = await r.json().catch(()=>({})); wa = !!jd?.ok;
    }
    const admins = (await sec('admin_emails')||'').split(/[,;\s]+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (admins[0]) { const logo=(await sec('email_logo_url'))||''; await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type:'founder_alert', to_email: admins[0], to_role:'founder', subject:`[Action needed] ${event}`, body: msg, html: wrapInternal(event, detail || event, logo), status:'queued', channel:'email' }); email=true; }
    await admin.from('founder_alerts').update({ channel: wa?'whatsapp':(email?'email':'none') }).eq('event',event).order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(1);
    return J({ ok:true, whatsapp:wa, email, notified:true });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message||e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/analytics_recommend/index.ts

```typescript
// analytics_recommend — the Analytics & Intelligence department's data-grounded advisory executor.
// Pulls LIVE marketplace + funnel metrics (fn_query_platform), then has the analytics head synthesize
// a concrete, prioritized recommendation that CITES those numbers — instead of reasoning in the
// abstract. Records the recommendation as a shared org insight (org_memory). Read + recommend only:
// NO business side effects, which is why it is safe to run for advisory-tier tasks.
// Auth: __secret (cos_execute / cron) OR admin-email JWT.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
const llm = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 900, temperature: 0.2 });
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
async function authed(req: Request, body: any): Promise<boolean> {
  if (body.__secret && body.__secret === (await sec('inbound_secret'))) return true;
  const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, ''); if (!jwt) return false;
  const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
  const allow = (await sec('admin_emails') || 'management@quotesdone.com').split(',').map((s) => s.trim().toLowerCase());
  return !!(user?.email && allow.includes(user.email.toLowerCase()));
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    if (!(await authed(req, body))) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);

    // Resolve the task (title/detail/objective) — cos_execute passes task_id.
    let title = String(body.title || '').trim(), detail = String(body.detail || '').trim(), objectiveText = '';
    if (body.task_id) {
      const { data: t } = await admin.from('org_tasks').select('title,detail,objective_id').eq('id', body.task_id).maybeSingle();
      if (t) { title = title || t.title || ''; detail = detail || t.detail || ''; if (t.objective_id) { const { data: o } = await admin.from('org_objectives').select('objective').eq('id', t.objective_id).maybeSingle(); objectiveText = o?.objective || ''; } }
    }
    if (!title) title = 'Produce an analytics recommendation on current marketplace performance';

    // Pull the LIVE data (same RPCs the OS dashboards use).
    const [{ data: analytics }, { data: funnel }, { data: company }] = await Promise.all([
      admin.rpc('fn_query_platform', { p_topic: 'analytics', p_args: {} }),
      admin.rpc('fn_query_platform', { p_topic: 'funnel', p_args: { days: 30 } }),
      admin.rpc('fn_query_platform', { p_topic: 'company', p_args: {} }),
    ]);

    const sys = 'You are the head of Analytics & Intelligence at QuotesDone, a UAE B2B anonymous quotation marketplace. Turn the live data into a DECISION. Ground every claim in the numbers provided and cite the specific figure in-line. Produce a concrete, prioritized recommendation of at most 3-4 points; for each, name the metric that justifies it and the department that should own the action. Be honest about pre-launch / low-volume data — flag when a number is too small to act on rather than over-reading noise. Never invent numbers not present in the data. End with a single line "RESULT:" summarizing the top recommendation in one sentence.';
    const user = 'ANALYTICS TASK: ' + title + (detail ? ('\n' + detail) : '') + (objectiveText ? ('\nParent objective: ' + objectiveText) : '') +
      '\n\nLIVE MARKETPLACE ANALYTICS:\n' + JSON.stringify(analytics || {}) +
      '\n\nCONVERSION FUNNEL (30d):\n' + JSON.stringify(funnel || {}) +
      '\n\nCOMPANY SNAPSHOT:\n' + JSON.stringify(company || {}) +
      '\n\nWrite the data-grounded recommendation now.';
    const rec = (await llm(sys, user, 900) || '').trim();
    if (!rec || rec.length < 40) return J({ error: 'analytics_llm_unavailable' }, 502);

    const m = rec.match(/RESULT:\s*(.+)\s*$/i);
    const oneLine = (m ? m[1] : rec.slice(0, 180)).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 300);

    // Record as a shared organizational insight (reusable by every department). No side effects.
    try { await admin.from('org_memory').insert({ scope: 'analytics', kind: 'insight', content: (title + ' — ' + oneLine).slice(0, 500) + '\n\n' + rec.slice(0, 3000), source: 'analytics_recommend' }); } catch (_e) {}

    return J({ ok: true, note: 'Produced a data-grounded recommendation citing live funnel/marketplace metrics; recorded as a shared org insight. ' + oneLine, recommendation: rec.slice(0, 4000) });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/apify_scrape/index.ts

```typescript
// apify_scrape - drives Apify Google-Maps scraping into public.leads. Secret-guarded (inbound_secret).
// Actions: account | start | status | collect. Token read from app_secrets.apify_token.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const API = 'https://api.apify.com/v2';
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string|undefined)||undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
function dom(u: string|null){ if(!u) return null; try{ return new URL(u).hostname.replace(/^www\./,'').toLowerCase(); }catch{ return null; } }
function firstArr(v: unknown){ return Array.isArray(v) ? v[0] : (typeof v==='string'? v : null); }
function mapItem(it: any){
  const website = it.website || null;
  const emails: string[] = Array.isArray(it.emails) ? it.emails : (it.email ? [it.email] : []);
  let email = (emails.find((e)=>typeof e==='string' && /@/.test(e)) || '').toLowerCase() || null;
  if (email && /^(no-?reply|donotreply|mailer-daemon)@/.test(email)) email = null;
  return {
    company_name: it.title || null,
    phone: it.phone || null,
    phone_e164: it.phoneUnformatted || null,
    website, domain: dom(website),
    street: it.street || it.address || null,
    city: it.city || null,
    rating_maps: (typeof it.totalScore==='number'? it.totalScore : null),
    reviews_maps: (typeof it.reviewsCount==='number'? it.reviewsCount : null),
    categories: it.categoryName || (Array.isArray(it.categories)? it.categories.join(', ') : null),
    maps_url: it.url || null,
    place_id: it.placeId || null,
    email, email_domain: email ? email.split('@')[1] : null,
    instagram: firstArr(it.instagrams) || it.instagram || null,
    facebook: firstArr(it.facebooks) || it.facebook || null,
    linkedin: firstArr(it.linkedIns) || it.linkedin || null,
  };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const tok = await sec('apify_token'); if (!tok) return J({ error: 'no_apify_token' }, 200);
    const action = String(body.action||'');

    if (action === 'account') {
      const r = await fetch(`${API}/users/me/limits?token=${tok}`);
      const me = await fetch(`${API}/users/me?token=${tok}`).then(x=>x.json()).catch(()=>({}));
      const lim = await r.json().catch(()=>({}));
      return J({ ok: r.ok, username: me?.data?.username||null, plan: me?.data?.plan?.id||null, limits: lim?.data||lim });
    }

    if (action === 'start') {
      const actor = String(body.actor||'compass/crawler-google-places').replace('/','~');
      const r = await fetch(`${API}/acts/${actor}/runs?token=${tok}`, { method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify(body.input||{}) });
      const jd = await r.json().catch(()=>({}));
      if (!r.ok) return J({ ok:false, error:'start_failed', status:r.status, detail: jd?.error||jd }, 200);
      const run = jd.data; 
      const { data: ins } = await admin.from('scrape_runs').insert({ run_id: run.id, dataset_id: run.defaultDatasetId, actor: body.actor||'compass/crawler-google-places', sector: body.sector||null, emirate: body.emirate||null, label: body.label||null, requested: body.requested||null, status: run.status||'RUNNING' }).select('id').maybeSingle();
      return J({ ok:true, scrape_run: ins?.id, run_id: run.id, dataset_id: run.defaultDatasetId, status: run.status });
    }

    if (action === 'status') {
      if (body.run_id) { const r = await fetch(`${API}/actor-runs/${body.run_id}?token=${tok}`).then(x=>x.json()).catch(()=>({})); return J({ ok:true, status:r?.data?.status, stats:r?.data?.stats, usageUsd:r?.data?.usageTotalUsd }); }
      const { data } = await admin.from('scrape_runs').select('id,run_id,sector,emirate,status,fetched,inserted,requested').order('id',{ascending:false}).limit(60);
      return J({ ok:true, runs:data });
    }

    if (action === 'collect') {
      const { data: sr } = await admin.from('scrape_runs').select('*').eq('run_id', body.run_id).maybeSingle();
      if (!sr) return J({ ok:false, error:'run_not_found' }, 200);
      const rs = await fetch(`${API}/actor-runs/${body.run_id}?token=${tok}`).then(x=>x.json()).catch(()=>({}));
      const st = rs?.data?.status; const dsId = sr.dataset_id || rs?.data?.defaultDatasetId;
      if (st && st!=='SUCCEEDED' && st!=='READY') { await admin.from('scrape_runs').update({status:st}).eq('id',sr.id); return J({ ok:true, status:st, note:'not finished yet' }); }
      const offset = sr.fetched || 0; const limit = Math.min(body.limit||1000, 1000);
      const items = await fetch(`${API}/datasets/${dsId}/items?token=${tok}&clean=true&format=json&offset=${offset}&limit=${limit}`).then(x=>x.json()).catch(()=>[]);
      const page = Array.isArray(items)? items : [];
      const rows = page.map(mapItem).filter(r=>r.place_id && r.email); // email-focused
      // de-dupe within batch
      const seen = new Set<string>(); const uniq: any[] = [];
      for (const r of rows){ const k=r.place_id!; if(seen.has(k)) continue; seen.add(k); uniq.push(r); }
      let inserted = 0;
      if (uniq.length){
        const pids = uniq.map(r=>r.place_id); const ems = uniq.map(r=>r.email);
        const { data: exP } = await admin.from('leads').select('place_id').in('place_id', pids);
        const { data: exE } = await admin.from('leads').select('email').in('email', ems);
        const haveP = new Set((exP||[]).map((x:any)=>x.place_id)); const haveE = new Set((exE||[]).map((x:any)=>(x.email||'').toLowerCase()));
        const toIns = uniq.filter(r=>!haveP.has(r.place_id) && !haveE.has(r.email)).map(r=>({ ...r, sector: sr.sector, emirate: sr.emirate, source: 'apify_'+(new Date().toISOString().slice(0,7)), enrich_source: 'apify_maps_contacts', scraped_at: new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) }));
        if (toIns.length){ const { data: di, error } = await admin.from('leads').upsert(toIns, { onConflict:'place_id', ignoreDuplicates:true }).select('id'); if(error) return J({ ok:false, error:'insert_failed', detail:error.message }, 200); inserted = di?.length||0; }
      }
      const newFetched = offset + page.length; const hasMore = page.length === limit;
      await admin.from('scrape_runs').update({ fetched:newFetched, inserted:(sr.inserted||0)+inserted, status: hasMore?'SUCCEEDED':'COLLECTED', collected_at: hasMore?null:new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', sr.id);
      return J({ ok:true, status:'SUCCEEDED', page: page.length, inserted, total_fetched:newFetched, total_inserted:(sr.inserted||0)+inserted, hasMore });
    }

    return J({ error:'unknown action' }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/archive_rfq/index.ts

````typescript
// archive_rfq v2 — archives a COMPLETED RFQ as an atomic case: structured data, the actual
// uploaded files (copied, not just referenced), AI conversations, RFQ + quote version history,
// supplier responses, quotations, comparison, decision history, audit logs, and an AI summary.
// Stored to backups/archives/RFQ-<id>/; searchable metadata in public.rfq_archives. Secret-gated.
import { createClient } from 'https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const URL = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
const KEY = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!;
const admin = createClient(URL, KEY);
const llm = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 900, temperature: 0 });
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'archive_rfq', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
}
const cors = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':'*','Access-Control-Allow-Headers':'*','Content-Type':'application/json' };
const j = (o:unknown,s=200)=>new Response(JSON.stringify(o),{status:s,headers:cors});
async function sha256(t:string){ const b=new TextEncoder().encode(t); const h=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',b); return Array.from(new Uint8Array(h)).map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join(''); }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;

async function aiSummary(pkg:any):Promise<any>{
  const sys='You write concise project post-mortems for a UAE procurement marketplace. Return STRICT JSON only: '+
    '{summary:string (6-10 lines: customer, category, budget, winning supplier, savings if any, timeline, disputes), '+
    'lessons:[string] (2-5 concrete, reusable institutional lessons for matching/qualification/recommendation)}. Base only on data. Never invent.';
  const brief=JSON.stringify({rfq:pkg['01_RFQ'],customer:pkg['02_Customer'],suppliers:pkg['03_Suppliers'],quotations:pkg['04_Quotations'],comparison:pkg['05_Comparison'],invoices:pkg['09_Invoices']}).slice(0,12000);
  try{
    let t=(await llm(sys,brief,900))||''; t=t.replace(/^```(json)?/i,'').replace(/```$/,'').trim(); const m=t.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if(m) return JSON.parse(m[0]);
  }catch(_e){}
  return { summary:'(AI summary unavailable)', lessons:[] };
}

Deno.serve(async (req)=>{
  if(req.method==='OPTIONS') return new Response('ok',{headers:cors});
  const sb=createClient(URL,KEY);
  let body:any={}; try{ body=await req.json(); }catch(_e){}
  const { data:secrets, error:secretsErr } = await sb.from('app_secrets').select('key,value').in('key',['inbound_secret','openrouter_api_key']);
  const secret=(secrets||[]).find((s:any)=>s.key==='inbound_secret')?.value;
  const apiKey=(secrets||[]).find((s:any)=>s.key==='openrouter_api_key')?.value;
  if(!secretOk(secret) || body.__secret!==secret){
    await logRun('error', { unauthorized:1, secret_configured: secret?1:0 }, secret ? 'RFQ archiver rejected a caller with a wrong __secret; no RFQ was archived on this invocation. If this was the scheduled cron its secret is stale and completed RFQs are piling up unarchived, so their drawing files may be purged by retention before the case is preserved.' : ('RFQ archiver could not read inbound_secret from app_secrets, so every call including the scheduled cron is rejected with 401 and no completed RFQ is ever archived. ' + String(secretsErr?.message || 'no inbound_secret row')));
    return j({error:'unauthorized'},401);
  }

  let inq:any=null;
  let pickErrMsg='';
  if(body.inquiry_id){ const { data, error:oneErr } = await sb.from('inquiries').select('*').eq('id',body.inquiry_id).maybeSingle(); inq=data; if(oneErr) pickErrMsg='Could not load the requested inquiry '+String(body.inquiry_id)+' so it was not archived: '+String(oneErr.message||oneErr)+'. '; }
  else {
    const { data, error:scanErr } = await sb.from('inquiries').select('*').in('status',['completed','accepted','closed'])
      .lt('completed_at', new Date(Date.now()-90*864e5).toISOString()).order('completed_at').limit(20);
    if(scanErr) pickErrMsg='Could not scan the inquiries table for RFQs eligible for archiving, so nothing was archived this run and completed RFQs remain unpreserved: '+String(scanErr.message||scanErr)+'. ';
    for(const cand of (data||[])){ const { count } = await sb.from('rfq_archives').select('*',{count:'exact',head:true}).eq('rfq_id',String(cand.id)); if(!count){ inq=cand; break; } }
  }
  if(!inq){
    if(pickErrMsg) await logRun('error', { archived:0 }, pickErrMsg);
    else await logRun('ok', { archived:0, eligible:0 }, '');
    return j({ok:true,note:'no RFQ eligible for archiving'});
  }
  const rid=String(inq.id);
  const { count:already } = await sb.from('rfq_archives').select('*',{count:'exact',head:true}).eq('rfq_id',rid);
  if(already && !body.force){
    await logRun('ok', { archived:0, rfq_id:rid, already_archived:1 }, '');
    return j({ok:true,note:'already archived',rfq_id:rid});
  }
  const folder=`archives/RFQ-${rid}`;

  try{
    const warn:string[]=[];
    const { data:customer, error:custErr } = await sb.from('customers').select('*').eq('id',inq.customer_id).maybeSingle();
    if(custErr) warn.push('Customer record could not be read, so the archive for RFQ '+rid+' has no customer section: '+String(custErr.message||custErr)+'. ');
    const { data:matches, error:matchErr } = await sb.from('inquiry_matches').select('*').eq('inquiry_id',rid);
    if(matchErr) warn.push('Supplier matches could not be read, so the archive for RFQ '+rid+' records no matched suppliers: '+String(matchErr.message||matchErr)+'. ');
    const supIds=[...new Set((matches||[]).map((m:any)=>m.supplier_id).filter(Boolean))];
    const { data:suppliers } = await sb.from('leads').select('id,company_name,emirate,categories,rating,verified,approval_status').in('id',supIds.length?supIds:['__none__']);
    const { data:quotes, error:quotesErr } = await sb.from('quotes').select('*').eq('inquiry_id',rid);
    if(quotesErr) warn.push('Quotes could not be read, so the archive for RFQ '+rid+' contains no quotations, no comparison and no quote files: '+String(quotesErr.message||quotesErr)+'. ');
    const { data:messages, error:msgErr } = await sb.from('messages').select('id,sender,body,created_at,flagged,blocked').eq('inquiry_id',rid).order('created_at');
    if(msgErr) warn.push('Communications could not be read, so the archive for RFQ '+rid+' has no message trail to support a future dispute: '+String(msgErr.message||msgErr)+'. ');
    const { data:threads } = await sb.from('chat_threads').select('*').eq('inquiry_id',rid);
    const { data:txns } = await sb.from('transactions').select('*').eq('inquiry_id',rid);
    const txnIds=(txns||[]).map((t:any)=>t.id);
    const { data:invoices } = await sb.from('reveal_invoices').select('*').in('transaction_id',txnIds.length?txnIds:[-1]);
    const { data:audit } = await sb.from('notifications').select('type,subject,created_at').eq('inquiry_id',rid).order('created_at').limit(80);
    // AI conversations: agent chats attributable to this customer
    let aichats:any[]=[];
    const idents=[customer?.email, customer?.id, inq.customer_id].filter(Boolean).map(String);
    if(idents.length){ const { data:ac } = await sb.from('agent_chats').select('agent_key,role,content,created_at,created_by').in('created_by',idents).order('created_at').limit(200); aichats=ac||[]; }
    // version history
    const verIds=['rfq:'+rid, ...(quotes||[]).map((q:any)=>'quote:'+q.id)];
    const { data:versions, error:verErr } = await sb.from('doc_versions').select('entity_type,entity_id,version,changed_fields,checksum,created_at')
      .or(`and(entity_type.eq.rfq,entity_id.eq.${rid})`+ (quotes&&quotes.length? ','+quotes.map((q:any)=>`and(entity_type.eq.quote,entity_id.eq.${q.id})`).join(',') : '')).order('created_at');
    if(verErr) warn.push('Document version history could not be read, so the archive for RFQ '+rid+' cannot evidence what changed and when: '+String(verErr.message||verErr)+'. ');

    // ---- copy the actual uploaded files into the case ----
    const filesManifest:any[]=[];
    async function copyFile(bucket:string, path:string, kind:string){
      if(!path) return; try{
        const { data:blob, error } = await sb.storage.from(bucket).download(path);
        if(error||!blob) { filesManifest.push({kind,bucket,path,copied:false,error:error?.message||'missing'}); return; }
        const name=path.split('/').pop()||'file';
        const dest=`${folder}/files/${kind}/${name}`;
        const { error:upErr } = await sb.storage.from('backups').upload(dest, blob, { upsert:true });
        if(upErr){ filesManifest.push({kind,bucket,path,copied:false,error:String(upErr.message||upErr).slice(0,120)}); return; }
        filesManifest.push({kind,source_bucket:bucket,source_path:path,archived_path:dest,copied:true,bytes:blob.size});
      }catch(e){ filesManifest.push({kind,bucket,path,copied:false,error:String(e).slice(0,120)}); }
    }
    await copyFile('drawing-files', inq.drawing_file_path, 'drawing');
    for(const p of (inq.drawing_redacted_paths||[])) await copyFile('drawing-files', p, 'drawing_redacted');
    for(const q of (quotes||[])) await copyFile('quote-files', q.original_file_path, 'quotation');
    const filesFailed=filesManifest.filter((f:any)=>!f.copied);
    if(filesFailed.length) warn.push(filesFailed.length+' of '+filesManifest.length+' uploaded files could not be copied into the archive for RFQ '+rid+', so those drawings/quotations are NOT preserved and will be lost once retention purges the originals. First error: '+String(filesFailed[0]?.error||'')+'. ');

    const winner=(quotes||[]).find((q:any)=>['won','accepted'].includes(String(q.status||'')));
    const pkg:any = {
      '00_Manifest': { rfq_id:rid, generated_at:new Date().toISOString(), files:filesManifest, sections:11, versions:(versions||[]).length },
      '01_RFQ': { id:rid, category:inq.category, emirate:inq.emirate, summary:inq.summary, spec:inq.spec, budget:inq.budget, scope_type:inq.scope_type, trades:inq.trades, boq:inq.boq, created_at:inq.created_at, completed_at:inq.completed_at, outcome:inq.outcome },
      '02_Customer': customer ? { id:customer.id, name:customer.full_name, email:customer.email, phone:customer.phone } : null,
      '03_Suppliers': suppliers||[],
      '04_Quotations': quotes||[],
      '05_Comparison': { committed:(quotes||[]).map((q:any)=>({supplier_id:q.supplier_id, amount:q.quote_amount, committed_items:q.committed_items, status:q.status})), winner: winner?{supplier_id:winner.supplier_id, amount:winner.quote_amount}:null },
      '06_AI_Analysis': { quality:(quotes||[]).map((q:any)=>({id:q.id, quality:q.quality, review_status:q.review_status})) },
      '07_AI_Conversations': { agent_chats:aichats, chat_threads:threads||[] },
      '08_Communications': messages||[],
      '09_Invoices_and_Decisions': { transactions:txns||[], invoices:invoices||[], hired_supplier_id:inq.hired_supplier_id, lost_reason:inq.lost_reason },
      '10_Audit': audit||[],
      '11_Versions': versions||[],
      '12_Final_Report': null };

    if(!apiKey) warn.push('No openrouter_api_key is configured, so the AI post-mortem summary and lessons-learned for RFQ '+rid+' were not generated and the archive was stored with a placeholder summary. ');
    const ai=await aiSummary(pkg);
    if(apiKey && ai && ai.summary==='(AI summary unavailable)') warn.push('Every OpenRouter model failed, so the AI post-mortem summary and lessons-learned for RFQ '+rid+' were not generated and the archive was stored with a placeholder summary. ');
    pkg['12_Final_Report']=ai;

    const caseJson=JSON.stringify(pkg,null,2);
    const checksum=await sha256(caseJson);
    const finalMd=`# Project Summary — RFQ-${rid}\n\n${ai.summary||''}\n\n## Lessons Learned\n`+((ai.lessons||[]).map((l:string)=>`- ${l}`).join('\n'));
    const { error:caseUpErr } = await sb.storage.from('backups').upload(`${folder}/case.json`, new Blob([caseJson],{type:'application/json'}), { upsert:true });
    if(caseUpErr) warn.push('Uploading case.json for RFQ '+rid+' failed, so the archive folder is empty or incomplete even though the run reported success and rfq_archives will point at a non-existent case file: '+String(caseUpErr.message||caseUpErr)+'. ');
    const { error:mdUpErr } = await sb.storage.from('backups').upload(`${folder}/12_Final_Report/final_report.md`, new Blob([finalMd],{type:'text/markdown'}), { upsert:true });
    if(mdUpErr) warn.push('Uploading the final report markdown for RFQ '+rid+' failed, so the human-readable post-mortem is missing from the archive: '+String(mdUpErr.message||mdUpErr)+'. ');

    const { error:archErr } = await sb.from('rfq_archives').upsert({
      rfq_id:rid, customer_id:inq.customer_id?String(inq.customer_id):null, supplier_ids:supIds,
      category:inq.category, status:inq.status, dates:{ created_at:inq.created_at, completed_at:inq.completed_at },
      bucket:'backups', archive_path:folder, checksum, archive_version:2, ai_summary:ai, size_bytes:caseJson.length, restored_at:null
    }, { onConflict:'rfq_id' });
    if(archErr) warn.push('Writing the rfq_archives index row for RFQ '+rid+' failed, so the archive exists in storage but is invisible and unsearchable, and this RFQ will be re-archived on every future run: '+String(archErr.message||archErr)+'. ');

    const counts={ rfq_id:rid, archived:1, files_total:filesManifest.length, files_copied:filesManifest.filter((f:any)=>f.copied).length, files_failed:filesFailed.length, quotes:(quotes||[]).length, versions:(versions||[]).length, ai_conversations:aichats.length, lessons:(ai.lessons||[]).length };
    if(warn.length) await logRun('error', counts, warn.join(''));
    else await logRun('ok', counts, '');

    return j({ ok:true, rfq_id:rid, archive_path:folder, checksum, files_copied:filesManifest.filter(f=>f.copied).length, files_total:filesManifest.length,
      ai_conversations:aichats.length, versions:(versions||[]).length, quotes:(quotes||[]).length, lessons:(ai.lessons||[]).length });
  }catch(e){ await logRun('error', { rfq_id:rid, archived:0 }, 'RFQ archiving crashed part-way for RFQ '+rid+', so this completed RFQ was not preserved and its drawings, quotes and message trail may be lost once retention purges them: '+String(e).slice(0,300)); return j({error:String(e)},500); }
});
````

### supabase/functions/asset_delete/index.ts

```typescript
// asset_delete — secret-gated removal of asset paths from an allow-listed bucket (test/demo cleanup).
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
const ALLOW = ['quote-files','supplier-docs','drawing-files','agent-docs','brand'];
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const b = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || b.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const bucket = String(b.bucket || '');
    if (!ALLOW.includes(bucket)) return J({ error: 'bucket_not_allowed' }, 400);
    let paths: string[] = Array.isArray(b.paths) ? b.paths.map((p: any) => String(p)) : [];
    // optional prefix mode: list everything under a prefix and delete it
    if (b.prefix) {
      const pfx = String(b.prefix).replace(/\/$/, '');
      const { data } = await admin.storage.from(bucket).list(pfx, { limit: 1000 });
      for (const f of (data || [])) paths.push(pfx + '/' + f.name);
    }
    paths = [...new Set(paths)].filter(Boolean);
    if (!paths.length) return J({ error: 'no paths' }, 400);
    const { data, error } = await admin.storage.from(bucket).remove(paths);
    if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
    return J({ ok: true, removed: (data || []).length, paths });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/assets_ingest/index.ts

```typescript
// assets_ingest v2 — makes agents ASSET-AWARE (compact, deduped).
// Reads Dropbox "/QuotesDone Backup/Assets", folds text assets into agent_knowledge,
// and writes a COMPACT folder-grouped index of binary assets so it fits the brain budget.
// Auth: __secret == inbound_secret.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' } });
async function sec(k: string): Promise<string | undefined> { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;

const ASSETS_PATH = '/QuotesDone Backup/Assets';
const TEXT_EXT = new Set(['md', 'txt', 'csv', 'json', 'html']);
const human = (n: number) => n == null ? '?' : (n > 1048576 ? (n / 1048576).toFixed(1) + ' MB' : (n > 1024 ? (n / 1024).toFixed(0) + ' KB' : n + ' B'));

async function dbxToken(): Promise<string> {
  const [key, secret, refresh] = await Promise.all([sec('dropbox_app_key'), sec('dropbox_app_secret'), sec('dropbox_refresh_token')]);
  const body = new URLSearchParams({ grant_type: 'refresh_token', refresh_token: refresh || '', client_id: key || '', client_secret: secret || '' });
  const r = await fetch('https://api.dropboxapi.com/oauth2/token', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body });
  const j = await r.json(); if (!j.access_token) throw new Error('dropbox_auth_failed: ' + JSON.stringify(j).slice(0, 200));
  return j.access_token as string;
}
async function dbxRpc(token: string, path: string, arg: unknown) {
  const r = await fetch('https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/' + path, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(arg) });
  const txt = await r.text(); let j: any = {}; try { j = JSON.parse(txt); } catch (_e) { j = { _raw: txt }; }
  return { ok: r.ok, status: r.status, j };
}
async function dbxDownload(token: string, path: string): Promise<string> {
  const r = await fetch('https://content.dropboxapi.com/2/files/download', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token, 'Dropbox-API-Arg': JSON.stringify({ path }) } });
  if (!r.ok) return ''; return (await r.text()).slice(0, 12000);
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': '*' } });
  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
  const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
  if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
  const started = new Date().toISOString();
  try {
    const token = await dbxToken();
    await dbxRpc(token, 'files/create_folder_v2', { path: ASSETS_PATH, autorename: false });

    // list recursively
    const files: any[] = [];
    const res = await dbxRpc(token, 'files/list_folder', { path: ASSETS_PATH, recursive: true, limit: 2000 });
    if (!res.ok) return J({ error: 'list_failed', detail: res.j }, 200);
    const collect = (entries: any[]) => { for (const e of entries) { if (e['.tag'] === 'file') files.push(e); } };
    collect(res.j.entries || []);
    let cursor = res.j.cursor, hasMore = res.j.has_more, guard = 0;
    while (hasMore && guard++ < 20) { const c = await dbxRpc(token, 'files/list_folder/continue', { cursor }); if (!c.ok) break; collect(c.j.entries || []); cursor = c.j.cursor; hasMore = c.j.has_more; }

    // group by the first folder segment under ASSETS_PATH; ingest text files in full
    const groups: Record<string, { count: number; bytes: number; examples: string[] }> = {};
    const textEntries: { topic: string; content: string }[] = [];
    const prefixLen = ASSETS_PATH.length + 1;
    for (const f of files) {
      const name = f.name as string; const path = f.path_display || f.path_lower;
      const rel = String(path).slice(prefixLen);
      const seg = rel.includes('/') ? rel.split('/')[0] : '(root)';
      const g = groups[seg] || (groups[seg] = { count: 0, bytes: 0, examples: [] });
      g.count++; g.bytes += Number(f.size) || 0;
      const ext = (name.split('.').pop() || '').toLowerCase();
      const notable = /logo|lockup|cover|avatar|icon_|mark|banner|kit|guide|palette|font/i.test(name);
      if (g.examples.length < 6 && (notable || g.examples.length < 3)) g.examples.push(name);
      if (TEXT_EXT.has(ext) && (f.size || 0) < 200000) {
        const content = await dbxDownload(token, path);
        if (content && content.trim()) textEntries.push({ topic: ('Asset text: ' + name).slice(0, 120), content: ('From company asset "' + name + '" (Dropbox: ' + path + ')\n\n' + content).slice(0, 8000) });
      }
    }

    // wipe previous asset knowledge (two clean deletes — no malformed or() filters)
    await admin.from('agent_knowledge').delete().eq('agent_key', '_global').eq('topic', 'Company assets (auto-synced from Dropbox)');
    await admin.from('agent_knowledge').delete().eq('agent_key', '_global').like('topic', 'Asset text: %');

    // compact manifest (folder summary, capped)
    let manifest: string;
    if (files.length) {
      const lines = Object.entries(groups).sort((a, b) => b[1].count - a[1].count).map(([g, v]) => '- ' + g + ' — ' + v.count + ' file(s), ' + human(v.bytes) + (v.examples.length ? (' · e.g. ' + v.examples.join(', ')) : ''));
      manifest = 'COMPANY ASSETS (synced from Dropbox "' + ASSETS_PATH + '", ' + files.length + ' files). These are real files the company owns; reference them and give the founder the Dropbox path when useful. Folders:\n' + lines.join('\n') + '\n\nText docs (brand voice, colours, letterhead, where-to-use) are read into your knowledge in full. For a specific image/logo/cover, tell the founder the folder above and offer to fetch the exact filename.';
    } else {
      manifest = 'COMPANY ASSETS: the Dropbox folder "' + ASSETS_PATH + '" is currently empty. Drop the PRO brand kit and social kit there to make agents asset-aware.';
    }
    await admin.from('agent_knowledge').insert({ agent_key: '_global', topic: 'Company assets (auto-synced from Dropbox)', content: manifest.slice(0, 3500), priority: 60 });
    if (textEntries.length) await admin.from('agent_knowledge').insert(textEntries.map((t) => ({ agent_key: '_global', topic: t.topic, content: t.content, priority: 45 })));

    const counts = { files: files.length, folders: Object.keys(groups).length, text_ingested: textEntries.length };
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'assets_ingest', started_at: started, finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'ok', counts });
    return J({ ok: true, path: ASSETS_PATH, ...counts, folders: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(groups).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.count])) });
  } catch (e) {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'assets_ingest', started_at: started, finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'error', note: String(e).slice(0, 200) });
    return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 200);
  }
});
```

```typescript
// attach_photos - persists a customer's REFERENCE photos into the inquiry package so matched suppliers
// receive them (anonymised) and can quote from them. Redact-only (no BOQ). Auth: customer JWT.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
const SERVICE = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!;
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const auth = req.headers.get('Authorization') || ''; const jwt = auth.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
    const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
    if (!user || !user.email) return J({ error: 'Not signed in' }, 401);
    const uid = (user.id || user.email).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 24) || 'anon';
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const images = (Array.isArray(body.images) ? body.images : []).filter((im: any) => im && im.data && im.mime).slice(0, 24);
    if (!images.length) return J({ ok: true, paths: [] });
    const secret = await sec('inbound_secret');
    const prefix = `refphoto/${uid}/${Date.now()}`;
    let paths: string[] = [];
    try {
      const r = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/drawing_redact`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': `Bearer ${SERVICE}` }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: secret, images, prefix }) });
      const j = await r.json();
      if (j?.ok && Array.isArray(j.paths)) paths = j.paths.map((p: any) => String(p)).slice(0, 24);
    } catch (_e) { /* redaction best-effort */ }
    return J({ ok: true, paths });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/backup/index.ts

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
async function sec(k:string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
// Core tables to snapshot. leads dumped with a column subset (no heavy embedding vectors).
const FULL=['customers','inquiries','quotes','transactions','supplier_dues','reviews','questions','inquiry_matches','agent_knowledge','agent_memory','agent_chats','pricing_config','category_specs','category_agents','content_drafts','expenses','reveal_invoices'];
const LEAD_COLS='id,company_name,email,phone,whatsapp,website,categories,sector,emirate,rating,reviews,app_rating,app_reviews,verified,verification_status,claimed,claimed_by,approval_status,trade_license_no,trn,license_expiry,invite_status,created_at';

async function dumpTable(t:string, cols='*'){
  const rows:any[]=[]; let from=0; const page=1000;
  for(;;){ const {data,error}=await admin.from(t).select(cols).range(from,from+page-1); if(error) throw new Error(t+': '+error.message); if(!data||!data.length) break; rows.push(...data); if(data.length<page) break; from+=page; if(from>200000) break; }
  return rows;
}

// recursive storage listing (capped) so the backup records every stored file (path,size,updated)
async function listBucket(bucket:string, prefix='', acc:any[]=[], depth=0):Promise<any[]>{
  if(acc.length>20000 || depth>6) return acc;
  let offset=0; const lim=100;
  for(;;){
    const { data, error } = await admin.storage.from(bucket).list(prefix, { limit:lim, offset, sortBy:{ column:'name', order:'asc' } });
    if(error || !data || !data.length) break;
    for(const it of data){
      const full = prefix ? prefix+'/'+it.name : it.name;
      if(it.id===null && !it.metadata){ await listBucket(bucket, full, acc, depth+1); }
      else { acc.push({ path: full, size: it.metadata?.size ?? null, updated_at: it.updated_at ?? null }); }
      if(acc.length>20000) return acc;
    }
    if(data.length<lim) break; offset+=lim;
  }
  return acc;
}
```

async function sec(k: string): Promise<string | undefined> { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is

const slugify = (t: string) => t.toLowerCase().replace(/&/g, ' and ').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 70);

async function llmJSON(sys: string, user: string): Promise<any | null> {

    c = String(c).replace(/^```json/i, '').replace(/^```/, '').replace(/```$/, '').trim();
    const a = c.indexOf('{'); const b = c.lastIndexOf('}'); if (a >= 0 && b > a) c = c.slice(a, b + 1);
    return JSON.parse(c);
  } catch (_e) {}
  return null;
}

Follow the brand voice in the knowledge below. Practical, trustworthy, no invented statistics, no fluff. British/UAE English.\n\n' + brain;
    const user = 'Write ONE fresh, SEO-optimised blog article for quotesdone.com/blog targeting a high-intent UAE search query we have NOT covered. Avoid these existing titles: ' + JSON.stringify(taken).slice(0, 1500) + '.\n\nRules:\n- Pick a specific long-tail keyword an SME would search (e.g. "office fit out cost per square foot dubai", "how to compare AC maintenance quotes uae").\n- 700-1000 words, body in clean semantic HTML using <h2>, <h3>, <p>, <ul><li>, and a short <h2>FAQ</h2> with 3 Q/A.\n- Include 2 contextual internal links: one to a relevant service on https://quotesdone.com/ and one CTA link to https://quotesdone.com/app (anchor like "get anonymous quotes"). No emojis.\n- Return ONLY minified JSON: {"title","meta_desc"(<=155 chars),"excerpt"(<=200 chars),"category"(one of: Cost Guides, How-To, Buyer Guides, Industry),"keyword","body_html"}. body_html must NOT include an <h1> (the page renders the title separately).';

### supabase/functions/boost_recommend/index.ts

````typescript
// boost_recommend — the paid-media RECOMMEND step (capability-gated, per the claude-ads methodology now
// in the marketing agent's knowledge). It audits available signals, applies the hard rules (3x kill,
// learning-phase budget, tracking gate, only-boost-with-traction), and if a boost is warranted it writes
// a source-grounded proposal into review_queue(kind='boost_budget') for the FOUNDER to fund. It never
// spends and never touches an ad account — money out is the founder's gate. Auth: __secret OR admin JWT.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
const llm = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 900, temperature: 0.3 });
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
async function authed(req: Request, body: any): Promise<boolean> {
  if (body.__secret && body.__secret === (await sec('inbound_secret'))) return true;
  const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, ''); if (!jwt) return false;
  const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
  const allow = (await sec('admin_emails') || 'management@quotesdone.com').split(',').map((s) => s.trim().toLowerCase());
  return !!(user?.email && allow.includes(user.email.toLowerCase()));
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    if (!(await authed(req, body))) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);

    // Don't stack boost proposals: if one is already pending review, do nothing.
    const { count: pending } = await admin.from('review_queue').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('kind', 'boost_budget').eq('status', 'pending');
    if ((pending || 0) > 0) return J({ ok: true, recommend: false, reason: 'a boost proposal is already awaiting founder review' });

    // Marketing brain (now includes the paid-media hard rules) + candidate content to boost.
    let brain = ''; try { const { data } = await admin.rpc('fn_agent_context', { p_agent_key: 'marketing', p_max_chars: 7000 }); brain = data ? String(data) : ''; } catch (_e) {}
    const { data: posts } = await admin.from('content_drafts').select('id,title,channel,status,review_status,created_at').in('status', ['published', 'staged', 'draft']).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(12);
    const candidates = (posts || []).map((p: any) => '- #' + p.id + ' [' + p.status + '/' + (p.review_status || '-') + '] ' + (p.title || '').slice(0, 80)).join('\n') || '(no posts yet)';
    const golive = (await sec('marketing_golive')) || 'false';

    const sys = 'You are the paid-media lead for QuotesDone (UAE B2B anonymous quotation marketplace). Decide whether to propose a paid BOOST right now, strictly following your paid-media hard rules (audit before spend, only boost content with real organic traction, tracking must be verified, define a funnel objective + expected CPA + a 3x kill stop-loss + a review date, recommend the SMALLEST budget that can exit learning). You never spend - you only propose a budget for the founder to fund. Be conservative: if there is no live ad tracking, no published post with proven traction, or the pipeline is pre-launch, recommend NOTHING and say what data/condition is needed first. Return STRICT minified JSON only: {"recommend":true|false,"reason":"...","post_ref":<id or null>,"budget_aed":<int or null>,"objective":"awareness|consideration|conversion|null","expected":"<expected reach/CPA in plain words>","kill_criteria":"...","review_in_days":<int or null>}.';
    const user = 'Marketing go-live switch: ' + golive + ' (if false, the platform has not launched paid yet).\n\nRECENT CONTENT (boost candidates):\n' + candidates + '\n\nNote: no live ad-account metrics are connected yet, so you cannot audit real CPA/ROAS. Decide accordingly and return the JSON.\n\n' + (brain ? ('YOUR KNOWLEDGE:\n' + brain.slice(0, 4000)) : '');

    const raw = (await llm(sys, user, 900) || '').trim();
    if (!raw) return J({ error: 'llm_unavailable' }, 502);
    let p: any = null;
    try { p = JSON.parse(raw.replace(/^```(json)?/i, '').replace(/```$/, '').trim()); } catch (_e) { const m = raw.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (m) { try { p = JSON.parse(m[0]); } catch (_e2) { /* noop */ } } }
    if (!p || p.recommend !== true) {
      return J({ ok: true, recommend: false, reason: String(p?.reason || 'no boost warranted now') });
    }

    const budget = Math.max(0, Math.min(Number(p.budget_aed) || 0, 100000));
    const title = 'Boost recommendation: AED ' + budget + (p.objective ? (' (' + p.objective + ')') : '');
    const summary = String(p.reason || '').slice(0, 400);
    const { data: ins } = await admin.from('review_queue').insert({
      kind: 'boost_budget', dept_key: 'marketing', title, summary,
      payload: { post_ref: p.post_ref ?? null, budget_aed: budget, objective: p.objective ?? null, expected: p.expected ?? null, kill_criteria: p.kill_criteria ?? null, review_in_days: p.review_in_days ?? null },
      status: 'pending',
    }).select('id').maybeSingle();

    return J({ ok: true, recommend: true, review_id: ins?.id || null, budget_aed: budget, note: 'Boost proposal queued for founder funding (no spend until approved).' });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
````

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
function toB64(buf: Uint8Array): string { let s = ''; const CH = 0x8000; for (let i = 0; i < buf.length; i += CH) { s += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, Array.from(buf.subarray(i, i + CH))); } return btoa(s); }
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
async function jf(url: string, opts: any, ms: number){ const c = new AbortController(); const t = setTimeout(() => c.abort(), ms); try { return await fetch(url, { ...opts, signal: c.signal }); } finally { clearTimeout(t); } }
const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const key = await sec('cloudconvert_api_key');
    if (!key) return J({ ok: false, error: 'no_converter' }, 200);
    const b64 = String(body.b64 || '').replace(/^data:[^;]+;base64,/, '');
    if (!b64) return J({ ok: false, error: 'no_file' }, 200);
    const filename = String(body.filename || 'drawing.dwg');
    const ext = (filename.split('.').pop() || 'dwg').toLowerCase();
    const input_format = ext === 'dxf' ? 'dxf' : 'dwg';
    const auth = { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + key, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
    try {
      let jobRes: Response; let jobJson: any;
      try { jobRes = await jf('https://api.cloudconvert.com/v2/jobs', { method: 'POST', headers: auth, body: JSON.stringify({ tasks: {
        imp: { operation: 'import/base64', file: b64, filename },
        conv: { operation: 'convert', input: 'imp', input_format, output_format: 'png', pixel_density: 200 },
        exp: { operation: 'export/url', input: 'conv', inline: false, archive_multiple_files: false }
      } }) }, 25000); jobJson = await jobRes.json(); } catch (e) { return J({ ok: false, error: 'create_exception', detail: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 200); }
      if (body.__probe) return J({ ok: true, probe: true, createStatus: jobRes.status, jobId: jobJson?.data?.id || null, raw: JSON.stringify(jobJson).slice(0, 600) });
      if (!jobRes.ok) return J({ ok: false, error: 'convert_create_failed', detail: JSON.stringify(jobJson?.message || jobJson).slice(0, 400) }, 200);
      const jobId = jobJson?.data?.id;
      if (!jobId) return J({ ok: false, error: 'no_job_id' }, 200);
      let expTask: any = null; let lastStatus = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        await sleep(3500);
        let pj: any = {};
        try { const pr = await jf('https://api.cloudconvert.com/v2/jobs/' + jobId, { headers: auth }, 12000); pj = await pr.json(); } catch (_e) { continue; }
        const tasks: any[] = pj?.data?.tasks || []; lastStatus = pj?.data?.status || '';
        const conv = tasks.find((t) => t.name === 'conv');
        if (conv && conv.status === 'error') return J({ ok: false, error: 'convert_failed', detail: String(conv?.message || 'conversion error').slice(0, 400) }, 200);
        if (lastStatus === 'error') { const ferr = tasks.find((t) => t.status === 'error'); return J({ ok: false, error: 'job_error', detail: String(ferr?.message || '').slice(0, 400) }, 200); }
        expTask = tasks.find((t) => t.name === 'exp');
        if (expTask && expTask.status === 'finished') break;
      }
      if (!expTask || expTask.status !== 'finished') return J({ ok: false, error: 'timeout', detail: 'status ' + lastStatus }, 200);
      const files: any[] = expTask?.result?.files || [];
      if (!files.length) return J({ ok: false, error: 'no_output' }, 200);
      const images: any[] = [];
      for (const f of files.slice(0, 10)) { try { const fr = await jf(f.url, {}, 20000); if (!fr.ok) continue; const buf = new Uint8Array(await fr.arrayBuffer()); if (buf.length) images.push({ mime: 'image/png', data: toB64(buf) }); } catch (_e) { /* skip */ } }
      if (!images.length) return J({ ok: false, error: 'download_failed' }, 200);
      return J({ ok: true, images, pages: images.length });
    } catch (e) { return J({ ok: false, error: 'exception', detail: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 200); }
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```
