### supabase/functions/canon_eval/index.ts

````typescript
// canon_eval v2 — the LAYERED EXAMINATION ENGINE. Picks questions scoped to the agent
// (agent_key null = shared; agent_key = this agent) balanced across knowledge layers
// (company / profession / state / experience), asks the real agent via agent_brain, and
// grades against the reference with an LLM judge. Random selection per run (no memorizable
// fixed paper). Records runs + per-layer gaps to canon_eval_runs. Auth: __secret OR admin JWT.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const FN = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')! + '/functions/v1';
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
const judge = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 200, temperature: 0 });
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
async function authed(req: Request, body: any): Promise<boolean> {
  if (body.__secret && body.__secret === (await sec('inbound_secret'))) return true;
  const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, ''); if (!jwt) return false;
  const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
  const allow = (await sec('admin_emails') || 'management@quotesdone.com').split(',').map((s) => s.trim().toLowerCase());
  return !!(user?.email && allow.includes(user.email.toLowerCase()));
}
function shuffle<T>(a: T[]): T[] { const x = [...a]; for (let i = x.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1)); [x[i], x[j]] = [x[j], x[i]]; } return x; }

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    if (!(await authed(req, body))) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const agent = String(body.agent || 'followup');
    const limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(Number(body.limit) || 4, 6));
    const secret = await sec('inbound_secret');

    const { data: all } = await admin.from('canon_eval_questions')
      .select('id,category,question,reference,layer,agent_key').eq('active', true)
      .or('agent_key.is.null,agent_key.eq.' + agent);
    if (!all || !all.length) return J({ error: 'no questions loaded' });

    // Balanced draw: the agent's OWN profession questions first, then one state + one
    // experience, remainder from the shared company canon. Random within each pool.
    let chosen: any[];
    if (Array.isArray(body.ids) && body.ids.length) {
      chosen = all.filter((q) => body.ids.includes(q.id)).slice(0, limit);
    } else {
      const pool = (l: string, own = false) => shuffle(all.filter((q) =>
        (q.layer || 'company') === l && (own ? q.agent_key === agent : true)));
      const picks: any[] = [];
      picks.push(...pool('profession', true).slice(0, 2));
      picks.push(...pool('state').slice(0, 1));
      picks.push(...pool('experience').slice(0, 1));
      for (const q of shuffle(all.filter((q) => (q.layer || 'company') === 'company'))) {
        if (picks.length >= limit) break;
        picks.push(q);
      }
      chosen = picks.slice(0, limit);
    }
    if (!chosen.length) return J({ error: 'no questions matched' });

    let passed = 0; const gaps: any[] = []; const byLayer: Record<string, { asked: number; passed: number }> = {};
    for (const q of chosen) {
      const L = q.layer || 'company'; byLayer[L] = byLayer[L] || { asked: 0, passed: 0 }; byLayer[L].asked++;
      let answer = '';
      try {
        const ar = await fetch(FN + '/agent_brain', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: secret, agent, message: String(q.question) }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(30000) });
        const aj = await ar.json().catch(() => ({} as any)); answer = String(aj?.reply || '');
      } catch (_e) { answer = ''; }
      const jsys = 'You grade whether an AI agent answer about QuotesDone is CORRECT against a reference. PASS if the answer conveys the key facts of the reference (wording differences and extra correct detail are fine). FAIL if it contradicts the reference, invents wrong facts, or misses the core fact. If the reference says the fact is "not specified in canon", PASS only if the agent appropriately says it is not defined / declines rather than fabricating. Reply STRICT JSON only: {"verdict":"PASS"|"FAIL","reason":"<=12 words"}.';
      const juser = 'QUESTION: ' + q.question + '\nREFERENCE: ' + (q.reference || '') + '\nAGENT ANSWER: ' + (answer || '(no answer)') + '\n\nGrade it.';
      let v: any = null;
      try { const raw = (await judge(jsys, juser, 200) || '').trim(); v = JSON.parse(raw.replace(/^```(json)?/i, '').replace(/```$/, '').trim()); } catch (_e) { const m = (await judge(jsys, juser, 200) || '').match(/PASS|FAIL/i); v = { verdict: m ? m[0].toUpperCase() : 'FAIL', reason: 'parse' }; }
      const ok = String(v?.verdict).toUpperCase() === 'PASS';
      if (ok) { passed++; byLayer[L].passed++; }
      else gaps.push({ id: q.id, category: q.category, layer: L, question: q.question, reason: v?.reason || '', answer: answer.slice(0, 200) });
    }
    const score = chosen.length ? Math.round((passed / chosen.length) * 1000) / 10 : 0;
    const { data: run } = await admin.from('canon_eval_runs').insert({ agent, asked: chosen.length, passed, score_pct: score, gaps }).select('id').maybeSingle();
    return J({ ok: true, run_id: run?.id || null, agent, asked: chosen.length, passed, score_pct: score, by_layer: byLayer, gaps });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
````

### supabase/functions/capability_agent/index.ts

````typescript
// capability_agent — reads a supplier's OWN documents (trade licence + company profile, and the
// catalogue when the first two are not enough), works out EXACTLY what work they can take on against
// the controlled vocabulary, tells them precisely what is missing if it cannot, and then records what
// THE SUPPLIER CONFIRMS as the source of truth.
//
// Why confirmation rather than pure extraction: the supplier is the only party who actually knows their
// scope. Having them confirm corrects extraction error at source, populates the negative scope
// (exclusions) that stops irrelevant inquiries, and gives us their explicit agreement to what they will
// receive — which matters the day a supplier disputes a match.
//
// Nothing here is wired into live matching. Secret-guarded; called server-side only.
// actions: analyze | confirm | state
// v2: probe_text — secret-guarded diagnostic that analyses supplied text instead of stored documents,
//     so extraction quality can be tested ("would this profile be enough?") without an upload. Never persists.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
const MODELS = ['anthropic/claude-sonnet-5', 'anthropic/claude-opus-4.8'];
const AGENT_VERSION = 'capability_agent@2';
const BUCKET = 'supplier-docs';
const MAX_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024;

async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
function parseJson(t: string) { let s = String(t || '').trim(); const f = s.match(/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i); if (f) s = f[1].trim(); try { return JSON.parse(s); } catch { const m = s.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (m) { try { return JSON.parse(m[0]); } catch { /* */ } } return null; } }
function clip(v: unknown, n: number) { return String(v == null ? '' : v).slice(0, n); }
function strArr(v: unknown, n: number, len = 120): string[] { return Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((x) => clip(x, len)).filter(Boolean).slice(0, n) : []; }
function num(v: unknown): number | null { const n = Number(v); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null; }
function conf(v: unknown): number { const n = Number(v); return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n)) : 0; }

async function b64(blob: Blob): Promise<string> {
  const buf = new Uint8Array(await blob.arrayBuffer());
  let s = ''; const CH = 0x8000;
  for (let i = 0; i < buf.length; i += CH) s += String.fromCharCode(...(buf.subarray(i, i + CH) as unknown as number[]));
  return btoa(s);
}
function mimeOf(path: string) {
  const e = String(path).toLowerCase().split('.').pop() || '';
  if (e === 'pdf') return 'application/pdf';
  if (e === 'png') return 'image/png';
  if (e === 'webp') return 'image/webp';
  if (e === 'jpg' || e === 'jpeg') return 'image/jpeg';
  return 'application/octet-stream';
}
async function attach(path: string, label: string, content: any[], used: string[]) {
  if (!path) return;
  try {
    const { data, error } = await admin.storage.from(BUCKET).download(path);
    if (error || !data) return;
    if (data.size > MAX_BYTES) return;
    const mime = mimeOf(path);
    const b = await b64(data);
    content.push({ type: 'text', text: `--- ${label} ---` });
    if (/^image\//.test(mime)) content.push({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: `data:${mime};base64,${b}` } });
    else content.push({ type: 'file', file: { filename: path.split('/').pop() || 'document.pdf', file_data: `data:application/pdf;base64,${b}` } });
    used.push(label + ': ' + path);
  } catch (_e) { /* a single unreadable document must not abort the analysis */ }
}

async function vocabulary() {
  const { data: tr } = await admin.from('taxonomy_trade').select('code,label,authority_required').eq('active', true).order('sort');
  const { data: ro } = await admin.from('taxonomy_role').select('code,label,supplies,executes,whole_scope').eq('active', true).order('sort');
  return { trades: tr || [], roles: ro || [] };
}

const SYS = `You are QuotesDone's supplier capability analyst for the UAE construction, fit-out, MEP and building-services market. You read a supplier's own documents and determine EXACTLY what work they can take on, so that we only ever send them inquiries they can genuinely quote. A supplier who receives irrelevant inquiries leaves the platform, so precision matters more than coverage.

You MUST classify using ONLY the controlled vocabulary given in the user message. Never invent a code.

CRITICAL RULES
1. TRADE (what the work is) and ROLE (how they participate) are separate axes. A company that MANUFACTURES fire pumps is trade=fire_fighting, role=manufacturer. It is NOT plumbing, and it is NOT an installer. Getting role wrong is the most damaging error you can make, because it is what causes a supplier to receive work they cannot perform.
2. Assign a trade ONLY on real evidence of working in it. A passing mention of a material is not evidence: "we use stainless steel fittings" does NOT make them a steel fabricator. When in doubt, leave it out and say so in missing.
3. products = the specific product lines or systems they supply/install, generic and in their own words (no brand names). This is the strongest matching signal, so be concrete: "VRF indoor units", "chilled water pipework", not "HVAC solutions".
4. exclusions = anything the documents explicitly state they do NOT do or do not supply.
5. Be honest about insufficiency. Generic marketing copy with no concrete scope is NOT sufficient. Never pad the lists to look complete — an over-broad record causes exactly the spam we are preventing.

Return STRICT JSON only:
{"trades":[code],"roles":[code],"products":[string],"brands":[string],"project_types":[string],"exclusions":[string],"years_in_business":number|null,"team_size":number|null,"evidence":{"trades":string,"roles":string},"sufficient":boolean,"missing":[string],"confirm_summary":string,"confirm_questions":[string],"confidence":{"trades":0.0,"roles":0.0,"products":0.0}}

sufficient = true ONLY if the documents evidence at least one trade AND one role AND at least two concrete product lines or services.
missing = plain English, addressed to the supplier, naming exactly what they must provide. Not "insufficient data" but e.g. "a product catalogue, or a list of the air-conditioning systems you supply and install".
confirm_summary = one short paragraph written TO THE SUPPLIER in second person, in plain language with no codes, stating what we understood their business does, for them to confirm or correct.
confirm_questions = up to 3 short questions that would remove remaining ambiguity. ALWAYS include one asking what they do NOT take on.`;

async function callModel(key: string, content: any[]) {
  let last = '';
  for (const model of MODELS) {
    for (let at = 0; at < 2; at++) {
      try {
        const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', {
          method: 'POST', headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ model, max_tokens: 2500, temperature: 0.1, messages: [
            { role: 'system', content: [{ type: 'text', text: SYS, cache_control: { type: 'ephemeral' } }] },
            { role: 'user', content } ] })
        });
        const jd = await r.json();
        if (!r.ok) { last = 'http ' + r.status + ' ' + clip(jd?.error?.message, 140); continue; }
        const p = parseJson(jd?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '');
        if (p && Object.keys(p).length) return { ai: p, err: '' };
        last = 'unparseable model output';
      } catch (e) { last = clip((e as Error)?.message || e, 140); }
    }
  }
  return { ai: null, err: last };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const action = String(body.action || 'analyze');
    const probeText = clip(body.probe_text || '', 20000);
    const supplierId = Number(body.supplier_id || 0);
    if (!supplierId && !probeText) return J({ error: 'supplier_id_required' }, 400);

    let lead: any = null;
    if (supplierId) {
      const { data } = await admin.from('leads')
        .select('id,company_name,sector,products,services,capability_summary,emirate,service_emirates,license_doc_path,company_profile_doc_path,catalog_doc_paths,catalogue_pdfs,license_expiry')
        .eq('id', supplierId).maybeSingle();
      lead = data;
      if (!lead && !probeText) return J({ error: 'supplier_not_found' }, 404);
    }

    // ---------------- state ----------------
    if (action === 'state') {
      const { data: cap } = await admin.from('supplier_capabilities').select('*').eq('supplier_id', supplierId).maybeSingle();
      const { data: hist } = await admin.from('supplier_capability_confirmation')
        .select('version,confirmed_at,confirmed_via').eq('supplier_id', supplierId).order('version', { ascending: false }).limit(5);
      return J({ ok: true, capability: cap || null, confirmed: !!cap?.confirmed_at, history: hist || [] });
    }

    // ---------------- confirm ----------------
    // What the supplier agrees to is what we store. Validated against the controlled vocabulary so a
    // bad client cannot inject codes that would silently never match.
    if (action === 'confirm') {
      const vocab = await vocabulary();
      const okTrade = new Set(vocab.trades.map((t: any) => t.code));
      const okRole = new Set(vocab.roles.map((r: any) => r.code));
      const trades = strArr(body.trades, 25, 40).filter((c) => okTrade.has(c));
      const roles = strArr(body.roles, 8, 40).filter((c) => okRole.has(c));
      if (!trades.length || !roles.length) return J({ error: 'need_at_least_one_trade_and_role', valid_trades: [...okTrade], valid_roles: [...okRole] }, 400);

      const products = strArr(body.products, 40);
      const exclusions = strArr(body.exclusions, 25);
      const brands = strArr(body.brands, 40, 60);
      const projectTypes = strArr(body.project_types, 12, 60);

      const { data: prev } = await admin.from('supplier_capability_confirmation')
        .select('version').eq('supplier_id', supplierId).order('version', { ascending: false }).limit(1).maybeSingle();
      const version = Number(prev?.version || 0) + 1;
      const now = new Date().toISOString();

      const { error: upErr } = await admin.from('supplier_capabilities').upsert({
        supplier_id: supplierId,
        trades, roles, products_norm: products, brands, project_types: projectTypes, exclusions,
        services: strArr(body.services, 25),
        coverage_emirates: strArr(body.coverage_emirates, 8, 40),
        confidence: body.confidence && typeof body.confidence === 'object' ? body.confidence : {},
        source_docs: body.source_docs && typeof body.source_docs === 'object' ? body.source_docs : {},
        missing_fields: [],
        review_status: 'confirmed',
        confirmed_at: now,
        confirmed_version: version,
        extracted_at: now,
        extractor_version: AGENT_VERSION,
        updated_at: now,
      }, { onConflict: 'supplier_id' });
      if (upErr) return J({ error: 'capability_write_failed', detail: upErr.message }, 500);

      await admin.from('supplier_capability_confirmation').insert({
        supplier_id: supplierId, version,
        proposed: body.proposed && typeof body.proposed === 'object' ? body.proposed : {},
        confirmed: { trades, roles, products, brands, project_types: projectTypes },
        supplier_added: body.supplier_added && typeof body.supplier_added === 'object' ? body.supplier_added : {},
        exclusions,
        source_docs: body.source_docs && typeof body.source_docs === 'object' ? body.source_docs : {},
        confirmed_at: now,
        confirmed_via: clip(body.confirmed_via || 'portal', 20),
        agent_version: AGENT_VERSION,
      });

      return J({ ok: true, confirmed: true, version, trades, roles, products_count: products.length, exclusions_count: exclusions.length });
    }

    // ---------------- analyze ----------------
    const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key');
    if (!key) return J({ error: 'no_ai_key' }, 500);

    const used: string[] = [];
    const vocab = await vocabulary();
    const vocabText =
      'CONTROLLED VOCABULARY — use ONLY these codes.\n\nTRADES:\n' +
      vocab.trades.map((t: any) => `  ${t.code} — ${t.label}` + (t.authority_required?.length ? ` [requires: ${t.authority_required.join(', ')}]` : '')).join('\n') +
      '\n\nROLES (supplies = can provide goods, executes = can perform site work, whole_scope = can take a multi-trade turnkey job):\n' +
      vocab.roles.map((r: any) => `  ${r.code} — ${r.label} [supplies=${r.supplies}, executes=${r.executes}, whole_scope=${r.whole_scope}]`).join('\n');

    const content: any[] = [];

    if (probeText) {
      // DIAGNOSTIC MODE: analyse supplied text, never touch storage, never persist.
      content.push({ type: 'text', text: vocabText + `\n\nSUPPLIER: ${clip(lead?.company_name || body.company_name || '(probe)', 120)}\n\nThe following is the content of their company documents. Read it and return the capability JSON.\n\n--- DOCUMENT CONTENT ---\n` + probeText });
      used.push('probe_text');
    } else {
      // Mandatory documents. Catalogue is NOT required up front — only asked for if the first two
      // do not carry enough concrete scope.
      const blocking: any[] = [];
      if (!lead.license_doc_path) blocking.push({ code: 'license_missing', ask: 'Attach your trade licence.' });
      if (!lead.company_profile_doc_path) blocking.push({ code: 'profile_missing', ask: 'Attach your company profile.' });
      if (blocking.length) {
        return J({ ok: true, sufficient: false, stage: 'documents', blocking,
          message: 'We need your trade licence and company profile before we can work out what to send you.' });
      }

      const cats: string[] = [];
      for (const c of ([] as any[]).concat(lead.catalog_doc_paths || [], lead.catalogue_pdfs || [])) {
        const p = typeof c === 'string' ? c : (c?.path || c?.url || '');
        if (p) cats.push(String(p));
      }

      content.push({ type: 'text', text: vocabText +
        `\n\nSUPPLIER: ${clip(lead.company_name, 120)}\nSelf-declared sector: ${clip(lead.sector, 60) || '(none)'}\nSelf-declared products: ${clip(lead.products, 400) || '(none)'}\nSelf-declared services: ${clip(lead.services, 400) || '(none)'}\n\nRead the attached documents and return the capability JSON. The self-declared text above is UNVERIFIED — treat the attached documents as the evidence.` });

      await attach(String(lead.license_doc_path || ''), 'TRADE LICENCE', content, used);
      await attach(String(lead.company_profile_doc_path || ''), 'COMPANY PROFILE', content, used);
      for (const p of cats.slice(0, 3)) await attach(p, 'PRODUCT CATALOGUE', content, used);

      if (used.length === 0) {
        return J({ ok: true, sufficient: false, stage: 'documents',
          blocking: [{ code: 'documents_unreadable', ask: 'We could not open your documents. Please re-upload your trade licence and company profile as PDF or image.' }],
          message: 'Your documents could not be read.' });
      }
    }

    const { ai, err } = await callModel(key, content);
    if (!ai) return J({ error: 'ai_failed', detail: err }, 502);

    const okTrade = new Set(vocab.trades.map((t: any) => t.code));
    const okRole = new Set(vocab.roles.map((r: any) => r.code));
    const trades = strArr(ai.trades, 25, 40).filter((c) => okTrade.has(c));
    const roles = strArr(ai.roles, 8, 40).filter((c) => okRole.has(c));
    const products = strArr(ai.products, 40);
    const dropped = strArr(ai.trades, 25, 40).filter((c) => !okTrade.has(c));

    // Sufficiency is decided HERE, not by the model — the model can be optimistic, and an
    // over-confident record is what produces irrelevant inquiries later.
    const missing = strArr(ai.missing, 8, 200);
    const hardEnough = trades.length >= 1 && roles.length >= 1 && products.length >= 2;
    const sufficient = hardEnough && ai.sufficient !== false;
    if (!hardEnough && !missing.length) {
      if (!trades.length) missing.push('a clearer description of the type of work you do');
      if (!roles.length) missing.push('whether you supply materials, install on site, or both');
      if (products.length < 2) missing.push('a product catalogue, or a list of the specific products and systems you supply');
    }

    const proposed = {
      trades, roles, products,
      brands: strArr(ai.brands, 40, 60),
      project_types: strArr(ai.project_types, 12, 60),
      exclusions: strArr(ai.exclusions, 25),
      years_in_business: num(ai.years_in_business),
      team_size: num(ai.team_size),
      evidence: { trades: clip(ai?.evidence?.trades, 500), roles: clip(ai?.evidence?.roles, 500) },
      confidence: { trades: conf(ai?.confidence?.trades), roles: conf(ai?.confidence?.roles), products: conf(ai?.confidence?.products) },
      source_docs: used,
    };

    // Persist the working extraction, but NEVER mark it confirmed — matching must require
    // supplier confirmation, so an unconfirmed extraction can never generate contact.
    // Probe mode is diagnostic and must not write.
    if (!probeText && supplierId) {
      try {
        await admin.from('supplier_capabilities').upsert({
          supplier_id: supplierId,
          trades, roles, products_norm: products,
          brands: proposed.brands, project_types: proposed.project_types, exclusions: proposed.exclusions,
          confidence: proposed.confidence,
          source_docs: { documents: used },
          missing_fields: missing,
          review_status: sufficient ? 'awaiting_confirmation' : 'insufficient',
          extracted_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          extractor_version: AGENT_VERSION,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        }, { onConflict: 'supplier_id' });
      } catch (_e) { /* analysis is still useful to return even if the cache write fails */ }
    }

    return J({
      ok: true,
      probe: !!probeText,
      stage: sufficient ? 'confirm' : 'need_more',
      sufficient,
      can_submit: sufficient,
      missing,
      proposed,
      confirm_summary: clip(ai.confirm_summary, 1200),
      confirm_questions: strArr(ai.confirm_questions, 3, 200),
      documents_read: used,
      vocabulary_rejected: dropped,
      agent_version: AGENT_VERSION,
    });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
````

### supabase/functions/category_provision/index.ts

```typescript
// category_provision — when a supplier self-registers a trade we don't have,
// classify it against existing category-agents; if genuinely new, auto-provision a
// full-parity agent: persona + qualification playbook + category spec go LIVE (intake),
// the AI-generated quoting knowledge + regulation mapping are staged PENDING for founder
// approval (hybrid: live intake, gated knowledge). Idempotent per slug.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;

const _llm = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 1600, temperature: 0 });
const llm = async (sys: string, user: string, max?: number): Promise<string> => (await _llm(sys, user, max)) ?? ''; // shared client, Sonnet-first + 25s timeout
function parseJson(s: string): any { try { const m = s.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); return m ? JSON.parse(m[0]) : null; } catch (_e) { return null; } }
function slugify(s: string){ return String(s||'').toLowerCase().replace(/&/g,' and ').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g,'').replace(/-{2,}/g,'-').slice(0,40); }

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const raw = String(body.raw_category || body.category || '').trim();
    const hint = String(body.hint_services || '').trim();
    const leadId = body.lead_id ?? null;
    if (!raw) return J({ error: 'raw_category_required' }, 400);

    // existing service-category agents (exclude internal underscore agents)
    const { data: agents } = await admin.from('category_agents').select('slug,name').eq('active', true);
    const svc = (agents || []).filter((a: any) => !String(a.slug).includes('_'));
    const catalog = svc.map((a: any) => `${a.slug} = ${a.name}`).join('\n');

    // 1) classify: match to an existing category, or declare new
    const clsRaw = await llm(
      'You map a UAE contractor/supplier trade to a fixed catalog of service categories for a B2B quotation marketplace. Prefer matching an EXISTING category whenever the trade reasonably fits one (synonyms, sub-trades and supplier-of count as a match). Only mark NEW when the trade is clearly outside every listed category. Reply ONLY compact JSON: {"match": "<existing slug or empty>", "confidence": <0-1>, "proposed_slug": "<kebab-case>", "proposed_name": "<Title Case>", "reason": "<=15 words"}.',
      `CATALOG:\n${catalog}\n\nTRADE (as the supplier entered it): "${raw}"${hint ? `\nSERVICES: ${hint}` : ''}`, 400);
    const cls = parseJson(clsRaw) || {};
    const matched = String(cls.match || '').trim();
    if (matched && svc.some((a: any) => a.slug === matched)) {
      if (leadId) { try { await admin.from('leads').update({ categories: matched }).eq('id', leadId); } catch (_e) {} }
      return J({ ok: true, action: 'matched', matched_slug: matched, confidence: cls.confidence ?? null, reason: cls.reason || '' });
    }

    const slug = slugify(cls.proposed_slug || raw);
    const name = String(cls.proposed_name || raw).slice(0, 80);
    if (!slug) return J({ error: 'could_not_slug' }, 400);

    // idempotent: if the agent already exists, don't duplicate
    const { data: exists } = await admin.from('category_agents').select('slug').eq('slug', slug).maybeSingle();
    if (exists) return J({ ok: true, action: 'exists', slug });

    // 2) generate the full parity kit (ask for minified JSON; generous token budget)
    const genSys = 'You are a senior UAE construction/services domain expert building a new category for a B2B quotation marketplace. Produce a rich, accurate, UAE-specific kit. Ground everything in real UAE practice and authorities (DEWA, Dubai Municipality, Dubai Civil Defence/DCD, SIRA, Trakhees/DDA, MOIAT/ESMA, MOHRE, Al Sa’fat) ONLY where genuinely relevant — never invent a regulation. Output ONLY minified JSON (no markdown, no commentary) with keys: '
      + '"emoji" (1 char), "persona" (<=240 chars), "knowledge" (200-350 words: exactly what a complete itemised quote in this category must include — scope, materials/brands/specs, units, standards, install/testing, UAE approvals; expert checklist prose), '
      + '"questions" (array of 8-11 objects {key,label,type[choice|text|number|bool],options?,required(bool),decision?} — RFQ qualification; UAE authority triggers go in "decision"), '
      + '"reg_keywords" (array 3-8 lowercase terms), "supplier_requirements" (array of short strings: UAE licences/certs needed), "compliance_checklist" (array of short strings to verify on a quote). Keep arrays concise so the JSON is complete and valid.';
    let g: any = null;
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2 && !g; attempt++) {
      const genRaw = await llm(genSys, `CATEGORY: ${name} (slug: ${slug})\nSupplier described it as: "${raw}"${hint ? `\nServices: ${hint}` : ''}`, 3800);
      const p = parseJson(genRaw);
      if (p && p.knowledge && Array.isArray(p.questions)) g = p;
    }
    if (!g) return J({ error: 'generation_failed', slug }, 502);

    // 3) LIVE writes: agent (intake), playbook (intake), spec (intake requirements)
    await admin.from('category_agents').insert({ slug, name, emoji: String(g.emoji || '🛠️').slice(0,4), active: true, persona: String(g.persona || '').slice(0, 500) });
    await admin.from('qualification_playbooks').insert({ category: slug, version: 1, status: 'active', questions: g.questions, effective_date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) });
    try { await admin.from('category_specs').upsert({ category: slug, label: name, fields: {}, supplier_requirements: g.supplier_requirements || [], compliance_checklist: g.compliance_checklist || [], updated_at: new Date().toISOString(), reqs_updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }, { onConflict: 'category' }); } catch (_e) {}

    // 4) reg mapping proposal (staged, applied on approval)
    const kws: string[] = Array.isArray(g.reg_keywords) ? g.reg_keywords.map((s: any)=>String(s).toLowerCase()) : [];
    const { data: regs } = await admin.from('regulations').select('id,title,authority,categories').limit(200);
    const regMatches = (regs || []).filter((r: any) => { const hay = `${r.title||''} ${r.authority||''}`.toLowerCase(); return kws.some(k => k && hay.includes(k)); })
      .slice(0, 8).map((r: any) => ({ id: r.id, title: r.title, authority: r.authority }));

    // 5) founder review card — knowledge stays PENDING until approved
    const { data: card } = await admin.from('agent_actions').insert({
      agent: 'knowledge_curator', kind: 'category_knowledge', status: 'pending', risk: 'medium',
      title: 'New category auto-provisioned: ' + name,
      recommendation: 'A supplier self-registered a trade we did not have. The agent, its qualification playbook and category requirements are LIVE for intake. Review & approve the AI-generated quoting knowledge (and regulation links) to bring it to full quality.',
      detail: { signal: 'category_knowledge:' + slug, kind: 'category_knowledge', slug, name, knowledge: g.knowledge, reg_matches: regMatches, reg_keywords: kws, playbook_questions: (g.questions||[]).length, source_raw: raw, lead_id: leadId },
      target_table: 'category_agents', target_id: slug
    }).select('id').maybeSingle();

    if (leadId) { try { await admin.from('leads').update({ categories: slug }).eq('id', leadId); } catch (_e) {} }
    return J({ ok: true, action: 'provisioned', slug, name, live: ['category_agents','qualification_playbooks','category_specs'], pending: ['agent_knowledge','reg_mapping'], reg_matches: regMatches.length, review_action_id: card?.id ?? null });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/category_reqs/index.ts

```typescript
// category_reqs — AI category generator extension (#1): generate per-category supplier requirements
// + compliance checklists (UAE) into category_specs. Auth: __secret == inbound_secret.
// Actions: 'generate' {category}, 'backfill' {limit}.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' } });
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
const llm = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 1400, temperature: 0.2 }); // shared OpenRouter client (Sonnet-first + 25s timeout)
function parseJson(s: string): any { if (!s) return null; const m = s.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (!m) return null; try { return JSON.parse(m[0]); } catch { return null; } }

async function genOne(category: string, label: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const sys = 'You define onboarding standards for a UAE B2B services marketplace. For the given service category, produce (1) SUPPLIER REQUIREMENTS: what a legitimate supplier in this trade must have to be approved and to quote credibly in the UAE (licences, trade-licence activity, certifications, insurances, technical staff/tickets, equipment, portfolio, approvals from authorities), and (2) a COMPLIANCE CHECKLIST: the UAE regulatory / safety / documentation items relevant to delivering this service (e.g. Dubai Municipality, Civil Defence, DEWA, ADDC, ESMA, HACCP, third-party inspections, warranties, insurances, permits). Be specific and realistic to the UAE. Return ONLY JSON: {"supplier_requirements":[{"item":string,"why":string,"mandatory":boolean}],"compliance_checklist":[{"item":string,"authority":string|null,"notes":string|null}]}.';
  const raw = await llm(sys, 'Category: ' + category + (label ? ' (' + label + ')' : ''), 1500);
  const out = parseJson(raw || '');
  if (!out || !Array.isArray(out.supplier_requirements)) return false;
  const { error } = await admin.from('category_specs').update({
    supplier_requirements: out.supplier_requirements,
    compliance_checklist: out.compliance_checklist || [],
    reqs_updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
  }).eq('category', category);
  return !error;
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': '*' } });
  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
  const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
  if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
  const action = String(body.action || 'generate');

  if (action === 'generate') {
    const category = String(body.category || '').trim();
    if (!category) return J({ error: 'category required' }, 400);
    const { data: cs } = await admin.from('category_specs').select('category,label').eq('category', category).maybeSingle();
    if (!cs) return J({ error: 'unknown category' }, 404);
    const ok = await genOne(category, cs.label || '');
    return J({ ok, category });
  }

  if (action === 'backfill') {
    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(String(body.limit || '3'), 10) || 3, 1), 8);
    const { data: rows } = await admin.from('category_specs').select('category,label').is('supplier_requirements', null).limit(limit);
    const done: string[] = [];
    for (const r of rows || []) { if (await genOne(r.category, (r as any).label || '')) done.push(r.category); }
    return J({ ok: true, generated: done, remaining_unfilled: 'run again to continue' });
  }

  return J({ error: 'unknown action' }, 400);
});
```

### supabase/functions/claim_lookup/index.ts

```typescript
// claim_lookup v2 - public "is this your company?" check for the supplier claim flow.
//
// SECURITY FIX 19 Jul 2026 ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// v1 accepted { id } - the sequential leads.id primary key - and returned company_name + emirate
// to any anonymous caller. Walking id = 1,2,3... therefore dumped the entire 20,470-row supplier
// lead database: the core commercial asset of the marketplace, and the thing the whole anonymous
// model exists to protect. It was not an authentication bug (this endpoint is public BY DESIGN -
// an invited supplier has no account yet, so there is nobody to authenticate), it was an
// IDENTIFIER bug: the lookup key was guessable.
//
// v2 accepts only leads.claim_token, an unguessable UUID added in the
// leads_claim_token_stop_enumeration migration. Guessing one is infeasible, so the endpoint stays
// public while bulk harvesting stops.
//
// The raw-id path is deliberately REMOVED rather than deprecated: zero claim invitations had been
// sent and zero leads claimed when this shipped, so nothing in the wild depends on it. Anything
// still calling with { id } is either stale internal code or someone enumerating - both of which
// we want to see, so those calls are rejected AND logged rather than silently supported.
//
// OUTREACH MUST NOW LINK WITH THE TOKEN, e.g.
//     https://quotesdone.com/claim?t=<leads.claim_token>
// Never put leads.id in a supplier invitation.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
const T0 = Date.now();

async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'claim_lookup', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the lookup */ }
}

const UUID_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const token = String(body.token || body.t || '').trim();

    // Reject-and-log the old enumerable shape. A burst of these is a scrape in progress.
    if (!token && (body.id || body.ref)) {
      await logRun('error', { rejected_legacy_id: 1, asked_id: Number(body.id || body.ref) || null },
        'claim_lookup was called with a numeric lead id, which is no longer accepted. Until 19 Jul 2026 this returned company_name and emirate for any sequential id, allowing the whole 20,470-row supplier database to be enumerated. Either an outreach template still builds links with leads.id (fix the template to use claim_token) or someone is attempting a scrape.');
      return J({ ok: false, error: 'invalid_link', message: 'This claim link is out of date. Please use the link from your latest invitation, or contact management@quotesdone.com.' }, 400);
    }

    if (!token || !UUID_RE.test(token)) {
      return J({ ok: false, error: 'invalid_link', message: 'This claim link is not valid. Please use the link from your invitation.' }, 400);
    }

    const { data: l, error } = await admin.from('leads')
      .select('id,company_name,emirate,claimed,approval_status,permanently_closed')
      .eq('claim_token', token).maybeSingle();

    if (error) {
      await logRun('error', { lookup_ok: 0 }, 'claim_lookup could not read the leads table (' + String(error.message).slice(0, 140) + '), so a supplier with a VALID invitation link was told their link is invalid. This is a database failure, not a bad link - the supplier may abandon the claim.');
      return J({ ok: false, error: 'temporarily_unavailable', message: 'We could not check this link just now. Please try again shortly.' }, 503);
    }

    // Unknown token: do not distinguish "never existed" from "closed" in the response.
    if (!l || l.permanently_closed) {
      await logRun('ok', { found: 0 }, 'claim_lookup received a well-formed token that matched no available lead. With unguessable tokens this should be rare; a run of these suggests a broken outreach template rather than probing, since tokens cannot be guessed.');
      return J({ ok: false, error: 'not_found', message: 'This claim link is no longer available. Please contact management@quotesdone.com.' }, 404);
    }

    await logRun('ok', { found: 1, already_claimed: l.claimed ? 1 : 0 },
      'claim_lookup resolved a valid invitation token' + (l.claimed ? ' for a lead that has ALREADY been claimed - the supplier will be told it is taken.' : ' for an unclaimed lead; the supplier can proceed to claim it.'));

    return J({ ok: true, company_name: l.company_name || null, emirate: l.emirate || null,
      claimable: !l.claimed, already_claimed: !!l.claimed });
  } catch (e) {
    await logRun('error', { unhandled_exception: 1 }, 'claim_lookup threw an unhandled exception: ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0, 200) + ' - a supplier trying to claim their listing was blocked for an internal reason.');
    return J({ ok: false, error: 'error' }, 500);
  }
});
```

```typescript
// collections_legal v1 — non-response fine lifecycle. Sends gentle reminders, and at 30 WORKING days unpaid escalates:
// applies UAE-lawful interest (<=9% p.a., Fed. Decree-Law 50/2022) + a fixed admin fee, then the Legal agent DRAFTS two
// branded PDFs — (1) a formal demand letter to the supplier, (2) the founder's case-support file (with the signed T&C as
// evidence and a moral/reputational-damages head of claim under Art. 293) — backs them up to Dropbox, and raises a founder
// approval card BEFORE the demand letter is sent (oversight). Never auto-sends. inbound_secret gated. Not legal advice.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const BASE = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')! + '/functions/v1';
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
const esc = (s: unknown) => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>]/g, (c)=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;'} as any)[c]);
const money = (n: unknown) => 'AED ' + Number(n||0).toLocaleString('en-US',{minimumFractionDigits:2, maximumFractionDigits:2});
const fmtD = (s: unknown) => { if(!s) return '—'; try { return new Date(String(s)).toISOString().slice(0,10); } catch { return String(s); } };
const dbx = (x: unknown) => String(x??'').replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|\r\n\t]+/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
const REF = (id: unknown) => 'QD-NR-' + String(id);

async function renderPdf(html: string, title: string, name: string){
  const r = await fetch(`${BASE}/make_pdf`, { method:'POST', headers:{ 'Content-Type':'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: await sec('inbound_secret'), html, title, name: name.replace(/[^a-z0-9_]+/gi,'_').slice(0,60), bucket:'supplier-docs', folder:'legal' }) });
  const jd = await r.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
  if (!jd?.path) throw new Error('make_pdf '+(jd?.error||r.status));
  return String(jd.path);
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error:'forbidden' }, 403);
    const { data: cfg } = await admin.from('collections_config').select('*').eq('id',1).maybeSingle();
    const C = cfg || { interest_pa:0.09, admin_fee:250, escalate_working_days:30, reminder_max:3 };
    const owner = (await sec('admin_emails')||'').split(/[,;\s]+/).filter(Boolean)[0] || 'management@quotesdone.com';

    // ---- 1) gentle reminders (pre-escalation) ----
    let reminded = 0;
    const { data: rem } = await admin.from('supplier_dues').select('id,supplier_id,amount_due,status,reminders,last_reminder_at,legal_stage')
      .in('status',['due','pending','reminded']).is('legal_stage', null).lt('reminders', C.reminder_max);
    for (const d of (rem||[])){
      if (d.last_reminder_at && (Date.now() - new Date(d.last_reminder_at).getTime()) < 4*864e5) continue;
      const { data: l } = await admin.from('leads').select('company_name,claimed_by,email').eq('id', d.supplier_id).maybeSingle();
      await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type:'nonresponse_reminder', to_email: l?.claimed_by||l?.email, to_role:'supplier', channel:'portal', status:'portal', lead_id: d.supplier_id,
        subject:'Reminder: outstanding non-response charge',
        body:'Reminder: a non-response charge of '+money(d.amount_due)+' is outstanding on your account (the reveal fee refunded to a customer after a paid reveal was not responded to). Please settle it on the portal to lift the hold on new matches. QuotesDone charges no commission on won jobs.' });
      await admin.from('supplier_dues').update({ status:'reminded', reminders:(d.reminders||0)+1, last_reminder_at:new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', d.id);
      reminded++;
    }

    // ---- 2) escalate at >= escalate_working_days ----
    const { data: due } = await admin.rpc('fn_dues_to_escalate', { p_days: C.escalate_working_days });
    let escalated = 0; const results: any[] = [];
    for (const row of (due||[])){
      try {
        const principal = Number(row.principal||0);
        const interest = Math.round(principal * Number(C.interest_pa) * (Number(row.days_overdue)/365) * 100)/100;
        const admin_fee = Number(C.admin_fee);
        const total = Math.round((principal + interest + admin_fee)*100)/100;
        const amt = { principal, interest, admin_fee, total, days_overdue: row.days_overdue };
        const ref = REF(row.due_id);
        const demandPath = await renderPdf(demandHtml(row, amt, C), 'Formal Demand '+ref, 'demand_'+row.due_id);
        const casePath = await renderPdf(caseHtml(row, amt, C), 'Case File '+ref, 'casefile_'+row.due_id);
        await admin.from('supplier_dues').update({ status:'legal', legal_stage:'legal', legal_escalated_at:new Date().toISOString(),
          interest_amount:interest, admin_fee, total_claim:total, demand_letter_path:demandPath, case_file_path:casePath, evidence_terms_path: row.signed_terms_path||null,
          fine_pct: Number(C.interest_pa)*100, fine_amount: 0 /* C1 fix (OS audit): interest lives only in interest_amount. supplier_pay.owed() and fn_gl_sync_business sum interest_amount + fine_amount, so mirroring interest here double-billed the supplier and double-credited the GL. */ }).eq('id', row.due_id);
        // keep the account held
        await admin.from('leads').update({ matching_blocked:true, matching_block_reason:'Unpaid non-response charge — in legal collections' }).eq('id', row.supplier_id);
        // back up both PDFs to the supplier's Dropbox Legal folder
        const base = '/QuotesDone Backup/Suppliers/'+dbx(row.category)+'/'+dbx(row.company_name||('Supplier '+row.supplier_id))+' ('+row.supplier_id+')/Legal/';
        for (const [p, label, kind] of [[demandPath,'Formal Demand Letter '+ref+'.pdf','demand'],[casePath,'Case Support File '+ref+'.pdf','case']] as any){
          await admin.from('doc_backups').insert({ entity:'supplier', entity_id:String(row.supplier_id), doc_type:'Legal '+kind, bucket:'supplier-docs', path:p, file_name:label, dropbox_path: base+label, source:'storage', dedupe_key:'LEGAL:'+row.due_id+':'+kind });
        }
        // founder approval card (approve BEFORE the demand letter is sent)
        await admin.from('agent_actions').insert({ agent:'legal_ai', kind:'dues_legal_demand', status:'pending', risk:'high',
          title:'Approve demand letter — '+(row.company_name||('Supplier '+row.supplier_id))+' ('+money(total)+')',
          recommendation:'A supplier is '+row.days_overdue+' days overdue on a non-response charge. A formal demand letter and a case-support file have been drafted. Approve to issue the demand letter to the supplier; the case file is for your records / to instruct a lawyer.',
          detail: JSON.stringify({ ref, supplier_id:row.supplier_id, company:row.company_name, principal, interest, admin_fee, total, demand_letter_path:demandPath, case_file_path:casePath, signed_terms:row.signed_terms_path }),
          target_table:'supplier_dues', target_id:String(row.due_id) });
        // alert founder
        await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type:'legal_pack_ready', to_email:owner, to_role:'admin', channel:'email',
          subject:'Legal pack ready for approval — '+(row.company_name||'supplier')+' '+money(total),
          body:(row.company_name||'A supplier')+' is '+row.days_overdue+' days overdue on a non-response charge of '+money(principal)+'. Total now '+money(total)+' (incl. '+(C.interest_pa*100)+'% p.a. interest '+money(interest)+' + admin '+money(admin_fee)+'). A demand letter and your case-support file are drafted and saved; approve in the OS to issue the demand letter.' });
        escalated++; results.push({ due:row.due_id, total, demandPath, casePath });
      } catch (e){ results.push({ due:row.due_id, error:String((e as Error)?.message||e).slice(0,160) }); }
    }
    return J({ ok:true, reminded, escalated, results });
  } catch (e){ return J({ error:String((e as Error)?.message||e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
// compliance_archive v4 — signed T&C acceptance certificates + customer register + Dropbox mirror.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import * as XLSX from 'https://esm.sh/xlsx@0.18.5';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const URL_ = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
const BUCKET = 'signed-terms';
const DBX_BASE = '/QuotesDone Backup';
const TENYRS = 10 * 365 * 24 * 3600;

async function sec(k: string): Promise<string | undefined> { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
async function authed(req: Request, body: any) { if (body.__secret && body.__secret === (await sec('inbound_secret'))) return true; const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, ''); const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt); const allow = (await sec('admin_emails') || '').split(',').map((s) => s.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean); return !!(user?.email && allow.includes(user.email.toLowerCase())); }
function esc(s: any) { return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;'); }
function safeName(s: string) { return String(s || '').replace(/[^\w.\- ]+/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 80) || 'record'; }
async function sha256hex(s: string) { const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(s)); return [...new Uint8Array(buf)].map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(''); }
function gst(iso: string) { try { return new Date(iso).toLocaleString('en-GB', { timeZone: 'Asia/Dubai', day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) + ' (GST)'; } catch { return iso; } }

async function dbxToken(): Promise<string | null> {
  const key = await sec('dropbox_app_key'), secret = await sec('dropbox_app_secret'), refresh = await sec('dropbox_refresh_token');
  if (!key || !secret || !refresh) return null;
  try {
    const r = await fetch('https://api.dropboxapi.com/oauth2/token', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: new URLSearchParams({ grant_type: 'refresh_token', refresh_token: refresh, client_id: key, client_secret: secret }) });
    const jd = await r.json(); return jd?.access_token || null;
  } catch { return null; }
}
function apiArg(obj: any) { return JSON.stringify(obj).replace(/[-￿]/g, (c) => '\\u' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).padStart(4, '0')); }
async function dbxUpload(token: string, path: string, bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const r = await fetch('https://content.dropboxapi.com/2/files/upload', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token, 'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream', 'Dropbox-API-Arg': apiArg({ path, mode: 'overwrite', autorename: false, mute: true, strict_conflict: false }) }, body: bytes });
    return r.ok;
  } catch { return false; }
}

async function renderCert(fields: Record<string, string>, kind: string, hash: string, name: string, termsUrl: string): Promise<{ path: string; url: string } | null> {
  const rows: [string, string][] = [];
  rows.push(['Full name', fields.full_name]);
  if (kind === 'supplier') rows.push(['Company', fields.company], ['Authorised signatory', fields.full_name]);
  if (fields.dob) rows.push(['Date of birth', fields.dob]);
  rows.push(['Mobile', fields.phone], ['Email', fields.email], ['Account type', kind === 'supplier' ? 'Supplier' : 'Customer'], ['Terms accepted', fields.terms_label], ['Accepted at (UTC)', fields.accepted_utc], ['Accepted at (local)', gst(fields.accepted_iso)], ['IP address', fields.ip || 'Not recorded'], ['Method', 'Click-to-accept checkbox at registration'], ['Document integrity (SHA-256)', hash]);
  const trs = rows.map(([k, v]) => `<tr><td>${esc(k)}</td><td>${esc(v)}</td></tr>`).join('');
  const clauses = kind === 'supplier' ? '<ul><li>No-circumvention: no off-platform dealing with a customer introduced through the Platform for 24 months.</li><li>Confidentiality: no copying, reuse or disclosure of platform leads, customer data, pricing or anonymised scopes.</li><li>No replication or competing use of the Platform&#39;s software, matching logic or outputs.</li></ul>' : '<ul><li>No use of the Platform to build, benchmark or assist a competing product or service.</li><li>No scraping, copying or reuse of supplier data, pricing or platform content.</li><li>No reverse-engineering or replication of the Platform&#39;s software, matching logic or outputs.</li></ul>';
  const penalties = kind === 'supplier' ? 'Breach of the no-circumvention obligation entitles QuotesDone to liquidated compensation of AED 15,000 per incident, or three (3) times the avoided fee, whichever is higher, in addition to the unpaid fee. Breach of the confidentiality or data-reuse obligation entitles QuotesDone to AED 20,000 per incident. In every case QuotesDone is also entitled to injunctive relief to stop the ongoing breach and to recover any further proven losses.' : 'Any breach of the above obligations entitles QuotesDone to liquidated compensation of AED 10,000 per incident, immediate suspension or termination of the account, recovery of any further proven losses, and injunctive relief to stop the ongoing breach. The parties agree these amounts are a genuine pre-estimate of loss under the laws of the United Arab Emirates.';
  const body_html = `<p>This certificate records the electronic acceptance of the QuotesDone ${kind === 'supplier' ? 'Supplier Agreement &amp; Platform Terms' : 'Customer Terms &amp; Conditions'} by the party identified below. Acceptance was given by ticking the &quot;I accept&quot; box during registration on the QuotesDone platform, which under the laws of the United Arab Emirates (including the Electronic Transactions and Trust Services Law) constitutes a valid and binding electronic acceptance.</p><table><thead><tr><th>Field</th><th>Detail</th></tr></thead><tbody>${trs}</tbody></table><h3>Terms accepted</h3><p>By registering, the party accepted the QuotesDone ${kind === 'supplier' ? 'Supplier Agreement &amp; Platform Terms' : 'Customer Terms &amp; Conditions'} (${fields.terms_label}), published in full at ${termsUrl}. The key binding obligations accepted include:</p>${clauses}<h3>Penalties for breach</h3><p>${penalties}</p><p>The SHA-256 value above is a cryptographic fingerprint of the exact Terms text that was accepted. Any later change to that text produces a different fingerprint, allowing the accepted version to be independently verified.</p><p>This is a system-generated record issued by QuotesDone Technologies and is valid without a handwritten signature.</p>`;
  try {
    const secret = await sec('inbound_secret');
    const pr = await fetch(`${URL_}/functions/v1/pdf_native`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: secret, title: 'Certificate of Acceptance — Terms & Conditions', body_html, name, bucket: BUCKET, folder: (kind === 'supplier' ? 'suppliers' : 'customers'), options: { letterhead: true, sign: true, stamp: true } }) });
    const pj = await pr.json(); if (pj?.ok && pj.path) return { path: pj.path, url: pj.url }; return null;
  } catch { return null; }
}

async function buildRegister(): Promise<{ count: number; url: string | null; bytes: Uint8Array | null }> {
  const { data } = await admin.from('customers').select('full_name,date_of_birth,phone,email,signed_terms_path,created_at,email_verified').order('created_at', { ascending: true });
  const rows = (data || []);
  const paths = rows.map((c: any) => c.signed_terms_path).filter(Boolean) as string[];
  const urlByPath: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (paths.length) { try { const { data: su } = await admin.storage.from(BUCKET).createSignedUrls(paths, TENYRS); for (const it of (su || [])) { if (it.path && it.signedUrl) urlByPath[it.path] = it.signedUrl; } } catch (_e) { } }
  const header = ['Name', 'Date of birth', 'Mobile', 'Email', 'Signed T&C copy', 'Registered (UTC)', 'Email verified'];
  const aoa: any[][] = [header];
  const urls: (string | null)[] = [null];
  for (const c of rows) { const u = c.signed_terms_path ? (urlByPath[c.signed_terms_path] || null) : null; aoa.push([c.full_name || '', c.date_of_birth || '', c.phone || '', c.email || '', u ? 'Open signed PDF' : '', (c.created_at || '').slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' '), c.email_verified ? 'Yes' : 'No']); urls.push(u); }
  const ws = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(aoa); ws['!cols'] = [{ wch: 26 }, { wch: 14 }, { wch: 18 }, { wch: 30 }, { wch: 24 }, { wch: 20 }, { wch: 14 }];
  for (let r = 1; r < aoa.length; r++) { const u = urls[r]; if (!u) continue; const ref = XLSX.utils.encode_cell({ c: 4, r }); ws[ref] = { t: 's', v: 'Open signed PDF', l: { Target: u, Tooltip: 'Open signed acceptance certificate (PDF)' } }; }
  const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new(); XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, 'Customers');
  const out = XLSX.write(wb, { type: 'array', bookType: 'xlsx' }); const bytes = new Uint8Array(out);
  await admin.storage.from(BUCKET).upload('registers/customers-register.xlsx', bytes, { contentType: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet', upsert: true });
  const { data: signed } = await admin.storage.from(BUCKET).createSignedUrl('registers/customers-register.xlsx', TENYRS);
  return { count: rows.length, url: signed?.signedUrl || null, bytes };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    if (!(await authed(req, body))) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const action = String(body.action || '');
    try { await admin.storage.createBucket(BUCKET, { public: false }); } catch (_e) { }

    if (action === 'ping') { const t = await dbxToken(); return J({ ok: true, dropbox_ready: !!t }); }

    if (action === 'sign') {
      const kind = body.kind === 'supplier' ? 'supplier' : 'customer';
      const keyEmail = String(body.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      let rec: any = null;
      if (kind === 'customer') { const q = keyEmail ? admin.from('customers').select('*').eq('email', keyEmail) : admin.from('customers').select('*').eq('id', body.id); const { data } = await q.maybeSingle(); rec = data; }
      else { const q = keyEmail ? admin.from('leads').select('*').eq('claimed_by', keyEmail) : admin.from('leads').select('*').eq('id', body.id); const { data } = await q.maybeSingle(); rec = data; }
      if (!rec) return J({ error: 'record_not_found' }, 404);

      let termsText = '', termsLabel = '';
      if (kind === 'supplier') { termsText = (await sec('supplier_terms_html')) || ''; termsLabel = 'Supplier Agreement — Version 4'; }
      else { const { data: p } = await admin.from('pages').select('html').eq('slug', 'legal_terms_body').maybeSingle(); termsText = (p?.html as string) || ''; termsLabel = 'Customer Terms & Conditions — Version 3'; }
      const hash = await sha256hex(termsText);
      const acceptedIso = (kind === 'supplier' ? rec.accepted_terms_at : rec.tos_accepted_at) || new Date().toISOString();
      const ip = (kind === 'supplier' ? rec.accepted_terms_ip : rec.tos_ip) || '';
      const fields: Record<string, string> = { full_name: rec.full_name || rec.contact_name || rec.signatory_name || '', company: rec.company_name || '', dob: (kind === 'supplier' ? rec.owner_dob : rec.date_of_birth) || '', phone: rec.phone || '', email: rec.email || rec.claimed_by || keyEmail, terms_label: termsLabel, accepted_utc: acceptedIso.slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' ') + ' UTC', accepted_iso: acceptedIso, ip };
      const nm = safeName((kind === 'supplier' ? fields.company : fields.full_name) || fields.email).replace(/\s+/g, '_') + '_TnC-Acceptance';
      const termsUrl = kind === 'supplier' ? 'https://quotesdone.com/supplier-agreement' : 'https://quotesdone.com/terms';
      const cert = await renderCert(fields, kind, hash, nm, termsUrl);
      if (!cert) return J({ error: 'cert_render_failed' }, 502);
      const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
      let certUrl = cert.url; try { const { data: lu } = await admin.storage.from(BUCKET).createSignedUrl(cert.path, TENYRS); if (lu?.signedUrl) certUrl = lu.signedUrl; } catch (_e) { }
      if (kind === 'customer') await admin.from('customers').update({ signed_terms_url: certUrl, signed_terms_path: cert.path, signed_terms_at: nowIso }).eq('id', rec.id);
      else await admin.from('leads').update({ signed_terms_url: certUrl, signed_terms_path: cert.path, signed_terms_at: nowIso }).eq('id', rec.id);

      let dbx = false; const token = await dbxToken();
      let pdfBytes: Uint8Array | null = null;
      try { const dl = await admin.storage.from(BUCKET).download(cert.path); if (dl.data) pdfBytes = new Uint8Array(await dl.data.arrayBuffer()); } catch (_e) { }
      if (token && pdfBytes) {
        const folder = kind === 'supplier' ? `${DBX_BASE}/Suppliers/${safeName(fields.company || fields.email)}` : `${DBX_BASE}/Customers/${safeName(fields.full_name || fields.email)}`;
        dbx = await dbxUpload(token, `${folder}/Signed-Terms-Acceptance.pdf`, pdfBytes);
      }

      let reg: any = null;
      if (kind === 'customer') { try { const r = await buildRegister(); reg = { count: r.count, url: r.url }; if (token && r.bytes) await dbxUpload(token, `${DBX_BASE}/Customers/customers-register.xlsx`, r.bytes); } catch (_e) { } }

      return J({ ok: true, kind, signed_url: certUrl, dropbox_mirrored: dbx, register: reg });
    }

    if (action === 'register') {
      const r = await buildRegister(); let dbx = false; const token = await dbxToken();
      if (token && r.bytes) dbx = await dbxUpload(token, `${DBX_BASE}/Customers/customers-register.xlsx`, r.bytes);
      return J({ ok: true, count: r.count, url: r.url, dropbox_mirrored: dbx });
    }

    return J({ error: 'unknown_action' }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
// contact_submit - public contact form handler. Stores the message, emails the founder (best-effort). Honeypot spam guard. verify_jwt=false.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type, apikey', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
function esc(s: string){ return String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;'); }
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const b = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    // honeypot: hidden 'company' field must stay empty
    if (String(b.company||'').trim() !== '') return J({ ok: true });
    const name = String(b.name||'').trim().slice(0,120);
    const email = String(b.email||'').trim().slice(0,160);
    const phone = String(b.phone||'').trim().slice(0,40);
    const message = String(b.message||'').trim().slice(0,4000);
    if (message.length < 4) return J({ error: 'Please write a short message.' }, 400);
    if (!/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(email)) return J({ error: 'Please enter a valid email so we can reply.' }, 400);
    const ua = String(req.headers.get('user-agent')||'').slice(0,300);
    const { data: row, error } = await admin.from('contact_messages').insert({ name, email, phone, message, user_agent: ua }).select('id').maybeSingle();
    if (error) return J({ error: 'Could not send. Please try again.' }, 500);
    // best-effort email notify
    try {
      const key = await sec('resend_api_key');
      const to = (await sec('admin_emails') || 'management@quotesdone.com').split(',')[0].trim();
      const from = (await sec('resend_from')) || 'QuotesDone <noreply@quotesdone.com>';
      // SUPPRESSION BYPASS 27 Jul 2026 ------------------------------------------------------------
      // This handler built its own Resend call and never consulted email_suppressions - send_outbox
      // was the only sender that did. The moment the admin notify inbox lands on that list (one
      // hard bounce from resend_webhook is enough) we would keep pushing every contact-form message
      // at a mailbox Resend has already told us rejects mail, damaging the sending domain for the
      // supplier and customer mail that shares it. Check the RECIPIENT first. The contact_messages
      // row is stored either way so nothing a customer wrote is lost, but the skipped notification
      // is written to agent_runs rather than disappearing into the best-effort catch below.
      const { data: supRow } = await admin.from('email_suppressions').select('email').eq('email', to.toLowerCase()).maybeSingle();
      if (supRow) {
        try { await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent:'contact_submit', status:'error', counts:{ suppressed:1 }, note:'contact_submit did NOT email the new contact message: the admin notify address ('+to+') is in email_suppressions. The message is safe in contact_messages (ref #'+(row?.id||'')+') - read it there, then fix the mailbox and delete its email_suppressions row.', finished_at:new Date().toISOString() }); } catch(_e2){ /* */ }
      } else if (key) {
        await fetch('https://api.resend.com/emails', { method:'POST', headers:{ 'Authorization':'Bearer '+key, 'Content-Type':'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({
          from, to, reply_to: email || undefined,
          subject: 'New contact message'+(name?(' from '+name):''),
          html: `<p><b>New contact-form message</b></p><p><b>Name:</b> ${esc(name)||'—'}<br><b>Email:</b> ${esc(email)||'—'}<br><b>Phone:</b> ${esc(phone)||'—'}</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap">${esc(message)}</p><p style="color:#888;font-size:12px">Ref #${row?.id||''}</p>`
        }) });
      }
    } catch(_e){ /* email is best-effort; the row is stored regardless */ }
    return J({ ok: true });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/content_revise/index.ts

````typescript
// content_revise — the "comment -> it changes" half of the marketing review gate. It picks up drafts the
// founder sent back (review_status='changes_requested' with a founder_comment), rewrites the post to address
// the comment (on-brand, using the marketing knowledge), and puts it back in the review queue as 'pending'.
// Never publishes. Auth: __secret (cron) OR admin JWT.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
const llm = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 1100, temperature: 0.4 });
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
async function authed(req: Request, body: any): Promise<boolean> {
  if (body.__secret && body.__secret === (await sec('inbound_secret'))) return true;
  const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, ''); if (!jwt) return false;
  const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
  const allow = (await sec('admin_emails') || 'management@quotesdone.com').split(',').map((s) => s.trim().toLowerCase());
  return !!(user?.email && allow.includes(user.email.toLowerCase()));
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    if (!(await authed(req, body))) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);

    const { data: drafts } = await admin.from('content_drafts')
      .select('id,title,body,channel,founder_comment')
      .eq('review_status', 'changes_requested').not('founder_comment', 'is', null).limit(5);
    if (!drafts || !drafts.length) return J({ ok: true, revised: 0, note: 'nothing to revise' });

    let brain = ''; try { const { data } = await admin.rpc('fn_agent_context', { p_agent_key: 'marketing', p_max_chars: 6000 }); brain = data ? String(data) : ''; } catch (_e) {}
    const sys = 'You revise a QuotesDone marketing post to address the founder feedback exactly, keeping it on-brand (UAE B2B anonymous quotation marketplace; practical, trustworthy, pro-SME; never invent stats/prices/client names). Change exactly what the feedback asks and improve the post; keep the same channel and intent. Return STRICT minified JSON only: {"title":"...","body":"..."}. body is the finished revised post.' + (brain ? ('\n\n' + brain.slice(0, 4500)) : '');

    const results: any[] = [];
    for (const d of drafts) {
      const user = 'CHANNEL: ' + (d.channel || 'social') + '\nCURRENT TITLE: ' + (d.title || '') + '\nCURRENT POST:\n' + (d.body || '') + '\n\nFOUNDER FEEDBACK (address this exactly):\n' + (d.founder_comment || '') + '\n\nReturn the revised JSON.';
      const raw = (await llm(sys, user, 1100) || '').trim();
      let p: any = null;
      try { p = JSON.parse(raw.replace(/^```(json)?/i, '').replace(/```$/, '').trim()); } catch (_e) { const m = raw.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (m) { try { p = JSON.parse(m[0]); } catch (_e2) { /* noop */ } } }
      const newBody = String(p?.body || '').trim();
      if (newBody.length < 20) { results.push({ id: d.id, ok: false, reason: 'revision_failed' }); continue; }
      await admin.from('content_drafts').update({
        title: String(p?.title || d.title || '').slice(0, 200), body: newBody.slice(0, 6000),
        review_status: 'pending', founder_comment: null, reviewed_at: null,
      }).eq('id', d.id);
      results.push({ id: d.id, ok: true });
    }
    return J({ ok: true, revised: results.filter((r) => r.ok).length, results, note: 'Revised drafts are back in the founder review queue as pending.' });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
````
