### supabase/functions/copilot/index.ts

```typescript
// copilot — AI Marketplace Copilot (#4/#5). Role-aware assistant over platform data.
// Roles: admin (marketplace analytics), customer (own procurement), supplier (own performance/why-not-invited).
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type, apikey', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
const llm = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 1200, temperature: 0.2 }); // shared OpenRouter client (Sonnet-first + 25s timeout)

async function identify(req: Request): Promise<{ role: string; id?: string; email: string } | null> {
  const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
  if (!jwt) return null;
  const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
  if (!user?.email) return null;
  const email = user.email.toLowerCase();
  const admins = String((await sec('admin_emails')) || 'management@quotesdone.com').toLowerCase().split(',').map((s) => s.trim());
  if (admins.includes(email)) return { role: 'admin', email };
  const { data: c } = await admin.from('customers').select('id,banned').eq('email', email).maybeSingle();
  if (c && !c.banned) return { role: 'customer', id: c.id as string, email };
  const { data: l } = await admin.from('leads').select('id').eq('claimed_by', email).eq('claimed', true).maybeSingle();
  if (l) return { role: 'supplier', id: String(l.id), email };
  return null;
}

function toCats(v: unknown): string[] {
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map((x) => String(x).trim()).filter(Boolean);
  return String(v || '').split(/[,;]/).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
}

async function snapshot(who: { role: string; id?: string }): Promise<any> {
  try {
    if (who.role === 'admin') { const { data } = await admin.rpc('fn_marketplace_analytics'); return { marketplace: data }; }
    if (who.role === 'customer') {
      const cid = who.id;
      const { data: inq } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('id,category,status,expected_value,hired_supplier_id,created_at').eq('customer_id', cid).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(200);
      const { data: tx } = await admin.from('transactions').select('supplier_id,reveal_fee,quote_amount,revealed_at').eq('customer_id', cid);
      const { data: projs } = await admin.from('project_summary').select('*').eq('customer_id', cid);
      const suppliers = [...new Set((tx || []).map((t: any) => t.supplier_id).filter(Boolean))];
      const spend = (tx || []).reduce((a: number, t: any) => a + (Number(t.reveal_fee) || 0), 0);
      const byStatus: Record<string, number> = {}; for (const i of inq || []) byStatus[i.status || 'unknown'] = (byStatus[i.status || 'unknown'] || 0) + 1;
      return { rfqs_total: (inq || []).length, rfqs_by_status: byStatus, reveals: (tx || []).length, fees_paid_aed: Math.round(spend), suppliers_engaged: suppliers.length, projects: projs || [] };
    }
    if (who.role === 'supplier') {
      const sid = Number(who.id);
      const { data: twin } = await admin.from('supplier_twin').select('*').eq('supplier_id', sid).maybeSingle();
      const { data: lead } = await admin.from('leads').select('categories,sector,emirate,approval_status').eq('id', sid).maybeSingle();
      // leads.categories is a comma-separated string; the supplier's sector is also a valid category.
      const cats = Array.from(new Set([ ...toCats(lead?.categories), ...(lead?.sector ? [String(lead.sector).trim()] : []) ].filter(Boolean)));
      let missed = 0, matchedRecent = 0;
      if (cats.length) {
        const since = new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 864e5).toISOString();
        const { data: rfqs } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('id').in('category', cats).gte('created_at', since);
        const ids = (rfqs || []).map((r: any) => r.id);
        if (ids.length) { const { data: m } = await admin.from('inquiry_matches').select('inquiry_id').eq('supplier_id', sid).in('inquiry_id', ids); matchedRecent = (m || []).length; missed = ids.length - matchedRecent; }
      }
      return { twin: twin || null, approval_status: lead?.approval_status, categories: cats, recent_rfqs_in_your_categories_30d: matchedRecent + missed, you_were_matched: matchedRecent, you_were_not_matched: missed };
    }
  } catch (_e) { return { error: 'snapshot_unavailable' }; }
  return {};
}

const ROLE_GUIDE: Record<string, string> = {
  admin: 'You are the QuotesDone Marketplace Copilot for the founder/admin. Answer operational and analytical questions using the SNAPSHOT (live marketplace analytics). Cite concrete numbers from the snapshot; if something is not in the snapshot, say so plainly rather than guessing. Be concise and decision-useful.',
  customer: 'You are the QuotesDone Copilot helping a business customer manage their procurement. Use ONLY their own SNAPSHOT (their RFQs, spend, suppliers, projects). Answer their questions and suggest concrete next steps such as grouping RFQs into a project or chasing a stalled RFQ. Never reveal the private data of other customers or suppliers.',
  supplier: 'You are the QuotesDone Copilot helping a supplier win more work. Use ONLY their own SNAPSHOT (their performance twin, categories, and how many recent RFQs in their categories they were or were not matched to). If they ask why they are not getting invited, explain the likely reasons from the snapshot (approval status, category coverage, response rate, win rate, reputation) and give specific improvement steps. Never reveal customer contact details or competitor quotes.'
};

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const who = await identify(req);
    if (!who) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
    const msg = String(body.message || '').trim();
    if (!msg) return J({ error: 'message required' }, 400);
    const history = Array.isArray(body.history) ? body.history.slice(-6).map((h: any) => ({ role: h.role === 'assistant' ? 'assistant' : 'user', content: String(h.content || '').slice(0, 1500) })) : [];
    const snap = await snapshot(who);
    const sys = ROLE_GUIDE[who.role] + '\n\nSNAPSHOT (read-only, just captured):\n' + JSON.stringify(snap).slice(0, 6500);
    const reply = await llm(sys, [...history, { role: 'user', content: msg }], 1200) || 'I could not reach the AI service just now — please try again in a moment.';
    try { await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'copilot', started_at: new Date().toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'ok', counts: { role: who.role } }); } catch (_e) {}
    return J({ ok: true, role: who.role, reply });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/cos_execute/index.ts

```typescript
// cos_execute (v4) — the Chief of Staff's EXECUTION ENGINE. Runs hourly. Turns the objective/task
// ledger from a plan into work actually getting done. For each ready task:
//   - if its action_class is wired to a real executor (org_action_executor registry), it RUNS that
//     executor (real side effect, within the executor's own guards) and records mode:'executed';
//   - otherwise it dispatches to the owning department's specialist (agent_brain), which reasons +
//     produces the deliverable within its delegated authority (mode:'prepared'/'delivered').
// Either way it records to the ledger + organizational memory, advances the task by its authority tier,
// and rolls each objective up to done.
//
// SAFETY (Tier-0 discipline, permanent gates) — the tier IS the gate:
//   - Only works tasks the permission model already cleared: status='assigned' (advisory/supervised/
//     autonomous), plus stale 'in_progress' reclaimed from a killed run. GATED tasks are status='proposed'
//     and are NEVER touched here — they wait for the founder. fn_dept_authority already forced every
//     money/auth/security/destructive/legal-judgment class to 'gated', so nothing dangerous can be 'assigned'.
//   - agent_brain is advisory: it prepares work and hands off; it never moves money, approves suppliers,
//     publishes, or sends. So those side effects cannot happen here even in principle.
//   - supervised tasks complete but are flagged review_pending (the founder audits them in the daily brief).
//   - FREEZE SWITCH: app_secrets.cos_frozen='true' (or ai_kill_switch='true') halts everything instantly.
// Auth: __secret (cron) OR admin-email JWT (founder "run now").
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const FN = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')! + '/functions/v1';
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
const llm = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 500, temperature: 0.2 });
const MAX_TASKS = 3;            // per run; hourly cadence drains the rest (bounded runtime)
const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3;        // no deliverable after this many hourly tries → escalate to founder
const TIME_BUDGET_MS = 110000; // stop starting new specialist calls before the edge wall limit
const STALE_MIN = 15;          // reclaim an in_progress task a prior (possibly killed) run left behind

const nowIso = () => new Date().toISOString();
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
async function authed(req: Request, body: any): Promise<boolean> {
  if (body.__secret && body.__secret === (await sec('inbound_secret'))) return true;
  const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, ''); if (!jwt) return false;
  const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
  const allow = (await sec('admin_emails') || 'management@quotesdone.com').split(',').map((s) => s.trim().toLowerCase());
  return !!(user?.email && allow.includes(user.email.toLowerCase()));
}

const VALID_BRAINS = new Set(['legal', 'collections', 'cfo', 'bookkeeper', 'security', 'it', 'onboarding', 'docs', 'followup', 'bd', 'marketing', 'brief']);
// A deliverable-complete class is one where the work product IS the completion (advice/analysis/plan/
// draft/knowledge). Others are 'prepared' — the department's own autonomous machinery (invite ramp,
// kb autofill, approval lane, etc.) performs the real side effect on its schedule.
const DELIVERED_CLASSES = /recommend|review|analy|forecast|report|research|draft|knowledge|plan|strategy|audit|assess/i;

// Ask the owning department's specialist to produce the ACTUAL deliverable for this task.
async function dispatch(deptName: string, brainKey: string, objective: string, t: any): Promise<string> {
  const instruction =
    'DEPARTMENT WORK ORDER from the Chief of Staff.\n' +
    'Company objective: ' + objective + '\n' +
    'Your department: ' + deptName + '\n' +
    'Task: ' + t.title + '\n' +
    'Detail: ' + (t.detail || '') + '\n' +
    'Action class: ' + t.action_class + '  |  Authority tier: ' + t.tier + '\n\n' +
    'Do the work now, to the fullest extent of your authority and knowledge. Produce the ACTUAL deliverable ' +
    '(the real draft / analysis / recommendation / plan / checklist / findings), not a description of what you would do. ' +
    'Be concrete and specific to QuotesDone and the UAE market. End with a one-line "RESULT:" summarising what you produced.';
  if (brainKey && VALID_BRAINS.has(brainKey)) {
    try {
      const r = await fetch(FN + '/agent_brain', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: await sec('inbound_secret'), agent: brainKey, message: instruction }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(50000) });
      const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
      if (j?.reply && String(j.reply).length > 40) return String(j.reply);
    } catch (_e) { /* fall through to generic */ }
  }
  // Generic department-head fallback (analytics, procurement, or brain unreachable).
  const out = await llm('You are the head of the ' + deptName + ' department at QuotesDone, a UAE B2B anonymous quotation marketplace. You are a seasoned professional. Produce concrete, practical deliverables. Never invent numbers.', instruction, 1200);
  return out || '';
}
function resultLine(deliverable: string): string {
  const m = deliverable.match(/RESULT:\s*(.+)\s*$/i);
  return (m ? m[1] : deliverable.slice(0, 160)).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 300);
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  const started = Date.now();
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    if (!(await authed(req, body))) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);

    // FREEZE / kill switch — halt instantly.
    if ((await sec('cos_frozen')) === 'true' || (await sec('ai_kill_switch')) === 'true') return J({ ok: true, frozen: true, note: 'CoS execution is frozen; no tasks worked.' });

    const { data: depts } = await admin.from('org_departments').select('dept_key,name,brain_agent,lead_agent');
    const deptMap = new Map((depts || []).map((d: any) => [d.dept_key, d]));
    // Action-executor registry: action_classes wired to a REAL side-effect executor.
    const { data: execs } = await admin.from('org_action_executor').select('action_class,kind,target,params,active,advisory_safe').eq('active', true);
    const execMap = new Map((execs || []).map((e: any) => [e.action_class, e]));

    // Ready set: freshly assigned + any in_progress a prior run may have left orphaned (stale).
    const staleCut = new Date(Date.now() - STALE_MIN * 60000).toISOString();
    const { data: assigned } = await admin.from('org_tasks').select('id,objective_id,dept_key,title,detail,action_class,tier,attempts,status').eq('status', 'assigned').order('id').limit(MAX_TASKS);
    let batch = assigned || [];
    if (batch.length < MAX_TASKS) {
      const { data: stale } = await admin.from('org_tasks').select('id,objective_id,dept_key,title,detail,action_class,tier,attempts,status').eq('status', 'in_progress').lt('last_run_at', staleCut).order('id').limit(MAX_TASKS - batch.length);
      batch = batch.concat(stale || []);
    }

    const touchedObjectives = new Set<number>();
    const summary: any[] = []; let done = 0, escalated = 0, working = 0;

    for (const t of batch) {
      if (Date.now() - started > TIME_BUDGET_MS) break; // leave the rest for the next hourly run
      touchedObjectives.add(t.objective_id);
      const dept: any = deptMap.get(t.dept_key) || { name: t.dept_key, brain_agent: null, lead_agent: null };
      const attempts = (t.attempts || 0) + 1;
      await admin.from('org_tasks').update({ status: 'in_progress', attempts, last_run_at: nowIso(), updated_at: nowIso() }).eq('id', t.id);

      // EXECUTOR PATH — if this action_class is wired to a real executor, run it (real side effect)
      // instead of only preparing a deliverable. advisory tasks never execute (advice only).
      const ex: any = execMap.get(t.action_class);
      if (ex && (t.tier !== 'advisory' || ex.advisory_safe)) {
        let execResult: any;
        try {
          if (ex.kind === 'rpc') { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc(ex.target, ex.params || {}); execResult = error ? { error: error.message } : data; }
          else { const r = await fetch(FN + '/' + ex.target, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: await sec('inbound_secret'), objective_id: t.objective_id, task_id: t.id, ...(ex.params || {}) }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(50000) }); execResult = await r.json().catch(() => ({ error: 'bad_json' })); }
        } catch (e) { execResult = { error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }; }
        const okExec = execResult && !execResult.error;
        const oneLine = (okExec ? String(execResult.note || JSON.stringify(execResult)) : 'executor error: ' + String(execResult?.error || 'unknown')).slice(0, 300);
        const newStatus = okExec ? 'done' : (attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS ? 'escalated' : 'in_progress');
        if (newStatus === 'done') done++; else if (newStatus === 'escalated') escalated++; else working++;
        const review_pending = newStatus === 'done' && t.tier === 'supervised';
        await admin.from('org_tasks').update({ status: newStatus, decided_by: 'cos', updated_at: nowIso(),
          result: { mode: 'executed', executor: ex.target, executed: execResult, summary: oneLine, review_pending, at: nowIso() } }).eq('id', t.id);
        try { await admin.from('org_memory').insert({ scope: t.dept_key, kind: 'action', content: (t.title + ' — ' + oneLine).slice(0, 500), source: 'cos' }); } catch (_e) {}
        if (newStatus === 'escalated') {
          try { await admin.from('agent_actions').insert({ agent: t.dept_key, kind: 'objective_step', status: 'pending', risk: 'low',
            title: ('Objective step needs you — ' + t.title).slice(0, 200),
            recommendation: ('Automated executor for ' + t.action_class + ' failed after ' + attempts + ' tries: ' + oneLine).slice(0, 400),
            detail: { objective_id: t.objective_id, task_id: t.id, dept: t.dept_key, action_class: t.action_class, tier: t.tier } }); } catch (_e) {}
        }
        summary.push({ task_id: t.id, dept: t.dept_key, tier: t.tier, status: newStatus, mode: 'executed', summary: oneLine });
        continue; // executed — skip the advisory deliverable path
      }

      const { data: obj } = await admin.from('org_objectives').select('objective').eq('id', t.objective_id).maybeSingle();
      const deliverable = (await dispatch(dept.name, dept.brain_agent || dept.lead_agent, obj?.objective || '', t)).trim();
      const oneLine = resultLine(deliverable);
      const delivered = DELIVERED_CLASSES.test(t.action_class || '') || t.tier === 'advisory';
      const mode = delivered ? 'delivered' : 'prepared'; // 'prepared' → dept's autonomous machinery executes the side effect
      const hasWork = deliverable.length > 60;

      if (hasWork) {
        try { await admin.from('org_memory').insert({ scope: t.dept_key, kind: 'deliverable', content: (t.title + ' — ' + oneLine).slice(0, 500) + '\n\n' + deliverable.slice(0, 2500), source: 'cos' }); } catch (_e) {}
      }

      // Disposition by tier — the permission model already decided what's allowed.
      let newStatus: string;
      if (!hasWork) {
        newStatus = attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS ? 'escalated' : 'in_progress'; // couldn't produce work → retry, then hand up
      } else {
        newStatus = 'done';
      }
      if (newStatus === 'done') done++; else if (newStatus === 'escalated') escalated++; else working++;

      const review_pending = newStatus === 'done' && t.tier === 'supervised';
      await admin.from('org_tasks').update({
        status: newStatus, decided_by: 'cos', updated_at: nowIso(),
        result: { deliverable: deliverable.slice(0, 6000), summary: oneLine, mode, review_pending, brain: dept.brain_agent || dept.lead_agent || 'dept_head', at: nowIso() },
      }).eq('id', t.id);

      if (newStatus === 'escalated') {
        try {
          await admin.from('agent_actions').insert({
            agent: t.dept_key, kind: 'objective_step', status: 'pending', risk: 'low',
            title: ('Objective step needs you — ' + t.title).slice(0, 200),
            recommendation: ('The ' + dept.name + ' department could not complete this autonomously after ' + attempts + ' tries. Review and advise.').slice(0, 400),
            detail: { objective_id: t.objective_id, task_id: t.id, dept: t.dept_key, action_class: t.action_class, tier: t.tier },
          });
        } catch (_e) {}
      }
      summary.push({ task_id: t.id, dept: t.dept_key, tier: t.tier, status: newStatus, mode, summary: oneLine });
    }

    // Roll up each touched objective. Open = anything still needing work or the founder (incl. gated 'proposed').
    const rolled: any[] = [];
    for (const oid of touchedObjectives) {
      const { data: all } = await admin.from('org_tasks').select('status,tier,title,result').eq('objective_id', oid);
      const open = (all || []).filter((x: any) => ['proposed', 'assigned', 'in_progress', 'escalated'].includes(x.status));
      if (open.length === 0 && (all || []).length > 0) {
        const lines = (all || []).map((x: any) => '- [' + x.status + '] ' + x.title + ': ' + String(x.result?.summary || '').slice(0, 160)).join('\n');
        const { data: o } = await admin.from('org_objectives').select('objective').eq('id', oid).maybeSingle();
        const outcome = await llm('You are the Chief of Staff at QuotesDone. In 2-3 sentences, summarize for the founder what the organization accomplished on this objective across its departments. Concrete and honest.', 'OBJECTIVE: ' + (o?.objective || '') + '\n\nTASK RESULTS:\n' + lines, 400);
        const anyFailed = (all || []).some((x: any) => x.status === 'failed');
        await admin.from('org_objectives').update({ status: anyFailed ? 'blocked' : 'done', outcome: (outcome || 'Completed.').slice(0, 2000), closed_at: nowIso(), updated_at: nowIso() }).eq('id', oid);
        rolled.push({ objective_id: oid, status: anyFailed ? 'blocked' : 'done' });
      }
    }

    try { await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'chief_of_staff', status: 'ok', finished_at: nowIso(), counts: { processed: batch.length, done, escalated, working, objectives_closed: rolled.length, ms: Date.now() - started } }); } catch (_e) {}
    return J({ ok: true, processed: batch.length, done, escalated, working, objectives_rolled: rolled, tasks: summary });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/cost_snapshot/index.ts

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.

    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'cost_snapshot', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500), started_at: startedIso, finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });

}

  const revenue_7d = await rev(d7); const revenue_30d = await rev(d30); const revenue_all = await rev();
  // --- activity ---
  const inquiries_7d = await cnt('inquiries', 'id', d7);
  const reveals_7d = await admin.from('transactions').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).gte('revealed_at', d7).then((r: any) => r.count || 0);
  const emails_7d = await cnt('notifications', 'id', d7, (q: any) => q.eq('channel', 'email').eq('status', 'sent'));
  const ai_runs_7d = await admin.from('agent_runs').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).gte('started_at', d7).then((r: any) => r.count || 0);
  const new_suppliers_7d = await admin.from('leads').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('claimed', true).gte('created_at', d7).then((r: any) => r.count || 0);
  const fmt = (n: number) => 'AED ' + Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('en-AE', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });

    openrouter_usd: or.ok ? { spent_total: or.total_usage, credits_total: or.total_credits, remaining: or.remaining } : or,
    revenue: { last_7d: revenue_7d, last_30d: revenue_30d, all_time: revenue_all },
    activity_7d: { inquiries: inquiries_7d, reveals: reveals_7d, new_suppliers: new_suppliers_7d, emails_sent: emails_7d, ai_runs: ai_runs_7d },
    note: 'OpenRouter is the only provider with a live spend API wired. Apify / Twilio / Resend / Supabase balances require their own keys + endpoints to add.'
  };

  let emailQueued = 0; let emailErr = '';
  if (body.email !== false) {
    try {

      const orLine = or.ok ? ('OpenRouter (AI): $' + Number(or.total_usage || 0).toFixed(2) + ' spent total, $' + Number(or.remaining || 0).toFixed(2) + ' credit remaining.') : 'OpenRouter: spend API unavailable.';
      const bodyTxt = 'QuotesDone weekly burn + revenue snapshot\n\n'

        + 'ACTIVITY (last 7 days)\n  Inquiries: ' + inquiries_7d + '\n  Reveals (paid): ' + reveals_7d + '\n  New onboarded suppliers: ' + new_suppliers_7d + '\n  Emails sent: ' + emails_7d + '\n  AI/agent runs: ' + ai_runs_7d + '\n\n'
        + 'COSTS\n  ' + orLine + '\n  (Apify, Twilio, Resend, Supabase: check each dashboard — no live API wired.)\n';
      if (owner) { const { error: nErr } = await admin.from('notifications').insert([{ type: 'cost_snapshot', to_email: owner, to_role: 'admin', channel: 'email', subject: 'QuotesDone weekly burn + revenue snapshot', body: bodyTxt }]); if (nErr) emailErr = String(nErr.message).slice(0, 140); else emailQueued = 1; }
    } catch (e) { emailErr = String(e).slice(0, 140); }

  const counts = { ...snapshot, authorised: 1, email_queued: emailQueued, openrouter_ok: or.ok ? 1 : 0 };

Do not read the missing figure as "no AI spend this week".');
  else await logRun(started, 'ok', counts, 'cost_snapshot ran cleanly: revenue 7d/30d/all-time computed, OpenRouter spend fetched, owner email queued.');

  return J({ ok: true, snapshot });
});
```

```typescript
type Cfg = { promo_until: string | null; promo_reveal_rate: number; promo_reveal_cap: number; standard_reveal_rate: number; standard_reveal_cap: number; refund_window_working_days: number };
async function getCfg(): Promise<Cfg> { const { data } = await admin.from('pricing_config').select('*').eq('id', 1).maybeSingle(); return (data as Cfg) || { promo_until: null, promo_reveal_rate: 0.02, promo_reveal_cap: 250, standard_reveal_rate: 0.02, standard_reveal_cap: 250, refund_window_working_days: 3 }; }

Number(l.app_rating) : null, count: appN, source: 'QuotesDone' }; const g = l.rating ?? l.rating_maps; const gn = l.reviews ?? l.reviews_maps; return { value: g != null ? Number(g) : null, count: gn != null ? Number(gn) : 0, source: 'Google' }; }
function band(n: number) { n = Number(n || 0); if (n < 1000) return '< AED 1k'; if (n < 5000) return 'AED 1–5k'; if (n < 20000) return 'AED 5–20k'; if (n < 50000) return 'AED 20–50k'; return 'AED 50k+'; }
// PRE-REVEAL FINGERPRINT (27 Jul 2026). my_inquiries used to return the supplier's exact rating,
// exact review count, emirate, years-since-founding and win rate on EVERY quote, revealed or not.
// "4.6 stars, 23 reviews, Sharjah, trading since 2011" is a unique fingerprint: one Google Maps
// search finds the company, and the buyer contacts them directly without ever paying the reveal
// fee, which is the only transaction revenue this business has. Unrevealed quotes now carry
// coarse bands that fit hundreds of firms, plus the verified flag (a trust signal that identifies
// nobody). Emirate, win rate and rating source are withheld until a transaction exists.
function ratingBand(v: unknown): string | null { const n = Number(v); if (v == null || !isFinite(n) || n <= 0) return null; if (n >= 4.5) return '4.5+'; if (n >= 4) return '4.0-4.5'; if (n >= 3.5) return '3.5-4.0'; return 'below 3.5'; }
function reviewCountBand(v: unknown): string { const n = Number(v || 0); if (n >= 50) return '50+'; if (n >= 20) return '20-49'; if (n >= 5) return '5-19'; return 'under 5'; }
function yearsBand(v: unknown): string | null { if (v == null) return null; const n = Number(v); if (!isFinite(n)) return null; if (n >= 10) return '10+ years'; if (n >= 5) return '5-9 years'; return 'under 5 years'; }

}

      const jd = await r.json(); let c = jd?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || ''; const m = c.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (m) c = m[0]; const t = JSON.parse(c);

async function buildQuotePdf(q: any, inq: any, wantAr: boolean) {
  const { data: sibs } = await admin.from('quotes').select('id,quote_amount').eq('inquiry_id', q.inquiry_id).order('quote_amount', { ascending: true });
  const idx = (sibs || []).findIndex((s: any) => s.id === q.id); const letter = supplierLabel(idx >= 0 ? idx : 0);
  // The supplier's OWN priced breakdown lives in quote_items. This previously read
  // q.boq || q.line_items — neither is a column on quotes, so it was always undefined and
  // the quotation PDF silently fell back to the customer's requested BOQ instead.
  let items: { desc: string; qty: string; unit: string }[] = [];
  try {
    const { data: qi } = await admin.from('quote_items').select('line_no,description,qty,unit').eq('quote_id', String(q.id)).order('line_no', { ascending: true }).limit(60);
    items = (qi || []).map((b: any) => ({ desc: String(b.description || ''), qty: b.qty == null ? '' : String(b.qty), unit: String(b.unit || '') })).filter((x: any) => x.desc);
  } catch (_e) { items = []; }
  if (!items.length && inq?.boq && Array.isArray((inq.boq as any).boq)) items = (inq.boq as any).boq.map((b: any) => ({ desc: String(b.description || ''), qty: b.qty == null ? '' : String(b.qty), unit: String(b.unit || '') })).filter((x: any) => x.desc).slice(0, 40);
  const quote = { supplier_label: letter, job_category: inq?.category, job_summary: inq?.summary, emirate: inq?.emirate, items, scope: items.length ? String(q.scope || '') : String(q.scope || inq?.summary || ''), lead_time: q.lead_time, validity: q.validity, warranty: q.warranty, payment_terms: q.payment_terms, conditions: q.conditions, exclusions: q.exclusions, notes: q.notes, total: q.quote_amount };
  const ref = 'QD-' + String(q.inquiry_id || '').slice(0, 8).toUpperCase() + '-' + letter;
  const secret = await getSecret('inbound_secret');
  const payload: any = { __secret: secret, quote, lang: wantAr ? 'bi' : 'en', ref, name: ref };
  if (wantAr) { const quoteAr = await translateQuoteAr(quote); payload.quote_ar = quoteAr || quote; }
  const r = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/pdf_native`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
  const j = await r.json();
  return { j, ref };
}
// The comparison report as a branded document, rendered by the same engine as the
// quotations so header band, logo, letterhead, gold rule and footer all match.
function clipCell(s: any, n: number) { const t = String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); return t.length > n ? t.slice(0, n - 1) + '…' : t; }
// The anonymised supplier brief as a branded document. Same engine as the quotations
// and the comparison report, so the customer sees exactly what left the building on
// QuotesDone letterhead instead of a browser print-out.
async function buildBriefPdf(inq: any, lang: string) {
  const ar = lang === 'ar';
  const T = (en: string, arx: string) => (ar ? arx : en);
  const blocks: any[] = [];
  const ref = 'QD-' + String(inq?.id || '').slice(0, 8).toUpperCase() + '-BRIEF';
  const kv: any[] = [
    [T('Reference', 'الرقم المرجعي'), ref],
    [T('Category', 'الفئة'), clipCell(inq?.category, 40) || '—'],
    [T('Emirate', 'الإمارة'), clipCell(inq?.emirate, 40) || '—'],
    [T('Budget', 'الميزانية'), clipCell(inq?.budget, 40) || '—'] ];
  if (Array.isArray(inq?.trades) && inq.trades.length) kv.push([T('Trades', 'التخصصات'), clipCell(inq.trades.join(', '), 80)]);
  blocks.push({ t: 'kv', pairs: kv });
  blocks.push({ t: 'h2', text: T('Scope', 'النطاق') });
  blocks.push({ t: 'p', text: String(inq?.summary || '—') });
  const spec = (inq?.spec && typeof inq.spec === 'object' && !Array.isArray(inq.spec)) ? inq.spec : null;
  if (spec) {
    const rows = Object.entries(spec)
      .filter(([, v]) => v != null && String(v).trim() !== '')
      .map(([k, v]) => [clipCell(String(k).replace(/_/g, ' '), 40), clipCell(Array.isArray(v) ? v.join(', ') : v, 160)]);
    if (rows.length) {
      blocks.push({ t: 'h2', text: T('Specification', 'المواصفات') });
      blocks.push({ t: 'table', head: [T('Item', 'البند'), T('Detail', 'التفصيل')], rows, widths: [0.32, 0.68] });
    }
  }
  const boq = (inq?.boq && Array.isArray((inq.boq as any).boq)) ? (inq.boq as any).boq : null;
  if (boq && boq.length) {
    const rows = boq.slice(0, 60)
      .map((b: any, i: number) => [String(i + 1), clipCell(b.description, 150), b.qty == null ? '' : String(b.qty), clipCell(b.unit, 12)])
      .filter((r: any) => r[1]);
    if (rows.length) {
      blocks.push({ t: 'h2', text: T('Bill of quantities', 'جدول الكميات') });
      blocks.push({ t: 'table', head: ['#', T('Description', 'الوصف'), T('Qty', 'الكمية'), T('Unit', 'الوحدة')], rows, widths: [0.07, 0.68, 0.12, 0.13] });
    }
  }
  if (inq?.drawing_file_name) blocks.push({ t: 'note', text: T('A drawing is attached to this request and is shared with matched suppliers: ', 'أُرفق مخطط بهذا الطلب ويُشارك مع المورّدين المطابقين: ') + clipCell(inq.drawing_file_name, 80) });
  blocks.push({ t: 'space', h: 6 });
  blocks.push({ t: 'note', text: T(
    'This is the anonymised brief QuotesDone sends to matched suppliers. The customer name, company and contact details are never included - suppliers quote on the scope alone, and contact details are exchanged only after the customer reveals a quote.',
    'هذا هو الملخّص المجهول الذي ترسله QuotesDone إلى المورّدين المطابقين. لا يتضمّن اسم العميل أو شركته أو بيانات التواصل — يقدّم المورّدون عروضهم بناءً على النطاق فقط، وتُتبادل بيانات التواصل فقط بعد أن يكشف العميل عن العرض.') });
  const secret = await getSecret('inbound_secret');
  const r = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/pdf_native`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: secret, title: T('Supplier brief', 'ملخّص المورّد'), ref, name: ref, lang: ar ? 'ar' : 'en', blocks, options: { letterhead: true } }) });
  const j = await r.json();
  return { j, ref };
}
async function buildComparePdf(a: any, inq: any, lang: string) {
  const ar = lang === 'ar';
  const T = (en: string, arx: string) => (ar ? arx : en);
  const money = (v: any) => (v == null || v === '') ? '—' : ('AED ' + Number(v).toLocaleString('en-AE', { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }));
  const arrOf = (x: any) => Array.isArray(x) ? x : [];
  const qs = arrOf(a.quotes);
  const blocks: any[] = [];
  blocks.push({ t: 'kv', pairs: [
    [T('Request', 'الطلب'), clipCell(inq?.summary, 120) || '—'],
    [T('Category', 'الفئة'), clipCell(inq?.category, 40) || '—'],
    [T('Emirate', 'الإمارة'), clipCell(inq?.emirate, 40) || '—'],
    [T('Quotes evaluated', 'العروض المُقيّمة'), String(a.considered ?? a.total_quotes ?? qs.length)] ] });
  if (a.bottom_line) { blocks.push({ t: 'h2', text: T('Bottom line', 'الخلاصة') }); blocks.push({ t: 'p', text: String(a.bottom_line) }); }
  if (a.overview) blocks.push({ t: 'p', text: String(a.overview) });
  if (a.shortlist_reason) blocks.push({ t: 'note', text: String(a.shortlist_reason) });
  if (arrOf(a.top3).length) {
    blocks.push({ t: 'h2', text: T('Recommended', 'التوصية') });
    blocks.push({ t: 'table', head: [T('#', '#'), T('Supplier', 'المورّد'), T('Why', 'السبب'), T('Catch', 'الاعتبار')],
      rows: arrOf(a.top3).map((r: any, i: number) => [String(r.rank ?? i + 1), clipCell(r.label, 24), clipCell(r.why, 220), clipCell(r.tradeoff, 160) || '—']),
      widths: [0.06, 0.16, 0.46, 0.32] });
  }
  if (qs.length) {
    blocks.push({ t: 'h2', text: T('Side by side', 'مقارنة جنبًا إلى جنب') });
    const rows: string[][] = [];
    const push = (label: string, get: (q: any) => string) => { const vals = qs.map(get); if (vals.some((v) => v && v !== '—')) rows.push([label, ...vals]); };
    push(T('Price', 'السعر'), (q) => money(q.price));
    push(T('Lead time', 'مدة التنفيذ'), (q) => clipCell(q.lead_time, 60) || '—');
    push(T('Warranty', 'الضمان'), (q) => clipCell(q.warranty, 60) || '—');
    push(T('Payment terms', 'شروط الدفع'), (q) => clipCell(q.payment_terms, 60) || '—');
    push(T('Valid for', 'مدة الصلاحية'), (q) => clipCell(q.validity, 40) || '—');
    push(T('What you get', 'ما ستحصل عليه'), (q) => clipCell(q.getting, 240) || '—');
    push(T('Included', 'مشمول'), (q) => clipCell(arrOf(q.includes).join('; '), 240) || '—');
    push(T('Not included', 'غير مشمول'), (q) => clipCell(arrOf(q.excludes).join('; '), 200) || '—');
    push(T('Missing from your request', 'ناقص مما طلبت'), (q) => clipCell(arrOf(q.missing_from_request).join('; '), 200) || '—');
    push(T('Differs from your spec', 'اختلاف عن مواصفاتك'), (q) => clipCell(arrOf(q.spec_deviation).join('; '), 200) || '—');
    push(T('Track record', 'سجل الأداء'), (q) => clipCell(q.track_record_note, 180) || '—');
    push(T('Watch out', 'تنبيهات'), (q) => clipCell(arrOf(q.flags).join('; '), 200) || '—');
    const colW = 0.76 / Math.max(1, qs.length);
    blocks.push({ t: 'table', head: [T('Compare', 'المقارنة'), ...qs.map((q: any) => clipCell(q.label, 20))], rows, widths: [0.24, ...qs.map(() => colW)] });
  }
  if (arrOf(a.line_findings).length) {
    blocks.push({ t: 'h2', text: T('Line by line', 'بندًا بندًا') });
    blocks.push({ t: 'table', head: [T('Item', 'البند'), T('Finding', 'الملاحظة')],
      rows: arrOf(a.line_findings).map((f: any) => [clipCell(f.item, 60), clipCell(f.finding, 300)]), widths: [0.28, 0.72] });
  }
  if (a.best_value_reason) { blocks.push({ t: 'h2', text: T('Why that pick', 'سبب الاختيار') }); blocks.push({ t: 'p', text: String(a.best_value_reason) }); }
  if (arrOf(a.watch_outs).length) { blocks.push({ t: 'h2', text: T('Watch out', 'انتبه') }); for (const w of arrOf(a.watch_outs)) blocks.push({ t: 'li', text: String(w) }); }
  if (a.advice) { blocks.push({ t: 'h2', text: T('Advice', 'النصيحة') }); blocks.push({ t: 'p', text: String(a.advice) }); }
  blocks.push({ t: 'space', h: 6 });
  blocks.push({ t: 'note', text: String(a.disclaimer || '') });
  const ref = 'QD-' + String(inq?.id || '').slice(0, 8).toUpperCase() + '-CMP';
  const secret = await getSecret('inbound_secret');
  const r = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/pdf_native`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: secret, title: T('Quote comparison report', 'تقرير مقارنة العروض'), ref, name: ref, lang: ar ? 'ar' : 'en', blocks, options: { letterhead: true } }) });
  const j = await r.json();
  return { j, ref };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const auth = req.headers.get('Authorization') || ''; const jwt = auth.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
    const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
    if (!user || !user.email) return J({ error: 'Not signed in' }, 401);
    const email = user.email.toLowerCase();
    let { data: cust } = await admin.from('customers').select('*').eq('email', email).maybeSingle();
    if (!cust) { const ins = await admin.from('customers').insert({ email }).select('*').maybeSingle(); cust = ins.data; }
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({})); const action = String(body.action || '');
    // BANNED CUSTOMER (27 Jul 2026). messages_api auto-bans a buyer who pushes contact details
    // off-platform (it writes customers.banned = true) but customer_api never read that column,
    // so the ban only ever closed the chat: the same person could still post RFQs, reveal
    // suppliers, request refunds and rate them from the main buyer surface. Every mutating
    // action is refused now. 'me' and 'my_inquiries' stay open on purpose so the person can
    // still see their own account state and existing requests rather than hitting a dead wall.
    const MUTATING = ['create_inquiry', 'edit_inquiry', 'reveal', 'request_refund', 'rate_supplier', 'complete_inquiry', 'cancel_inquiry'];
    if (cust?.banned === true && MUTATING.includes(action)) return J({ error: 'Your account is suspended. Please contact support@quotesdone.com if you believe this is a mistake.' }, 403);

    if (action === 'me') return J({ customer: cust });

    if (action === 'analyze_drawing') {
      let images: any[] = Array.isArray(body.images) ? body.images.slice(0, 10) : [];
      const name = String(body.drawing_file_name || 'drawing').slice(0, 180);
      const mime = String(body.mime || 'application/octet-stream');
      const hint = String(body.hint || '').slice(0, 400);
      const path = body.original_b64 ? await storeOriginal(cust.id, name, mime, String(body.original_b64)) : null;
      const secret = await getSecret('inbound_secret');
      const isCad = /\.(dwg|dxf)$/i.test(name) || /dwg|dxf|autocad|acad/i.test(mime);
      if (!images.length && isCad && body.original_b64) {
        try { const cr = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/cad_convert`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': `Bearer ${SERVICE}` }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: secret, b64: body.original_b64, filename: name }) }); const cj = await cr.json(); if (cj?.ok && Array.isArray(cj.images) && cj.images.length) images = cj.images.slice(0, 10); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
      }
      if (!images.length) return J({ ok: true, boq: null, drawing_file_path: path, drawing_file_name: name, drawing_redacted_paths: [], note: isCad ? 'cad_not_converted' : 'no_readable_pages' });
      try {
        const redPrefix = `redacted/${crypto.randomUUID()}/page`;
        const [boqRes, redRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
          fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/drawing_boq`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': `Bearer ${SERVICE}` }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: secret, hint, images }) }),
          fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/drawing_redact`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': `Bearer ${SERVICE}` }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: secret, images, prefix: redPrefix }) }),
        ]);
        let redacted: string[] = [];
        if (redRes.status === 'fulfilled') { try { const rj = await redRes.value.json(); if (rj?.ok && Array.isArray(rj.paths)) redacted = rj.paths; } catch (_e) { /* */ } }
        if (boqRes.status !== 'fulfilled') return J({ ok: false, error: 'analysis_exception', detail: 'boq_fetch_failed', drawing_file_path: path, drawing_file_name: name, drawing_redacted_paths: redacted }, 200);
        const jd = await boqRes.value.json();
        if (!jd?.ok) return J({ ok: false, error: 'analysis_failed', detail: jd?.detail || jd?.error || '', drawing_file_path: path, drawing_file_name: name, drawing_redacted_paths: redacted }, 200);
        return J({ ok: true, boq: jd.boq, drawing_file_path: path, drawing_file_name: name, drawing_redacted_paths: redacted });
      } catch (e) { return J({ ok: false, error: 'analysis_exception', detail: String((e as Error)?.message || e), drawing_file_path: path, drawing_file_name: name, drawing_redacted_paths: [] }, 200); }
    }

    if (action === 'create_inquiry') {
      if (!cust.email_verified) return J({ error: 'Please verify your email before sending a request. Open the Account tab and enter the 6-digit code we email you.' }, 403);
      const hourAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 3600e3).toISOString();
      const { count: recent } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('customer_id', cust.id).gte('created_at', hourAgo);
      if ((recent || 0) >= INQUIRY_LIMIT_PER_HOUR) return J({ error: 'You have created many requests in a short time. Please try again later.' }, 429);
      const drawing = body.drawing && typeof body.drawing === 'object' ? body.drawing : null;
      const boqObj = drawing?.boq && typeof drawing.boq === 'object' ? drawing.boq : null;
      const briefSource = drawing ? (['drawing','quotation'].includes(String(drawing.brief_source)) ? String(drawing.brief_source) : 'drawing') : null;
      let intake: any = null;
      if (body.intake_id) { const { data: it } = await admin.from('inquiry_intake').select('*').eq('id', String(body.intake_id)).maybeSingle(); if (it && it.email === email && it.status === 'ready') intake = it; }
      // INTAKE GATE BYPASS (27 Jul 2026). The mandatory intake used to be waived whenever the
      // CALLER posted a drawing object carrying a one-line boq array — a body the client builds
      // and can therefore forge, so { drawing: { boq: { boq: [{}] } } } skipped the questions
      // entirely and suppliers got briefs with no scope, quantity or emirate. The only bypass now
      // is a real, server-side inquiry_intake row owned by this customer and marked 'ready'
      // (resolved just above). A drawing still enriches the brief; it no longer replaces it.
      if (!intake) return J({ error: 'intake_required', message: 'Please answer a few quick questions so suppliers can quote accurately.' }, 428);
      const briefObj = intake?.brief && typeof intake.brief === 'object' ? intake.brief : null;
      let category = String(body.category || '').trim();
      if (!category && intake?.category) category = String(intake.category).trim();
      if (!category && boqObj?.category) category = String(boqObj.category).trim();
      const raw = String(body.raw_input || (intake?.raw_input || '')).slice(0, 4000);
      let summary = String(body.summary || '').slice(0, 500);
      if (!summary && briefObj?.summary) summary = String(briefObj.summary).slice(0, 500);
      if (!summary && boqObj?.summary) summary = String(boqObj.summary).slice(0, 500);
      if (!category) { const dd = detect(raw + ' ' + summary); category = dd.category || 'general'; }
      const emirate = body.emirate || (briefObj?.emirate || null) || null;
      const specIn = body.spec && typeof body.spec === 'object' ? body.spec : {};
      const spec = (briefObj?.details && typeof briefObj.details === 'object') ? { ...briefObj.details, ...specIn } : specIn;
      const budget = (body.budget ? String(body.budget) : (briefObj?.budget ? String(briefObj.budget) : '')).slice(0, 80) || null;
      const scope_type = ['single','multi','turnkey'].includes(String(body.scope_type)) ? String(body.scope_type) : 'single';
      const tradesIn = Array.isArray(body.trades) ? body.trades.map((t: any) => String(t).toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean) : [];
      const d = detect(raw + ' ' + summary + ' ' + Object.values(spec).join(' '));
      const base = d.keywords.length ? d.keywords : (KW[category] || []);
      let keywords = Array.from(new Set([...base, category, ...tradesIn]));
      if (Array.isArray(boqObj?.keywords)) keywords = Array.from(new Set([...keywords, ...boqObj.keywords.map((s: any) => String(s).toLowerCase())]));
      keywords = keywords.slice(0, 30);
      const drawingPath = drawing?.drawing_file_path ? String(drawing.drawing_file_path) : null;
      const drawingName = drawing?.drawing_file_name ? String(drawing.drawing_file_name).slice(0, 180) : null;
      const drawingRedacted = Array.isArray(drawing?.drawing_redacted_paths) ? drawing.drawing_redacted_paths.map((s: any) => String(s)).slice(0, 12) : null;
      const distinctTrades = Array.from(new Set(tradesIn)).slice(0, 6);
      const wantSplit = scope_type === 'multi' && distinctTrades.length > 1;
      const wantTurnkey = scope_type === 'turnkey';
      const drawCols = { drawing_file_path: drawingPath, drawing_file_name: drawingName, drawing_redacted_paths: drawingRedacted, boq: boqObj, boq_confidence: boqObj?.confidence || null };

      if (wantSplit) {
        const { data: parent, error: ep } = await admin.from('inquiries').insert({ customer_id: cust.id, category: 'combined', emirate, role_needed: 'supplier', raw_input: raw, spec, summary, keywords, status: 'split', budget, scope_type: 'multi', trades: distinctTrades, brief_source: briefSource, ...drawCols }).select('id').maybeSingle();
        if (ep) return J({ error: ep.message }, 500);
        if (intake) { try { await admin.from('inquiry_intake').update({ status: 'consumed' }).eq('id', intake.id); } catch (_e) { /* */ } }
        const children: any[] = [];
        for (const tr of distinctTrades) {
          const tlabel = labelize(tr);
          const childSummary = ((summary ? summary + ' — ' : '') + tlabel + ' works (part of a combined project)').slice(0, 500);
          const childKw = Array.from(new Set([...(KW[tr] || []), tr])).slice(0, 30);
          const { data: child, error: ec } = await admin.from('inquiries').insert({ customer_id: cust.id, parent_inquiry_id: parent!.id, category: tr, emirate, role_needed: 'supplier', raw_input: raw, spec, summary: childSummary, keywords: childKw, status: 'sent', budget, scope_type: 'single', trades: [tr], brief_source: briefSource, ...drawCols }).select('id').maybeSingle();
          if (ec || !child) continue;
```

```typescript
// customer_portal — advanced customer dashboard API. Customer-authed (own customers row).
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const cors = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: cors });
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: cors });
  try {
    const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace('Bearer ', '');
    const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
    if (!user) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
    const email = (user.email || '').toLowerCase();
    let { data: cust } = await admin.from('customers').select('id,full_name,email').eq('id', user.id).maybeSingle();
    if (!cust && email) { const r = await admin.from('customers').select('id,full_name,email').eq('email', email).maybeSingle(); cust = r.data; }
    if (!cust) return J({ error: 'no_customer', hint: 'no customer profile for this account' }, 400);
    const b = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const action = b.action;
    const ar = String(b.lang || 'en') === 'ar';

    if (action === 'overview') {
      const { data: stats, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_customer_stats', { p_customer: cust.id });
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      const inqs = (stats && stats.inquiries) || [];
      const alerts: any[] = [];
      const editable = inqs.filter((x: any) => x.editable);
      for (const e of editable) {
        const cat = e.category || (ar ? 'طلبك' : 'your request');
        alerts.push({ kind: 'edit_window', severity: 'medium',
          title: ar ? ('ما زال بإمكانك تعديل «' + cat + '»') : ('You can still edit “' + cat + '”'),
          detail: ar ? ('قابل للتعديل لمدة ' + e.edit_minutes_left + ' دقيقة أخرى، بعدها تُقفل التعديلات ويستمر المورّدون في التسعير على النطاق الأصلي.') : ('Editable for another ' + e.edit_minutes_left + ' minutes. After that, edits are locked and suppliers keep quoting the original scope.'),
          inquiry_id: e.id });
      }
      const toReview = inqs.filter((x: any) => (x.quotes_count || 0) > 0 && !['completed', 'closed', 'cancelled'].includes(String(x.status)));
      for (const t of toReview) {
        const cat = t.category || (ar ? 'طلبك' : 'your request');
        const n = t.quotes_count;
        alerts.push({ kind: 'quotes_ready', severity: 'low',
          title: ar ? (n + ' عرض للمراجعة على «' + cat + '»') : (n + ' quote' + (n > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' to review on “' + cat + '”'),
          detail: ar ? ('قارن العروض جنبًا إلى جنب واكشف عن المورّد الذي تريد.') : ('Compare quotes side by side and reveal the supplier you want.'),
          inquiry_id: t.id });
      }
      return J({ ok: true, customer: { id: cust.id, name: cust.full_name }, stats, alerts, alerts_count: alerts.length });
    }

    return J({ error: 'unknown_action', action }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/deploy_next_preview/index.ts

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string|undefined)||undefined; }
async function sha1hex(bytes: Uint8Array){ const h = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-1', bytes); return [...new Uint8Array(h)].map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join(''); }
// SECURITY FIX 27 Jul 2026 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
// WHAT WAS WRONG: this function publishes whatever currently sits in qd_deploy_src to Vercel, and it
// was gated on inbound_secret - the single shared secret that 134 of the 187 edge functions accept.
// Paired with put_src (which writes any path/content into that table on the same secret), one leaked
// inbound_secret was a full takeover of quotesdone.com, not an API key with some reach.
// WHY THIS FIX: deploy authority now needs its OWN key - app_secrets key 'deploy_secret', sent as
// body.__deploy_secret. Until that row exists we still honour inbound_secret so os_pages 'publish'
// does not break before the founder creates it, but every fallback authorisation is written to
// agent_runs with status 'error' so the gap is loud, not silent. Drop the fallback once it is set.
async function deployAuth(b: any, fn: string){
  const dep = await sec('deploy_secret');
  if (dep) return b.__deploy_secret === dep;
  const inbound = await sec('inbound_secret');
  const ok = !!inbound && (b.__deploy_secret === inbound || b.__secret === inbound);
  if (ok) { const t = new Date().toISOString(); try { await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent:'deploy_authority', started_at:t, finished_at:t, status:'error', counts:{ fallback_auth:1, fn }, note:'DEPLOY SECRET NOT SET YET: '+fn+' authorised a deploy-capable call using inbound_secret because app_secrets has no deploy_secret row. inbound_secret is accepted by 134 of 187 functions, so until deploy_secret exists anything holding it can publish arbitrary source to quotesdone.com. Create app_secrets key deploy_secret and have callers send __deploy_secret.' }); } catch(_e){ /* never block the deploy path on a log write */ } }
  return ok;
}
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    if (!(await deployAuth(body, 'deploy_next_preview'))) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const token = await sec('vercel_token'); const team = await sec('vercel_team_id');
    if (!token || !team) return J({ ok:false, error:'vercel_not_configured' }, 200);
    const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token };
    // FIX 27 Jul 2026: WHAT WAS WRONG - this read `(body.target === 'preview') ? 'preview' : 'production'`,
    // so a caller that simply omitted `target` got a PRODUCTION deploy out of a function called
    // deploy_next_preview. Every wrong guess landed on the live site. Now inverted: preview is the
    // default and production must be asked for by name. os_pages 'publish' and any deliberate release
    // already send target:'production' explicitly, so nothing that meant production loses production.
    const target = (body.target === 'production') ? 'production' : 'preview';
    const project = 'quotesdone-next';
    // 1) turn off deployment protection so the LIVE site is publicly viewable.
    // FIX 27 Jul 2026: WHAT WAS WRONG - this PATCH ran on every single call, so any deploy, including a
    // throwaway preview, stripped ssoProtection and passwordProtection off the whole Vercel project and
    // left them off. Project-wide protection is not a preview's business: only a production publish
    // needs the public site reachable, and previews must never widen access as a side effect.
    if (target === 'production') { try { await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/v9/projects/' + project + '?teamId=' + team, { method:'PATCH', headers:{ ...H, 'Content-Type':'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ ssoProtection: null, passwordProtection: null }) }); } catch(_e){} }
    // 2) upload source files
    const { data: rows } = await admin.from('qd_deploy_src').select('path,data');
    if (!rows || !rows.length) return J({ ok:false, error:'no_source_files' }, 200);
    const files: { file: string; sha: string; size: number }[] = [];
    for (const r of rows) {
      const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(r.data as string);
      const sha = await sha1hex(bytes);
      const up = await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/v2/files?teamId=' + team, { method:'POST', headers:{ ...H, 'Content-Type':'application/octet-stream', 'x-vercel-digest':sha }, body: bytes });
      if (!up.ok) return J({ ok:false, error:'upload_failed', path:r.path, status:up.status, detail:(await up.text()).slice(0,200) }, 200);
      files.push({ file: r.path as string, sha, size: bytes.length });
    }
    // 3) create the deployment (preview by default since 27 Jul 2026; production needs target:'production')
    // FIX 27 Jul 2026: WHAT WAS WRONG - the previous change made 'preview' the default and then sent it
    // verbatim as the API's `target`. Vercel's v13 deployments endpoint does not accept 'preview' there:
    // it answers 400 `target should be 'production', 'staging', or a custom environment identifier`.
    // A preview is expressed by OMITTING target entirely. So every call that did not ask for production
    // - i.e. the whole default path of a function named deploy_next_preview - was a hard 400 that
    // uploaded all 70 source files first and then threw the deployment away. Target is now only sent
    // when it is 'production'; the local `target` variable still gates the protection PATCH above and
    // is still reported back to the caller, so nothing else changes.
    const depBody: Record<string, unknown> = { name: project, files, projectSettings:{ framework:'nextjs' } };
    if (target === 'production') depBody.target = 'production';
    const dep = await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/v13/deployments?teamId=' + team + '&forceNew=1', { method:'POST', headers:{ ...H, 'Content-Type':'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(depBody) });
    const dj = await dep.json();
    if (!dep.ok) return J({ ok:false, error:'deploy_failed', status:dep.status, detail: JSON.stringify(dj?.error||dj).slice(0,500) }, 200);
    return J({ ok:true, id: dj.id, url: dj.url, target, readyState: dj.readyState, files: files.length, alias: (dj.alias||[]) }, 200);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/dept_learn/index.ts

````typescript
// dept_learn — THE LEARN STEP of the department loop (makes experience compound).
// After work runs, each department reflects on recently completed tasks + their outcomes + its live
// numbers, and extracts at most 2 DURABLE, reusable lessons (what worked, what failed, a pattern).
// Lessons are written to BOTH stores the org already reads: org_memory (scope=dept → the self-planner
// dept_plan reads it next cycle) and agent_memory (the lead agent → agent_brain reads it in chat).
// So the department is measurably smarter each cycle. Runs on a cadence just BEFORE dept_plan.
// Auth: __secret (cron / self fan-out) OR admin JWT.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const SELF = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')! + '/functions/v1/dept_learn';
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
const llm = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 700, temperature: 0.3 });

async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
async function authed(req: Request, body: any): Promise<boolean> {
  if (body.__secret && body.__secret === (await sec('inbound_secret'))) return true;
  const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, ''); if (!jwt) return false;
  const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
  const allow = (await sec('admin_emails') || 'management@quotesdone.com').split(',').map((s) => s.trim().toLowerCase());
  return !!(user?.email && allow.includes(user.email.toLowerCase()));
}

async function learnDept(deptKey: string) {
  const { data: d } = await admin.from('org_departments').select('dept_key,name,north_star,lead_agent,active').eq('dept_key', deptKey).maybeSingle();
  if (!d || !d.active) return { dept: deptKey, skipped: 'unknown/inactive' };

  // Look at recently completed / failed work (last ~26h so a daily run covers one cycle, no double-counting).
  const since = new Date(Date.now() - 26 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();
  const { data: done } = await admin.from('org_tasks').select('title,status,result,action_class,updated_at')
    .eq('dept_key', deptKey).in('status', ['done', 'failed', 'review_pending', 'escalated']).gte('updated_at', since).order('updated_at', { ascending: false }).limit(12);
  if (!done || !done.length) return { dept: deptKey, learned: 0, note: 'no completed work in window' };

  const { data: existing } = await admin.from('org_memory').select('content').eq('scope', deptKey).eq('kind', 'lesson').order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(20);
  const known = (existing || []).map((m: any) => '- ' + m.content).join('\n') || '(none yet)';
  const outcomes = done.map((t: any) => '- [' + t.status + '] ' + (t.title || '') + (t.result ? (' → ' + (typeof t.result === 'string' ? t.result : JSON.stringify(t.result)).slice(0, 260)) : '')).join('\n');

  const sys = 'You are the head of the ' + (d.name || deptKey) + ' department at QuotesDone (UAE B2B anonymous quotation marketplace). Your north star: ' + (d.north_star || '') + '. '
    + 'From the recently completed/failed work below, extract AT MOST 2 DURABLE, reusable lessons that will make this department better over time — what worked and should be repeated, what failed and should be avoided, or a pattern worth remembering. '
    + 'Only genuinely NEW lessons not already covered by EXISTING LESSONS. Each lesson must be a self-contained, actionable sentence (max 220 chars), not a one-off fact or a restatement of a task. If there is nothing durable to learn, return an empty list. '
    + 'Return STRICT minified JSON only: {"lessons":[{"lesson":"...","kind":"win|mistake|insight"}]}.';
  const user = 'EXISTING LESSONS:\n' + known + '\n\nRECENT WORK & OUTCOMES:\n' + outcomes + '\n\nExtract the new durable lessons and return the JSON.';

  const raw = (await llm(sys, user, 700) || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return { dept: deptKey, learned: 0, error: 'llm_unavailable' };
  let parsed: any = null;
  try { parsed = JSON.parse(raw.replace(/^```(json)?/i, '').replace(/```$/, '').trim()); } catch (_e) { const m = raw.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (m) { try { parsed = JSON.parse(m[0]); } catch (_e2) { /* noop */ } } }
  const lessons = Array.isArray(parsed?.lessons) ? parsed.lessons.slice(0, 2) : [];
  if (!lessons.length) return { dept: deptKey, learned: 0, note: 'nothing durable to learn' };

  let written = 0;
  for (const l of lessons) {
    const text = String(l?.lesson || '').trim(); if (text.length < 12) continue;
    const kind = ['win', 'mistake', 'insight'].includes(String(l?.kind)) ? String(l.kind) : 'insight';
    const tagged = '[' + kind + '] ' + text;
    await admin.from('org_memory').insert({ scope: deptKey, kind: 'lesson', content: tagged.slice(0, 400), source: 'dept_learn' });
    if (d.lead_agent) await admin.from('agent_memory').insert({ agent_key: d.lead_agent, kind: 'learned', content: tagged.slice(0, 360), source: 'dept_learn' });
    written++;
  }
  return { dept: deptKey, learned: written, from_tasks: done.length };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    if (!(await authed(req, body))) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    if (body.dept_key) return J({ ok: true, result: await learnDept(String(body.dept_key)) });
    if (body.all) {
      const { data: depts } = await admin.from('org_departments').select('dept_key').eq('active', true);
      const secret = await sec('inbound_secret');
      const keys = (depts || []).map((d: any) => d.dept_key);
      await Promise.all(keys.map((k: string) => fetch(SELF, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: secret, dept_key: k }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(2500) }).catch(() => {})));
      return J({ ok: true, fanned_out: keys.length });
    }
    return J({ error: 'provide dept_key or all:true' }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
````

### supabase/functions/dept_plan/index.ts

````typescript
// dept_plan — THE DEPARTMENT OPERATING LOOP (self-planning half of the autonomy engine).
// On a cadence, each department acts as its own head: it reads the company vision + its charter +
// north star + its recent work AND whether it worked + its live numbers + what's already open, then
// GENERATES ITS OWN next objectives/tasks. The existing cos_execute engine carries them out; their
// outcomes feed the next cycle. No founder-fed tasks. This is what keeps the company growing unattended.
//
// Founder gates stay narrow: a task is only sent for founder approval (status='proposed') when it
// spends money or publishes public content; everything safe runs autonomously (status='assigned').
// Auth: __secret (cron / self fan-out) OR admin JWT.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const SELF = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')! + '/functions/v1/dept_plan';
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
const llm = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 1200, temperature: 0.35 });

// Work that runs WITHOUT the founder (safe, reversible, non-spending, non-publishing).
// Anything not in this set, or anything the department head marks needs_founder, waits for approval.
const AUTONOMOUS_SAFE = new Set(['content_draft', 'knowledge_fill', 'recommend', 'invite', 'analysis', 'research', 'seo', 'monitor', 'reconcile', 'outreach_draft']);
const OPEN_TASK_CAP = 5;     // don't let a department pile up unstarted work
const MAX_NEW = 3;           // per cycle

async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
async function authed(req: Request, body: any): Promise<boolean> {
  if (body.__secret && body.__secret === (await sec('inbound_secret'))) return true;
  const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, ''); if (!jwt) return false;
  const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
  const allow = (await sec('admin_emails') || 'management@quotesdone.com').split(',').map((s) => s.trim().toLowerCase());
  return !!(user?.email && allow.includes(user.email.toLowerCase()));
}

async function planDept(deptKey: string) {
  const { data: d } = await admin.from('org_departments').select('dept_key,name,charter,north_star,health_fn,lead_agent,active').eq('dept_key', deptKey).maybeSingle();
  if (!d || !d.active) return { dept: deptKey, skipped: 'unknown or inactive' };

  // Guard: already enough open work → don't pile up.
  const { count: openCount } = await admin.from('org_tasks').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('dept_key', deptKey).in('status', ['assigned', 'proposed', 'in_progress']);
  if ((openCount || 0) >= OPEN_TASK_CAP) return { dept: deptKey, skipped: 'has ' + openCount + ' open tasks' };

  const { data: vis } = await admin.from('company_vision').select('vision,mission').eq('id', 1).maybeSingle();
  // Company-level strategic targets every department plans against (company_goals).
  // Distinct from org_objectives, which is this loop's own work-item table.
  const { data: goals } = await admin.from('company_goals')
    .select('goal,metric,target_value,unit,period,owner_dept')
    .eq('active', true).order('sort');
  const goalsTxt = (goals || []).map((g: any) =>
    '- ' + g.goal + ' (' + g.metric + (g.target_value != null ? ('; target ' + g.target_value + ' ' + (g.unit || '')) : '')
    + '; ' + (g.period || 'annual') + (g.owner_dept ? ('; owned by ' + g.owner_dept) : '') + ')'
  ).join('\n');
  // SENSE: recent work and whether it worked
  const { data: recent } = await admin.from('org_tasks').select('title,status,result,action_class,updated_at').eq('dept_key', deptKey).order('updated_at', { ascending: false }).limit(8);
  const { data: mem } = await admin.from('org_memory').select('kind,content,created_at').eq('scope', deptKey).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(6);
  const { data: openItems } = await admin.from('org_tasks').select('title,status').eq('dept_key', deptKey).in('status', ['assigned', 'proposed', 'in_progress']).limit(10);
  // Live KPIs from the department's own health function, if it has one.
  let kpi = '';
  if (d.health_fn) { try { const { data: h } = await admin.rpc(d.health_fn); if (h) kpi = JSON.stringify(h).slice(0, 1200); } catch (_e) { /* health fn optional */ } }
  // Capabilities the department can actually execute.
  const { data: caps } = await admin.from('org_action_executor').select('action_class,note,advisory_safe').eq('department', deptKey).eq('active', true);
  const capList = (caps || []).map((c: any) => c.action_class + (c.note ? (' — ' + c.note) : '')).join('; ') || '(no wired executors yet — use action_class "analysis" to prepare a deliverable)';
  // The department head plans WITH its management discipline (_global) + its own domain expertise
  // (the lead agent's knowledge): reversibility, ruthless prioritization, and role-specific know-how.
  let expertise = '';
  try { const { data } = await admin.rpc('fn_agent_context', { p_agent_key: d.lead_agent || null, p_max_chars: 5000 }); expertise = data ? String(data).slice(0, 4500) : ''; } catch (_e) { /* optional */ }

  const recentTxt = (recent || []).map((r: any) => '- [' + r.status + '] ' + (r.title || '') + (r.result ? (' → ' + (typeof r.result === 'string' ? r.result : JSON.stringify(r.result)).slice(0, 200)) : '')).join('\n') || '(no recent work)';
  const memTxt = (mem || []).map((m: any) => '- ' + (m.content || '').slice(0, 200)).join('\n') || '(no notes)';
  const openTxt = (openItems || []).map((o: any) => '- [' + o.status + '] ' + o.title).join('\n') || '(none)';

  const sys = 'You are the HEAD of the ' + (d.name || deptKey) + ' department at QuotesDone, a UAE B2B anonymous quotation marketplace. '
    + 'Company vision: ' + (vis?.vision || 'Become the smartest marketplace engine in the world.') + ' '
    + (goalsTxt ? ('COMPANY GOALS every department is working toward — your plan must move at least one of these, and you must say which one and how:\n' + goalsTxt + '\n') : '')
    + 'Your charter: ' + (d.charter || '') + ' Your north-star metric: ' + (d.north_star || '') + '. '
    + 'You run a CONTINUOUS LOOP as an autonomous expert: review what you recently did and whether it worked, look at your live numbers, and decide the highest-leverage NEXT actions that move your north star toward the vision. You never wait for instructions. '
    + 'Propose only real, concrete, doable actions — no vague goals. For each, pick an action_class from YOUR CAPABILITIES: ' + capList + '. If none fits, use "analysis" to prepare a research/analysis deliverable. '
    + 'Set needs_founder=true ONLY when the action spends money or publishes public content; otherwise it runs autonomously. '
    + 'Do NOT duplicate anything already open. Return STRICT minified JSON only: {"plan_rationale":"<2-3 sentences: what you learned from recent outcomes and why these are the next best moves>","tasks":[{"title":"<short>","detail":"<exactly what to do and the outcome you expect>","action_class":"<one of the above>","needs_founder":false}]}. At most ' + MAX_NEW + ' tasks; fewer if that is genuinely the right call.'
    + (expertise ? ('\n\nHOW YOU THINK (management discipline + your domain expertise — plan by this):\n' + expertise) : '');
  const user = 'RECENT WORK & OUTCOMES:\n' + recentTxt + '\n\nLEARNED NOTES:\n' + memTxt + '\n\nLIVE NUMBERS:\n' + (kpi || '(no KPI feed)') + '\n\nALREADY OPEN (do not duplicate):\n' + openTxt + '\n\nDecide your next moves and return the JSON.';

  const raw = (await llm(sys, user, 1200) || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return { dept: deptKey, error: 'llm_unavailable' };
  let parsed: any = null;
  try { parsed = JSON.parse(raw.replace(/^```(json)?/i, '').replace(/```$/, '').trim()); } catch (_e) { const m = raw.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (m) { try { parsed = JSON.parse(m[0]); } catch (_e2) { /* noop */ } } }
  const tasks = Array.isArray(parsed?.tasks) ? parsed.tasks.slice(0, MAX_NEW) : [];
  if (!tasks.length) return { dept: deptKey, planned: 0, note: 'no new tasks proposed' };

  // One objective per planning cycle, owned by the department.
  const { data: obj } = await admin.from('org_objectives').insert({
    objective: (parsed?.plan_rationale || ('Self-directed plan for ' + (d.name || deptKey))).slice(0, 500),
    raw_input: 'dept_plan self-planning cycle', created_by: deptKey, status: 'active', priority: 3,
  }).select('id').maybeSingle();

  const rows = tasks.map((t: any) => {
    const ac = String(t?.action_class || 'analysis').toLowerCase().trim();
    const gated = t?.needs_founder === true || !AUTONOMOUS_SAFE.has(ac);
    return {
      objective_id: obj?.id || null, dept_key: deptKey,
      title: String(t?.title || 'Untitled').slice(0, 200), detail: String(t?.detail || '').slice(0, 2000),
      action_class: ac, status: gated ? 'proposed' : 'assigned',
      tier: gated ? 'gated' : 'autonomous', needs_founder: gated, decided_by: 'dept_plan',
    };
  });
  const { data: ins } = await admin.from('org_tasks').insert(rows).select('id,status');
  const assigned = (ins || []).filter((r: any) => r.status === 'assigned').length;
  const proposed = (ins || []).filter((r: any) => r.status === 'proposed').length;

  await admin.from('org_memory').insert({ scope: deptKey, kind: 'plan', content: 'Self-planned ' + rows.length + ' task(s) (' + assigned + ' autonomous, ' + proposed + ' for founder). Rationale: ' + String(parsed?.plan_rationale || '').slice(0, 400), source: 'dept_plan' });
  return { dept: deptKey, planned: rows.length, autonomous: assigned, needs_founder: proposed, rationale: String(parsed?.plan_rationale || '').slice(0, 240) };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    if (!(await authed(req, body))) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);

    // Single department (real work).
    if (body.dept_key) return J({ ok: true, result: await planDept(String(body.dept_key)) });

    // Fan-out: trigger every active department's own planning invocation (fire-and-forget so no edge timeout).
    if (body.all) {
      const { data: depts } = await admin.from('org_departments').select('dept_key').eq('active', true);
      const secret = await sec('inbound_secret');
      const keys = (depts || []).map((d: any) => d.dept_key);
      await Promise.all(keys.map((k: string) => fetch(SELF, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: secret, dept_key: k }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(2500) }).catch(() => {})));
      return J({ ok: true, fanned_out: keys.length, departments: keys });
    }
    return J({ error: 'provide dept_key or all:true' }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
````
