### supabase/functions/designer/index.ts

```typescript
// designer v2 — the Designer agent's image engine. Generates on-brand images via OpenAI gpt-image-1,
// hosts them publicly (brand bucket), returns a URL usable in Meta ads, Postiz, or the blog.
// Auth: __secret == inbound_secret. Secret needed to generate: openai_api_key.
// Actions: 'status' (readiness), 'generate' (default).
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const SUPA = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' } });
async function sec(k: string): Promise<string | undefined> { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;

const SIZE: Record<string, string> = {
  square: '1024x1024', instagram: '1024x1024', facebook_feed: '1024x1024', social: '1024x1024',
  portrait: '1024x1536', story: '1024x1536', reel: '1024x1536', instagram_story: '1024x1536',
  landscape: '1536x1024', blog: '1536x1024', linkedin: '1536x1024', ad: '1024x1024',
};

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': '*' } });
  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
  const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
  if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);

  const key = await sec('openai_api_key');
  const fallback = await sec('default_post_image');
  const action = String(body.action || 'generate');

  // Readiness probe for the Agents console / callers.
  if (action === 'status') {
    return J({ ok: true, ready: !!key, model: 'gpt-image-1', sizes: Object.keys(SIZE), has_fallback: !!fallback,
      message: key ? 'Designer ready.' : 'Set app_secrets.openai_api_key to enable image generation.' });
  }
  if (action !== 'generate') return J({ error: 'unknown_action' }, 400);

  const brief = String(body.prompt || body.brief || '').trim();
  if (!brief) return J({ error: 'empty_prompt' }, 400);
  const purpose = String(body.purpose || 'social');
  const size = SIZE[String(body.size || purpose).toLowerCase()] || '1024x1024';
  const started = new Date().toISOString();

  // No key: don't fail hard — tell the caller it's not configured and offer the brand fallback image.
  if (!key) {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'designer', started_at: started, finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'skipped', note: 'openai_api_key not set' }).catch(() => null);
    return J({ ok: false, ready: false, error: 'openai_not_configured', need: ['openai_api_key'], fallback_url: fallback || null, message: 'Image generation is not active yet — add the openai_api_key secret. A brand fallback image is available.' }, 200);
  }

  try {
    let brain = ''; try { const { data } = await admin.rpc('fn_agent_context', { p_agent_key: 'designer', p_max_chars: 3000 }); brain = data ? String(data) : ''; } catch (_e) {}
    const brandLine = 'Brand: QuotesDone, a modern UAE B2B marketplace. Visual style: clean, professional, trustworthy, tech-forward; teal/deep-green brand accent (#0E7C73) with crisp white space; UAE business context (offices, trades, SMEs) where relevant. Avoid clutter and stocky clichés. If the brief asks for a headline area, leave clean negative space for text to be added later — do not render long paragraphs of text.';
    const prompt = brandLine + (brain ? ('\n' + brain.slice(0, 1500)) : '') + '\n\nDesign request: ' + brief;

    const r = await fetch('https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations', {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + key, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-image-1', prompt: prompt.slice(0, 3800), size, n: 1 }),
    });
    const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (!r.ok) { await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'designer', started_at: started, finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'error', note: JSON.stringify(j).slice(0, 250) }); return J({ ok: false, error: j?.error?.message || 'image_generation_failed', status: r.status }, 200); }
    const b64 = j?.data?.[0]?.b64_json;
    if (!b64) return J({ ok: false, error: 'no_image_returned' }, 200);

    const bytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(b64), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
    const path = 'designer/' + Date.now() + '-' + purpose.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/gi, '-').slice(0, 24) + '.png';
    const up = await admin.storage.from('brand').upload(path, bytes, { contentType: 'image/png', upsert: true });
    if (up.error) return J({ ok: false, error: up.error.message }, 200);
    const url = SUPA + '/storage/v1/object/public/brand/' + path;

    await admin.from('content_drafts').insert({ channel: 'image', title: ('Design: ' + brief).slice(0, 200), body: url, status: 'ready', source: 'agent:designer' }).catch(() => null);
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'designer', started_at: started, finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'ok', counts: { size, purpose } });
    return J({ ok: true, url, size, purpose });
  } catch (e) {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'designer', started_at: started, finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'error', note: String(e).slice(0, 200) });
    return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 200);
  }
});
```

### supabase/functions/dir_ingest/index.ts

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' } });

// SECURITY HARDENING 19 Jul 2026 ---------------------------------------------------------------
// This used to accept EITHER inbound_secret OR a shared 'test_token' as full authority:
//     return (body.__secret && body.__secret === sec.inbound_secret)
//         || (body.__test   && body.__test   === sec.test_token);
// A QA/test credential should never carry the same power as the production secret - this endpoint
// bulk-upserts into yello_staging, the supplier directory pipeline that ultimately feeds the leads
// table, so anyone holding the test token could inject or overwrite directory records at scale.
//
// app_secrets has no 'test_token' row today, so the branch was already inert and removing it breaks
// nothing. It is deleted rather than left dormant so that re-adding a test_token row for some
// unrelated test harness cannot silently re-grant production write access here.
// The same dormant __test branch still exists in yello_scrape and profile_ai; equally inert today.
async function auth(body: any): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!body || !body.__secret) return false;
  const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', 'inbound_secret').maybeSingle();
  const expected = (data?.value as string) || '';
  // Fail closed if the secret is missing or empty rather than comparing against a falsy value.
  if (!expected) return false;
  return body.__secret === expected;
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':'*','Access-Control-Allow-Headers':'*' } });
  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!(await auth(body))) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);

  try {
    if (body.action === 'stats') {
      const { data: rows } = await admin.from('yello_staging').select('stage,sector,email');
      const by: Record<string,number> = {}; const bySector: Record<string,number> = {}; let withEmail = 0;
      for (const r of (rows||[])) { by[r.stage]=(by[r.stage]||0)+1; if (r.email) { withEmail++; bySector[r.sector||'?']=(bySector[r.sector||'?']||0)+1; } }
      return J({ ok:true, total:(rows||[]).length, with_email: withEmail, by_stage: by, by_sector: bySector });
    }

    if (body.action === 'ingest') {
      const rows = Array.isArray(body.rows) ? body.rows : [];
      if (!rows.length) return J({ error:'no rows' }, 400);
      const clean = rows.filter((r:any)=>r && r.company_id).map((r:any)=>({
        company_id: String(r.company_id).slice(0,120),
        name: r.name ? String(r.name).slice(0,200) : null,
        slug: r.slug ? String(r.slug).slice(0,160) : null,
        city: r.city ? String(r.city).slice(0,60) : null,
        src_category: r.src_category ? String(r.src_category).slice(0,80) : null,
        categories: Array.isArray(r.categories) ? r.categories.slice(0,12) : null,
        website: r.website ? String(r.website).slice(0,200) : null,
        phone: r.phone ? String(r.phone).slice(0,40) : null,
        whatsapp: r.whatsapp ? String(r.whatsapp).slice(0,40) : null,
        email: r.email ? String(r.email).toLowerCase().slice(0,120) : null,
        email_source: r.email ? 'directory' : null,
        sector: r.sector ? String(r.sector).slice(0,40) : null,
        stage: r.email ? 'emailed' : 'profiled',
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      }));
      // upsert in chunks
      let up = 0;
      for (let i=0;i<clean.length;i+=200) {
        const ch = clean.slice(i,i+200);
        const { error, count } = await admin.from('yello_staging').upsert(ch, { onConflict: 'company_id', count: 'exact' });
        if (error) return J({ error: error.message, at:i }, 200);
        up += ch.length;
      }
      return J({ ok:true, received: rows.length, upserted: up });
    }

    return J({ error:'unknown action' }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 200); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/dispatch_inquiry/index.ts

```typescript
// dispatch_inquiry — the automated cross-match dispatcher. For a finalized (rfq_ready) inquiry it
// runs the sharp adjudicator (route_inquiry), applies guardrails, PERSISTS accepted matches to
// inquiry_matches (which fires the seller-notify trigger), logs the full routing decision to
// inquiries.routing, and on ZERO genuine fits raises an internal coverage-gap flag WITHOUT spamming
// any seller. Fully automated — no founder approval. Idempotent + atomic dispatch lock (no races).
// v3: agent_runs instrumentation.
// v4 CORRECTNESS FIX: when every inquiry_matches insert failed, the inquiry was still recorded as
//    outcome:'dispatched' and the caller got ok:true - a customer RFQ that looks routed but reached
//    nobody. That case now returns ok:false and raises a founder_alert + email, so it surfaces even
//    if the caller ignores the response. Route failures escalate the same way.
// v5 AUTHORITY FIX (28 Jul 2026): body.force===true used to be honoured on the strength of
//    inbound_secret alone. inbound_secret is accepted by 134 of 187 functions, so anything holding
//    it could bypass THREE independent safety guards at once - the already_dispatched check, the
//    freshness of the atomic dispatch lock, and the lost-claim exit. Two concurrent forced runs both
//    read the existing-match set before either writes, so the dedup does not hold and suppliers get
//    contacted twice about the same RFQ. force now needs its OWN key (dispatch_force_key) plus a
//    written reason, and every use is recorded and escalated to the founder. A force attempt without
//    that key is refused outright rather than silently downgraded, so nobody believes an override
//    took effect when it did not.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 28 Jul 2026 (missed by the 27 Jul sweep): sec() returns undefined/'' when the
// app_secrets read fails or the row is missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller
// posting {} matched and gained full service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The
// stored secret must now be a real value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
async function policyInt(k: string, dflt: number){ const { data } = await admin.from('decision_policy').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); const n = Number((data as any)?.value); return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n : dflt; }
const LOCK_STALE_MS = 120000;

const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'dispatch_inquiry', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging block dispatch */ }
}
// Out-of-band escalation: a customer RFQ reaching nobody is revenue loss and must not depend
// on whatever called this function noticing the response body.
async function escalate(subject: string, detail: string, level = 'high', event = 'rfq_not_dispatched') {
  try { await admin.from('founder_alerts').insert({ level, event, detail: String(detail).slice(0, 900), channel: 'email' }); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
  try {
    const owner = ((await sec('admin_emails')) || 'management@quotesdone.com').split(',')[0].trim();
    await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type: event, to_email: owner, to_role: 'admin', channel: 'email', subject, body: detail, status: 'queued' });
  } catch (_e) { /* */ }
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const inbound = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(inbound) || body.__secret !== inbound) { await logRun('error', {}, 'forbidden: dispatch_inquiry called without the inbound secret'); return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403); }
    const inquiryId = String(body.inquiry_id || '');
    if (!inquiryId) return J({ error: 'inquiry_id_required' }, 400);

    // ---- FORCE AUTHORITY GATE (v5) ----------------------------------------------------------
    // force bypasses idempotency AND concurrency control. It therefore needs authority that
    // inbound_secret does not confer, and it must never be usable anonymously or by accident.
    let force = false;
    if (body.force === true) {
      const forceKey = await sec('dispatch_force_key');
      const reason = String(body.force_reason || '').trim();
      if (!secretOk(forceKey) || body.__force_key !== forceKey || reason.length < 10) {
        await logRun('error', { inquiry_id: inquiryId, stage: 'force_auth' },
          'REFUSED a force-dispatch: force=true requires dispatch_force_key AND a force_reason of at least 10 characters. ' +
          'force bypasses the already_dispatched guard, the dispatch lock and the lost-claim exit, so two concurrent forced runs ' +
          'can contact the same suppliers twice about one RFQ. Nothing was dispatched.');
        await escalate('Refused force-dispatch on inquiry ' + inquiryId,
          'Someone called dispatch_inquiry with force=true but without dispatch_force_key (or without a written reason).\n\n' +
          'Inquiry: ' + inquiryId + '\nReason supplied: ' + (reason || '(none)') + '\n\n' +
          'The call was refused and nothing was dispatched. If this was you, supply __force_key and force_reason. ' +
          'If it was not, something holding inbound_secret is attempting to re-notify suppliers.',
          'high', 'force_dispatch_refused');
        return J({ error: 'force_requires_dispatch_force_key_and_reason' }, 403);
      }
      force = true;
      await logRun('warn', { inquiry_id: inquiryId, stage: 'force_auth', force_reason: reason.slice(0, 200) },
        'FORCE DISPATCH AUTHORISED for inquiry ' + inquiryId + '. Idempotency and the concurrency lock are being bypassed deliberately. Reason: ' + reason.slice(0, 250));
      await escalate('Force-dispatch used on inquiry ' + inquiryId,
        'dispatch_inquiry was run with force=true, which re-dispatches an RFQ that was already dispatched and bypasses the concurrency lock.\n\n' +
        'Inquiry: ' + inquiryId + '\nStated reason: ' + reason + '\n\nSuppliers not already matched to this RFQ may be contacted about it now.',
        'warn', 'force_dispatch_used');
    }
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const { data: inq } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('id,rfq_ready,routing,category,emirate,summary,status').eq('id', inquiryId).maybeSingle();
    if (!inq) { await logRun('error', { inquiry_id: inquiryId }, 'inquiry_not_found - dispatch requested for an inquiry that does not exist'); return J({ error: 'inquiry_not_found' }, 404); }
    if (inq.rfq_ready !== true) return J({ ok: true, skip: 'not_rfq_ready' });
    const routing = (inq.routing && typeof inq.routing === 'object') ? inq.routing as any : {};
    if (routing.dispatched_at && !force) return J({ ok: true, skip: 'already_dispatched', dispatched_at: routing.dispatched_at });

    // ATOMIC CLAIM: set dispatch_lock only if unlocked (or stale). Losers of the race skip.
    // NOTE: force skips the freshness check but STILL takes the claim below, so a forced run and a
    // normal run cannot interleave. Two simultaneous FORCED runs remain the one uncovered case,
    // which is why force now requires a deliberate key rather than being callable in a loop.
    const nowMs = Date.now(); const nowIso = new Date(nowMs).toISOString();
    const prevLock = routing.dispatch_lock ? Date.parse(routing.dispatch_lock) : 0;
    const lockFresh = prevLock && (nowMs - prevLock) < LOCK_STALE_MS;
    if (lockFresh && !force) return J({ ok: true, skip: 'dispatch_in_progress' });
    const { data: claimed } = await admin.from('inquiries')
      .update({ routing: { ...routing, dispatch_lock: nowIso } })
      .eq('id', inquiryId)
      .or('routing->>dispatch_lock.is.null,routing->>dispatch_lock.eq.' + (routing.dispatch_lock || ''))
      .select('id');
    if ((!claimed || !claimed.length) && !force) return J({ ok: true, skip: 'lost_claim' });

    const MAX_FANOUT = await policyInt('match_max_fanout', 5);
    const label = (inq.category || 'uncategorised') + ' / ' + (inq.emirate || 'UAE');

    // 1) run the sharp adjudicator (reuse route_inquiry)
    let route: any = null;
    try {
      const r = await fetch('https://htdblwldjkcgjvmqkbeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/route_inquiry', {
        method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: inbound, inquiry_id: inquiryId })
      });
      route = await r.json();
    } catch (e) {
      const m = String((e as Error)?.message || e);
      await logRun('error', { inquiry_id: inquiryId, category: inq.category, emirate: inq.emirate }, 'RFQ NOT DISPATCHED - route_inquiry call threw, no supplier was contacted: ' + m);
      await escalate('RFQ not dispatched: ' + label, 'A finalized customer RFQ (' + label + ') could not be routed because route_inquiry failed, so NO supplier was contacted.\n\nInquiry: ' + inquiryId + '\nError: ' + m + '\n\nThe dispatch lock clears after 2 minutes and a retry will re-attempt. If this repeats, the RFQ is stuck.');
      return J({ ok: false, error: 'route_failed', detail: m }, 502);
    }
    if (!route || route.error) {
      const m = String(route?.error || 'no_route');
      await logRun('error', { inquiry_id: inquiryId, category: inq.category, emirate: inq.emirate }, 'RFQ NOT DISPATCHED - route_inquiry returned an error, no supplier was contacted: ' + m.slice(0, 200));
      await escalate('RFQ not dispatched: ' + label, 'A finalized customer RFQ (' + label + ') could not be routed — route_inquiry returned an error, so NO supplier was contacted.\n\nInquiry: ' + inquiryId + '\nError: ' + m + '\n\nThe dispatch lock clears after 2 minutes and a retry will re-attempt.');
      return J({ ok: false, error: 'route_error', detail: m }, 502);
    }

    const fitsAll: any[] = Array.isArray(route.fits) ? route.fits : [];
    const decisionBase = {
      dispatch_lock: null, dispatched_at: new Date().toISOString(), job_type: route.job_type || null, primary_trade: route.primary_trade || null,
      reasoning: route.reasoning || '', evaluated: route.evaluated ?? null, retrieval: route.retrieval || null, fits_returned: fitsAll.length,
      forced: force || undefined, force_reason: force ? String(body.force_reason || '').slice(0, 300) : undefined
    };

    // 2) ZERO genuine fits — never spam sellers; raise an internal coverage-gap flag
    if (!fitsAll.length) {
      await admin.from('inquiries').update({ routing: { ...routing, ...decisionBase, outcome: 'no_fit', fanout: 0 } }).eq('id', inquiryId);
      let flagged = true;
      try {
        await admin.from('agent_actions').insert({
          agent: 'operations_ai', kind: 'coverage_gap', status: 'pending', risk: 'medium',
          title: 'RFQ had no matchable seller' + (inq.category ? (': ' + inq.category) : ''),
          recommendation: 'A finalized customer RFQ (' + label + ') produced ZERO genuine seller matches — a supply-coverage gap. Consider acquiring/onboarding sellers in this trade+emirate. No sellers were contacted.',
          detail: { signal: 'coverage_gap:' + inquiryId, inquiry_id: inquiryId, category: inq.category, emirate: inq.emirate, primary_trade: route.primary_trade, evaluated: route.evaluated },
          target_table: 'inquiries', target_id: inquiryId
        });
      } catch (_e) { flagged = false; }
      if (!flagged) await escalate('Coverage gap not recorded: ' + label, 'An RFQ (' + label + ', inquiry ' + inquiryId + ') produced zero seller matches AND the coverage_gap flag failed to insert, so this gap is not in your action queue.');
      await logRun('ok', { inquiry_id: inquiryId, outcome: 'no_fit', notified: 0, evaluated: route.evaluated ?? null, category: inq.category, emirate: inq.emirate, coverage_gap_flagged: flagged },
        'coverage gap: no genuine seller for ' + label + (flagged ? '' : ' (WARNING: coverage_gap flag failed to insert)'));
      return J({ ok: true, outcome: 'no_fit', notified: 0, note: 'no genuine seller — coverage gap flagged, no seller contacted' });
    }

    // 3) guardrails: dedup against existing matches, cap fanout
    const { data: existing } = await admin.from('inquiry_matches').select('supplier_id').eq('inquiry_id', inquiryId);
    const already = new Set((existing || []).map((r: any) => Number(r.supplier_id)));
    const pick: any[] = [];
    for (const f of fitsAll) { const id = Number(f.id); if (id && !already.has(id) && !pick.some(p => Number(p.id) === id)) pick.push(f); if (pick.length >= MAX_FANOUT) break; }
    const capped = fitsAll.length > pick.length + already.size;

    // 4) persist matches (gate trigger allows only rfq_ready; notify trigger queues seller emails)
    let inserted = 0; const sent_ids: number[] = []; let insertErrors = 0; let lastInsertErr = '';
    for (const f of pick) {
      const reason = String((route.primary_trade ? route.primary_trade + ' — ' : '') + (f.reason || 'genuine capability match')).slice(0, 300);
      const { error } = await admin.from('inquiry_matches').insert({ inquiry_id: inquiryId, supplier_id: Number(f.id), similarity: null, match_reason: reason, sent_at: new Date().toISOString() });
      if (!error) { inserted++; sent_ids.push(Number(f.id)); }
      else { insertErrors++; lastInsertErr = String(error.message || '').slice(0, 200); }
    }

    const outcome = (pick.length && inserted === 0) ? 'dispatch_failed' : 'dispatched';
    await admin.from('inquiries').update({ routing: { ...routing, ...decisionBase, outcome, fanout: inserted, fit_ids: sent_ids, capped, max_fanout: MAX_FANOUT } }).eq('id', inquiryId);
    const counts = { inquiry_id: inquiryId, outcome, notified: inserted, attempted: pick.length, insert_errors: insertErrors, capped, max_fanout: MAX_FANOUT, category: inq.category, emirate: inq.emirate, forced: force };

    if (pick.length && inserted === 0) {
      // v4: no longer reported as a successful dispatch.
      await logRun('error', counts, 'RFQ REACHED NOBODY - all ' + pick.length + ' inquiry_matches inserts failed. Last error: ' + lastInsertErr);
      await escalate('RFQ reached no suppliers: ' + label,
        'A finalized customer RFQ (' + label + ') found ' + pick.length + ' matching supplier(s), but EVERY attempt to record the match failed, so no supplier was notified.\n\n' +
        'Inquiry: ' + inquiryId + '\nSuppliers that should have been contacted: ' + pick.length + '\nDatabase error: ' + lastInsertErr +
        '\n\nThe inquiry is marked dispatch_failed. This customer is waiting for quotes that will not arrive.');
      return J({ ok: false, outcome: 'dispatch_failed', notified: 0, attempted: pick.length, error: 'match_insert_failed', detail: lastInsertErr });
    }
    if (insertErrors) {
      await logRun('error', counts, insertErrors + ' of ' + pick.length + ' seller matches failed to insert, only ' + inserted + ' seller(s) contacted. Last error: ' + lastInsertErr);
      await escalate('RFQ only partly dispatched: ' + label,
        'A customer RFQ (' + label + ', inquiry ' + inquiryId + ') matched ' + pick.length + ' supplier(s) but only ' + inserted + ' were successfully contacted; ' + insertErrors + ' failed.\n\nDatabase error: ' + lastInsertErr);
    } else {
      await logRun('ok', counts, '');
    }
    return J({ ok: true, outcome: 'dispatched', notified: inserted, capped, max_fanout: MAX_FANOUT, job_type: route.job_type, primary_trade: route.primary_trade, forced: force });
  } catch (e) { const m = String((e as Error)?.message || e); await logRun('error', {}, 'exception during dispatch: ' + m); return J({ error: m }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/doc_extract/index.ts

````typescript
// doc_extract — universal Document Intelligence extractor.
// Pulls {text, specifications, brands[], models[], dates[], quantities[], certifications[]}
// from a registered document, and indexes non-sensitive docs into kb_chunks.
// Secret-gated (inbound_secret). Service-role only.
import { createClient } from 'https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
const SERVICE_KEY = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!;
const cors = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':'*','Access-Control-Allow-Headers':'*','Content-Type':'application/json' };
const j = (o:unknown,s=200)=>new Response(JSON.stringify(o),{status:s,headers:cors});
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;

// index these kinds into the shared KB (non customer-identifying capability text).
const INDEX_KINDS = new Set(['catalog','profile','drawing']);
// never index (pricing tied to identity, or PII documents)
// quote, licence, egr are intentionally excluded.

async function llmJSON(apiKey:string, content:unknown):Promise<any>{
  const models=['anthropic/claude-sonnet-5','anthropic/claude-opus-4.8'];
  const sys='You are a document-extraction engine for a UAE construction/services procurement platform. '+
    'Return STRICT JSON only (no markdown) with exactly these keys: '+
    'text (string: a faithful transcription or concise summary of the readable content), '+
    'specifications (array of short strings), brands (array of strings), models (array of strings), '+
    'dates (array of strings as seen), quantities (array of strings like "12 nos", "45 sqm"), '+
    'certifications (array of strings e.g. SIRA, ISO 9001, IP65, CE). '+
    'Use [] for anything absent. Never invent values.';
  for(const model of models){
    try{
      const r=await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions',{method:'POST',
        headers:{'Authorization':`Bearer ${apiKey}`,'Content-Type':'application/json'},
        body:JSON.stringify({model,temperature:0,max_tokens:2000,
          messages:[{role:'system',content:sys},{role:'user',content}]})});
      if(!r.ok){continue;}
      const d=await r.json();
      let t=d?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content||'';
      t=t.replace(/^```(json)?/i,'').replace(/```$/,'').trim();
      const m=t.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if(m) return JSON.parse(m[0]);
    }catch(_e){/*try next*/}
  }
  return null;
}

Deno.serve(async (req)=>{
  if(req.method==='OPTIONS') return new Response('ok',{headers:cors});
  const sb=createClient(SUPABASE_URL,SERVICE_KEY);
  const T0 = Date.now();
  async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
    try {
      await sb.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'doc_extract', status, counts,
        note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
        started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
    } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
  }
  async function logThrottled(signal: string, minutes: number, status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
    try {
      const since = new Date(Date.now() - minutes * 60000).toISOString();
      const { data } = await sb.from('agent_runs').select('id').eq('agent', 'doc_extract')
        .gte('started_at', since).eq('counts->>signal', signal).limit(1);
      if (data && data.length) return;
    } catch (_e) { /* if the check fails, fall through and log */ }
    await logRun(status, { ...counts, signal }, note);
  }
  let body:any={}; try{ body=await req.json(); }catch(_e){}
  // secrets from app_secrets
  const { data:secrets } = await sb.from('app_secrets').select('key,value').in('key',['inbound_secret','openrouter_api_key','cloudconvert_api_key']);
  const secret=(secrets||[]).find((s:any)=>s.key==='inbound_secret')?.value;
  const apiKey=(secrets||[]).find((s:any)=>s.key==='openrouter_api_key')?.value;
  if(!secretOk(secret) || body.__secret!==secret) {
    if(!secret) await logThrottled('missing_inbound_secret',60,'error',{stage:'auth'},'The inbound_secret row is missing from app_secrets, so doc_extract rejects every caller including the scheduler; no supplier document is being extracted or indexed at all.');
    else await logThrottled('bad_secret',60,'error',{stage:'auth'},'doc_extract rejected a caller presenting the wrong inbound secret. If this is the scheduled drainer, the document extraction queue is not being processed and supplier documents stay unread.');
    return j({error:'unauthorized'},401);
  }
  if(!apiKey) { await logThrottled('no_openrouter_key',60,'error',{stage:'config'},'openrouter_api_key is missing from app_secrets, so doc_extract cannot call the extraction model; every uploaded supplier document is stuck pending and none of their specs, brands or certifications reach the knowledge base.'); return j({error:'no_openrouter_key'},500); }

  // pick a document: explicit id, or next pending (batch drainer passes nothing)
  let doc:any=null;
  if(body.document_id){
    const { data } = await sb.from('documents').select('*').eq('id',body.document_id).maybeSingle(); doc=data;
  } else {
    const { data } = await sb.from('documents').select('*').eq('status','pending').lt('attempts',3).order('id').limit(1); doc=(data||[])[0];
  }
  if(!doc) return j({ok:true,note:'no pending documents'});

  const { error:claimErr } = await sb.from('documents').update({status:'processing',attempts:(doc.attempts||0)+1}).eq('id',doc.id);
  if(claimErr) await logThrottled('claim_failed',60,'error',{stage:'claim',document_id:doc.id},'doc_extract could not mark document '+doc.id+' as processing, so the same document will be picked up again every run: the queue never advances and extraction cost is burned repeatedly. '+String(claimErr?.message||claimErr).slice(0,160));

  try{
    const { data:signed, error:se } = await sb.storage.from(doc.bucket).createSignedUrl(doc.path,300);
    if(se||!signed?.signedUrl) throw new Error('signed_url_failed: '+(se?.message||''));
    const fr=await fetch(signed.signedUrl); if(!fr.ok) throw new Error('fetch_failed_'+fr.status);
    const ct=(fr.headers.get('content-type')||'').toLowerCase();
    const name=(doc.file_name||doc.path).toLowerCase();
    const isImg = ct.startsWith('image/') || /\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|gif)$/.test(name);
    const isPdf = ct.includes('pdf') || name.endsWith('.pdf');
    const isText= ct.startsWith('text/') || /\.(txt|csv|md|html?)$/.test(name);

    let extracted:any=null; let mime=ct||null;
    if(isImg){
      const buf=new Uint8Array(await fr.arrayBuffer());
      let bin=''; for(let i=0;i<buf.length;i++) bin+=String.fromCharCode(buf[i]);
      const b64=btoa(bin);
      const dataUrl=`data:${ct||'image/jpeg'};base64,${b64}`;
      extracted=await llmJSON(apiKey,[{type:'text',text:'Extract the fields from this document image.'},{type:'image_url',image_url:{url:dataUrl}}]);
      mime=ct||'image/jpeg';
    } else if(isPdf){
      try{
        const { extractText, getDocumentProxy } = await import('https://esm.sh/unpdf@0.11.0');
        const ab=await fr.arrayBuffer();
        const pdf=await getDocumentProxy(new Uint8Array(ab));
        const { text } = await extractText(pdf,{mergePages:true});
        const clean=(text||'').trim();
        if(clean.length>80){ extracted=await llmJSON(apiKey,`Extract the fields from this document text:\n\n${clean.slice(0,12000)}`); }
        else {
          // OCR FALLBACK. A scanned PDF has no text layer, but this function already has a
          // working vision path for images. Render the PDF to PNG via CloudConvert and use it.
          // UAE trade licences are commonly scanned, and licence extraction is the first step
          // of supplier verification, so skipping these blocks the whole verification pipeline.
          let ocrOk = false;
          try {
            const ccKey=(secrets||[]).find((s:any)=>s.key==='cloudconvert_api_key')?.value;
            if (ccKey) {
              const pdfBuf = new Uint8Array(ab);
              let pbin = ''; for (let i = 0; i < pdfBuf.length; i++) pbin += String.fromCharCode(pdfBuf[i]);
              const pdfB64 = btoa(pbin);
              const ccAuth = { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + ccKey, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
              const jr = await fetch('https://api.cloudconvert.com/v2/jobs', { method: 'POST', headers: ccAuth,
                body: JSON.stringify({ tasks: {
                  imp: { operation: 'import/base64', file: pdfB64, filename: (doc.file_name || 'doc.pdf') },
                  conv: { operation: 'convert', input: 'imp', input_format: 'pdf', output_format: 'png', pixel_density: 200, pages: '1-3' },
                  exp: { operation: 'export/url', input: 'conv', inline: false, archive_multiple_files: false }
                } }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(25000) });
              const jj = await jr.json();
              const jobId = jj?.data?.id;
              if (jobId) {
                for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
                  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3500));
                  const pr = await fetch('https://api.cloudconvert.com/v2/jobs/' + jobId, { headers: ccAuth, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(12000) }).catch(() => null);
                  if (!pr) continue;
                  const pj = await pr.json().catch(() => ({}));
                  const tasks = (pj?.data?.tasks || []) as any[];
                  const done = tasks.find((t) => t.operation === 'export/url' && t.status === 'finished');
                  if (done) {
                    const files = (done.result?.files || []) as any[];
                    const parts: any[] = [{ type: 'text', text: 'This is a scanned document rendered to images. Extract the fields.' }];
                    for (const f of files.slice(0, 3)) {
                      const ir = await fetch(f.url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(20000) }).catch(() => null);
                      if (!ir || !ir.ok) continue;
                      const ibuf = new Uint8Array(await ir.arrayBuffer());
                      let ibin = ''; for (let k = 0; k < ibuf.length; k++) ibin += String.fromCharCode(ibuf[k]);
                      parts.push({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: 'data:image/png;base64,' + btoa(ibin) } });
                    }
                    if (parts.length > 1) { extracted = await llmJSON(apiKey, parts); ocrOk = !!extracted; }
                    break;
                  }
                  if (tasks.some((t) => t.status === 'error')) break;
                }
              }
            }
          } catch (_e) { /* fall through to the original skip */ }
          if (ocrOk) { mime = 'application/pdf'; }
          else { await sb.from('documents').update({status:'skipped',error:'scanned_pdf_no_text_ocr_failed',processed_at:new Date().toISOString()}).eq('id',doc.id); await logThrottled('skipped_scanned_pdf',60,'error',{stage:'pdf',document_id:doc.id,kind:doc.kind},'Document '+doc.id+' is a scanned PDF and the OCR fallback did not produce text, so it was skipped: this supplier document will never be read into the knowledge base and its specs and certifications are invisible to matching.'); return j({ok:true,id:doc.id,status:'skipped'}); }
        }
      }catch(pe){ await sb.from('documents').update({status:'skipped',error:'pdf_parse:'+String(pe).slice(0,120),processed_at:new Date().toISOString()}).eq('id',doc.id); await logThrottled('skipped_pdf_parse',60,'error',{stage:'pdf',document_id:doc.id,kind:doc.kind},'PDF parsing failed for document '+doc.id+' and it was silently skipped, so its contents never reach the knowledge base. '+String(pe).slice(0,160)); return j({ok:true,id:doc.id,status:'skipped'}); }
      mime='application/pdf';
    } else if(isText){
      const txt=(await fr.text()).slice(0,12000);
      extracted=await llmJSON(apiKey,`Extract the fields from this document text:\n\n${txt}`);
      mime=ct||'text/plain';
    } else {
      await sb.from('documents').update({status:'skipped',error:'unsupported_mime:'+ct,processed_at:new Date().toISOString()}).eq('id',doc.id);
      await logThrottled('skipped_unsupported_mime',60,'error',{stage:'mime',document_id:doc.id,kind:doc.kind,mime:ct},'Document '+doc.id+' has an unsupported content type ('+ct+') and was skipped, so a supplier document that was accepted at upload is never extracted or indexed.');
      return j({ok:true,id:doc.id,status:'skipped'});
    }

    if(!extracted){ throw new Error('extraction_null'); }
    // ensure array fields exist
    for(const k of ['specifications','brands','models','dates','quantities','certifications']){ if(!Array.isArray(extracted[k])) extracted[k]=[]; }
    if(typeof extracted.text!=='string') extracted.text=String(extracted.text||'');

    let indexed=false;
    if(INDEX_KINDS.has(doc.kind)){
      const parts=[extracted.text, (extracted.specifications||[]).join('; '), (extracted.brands||[]).join(', ')].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
      if(parts.trim().length>40){
        // category from the owning lead, if any
        let cat:string|null=null;
        if(doc.ref_table==='leads'&&doc.ref_id){ const { data:l }=await sb.from('leads').select('sector,sub_type').eq('id',doc.ref_id).maybeSingle(); cat=l?.sub_type||l?.sector||null; }
        const { error:kbErr } = await sb.from('kb_chunks').insert({source_kind:'document',source_id:String(doc.id),category:cat,title:(doc.file_name||doc.kind),content:parts.slice(0,6000),citation:`Supplier ${doc.kind} document`});
        if(kbErr) await logRun('error',{stage:'kb_insert',document_id:doc.id,kind:doc.kind},'Document '+doc.id+' was extracted but the kb_chunks insert failed, yet it is about to be marked indexed: this supplier capability text is permanently missing from the knowledge base and will not surface in supplier matching. '+String(kbErr?.message||kbErr).slice(0,160));
        indexed=true;
      }
    }

    const { error:doneErr } = await sb.from('documents').update({status:'done',extracted,indexed,mime,error:null,processed_at:new Date().toISOString()}).eq('id',doc.id);
    if(doneErr) await logRun('error',{stage:'mark_done',document_id:doc.id,kind:doc.kind},'Document '+doc.id+' was extracted successfully but could not be marked done, so it stays in processing forever and the extraction work (and its cost) is repeated or lost. '+String(doneErr?.message||doneErr).slice(0,160));
    else await logRun('ok',{stage:'extract',processed:1,document_id:doc.id,kind:doc.kind,indexed,brands:extracted.brands.length,specs:extracted.specifications.length,certs:extracted.certifications.length},'doc_extract processed document '+doc.id+' ('+doc.kind+'), indexed='+indexed+'.');
    return j({ok:true,id:doc.id,kind:doc.kind,indexed,fields:{brands:extracted.brands.length,specs:extracted.specifications.length,certs:extracted.certifications.length}});
  }catch(e){
    await sb.from('documents').update({status:'error',error:String(e).slice(0,200),processed_at:new Date().toISOString()}).eq('id',doc.id);
    await logThrottled('doc_error',60,'error',{stage:'extract',document_id:doc.id,kind:doc.kind},'doc_extract failed on document '+doc.id+' ('+doc.kind+'); after 3 attempts it stops being retried, so this supplier document is never read and its specs never reach the knowledge base. '+String(e).slice(0,200));
    return j({error:String(e)},500);
  }
});
````

### supabase/functions/doc_reminder/index.ts

```typescript
// doc_reminder - consolidated supplier document reminder. Checks trade licence, insurance, establishment
// card, VAT/TRN, ISO certification and manufacturer authorisation for each active supplier; if anything is
// EXPIRING (within N days), EXPIRED, or MISSING (where relevant), sends ONE branded email asking them to reply
// with the documents. Type 'doc_request' => send_outbox sets reply-to = docs@mail.quotesdone.com and bypasses the
// supplier marketing gate (transactional); the reply is auto-extracted/applied to the supplier profile.
// v2: adds ISO + manufacturer authorisation (expiry always; missing only where category/brands make it relevant).
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
function parseDate(v: unknown): Date | null { if(!v) return null; const d=new Date(String(v)); return isNaN(d.getTime())?null:d; }
function filled(v: unknown): boolean { if (v === null || v === undefined) return false; if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.length > 0; const s = String(v).trim(); return s.length > 0 && s !== '[]' && s !== '{}' && s.toLowerCase() !== 'null' && s.toLowerCase() !== 'none'; }
const ISO_RELEVANT = /secur|cctv|fire|mep|electric|hvac|\bac\b|duct|elevator|\blift|medical|water|pool|solar|smart[-_ ]?home|access[-_ ]?control/i;
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const windowDays = Math.max(1, Math.min(90, Number(body.days) || 14));
    const reDays = Math.max(3, Math.min(30, Number(body.resend_after_days) || 10));
    const now = Date.now();
    const { data: leads } = await admin.from('leads')
      .select('id,company_name,email,claimed_by,banned,license_expiry,license_doc_path,insurance_expiry,insurance_doc_path,egr_doc_path,trn,iso_certifications,iso_expiry,iso_doc_path,manufacturer_authorizations,manufacturer_auth_expiry,manufacturer_auth_doc_path,brands_carried,sector,categories')
      .eq('approval_status','approved').eq('claimed',true).limit(500);
    let queued = 0, skipped = 0, no_issues = 0; const sample: string[] = [];
    for (const l of (leads||[])) {
      if (l.banned === true) { skipped++; continue; }
      const to = String(l.claimed_by || l.email || '').trim();
      if (!to || to.indexOf('@') < 0) { skipped++; continue; }
      const issues: string[] = [];
      const expLine = (label: string, d: Date) => { const days = Math.round((d.getTime()-now)/864e5); if (days < 0) return label+' EXPIRED on '+d.toISOString().slice(0,10); if (days===0) return label+' expires TODAY'; return label+' expires on '+d.toISOString().slice(0,10)+' (in '+days+' day'+(days===1?'':'s')+')'; };
      const chk = (exp: unknown, docPath: unknown, present: boolean, label: string, missingLabel: string | null) => {
        const dx = parseDate(exp);
        if (dx) { const days = Math.round((dx.getTime()-now)/864e5); if (days <= windowDays) issues.push(expLine(label, dx)); }
        else if (missingLabel && !present && !filled(docPath)) issues.push(missingLabel);
      };
      // trade licence
      chk(l.license_expiry, l.license_doc_path, false, 'Trade licence', 'Trade licence not on file');
      // insurance
      chk(l.insurance_expiry, l.insurance_doc_path, false, 'Insurance certificate', 'Insurance certificate not on file');
      // establishment card
      if (!filled(l.egr_doc_path)) issues.push('Establishment card not on file');
      // VAT / TRN
      if (!filled(l.trn)) issues.push('VAT / TRN number not provided');
      // ISO: expiry always; missing only for ISO-relevant categories
      const catText = [l.sector, Array.isArray(l.categories) ? l.categories.join(' ') : l.categories].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
      const isoRelevant = ISO_RELEVANT.test(catText);
      chk(l.iso_expiry, l.iso_doc_path, filled(l.iso_certifications), 'ISO certification', isoRelevant ? 'ISO certification recommended for your category (upload if you hold one)' : null);
      // manufacturer authorisation: expiry always; missing only if they carry brands
      const carriesBrands = filled(l.brands_carried);
      chk(l.manufacturer_auth_expiry, l.manufacturer_auth_doc_path, filled(l.manufacturer_authorizations), 'Manufacturer authorisation', carriesBrands ? 'Manufacturer authorisation for the brands you carry not on file' : null);
      if (!issues.length) { no_issues++; continue; }
      // de-dupe
      const { data: recent } = await admin.from('notifications').select('id').eq('type','doc_request').eq('lead_id', l.id).gte('created_at', new Date(now - reDays*864e5).toISOString()).limit(1);
      if (recent && recent.length) { skipped++; continue; }
      const co = String(l.company_name || 'there');
      const listTxt = issues.map(x=>'• '+x).join('\n');
      const subject = 'Action needed: keep your QuotesDone documents up to date — ' + co;
      const bodyTxt = 'Dear ' + co + ',\n\nTo keep your QuotesDone supplier profile active and continue receiving customer job requests, the following document(s) need your attention:\n\n' + listTxt + '\n\nHow to fix this: simply REPLY to this email with the document(s) attached (PDF or a clear photo). Our system will read them and update your account automatically — you do not need to do anything else.\n\nIf you have already provided these, please reply with the latest copies so our records stay current. Thank you for being part of QuotesDone.';
      const { error } = await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type:'doc_request', to_email: to, to_role:'supplier', lead_id: l.id, channel:'email', subject, body: bodyTxt, status:'queued' });
      if (!error) { queued++; if (sample.length < 10) sample.push(co + ': ' + issues.length + ' issue(s)'); } else skipped++;
    }
    return J({ ok: true, suppliers: (leads||[]).length, queued, no_issues, skipped, window_days: windowDays, sample });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/doc_render/index.ts

````typescript
// doc_render v9 - branded document generator. Opus writes ONLY the body (in the requested language); this wraps it in
// letterhead HTML (kept for on-screen view) AND renders a native branded PDF via pdf_native (pdf-lib, no CloudConvert).
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, OPUS_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const llm = makeLlm(OPUS_FIRST, { max: 9000, temperature: 0.3 });
const URL_ = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
const ASSET = URL_ + '/storage/v1/object/public/brand';
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
const CO = { name:'QuotesDone Technologies', licence:'DET E-Trader Licence No. 1633275', city:'Dubai, United Arab Emirates', email:'management@quotesdone.com', phone:'+971 50 931 9355', web:'quotesdone.com', signer:'Ahmad Alzain', title:'Founder & Managing Director' };
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
async function authed(req: Request, body: any){ if(body.__secret && body.__secret===(await sec('inbound_secret'))) return true; const jwt=(req.headers.get('Authorization')||'').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i,''); const { data:{ user } }=await admin.auth.getUser(jwt); const allow=(await sec('admin_emails')||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean); return !!(user?.email && allow.includes(user.email.toLowerCase())); }
function stripFences(s: string){ let t=String(s||'').trim(); const m=t.match(/```(?:html)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i); if(m) t=m[1].trim(); return t; }
function esc(s: string){ return String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;'); }
function dir(s:string){ return /[؀-ۿ]/.test(s) ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'; }

const STAMP = `<svg class=\"stamp\" width=\"152\" height=\"152\" viewBox=\"0 0 152 152\" xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"><defs><path id=\"qdtop\" d=\"M 16,76 A 60,60 0 0 1 136,76\" fill=\"none\"/></defs><g fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#0b5c54\" stroke-width=\"2.2\"><circle cx=\"76\" cy=\"76\" r=\"72\"/><circle cx=\"76\" cy=\"76\" r=\"56\"/></g><g fill=\"#0b5c54\" font-family=\"Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif\"><text font-size=\"10.5\" font-weight=\"700\" letter-spacing=\"0.7\"><textPath href=\"#qdtop\" startOffset=\"50%\" text-anchor=\"middle\">QUOTESDONE TECHNOLOGIES</textPath></text><text x=\"76\" y=\"63\" text-anchor=\"middle\" font-size=\"18\" font-weight=\"800\">QuotesDone</text><text x=\"76\" y=\"75\" text-anchor=\"middle\" font-size=\"7.5\" letter-spacing=\"2.5\" font-weight=\"600\">DUBAI · UAE</text><line x1=\"50\" y1=\"82\" x2=\"102\" y2=\"82\" stroke=\"#0b5c54\" stroke-width=\"0.9\"/><text x=\"76\" y=\"95\" text-anchor=\"middle\" font-size=\"9\" font-weight=\"700\" letter-spacing=\"0.4\">LICENCE 1633275</text><text x=\"76\" y=\"104\" text-anchor=\"middle\" font-size=\"6\" letter-spacing=\"1.5\" font-weight=\"600\">DET E-TRADER</text></g></svg>`;

function wrap(title: string, bodyHtml: string, rtl: boolean){
  const head = `<link rel=\"icon\" href=\"${ASSET}/favicon-32.png\">`;
  const css = `*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0}body{font-family:Inter,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;color:#15181d;font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;padding:0 0 90px}\n.page{max-width:780px;margin:0 auto;padding:32px 40px 0}\n.lh{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;border-bottom:3px solid #14B8A6;padding-bottom:14px}\n.lh img{height:40px;width:auto}\n.lh-co{text-align:right;font-size:11.5px;color:#475569;line-height:1.5}\n.lh-co .nm{font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:#0C2330;letter-spacing:.2px}\n.doc-title{margin:26px 0 4px;font-size:21px;font-weight:800;color:#0C2330}\n.doc-meta{color:#64748b;font-size:11.5px;margin-bottom:14px}\nh2{font-size:15px;color:#0C2330;margin:22px 0 7px;border-bottom:1px solid #e8edf2;padding-bottom:4px}\nh3{font-size:13.5px;color:#0C2330;margin:16px 0 5px}\np{margin:0 0 10px}ul,ol{margin:0 0 10px;padding-left:20px}li{margin:3px 0}\ntable{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12.5px;margin:8px 0 14px}\nth,td{border:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:7px 9px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top}th{background:#f1f5f9;color:#0C2330;font-weight:700}\n.sign{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:30px;margin:42px 0 10px;page-break-inside:avoid}\n.sign-l{margin-left:120px}\n.sign .lbl{font-size:11px;color:#64748b;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:2px}\n.sig-img{height:60px;width:auto;display:block;margin:0 0 2px}\n.sig-rule{width:230px;border-bottom:1px solid #334155;margin:2px 0 6px}\n.sig-nm{font-weight:700;color:#0C2330}.sig-tt{font-size:11.5px;color:#475569}.sig-co{font-size:11.5px;color:#475569}\n.stamp{opacity:.85;transform:rotate(-8deg)}\n.ft{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0;background:#fff;color:#7a8aa0;font-size:10px;text-align:center;padding:8px 40px;line-height:1.5}\nbody[dir=rtl] th,body[dir=rtl] td{text-align:right}\n@media print{.ft{position:fixed}}`;
  const header = `<div class=\"lh\" dir=\"ltr\"><img src=\"${ASSET}/qd_lockup_dark.png\" alt=\"QuotesDone\"><div class=\"lh-co\"><div class=\"nm\">${CO.name}</div><div>${CO.licence}</div><div>${CO.city}</div><div>${CO.email} · ${CO.phone}</div></div></div>`;
  const dateStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'2-digit',month:'long',year:'numeric'});
  const signBlock = `<div class=\"sign\" dir=\"ltr\"><div class=\"sign-l\"><div class=\"lbl\">Authorised signatory</div><img class=\"sig-img\" src=\"${ASSET}/qd_signature.png\" alt=\"Signature\"><div class=\"sig-rule\"></div><div class=\"sig-nm\">${esc(CO.signer)}</div><div class=\"sig-tt\">${esc(CO.title)}</div><div class=\"sig-co\">${CO.name}</div></div><div class=\"sign-r\">${STAMP}</div></div>`;
  const footer = `<div class=\"ft\">${CO.name} · ${CO.licence} · ${CO.city}<br>${CO.email} · ${CO.phone} · ${CO.web}</div>`;
  return `<!doctype html><html lang=\"en\"><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\"><meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width,initial-scale=1\"><title>${esc(title)}</title>${head}<style>${css}</style></head><body${rtl?' dir=\"rtl\"':''}><div class=\"page\">${header}<div class=\"doc-title\">${esc(title)}</div><div class=\"doc-meta\">${CO.city} · ${dateStr}</div>${bodyHtml}${signBlock}</div>${footer}</body></html>`;
}

const SYS = `You are the document writer for QuotesDone, a UAE B2B quotation marketplace. Produce ONLY the inner BODY of a document from the brief — the sections, paragraphs, tables and lists.\n\nHARD REQUIREMENTS:\n- Output ONLY an HTML FRAGMENT (the body content). DO NOT output <!doctype>, <html>, <head>, <style>, a logo, a letterhead/header, a signature, a stamp, or a footer — ALL of those are added automatically around your content. Do not repeat the document title as a heading (it is added automatically).\n- A signature block (authorised signatory name, title, company and the company stamp) is appended automatically AFTER your content. Therefore DO NOT write any closing signature, do NOT type a signatory name or job title, do NOT write '[Authorised Signatory]', and do NOT add the company name as a sign-off. Do NOT reference or mention 'the stamp below'. For a letter you MAY end with a simple salutation line.\n- Use semantic tags: <h2> for section headings, <h3> for sub-sections, <p> for paragraphs, <ul>/<ol> for lists, and <table><thead><tbody> for any tabular/figures data. No inline styles, no markdown, no code fences.\n- FOLLOW THE LAYOUT INSTRUCTIONS EXACTLY (sections, tables, columns, order). Write in clear, professional business language.\n- Use ONLY the data provided. Never invent figures, names, or facts; where a value is unknown use a clear [placeholder].`;

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    if(!(await authed(req, body))) return J({ error:'forbidden' }, 403);
    const lang = ['en','ar','bi'].includes(String(body.lang)) ? String(body.lang) : 'en';
    const title = String(body.title||'Document').slice(0,160);
    const layout = String(body.layout||body.brief||body.instruction||'').slice(0,4000);
    if(!layout) return J({ error:'layout/brief required' }, 400);
    const data = body.data!=null ? (typeof body.data==='string'?body.data:JSON.stringify(body.data)).slice(0,8000) : '';
    const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key'); if(!key) return J({ error:'ai_unavailable' }, 500);
    const langDirective = lang==='ar' ? '\n\nLANGUAGE: Write the ENTIRE document body in formal Modern Standard Arabic (العربية الفصحى). Keep numbers, currency codes (AED) and proper names as-is.' : (lang==='bi' ? '\n\nLANGUAGE: Produce the document BILINGUALLY. For every section, write the English version first, then immediately its Modern Standard Arabic translation as a separate paragraph/heading. Keep numbers and AED as-is.' : '');
    const user = `DOCUMENT TITLE: ${title}\n\nLAYOUT / CONTENT INSTRUCTIONS:\n${layout}${langDirective}\n\nDATA TO USE${data?':\n'+data:' : (none provided — use [placeholders] where needed)'}`;
    let frag=''; let lastErr='';
    const c = await llm(SYS, user, 9000);
    if(c){ frag = stripFences(c); } else lastErr='empty';
    if(frag.length<40) return J({ error:'render_failed', detail:lastErr }, 502);
    frag = frag.replace(/<!doctype[\s\S]*?>/gi,'').replace(/<\/?(html|head|body)[^>]*>/gi,'').replace(/<style[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi,'').trim();
    const rtl = lang==='ar' || (lang!=='bi' && dir(frag)==='rtl');
    const html = wrap(title, frag, rtl);
    const safe = title.replace(/[^\w.\-]+/g,'_').slice(0,60) || 'document';
    const stamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) + '/' + Date.now() + '_' + safe;
    const path = stamp + '.html';
    const up = await admin.storage.from('agent-docs').upload(path, new Blob([html], { type:'text/html' }), { contentType:'text/html', upsert:false });
    if(up.error) return J({ error:'store_failed', detail: up.error.message }, 500);
    const { data: signed } = await admin.storage.from('agent-docs').createSignedUrl(path, 7*24*3600);
    let pdf_url=null, pdf_path=null;
    if (body.pdf !== false){
      try { const secret=await sec('inbound_secret'); const pr = await fetch(`${URL_}/functions/v1/pdf_native`, { method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: secret, title, body_html: frag, name: safe, lang, options:{ letterhead:true, sign: body.sign!==false, stamp: body.stamp!==false } }) }); const pj=await pr.json(); if(pj?.ok){ pdf_url=pj.url; pdf_path=pj.path; } } catch(_e){ /* */ }
    }
    return J({ ok:true, title, lang, path, url: signed?.signedUrl||null, pdf_url, pdf_path, bytes: html.length });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message||e) }, 500); }
});
````

```typescript
// dr_drill — disaster-recovery restore drill.
// Downloads backup JSON files, parses them, reloads into public.dr_restore,
// and reports backup-vs-live row counts + schema-key integrity. Secret-gated.
import { createClient } from 'https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
const SERVICE_KEY = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!;
const admin = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SERVICE_KEY);
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'dr_drill', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
}
const cors={'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':'*','Access-Control-Allow-Headers':'*','Content-Type':'application/json'};
const j=(o:unknown,s=200)=>new Response(JSON.stringify(o),{status:s,headers:cors});
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;

// small, business-critical tables + a required key to prove schema integrity
const TABLES:[string,string][]=[
  ['pricing_config','id'],['customers','id'],['quotes','id'],
  ['inquiries','id'],['transactions','id'],['inquiry_matches','inquiry_id']];

Deno.serve(async (req)=>{
  if(req.method==='OPTIONS') return new Response('ok',{headers:cors});
  const sb=createClient(SUPABASE_URL,SERVICE_KEY);
  let body:any={}; try{ body=await req.json(); }catch(_e){}
  const { data:secrets, error:secretsErr } = await sb.from('app_secrets').select('key,value').eq('key','inbound_secret');
  const secret=(secrets||[])[0]?.value;
  if(!secretOk(secret) || body.__secret!==secret){
    await logRun('error', { unauthorized:1, secret_configured: secret?1:0 }, secret ? 'Disaster-recovery drill rejected a caller with a wrong __secret; no restore drill ran. If this was the scheduled cron its secret is stale, which means backups are going unverified and a real outage could find them unrestorable.' : ('Disaster-recovery drill could not read inbound_secret from app_secrets, so every call including the scheduled cron is rejected with 401. The backup restore drill never runs and nobody is verifying that backups are restorable. ' + String(secretsErr?.message || 'no inbound_secret row')));
    return j({error:'unauthorized'},401);
  }

  // resolve day: explicit or latest folder that has a _manifest.json
  let day=body.day as string|undefined;
  let listErrMsg='';
  if(!day){
    const { data:root, error:listErr } = await sb.storage.from('backups').list('',{limit:1000});
    if(listErr) listErrMsg='Could not list the backups storage bucket, so the drill could not even find a backup to restore: '+String(listErr.message||listErr)+'. ';
    const days=(root||[]).map((e:any)=>e.name).filter((n:string)=>/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(n)).sort();
    day=days[days.length-1];
  }
  if(!day){
    await logRun('error', { day:null }, listErrMsg+'No dated backup folder was found in the backups bucket, so the disaster-recovery drill did not run. Either backups are not being written at all or they are not where the drill looks; an outage right now may be unrecoverable.');
    return j({error:'no_backup_folder'},404);
  }

  const failNotes:string[]=[];
  const { error:wipeErr } = await sb.from('dr_restore').delete().neq('id',0); // clean slate
  if(wipeErr) failNotes.push('Could not clear the dr_restore staging table before the drill, so restored-row counts are compared against leftover rows from a previous run and the drill result cannot be trusted: '+String(wipeErr.message||wipeErr)+'. ');
  const report:any[]=[]; let ok=true;
  for(const [tbl,key] of TABLES){
    const row:any={ table:tbl };
    try{
      const { data:blob, error:de } = await sb.storage.from('backups').download(`${day}/${tbl}.json`);
      if(de||!blob){ row.status='backup_missing'; row.error=de?.message; ok=false; report.push(row); failNotes.push('Backup file '+day+'/'+tbl+'.json is missing, so the '+tbl+' table has no verified backup and could not be restored in a real outage. '); continue; }
      const arr=JSON.parse(await blob.text());
      row.backup_rows=Array.isArray(arr)?arr.length:0;
      // restore into staging
      if(row.backup_rows>0){
        const chunk=arr.map((r:any)=>({kind:tbl,row:r}));
        let insertErrMsg='';
        for(let i=0;i<chunk.length;i+=500){ const { error:ie } = await sb.from('dr_restore').insert(chunk.slice(i,i+500)); if(ie&&!insertErrMsg) insertErrMsg=String(ie.message||ie); }
        if(insertErrMsg) failNotes.push('Restoring '+tbl+' into the dr_restore staging table failed part-way, so the backup for '+tbl+' is not proven restorable: '+insertErrMsg+'. ');
      }
      const { count:restored, error:rcErr } = await sb.from('dr_restore').select('*',{count:'exact',head:true}).eq('kind',tbl);
      if(rcErr) failNotes.push('Could not count restored rows for '+tbl+', so its restore could not be verified: '+String(rcErr.message||rcErr)+'. ');
      row.restored_rows=restored||0;
      row.key_ok = row.backup_rows===0 ? true : (arr[0] && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(arr[0],key));
      const { count:live, error:lcErr } = await sb.from(tbl).select('*',{count:'exact',head:true});
      if(lcErr) failNotes.push('Could not count live rows in '+tbl+', so backup-vs-live drift for that table was not checked: '+String(lcErr.message||lcErr)+'. ');
      row.live_rows=live||0;
      row.restore_ok = row.restored_rows===row.backup_rows && row.key_ok;
      row.status = row.restore_ok ? 'ok' : 'mismatch';
      if(!row.restore_ok) ok=false;
    }catch(e){ row.status='error'; row.error=String(e).slice(0,160); ok=false; failNotes.push('Drill threw while restoring '+tbl+', so that table is not proven restorable: '+String(e).slice(0,160)+'. '); }
    report.push(row);
  }
  const total_restored=report.reduce((a,r)=>a+(r.restored_rows||0),0);
  const counts={ day, total_restored, tables_checked:report.length, tables_failed:report.filter((r:any)=>r.status!=='ok').length, failed_tables:report.filter((r:any)=>r.status!=='ok').map((r:any)=>r.table) };
  if(ok && !failNotes.length) await logRun('ok', counts, '');
  else await logRun('error', counts, (failNotes.join('') || 'Disaster-recovery drill finished with mismatches, so one or more backups are not proven restorable. ')+'Backups for the failing tables cannot be relied on for recovery.');
  return j({ ok, day, tables:report, total_restored, note:'Restored into public.dr_restore (staging); live tables untouched.' });
});
```

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }

const CATS = 'civil_construction, fit_out_interior, mep_electrical, mep_plumbing, mep_hvac, joinery_carpentry, flooring_tiling, painting_finishes, aluminium_glass, false_ceiling_partitions, steel_fabrication, waterproofing, landscaping, signage, cleaning_facilities, swimming_pools';

const SYS = `You are a UAE quantity surveyor. You read CONSTRUCTION / FIT-OUT / MEP / architectural drawings (floor plans, elevations, sections, layouts, schedules, single-line diagrams) and produce a DRAFT Bill of Quantities (BOQ) that a contractor could price.\n\nPRIVACY (CRITICAL): your output is shown to competing suppliers who must NOT be able to identify the client or project. NEVER read out, copy or include ANY identifying information from the drawing. Specifically ignore and never repeat: the title block's company / consultant / architect / contractor names, client or owner names, any person names, phone numbers, emails, websites, the project name or title, drawing or project numbers, plot / parcel / makani numbers, and the site or project address. You MAY use the title block ONLY for scale, drawing type and dimensions. Output ONLY generic technical scope. If any text field (summary, descriptions, basis, keywords, assumptions, missing_info) would contain a name, company, phone, email or address, leave it out or generalise it (e.g. say 'a villa', not the address; 'ground floor', not the project name).\n\nRead EVERY drawing page. Use the title block, scale bar, stated dimensions, room/area labels, schedules (door/window/finish/fixture schedules), legends and symbol counts. Where a scale or explicit dimensions are given, compute areas (sqm), lengths (m) and counts (nos). Where you must assume, say so and lower the confidence.\n\nProduce measurable BOQ line items grouped into sections (e.g. Demolition, Blockwork, Flooring, Painting, Doors, Electrical points, Plumbing fixtures, HVAC, Ceiling). For each item give: a clear generic description, quantity, unit (sqm / m / nos / lot), the dimensions or basis used, and a per-item confidence. Keep to the most relevant items (aim for under 40). Be concise in every text field.\n\nIMPORTANT: this is an AI ESTIMATE for guidance and supplier matching, NOT a certified take-off. Be honest. Never invent quantities you cannot see. Flag everything you assumed and everything you could not determine.\n\nOutput ONLY the JSON object, no markdown, no prose before or after:\n{\"drawing_type\":string,\"category\":one of [${CATS}] or \"\",\"summary\":string,\"scale_detected\":string,\"total_area_sqm\":number|null,\"boq\":[{\"section\":string,\"description\":string,\"qty\":number|null,\"unit\":string,\"basis\":string,\"confidence\":\"low\"|\"medium\"|\"high\"}],\"keywords\":[string],\"assumptions\":[string],\"missing_info\":[string],\"confidence\":\"low\"|\"medium\"|\"high\"}\ncategory = best single match from the list for supplier matching. keywords = 4-10 short terms describing the trades/materials shown (for matching). If you cannot read the drawing at all, return confidence \"low\", empty boq, and explain in missing_info.`;

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key');

    const hint = body.hint ? String(body.hint).slice(0,400) : '';

    const content: any[] = [{ type: 'text', text: `Customer note (context only): ${hint||'(none)'}. Read the attached drawing pages and return the DRAFT BOQ JSON. Remember: never include any names, company, contact or address from the drawing.` }];
    const imgs: any[] = Array.isArray(body.images) ? body.images : [];
    if (imgs.length) {
      for (const im of imgs.slice(0, 10)) { const b = (im && (im.b64 || im.data)) || im; const m = (im && im.mime) || 'image/jpeg'; if (b && typeof b === 'string') content.push({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: dataUrl(b, String(m)) } }); }
    } else if (body.file_b64) {
      const mime = String(body.mime || 'application/octet-stream');
      if (/^image\//.test(mime)) content.push({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: dataUrl(String(body.file_b64), mime) } });
      else content.push({ type: 'file', file: { filename: String(body.filename||'drawing.pdf'), file_data: dataUrl(String(body.file_b64), mime||'application/pdf') } });
    } else { return J({ error: 'no file' }, 400); }
    if (content.length < 2) return J({ error: 'no readable image' }, 400);

    let rawContent = '';
    let ai: any = {};
    try {
      const payload = { models: FALLBACK_MODELS, max_tokens: 8000, temperature: 0.1, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: SYS }, { role: 'user', content }] };
      const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${key}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'HTTP-Referer': 'https://quotesdone.com', 'X-Title': 'QuotesDone' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
      const jd = await r.json();
      if (!r.ok) return J({ error: 'ai_error', detail: jd?.error?.message || '', meta: JSON.stringify(jd?.error?.metadata||jd).slice(0,600) }, 502);
      rawContent = jd?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '';
      if (body.__debug) return J({ ok: true, _len: String(rawContent).length, finish: jd?.choices?.[0]?.finish_reason });
      ai = parseJson(rawContent || '{}');
    } catch (e) { return J({ error: 'ai_exception', detail: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 502); }

    if (!Array.isArray(ai.boq)) ai.boq = [];
    ai.boq = ai.boq.slice(0, 120).map((li: any) => ({ section: scrub(li?.section||'General'), description: scrub(li?.description||''), qty: (li?.qty===null||li?.qty==='')?null:(Number(li?.qty)||null), unit: scrub(li?.unit||''), basis: scrub(li?.basis||''), confidence: ['low','medium','high'].includes(li?.confidence)?li.confidence:'low' }));
    ai.keywords = Array.isArray(ai.keywords) ? ai.keywords.map((s:any)=>scrub(s)).slice(0,12) : [];
    ai.assumptions = Array.isArray(ai.assumptions) ? ai.assumptions.map((s:any)=>scrub(s)).slice(0,20) : [];
    ai.missing_info = Array.isArray(ai.missing_info) ? ai.missing_info.map((s:any)=>scrub(s)).slice(0,20) : [];
    ai.total_area_sqm = (ai.total_area_sqm===null||ai.total_area_sqm==='')?null:(Number(ai.total_area_sqm)||null);
    ai.drawing_type = scrub(ai.drawing_type||'');
    ai.category = String(ai.category||'');
    ai.summary = scrub(ai.summary||'');
    ai.scale_detected = scrub(ai.scale_detected||'');
    if (!['low','medium','high'].includes(ai.confidence)) ai.confidence = 'low';
    return J({ ok: true, boq: ai });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```
