### supabase/functions/drawing_redact/index.ts

```typescript
// drawing_redact - blacks out client/consultant/contractor/project identifiers (title block, logos, address,
// contacts, drawing/project numbers) on drawing pages so a REDACTED copy can be shared with suppliers.
// Fail-closed: any page we cannot confidently clean is skipped (not shared). Internal-only: __secret auth.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { Image } from 'https://deno.land/x/imagescript@1.2.17/mod.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
const FALLBACK_MODELS = ['anthropic/claude-sonnet-5','anthropic/claude-opus-4.8'];
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
function parseJson(t:string){ try{return JSON.parse(t);}catch{ const m=t.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if(m){try{return JSON.parse(m[0]);}catch{}} return null; } }
function stripB64(s:string){ return String(s).replace(/^data:[^;]+;base64,/,''); }
function b64ToBytes(b64:string){ const bin=atob(stripB64(b64)); const a=new Uint8Array(bin.length); for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)a[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i); return a; }
const MAXW = 1600;
const MARGIN = 0.03;

const SYS = `You are a privacy redaction assistant for construction / architectural / MEP drawings that will be shared with COMPETING suppliers. For EACH page image, find EVERY area containing information that could identify the client, the project, or the firms involved — so a supplier cannot identify or contact them.\nCover: the title block (usually a vertical strip on the right edge or a horizontal strip along the bottom), and any consultant / architect / engineer / contractor / developer / owner / client names, company logos, stamps, signatures, addresses, plot / parcel / makani numbers, project name or number, drawing number or reference, phone numbers, emails and websites — wherever they appear (including next to the legend).\nDo NOT cover the technical drawing, dimensions, room/space names, grid bubbles, north arrow, or the legend's symbol explanations themselves — only the identifying text/logos.\nBe GENEROUS: if unsure whether a block is identifying, INCLUDE it. It is far better to over-cover than to leak.\nReturn STRICT JSON ONLY: {\"pages\":[{\"i\":0,\"has_identity\":true,\"regions\":[{\"x\":0.80,\"y\":0.0,\"w\":0.20,\"h\":1.0}]}]} — x,y,w,h are fractions 0..1 of the page (x,y = top-left corner of the box). One object per page, in the SAME order as the images. If a page truly has no identifying info, set has_identity=false and regions=[].`;

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key'); if (!key) return J({ error: 'no_ai_key' }, 500);
    // ANONYMITY 27 Jul 2026. These objects are handed to matched suppliers as SIGNED URLs before any
    // reveal or payment, and a signed URL necessarily contains the object path. The path is therefore
    // untrusted output: anything a caller puts in it is readable by every supplier who is matched.
    // Callers used to supply the whole prefix and both of them embedded an identifier plus a clock —
    // customer_api sent `redacted/<customers.id>/<Date.now()>` and attach_photos sends
    // `refphoto/<user.id>/<Date.now()>` — so a supplier could correlate the same buyer across every
    // RFQ they ever post, which is exactly the identity QuotesDone charges a reveal fee to disclose.
    // The caller's prefix now selects ONLY the namespace (its first path segment, e.g. 'redacted' or
    // 'refphoto'); the identifying remainder is discarded and replaced here with an opaque random
    // UUID that is not derivable from the customer, the inquiry or the time. This is deliberately
    // enforced at the single point where the stored path is built, so no caller — present or future —
    // can reintroduce the leak. Retrieval is unaffected: the paths returned below are stored verbatim
    // in inquiries.drawing_redacted_paths, which remains the only source of truth for reading,
    // signing and deleting these objects. Nothing anywhere reconstructs or prefix-lists this path.
    const ns = (String(body.prefix || 'redacted').split('/')[0] || 'redacted').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9._-]/g, '_');
    const prefix = `${ns}/${crypto.randomUUID()}/page`;
    const imgs: any[] = Array.isArray(body.images) ? body.images.slice(0, 8) : [];
    if (!imgs.length) return J({ ok: true, paths: [], pages_in: 0, pages_out: 0 });

    const content: any[] = [{ type: 'text', text: 'Find identifying regions to black out on each of the following ' + imgs.length + ' drawing page(s). Return the JSON.' }];
    for (const im of imgs) { const b = (im && (im.b64 || im.data)) || im; const m = (im && im.mime) || 'image/jpeg'; if (b && typeof b === 'string') content.push({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: 'data:' + m + ';base64,' + stripB64(b) } }); }
    const regionsByPage: Record<number, {x:number;y:number;w:number;h:number}[]> = {};
    const identityByPage: Record<number, boolean> = {};
    try {
      const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + key, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ models: FALLBACK_MODELS, max_tokens: 2000, temperature: 0, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: SYS }, { role: 'user', content }] }) });
      const jd = await r.json();
      const parsed = parseJson(jd?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '');
      if (!parsed || !Array.isArray(parsed.pages)) return J({ ok: false, error: 'detect_failed' }, 200);
      for (const p of parsed.pages) { const i = Number(p?.i); if (!Number.isFinite(i)) continue; identityByPage[i] = p?.has_identity !== false; regionsByPage[i] = Array.isArray(p?.regions) ? p.regions.map((g:any)=>({x:Number(g.x)||0,y:Number(g.y)||0,w:Number(g.w)||0,h:Number(g.h)||0})).filter((g:any)=>g.w>0&&g.h>0) : []; }
    } catch (_e) { return J({ ok: false, error: 'detect_exception' }, 200); }

    const paths: string[] = []; let skipped = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < imgs.length; i++) {
      try {
        const regions = regionsByPage[i] || [];
        const hasId = identityByPage[i] !== false;
        if (hasId && regions.length === 0) { skipped++; continue; }
        const b = (imgs[i] && (imgs[i].b64 || imgs[i].data)) || imgs[i];
        let img = await Image.decode(b64ToBytes(String(b)));
        if (img.width > MAXW) img = img.resize(MAXW, Image.RESIZE_AUTO);
        const W = img.width, H = img.height;
        for (const g of regions) {
          let x = Math.floor((g.x - MARGIN) * W), y = Math.floor((g.y - MARGIN) * H);
          let w = Math.ceil((g.w + 2 * MARGIN) * W), h = Math.ceil((g.h + 2 * MARGIN) * H);
          x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, W - 1)); y = Math.max(0, Math.min(y, H - 1));
          w = Math.max(1, Math.min(w, W - x)); h = Math.max(1, Math.min(h, H - y));
          const box = new Image(w, h).fill(0x000000ff);
          img.composite(box, x, y);
        }
        const jpg = await img.encodeJPEG(82);
        const path = `${prefix}_p${i}.jpg`;
        const up = await admin.storage.from('drawing-files').upload(path, jpg, { contentType: 'image/jpeg', upsert: true });
        if (up.error) { skipped++; continue; }
        paths.push(path);
      } catch (_e) { skipped++; continue; }
    }
    return J({ ok: true, paths, pages_in: imgs.length, pages_out: paths.length, skipped });
  } catch (e) { return J({ ok: false, error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 200); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/dropbox_backup/index.ts

```typescript
// dropbox_backup v4 — organized Dropbox backup tree under '/QuotesDone Backup'. 'storage' rows are downloaded from
// Supabase Storage; 'generated' rows are rendered to branded PDF via make_pdf first (customer/supplier details,
// inquiry summary, quote comparison). Read-only on our storage; only uploads to Dropbox. Exception: op:pdpl_erase deletes the
// files queued in pdpl_erase_files for an approved PDPL erasure request (Dropbox delete_v2 + storage remove). inbound_secret gated.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'dropbox_backup', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
}
async function logThrottled(signal: string, minutes: number, status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    const since = new Date(Date.now() - minutes * 60000).toISOString();
    const { data } = await admin.from('agent_runs').select('id').eq('agent', 'dropbox_backup')
      .gte('started_at', since).eq('counts->>signal', signal).limit(1);
    if (data && data.length) return;
  } catch (_e) { /* if the check fails, fall through and log */ }
  await logRun(status, { ...counts, signal }, note);
}
const BASE = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')! + '/functions/v1';
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is

const esc = (s: unknown) => String(s ?? '—').replace(/[&<>]/g, (c)=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;'} as any)[c]);
const fmtD = (s: unknown) => { if(!s) return '—'; try { return new Date(String(s)).toISOString().slice(0,10); } catch { return String(s); } };

async function accessToken(): Promise<string|null> {
  const rt = await sec('dropbox_refresh_token'); const ak = await sec('dropbox_app_key'); const as = await sec('dropbox_app_secret');
  if (!rt || !ak || !as) return null;
  const body = new URLSearchParams({ grant_type:'refresh_token', refresh_token:rt, client_id:ak, client_secret:as });
  const r = await fetch('https://api.dropboxapi.com/oauth2/token', { method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'}, body });
  const j = await r.json(); return j?.access_token || null;
}
function arg(o: unknown){ return JSON.stringify(o).replace(/[-￿]/g, (c)=> '\\u'+c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).padStart(4,'0')); }
async function uploadSingle(token: string, dest: string, bytes: ArrayBuffer){
  const r = await fetch('https://content.dropboxapi.com/2/files/upload', { method:'POST', headers:{ 'Authorization':'Bearer '+token, 'Content-Type':'application/octet-stream', 'Dropbox-API-Arg': arg({ path:dest, mode:'overwrite', autorename:false, mute:true, strict_conflict:false }) }, body: bytes });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error('dbx_upload '+r.status+' '+(await r.text()).slice(0,200));

async function uploadSession(token: string, dest: string, signedUrl: string, size: number){
  let r = await fetch('https://content.dropboxapi.com/2/files/upload_session/start', { method:'POST', headers:{ 'Authorization':'Bearer '+token, 'Content-Type':'application/octet-stream', 'Dropbox-API-Arg': arg({ close:false }) }, body:new Uint8Array(0) });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error('session_start '+r.status);
  const sid = (await r.json()).session_id as string; let off = 0;
  while (off < size){ const end = Math.min(off+CHUNK, size)-1; const g = await fetch(signedUrl, { headers:{ 'Range':`bytes=${off}-${end}` } }); if(!(g.status===206||g.status===200)) throw new Error('range_get '+g.status); const buf = await g.arrayBuffer(); if(buf.byteLength===0) throw new Error('empty_chunk'); r = await fetch('https://content.dropboxapi.com/2/files/upload_session/append_v2', { method:'POST', headers:{ 'Authorization':'Bearer '+token, 'Content-Type':'application/octet-stream', 'Dropbox-API-Arg': arg({ cursor:{ session_id:sid, offset:off }, close:false }) }, body:buf }); if(!r.ok) throw new Error('append '+r.status); off += buf.byteLength; }
  r = await fetch('https://content.dropboxapi.com/2/files/upload_session/finish', { method:'POST', headers:{ 'Authorization':'Bearer '+token, 'Content-Type':'application/octet-stream', 'Dropbox-API-Arg': arg({ cursor:{ session_id:sid, offset:size }, commit:{ path:dest, mode:'overwrite', autorename:false, mute:true } }) }, body:new Uint8Array(0) });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error('finish '+r.status);
}
function kvTable(rows: [string, unknown][]){ return '<table style="border-collapse:collapse;width:100%">' + rows.map(([k,v])=>`<tr><td style="padding:4px 10px 4px 0;color:#555;white-space:nowrap;vertical-align:top">${esc(k)}</td><td style="padding:4px 0"><b>${esc(v)}</b></td></tr>`).join('') + '</table>'; }

' + String((_e as Error)?.message||_e).slice(0,160)); }
    title = 'Quote Comparison — Inquiry ' + inqId.slice(0,8);

Deno.serve(async (req) => {

      await uploadSingle(token, dest, new TextEncoder().encode('quotesdone dropbox backup selftest').buffer as ArrayBuffer);
      const del = await fetch('https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/files/delete_v2', { method:'POST', headers:{ 'Authorization':'Bearer '+token, 'Content-Type':'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ path: dest }) });
      return J({ ok:true, uploaded:dest, deleted_probe: del.ok });
    }

    if (body.op === 'pdpl_erase'){
      const reqId = String(body.request_id||'');
      if (!reqId) return J({ ok:false, error:'request_id required' }, 400);
      const token = await accessToken();
      const { data: files } = await admin.from('pdpl_erase_files').select('*').eq('request_id', reqId).eq('status','pending').order('id',{ ascending:true }).limit(Math.min(Number(body.limit)||200, 500));
      let dbx=0, stg=0, failed=0; const results:any[]=[];
      for (const f of (files||[])){
        let ok=true, err='';
        if (f.dropbox_path){
          if (!token){ ok=false; err='no_dropbox_auth'; }
          else { const dr = await fetch('https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/files/delete_v2', { method:'POST', headers:{ 'Authorization':'Bearer '+token, 'Content-Type':'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ path: f.dropbox_path }) });
            if (dr.ok) dbx++; else { const t = await dr.text(); if (t.includes('not_found')||t.includes('path_lookup')) dbx++; else { ok=false; err='dbx:'+dr.status; } } }
        }
        if (f.bucket && f.storage_path){ const { error: se } = await admin.storage.from(f.bucket).remove([f.storage_path]); if (se){ ok=false; err=(err?err+';':'')+'stg:'+se.message; } else stg++; }
        await admin.from('pdpl_erase_files').update({ status: ok?'erased':'error', error: ok?null:err.slice(0,300), erased_at: ok? new Date().toISOString(): null }).eq('id', f.id);
        if (!ok) failed++;
        results.push({ id:f.id, ok, err: ok?undefined:err });
      }
      try { await admin.from('security_events').insert({ kind:'pdpl_file_erasure', severity:'high', source:'dropbox_backup', subject: reqId, detail:{ request_id:reqId, dropbox_deleted:dbx, storage_deleted:stg, failed, processed:(files||[]).length } }); } catch(_e){ /* audit best-effort */ }
      await logRun(failed>0?'error':'ok', { pdpl_erase:reqId, dbx, stg, failed }, failed>0 ? ('PDPL file erasure for request '+reqId+' left '+failed+' file(s) undeleted; personal documents may remain in Dropbox/storage — inspect pdpl_erase_files.') : ('PDPL file erasure for request '+reqId+': '+dbx+' Dropbox + '+stg+' storage object(s) removed.'));
      return J({ ok: failed===0, request_id:reqId, processed:(files||[]).length, dropbox_deleted:dbx, storage_deleted:stg, failed, results });
    }

    const limit = Math.min(Number(body.limit)||8, 25);
    let enqueued = 0;
    if (body.mode !== 'process_only') { const { data, error: enqErr } = await admin.rpc('fn_enqueue_doc_backups'); enqueued = Number(data)||0; if (enqErr) { await logThrottled('enqueue_failed', 60, 'error', { stage:'enqueue' }, 'fn_enqueue_doc_backups failed, so no new documents are being queued for Dropbox backup; newly uploaded documents will never reach Dropbox until this is fixed. ' + String(enqErr?.message||enqErr).slice(0,160)); } }
    const token = await accessToken();
    if (!token) { await logThrottled('no_dropbox_auth', 60, 'error', { stage:'token', enqueued }, 'Dropbox backup could not obtain an access token (refresh token expired/revoked or app key/secret missing). No documents are being backed up to Dropbox and the backup set is going stale from this point onward.'); return J({ ok:false, error:'no_dropbox_auth', enqueued }); }

    const { data: rows } = await admin.from('doc_backups').select('*').in('status',['pending','error']).lt('attempts',5).order('id',{ ascending:true }).limit(limit);
    let done=0, failed=0, skipped=0; const results:any[]=[];
    const errNotes:string[] = [];
    for (const row of (rows||[])){
      try {
        let bucket = row.bucket, path = row.path;
        if (row.source === 'generated' && !path){ const g = await renderGenerated(row); bucket = g.bucket; path = g.path; await admin.from('doc_backups').update({ bucket, path }).eq('id', row.id); }
        if (!bucket || !path) throw new Error('no_source');
        const { data: blob, error: derr } = await admin.storage.from(bucket).download(path);
        if (derr || !blob) throw new Error('download '+(derr?.message||'missing'));
        const size = (blob as Blob).size;
        if (size > HARD_MAX){ await admin.from('doc_backups').update({ status:'skipped_large', bytes:size, error:'>1GB', attempts:row.attempts+1 }).eq('id',row.id); skipped++; results.push({ id:row.id, skipped_large:size }); continue; }
        if (size <= SINGLE_MAX){ await uploadSingle(token, row.dropbox_path, await (blob as Blob).arrayBuffer()); }
        else { const { data: su } = await admin.storage.from(bucket).createSignedUrl(path, 900); if(!su?.signedUrl) throw new Error('sign_failed'); await uploadSession(token, row.dropbox_path, su.signedUrl, size); }
        const { error: markErr } = await admin.from('doc_backups').update({ status:'done', bytes:size, backed_up_at:new Date().toISOString(), error:null, attempts:row.attempts+1 }).eq('id',row.id);
        if (markErr) { await logRun('error', { stage:'mark_done', doc_backup_id: row.id }, 'Document ' + row.id + ' was uploaded to Dropbox but could not be marked done, so it will be re-uploaded on every future run and the backup queue will never drain. ' + String(markErr?.message||markErr).slice(0,160)); }
        done++; results.push({ id:row.id, done:size, dest:row.dropbox_path });
      } catch (e){
        await admin.from('doc_backups').update({ status:'error', error:String((e as Error)?.message||e).slice(0,300), attempts:row.attempts+1 }).eq('id',row.id);
        failed++; results.push({ id:row.id, error:String((e as Error)?.message||e).slice(0,160) });
        if (errNotes.length < 3) errNotes.push('#'+row.id+': '+String((e as Error)?.message||e).slice(0,120));
      }
    }
    const processed = (rows||[]).length;
    if (processed > 0 || enqueued > 0 || failed > 0 || skipped > 0) {
      const counts = { enqueued, processed, done, failed, skipped };
      if (failed > 0 || skipped > 0) {
        await logRun('error', counts, 'Dropbox backup finished with ' + failed + ' failed and ' + skipped + ' oversized-skipped document(s) out of ' + processed + '; those documents are NOT in Dropbox and will be missing if the backup is ever needed. ' + errNotes.join(' | '));
      } else {
        await logRun('ok', counts, 'Dropbox backup uploaded ' + done + ' document(s); queue drained cleanly.');
      }
    }
    return J({ ok:true, enqueued, processed:(rows||[]).length, done, failed, skipped, results });
  } catch (e){ await logRun('error', { stage:'fatal' }, 'dropbox_backup crashed before completing; the Dropbox backup run did not finish and documents from this window are not backed up. ' + String((e as Error)?.message||e).slice(0,200)); return J({ error:String((e as Error)?.message||e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
// dropbox_oauth — self-service connect page + diagnostics for the QuotesDone Dropbox.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const BASE = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')! + '/functions/v1';
const H = (html: string, s = 200) => new Response(html, { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } });
const JS = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o, null, 2), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
const esc = (s: string) => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' } as any)[c]);
const SHELL = (inner: string) => `<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Connect QuotesDone Dropbox</title><body style="font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;max-width:560px;margin:44px auto;padding:0 20px;color:#16181d;line-height:1.5"><div style="height:6px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0c2330,#14b8a6);border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:22px"></div>${inner}</body>`;

async function dbxAccessToken(): Promise<string> {
  const rt = await sec('dropbox_refresh_token'); const key = await sec('dropbox_app_key'); const secret = await sec('dropbox_app_secret');
  const p = new URLSearchParams({ grant_type: 'refresh_token', refresh_token: rt, client_id: key, client_secret: secret });
  const r = await fetch('https://api.dropboxapi.com/oauth2/token', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: p });
  const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); return j.access_token || '';
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const url = new URL(req.url);
    const gate = await sec('dropbox_oauth_key');
    const appKey = await sec('dropbox_app_key');
    const appSecret = await sec('dropbox_app_secret');
    if (!gate) return H(SHELL('<h3>Setup not initialised.</h3>'), 403);

    // ---- diagnostics: which account + scope does the STORED token see? ----
    if (req.method === 'GET' && url.searchParams.get('diag') === gate) {
      const at = await dbxAccessToken();
      if (!at) return JS({ error: 'could_not_refresh_stored_token' }, 400);
      let account: any = {}; try { const r = await fetch('https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/users/get_current_account', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + at } }); account = await r.json(); } catch (e) { account = { error: String(e) }; }
      let root: string[] = []; let rootErr: any = null;
      try { const r = await fetch('https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/files/list_folder', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + at, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ path: '', recursive: false, limit: 200 }) }); const j = await r.json(); if (j.entries) root = j.entries.map((e: any) => (e['.tag'] === 'folder' ? '[dir] ' : '') + e.name); else rootErr = j; } catch (e) { rootErr = String(e); }
      let qdBackup: any = 'not_checked';
      try { const r = await fetch('https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/files/get_metadata', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + at, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ path: '/QuotesDone Backup' }) }); const j = await r.json(); qdBackup = j.error ? ('NOT VISIBLE: ' + (j.error_summary || JSON.stringify(j.error))) : ('VISIBLE: ' + j.path_display); } catch (e) { qdBackup = String(e); }
      return JS({ token_account: { account_id: account.account_id, email: account.email, name: account?.name?.display_name, root_info: account.root_info }, root_folders: root, root_error: rootErr, quotesdone_backup: qdBackup });
    }

    if (req.method === 'GET') {
      const k = url.searchParams.get('k') || '';
      if (k !== gate) return H(SHELL('<h2>Not authorized</h2><p>This connect link is invalid or expired.</p>'), 403);
      const authUrl = `https://www.dropbox.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=${encodeURIComponent(appKey)}&response_type=code&token_access_type=offline&force_reapprove=true`;
      return H(SHELL(`
        <h2>Connect the QuotesDone Dropbox</h2>
        <p>This links the platform (daily document sync + backups) to your Dropbox account.</p>
        <ol style="line-height:2">
          <li><a href="${authUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="display:inline-block;padding:11px 20px;background:#0c2330;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;border-radius:8px">Authorize on Dropbox ↗</a></li>
          <li>Approve access. Dropbox will show you a short <b>access code</b> — copy it.</li>
          <li>Paste that code below and press <b>Connect</b>.</li>
        </ol>
        <form method="POST" style="margin-top:18px">
          <input type="hidden" name="k" value="${esc(k)}">
          <input name="code" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Paste the Dropbox access code" style="width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:13px;font-size:15px;border:1px solid #cbd2da;border-radius:8px">
          <button type="submit" style="margin-top:12px;padding:12px 24px;background:#14b8a6;color:#04241f;font-weight:700;border:0;border-radius:8px;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer">Connect</button>
        </form>`));
    }

    if (req.method === 'POST') {
      const form = await req.formData();
      const k = String(form.get('k') || '');
      const code = String(form.get('code') || '').trim();
      if (k !== gate) return H(SHELL('<h2>Not authorized</h2>'), 403);
      if (!code) return H(SHELL('<h2>No code provided</h2><p><a href="?k=' + esc(k) + '">Go back</a></p>'), 400);
      const params = new URLSearchParams({ code, grant_type: 'authorization_code', client_id: appKey, client_secret: appSecret });
      const tr = await fetch('https://api.dropboxapi.com/oauth2/token', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: params });
      const tj = await tr.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!tj.refresh_token) return H(SHELL('<h2>Could not connect</h2><p>The code may have expired — <a href="?k=' + esc(k) + '">start again</a>.</p><pre style="white-space:pre-wrap;color:#a00;font-size:12px">' + esc(JSON.stringify(tj)) + '</pre>'), 400);
      let email = ''; let name = '';
      try { const ar = await fetch('https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/users/get_current_account', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + tj.access_token } }); const aj = await ar.json(); email = aj?.email || ''; name = aj?.name?.display_name || ''; } catch (_e) { /* ignore */ }
      await admin.from('app_secrets').update({ value: tj.refresh_token }).eq('key', 'dropbox_refresh_token');
      let sync = 'started'; let cron = 'unknown';
      try { await fetch(`${BASE}/dropbox_sync`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: await sec('inbound_secret') }) }); } catch (_e) { sync = 'queued'; }
      try { const { data } = await admin.rpc('fn_enable_dropbox_sync'); cron = String(data || 'unknown'); } catch (_e) { /* ignore */ }
      return H(SHELL(`<h2>✓ Dropbox connected</h2><p>Linked to <b>${esc(name || email || 'the authorized account')}</b>${email ? ' (' + esc(email) + ')' : ''}.</p><p>Sync ${sync}; daily sync <b>${esc(cron === 'enabled' ? 'on' : cron)}</b>.</p>`));
    }
    return H(SHELL('<h3>Unsupported</h3>'), 405);
  } catch (e) { return H(SHELL('<h2>Error</h2><pre style="white-space:pre-wrap">' + String((e as Error)?.message || e) + '</pre>'), 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/dropbox_sync/index.ts

```typescript
// dropbox_sync v3 - the Document Controller's server-side Dropbox integration. Uses the platform's stored Dropbox
// refresh token to index specific QuotesDone folders into public.dropbox_files. Read/index only — never deletes
// anything in Dropbox. Scoped to the QuotesDone folders (dropbox_roots secret) so the huge jewelry/media tree on the
// same account is ignored and the sync always completes. On a complete sync it prunes local index rows that no longer
// exist so the catalog matches Dropbox.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'dropbox_sync', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
}
async function logThrottled(signal: string, minutes: number, status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    const since = new Date(Date.now() - minutes * 60000).toISOString();
    const { data } = await admin.from('agent_runs').select('id').eq('agent', 'dropbox_sync')
      .gte('started_at', since).eq('counts->>signal', signal).limit(1);
    if (data && data.length) return;
  } catch (_e) { /* if the check fails, fall through and log */ }
  await logRun(status, { ...counts, signal }, note);
}
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
async function accessToken(): Promise<string|null> {
  const rt = await sec('dropbox_refresh_token'); const ak = await sec('dropbox_app_key'); const as = await sec('dropbox_app_secret');
  if (!rt || !ak || !as) return null;
  const body = new URLSearchParams({ grant_type: 'refresh_token', refresh_token: rt, client_id: ak, client_secret: as });
  const r = await fetch('https://api.dropboxapi.com/oauth2/token', { method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'}, body });
  const j = await r.json(); return j?.access_token || null;
}
async function listRoot(token: string, path: string){
  const entries: any[] = []; let complete = true; let truncated = false;
  let r = await fetch('https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/files/list_folder', { method:'POST', headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({ path, recursive: true, limit: 2000 }) });
  let j = await r.json();
  if (j?.error) { // a missing folder is not fatal for the whole sync
    return { entries, complete: false, error: j.error_summary || j.error };
  }
  entries.push(...(j.entries||[]));
  let guard = 0;
  while (j.has_more) { if (guard++ >= 200) { truncated = true; break; }
    r = await fetch('https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/files/list_folder/continue', { method:'POST', headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({ cursor: j.cursor }) });
    j = await r.json(); if (j?.error) { complete=false; break; } entries.push(...(j.entries||[]));
  }
  if (truncated) complete = false;
  return { entries, complete, truncated };
}
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) { await logThrottled('forbidden', 60, 'error', { stage:'auth' }, 'dropbox_sync rejected a caller presenting a bad or missing inbound secret. If this is the scheduled caller, the Dropbox document catalog is no longer being refreshed at all.'); return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403); }
    const runStart = new Date().toISOString();
    const token = await accessToken();
    if (!token) { await logThrottled('no_dropbox_auth', 60, 'error', { stage:'token' }, 'dropbox_sync could not obtain a Dropbox access token (refresh token expired/revoked or app key/secret missing). The dropbox_files catalog is frozen and the Document Controller is showing stale contents until the OAuth credentials are restored.'); return J({ ok:false, error:'no_dropbox_auth' }); }
    let roots: string[] = [];
    if (Array.isArray(body.paths)) roots = body.paths.map((p:any)=>String(p));
    else { try { roots = JSON.parse((await sec('dropbox_roots')) || '[]'); } catch { roots = []; await logThrottled('bad_dropbox_roots', 60, 'error', { stage:'config' }, 'The dropbox_roots secret is not valid JSON, so dropbox_sync silently fell back to the built-in default folder list; any custom backup folders configured there are not being indexed.'); } }
    if (!roots.length) roots = ['/QuotesDone Backup', '/quotes done'];

    let files=0, folders=0, up=0; let complete = true; const perRoot: any[] = [];
    let upsertFailed = 0; const rootErrors: string[] = []; let truncatedRoots = 0;
    for (const root of roots) {
      const res = await listRoot(token, root);
      if (!res.complete) complete = false;
      if ((res as any).error) rootErrors.push(root + ': ' + String((res as any).error).slice(0,120));
      if ((res as any).truncated) truncatedRoots++;
      perRoot.push({ root, entries: res.entries.length, complete: res.complete, error: (res as any).error||null });
      for (const e of res.entries) {
        const isFolder = e['.tag']==='folder';
        if (isFolder) folders++; else files++;
        const rec = { dropbox_id: e.id || e.path_lower, path: e.path_display || e.path_lower, name: e.name, is_folder: isFolder,
          size: isFolder ? 0 : (Number(e.size)||0), content_hash: e.content_hash || null,
          server_modified: e.server_modified || null, synced_at: new Date().toISOString() };
        const { error } = await admin.from('dropbox_files').upsert(rec, { onConflict: 'dropbox_id' });
        if (!error) up++; else upsertFailed++;
      }
    }
    // prune stale rows only on a fully complete sync of all roots
    let pruned = 0;
    if (complete) { const { count, error: pruneErr } = await admin.from('dropbox_files').delete({ count:'exact' }).lt('synced_at', runStart); pruned = count || 0; if (pruneErr) { await logRun('error', { stage:'prune', files, folders }, 'dropbox_sync could not prune stale rows from dropbox_files; the Document Controller will keep listing documents that no longer exist in Dropbox. ' + String(pruneErr?.message||pruneErr).slice(0,160)); } }

    const seen = files + folders;
    const counts = { roots: roots.length, files, folders, upserted: up, upsert_failed: upsertFailed, pruned, complete, root_errors: rootErrors.length, truncated_roots: truncatedRoots };
    if (seen > 0 || rootErrors.length > 0 || upsertFailed > 0) {
      if (rootErrors.length > 0) {
        await logThrottled('root_error', 60, 'error', counts, 'dropbox_sync could not list ' + rootErrors.length + ' configured Dropbox root(s), so those folders are missing from the document catalog and pruning was skipped (stale rows remain). ' + rootErrors.slice(0,3).join(' | '));
      } else if (upsertFailed > 0) {
        await logRun('error', counts, 'dropbox_sync failed to index ' + upsertFailed + ' of ' + seen + ' Dropbox entries; those documents exist in Dropbox but are invisible in the Document Controller.');
      } else if (truncatedRoots > 0) {
        await logThrottled('truncated', 60, 'error', counts, 'dropbox_sync hit the 200-page listing guard on ' + truncatedRoots + ' root(s), so the sync was incomplete, the catalog is only partially refreshed and stale-row pruning was skipped.');
      } else if (seen === 0) {
        await logThrottled('empty_result', 60, 'error', counts, 'dropbox_sync completed but found zero files or folders under the configured roots; the document catalog has just been pruned to empty, which usually means the roots are misconfigured or the Dropbox folders were moved.');
      } else {
        await logRun('ok', counts, 'dropbox_sync indexed ' + files + ' file(s) and ' + folders + ' folder(s), pruned ' + pruned + ' stale row(s).');
      }
    }
    return J({ ok:true, roots, per_root: perRoot, files, folders, upserted: up, pruned, complete });
  } catch (e) { await logRun('error', { stage:'fatal' }, 'dropbox_sync crashed before completing; the Dropbox document catalog was not refreshed on this run and may be stale or partially pruned. ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0,200)); return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/ea_meeting_summary/index.ts

````typescript
// ea_meeting_summary - the Executive Assistant's meeting note-taker. Turns a transcript/notes into a structured
// summary + decisions + action items, stores it in ea_meetings, and creates tracked tasks (crm_tasks) for the
// action items. Internal use; drafts/records only — never sends anything externally.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);

const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
````

### supabase/functions/email_cron/index.ts

```typescript
// email_cron - run on a schedule: auto-detect Resend domain verification, enable sending, flush the outbox.
// v2: agent_runs instrumentation. This is the parent of send_outbox and only calls it when email_enabled is
//     true, so a disabled mail system could never be reported by send_outbox itself - nothing would invoke it.
//     That gap is closed here. Also surfaces Resend domain-verification failures, which were swallowed by a
//     bare catch. Runs every 2 minutes, so recurring states are throttled to one row per hour and healthy
//     idle runs are not logged at all.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const SUPA = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;

// Observability -------------------------------------------------------------
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'email_cron', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging block the mail pipeline */ }
}
async function logThrottled(signal: string, minutes: number, status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    const since = new Date(Date.now() - minutes * 60000).toISOString();
    const { data } = await admin.from('agent_runs').select('id').eq('agent', 'email_cron')
      .gte('started_at', since).eq('counts->>signal', signal).limit(1);
    if (data && data.length) return;
  } catch (_e) { /* if the check fails, fall through and log */ }
  await logRun(status, { ...counts, signal }, note);
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({}));
    const secret = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(secret) || body.__secret !== secret) { await logThrottled('forbidden', 60, 'error', {}, 'email_cron called without the inbound secret'); return J({ error:'forbidden' }, 403); }
    let enabled = (await sec('email_enabled')) === 'true';
    let verified = enabled;
    let domainNote = '';
    // auto-verify: if not yet enabled, poll Resend domain status
    if (!enabled) {
      const key = await sec('resend_api_key'); const did = await sec('resend_domain_id');
      if (key && did) {
        try {
          const r = await fetch(`https://api.resend.com/domains/${did}`, { headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${key}` } });
          const d = await r.json();
          if (d?.status === 'verified') { await admin.from('app_secrets').update({ value:'true' }).eq('key','email_enabled'); enabled = true; verified = true; await logRun('ok', { signal: 'email_auto_enabled' }, 'Resend domain verified - email_enabled flipped to true automatically'); }
          else { verified = false; domainNote = 'Resend domain status is "' + String(d?.status || 'unknown') + '", not verified'; }
        } catch (e) { domainNote = 'Resend domain check failed: ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0, 200); }
      } else {
        domainNote = 'cannot auto-verify: resend_api_key or resend_domain_id missing';
      }
    }
    let flush: unknown = null;
    let flushErr = '';
    if (enabled) {
      try { const r = await fetch(`${SUPA}/functions/v1/send_outbox`, { method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: secret, limit: 50 }) }); flush = await r.json(); if (!r.ok) flushErr = 'send_outbox returned http ' + r.status; } catch (e) { flushErr = String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0, 200); flush = { error: String(e) }; }
    } else {
      // send_outbox is never invoked while disabled, so this is the only place the outage can surface.
      const { count: queued } = await admin.from('notifications').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).or('status.eq.queued,status.eq.pending,status.is.null');
      await logThrottled('email_disabled', 60, 'error', { queued: queued || 0, verified },
        'EMAIL PIPELINE IDLE - email_enabled is not true, so send_outbox is never called and ' + (queued || 0) + ' notification(s) are waiting. ' + domainNote);
    }
    if (flushErr) await logRun('error', { enabled, verified }, 'outbox flush failed: ' + flushErr);
    return J({ ok:true, enabled, verified, flush });
  } catch (e) { const m = String((e as Error)?.message||e); await logRun('error', {}, 'exception: ' + m); return J({ error: m }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/email_fix/index.ts

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const { data: sec } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key','inbound_secret').maybeSingle();
    if (!sec?.value || body.__secret !== sec.value) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const action = String(body.action || '');
    if (action === 'list') {
      const after = Number(body.after || 0);
      const { data, error } = await admin.from('leads')
        .select('id,company_name,website,domain')
        .or('email.is.null,email.eq.')
        .not('website','is',null)
        .gt('id', after)
        .order('id', { ascending: true })
        .limit(1000);
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ rows: data || [] });
    }
    if (action === 'apply') {
      const rows = Array.isArray(body.rows) ? body.rows : [];
      const src = String(body.source || 'web_crawl');
      let updated = 0;
      for (const r of rows) {
        if (!r?.id || !r?.email) continue;
        const { error } = await admin.from('leads')
          .update({ email: String(r.email).toLowerCase(), email_domain: r.domain ?? null, email_verified: !!r.mx, enrich_source: src })
          .eq('id', r.id).or('email.is.null,email.eq.');
        if (!error) updated++;
      }
      return J({ ok: true, updated });
    }
    return J({ error: 'unknown action' }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
// email_triage - reads un-triaged inbound emails, classifies + drafts a reply (LLM), surfaces to founder. Never sends.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
const llm = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 700 }); // shared OpenRouter client (Sonnet-first ladder + 25s timeout)

const SYS = `You are the inbox assistant for QuotesDone, a UAE B2B anonymous quotation marketplace (customers post a job, get matched to vetted suppliers, compare anonymised quotes, and pay a small reveal fee to unlock the supplier they choose; suppliers pay no commission). You triage an incoming email addressed to the company and draft a reply the founder can send.\nReturn STRICT JSON ONLY: {"category":"supplier_document|supplier_question|customer_question|complaint|billing|partnership|spam|other","summary":"one factual sentence","reply":"a short, warm, professional reply in plain text, signed 'The QuotesDone Team'. Do not invent facts, prices, or commitments. If a document was sent, acknowledge receipt and say records will be updated. If it needs info you don't have, ask politely. If it is spam, set reply to an empty string."}\nReply with JSON only, no preamble.`;

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const { data: run } = await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'email_triage' }).select('id').maybeSingle();
    const counts = { triaged: 0, drafted: 0, spam: 0 };
    const { data: msgs } = await admin.from('inbound_messages').select('id,from_email,subject,body')
      .eq('needs_review', true).is('triaged_at', null).is('replied_at', null).order('created_at', { ascending: true }).limit(20);
    for (const m of (msgs || [])) {
      let category = 'other', summary = '', reply = '';
      const out = await llm(SYS, 'From: ' + (m.from_email||'') + '\nSubject: ' + (m.subject||'') + '\n\n' + String(m.body||'').slice(0, 4000), 800);
      if (out) { const mm = out.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (mm) { try { const pj = JSON.parse(mm[0]); category = String(pj.category||'other').slice(0,40); summary = String(pj.summary||'').slice(0,500); reply = String(pj.reply||'').slice(0,4000); } catch (_e) {} } }
      await admin.from('inbound_messages').update({ ai_category: category, ai_summary: summary, ai_draft_reply: reply || null, triaged_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', m.id);
      counts.triaged++;
      if (category === 'spam' || !reply) { counts.spam++; }
      else {
        counts.drafted++;
        // resolve any older generic review reminder for this message
        await admin.from('agent_actions').update({ status: 'auto_done', decided_by: 'email_triage', decided_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('target_table', 'inbound_messages').eq('target_id', String(m.id)).in('status', ['pending','held_for_review','proposed','open']).eq('kind','sla_review');
        await admin.from('agent_actions').insert({ agent: 'email', kind: 'inbound_review', status: 'pending', risk: 'low', title: 'Inbox: ' + String(m.subject||'(no subject)').slice(0,70) + ' — ' + category, recommendation: 'Review the AI draft in the Inbox and send (or edit) it.', target_table: 'inbound_messages', target_id: String(m.id), detail: { from: m.from_email, category, summary, draft: reply } });
      }
    }
    if (run?.id) await admin.from('agent_runs').update({ finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'ok', counts }).eq('id', run.id);
    return J({ ok: true, counts });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/embed_leads/index.ts

```typescript
// embed_leads - populate leads.embedding_gte (vector 384) via free in-region gte-small.
// Secret-guarded. Default scope ('new'): REAL suppliers first (registered / self-registered / approved) so a
// supplier is matchable via semantic search within a day of registering, THEN the cold apify-scraped backlog.
// This closes the launch trap where a self-registered supplier (source='self_registered') was never embedded
// by the old 'new' scope (which only touched enrich_source='apify_maps_contacts') and stayed invisible to
// vector matching. scope='all' embeds everything missing embedding_gte, unprioritised.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'embed_leads', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
}
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string|undefined)||undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  let embedded = 0; let updFails = 0; const failIds: unknown[] = [];
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) { await logRun('error', { stage:'auth', rejected:1 }, 'Rejected a call with a wrong or missing __secret; no supplier embeddings were generated this run, so any suppliers still lacking embedding_gte remain unmatchable to every RFQ'); return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403); }
    const scope = body.scope === 'all' ? 'all' : 'new';
    // deno-lint-ignore no-explicit-any
    const model = new (globalThis as any).Supabase.ai.Session('gte-small');
    const t0 = Date.now(); let total = 0;
    while (Date.now() - t0 < 44000) {
      let data: any[] | null = null; let error: any = null;
      if (scope === 'all') {
        ({ data, error } = await admin.from('leads').select('id, capability_summary, company_name').is('embedding_gte', null).limit(100));
      } else {
        // PRIORITY 1: real suppliers (registered / self-registered / approved) missing an embedding.
        ({ data, error } = await admin.from('leads').select('id, capability_summary, company_name')
          .is('embedding_gte', null)
          .or('registration_submitted_at.not.is.null,source.eq.self_registered,approval_status.eq.approved')
          .limit(100));
        // PRIORITY 2: only once no real supplier is waiting, chew through the cold apify-scraped backlog.
        if (!error && (!data || data.length === 0)) {
          ({ data, error } = await admin.from('leads').select('id, capability_summary, company_name')
            .is('embedding_gte', null).eq('enrich_source', 'apify_maps_contacts').limit(100));
        }
      }
      if (error) { await logRun('error', { stage:'select', scope, embedded, update_failures: updFails }, 'Could not read the backlog of un-embedded suppliers: '+String(error.message)+'; every supplier still missing embedding_gte stays invisible to semantic matching and cannot be matched to any RFQ'); return J({ error: error.message, total }, 500); }
      if (!data || data.length === 0) { await logRun(updFails ? 'error' : 'ok', { stage:'done', scope, embedded, update_failures: updFails, failed_ids: failIds }, updFails ? (updFails+' supplier embedding writes failed (ids '+failIds.join(',')+'); those suppliers are left without embeddings, cannot be matched to any RFQ, and will be re-selected on every future run because embedding_gte stays null') : ('Backlog cleared: '+embedded+' suppliers embedded; no suppliers are left unmatchable for scope '+scope)); return J({ ok: true, done: true, total }); }
      for (const r of data as any[]) {
        const text = String(r.capability_summary || r.company_name || '').slice(0, 800);
        const emb = await model.run(text, { mean_pool: true, normalize: true }) as number[];
        const { error: updErr } = await admin.from('leads').update({ embedding_gte: '[' + emb.join(',') + ']' }).eq('id', r.id);
        if (updErr) { updFails++; if (failIds.length < 20) failIds.push(r.id); }
        total++;
        embedded++;
      }
    }
    await logRun(updFails ? 'error' : 'ok', { stage:'partial', scope, embedded, update_failures: updFails, failed_ids: failIds }, updFails ? (updFails+' of '+embedded+' supplier embedding writes failed (ids '+failIds.join(',')+'); those suppliers are left without embeddings and cannot be matched to any RFQ. Time budget also expired, so an un-embedded backlog remains') : ('Time budget expired after embedding '+embedded+' suppliers; an un-embedded backlog remains and those suppliers cannot be matched to any RFQ until a later run reaches them'));
    return J({ ok:true, partial:true, total });
  } catch (e) { await logRun('error', { stage:'embed', embedded, update_failures: updFails }, 'embed_leads aborted: '+String((e as Error)?.message || e)+'; the embedding model or a write failed mid-batch, so the remaining suppliers keep a null embedding_gte and cannot be matched to any RFQ'); return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/enrich_capability/index.ts

```typescript
// enrich_capability — synthesizes a rich, factual capability_summary for a seller from their own
// profile (categories, services, products, sector, licence trade). This is the FUEL the matching
// adjudicator (route_inquiry) reads to judge who can genuinely quote a job. Never invents scope it
// cannot infer; thin inputs -> conservative summary + low_confidence flag. Single (lead_id) or batch.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const _llm = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 700, temperature: 0 });
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'enrich_capability', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
}
const LLM_STATE = { keyMissing: false, failures: [] as string[] };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
function parseJson(s: string){ try { const m=String(s||'').match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); return m?JSON.parse(m[0]):null; } catch { return null; } }

async function llm(sys: string, user: string, max = 700): Promise<string> {
  const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key'); if (!key) { LLM_STATE.keyMissing = true; return ''; }
  return (await _llm(sys, user, max)) || '';
}

const SYS = `You write a concise, FACTUAL capability profile for a UAE B2B supplier/contractor, used by an AI to decide which customer jobs this supplier can genuinely quote. Base it ONLY on the supplier's own profile data given. Do NOT invent trades, brands, certifications or scale that are not supported by the input. If the input is thin, write a short conservative summary and set low_confidence true. Capture: the exact products/materials they supply and/or services they perform, the trades they cover, typical project types/sectors, and any clear specialisation. 60-140 words, plain declarative sentences (no marketing fluff, no first person). Output ONLY minified JSON: {"capability_summary": string, "low_confidence": boolean}.`;

async function enrichOne(lead: any): Promise<{ id: number; ok: boolean; low?: boolean; reason?: string }> {
  const profile = [
    lead.company_name && ('Company: '+lead.company_name),
    lead.sector && ('Sector: '+lead.sector),
    lead.categories && ('Categories: '+lead.categories),
    lead.services && ('Services: '+lead.services),
    lead.products && ('Products: '+lead.products),
    lead.capability_summary && ('Existing notes: '+lead.capability_summary)
  ].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
  if (!profile.trim()) return { id: lead.id, ok: false, reason: 'no_profile_data' };
  const out = parseJson(await llm(SYS, profile, 700));
  const summary = out?.capability_summary ? String(out.capability_summary).slice(0, 1200) : '';
  if (!summary) return { id: lead.id, ok: false, reason: LLM_STATE.keyMissing ? 'llm_key_missing' : 'llm_no_summary' };
  const { error } = await admin.from('leads').update({ capability_summary: summary, capability_enriched_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', lead.id);
  return { id: lead.id, ok: !error, low: out?.low_confidence === true, reason: error ? ('db_update_failed:'+String(error.message)) : undefined };
}

const COLS = 'id,company_name,sector,categories,services,products,capability_summary';

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  LLM_STATE.keyMissing = false; LLM_STATE.failures.length = 0;
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) { await logRun('error', { stage:'auth', rejected:1 }, 'Rejected a call with a wrong or missing __secret; no supplier capability profiles were written, so suppliers awaiting enrichment stay without a capability_summary and the matching adjudicator cannot judge them for any RFQ'); return J({ error:'forbidden' }, 403); }

    if (body.lead_id) {
      const { data: lead, error: leadErr } = await admin.from('leads').select(COLS).eq('id', Number(body.lead_id)).maybeSingle();
      if (!lead) { await logRun('error', { stage:'single', lead_id: Number(body.lead_id), found: 0 }, 'Lead '+String(body.lead_id)+' could not be loaded for enrichment'+(leadErr ? (': '+String(leadErr.message)) : ' (not found)')+'; this supplier keeps no capability_summary and cannot be matched to any RFQ'); return J({ error:'lead_not_found' }, 404); }
      const r = await enrichOne(lead);
      await logRun(r.ok ? 'ok' : 'error', { stage:'single', lead_id: r.id, enriched: r.ok ? 1 : 0, low_confidence: r.low === true, reason: r.reason, llm_key_missing: LLM_STATE.keyMissing, llm_failures: LLM_STATE.failures }, r.ok ? ('Supplier '+r.id+' enriched'+(r.low ? ' with low_confidence (thin profile, so the adjudicator may under-match this supplier)' : '')) : ('Supplier '+r.id+' was NOT enriched ('+String(r.reason)+(LLM_STATE.failures.length ? ('; llm: '+LLM_STATE.failures.join(' | ')) : '')+'); it is left without a capability_summary and cannot be matched to any RFQ'));
      return J({ ok: true, ...r });
    }

    // batch backfill: approved, matchable, not yet enriched
    const limit = Math.min(Number(body.limit) || 10, 25);
    const { data: leads, error: batchErr } = await admin.from('leads').select(COLS + ',capability_enriched_at,approval_status,registration_submitted_at,source,banned,matching_blocked')
      .eq('approval_status','approved').is('capability_enriched_at', null).limit(limit);
    if (batchErr) { await logRun('error', { stage:'batch_select', limit }, 'Could not read the backlog of approved suppliers awaiting enrichment: '+String(batchErr.message)+'; the whole backlog stays without capability_summary and none of those suppliers can be matched to any RFQ'); }
    const cands = (leads || []).filter((l:any)=> (l.registration_submitted_at || l.source==='self_registered') && !l.banned && !l.matching_blocked);
    const results = []; let done = 0;
    for (const l of cands) { const r = await enrichOne(l); if (r.ok) done++; results.push(r); }
    const failed = results.filter((r:any)=> !r.ok);
    const lowN = results.filter((r:any)=> r.low === true).length;
    const notes: string[] = [];
    if (batchErr) notes.push('backlog query failed: '+String(batchErr.message));
    if (LLM_STATE.keyMissing) notes.push('openrouter_api_key is missing from app_secrets, so NO supplier can be enriched at all: every approved supplier awaiting enrichment stays without a capability_summary and is unmatchable to every RFQ until the key is restored');
    if (failed.length) notes.push(failed.length+' of '+cands.length+' suppliers were not enriched (ids '+failed.map((r:any)=>r.id).join(',')+'; reasons '+[...new Set(failed.map((r:any)=>String(r.reason)))].join(',')+'); they are left without a capability_summary, so the adjudicator cannot judge them and they will never be matched to any RFQ');
    if (LLM_STATE.failures.length) notes.push('llm errors: '+LLM_STATE.failures.join(' | '));
    if (lowN) notes.push(lowN+' summaries were low_confidence (thin supplier profiles), which typically means those suppliers get under-matched');
    if (!notes.length) notes.push(cands.length ? ('Enriched '+done+' of '+cands.length+' suppliers; all now have a capability_summary and are matchable') : 'No approved suppliers were awaiting enrichment');
    await logRun((batchErr || failed.length || LLM_STATE.keyMissing) ? 'error' : 'ok', { stage:'batch', limit, candidates: cands.length, enriched: done, failed: failed.length, low_confidence: lowN, llm_key_missing: LLM_STATE.keyMissing, batch_select_failed: batchErr ? 1 : 0 }, notes.join(' | '));
    return J({ ok: true, processed: cands.length, enriched: done, results });
  } catch (e) { await logRun('error', { stage:'run' }, 'enrich_capability crashed: '+String((e as Error)?.message || e)+'; the suppliers in this batch keep no capability_summary and cannot be matched to any RFQ'); return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/exec_agents/index.ts

```typescript
// exec_agents — Executive Intelligence layer. Each officer reads live metrics and writes a
// prioritized action plan into exec_reports. Secret-gated (cron/internal). Action: run {officer} | run_all.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' } });
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
function parseJson(s: string): any { if (!s) return null; const m = s.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (!m) return null; try { return JSON.parse(m[0]); } catch { return null; } }
const llm = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 1600, temperature: 0.25 }); // shared OpenRouter client (Sonnet-first + 25s timeout)

const OFFICERS: Record<string, { name: string; rpc: string; brief: string }> = {
  strategy: { name: 'AI Strategy Officer', rpc: 'fn_strategy_metrics', brief: 'You continuously IMPROVE the business (not run it). From the metrics identify: categories with high demand but too few suppliers; coverage gaps (categories without engineered requirements, playbooks or mapped regulations); funnel leaks (abandoned RFQs, low response rate, slow first quote). Output a prioritized action plan the founder can approve.' },
  operations: { name: 'Operations Director', rpc: 'fn_ops_metrics', brief: 'You run the marketplace. From the metrics find what is slowing it down: RFQs open with no quotes, suppliers matched but not quoting, slow first-response, stuck pipeline stages, overdue activities. Recommend concrete unblocking actions.' },
  procurement_quality: { name: 'Procurement Quality Officer', rpc: 'fn_quality_metrics', brief: 'You protect quality. From the metrics flag: RFQs missing category/scope/emirate; RFQs with too few suppliers invited; low quote completeness scores; RFQs that are not comparable (only one quote). Recommend fixes that raise quote quality and comparability.' },
  data_science: { name: 'Data Scientist', rpc: 'fn_data_metrics', brief: 'You analyze trends. From the metrics identify category demand growth/decline, most competitive categories, price spread/volatility, and seasonality. Recommend where to invest supply/marketing and any pricing guidance.' },
  product_ux: { name: 'Product & UX Officer', rpc: 'fn_voice_metrics', brief: 'You are the voice of the customer. From the metrics (low ratings + comments, disputes, abandoned RFQs, repeat customers) infer friction and product/UX issues. Recommend product changes and where users drop off.' },
  competitive: { name: 'Competitive Intelligence Officer', rpc: 'fn_strategy_metrics', brief: 'Assess QuotesDone competitive position from internal proxies (category coverage vs demand, response rate, savings). Note explicitly that live competitor tracking needs an external data connector (SEO/ads/traffic) to be complete, and list what to monitor.' }
};

async function runOfficer(k: string): Promise<any> {
  const cfg = OFFICERS[k]; if (!cfg) return { error: 'unknown officer' };
  const { data: metrics } = await admin.rpc(cfg.rpc);
  const sys = 'You are ' + cfg.name + ' for QuotesDone, the UAE anonymous B2B quotation marketplace. ' + cfg.brief + ' Be concrete, specific to the numbers, and honest about small sample sizes. Return ONLY JSON: {"summary":string,"findings":[string],"recommendations":[{"action":string,"impact":"high|medium|low","effort":"high|medium|low","confidence":number}]}. 3-6 findings, 3-6 recommendations, most important first.';
  const raw = await llm(sys, 'LIVE METRICS (JSON):\n' + JSON.stringify(metrics || {}), 1800);
  const parsed = parseJson(raw || '');
  const row: any = { officer: k, period: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), metrics: metrics || {},
    summary: parsed?.summary || ('Metrics captured; AI synthesis unavailable this run.'),
    findings: Array.isArray(parsed?.findings) ? parsed.findings : [],
    recommendations: Array.isArray(parsed?.recommendations) ? parsed.recommendations : [] };
  const { data: ins } = await admin.from('exec_reports').insert(row).select('id').maybeSingle();
  try { await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'exec:' + k, started_at: new Date().toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'ok', counts: { recs: row.recommendations.length } }); } catch (_e) {}
  return { officer: k, report_id: ins?.id, recommendations: row.recommendations.length, ai: !!parsed };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': '*' } });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const action = String(body.action || 'run_all');
    if (action === 'run') return J(await runOfficer(String(body.officer || 'strategy')));
    if (action === 'run_all') { const out: any[] = []; for (const k of Object.keys(OFFICERS)) out.push(await runOfficer(k)); return J({ ok: true, ran: out }); }
    if (action === 'latest') { const { data } = await admin.from('exec_reports').select('*').order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(Math.min(Number(body.limit) || 12, 50)); return J({ ok: true, reports: data || [] }); }
    return J({ error: 'unknown action' }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
async function sec(k:string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
const FIXED:Record<string,string>={brief:'Daily Brief',secretary:'Secretary (Chief of Staff)',cfo:'CFO',legal:'Legal Counsel',collections:'Collections Accountant',bookkeeper:'Bookkeeper',onboarding:'Onboarding / KYC',docs:'Document Controller',security:'Security Engineer',it:'IT / Uptime (SRE)',followup:'Follow-up (Lifecycle)',bd:'BD Representative',marketing:'Marketing'};
Deno.serve(async (req)=>{
  let b:any={}; try{ b=await req.json(); }catch(_){}
  const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
  if(!secretOk(__exp) || b.__secret!==__exp) return new Response('forbidden',{status:403});
  const { data: kn } = await admin.from('agent_knowledge').select('agent_key,topic,content,priority').order('priority',{ascending:false});
  const { data: cats } = await admin.from('category_agents').select('slug,name,persona').eq('active',true).order('name');
  const byKey=new Map<string, any[]>();
  for(const r of (kn||[])){ const k=r.agent_key as string; if(!byKey.has(k)) byKey.set(k,[]); byKey.get(k)!.push(r); }
  const sortRows=(rows:any[])=>rows.sort((a:any,b:any)=> (b.priority-a.priority));
  // Header/counts computed at runtime (OPEN_ISSUES #6 — were hardcoded "25 June 2026" / "24 trades").
  const catCount=(cats||[]).length;
  const pulledOn=new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'2-digit',month:'long',year:'numeric'});
  let md='# QuotesDone — Complete Agent Knowledge Base (All Agents)\n\nEvery agent, every knowledge entry, pulled live on '+pulledOn+'. Sections: Global (all agents) → Fixed specialists → Category sales agents. Trade and fixed-agent packs are web-researched with sources; verify any exact figure before operational reliance.\n\n';
  // GLOBAL
  md+='\n# GLOBAL — shared by every agent\n\n';
  for(const r of sortRows(byKey.get('_global')||[])) md+='### '+r.topic+'\n\n'+(r.content||'').trim()+'\n\n';
  // FIXED
  md+='\n# FIXED SPECIALIST AGENTS\n\n';
  for(const key of Object.keys(FIXED)){
    const rows=byKey.get(key); if(!rows||!rows.length) continue;
    md+='\n---\n\n## '+FIXED[key]+'\n\n';
    for(const r of sortRows(rows)) md+='### '+r.topic+'\n\n'+(r.content||'').trim()+'\n\n';
  }
  // CATEGORIES
  md+='\n# CATEGORY SALES AGENTS ('+catCount+' trades)\n\n';
  const order=['Quote analysis & comparison','Customer intake & scoping questions','Regulations, licensing & approvals','Standards, materials & specifications','Pricing benchmarks & red flags','Authoritative sources & references'];
  for(const c of (cats||[])){
    md+='\n---\n\n## '+c.name+'\n\n**Persona:** '+((c.persona||'(none)').trim())+'\n\n';
    const rows=(byKey.get('cat:'+c.slug)||[]).slice();
    rows.sort((a:any,b:any)=>{ const ia=order.indexOf(a.topic), ib=order.indexOf(b.topic); return (ia<0?99:ia)-(ib<0?99:ib); });
    for(const r of rows) md+='### '+r.topic+'\n\n'+(r.content||'').trim()+'\n\n';
  }
  return new Response(md,{headers:{'Content-Type':'text/markdown; charset=utf-8'}});
});
```
