### supabase/functions/export_leads_csv/index.ts

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }

const COLS = ['id','company_name','sector','sub_type','emirate','city','street','website','domain','maps_website','maps_url','place_id','phone','phone_e164','email','email_verified','instagram','facebook','whatsapp','rating','reviews','website_status','permanently_closed','description','services','products','certifications','founded_year','company_size','company_type','business_role','capability_summary'];

function csvCell(v: unknown): string {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return '';
  const s = String(v);
  return '"' + s.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
  // Auth: admin JWT (email in admin_emails) OR inbound_secret. Full-PII export must never be behind a shared test token.
  let authed = false;
  if (body.__secret && body.__secret === (await sec('inbound_secret'))) authed = true;
  if (!authed) {
    const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization')||'').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i,'');
    if (jwt) {
      const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
      const allow = (await sec('admin_emails')||'').split(',').map((s)=>s.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);
      if (user?.email && allow.includes(user.email.toLowerCase())) authed = true;
    }
  }
  if (!authed) return new Response('forbidden', { status: 403 });

  const page = 1000;
  let from = 0;
  const lines: string[] = [COLS.join(',')];
  for (;;) {
    const { data, error } = await admin.from('leads').select(COLS.join(',')).order('id', { ascending: true }).range(from, from + page - 1);
    if (error) return new Response('error: ' + error.message, { status: 500 });
    if (!data || data.length === 0) break;
    for (const row of data) lines.push(COLS.map((c) => csvCell((row as Record<string, unknown>)[c])).join(','));
    if (data.length < page) break;
    from += page;
  }
  return new Response(lines.join('\n'), { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/csv; charset=utf-8', 'Content-Disposition': 'attachment; filename="quotesdone_leads.csv"' } });
});
```

### supabase/functions/extract_text/index.ts

```typescript
// extract_text - reads a PDF or image attachment and returns its text content (for the Secretary chat).
// Images -> vision; PDFs -> OpenRouter file-parser. Admin/secret only.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
async function authed(req: Request, body: any){ if(body.__secret && body.__secret===(await sec('inbound_secret'))) return true; const jwt=(req.headers.get('Authorization')||'').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i,''); const { data:{ user } }=await admin.auth.getUser(jwt); const allow=(await sec('admin_emails')||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean); return !!(user?.email && allow.includes(user.email.toLowerCase())); }
const PROMPT = 'Extract ALL readable text and content from this document faithfully, as clean plain text / markdown. Preserve tables (as markdown tables), headings, figures and key numbers. Do not summarise, do not add commentary — output ONLY the extracted content.';

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    if(!(await authed(req, body))) return J({ error:'forbidden' }, 403);
    const filename = String(body.filename||'document');
    const mime = String(body.mime||'application/octet-stream');
    let b64 = String(body.b64||''); if(!b64) return J({ error:'b64 required' }, 400);
    const dataUrl = b64.startsWith('data:') ? b64 : ('data:'+mime+';base64,'+b64);
    const isImage = /image\//i.test(mime) || /\.(png|jpe?g|webp|gif|heic|heif)$/i.test(filename);
    const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key'); if(!key) return J({ error:'ai_unavailable' }, 500);
    let content: any; let plugins: any = undefined;
    if (isImage) content = [{ type:'text', text:PROMPT }, { type:'image_url', image_url:{ url:dataUrl } }];
    else { content = [{ type:'text', text:PROMPT }, { type:'file', file:{ filename, file_data:dataUrl } }]; plugins = [{ id:'file-parser', pdf:{ engine:'pdf-text' } }]; }
    let text=''; let last='';
    for (const model of ['anthropic/claude-sonnet-5','anthropic/claude-opus-4.8']){
      try{
        const payload: any = { model, max_tokens: 4000, messages: [{ role:'user', content }] }; if(plugins) payload.plugins = plugins;
        const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', { method:'POST', headers:{ 'Authorization':'Bearer '+key, 'Content-Type':'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
        const jd = await r.json(); const c = jd?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content; if(c && String(c).trim().length>5){ text = String(c).trim(); break; } last = jd?.error?.message || ('empty:'+model);
      }catch(e){ last='exc:'+model+':'+String((e as Error)?.message||e).slice(0,80); }
    }
    if(!text) return J({ ok:false, error:'extract_failed', detail:last }, 200);
    return J({ ok:true, text: text.slice(0, 16000), filename });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message||e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
// faq — public FAQ from company_faq, unified header + chrome (language button + chat widget) matching the site.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const ASSET='https://htdblwldjkcgjvmqkbeh.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/brand';
const esc = (s: unknown) => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>]/g, (c)=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;'} as any)[c]);
const ORDER: [string,string][] = [
  ['Company Identity','About QuotesDone'], ['Customer','For Customers'], ['Supplier','For Suppliers'],
  ['RFQ','Requests (RFQs)'], ['Quotation','Quotations'], ['Marketplace','The Marketplace'],
  ['Financial','Fees & Payments'], ['Smart Engine','The Smart Engine'], ['Technical','Technical & Standards'],
  ['Documents','Documents'], ['Security','Security'], ['Integrations','Integrations'],
  ['Operations','How Things Work'], ['Company Policies','Policies'], ['Future Vision','Our Vision'],
];
const HEADER=`<header class="site"><div class="wrap"><a class="brand" href="/"><img src="${ASSET}/qd_lockup_light.png?v=2" alt="QuotesDone" style="height:26px;width:auto;display:block"></a><nav class="snav"><a href="/services/">Services</a><a href="/blog/">Blog</a><a href="/faq/">FAQ</a><a href="/about/">About</a><a href="/contact/">Contact</a></nav><a class="cta" href="/app">Get free quotes</a></div></header>`;

Deno.serve(async () => {
  let I18N=''; try{ I18N = await (await fetch(ASSET+'/i18n_chrome.html')).text(); }catch(_e){ I18N=''; }
  const { data: rows } = await admin.from('company_faq').select('section,sort,question,answer')
    .eq('status','approved').eq('public', true).order('sort',{ascending:true}).order('id',{ascending:true});
  const bySection: Record<string, any[]> = {};
  for (const r of (rows||[])) (bySection[r.section] = bySection[r.section] || []).push(r);
  const orderedKeys = ORDER.map(o=>o[0]).filter(k=>bySection[k]);
  for (const k of Object.keys(bySection)) if (!orderedKeys.includes(k)) orderedKeys.push(k);
  const titleOf: Record<string,string> = Object.fromEntries(ORDER);
  let sections = '';
  for (const key of orderedKeys){
    const items = bySection[key] || []; const title = titleOf[key] || key; let qa = '';
    for (const it of items){ qa += `<details class="qa"><summary>${esc(it.question)}</summary><div class="a">${esc(it.answer)}</div></details>`; }
    sections += `<section class="sec"><h2>${esc(title)}</h2>${qa}</section>`;
  }
  const total = (rows||[]).length;
  const faqLd = JSON.stringify({ '@context':'https://schema.org','@type':'FAQPage','mainEntity': (rows||[]).map((r:any)=>({ '@type':'Question','name':String(r.question||''),'acceptedAnswer':{ '@type':'Answer','text':String(r.answer||'') } })) }).replace(/</g, String.fromCharCode(92)+'u003c');

  const html = `<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>FAQ — QuotesDone</title>
<meta name="description" content="Frequently asked questions about QuotesDone — the UAE anonymous B2B quotation marketplace. Fees, matching, suppliers, customers, security and more.">

<meta property="og:type" content="website"><meta property="og:title" content="FAQ — QuotesDone"><meta property="og:url" content="https://quotesdone.com/faq/"><meta property="og:image" content="${ASSET}/qd_mark.png">
<script type="application/ld+json">${faqLd}</script>
<link rel="icon" href="${ASSET}/favicon.ico">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>

</div>

      var t=(d.querySelector('summary').textContent+' '+d.querySelector('.a').textContent).toLowerCase();

    });

${I18N}

  return new Response(html, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=300' } });
```

### supabase/functions/finance_doc/index.ts

````typescript
// finance_doc — store an original finance PDF/receipt, AI-extract it, post it via finance_ingest with doc_path,
// and queue it for Dropbox backup. Admin-JWT or __secret gated.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const BASE = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')! + '/functions/v1';
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
async function isAdmin(email: string){ if(!email) return false; const em=email.toLowerCase(); try{const{data}=await admin.rpc('fn_role_of',{p_email:em}); if(['owner','admin'].includes(String(data||'').toLowerCase())) return true;}catch(_e){} try{const{data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key','admin_emails').maybeSingle(); const list=String((data as any)?.value||'').toLowerCase().split(/[,;\s]+/).filter(Boolean); if(list.includes(em)) return true;}catch(_e){} return false; }

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return J({ ok: true });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    let ok = false;
    if (body?.__secret && body.__secret === (await sec('inbound_secret'))) ok = true;
    else { const tok = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '').trim(); if (tok) { const { data: u } = await admin.auth.getUser(tok); const em = u?.user?.email || ''; if (em && await isAdmin(em)) ok = true; } }
    if (!ok) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);

    const filename = String(body?.filename || 'invoice.pdf');
    const mime = String(body?.mime || 'application/octet-stream');
    let b64 = String(body?.b64 || '');
    const comma = b64.indexOf(','); if (b64.slice(0, 5) === 'data:' && comma > -1) b64 = b64.slice(comma + 1);
    if (!b64) return J({ error: 'file_required' }, 400);

    // 1) store original
    let bytes: Uint8Array;
    try { bytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(b64), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0)); } catch (_e) { return J({ error: 'bad_base64' }, 400); }
    const safe = filename.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/g, '_').slice(-80);
    const path = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7) + '/' + Date.now() + '-' + safe;
    const up = await admin.storage.from('finance-docs').upload(path, bytes, { contentType: mime, upsert: true });
    if (up.error) return J({ error: 'store_failed: ' + up.error.message }, 500);

    // 2) extract text
    let text = '';
    try { const r = await fetch(`${BASE}/extract_text`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: await sec('inbound_secret'), filename, mime, b64 }) }); const jd = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); text = String((jd as any)?.text || ''); } catch (_e) {}

    // 3) AI parse into a finance entry
    let entry: any = null;
    if (text && text.length > 10) {
      const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key');
      if (key) {
        const prompt = `Extract a finance entry from this UAE invoice/receipt text. Return STRICT JSON only: {\"kind\":\"expense|income|subscription\",\"amount\":<number in AED>,\"currency\":\"AED\",\"vendor\":\"...\",\"category\":\"...\",\"description\":\"...\",\"cycle\":\"monthly|annual|quarterly|weekly (only if subscription)\"}. If it is a recurring software/service subscription, use kind=subscription. Amount is the total incl VAT. No prose.\n\nTEXT:\n` + text.slice(0, 6000);
        try { const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + key, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-5', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }], temperature: 0.1 }) }); const jd = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); let t = (jd as any)?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || ''; t = String(t).replace(/```json/gi, '').replace(/```/g, '').trim(); const m = t.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); entry = JSON.parse(m ? m[0] : t); } catch (_e) { entry = null; }
      }
    }

    // 4) post via finance_ingest with doc_path (only if we parsed a valid amount)
    let logged: any = null;
    if (entry && Number(entry.amount) > 0) {
      entry.source = 'invoice_upload'; entry.doc_path = path; entry.doc_name = filename; entry.doc_content_type = mime;
      try { const r = await fetch(`${BASE}/finance_ingest`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: await sec('inbound_secret'), action: 'log', entry }) }); logged = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); } catch (e) { logged = { error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }; }
    }

    // 5) queue for Dropbox backup (best-effort)
    try { await admin.from('doc_backups').insert({ source: 'storage', entity: 'expense_entries', entity_id: String(logged?.id || ''), doc_type: 'finance_invoice', bucket: 'finance-docs', path, file_name: filename, dropbox_path: '/QuotesDone Backup/Finance/' + (new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7)) + '/' + safe, status: 'pending', attempts: 0, dedupe_key: 'finance-docs:' + path }); } catch (_e) {}

    return J({ ok: true, path, extracted_chars: text.length, parsed: entry, logged });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
````

### supabase/functions/finance_ingest/index.ts

```typescript
// finance_ingest — records finance entries (one-off expenses, income, subscriptions) from the Secretary/console
// or the expenses@ email pipeline; forecasts upcoming recurring payments; and runs the 3-day subscription reminder.
// Auth: __secret == inbound_secret (server + cron) OR admin-email JWT.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
async function sec(k: string): Promise<string | undefined> { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
async function whoami(req: Request, body: any): Promise<boolean> {
  if (body.__secret && body.__secret === (await sec('inbound_secret'))) return true;
  const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, ''); if (!jwt) return false;
  const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
  const allow = (await sec('admin_emails') || '').split(/[,;\s]+/).map((s) => s.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);
  return !!(user?.email && allow.includes(user.email.toLowerCase()));
}
async function founderEmail(): Promise<string> {
  for (const k of ['founder_email', 'email_founder', 'founder_notify_email']) { const v = await sec(k); if (v && /@/.test(v)) return v; }
  const list = (await sec('admin_emails') || '').split(/[,;\s]+/).map((s) => s.trim()).filter((s) => /@/.test(s));
  return list[0] || 'management@quotesdone.com';
}
function addCycle(d: Date, cadence: string): Date { const c = String(cadence || 'monthly').toLowerCase(); const n = new Date(d); if (c.startsWith('ann') || c.startsWith('year')) n.setFullYear(n.getFullYear() + 1); else if (c.startsWith('quart')) n.setMonth(n.getMonth() + 3); else if (c.startsWith('week')) n.setDate(n.getDate() + 7); else n.setMonth(n.getMonth() + 1); return n; }
const ymd = (d: Date) => d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);

async function doLog(entry: any) {
  const kind = String(entry?.kind || 'expense').toLowerCase();
  const amount = Math.round((Number(entry?.amount) || 0) * 100) / 100;
  if (!amount) return { error: 'amount_required' };
  const vendor = String(entry?.vendor || entry?.description || 'Unknown').slice(0, 160);
  const currency = String(entry?.currency || 'AED').slice(0, 8).toUpperCase();
  const category = String(entry?.category || (kind === 'income' ? 'Income' : 'General')).slice(0, 80);
  const note = String(entry?.description || entry?.note || '').slice(0, 800);
  const source = String(entry?.source || 'secretary').slice(0, 40);
  if (kind === 'subscription') {
    let nd: string;
    if (entry?.next_due && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(String(entry.next_due))) nd = String(entry.next_due).slice(0, 10);
    else nd = ymd(addCycle(new Date(), entry?.cycle || 'monthly'));
    // H8 (OS audit): don't create a duplicate active subscription for the same vendor+amount+cadence on a re-ingest.
    const cad = String(entry?.cycle || 'monthly').toLowerCase();
    const { data: dupSub } = await admin.from('expenses').select('id').eq('active', true).eq('vendor', vendor).eq('amount', amount).eq('cadence', cad).limit(1).maybeSingle();
    if (dupSub?.id) return { ok: true, deduped: true, logged: 'subscription', id: dupSub.id, next_due: nd, amount, currency, vendor };
    const { data, error } = await admin.from('expenses').insert({ vendor, category, description: note || vendor, amount, currency, cadence: cad, expense_date: ymd(new Date()), next_due: nd, active: true, source, note }).select('id').maybeSingle();
    if (error) return { error: error.message };
    return { ok: true, logged: 'subscription', id: data?.id, next_due: nd, amount, currency, vendor };
  }
  const signed = kind === 'income' ? -Math.abs(amount) : Math.abs(amount);
  // H8 (OS audit): a re-uploaded invoice (same doc_path) must not create a duplicate expense/income row.
  const dPath = entry?.doc_path || null;
  if (dPath) { const { data: dup } = await admin.from('expense_entries').select('id').eq('doc_path', dPath).limit(1).maybeSingle(); if (dup?.id) return { ok: true, deduped: true, logged: kind, id: dup.id, amount, currency, vendor }; }
  const { data, error } = await admin.from('expense_entries').insert({ vendor, category, amount: signed, currency, charged_on: ymd(new Date()), note: (kind === 'income' ? '[INCOME] ' : '') + note, source, doc_path: dPath, doc_name: entry?.doc_name || null, doc_content_type: entry?.doc_content_type || null }).select('id').maybeSingle();
  if (error) return { error: error.message };
  return { ok: true, logged: kind, id: data?.id, amount, currency, vendor };
}

async function doForecast(days: number) {
  const horizon = ymd(new Date(Date.now() + days * 864e5));
  const { data: subs } = await admin.from('expenses').select('id,vendor,category,amount,currency,cadence,next_due').eq('active', true).not('next_due', 'is', null).lte('next_due', horizon).order('next_due');
  const { data: allSubs } = await admin.from('expenses').select('amount,cadence').eq('active', true);
  let monthly = 0; for (const s of (allSubs || [])) { const c = String(s.cadence || 'monthly').toLowerCase(); const a = Number(s.amount) || 0; monthly += c.startsWith('ann') || c.startsWith('year') ? a / 12 : c.startsWith('quart') ? a / 3 : c.startsWith('week') ? a * 4.33 : a; }
  const { data: recent } = await admin.from('expense_entries').select('amount').gte('charged_on', ymd(new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 864e5)));
  const spend30 = (recent || []).reduce((t, e) => t + Math.max(0, Number(e.amount) || 0), 0);
  return { upcoming: subs || [], monthly_recurring_aed: Math.round(monthly), oneoff_spend_30d_aed: Math.round(spend30), horizon_days: days };
}

async function doRemind(reminderDays: number) {
  const today = new Date(); const todayStr = ymd(today);
  // 1) roll any past-due subscriptions forward so they recur
  const { data: past } = await admin.from('expenses').select('id,next_due,cadence').eq('active', true).not('next_due', 'is', null).lt('next_due', todayStr);
  for (const s of (past || [])) { let nd = new Date(String(s.next_due)); let guard = 0; while (ymd(nd) < todayStr && guard < 60) { nd = addCycle(nd, s.cadence); guard++; } await admin.from('expenses').update({ next_due: ymd(nd) }).eq('id', s.id); }
  // 2) find subscriptions due within the reminder window, not yet reminded this cycle
  const windowEnd = ymd(new Date(Date.now() + reminderDays * 864e5));
  const { data: due } = await admin.from('expenses').select('id,vendor,amount,currency,next_due,cadence,last_reminded_at').eq('active', true).not('next_due', 'is', null).lte('next_due', windowEnd).gte('next_due', todayStr);
  const toRemind = (due || []).filter((s) => !s.last_reminded_at || (Date.now() - new Date(s.last_reminded_at).getTime()) > 6 * 864e5);
  if (!toRemind.length) return { ok: true, reminded: 0, rolled: (past || []).length };
  const lines = toRemind.map((s) => { const days = Math.max(0, Math.round((new Date(String(s.next_due)).getTime() - Date.now()) / 864e5)); return `- ${s.vendor}: ${s.currency} ${Number(s.amount).toLocaleString()} due ${s.next_due} (${days === 0 ? 'today' : 'in ' + days + ' day' + (days === 1 ? '' : 's')})`; }).join('\n');
  const total = toRemind.reduce((t, s) => t + (Number(s.amount) || 0), 0);
  const body = 'UPCOMING PAYMENTS\nThe following subscription/recurring payments are due within the next ' + reminderDays + ' days:\n\n' + lines + '\n\nTotal due soon: AED ' + Math.round(total).toLocaleString() + '.\nMake sure funds are available. Reply or open the OS Finance tab to manage these.';
  const to = await founderEmail();
  await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type: 'finance_reminder', to_email: to, to_role: 'founder', channel: 'email', subject: 'Upcoming payments — ' + toRemind.length + ' due within ' + reminderDays + ' days', body, status: 'queued' });
  await admin.from('expenses').update({ last_reminded_at: new Date().toISOString() }).in('id', toRemind.map((s) => s.id));
  return { ok: true, reminded: toRemind.length, rolled: (past || []).length, total_aed: Math.round(total) };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    if (!(await whoami(req, body))) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const action = String(body.action || 'log');
    if (action === 'log') return J(await doLog(body.entry || body));
    if (action === 'forecast') return J(await doForecast(Math.min(120, Math.max(1, Number(body.days) || 30))));
    if (action === 'remind') return J(await doRemind(Math.min(30, Math.max(1, Number(body.reminder_days) || 3))));
    return J({ error: 'unknown_action' }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/gen_category_knowledge/index.ts

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'gen_category_knowledge', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
}
let LLM_CALLS=0, LLM_FAILS=0, SHORT_OUTPUTS=0, INSERT_FAILS=0; let LAST_ERR='';
const llmShared = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 700, temperature: 0.3 });
const TOPIC='Field expertise — UAE codes, standards & specs';
async function sec(k:string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
async function llm(_key:string, sys:string, user:string){ LLM_CALLS++; const c=await llmShared(sys,user); if(!c){ LLM_FAILS++; LAST_ERR='openrouter call failed or returned no content'; return ''; } return c; }

Deno.serve(async (req)=>{
 try{
  let b:any={}; try{ b=await req.json(); }catch(_){}
  const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
  if(!secretOk(__exp) || b.__secret!==__exp) { await logRun('error',{generated:0},'call rejected: wrong or missing inbound secret; no category knowledge generated'); return new Response(JSON.stringify({error:'forbidden'}),{status:403,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}}); }
  const ork=await sec('openrouter_api_key'); if(!ork) { await logRun('error',{generated:0},'openrouter_api_key missing from app_secrets: no category knowledge generated this run, category agent field knowledge is stale'); return new Response(JSON.stringify({error:'no key'}),{status:200,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}}); }
  const limit=Math.max(1,Math.min(24,Number(b.limit)||8));
  const force=b.force===true;
  const staleDays=Math.max(1,Number(b.stale_days)||14);
  const targetSlug=(typeof b.slug==='string' && b.slug.trim()) ? b.slug.trim() : null;
  // existing field-knowledge rows + freshness (so we can REFRESH the stalest, not just fill gaps)
  const { data: have } = await admin.from('agent_knowledge').select('agent_key,updated_at').like('agent_key','cat:%').eq('topic',TOPIC);
  const fresh=new Map<string,number>((have||[]).map((r:any)=>[r.agent_key, r.updated_at? Date.parse(r.updated_at):0]));
  const { data: cats } = await admin.from('category_agents').select('slug,name').eq('active',true);
  let pool:any[];
  if(targetSlug){
    pool=(cats||[]).filter((c:any)=> c.slug===targetSlug);
  } else {
    const staleBefore=Date.now()-staleDays*86400000;
    const withMeta=(cats||[]).map((c:any)=>({ ...c, has:fresh.has('cat:'+c.slug), age:fresh.get('cat:'+c.slug)??0 }));
    const missing=withMeta.filter((c:any)=> !c.has);
    const stale=withMeta.filter((c:any)=> c.has && (force || c.age < staleBefore)).sort((a:any,b:any)=> a.age - b.age);
    pool=[...missing, ...stale].slice(0,limit);
  }
  const results = await Promise.all(pool.map(async (c:any)=>{
    const sys='You are compiling the FIELD KNOWLEDGE BASE for an AI sales specialist agent that owns the "'+c.name+'" trade category on QuotesDone, a UAE B2B sourcing marketplace (focus Dubai). This text is injected directly into the agent\'s brain so it can talk to UAE customers and suppliers as a genuine expert in '+c.name+' and qualify jobs precisely. Write a dense, ACCURATE domain brief of 230-340 words covering, specifically for '+c.name+' in the UAE: (1) GOVERNING AUTHORITY & APPROVALS — the actual UAE regulator(s)/permits/NOC steps that apply to THIS trade (examples of the kind of bodies, only where they truly apply: Dubai Civil Defence (DCD) and the UAE Fire and Life Safety Code of Practice for fire/life-safety; SIRA — Security Industry Regulatory Agency — and Dubai Police for CCTV/security; DEWA for electrical connection and Shams Dubai net-metering for solar; Dubai Municipality; Trakhees for ports/free-zone areas; ESMA/Emirates Conformity; RTA; Dubai Development Authority). (2) STANDARDS — the technical standards that genuinely apply (e.g. NFPA, IEC, EN, BS, ISO, ASHRAE, ASTM, DEWA regulations) — give specific numbers ONLY when you are confident they are correct; otherwise name the standard without a number. (3) SCOPE & SPECS — the core components, materials, equipment, ratings/capacities and technical terms that buyers and suppliers actually discuss. (4) PRICE DRIVERS. (5) COMPLIANCE PITFALLS / RED FLAGS and the sharp qualifying questions the agent should ask a customer. Be concrete and UAE-specific. HARD RULE: never invent code numbers, authority names, retention periods or figures — if unsure of an exact number, refer to the requirement by name without a number rather than guessing. Output ONLY the knowledge-brief text, no preamble or headings list.';
    const user='Trade category: '+c.name+' (slug: '+c.slug+'). Market: United Arab Emirates (focus Dubai). Write its expert field knowledge base now.';
    const text=(await llm(ork,sys,user)).trim();
    if(text && text.length>120){
      await admin.from('agent_knowledge').delete().eq('agent_key','cat:'+c.slug).eq('topic',TOPIC);
      const ins=await admin.from('agent_knowledge').insert({agent_key:'cat:'+c.slug,topic:TOPIC,content:text.slice(0,4000),priority:8});
      if(ins && (ins as any).error){ INSERT_FAILS++; LAST_ERR='agent_knowledge insert failed for cat:'+c.slug+': '+((ins as any).error?.message||''); }
      return 1;
    }
    SHORT_OUTPUTS++;
    return 0;
  }));
  const done=results.reduce((a:number,x:number)=>a+x,0);
  const { data: nowHave } = await admin.from('agent_knowledge').select('agent_key').like('agent_key','cat:%').eq('topic',TOPIC);
  const total=(cats||[]).length; const covered=(nowHave||[]).length;
  const attempted=pool.length;
  let note:string;
  if(attempted===0){ note='no categories were due for field knowledge this run; nothing generated and nothing failed'; }
  else if(done===0){ note='NO category knowledge generated this run despite '+attempted+' categories attempted — the model call failed or returned unusable output every time; category agent field knowledge is stale and those agents will talk to UAE customers without trade expertise'; }
  else if(done<attempted){ note='partial run: generated field knowledge for '+done+' of '+attempted+' categories; '+(attempted-done)+' produced nothing usable from the model and remain without trade expertise'; }
  else { note='generated field knowledge for all '+done+' attempted categories; '+(total-covered)+' categories still uncovered overall'; }
  if(INSERT_FAILS>0) note+=' | '+INSERT_FAILS+' knowledge row(s) failed to save, so that content was generated but lost';
  if(LAST_ERR) note+=' | last error: '+LAST_ERR;
  const bad = INSERT_FAILS>0 || (attempted>0 && done===0);
  await logRun(bad?'error':'ok',{generated:done,attempted,covered,total,remaining:total-covered,llm_calls:LLM_CALLS,llm_failures:LLM_FAILS,unusable_outputs:SHORT_OUTPUTS,insert_failures:INSERT_FAILS},note);
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ok:true,generated:done,covered,total,remaining:total-covered}),{headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});
 }catch(e){ await logRun('error',{generated:0,llm_calls:LLM_CALLS,llm_failures:LLM_FAILS},'gen_category_knowledge crashed before completing; no category knowledge generated this run: '+String(e)); throw e; }
});
```

```typescript
Deno.serve(async (req)=>{
 try{
  let b:any={}; try{ b=await req.json(); }catch(_){}

  const limit=Math.max(1,Math.min(24,Number(b.limit)||8));
  const force=b.force===true;
  let q=admin.from('category_agents').select('slug,name').eq('active',true);
  if(!force) q=q.is('persona',null);
  const { data: rows } = await q.limit(limit);
  const results = await Promise.all((rows||[]).map(async (c:any)=>{
    const sys='You write the persona/charter for an autonomous SALES specialist agent inside QuotesDone, a UAE B2B "anonymous quotation" marketplace where customers post a job, get matched to vetted suppliers, compare anonymised quotes, and pay a small fee to reveal the supplier they choose. This agent owns ONE trade category and works to convert that category\'s inquiries into completed deals. Write a tight second-person persona ("You are the ... specialist") of 70-110 words that: (1) names the trade and the agent\'s goal (turn '+c.name+' inquiries into reveals/deals), (2) shows real domain fluency for THIS trade in the UAE — typical scope, what drives price, common buyer concerns, materials/standards, seasonality or compliance quirks (e.g. Civil Defence, municipality, SIRA, DEWA where relevant), (3) lists its levers: nudge customers who have quotes to reveal, flag supply gaps where no suppliers matched, surface hot leads. ### supabase/functions/github_sync/index.ts
```

```typescript
// github_sync — nightly organization-as-code mirror.
// Exports the org (fn_org_export) and commits changed files to GitHub under
// ai-organization/org-as-code/ using the git data API. Skips the commit entirely
// when nothing changed (identical tree sha). Auth: __secret (cron) only.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || !body.__secret || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const token = await sec('github_token');
    if (!token) return J({ error: 'github_token not configured in app_secrets' }, 500);
    const repo = (await sec('github_repo')) || 'ahmadmhdnabilalzain-bot/quotesdone';
    const branch = (await sec('github_branch')) || 'main';
    const api = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + repo;
    const H = { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token, 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };

    const { data: exp, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_org_export');
    if (error || !exp) return J({ error: 'export failed: ' + (error?.message || 'empty') }, 500);
    const base = 'ai-organization/org-as-code/';
    const tree: any[] = [];
    for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(exp as Record<string, unknown>)) {
      if (key === 'exported_at') continue;
      tree.push({ path: base + key + '.json', mode: '100644', type: 'blob', content: JSON.stringify(val, null, 1) });
    }
    tree.push({ path: 'ai-organization/EXPORTED_AT.txt', mode: '100644', type: 'blob', content: String((exp as any).exported_at || new Date().toISOString()) });

    // Full DB schema mirror — keeps GitHub in sync with the live Supabase schema
    // (tables, functions, views, triggers, indexes, RLS, policies, cron; secret VALUES
    // and row data excluded). Best-effort: if it fails, still sync the org-as-code files.
    try {
      const { data: schema } = await admin.rpc('fn_schema_export');
      if (schema && typeof schema === 'string' && schema.length > 100) {
        tree.push({ path: 'supabase/schema/full_schema.sql', mode: '100644', type: 'blob', content: schema });
      }
    } catch (_e) { /* schema export is best-effort */ }

    const ref = await fetch(api + '/git/ref/heads/' + branch, { headers: H }).then(r => r.json());
    const headSha = ref?.object?.sha; if (!headSha) return J({ error: 'ref lookup failed: ' + JSON.stringify(ref).slice(0, 200) }, 500);
    const headCommit = await fetch(api + '/git/commits/' + headSha, { headers: H }).then(r => r.json());
    const baseTree = headCommit?.tree?.sha;

    const newTree = await fetch(api + '/git/trees', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ base_tree: baseTree, tree }) }).then(r => r.json());
    if (!newTree?.sha) return J({ error: 'tree failed: ' + JSON.stringify(newTree).slice(0, 200) }, 500);
    if (newTree.sha === baseTree) return J({ ok: true, changed: false, note: 'no changes since last sync' });

    const commit = await fetch(api + '/git/commits', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({
      message: 'org-as-code + schema: nightly sync ' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      tree: newTree.sha, parents: [headSha] }) }).then(r => r.json());
    if (!commit?.sha) return J({ error: 'commit failed: ' + JSON.stringify(commit).slice(0, 200) }, 500);
    const upd = await fetch(api + '/git/refs/heads/' + branch, { method: 'PATCH', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ sha: commit.sha }) }).then(r => r.json());
    if (!upd?.object?.sha) return J({ error: 'ref update failed: ' + JSON.stringify(upd).slice(0, 200) }, 500);
    return J({ ok: true, changed: true, commit: commit.sha, files: tree.length });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/inbound_email/index.ts

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type, x-webhook-secret' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
const SUPA_URL = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;

const FREE = new Set(['gmail.com','googlemail.com','yahoo.com','ymail.com','yahoo.co.uk','hotmail.com','hotmail.co.uk','outlook.com','live.com','msn.com','icloud.com','me.com','mac.com','aol.com','mail.com','gmx.com','gmx.net','protonmail.com','proton.me','yandex.com','zoho.com','rediffmail.com','hotmail.fr','outlook.sa']);

const KW: Record<string, string[]> = {
  flooring: ['floor', 'flooring', 'spc', 'vinyl', 'lvt', 'parquet', 'laminate', 'epoxy', 'tile', 'marble', 'granite', 'carpet'],
  glass: ['glass', 'glazing', 'mirror', 'shower enclosure', 'partition', 'facade', 'curtain wall', 'window'],
  aluminium: ['aluminium', 'aluminum', 'pergola', 'cladding', 'composite panel'],
  steel: ['steel', 'metal', 'fabrication', 'welding', 'staircase', 'railing', 'gate'],
  acrylic: ['acrylic', 'plexiglass', 'perspex', 'display stand'],
  carpentry: ['carpentry', 'wood', 'joinery', 'wardrobe', 'cabinet', 'kitchen', 'furniture', 'door'],
  gypsum: ['gypsum', 'false ceiling', 'drywall', 'partition wall', 'ceiling'],
  signage: ['sign', 'signage', '3d letters', 'lightbox', 'led sign', 'billboard', 'sticker'],
  wallpaper: ['wallpaper', 'wall covering'],
  upholstery: ['upholstery', 'sofa', 'curtain', 'blinds', 'cushion'],
  fitout: ['fitout', 'fit-out', 'fit out', 'interior', 'renovation', 'refurbish', 'turnkey', 'joinery works'],
  painting: ['paint', 'painting', 'varnish', 'coating'],
  landscaping: ['landscaping', 'garden', 'grass', 'artificial grass', 'irrigation', 'swimming pool'],
  scaffolding: ['scaffolding', 'scaffold', 'formwork'],
  security: ['cctv', 'camera', 'access control', 'intercom', 'alarm', 'security system'],
  safety: ['safety', 'ppe', 'fire extinguisher', 'fire alarm', 'first aid', 'helmet'],
};
function inferSector(text: string): string | null {
  const t = ' ' + text.toLowerCase() + ' ';
  let best: string | null = null, n = 0;
  for (const [c, ks] of Object.entries(KW)) { let m = 0; for (const k of ks) if (t.includes(k)) m++; if (m > n) { n = m; best = c; } }
  return best;
}
function domainOf(email: string): string { const m = String(email || '').toLowerCase().match(/@([^>\s]+)/); return m ? m[1].trim() : ''; }
const empty = (v: unknown) => v === null || v === undefined || (typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() === '');

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  if (req.method !== 'POST') return J({ error: 'POST only' }, 405);
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    // Auth: external inbound webhook uses its own dedicated secret (inbound_webhook_secret).
    // The internal RPC secret (inbound_secret) is also accepted for backward compatibility and
    // is what we forward to internal functions (profile_ai).
    const { data: secRows } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('key,value').in('key', ['inbound_webhook_secret', 'inbound_secret']);
    const whSecret = (secRows || []).find((r: { key: string; value: string }) => r.key === 'inbound_webhook_secret')?.value || '';
    const ibSecret = (secRows || []).find((r: { key: string; value: string }) => r.key === 'inbound_secret')?.value || '';
    const provided = req.headers.get('x-webhook-secret') || body.__secret || '';
    if (!provided || (provided !== whSecret && provided !== ibSecret)) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const sec = { value: ibSecret }; // internal secret for downstream calls

    const fromEmail = String(body.from || body.sender || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const fromName = String(body.from_name || '').trim();
    const subject = String(body.subject || '');
    const text = String(body.text || body.body || '');
    const atts = Array.isArray(body.attachments) ? body.attachments : [];
    const images = atts.filter((a: { mime?: string; content_type?: string; data?: string }) => {
      const m = String(a?.mime || a?.content_type || '');
      return a?.data && /^image\//i.test(m);
    }).map((a: { mime?: string; content_type?: string; data: string }) => ({ mime: a.mime || a.content_type, data: a.data }));
    if (!fromEmail) return J({ error: 'missing from' }, 400);
    const dom = domainOf(fromEmail);
    const isFree = FREE.has(dom);

    let lead: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
    const { data: exact } = await admin.from('leads').select('*').ilike('email', fromEmail);
    let candidates: number[] = [];
    if (exact && exact.length === 1) lead = exact[0];
    else if (exact && exact.length > 1) candidates = exact.map((r: { id: number }) => r.id);

    if (!lead && candidates.length === 0 && dom && !isFree) {
      const { data: dl } = await admin.from('leads').select('*').or(`email_domain.ilike.${dom},domain.ilike.${dom}`).order('reviews', { ascending: false, nullsFirst: false }).limit(1);
      if (dl && dl.length) lead = dl[0];
    }

    if (!lead && candidates.length > 1) {
      const { data: m } = await admin.from('inbound_messages').insert({
        lead_id: null, from_email: fromEmail, to_email: String(body.to || ''), subject, body: text.slice(0, 20000),
        attachments_count: atts.length, matched_existing: true, created_new_lead: false, ai_ok: false,
        needs_review: true, ai_notes: `ambiguous: ${candidates.length} companies share this email`, raw: { candidates },
      }).select('id').maybeSingle();
      return J({ ok: true, needs_review: true, reason: 'multiple companies share this email; queued for manual review', candidates, message_id: m?.id });
    }

    let createdNew = false;
    if (!lead) {
      const guessSector = inferSector(subject + ' ' + text);
      const ins = await admin.from('leads').insert({
        company_name: fromName || (isFree ? fromEmail : dom) || fromEmail,
        email: fromEmail, email_domain: dom || null, domain: isFree ? null : (dom || null),
        sector: guessSector, business_role: 'supplier',
        source: 'email_inbound', enrich_source: 'email_inbound',
        contacted: true, claimed: false, verified: false, permanently_closed: false,
      }).select('*').maybeSingle();
      lead = ins.data; createdNew = !!lead;
      if (!lead) return J({ error: 'could not create lead', detail: ins.error?.message }, 500);
    }

    let profile: Record<string, unknown> = {}; let aiOk = false; let aiNotes = '';
    try {
      const rr = await fetch(`${SUPA_URL}/functions/v1/profile_ai`, {
        method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: sec.value, company_name: lead.company_name, sector: lead.sector, emirate: lead.emirate, text: (subject ? subject + '\n\n' : '') + text, images }),
      });
      const jd = await rr.json();
      if (jd?.ok && jd.profile) { profile = jd.profile; aiOk = true; } else aiNotes = jd?.error || 'ai fallback';
    } catch (e) { aiNotes = String((e as Error)?.message || e); }

    const upd: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    const setField = (col: string, val: unknown) => {
      if (empty(val)) return;
      const cur = (lead as Record<string, unknown>)[col];
      if (lead!.verified && !empty(cur)) return;
      upd[col] = val;
    };
    if (aiOk) {
      setField('description', profile.description);
      setField('services', profile.services);
      setField('products', profile.products);
      setField('certifications', profile.certifications);
      setField('founded_year', profile.founded_year);
      setField('company_size', profile.company_size);
      setField('company_type', profile.company_type);
      setField('contact_name', profile.contact_name);
      setField('trade_license_no', profile.trade_license_no);
      setField('capability_summary', profile.capability_summary);
      if (Array.isArray(profile.service_emirates) && profile.service_emirates.length) {
        if (!(lead.verified && Array.isArray(lead.service_emirates) && lead.service_emirates.length)) upd.service_emirates = profile.service_emirates;
      }
      if (empty(lead.sector)) { const gs = inferSector([profile.services, profile.products, profile.description, subject, text].join(' ')); if (gs) upd.sector = gs; }
    }
    upd.contacted = true;
    upd.portal_updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
    if (Object.keys(upd).length) await admin.from('leads').update(upd).eq('id', lead.id);

    await admin.from('inbound_messages').insert({
      lead_id: lead.id, from_email: fromEmail, to_email: String(body.to || ''), subject, body: text.slice(0, 20000),
      attachments_count: atts.length, matched_existing: !createdNew, created_new_lead: createdNew,
      ai_ok: aiOk, needs_review: false, ai_notes: aiNotes || null, raw: { fields_updated: Object.keys(upd) },
    });

    return J({ ok: true, lead_id: lead.id, company: lead.company_name, matched_existing: !createdNew, created_new_lead: createdNew, ai_ok: aiOk, fields_updated: Object.keys(upd) });
  } catch (e) {
    return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500);
  }
});
```

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const SYS = `You are QuotesDone's AI sourcing agent for the UAE. Behave like an experienced, friendly salesperson/estimator who has sold across many industries — fit-out, signage & printing, acrylic, furniture & joinery, glass & aluminium, metal fabrication, elevators, flooring, landscaping & pools, building materials & procurement, events & catering, security & low-current (CCTV/access), MEP (electrical, fire, HVAC), and business/PRO services. A customer describes ANYTHING they want to buy, make, supply or get done; verified suppliers will quote it. Your job: turn their words / photos / transcribed voice into ONE clean brief a supplier's estimation team can price WITHOUT meeting the customer.

GOLDEN RULES
1) The customer usually does NOT know deep technical details (most people cannot name elevator drive types, paint grades, glass specs). NEVER ask them to choose technical systems or engineering specs. Capture the GENERAL things a normal person CAN answer about what they want; the SUPPLIER proposes the technical options and prices. Where the right choice is technical, do NOT ask it — note in the brief 'supplier to propose suitable options with prices'.
2) NO site visits, ever. Price from the description + photos / videos / reference images. If a visual would clearly help suppliers quote, ASK the customer (an easy item in 'missing', type "photo") to add photos, a short video, or a reference / AI-generated image — framed as 'helps suppliers quote accurately', never as a visit.
3) COMPLETENESS IS YOUR #1 JOB. The brief goes to competing suppliers who must return a FIRM FIXED PRICE with NO further contact with the customer. Think like the supplier's estimator for THIS exact item and capture EVERY attribute that materially changes the price — not just the obvious ones. Use the CATEGORY CHECKLIST provided in this conversation as a MINIMUM, but go BEYOND it for the specific item. Example: for a table, do not stop at top material, finish and size — also capture leg/base material & style, edge detail, and quantity. For a door, capture material, finish, size, quantity, AND ironmongery/handing/frame. Anything quote-critical that the customer has not yet given must go into 'missing'. Ask FEW, EASY questions per turn (1–4), always with concrete options so the customer just picks. Never re-ask something already answered. Do NOT ask about budget (collected separately).
4) UNKNOWNS: if the customer says they don't know an attribute (or picks a 'not sure' option), do NOT keep re-asking it. Record it in 'spec' as "<key>": "Not specified — supplier to propose options and price" and remove it from 'missing'. Genuine unknowns must be captured this way (visible to suppliers as an open item), never silently dropped.
5) COMPLIANCE / ENGINEERING CODE: engineering & regulated systems must be assumed to follow UAE code BY DEFAULT. A COMPLIANCE REFERENCE is provided separately. When the request involves a regulated system (CCTV/SIRA, fire alarm & firefighting, electrical/power, lifts & escalators, gas, HVAC fire dampers, signage permits, glazing, telecom/cabling, pools, commercial kitchens, building permit/NOC, clinics), do NOT ask the customer technical or code questions. Instead: (a) append ONE short plain clause to the summary that it must comply with the governing UAE authority/standard 'unless the customer specifies otherwise'; and (b) populate compliance[]. If the customer EXPLICITLY asked for a non-standard spec, respect it and capture it in compliance[].note. Stay advisory; the supplier remains responsible for code-compliant design & approvals.
6) PRIVACY / ANONYMITY: the brief is shown to competing suppliers before any contact is paid for. NEVER put into summary or spec the customer's name, phone, email, company/brand name, or an EXACT address. Location must be AREA + EMIRATE only. Strip any such identifiers the customer included.
7) LANGUAGE: Detect the language of the customer's words and mirror it. Write every CUSTOMER-FACING 'question' and its 'options' in THAT language. When the customer writes in Arabic, write in warm, natural, fluent Gulf business Arabic (Modern Standard Arabic) as a real UAE-market salesperson speaks — NOT a literal translation. Use ، and ؟. ALWAYS keep numbers, quantities, measurements, dimensions, currency (AED), percentages, dates, and Latin technical terms/brands/units (sqm, mm, SPC, CCTV, MEP, LED) in Latin script with Western digits 0-9 (250, not ٢٥٠). Keep MACHINE fields (request_type, category, scope_type, trades, emirate) as the English values defined here, and write the supplier-facing 'summary' in English so suppliers read a consistent brief. 'notes' may be in English.

SCOPE
QuotesDone sources real purchases: products & materials, custom-made items, building elements & systems, and services quotable remotely. NOT for: small maintenance/repair, tiny jobs under ~AED 1,000, or anything that genuinely needs a physical site visit to price. If clearly one of those, set out_of_scope=true with a short reason, but still produce the brief.

CLASSIFY
- request_type: product_supply | custom_made | construction_supply | service | event_catering | other.
- category: reuse an EXISTING category key from the provided list when one truly fits; otherwise output a NEW concise lowercase slug for the supplier type to route to. category=null only if truly unclassifiable.
- scope_type: 'single' | 'multi' | 'turnkey'.
- trades: list of short lowercase tags = supplier types, materials and search keywords to route/match. Be generous and specific.

EMIRATE: exactly one of Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Umm Al Quwain, Fujairah, or null. Resolve any UAE district to its parent emirate; put ONLY the general area/community in spec.location — NEVER a building/tower/villa name, unit number, street, plot or makani, or full address.

SPEC: fill a field only with info the customer actually gave or clearly visible in media. Never invent filler. Every key is in spec OR missing, never both. Never place a name, phone, email, company or exact address into any spec field.

MISSING (questions) — each item: {"key":string,"question":string (short, plain),"type":"select"|"multiselect"|"number"|"text"|"photo","options":[string],"required":boolean}. Prefer select/multiselect with 2–6 concrete options (+ a 'Not sure' style option); number for quantity/size/count; "photo" (empty options) to ask for images/reference/drawing; text only when options cannot capture it. required=true only when a quote genuinely depends on it.

OUTPUT: a one-line supplier-facing summary (area + emirate only, no identity), then STRICT JSON ONLY (no markdown), exact shape:
{"request_type":string,"out_of_scope":boolean,"out_of_scope_reason":string,"category":string|null,"emirate":string|null,"spec":object,"summary":string,"scope_type":"single"|"multi"|"turnkey","trades":[string],"compliance":[{"system":string,"authority":string,"standard":string,"note":string}],"missing":[{"key":string,"question":string,"type":string,"options":[string],"required":boolean}],"confidence":number,"notes":string}`;

const EST_SYS = `You are the senior UAE estimator for this trade, finalising the exact questions a customer will answer so competing suppliers can return a FIRM FIXED-PRICE quote with NO further contact.

You are given: your trade knowledge, the category reference checklist, the details already captured (spec), and a DRAFT list of questions already prepared. Produce the FINAL question set the customer will see.

RULES:
- Include every attribute genuinely required to price THIS specific item. Add anything quote-critical that is missing (reason like a specialist: a table needs leg/base material and edge detail; CCTV needs footage retention and SIRA status; a door needs handing and ironmongery).
- MERGE duplicates and overlapping questions into ONE. Never ask the same thing twice in different words.
- DROP low-value questions and anything the supplier should decide.
- Keep it SHORT: at most 8 questions, most important first. It must feel easy for a normal customer.
- EVERY question must be answerable by TAPPING an option. Use "select"/"multiselect" with 2-6 concrete options and ALWAYS include a "Not sure" option; use "number" only for a pure quantity/count; for sizes/dimensions offer common ranges as a select plus an "Other / not sure" option. Use "text" ONLY when it is genuinely impossible to enumerate (avoid it).
- When a photo, site picture, reference image or drawing would materially help suppliers price the job, include ONE question with type "photo" and empty options asking for it (the customer can attach several); mark it required only if a firm price truly needs a visual.
- Do NOT ask budget, technical/engineering/code choices, or the customer identity/contact. Do NOT ask anything already answered in spec.
- Write questions and options in the SAME language the customer used.

Output STRICT JSON ONLY: {"missing":[{"key":string,"question":string,"type":"select"|"multiselect"|"number"|"text"|"photo","options":[string],"required":boolean}]}`;

function parseJson(txt: string) {
  try { return JSON.parse(txt); } catch { /* */ }
  const m = txt.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
  if (m) { try { return JSON.parse(m[0]); } catch { /* */ } }
  throw new Error('AI returned non-JSON');
}

const EMIRATES = ['Dubai','Abu Dhabi','Sharjah','Ajman','Ras Al Khaimah','Umm Al Quwain','Fujairah'];
const PLACE_TO_EMIRATE: Record<string,string> = {
  'al ain':'Abu Dhabi','liwa':'Abu Dhabi','madinat zayed':'Abu Dhabi','khalifa city':'Abu Dhabi','yas':'Abu Dhabi','yas island':'Abu Dhabi','saadiyat':'Abu Dhabi','mussafah':'Abu Dhabi','al reem':'Abu Dhabi','reem island':'Abu Dhabi','al raha':'Abu Dhabi','abudhabi':'Abu Dhabi','abu dhabi':'Abu Dhabi',
  'business bay':'Dubai','deira':'Dubai','jumeirah':'Dubai','marina':'Dubai','dubai marina':'Dubai','jlt':'Dubai','bur dubai':'Dubai','silicon oasis':'Dubai','mirdif':'Dubai','al barsha':'Dubai','downtown':'Dubai','jvc':'Dubai','damac hills':'Dubai','dubai':'Dubai',
  'al nahda':'Sharjah','muweilah':'Sharjah','sharjah':'Sharjah',
  'ajman':'Ajman','rak':'Ras Al Khaimah','ras al khaimah':'Ras Al Khaimah','uaq':'Umm Al Quwain','umm al quwain':'Umm Al Quwain','fujairah':'Fujairah'
};
function normalizeEmirate(ai: { emirate?: string|null; spec?: Record<string,unknown> }, hint: string) {
  const e = (ai.emirate || '').trim();
  const canon = EMIRATES.find((x) => x.toLowerCase() === e.toLowerCase());
  if (canon) return canon;
  const hay = (hint + ' ' + JSON.stringify(ai.spec || {}) + ' ' + e).toLowerCase();
  for (const [place, em] of Object.entries(PLACE_TO_EMIRATE)) {
    if (new RegExp('\\b' + place.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&') + '\\b').test(hay)) return em;
  }
  return null;
}
const NOTSURE_RE = /not sure|don'?t know|لست متأك|لا أعرف|غير متأكد|supplier to (propose|advise)/i;
function hasNotSure(options: string[]) { return options.some((o) => NOTSURE_RE.test(o)); }
function mergeMissing(spec: Record<string, unknown>, ...lists: any[][]) {
  const bad = ['maybe','tbc','n/a','na','not sure','unknown','no, need design','need design','none','-'];
  for (const k of Object.keys(spec)) { const v = spec[k]; if (v === null || v === undefined) { delete spec[k]; continue; } if (typeof v === 'string' && bad.includes(v.trim().toLowerCase())) delete spec[k]; }
  const out: any[] = []; const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const list of lists) {
    for (const m of (Array.isArray(list) ? list : [])) {
      if (!m || !m.key) continue;
      const key = String(m.key); const lk = key.toLowerCase();
      if (key in spec || seen.has(lk)) continue;
      let type = ['select','multiselect','number','text','photo'].includes(m.type) ? m.type : 'text';
      let options = Array.isArray(m.options) ? m.options.map((o: any) => String(o)).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 8) : [];
      const required = m.required !== false;
      if (type === 'photo') { options = []; }
      else if ((type === 'select' || type === 'multiselect') && options.length < 2) { type = 'text'; options = []; }
      if ((type === 'select' || type === 'multiselect') && required && !hasNotSure(options)) options = options.concat(['Not sure — supplier to advise']);
      seen.add(lk);
      out.push({ key, question: String(m.question || key), type, options, required });
    }
  }
  return out.slice(0, 8);
}

async function callModel(key: string, system: string, parts: { text?: string; img?: { mime: string; data: string } }[], maxTokens: number) {
  const content: unknown[] = [];
  for (const p of parts) { if (p.text) content.push({ type: 'text', text: p.text }); if (p.img) content.push({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: `data:${p.img.mime};base64,${p.img.data}` } }); }
  const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${key}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'HTTP-Referer': 'https://quotesdone.com', 'X-Title': 'QuotesDone' }, body: JSON.stringify({ models: MODELS, max_tokens: maxTokens, temperature: 0.15, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: system }, { role: 'user', content }] }) });
  const d = await r.json();
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(d?.error?.message || 'openrouter error');
  return parseJson(d?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '{}');
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    let ok = false; let who = 'anon';
    const auth = req.headers.get('Authorization') || ''; const jwt = auth.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
    if (jwt) { const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt); if (user) { ok = true; who = (user.email || user.id || 'user').toLowerCase(); } }
    if (!ok && body.__test) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', 'test_token').maybeSingle(); if (data && body.__test === data.value) { ok = true; who = 'test'; } }
    if (!ok) return J({ error: 'Not signed in' }, 401);

    const hourAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 3600e3).toISOString();
    const { count: usedC } = await admin.from('ai_usage').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('email', who).gte('created_at', hourAgo);
    if ((usedC || 0) >= AI_LIMIT_PER_HOUR) return J({ error: 'Too many requests right now. Please try again in a little while.' }, 429);
    await admin.from('ai_usage').insert({ email: who, kind: 'inquiry' });

    const { data: sec } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', 'openrouter_api_key').maybeSingle();
    if (!sec?.value) return J({ error: 'AI not configured', fallback: true }, 200);
    const key = sec.value;

    const { data: specs } = await admin.from('category_specs').select('category,label,fields');
    const catalog = (specs || []).map((s: { category: string; label: string }) => ({ category: s.category, label: s.label }));
    const { data: cref } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', 'compliance_ref').maybeSingle();

    const parts: { text?: string; img?: { mime: string; data: string } }[] = [];
    parts.push({ text: 'EXISTING CATEGORIES (reuse a key only when one truly fits; otherwise create a new concise lowercase category slug):\n' + JSON.stringify(catalog) });
    if (cref?.value) parts.push({ text: String(cref.value) });
    const textHint = body.text ? String(body.text).slice(0, 6000) : '';
    if (textHint) parts.push({ text: 'CUSTOMER REQUEST (typed and/or transcribed voice, including any answers already given): ' + textHint });
    if (body.emirate) parts.push({ text: 'EMIRATE already chosen by customer: ' + body.emirate });
    const imgs: { mime: string; data: string }[] = [];
    if (Array.isArray(body.images)) { for (const im of body.images.slice(0, 5)) { if (im?.data && im?.mime) { imgs.push({ mime: im.mime, data: im.data }); parts.push({ img: { mime: im.mime, data: im.data } }); } } }
    if (parts.length <= 2 && !imgs.length) return J({ error: 'Nothing to analyze' }, 400);

    let ai;
    try { ai = await callModel(key, SYS, parts, 2600); } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e), fallback: true }, 200); }

    ai.emirate = normalizeEmirate(ai, textHint + ' ' + (body.emirate || ''));
    ai.spec = ai.spec && typeof ai.spec === 'object' ? ai.spec : {};
    ai.scope_type = ['single','multi','turnkey'].includes(ai.scope_type) ? ai.scope_type : 'single';
    ai.trades = Array.isArray(ai.trades) ? ai.trades.map((t: any) => String(t).toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 16) : [];
    ai.compliance = Array.isArray(ai.compliance) ? ai.compliance.filter((c: any) => c && (c.system || c.authority)).slice(0, 8) : [];
    ai.out_of_scope = ai.out_of_scope === true;
    const chosen0 = catalog.find((c) => c.category === ai.category);
    ai.label = chosen0?.label || ai.category;

    // Resolve the best-matching expert sales agent for this trade, and load its persona + verified knowledge.
    let expert: any = null; let expertKnowledge = '';
    if (!ai.out_of_scope) {
      try {
        const { data: agents } = await admin.from('category_agents').select('slug,name,persona').eq('active', true);
        const STOP = new Set(['and','the','for','with','services','service','supply','supplies','system','systems','custom','made','installation','install','works','work','general','trading','solutions','company','contracting','contractors','materials','material','equipment','products','product','repair','maintenance','design','uae','dubai','abu','dhabi','sharjah','ajman','fujairah']);
        const clean = (str: string) => String(str || '').toLowerCase().split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).filter((w: string) => w.length > 2 && !STOP.has(w));
        const cat = String(ai.category || '');
        const catToks = new Set(clean(cat));
        const allToks = new Set([...clean(cat), ...clean(ai.label || ''), ...(Array.isArray(ai.trades) ? ai.trades.flatMap((t: any) => clean(String(t))) : [])]);
        let best: any = null; let bestScore = 0;
        for (const a of (agents || [])) {
          if (cat && a.slug === cat) { best = a; bestScore = 99; break; }
          const at = new Set(clean((a.slug || '') + ' ' + (a.name || '')));
          let sc = 0; for (const t of at) { if (catToks.has(t)) sc += 2; else if (allToks.has(t)) sc += 1; }
          if (sc > bestScore) { bestScore = sc; best = a; }
        }
        if (best && bestScore >= 2) {
          expert = best;
          const { data: kt } = await admin.from('agent_knowledge').select('topic,content').eq('agent_key', 'cat:' + best.slug).order('priority', { ascending: false }).limit(8);
          expertKnowledge = (kt || []).map((k: any) => '### ' + k.topic + '\n' + k.content).join('\n\n').slice(0, 8000);
        }
      } catch (_e) { /* expert resolution is best-effort */ }
    }

    let estMissing: any[] = [];
    if (!ai.out_of_scope) {
      try {
        const chk = (specs || []).find((s: { category: string; fields: unknown }) => s.category === ai.category);
        const draft = Array.isArray(ai.missing) ? ai.missing : [];
        const estParts: { text?: string; img?: { mime: string; data: string } }[] = [];
        if (expert) estParts.push({ text: 'YOU ARE ' + expert.name + ', QuotesDone\'s expert sales estimator for this exact trade. Reason with the depth and instincts of a specialist who prices this every day.' });
        if (expertKnowledge) estParts.push({ text: 'YOUR VERIFIED TRADE KNOWLEDGE (use it to know precisely what drives price and what MUST be specified to give a firm quote):\n' + expertKnowledge });
        if (expert && expert.persona) estParts.push({ text: 'YOUR PERSONA / STYLE:\n' + String(expert.persona).slice(0, 1500) });
        estParts.push({ text: 'CATEGORY: ' + (ai.category || 'unknown') + (ai.label ? (' (' + ai.label + ')') : '') });
        estParts.push({ text: 'REFERENCE CHECKLIST for this category (minimum fields; JSON, may be empty):\n' + JSON.stringify(chk?.fields || []) });
        estParts.push({ text: 'SUPPLIER-FACING SUMMARY:\n' + String(ai.summary || '') });
        estParts.push({ text: 'DETAILS ALREADY CAPTURED (spec JSON):\n' + JSON.stringify(ai.spec || {}) });
        estParts.push({ text: 'DRAFT QUESTIONS already prepared (consolidate + dedupe + extend these into the FINAL list):\n' + JSON.stringify(draft) });
        if (textHint) estParts.push({ text: 'CUSTOMER ORIGINAL WORDS + ANSWERS SO FAR:\n' + textHint });
        for (const im of imgs) estParts.push({ img: im });
        const est = await callModel(key, EST_SYS, estParts, 1500);
        estMissing = Array.isArray(est?.missing) ? est.missing : [];
      } catch (_e) { /* estimator gate is best-effort; never blocks intake */ }
    }

    const finalList = (estMissing && estMissing.length) ? estMissing : (Array.isArray(ai.missing) ? ai.missing : []);
    ai.missing = mergeMissing(ai.spec, finalList);
    ai.needs_more = ai.missing.some((m: any) => m.required);
    ai.agent = expert ? expert.slug : null;

    return J({ ok: true, ...ai, label: ai.label, fields: [] });
  } catch (e) {
    return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e), fallback: true }, 200);
  }
});
```

### supabase/functions/inquiry_dedup_check/index.ts

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
    const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
    if (!user || !user.email) return J({ error: 'Not signed in' }, 401);
    const { data: cust } = await admin.from('customers').select('id').eq('email', user.email.toLowerCase()).maybeSingle();
    if (!cust) return J({ duplicate: false });
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const summary = String(body.summary || body.text || '').slice(0, 500);
    const hours = Math.min(Math.max(Number(body.hours) || 72, 1), 720);
    if (summary.length < 13) return J({ duplicate: false });
    const { data: dupId } = await admin.rpc('recent_duplicate_inquiry', { p_customer: cust.id, p_summary: summary, p_window: hours + ' hours' });
    if (!dupId) return J({ duplicate: false });
    const { data: inq } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('id,summary,category,emirate,created_at,status').eq('id', dupId).maybeSingle();
    return J({ duplicate: true, inquiry: inq || { id: dupId } });
  } catch (e) { return J({ duplicate: false, error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/inquiry_intake/index.ts
