    const { data } = await admin.from('agent_runs').select('id').eq('agent', 'kb_ingest')
      .gte('started_at', since).eq('counts->>signal', signal).limit(1);
    if (data && data.length) return;
  } catch (_e) { /* if the check fails, fall through and log */ }
  await logRun(status, { ...counts, signal }, note);
}
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full

// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
function chunkText(t: string, target = 1800): string[] {
  const clean = String(t||'').replace(/␀/g,' ').replace(/[ \t]+/g,' ').replace(/\n{3,}/g,'\n\n').trim();
  if (!clean) return [];
  const paras = clean.split(/\n\n+/); const out: string[] = []; let buf = '';
  for (const p of paras) {
    if ((buf + '\n\n' + p).length > target && buf) { out.push(buf.trim()); buf = p; }
    else buf = buf ? (buf + '\n\n' + p) : p;
    while (buf.length > target*1.6) { out.push(buf.slice(0, target).trim()); buf = buf.slice(target); }
  }
  if (buf.trim()) out.push(buf.trim());
  return out.filter(c => c.length > 40);
}
async function ingestOne(s: any) {
  const { data: blob, error: derr } = await admin.storage.from('compliance-docs').download(s.doc_path);
  if (derr || !blob) { await logThrottled('download_failed:'+s.id, 60, 'error', { stage:'download', source_id:s.id, authority:s.authority }, 'kb_ingest cannot download the compliance PDF for source ' + s.id + ' (' + s.authority + ' / ' + s.topic + '), so its clauses are missing from the knowledge base and agents will answer compliance questions without this authority document. It will be retried forever without progressing. ' + String(derr?.message||'no blob').slice(0,160)); return { id: s.id, authority: s.authority, error: 'download:'+(derr?.message||'no blob') }; }
  const buf = new Uint8Array(await blob.arrayBuffer());
  const pdf = await getDocumentProxy(buf);
  const { text, totalPages } = await extractText(pdf, { mergePages: true });
  const chunks = chunkText(String(text||''));
  if (!chunks.length) { await logThrottled('no_text:'+s.id, 60, 'error', { stage:'extract', source_id:s.id, authority:s.authority, pages: totalPages }, 'Compliance document ' + s.id + ' (' + s.authority + ' / ' + s.topic + ') yielded no extractable text (scanned/image PDF), so it is never indexed. It blocks the queue and is re-attempted on every run, and agents cannot cite this authority.'); return { id: s.id, authority: s.authority, pages: totalPages, chunks: 0, note: 'no_text (scanned/image PDF?)' }; }
  const cite = `${s.authority} — ${s.topic}` + (s.url ? ` [${s.url}]` : '');
  const { error: delErr } = await admin.from('kb_chunks').delete().like('source_id', 'compliance:'+s.id+'#%');
  if (delErr) await logRun('error', { stage:'delete_old', source_id:s.id }, 'kb_ingest could not clear the previous chunks for compliance source ' + s.id + ' before re-indexing; the knowledge base may now hold duplicate or superseded clauses for ' + s.authority + '. ' + String(delErr?.message||delErr).slice(0,160));
  const rows = chunks.map((c, i) => ({ source_kind: 'document', source_id: 'compliance:'+s.id+'#'+i, category: null, title: s.topic, content: c, citation: cite, effective_date: null }));

  if (insFailed > 0) await logThrottled('insert_failed:'+s.id, 60, 'error', { stage:'insert', source_id:s.id, authority:s.authority, inserted:ins, failed:insFailed }, 'kb_ingest failed to index ' + insFailed + ' of ' + rows.length + ' chunk(s) for compliance source ' + s.id + ' (' + s.authority + '); those clauses are missing from the knowledge base and, if none landed, this document blocks the ingest queue on every run. ' + lastInsErr);
  else await logRun('ok', { stage:'ingest', source_id:s.id, authority:s.authority, pages: totalPages, chunks: ins }, 'kb_ingest indexed ' + ins + ' chunk(s) from compliance document ' + s.id + ' (' + s.authority + ' / ' + s.topic + ').');
  return { id: s.id, authority: s.authority, topic: s.topic, pages: totalPages, chunks: ins };
}
Deno.serve(async (req) => {

    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) { await logThrottled('forbidden', 60, 'error', { stage:'auth' }, 'kb_ingest rejected a caller presenting a bad or missing inbound secret. If this is the scheduled drainer, no authority/compliance documents are being indexed and agents are answering compliance questions from summaries only.'); return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403); }
    const minBytes = Number(body.min_bytes) || 50000;
    if (body.id) {
      const { data } = await admin.from('compliance_sources').select('id,authority,topic,url,doc_path,doc_bytes,doc_content_type').eq('id', Number(body.id)).maybeSingle();
      if (!data) { await logRun('error', { stage:'lookup', requested_id: Number(body.id) }, 'kb_ingest was asked to ingest compliance source ' + Number(body.id) + ' but no such row exists, so the requested authority document was never indexed.'); return J({ ok:false, error:'not_found' }); }
      return J({ ok:true, results:[ await ingestOne(data) ] });
    }
    // queue mode: find one real PDF not yet ingested
    const { data: srcs, error: srcErr } = await admin.from('compliance_sources').select('id,authority,topic,url,doc_path,doc_bytes,doc_content_type').not('doc_path','is',null).order('id');
    if (srcErr) await logThrottled('sources_query_failed', 60, 'error', { stage:'queue' }, 'kb_ingest could not read compliance_sources, so it reports the queue as fully ingested while authority documents may be waiting; compliance clauses silently stop being added to the knowledge base. ' + String(srcErr?.message||srcErr).slice(0,160));
    const real = (srcs||[]).filter((s:any)=> (s.doc_content_type||'').includes('pdf') && (s.doc_bytes||0) >= minBytes);
    for (const s of real) {
      const { count } = await admin.from('kb_chunks').select('id',{count:'exact',head:true}).like('source_id','compliance:'+s.id+'#%');
      if (!count) { const r = await ingestOne(s); return J({ ok:true, mode:'queue', processed: r, remaining_estimate: real.length }); }
    }
    return J({ ok:true, mode:'queue', processed: null, note:'all real documents already ingested' });
  } catch (e) { await logThrottled('fatal', 60, 'error', { stage:'fatal' }, 'kb_ingest crashed while ingesting an authority document (likely PDF parsing or memory); the same document will be retried every run and the compliance knowledge base stops growing. ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0,200)); return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});

  for (const p of paras) {
    if ((buf + '\n\n' + p).length > target && buf) { out.push(buf.trim()); buf = p; }
    else buf = buf ? (buf + '\n\n' + p) : p;

    return J({ ok: true, source_id, chunks: ins, stored });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }

### supabase/functions/kb_search/index.ts

```typescript
// kb_search — hybrid knowledge retrieval: semantic (gte-small vector) + full-text, merged with
// reciprocal-rank fusion so keyword precision and semantic recall combine robustly (also while the
// embedding backfill is still running). Secret-guarded. Input: { query, k?, category? }.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
const RRF_K = 60;
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const query = String(body.query || '').slice(0, 800);
    if (!query) return J({ error: 'query required' }, 400);
    const k = Math.min(Math.max(Number(body.k) || 8, 1), 20);
    const category = body.category ? String(body.category) : null;
    const pool = 20;
    const rec: Record<number, any> = {};
    const add = (r: any, rank: number, tag: string) => {
      const e = rec[r.id] || (rec[r.id] = { id: r.id, category: r.category, title: r.title, citation: r.citation, snippet: String(r.content || '').slice(0, 400), score: 0, via: [] as string[], similarity: null as number | null });
      e.score += 1 / (RRF_K + rank);
      if (!e.via.includes(tag)) e.via.push(tag);
      if (typeof r.similarity === 'number') e.similarity = Math.round(r.similarity * 1000) / 1000;
    };
    // 1) semantic (only over embedded rows)
    try {
      // deno-lint-ignore no-explicit-any
      const model = new (globalThis as any).Supabase.ai.Session('gte-small');
      const emb = await model.run(query, { mean_pool: true, normalize: true }) as number[];
      const { data: vec } = await admin.rpc('kb_match', { query_embedding: '[' + emb.join(',') + ']', match_count: pool, p_category: category });
      (vec || []).forEach((r: any, i: number) => add(r, i, 'semantic'));
    } catch (_e) { /* semantic optional; fall back to keyword */ }
    // 2) full-text
    let ftsQ = admin.from('kb_chunks').select('id, category, title, citation, content').textSearch('fts', query, { type: 'websearch', config: 'english' }).limit(pool);
    if (category) ftsQ = ftsQ.eq('category', category);
    const { data: fts } = await ftsQ;
    (fts || []).forEach((r: any, i: number) => add(r, i, 'keyword'));
    const results = Object.values(rec).sort((a: any, b: any) => b.score - a.score).slice(0, k)
      .map((e: any) => ({ id: e.id, category: e.category, title: e.title, citation: e.citation, snippet: e.snippet, similarity: e.similarity, via: e.via.join('+') }));
    return J({ ok: true, query, count: results.length, results });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});

// knowledge_exam — proactive auto-learning loop. For a target agent it (1) generates fresh domain
// questions + reference answers (examiner), (2) makes the agent answer using ONLY its own knowledge
// context (examinee — reveals coverage gaps), (3) has an INDEPENDENT grader model judge the answer and
// supply the correct fact, and (4) AUTO-WRITES a correction into agent_knowledge — but only when the two
// independent models converge on the fact AND it passes the policy poison-lint. Fills are provenance-
// tagged (topic 'exam:…') so they are auditable and bulk-revertible. Logs every attempt to knowledge_exam_results.
// No human approval step by design — safety comes from model-convergence + lint, not clicking.
// v2: examiner and examinee are now grounded on the DEEP knowledge corpus (kb_chunks via kb_search),
// so the exam probes and measures true retrieval-augmented mastery, not just the capped context layer.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, OPUS_FIRST, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const SUPA = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
const T0 = Date.now();
// Retrieve from the DEEP knowledge corpus (kb_chunks) exactly as production agents do, so the exam
// probes — and the examinee answers from — the real retrieval-augmented knowledge, not just the
// capped fn_agent_context layer. Without this the exam under-measures and flags false gaps.
async function deepKb(query: string, category: string | null, k: number): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const secret = await sec('inbound_secret'); if (!secret || !query.trim()) return '';
    const r = await fetch(SUPA + '/functions/v1/kb_search', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: secret, query: query.slice(0, 800), k, ...(category ? { category } : {}) }) });
    const j = await r.json(); const rows = (j && Array.isArray(j.results)) ? j.results : [];
    if (!rows.length) return '';
    return rows.map((x: any) => '- [' + (x.citation || x.category || 'ref') + '] ' + String(x.snippet || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 400)).join('\n');
  } catch (_e) { return ''; }
}
const examiner = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 1600, temperature: 0.4 });   // writes the curriculum
const grader   = makeLlm(OPUS_FIRST,   { max: 1600, temperature: 0.1 });   // independent judge + ground truth
const examinee = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 1200, temperature: 0.2 });   // answers, constrained to its KB
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try { await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'knowledge_exam', status, counts, note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500), started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() }); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
}
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
function parseJson(s: string): any { if (!s) return null; let t = String(s).trim().replace(/^```(?:json)?/i, '').replace(/```$/,'').trim(); const a = t.indexOf('['), o = t.indexOf('{'); const start = (a >= 0 && (o < 0 || a < o)) ? a : o; if (start > 0) t = t.slice(start); try { return JSON.parse(t); } catch (_e) { return null; } }
// crude convergence: do two independently-produced answers share their significant terms?
function converged(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  const norm = (x: string) => new Set(String(x || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9%\s.]/g, ' ').split(/\s+/).filter((w) => w.length > 3));
  const A = norm(a), B = norm(b); if (!A.size || !B.size) return false;
  let inter = 0; for (const w of A) if (B.has(w)) inter++;
  const jac = inter / (A.size + B.size - inter);
  // also require agreement on any numbers/codes present (a wrong figure must not pass)
  const nums = (x: string) => (String(x || '').match(/\b\d[\d.,]*\b/g) || []).map((n) => n.replace(/[.,]$/, ''));
  const na = nums(a), nb = nums(b); const numsOk = na.length === 0 || na.some((n) => nb.includes(n));
  return jac >= 0.3 && numsOk;
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const nGen = Math.max(0, Math.min(20, Number(body.generate) ?? 6));
    const nAns = Math.max(1, Math.min(20, Number(body.answer) ?? 8));

    // 1) resolve target agent: explicit, or the real agent (has knowledge) least-recently examined
    let key: string = String(body.agent_key || '').trim();
    if (!key) {
      const { data: roster } = await admin.rpc('fn_exam_pick_agent');
      key = (roster as any) || '';
    }
    if (!key) { await logRun('skipped', {}, 'no agent to examine'); return J({ ok: true, note: 'no agent' }); }
    let label = key;
    if (key.startsWith('cat:')) { const { data: ca } = await admin.from('category_agents').select('name').eq('slug', key.slice(4)).maybeSingle(); if (ca?.name) label = (ca as any).name + ' specialist'; }

    // 2) the agent's actual knowledge context (what it reasons from) + its DEEP corpus region
    const cat = key.startsWith('cat:') ? key.slice(4) : key;   // deep chunks are category-scoped to this slug
    const { data: ctxRaw } = await admin.rpc('fn_agent_context', { p_agent_key: key, p_max_chars: 16000 });
    const kb = String(ctxRaw || '').slice(0, 16000);
    // Deep material for the examiner's remit — lets it write questions that probe true mastery.
    const remitDeep = await deepKb(label + ' UAE Dubai key materials standards authorities pricing', cat, 8);

    // 3) examiner writes fresh questions (+ reference answers), avoiding recent duplicates
    const { data: recentQs } = await admin.from('knowledge_exam_questions').select('question').eq('agent_key', key).order('id', { ascending: false }).limit(60);
    const seen = (recentQs || []).map((r: any) => '- ' + r.question).join('\n');
    let generated = 0;
    if (nGen > 0) {
      const gsys = 'You are a rigorous examiner building a competency test for the "' + label + '" agent at QuotesDone, a UAE (Dubai-focused) B2B sourcing marketplace. Use the AGENT REMIT below to test the knowledge THIS agent actually needs for its role: for a trade specialist that means UAE governing authorities/permits, technical standards, scope & specs, price drivers and compliance red flags; for a functional role (finance, legal, IT, analytics, marketing, operations) it means the professional, regulatory and platform knowledge that role needs in the UAE context. Produce hard, SPECIFIC, factually-answerable questions with a definite correct answer, and give each correct concise answer (<=240 chars). Output ONLY a JSON array: [{"question":"...","answer":"...","topic":"authority|standards|scope|pricing|compliance|domain","difficulty":"core|edge"}]. HARD RULE: never invent code numbers, authority names or figures — if unsure of an exact number, phrase the answer by naming the requirement without a fabricated number.\n\nAGENT REMIT (excerpt of its live knowledge):\n' + (kb ? kb.slice(0, 1400) : '(sparse — infer the role from the agent name "' + label + '")') + (remitDeep ? '\n\nDEEP REFERENCE MATERIAL (the specialist carries this — probe it):\n' + remitDeep.slice(0, 2000) : '');
      const guser = 'Domain: ' + label + '. Market: UAE (Dubai). Write ' + nGen + ' new questions. Do NOT repeat any of these already-asked questions:\n' + (seen || '(none yet)');
      const gout = parseJson((await examiner(gsys, guser)) || '');
      if (Array.isArray(gout)) {
        const rows = gout.filter((q: any) => q && q.question).slice(0, nGen).map((q: any) => ({ agent_key: key, question: String(q.question).slice(0, 600), reference_answer: String(q.answer || '').slice(0, 600), topic: String(q.topic || 'general').slice(0, 40), difficulty: String(q.difficulty || 'core').slice(0, 12) }));
        if (rows.length) { const { data: ins } = await admin.from('knowledge_exam_questions').insert(rows).select('id'); generated = (ins || []).length; }
      }
    }

    // 4) pick the batch to test: least-recently-asked (new rows have null last_asked → first)
    const { data: batch } = await admin.from('knowledge_exam_questions').select('id,question,reference_answer,topic').eq('agent_key', key).order('last_asked', { ascending: true, nullsFirst: true }).limit(nAns);
    const qs = batch || [];
    if (!qs.length) { await logRun('ok', { generated, examined: 0 }, 'generated ' + generated + ' questions for ' + key + '; none to test yet'); return J({ ok: true, agent: key, generated, examined: 0 }); }

    // 5) examinee answers using its knowledge base — fn_agent_context PLUS the deep corpus it would
    //    retrieve in production (kb_search on the batch questions), so the exam mirrors real ability.
    const qList = qs.map((q: any, i: number) => (i + 1) + '. ' + q.question).join('\n');
    const answerDeep = await deepKb(qs.map((q: any) => q.question).join(' '), cat, 10);
    const esysKb = (kb || '(empty)') + (answerDeep ? '\n\nRETRIEVED REFERENCE KNOWLEDGE (deep corpus, same as production retrieval):\n' + answerDeep : '');
    const esys = 'You are the "' + label + '" specialist agent. Answer each question using ONLY the KNOWLEDGE BASE provided. If the knowledge base does not clearly contain the answer, reply exactly "NOT_COVERED" for that item — do not guess from general knowledge. Output ONLY a JSON array of strings, one answer per question in order.\n\nKNOWLEDGE BASE:\n' + esysKb;
    const eout = parseJson((await examinee(esys, 'Questions:\n' + qList)) || '');
    const answers: string[] = Array.isArray(eout) ? eout.map((x: any) => String(x)) : qs.map(() => '__NO_ANSWER__');

    // 6) independent grader judges + supplies ground truth
    const gradeItems = qs.map((q: any, i: number) => ({ n: i + 1, question: q.question, agent_answer: answers[i] || '' }));
    const jsys = 'You are an independent expert examiner for "' + label + '" in the UAE (Dubai). For each item you are given a question and the agent\'s answer. Independently determine the correct answer yourself, then judge the agent\'s answer. Output ONLY a JSON array: [{"n":<num>,"correct_answer":"<your concise correct answer, <=240 chars>","verdict":"correct|partial|wrong|not_covered","confidence":<0..1>,"fact":"<one durable teaching sentence, <=240 chars, that would fix the gap>"}]. verdict "not_covered" means the agent said NOT_COVERED. Be strict: a wrong number or wrong authority is "wrong", not "partial". HARD RULE: never fabricate a code number or authority; if unsure of an exact figure, state the requirement without a number.';
    const jout = parseJson((await grader(jsys, JSON.stringify(gradeItems))) || '');
    const grades: any[] = Array.isArray(jout) ? jout : [];

    // 7) fill decision — write only on gap + model convergence + lint + confidence
    const { data: rules } = await admin.from('policy_rules').select('forbid_regex').eq('active', true);
    const lintClean = (t: string) => { for (const r of (rules || [])) { try { if (new RegExp(String(r.forbid_regex), 'i').test(t)) return false; } catch (_e) {} } return true; };
    let examined = 0, gaps = 0, filled = 0, conflicts = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < qs.length; i++) {
      const q: any = qs[i]; const g = grades.find((x) => Number(x.n) === i + 1) || {};
      const verdict = String(g.verdict || 'unverifiable').toLowerCase();
      const conf = Number(g.confidence);
      const isGap = ['wrong', 'partial', 'not_covered'].includes(verdict);
      const fact = String(g.fact || g.correct_answer || '').trim();
      const conv = converged(q.reference_answer || '', g.correct_answer || '');
      let didFill = false; let knowledgeId: number | null = null;
      examined++;
      if (isGap) gaps++;
      if (isGap && fact && conv && (isFinite(conf) ? conf >= 0.7 : true) && lintClean(fact)) {
        const { data: kins } = await admin.from('agent_knowledge').insert({ agent_key: key, topic: 'exam:' + String(q.topic || 'general'), content: fact.slice(0, 1000), priority: 6, layer: 'profession' }).select('id').maybeSingle();
        knowledgeId = (kins as any)?.id ?? null; didFill = !!knowledgeId; if (didFill) filled++;
      } else if (isGap && fact && !conv) { conflicts++; }
      await admin.from('knowledge_exam_results').insert({ agent_key: key, question_id: q.id, examinee_answer: (answers[i] || '').slice(0, 1000), verdict, grader_answer: String(g.correct_answer || '').slice(0, 1000), grader_confidence: isFinite(conf) ? conf : null, converged: conv, gap_fact: isGap ? fact.slice(0, 1000) : null, filled: didFill, knowledge_id: knowledgeId });
      try { await admin.rpc('fn_bump_exam_question', { p_id: q.id }); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    }
    const score = examined ? Math.round(100 * (examined - gaps) / examined) : null;
    const note = 'Examined ' + key + ': ' + (examined - gaps) + '/' + examined + ' correct (' + score + '%), ' + gaps + ' gap(s), ' + filled + ' auto-filled after model-convergence+lint, ' + conflicts + ' correction(s) withheld (models disagreed).';
    await logRun('ok', { agent: key, generated, examined, gaps, filled, conflicts, score }, note);
    return J({ ok: true, agent: key, label, generated, examined, gaps, filled, conflicts, score });
  } catch (e) { await logRun('error', {}, 'knowledge_exam crashed: ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e)); return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});

// kyc — passwordless account completion: mobile (SMS) + email verification, optional DOB profile, terms->signed PDF.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const FN = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')! + '/functions/v1';
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
async function sec(k: string): Promise<string | null> { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || null; }
function emailOk(e: string) { return /^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(String(e || '')); }
function toE164(p: string): string { let d = String(p || '').replace(/[^\d+]/g, ''); if (d.startsWith('+')) { const n = d.slice(1).replace(/\D/g, ''); return n.length >= 8 ? '+' + n : ''; } d = d.replace(/\D/g, ''); if (d.startsWith('00')) d = d.slice(2); if (d.startsWith('971')) return '+' + d; if (d.startsWith('0')) return '+971' + d.slice(1); if (d.length === 9 && d.startsWith('5')) return '+971' + d; if (d.length >= 8) return '+' + d; return ''; }
function ageFrom(dob: string): number | null { const d = new Date(dob); if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return null; const t = new Date(); let a = t.getFullYear() - d.getFullYear(); const m = t.getMonth() - d.getMonth(); if (m < 0 || (m === 0 && t.getDate() < d.getDate())) a--; return a; }
function code6() { return String(Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000)); }
// SECURITY FIX (27 Jul 2026): email codes here were stored in PLAINTEXT (email_verifications.token)
// and checked with .eq('token', code) — a WHERE clause on the secret. A wrong guess simply matched no
// row, so nothing could be counted: no attempt cap, no lockout, no per-caller ceiling. 10^6 codes is
// minutes of scripted guessing. login_otp documented and fixed exactly this on 19–21 Jul; kyc never
// got the same treatment. Same approach copied here: HMAC-SHA256(code, app_secrets.otp_hmac_key) at
// rest (an unsalted hash of a 6-digit code is reversible from one table leak by precomputing all a
// million), fail closed if the key is absent rather than downgrade, guesses counted on the row and
// capped, plus a per-IP ceiling. email_verifications already carries attempts + token_hash (login_otp
// uses both), so no schema change is involved.
const KYC_EMAIL_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
const KYC_EMAIL_VERIFY_PER_IP_HOUR = 30;
let _otpKey: string | null = null;
async function otpKey(): Promise<string> { if (_otpKey) return _otpKey; const k = await sec('otp_hmac_key'); if (!k) throw new Error('otp_hmac_key_missing'); _otpKey = k; return k; }
async function otpHash(code: string): Promise<string> { const ck = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(await otpKey()), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']); const mac = await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', ck, new TextEncoder().encode(code)); return Array.from(new Uint8Array(mac)).map((x) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(''); }
async function rl(key: string, limit: number, seconds: number): Promise<boolean> {
  try { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('rl_check', { p_key: key, p_limit: limit, p_seconds: seconds }); if (error) return true; return data !== false; }
  catch (_e) { return true; } // limiter unavailable must not lock legitimate users out of account completion
}
async function twilioAuth() { const sid = await sec('twilio_api_key_sid'); const secret = await sec('twilio_api_key_secret'); const va = await sec('twilio_verify_service_sid'); if (!sid || !secret || !va) return null; return { hdr: 'Basic ' + btoa(sid + ':' + secret), va }; }
async function sendEmail(to: string, subject: string, html: string) { const key = await sec('resend_api_key'); if (!key) return false; const from = (await sec('email_from_info')) || 'QuotesDone <info@quotesdone.com>'; try { const r = await fetch('https://api.resend.com/emails', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + key, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ from, to, subject, html }) }); return r.ok; } catch { return false; } }
// SUPPRESSION BYPASS 28 Jul 2026 ----------------------------------------------------------------
// login_otp and contact_submit both consult email_suppressions before handing anything to Resend,
// and send_outbox queries the same table. kyc did not: sendEmail() above builds its own Resend call,
// so the "Confirm your QuotesDone email" code went to whatever address the session carries -
// including one Resend has already told us rejects mail permanently. A user correctly refused at
// sign-in by login_otp for exactly this reason reaches the same mailbox one screen later through
// account setup, which is the domain-reputation damage the list exists to prevent. Same check, same
// shape of refusal and the same agent_runs note as login_otp, so there is one mechanism and not two.
// Fails OPEN on a lookup error - a suppression-table outage must not block account completion.
async function isSuppressed(email: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try { const { data } = await admin.from('email_suppressions').select('email').eq('email', email).maybeSingle(); return !!data; }
  catch (_e) { return false; }
}
function wrapCode(code: string) { const logo = 'https://htdblwldjkcgjvmqkbeh.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/brand/icon_192.png'; return `<div style="font-family:-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;max-width:480px;margin:0 auto;color:#1f2937"><div style="text-align:center;padding:18px 0"><img src="${logo}" width="44" height="44" alt="QuotesDone"></div><div style="background:#fff;border:1px solid #eef0f2;border-radius:14px;padding:26px;text-align:center"><h1 style="font-size:19px;color:#111827;margin:0 0 8px">Confirm your email</h1><p style="font-size:14px;color:#6b7280;margin:0 0 16px">Enter this code to confirm your email on QuotesDone. It expires in 10 minutes.</p><div style="font-size:34px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:8px;color:#0d9488;background:#f0fdfa;border-radius:12px;padding:14px 0">${code}</div></div></div>`; }

// Observability: identity state changes and delivery failures land in agent_runs.
// The read-only 'state' action is not logged (high volume, no failure mode worth tracking).
function mkLog(t0: number) {
  return async (status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) => {
    try {
      await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'kyc', status, counts,
        note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
        started_at: new Date(t0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
    } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break account completion */ }
  };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  const logRun = mkLog(Date.now());
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
    const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
    if (!user || !user.email) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
    const email = user.email.toLowerCase();
    const b = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any)); const action = String(b.action || '');

    const { data: lead } = await admin.from('leads').select('id,contact_name,phone,owner_dob,owner_email_verified,owner_phone_verified,accepted_terms_at,signed_terms_url,company_name').eq('claimed_by', email).maybeSingle();
    const { data: cust } = await admin.from('customers').select('id,full_name,phone,date_of_birth,email_verified,phone_verified,tos_accepted_at,signed_terms_url').eq('email', email).maybeSingle();
    const kind = lead ? 'supplier' : 'customer';

    if (action === 'state') {

      // email_confirmed_at / confirmed_at and, on a plain READ, flipped owner_email_verified /
      // email_verified to true. That flag proves nothing on this platform: every auth user is minted
      // with email_confirm:true (login_otp ensureUser, and auth_api before it was retired), so

      // anyone holding a session — including a session obtained by SMS alone, which never touches the
      // address. Email is proven only by the 6-digit code this function itself sends and checks
      // (send_email -> verify_email). A read must not mutate identity state, so the persist-what-we-
      // report insert from the earlier fix is gone too: with nothing granted here there is nothing to

      if (kind === 'supplier') {

        return J({ ok: true, kind, email, full_name: lead!.contact_name, phone: lead!.phone, dob: lead!.owner_dob, email_verified: ev, phone_verified: !!lead!.owner_phone_verified, terms_signed: !!lead!.signed_terms_url });
      }

      const ev = !!c.email_verified;
      return J({ ok: true, kind, email, full_name: c.full_name || '', phone: c.phone || '', dob: c.date_of_birth || '', email_verified: ev, phone_verified: !!c.phone_verified, terms_signed: !!c.signed_terms_url });
    }

      if (full_name.length < 2) return J({ error: 'Please enter your name.' }, 400);
      if (phone.replace(/\D/g, '').length < 7) return J({ error: 'Please enter a valid mobile number.' }, 400);
      const row: any = { email, full_name, phone };
      if (dob) { const a = ageFrom(dob); if (a !== null && a >= 18 && a <= 120) row.date_of_birth = dob; }
      if (cust) await admin.from('customers').update(row).eq('id', cust.id); else await admin.from('customers').insert(row);
      await logRun('ok', { action, kind, created: !cust }, '');

    }

    if (action === 'send_email') {
      // Checked BEFORE the row is inserted so we never mint a code that cannot be delivered.
      if (await isSuppressed(email)) {
        await logRun('error', { action, kind, suppressed: 1, channel: 'email' }, 'kyc refused to email a verification code to ' + email + ' - it is in email_suppressions (hard bounce, spam complaint or unsubscribe). No code was issued and no Resend call was made. If this is a real user, confirm the mailbox works and delete their email_suppressions row; do not remove this check.');
        return J({ error: 'We cannot email this address - it is on our do-not-send list because mail to it bounced or was unsubscribed. Please contact info@quotesdone.com and we will restore it.', suppressed: true }, 403);
      }
      const c = code6();
      // 27 Jul 2026: store token_hash (HMAC), never the bare code. token stays NULL from here on;
      // verify_email still honours a plaintext token row so codes issued before this deploy work out
      // their 10 minutes. Expiry was and stays 10 minutes and is enforced on the verify side.
      await admin.from('email_verifications').insert({ email, token_hash: await otpHash(c), purpose: 'kyc', user_kind: kind, expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60e3).toISOString() });
      // previously the send result was discarded: a failed send left the user waiting with no trace
      const sent = await sendEmail(email, 'Confirm your QuotesDone email', wrapCode(c));
      if (!sent) await logRun('error', { action, kind }, 'verification email failed to send (Resend rejected or key missing) - user cannot verify');
      else await logRun('ok', { action, kind }, '');
      return J({ ok: true });
    }
    if (action === 'verify_email') {
      const c = String(b.code || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
      if (!c) return J({ error: 'Enter the 6-digit code.' }, 400);
      // SECURITY FIX (27 Jul 2026): see the OTP note at the top. The lookup used to put the code in
      // the WHERE clause, so a wrong guess was indistinguishable from "no code" and could not be
      // counted — unlimited guesses at 10^6. Now: cap per caller BEFORE touching the row, fetch the
      // newest live code, compare in code, count the miss, and burn the code on the 5th.
      const vip = (req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') || '').split(',')[0].trim() || 'unknown';
      if (!(await rl('kyc_verify_email_ip:' + vip, KYC_EMAIL_VERIFY_PER_IP_HOUR, 3600))) {
        await logRun('error', { action, kind, rate_limited: 1, scope: 'verify_ip' }, 'kyc blocked a caller making more than ' + KYC_EMAIL_VERIFY_PER_IP_HOUR + ' email-code attempts in an hour. A real person never reaches this; sustained hits mean someone is guessing codes.');
        return J({ error: 'Too many attempts. Please request a new code.' }, 429);
      }
      // limit(1) + [0], NOT maybeSingle(): a user who pressed send twice has two live rows and
      // maybeSingle() errors on >1 and returns null, which would reject BOTH codes (login_otp's
      // self-inflicted lockout, 21 Jul). limit(1) deterministically takes the newest.
      const { data: rows } = await admin.from('email_verifications').select('*').eq('email', email).eq('purpose', 'kyc').is('used_at', null).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(1);
      const row = rows && rows[0];
      if (!row) return J({ error: 'Incorrect or expired code.' }, 400);
      if (new Date(row.expires_at) < new Date()) return J({ error: 'That code has expired.' }, 400);
      if ((row.attempts || 0) >= KYC_EMAIL_MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
        await admin.from('email_verifications').update({ used_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', row.id);
        await logRun('error', { action, kind, locked: 1 }, 'kyc burned an email code after ' + KYC_EMAIL_MAX_ATTEMPTS + ' wrong guesses; the user must request a new one. Sustained hits on one account mean someone is guessing.');
        return J({ error: 'Too many incorrect attempts. Please request a new code.' }, 429);
      }
      // row.token is only set for codes issued before hashing shipped on 27 Jul 2026
      const match = row.token_hash ? ((await otpHash(c)) === row.token_hash) : (!!row.token && c === row.token);
      if (!match) { await admin.from('email_verifications').update({ attempts: (row.attempts || 0) + 1 }).eq('id', row.id); return J({ error: 'Incorrect or expired code.' }, 400); }
      await admin.from('email_verifications').update({ used_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', row.id);
      // 27 Jul 2026: 'state' no longer creates the customers row as a side effect of a read, so this
      // must not assume one exists — an .update() on a missing row silently persists nothing and the
      // user would loop on the verify step forever. Insert it, falling back to update on a race.
      if (kind === 'supplier') await admin.from('leads').update({ owner_email_verified: true }).eq('claimed_by', email);
      else if (cust) await admin.from('customers').update({ email_verified: true }).eq('email', email);
      else { const ins = await admin.from('customers').insert({ email, email_verified: true }); if (ins.error) await admin.from('customers').update({ email_verified: true }).eq('email', email); }
      await logRun('ok', { action, kind }, '');
      return J({ ok: true });
    }

    if (action === 'send_sms') {
      const phone = toE164(String(b.phone || '')); if (!phone) return J({ error: 'Enter a valid mobile number.' }, 400);
      const tw = await twilioAuth(); if (!tw) { await logRun('error', { action, kind }, 'SMS not configured: missing twilio_api_key_sid / secret / verify_service_sid'); return J({ error: 'SMS is not configured.' }, 500); }
      const since = new Date(Date.now() - 3600e3).toISOString();
      const { count } = await admin.from('phone_verifications').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('phone', phone).gte('created_at', since);
      if ((count || 0) >= 5) { await logRun('ok', { action, kind, rate_limited: true }, 'rate limit hit: 5+ code requests for this number in the last hour'); return J({ error: 'Too many code requests. Please try again later.' }, 429); }
      const r = await fetch(`https://verify.twilio.com/v2/Services/${tw.va}/Verifications`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': tw.hdr, 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: new URLSearchParams({ To: phone, Channel: 'sms' }) });
      const jd = await r.json(); if (!r.ok || jd?.status === 'canceled') { await logRun('error', { action, kind, http: r.status }, 'twilio verify send failed: ' + String(jd?.message || jd?.status || '').slice(0, 200)); return J({ error: jd?.message || 'Could not send the SMS code.' }, 502); }
      await admin.from('phone_verifications').insert({ email, phone, code: 'twilio', user_kind: kind, expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60e3).toISOString() });
      await logRun('ok', { action, kind }, '');
      return J({ ok: true });
    }
    if (action === 'verify_sms') {
      const phone = toE164(String(b.phone || '')); const code = String(b.code || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
      if (!phone || !code) return J({ error: 'Enter the 6-digit code.' }, 400);
      const tw = await twilioAuth(); if (!tw) { await logRun('error', { action, kind }, 'SMS not configured: missing twilio credentials'); return J({ error: 'SMS is not configured.' }, 500); }
      const r = await fetch(`https://verify.twilio.com/v2/Services/${tw.va}/VerificationCheck`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': tw.hdr, 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: new URLSearchParams({ To: phone, Code: code }) });
      const jd = await r.json(); if (jd?.status !== 'approved') return J({ error: 'Incorrect or expired code.' }, 400);
      if (kind === 'supplier') await admin.from('leads').update({ owner_phone_verified: true, phone }).eq('claimed_by', email); else await admin.from('customers').update({ phone_verified: true, phone }).eq('email', email);
      await admin.from('phone_verifications').update({ used_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('phone', phone).is('used_at', null);
      await logRun('ok', { action, kind }, '');
      return J({ ok: true });
    }

    if (action === 'accept_terms') {
      const ip = (req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') || '').split(',')[0].trim();
      const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
      if (kind === 'supplier') await admin.from('leads').update({ accepted_terms_at: nowIso, accepted_terms_version: 'v4', accepted_terms_ip: ip }).eq('claimed_by', email);
      else await admin.from('customers').update({ tos_accepted_at: nowIso, tos_version: 'v3', tos_ip: ip }).eq('email', email);
      let signed_url = null; let signErr = '';
      try { const secret = await sec('inbound_secret'); const r = await fetch(`${FN}/compliance_archive`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: secret, action: 'sign', kind, email }) }); const jd = await r.json(); signed_url = jd?.signed_url || null; if (!signed_url) signErr = String(jd?.error || jd?.detail || 'no signed_url returned').slice(0, 200); } catch (e) { signErr = String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0, 200); }
      // terms acceptance is recorded either way; a missing signed PDF is a compliance-trail gap worth surfacing
      if (!signed_url) await logRun('error', { action, kind, terms_recorded: true, signed_pdf: false }, 'terms accepted but signed PDF not produced: ' + signErr);
      else await logRun('ok', { action, kind, terms_recorded: true, signed_pdf: true }, '');
      return J({ ok: true, signed_url });
    }

    await logRun('error', { action }, 'unknown_action');
    return J({ error: 'unknown_action' }, 400);
  } catch (e) { const m = String((e as Error)?.message || e); await logRun('error', {}, 'exception: ' + m); return J({ error: m }, 500); }
});

### supabase/functions/learn_gaps/index.ts

```typescript
// learn_gaps — self-improving intake. Looks at inquiries matched to suppliers but with ZERO quotes,
// and per category asks an expert estimator which quote-critical attributes are commonly missing, then
// merges new fields into that category's intake checklist. Weekly cron + callable ({job:'run'}).
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'learn_gaps', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
}
let PARSE_FAILS = 0, SAVE_FAILS = 0, LLM_CALLS = 0; let LAST_ERR = '';
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { ...CORS, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
const llmShared = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 1400, temperature: 0.2 }); // Sonnet-first for cost (fleet policy)
const CLOSED = ['completed', 'accepted', 'closed', 'cancelled'];

async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
function parseJson(txt: string) { try { return JSON.parse(txt); } catch { /* */ } const m = txt.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (m) { try { return JSON.parse(m[0]); } catch { /* */ } } return null; }
async function llm(_key: string, sys: string, user: string, max = 1400) {
  LLM_CALLS++;
  const c = await llmShared(sys, user, max);
  if (c === null) { LAST_ERR = 'openrouter call failed or returned no content'; throw new Error('openrouter error'); }
  return c;
}

const SYS = `You are a senior UAE estimator improving a quotation platform's intake. You are shown a set of customer briefs in ONE category that were sent to matched suppliers but received ZERO quotes — a strong signal the brief was missing something suppliers need to price without contacting the customer. You are also shown the category's CURRENT intake checklist.

Identify up to 3 quote-critical attributes that are (a) commonly missing or ambiguous across these briefs, (b) genuinely required to give a firm price, and (c) NOT already covered by the current checklist. Do not propose technical/engineering choices the supplier should decide, budget, or the customer's identity.

Return STRICT JSON ONLY: {"fields":[{"key":"snake_case","question":"short plain customer-facing question","type":"select|multiselect|number|text","options":["concrete option","Not sure"],"required":true,"reason":"why suppliers likely couldn't quote without it"}]}. If the briefs look complete and the zero quotes are for other reasons, return {"fields":[]}.`;

async function learnCategory(key: string, category: string, briefs: string[], currentFields: any[]) {
  const user = 'CATEGORY: ' + category + '\n\nCURRENT INTAKE CHECKLIST (JSON):\n' + JSON.stringify(currentFields) + '\n\nBRIEFS THAT GOT ZERO QUOTES (' + briefs.length + '):\n' + briefs.map((b, i) => (i + 1) + '. ' + b).join('\n');
  const raw = await llm(key, SYS, user);
  const j = parseJson(raw);
  if (j === null) { PARSE_FAILS++; LAST_ERR = 'LLM output for category ' + category + ' was not parseable JSON, treated as zero suggestions'; }
  const fields = (j && Array.isArray(j.fields)) ? j.fields.filter((f: any) => f && f.key && f.question) : [];
  return fields.slice(0, 3);
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) { await logRun('error', { categories_reviewed: 0, fields_added: 0 }, 'call rejected: wrong or missing inbound secret; intake checklists were not reviewed or improved'); return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403); }
    const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key'); if (!key) { await logRun('error', { categories_reviewed: 0, fields_added: 0 }, 'openrouter_api_key missing from app_secrets: no intake checklist learning ran, categories with zero-quote briefs keep asking customers the same incomplete questions'); return J({ error: 'AI not configured' }, 200); }
    const maxCats = Math.max(1, Math.min(8, Number(body.max_categories) || 4));
    const minCases = Math.max(1, Number(body.min_cases) || 2);
    const sinceDays = Math.max(2, Number(body.since_days) || 3);
    const olderThan = new Date(Date.now() - sinceDays * 864e5).toISOString();
    const floor = new Date(Date.now() - 45 * 864e5).toISOString();

    const { data: inqs } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('id,category,summary,spec,status,created_at').not('status', 'in', '(' + CLOSED.join(',') + ')').lt('created_at', olderThan).gte('created_at', floor).not('category', 'is', null).limit(1500);
    // H15 (OS audit): was 2 count queries PER inquiry (~3,000 sequential round-trips at the 1,500 cap).
    // Replace with a few chunked bulk lookups of which inquiries have >=1 match / >=1 quote, then filter in memory.
    const ids = (inqs || []).map((i: any) => i.id);
    const hasMatch = new Set<any>(); const hasQuote = new Set<any>();
    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i += 200) {
      const chunk = ids.slice(i, i + 200);
      const [{ data: mr }, { data: qr }] = await Promise.all([
        admin.from('inquiry_matches').select('inquiry_id').in('inquiry_id', chunk),
        admin.from('quotes').select('inquiry_id').in('inquiry_id', chunk),
      ]);
      for (const r of (mr || [])) hasMatch.add(r.inquiry_id);
      for (const r of (qr || [])) hasQuote.add(r.inquiry_id);
    }
    const byCat: Record<string, string[]> = {};
    for (const inq of (inqs || [])) {
      const cat = String(inq.category || '').trim(); if (!cat) continue;
      if (!hasMatch.has(inq.id) || hasQuote.has(inq.id)) continue;
      const brief = String(inq.summary || '') + (inq.spec ? (' | specs: ' + JSON.stringify(inq.spec)) : '');
      (byCat[cat] = byCat[cat] || []).push(brief.slice(0, 600));
    }

    const cats = Object.entries(byCat).filter(([, arr]) => arr.length >= minCases).sort((a, b) => b[1].length - a[1].length).slice(0, maxCats);
    const results: any[] = [];
    for (const [cat, briefs] of cats) {
      try {
        const { data: cs } = await admin.from('category_specs').select('category,label,fields').eq('category', cat).maybeSingle();
        const currentFields = Array.isArray(cs?.fields) ? cs!.fields : [];
        const have = new Set(currentFields.map((f: any) => String(f.key || '').toLowerCase()));
        const proposed = await learnCategory(key, cat, briefs.slice(0, 10), currentFields);
        const fresh = proposed.filter((f: any) => !have.has(String(f.key).toLowerCase()));
        if (!fresh.length) { results.push({ category: cat, zero_quote_cases: briefs.length, added: 0 }); continue; }
        const clean = fresh.map((f: any) => ({ key: String(f.key).slice(0, 60), question: String(f.question).slice(0, 240), type: ['select', 'multiselect', 'number', 'text'].includes(f.type) ? f.type : 'text', options: Array.isArray(f.options) ? f.options.map((o: any) => String(o)).slice(0, 8) : [], required: f.required !== false, source: 'learned' }));
        const merged = currentFields.concat(clean).slice(0, 22);
        if (cs) { const _u = await admin.from('category_specs').update({ fields: merged }).eq('category', cat); if (_u && (_u as any).error) { SAVE_FAILS++; LAST_ERR = 'category_specs update failed for ' + cat + ': ' + String((_u as any).error?.message || ''); } }
        else { const _i = await admin.from('category_specs').insert({ category: cat, label: cat, fields: merged }); if (_i && (_i as any).error) { SAVE_FAILS++; LAST_ERR = 'category_specs insert failed for ' + cat + ': ' + String((_i as any).error?.message || ''); } }
        const _a = await admin.from('agent_actions').insert({ agent: 'learn', kind: 'checklist_improved', status: 'pending', risk: 'low', title: 'Intake checklist improved for "' + cat + '" (+' + clean.length + ' field(s) from ' + briefs.length + ' zero-quote briefs)', recommendation: 'review the added questions; remove any that are not truly needed', target_table: 'category_specs', target_id: cat, detail: { added: clean, reasons: fresh.map((f: any) => f.reason).filter(Boolean) } });
        if (_a && (_a as any).error) { SAVE_FAILS++; LAST_ERR = 'agent_actions insert failed for ' + cat + ': ' + String((_a as any).error?.message || ''); }
        results.push({ category: cat, zero_quote_cases: briefs.length, added: clean.length, keys: clean.map((f: any) => f.key) });
      } catch (e) { LAST_ERR = 'category ' + cat + ' failed: ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e); results.push({ category: cat, error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }); }
    }
    const errored = results.filter((r) => r.error).length;
    const added = results.reduce((a: number, r: any) => a + (Number(r.added) || 0), 0);
    let note: string;
    if (cats.length === 0) { note = 'no category had enough matched-but-zero-quote inquiries to review; nothing learned and nothing failed'; }
    else if (errored === cats.length) { note = 'NO intake checklist learning happened this run: the model call failed for all ' + cats.length + ' categories reviewed, so categories whose briefs get zero quotes keep collecting the same incomplete information'; }
    else if (PARSE_FAILS > 0 && added === 0) { note = 'reviewed ' + cats.length + ' zero-quote categories but added NOTHING: the model returned unparseable output for ' + PARSE_FAILS + ' of them, which is silently treated as "no suggestions" — intake checklists are unchanged and may still be missing quote-critical questions'; }
    else if (added === 0) { note = 'reviewed ' + cats.length + ' zero-quote categories; the model proposed no new quote-critical fields, so checklists are unchanged'; }
    else { note = 'reviewed ' + cats.length + ' zero-quote categories and added ' + added + ' new intake field(s)' + (errored ? ('; ' + errored + ' category/categories failed outright') : '') + (PARSE_FAILS ? ('; ' + PARSE_FAILS + ' model response(s) were unparseable and silently contributed nothing') : ''); }
    if (SAVE_FAILS > 0) { note += ' | ' + SAVE_FAILS + ' write(s) to category_specs/agent_actions failed, so learned fields may not have been saved'; }
    if (LAST_ERR) { note += ' | last error: ' + LAST_ERR; }
    const bad = SAVE_FAILS > 0 || (cats.length > 0 && errored === cats.length) || (cats.length > 0 && PARSE_FAILS > 0 && added === 0);
    await logRun(bad ? 'error' : 'ok', { categories_reviewed: cats.length, fields_added: added, categories_errored: errored, llm_calls: LLM_CALLS, parse_failures: PARSE_FAILS, save_failures: SAVE_FAILS }, note);
    return J({ ok: true, categories_reviewed: cats.length, results });
  } catch (e) { await logRun('error', { categories_reviewed: 0, fields_added: 0, llm_calls: LLM_CALLS, parse_failures: PARSE_FAILS }, 'learn_gaps crashed before completing; no intake checklists were improved this run: ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e)); return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});

async function docHtml(slug:string){ try{ const {data}=await sb.from('legal_documents').select('body_html').eq('slug',slug).eq('category','public').maybeSingle(); return (data?.body_html as string)||''; }catch(_){ return ''; } }

const NAV:[string,string][]=[

<style>:root{--bg:#05121A;--panel:rgba(255,255,255,.05);--line:rgba(255,255,255,.10);--line2:rgba(255,255,255,.18);--t:#EAF4F2;--mut:#9DB2B2;--faint:#5E7475;--teal:#2DD4BF;--teal2:#14B8A6;--gold:#E7C579}

h1,h2,h3{font-family:Sora,Inter,sans-serif;color:#fff}
header.site{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;background:rgba(5,18,26,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
header.site .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:13px 20px}
.brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.snav{display:flex;gap:20px;margin-left:6px}
.snav a{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px;font-weight:500}.snav a:hover{color:#fff}
@media(max-width:680px){.snav{display:none}}
.cta{margin-left:auto;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--teal),var(--teal2));color:#04121a;font-weight:700;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 10px 26px -12px rgba(45,212,191,.7)}
.cta:hover{color:#04121a;filter:brightness(1.05)}
.wrap{max-width:880px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
.docwrap{max-width:880px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px 20px 54px}
.crumb{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--faint);margin:16px 0 16px}.crumb a{color:var(--mut)}
.nav{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:20px}
.nav a{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;color:var(--mut);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 14px;transition:.15s}
.nav a:hover{color:#fff;border-color:var(--line2)}
.nav a.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--teal),var(--teal2));color:#04222b;border-color:transparent}
.doc{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:34px 40px;box-shadow:0 24px 60px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.dochead{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line2);padding-bottom:16px;margin-bottom:6px}
.dochead h1{font-size:28px;margin:0 0 6px;color:#fff;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.dochead .meta{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px}
.body{margin-top:10px}
.body>h1:first-child{display:none}
.body .muted{color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;font-style:italic;margin:0 0 12px}
.body p{margin:0 0 12px;color:#d4e4e2}
.body h1{font-size:22px;color:#fff;margin:26px 0 8px}
.body h2{font-size:18px;color:#fff;margin:28px 0 8px;padding-left:12px;border-left:3px solid var(--teal)}
.body h3{font-size:15px;color:#fff;margin:16px 0 6px}
.body ol,.body ul{padding-left:22px}.body li{margin:6px 0;color:#d4e4e2}
.body a{color:var(--teal);font-weight:600}.body strong{color:#fff}
.body table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:14px;margin:12px 0}.body th,.body td{border:1px solid var(--line);padding:8px 10px;text-align:left;color:#d4e4e2}.body th{background:var(--panel);color:#fff}
html[dir=rtl] .body h2{padding-left:0;padding-right:12px;border-left:0;border-right:3px solid var(--teal)}
html[dir=rtl] .body ol,html[dir=rtl] .body ul{padding-left:0;padding-right:22px}
html[dir=rtl] .body th,html[dir=rtl] .body td{text-align:right}
.note{background:rgba(45,212,191,.06);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-left:3px solid var(--teal);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:26px;line-height:1.65}
.note b{color:#fff}
.contact{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px 24px;margin-top:18px}
.contact .ct b{color:#fff}.contact .ct div{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px}
.cbtns{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;border-radius:11px;padding:11px 18px;cursor:pointer;border:0}
.btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--teal),var(--teal2));color:#04222b}
.btn.ghost{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line2);color:var(--t)}
.ft{max-width:880px;margin:0 auto;padding:26px 20px 54px;text-align:center;color:var(--faint);font-size:12px;line-height:1.9}
.ft a{color:var(--mut)}
@media(max-width:560px){.doc{padding:24px 20px}}
</style></head><body>
${HEADER}
<div class="docwrap">
<div class="crumb"><a href="/">Home</a> › Legal › ${title}</div>
<nav class="nav">${nav}</nav>
<article class="doc"><div class="dochead"><h1>${title}</h1><div class="meta">QuotesDone Technologies · Version ${VER} · Last updated ${UPDATED}</div><div class="meta">The English version of this document is the governing version.</div></div><div class="body">${body}</div>
<div class="note"><b>Operator:</b> QuotesDone Technologies, Dubai DET E-Trader (Professional) Licence No. 1633275, Commercial Register No. 2883503, Dubai, UAE. <b>Governing law:</b> the laws of the United Arab Emirates, including the Commercial Transactions Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 50 of 2022), the Electronic Transactions and Trust Services Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 46 of 2021), the Consumer Protection Law (Federal Law No. 15 of 2020) and Cabinet Resolution No. 66 of 2023, the Personal Data Protection Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021), and the Civil Transactions Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 25 of 2025, in force from 1 June 2026). Disputes are subject to the competent courts of Dubai.</div>
</article>
<div class="contact"><div class="ct"><b>Questions about this document?</b><div>Our team usually replies within one business day.</div></div><div class="cbtns"><a class="btn primary" href="mailto:management@quotesdone.com">✉ Email us</a><a class="btn ghost" href="/contact/">Contact us</a></div></div>
</div>
<footer class="ft">QuotesDone Technologies · DET E-Trader Licence No. 1633275 · Dubai, United Arab Emirates<br><a href="mailto:management@quotesdone.com">management@quotesdone.com</a> · <a href="/contact/">Contact</a> · <a href="/">quotesdone.com</a></footer>
${I18N}</body></html>`;
}
const FALLBACK=`<p>This document is being updated. Please contact management@quotesdone.com.</p>`;

Deno.serve(async (req)=>{
  const url=new URL(req.url);
  let doc=(url.searchParams.get('doc')||'terms').toLowerCase();
  if(!NAV.find(n=>n[0]===doc)) doc='terms';
  const embed=url.searchParams.get('embed')==='1';
  try{ I18N = await (await fetch(ASSET+'/i18n_chrome.html')).text(); }catch(_e){ I18N=''; }
  let body:string;
  if(doc==='terms'){ body=(await pageHtml('legal_terms_body'))||FALLBACK; }
  else if(doc==='supplier'){ body=(await pageHtml('legal_supplier_body'))||FALLBACK; }
  else { body=(await docHtml(doc))||FALLBACK; }
  if(embed){ return new Response(body,{headers:{'Content-Type':'text/html; charset=utf-8','Cache-Control':'no-store','Access-Control-Allow-Origin':'*'}}); }
  return new Response(shell(labelFor(doc), body, doc),{headers:{'Content-Type':'text/html; charset=utf-8','Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
});
```

### supabase/functions/legal_ingest/index.ts

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
async function sec(k:string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
Deno.serve(async (req)=>{
  let b:any={}; try{ b=await req.json(); }catch(_){}
  const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
  if(!secretOk(__exp) || b.__secret!==__exp) return new Response(JSON.stringify({error:'forbidden'}),{status:403,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});
  const items=Array.isArray(b.items)?b.items:[]; let n=0; const errs:string[]=[];
  for(const it of items){
    const slug=String(it.slug||'').trim(); const title=String(it.title||'').trim();
    const category=(String(it.category||'public').trim()==='internal')?'internal':'public';
    const body=String(it.body_html||''); const summary=String(it.summary||'').slice(0,600);
    if(!slug||!title||body.length<40){ errs.push((slug||'?')+': skipped'); continue; }
    try{ await admin.from('legal_documents').upsert({slug,title,category,summary,body_html:body.slice(0,60000),version:String(it.version||'1.0'),effective_date:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),updated_at:new Date().toISOString()},{onConflict:'slug'}); n++; }catch(e){ errs.push(slug+': '+String((e as Error)?.message||e)); }
  }
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ok:true,upserted:n,errors:errs.slice(0,20),received:items.length}),{headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});
});

### supabase/functions/legal_review/index.ts

````typescript
// legal_review - AI-assisted review of an agreement / NDA / supplier or customer contract. Flags missing or risky
// clauses against a checklist and produces a plain summary. It is NOT legal advice: every review sets
// needs_licensed_review=true and material/high-risk items are escalated to the founder for a licensed UAE lawyer.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
const MODELS = ['anthropic/claude-opus-4.8','anthropic/claude-sonnet-5'];

// Robust JSON extraction. Handles: clean JSON, fenced JSON, UNTERMINATED fences (truncated output),
// prose preambles, and truncated objects (repairs by balancing braces/brackets and closing open strings).
function parseJson(t:string){
  let s=String(t||'').trim();
  if(!s) return null;
  // 1) closed fence
  const closed=s.match(/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i);
  if(closed) s=closed[1].trim();
  else {
    // 2) unterminated fence (model hit max_tokens before closing it)
    const open=s.match(/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*)$/i);
    if(open) s=open[1].trim();
  }
  try{ return JSON.parse(s); }catch(_e){}
  // 3) first balanced-ish object
  const start=s.indexOf('{');
  if(start<0) return null;
  s=s.slice(start);
  const last=s.lastIndexOf('}');
  if(last>0){ try{ return JSON.parse(s.slice(0,last+1)); }catch(_e){} }
  // 4) repair truncated JSON: close any open string, then balance brackets
  try{
    let inStr=false, esc=false; const stack:string[]=[];
    for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){
      const ch=s[i];
      if(esc){ esc=false; continue; }
      if(ch==='\\'){ esc=true; continue; }
      if(ch==='"'){ inStr=!inStr; continue; }
      if(inStr) continue;
      if(ch==='{'||ch==='[') stack.push(ch);
      else if(ch==='}'||ch===']') stack.pop();
    }
    let fixed=s;
    if(inStr) fixed+='"';
    // drop a dangling trailing comma or partial key before closing
    fixed=fixed.replace(/,\s*$/,'');
    while(stack.length){ const o=stack.pop(); fixed += (o==='{' ? '}' : ']'); }
    return JSON.parse(fixed);
  }catch(_e){}
  return null;
}

async function logRun(status:string, counts:Record<string,unknown>, note:string){
  try{ await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent:'legal_review', status, counts, note: String(note||'').slice(0,500) }); }catch(_e){}
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const kind = String(body.kind || 'contract');
    const title = String(body.title || 'Untitled document');
    let text = String(body.text || '').trim();
    // optionally load from a legal_document slug
    if (!text && body.slug) { const { data } = await admin.from('legal_documents').select('body_html').eq('slug', body.slug).maybeSingle(); text = String(data?.body_html||'').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').trim(); }
    if (!text || text.length < 100) return J({ error: 'no_text', note: 'Provide {text} or a legal_document {slug} to review.' });
    if (text.length > 60000) text = text.slice(0, 60000);

    const sys = 'You are a contracts analyst assisting a UAE B2B marketplace. Review the document and identify MISSING or RISKY clauses against best practice for this document type. Consider: parties & definitions, scope, payment/commission, liability & indemnity, limitation of liability, confidentiality/NDA, data protection (UAE PDPL), IP/content ownership, termination, warranties, force majeure, governing law & jurisdiction (should be UAE/relevant emirate), dispute resolution, compliance with UAE law. You are NOT a lawyer and must NOT give definitive legal advice or say the document is safe/enforceable. Flag issues for a licensed UAE lawyer to decide. Return STRICT JSON only, no markdown fences and no commentary. Keep each "issue" under 40 words so the response is never truncated. Schema: {"summary": string (plain, 3-4 sentences), "risk_flags": [{"clause": string, "issue": string, "severity": "low|medium|high"}], "missing_clauses": string[], "risk_level": "low|medium|high", "lawyer_questions": string[]}';
    const usr = 'DOCUMENT TYPE: '+kind+'\nTITLE: '+title+'\n\nDOCUMENT:\n"""\n'+text+'\n"""';
    const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key'); if (!key) { await logRun('error',{},'ai_unavailable: no openrouter key'); return J({ error:'ai_unavailable' }); }
    let parsed:any=null; let used=''; let lastRaw=''; let lastErr='';
    for (const model of MODELS) {
      try {
        const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', { method:'POST', headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer '+key,'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({ model, max_tokens:4000, temperature:0.2, response_format:{type:'json_object'}, messages:[{role:'system',content:sys},{role:'user',content:usr}] }) });
        const jd=await r.json();
        if(jd?.error){ lastErr=String(jd.error?.message||jd.error).slice(0,200); continue; }
        const c=jd?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content||'';
        const finish=jd?.choices?.[0]?.finish_reason||'';
        lastRaw=String(c).slice(0,300);
        const p=parseJson(c);
        if(p){ parsed=p; used=model; if(finish==='length') await logRun('ok',{truncated:true},'recovered truncated output from '+model); break; }
        lastErr='unparseable ('+model+', finish='+finish+')';
      } catch(e){ lastErr=String((e as Error)?.message||e).slice(0,200); }
    }
    if (!parsed) { await logRun('error',{},'llm_failed: '+lastErr+' | raw: '+lastRaw); return J({ error:'llm_failed', detail:lastErr }); }
    const level = ['low','medium','high'].includes(parsed.risk_level) ? parsed.risk_level : 'medium';
    const flags = Array.isArray(parsed.risk_flags) ? parsed.risk_flags : [];
    const { data: row } = await admin.from('legal_reviews').insert({ doc_kind:kind, title, source: body.slug?('legal_document:'+body.slug):'pasted', summary: parsed.summary, risk_flags: flags, risk_level: level, needs_licensed_review: true }).select('id').single();
    // escalate material reviews to the founder (never resolve on its own)
    if (level==='high' || flags.some((f:any)=>f?.severity==='high')) {
      await admin.from('agent_actions').insert({ agent:'legal_ai', kind:'legal_flag', status:'pending', risk:'high',
        title:'Legal review flagged risks: '+title,
        recommendation:(parsed.summary||'')+'\n\nHigh-risk items were found. Have a licensed UAE lawyer review before signing.\n\n⚠️ Not legal advice.',
        detail: jsonb_min(parsed, kind, title, row?.id), target_table:'legal_reviews', target_id: String(row?.id||'') });
    }
    await logRun('ok',{ issues:flags.length, high:flags.filter((f:any)=>f?.severity==='high').length, risk:level },'');
    return J({ ok:true, review_id: row?.id, model: used, risk_level: level, summary: parsed.summary, risk_flags: flags, missing_clauses: parsed.missing_clauses, lawyer_questions: parsed.lawyer_questions, disclaimer: 'AI-assisted review only — not legal advice. Requires a licensed UAE lawyer.' });
  } catch (e) { const m=String((e as Error)?.message || e); await logRun('error',{},'exception: '+m); return J({ error: m }, 500); }
});
function jsonb_min(p:any, kind:string, title:string, id:any){ return { signal:'contract_review', kind, title, review_id:id, missing:(p.missing_clauses||[]).slice(0,8) }; }
````
