### supabase/functions/license_extract/index.ts

```typescript
// license_extract - Document Controller vision: (1) 'license' mode reads a UAE trade licence and
// extracts the legal company name, licence no, authority, emirate/city, issue/expiry dates;
// (2) 'profile' mode reads a company profile / catalog and summarises what the company does;
// (3) 'cert' mode reads ANY certificate (insurance, ISO, manufacturer authorisation) and pulls the
//     expiry date out of it - so nobody is ever asked to type dd/mm/yyyy by hand. A supplier holding
//     the document already has the date; asking them to retype it is a chance to get it wrong.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
const MODELS = ['anthropic/claude-sonnet-5', 'anthropic/claude-opus-4.8'];
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
function parseJson(t: string) { try { return JSON.parse(t); } catch { const m = t.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (m) { try { return JSON.parse(m[0]); } catch { /* */ } } return {}; } }
function dataUrl(b64: string, mime: string) { return `data:${mime};base64,${String(b64).replace(/^data:[^;]+;base64,/, '')}`; }
function normDate(s: unknown): string | null { const v = String(s || '').trim(); if (!v) return null; let m = v.match(/^(\d{4})[-/](\d{1,2})[-/](\d{1,2})$/); if (m) { const d = new Date(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3])); return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : `${m[1]}-${String(m[2]).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(m[3]).padStart(2,'0')}`; } m = v.match(/^(\d{1,2})[-/](\d{1,2})[-/](\d{4})$/); if (m) { return `${m[3]}-${String(m[2]).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(m[1]).padStart(2,'0')}`; } const d = new Date(v); return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d.toISOString().slice(0, 10); }
const EMIRATES = ['Dubai','Abu Dhabi','Sharjah','Ajman','Umm Al Quwain','Ras Al Khaimah','Fujairah'];
function normEmirate(s: unknown): string { const t = String(s || '').toLowerCase(); for (const e of EMIRATES) if (t.includes(e.toLowerCase())) return e; if (/rak/.test(t)) return 'Ras Al Khaimah'; if (/uaq|umm al/.test(t)) return 'Umm Al Quwain'; if (/auh|abu/.test(t)) return 'Abu Dhabi'; return ''; }

const SYS_LICENSE = `You are a meticulous UAE corporate-registry document controller. You read an official UAE TRADE LICENCE (DED / DET / free-zone / e-trader) and extract its registration data EXACTLY as printed. Read every line; do not guess. Return STRICT JSON only:\n{\"legal_name\":string,\"license_number\":string,\"license_authority\":string,\"emirate\":string,\"city\":string,\"issue_date\":\"YYYY-MM-DD\",\"expiry_date\":\"YYYY-MM-DD\",\"activities\":[string],\"trn\":string,\"confidence\":\"low\"|\"medium\"|\"high\"}\nlegal_name = the exact licensed company / establishment name as printed (English). license_number = the licence / register number. license_authority = issuing authority (e.g. 'Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism', 'Sharjah Economic Development Department', 'Abu Dhabi DED', 'Ajman Free Zone'). emirate = one of Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah. city = city/area if shown else the emirate. activities = listed business activities. trn = VAT TRN if present else ''. Dates as printed, output YYYY-MM-DD. If a value is not visible use an empty string and lower the confidence. This is NOT a tax/AML check - it is commercial onboarding verification only.`;
const SYS_PROFILE = `You read a UAE supplier's COMPANY PROFILE and/or PRODUCT CATALOG and summarise what the company actually does, so QuotesDone can match it to relevant customer requests. Be factual; use only what the documents show. Return STRICT JSON only:\n{\"summary\":string,\"services\":[string],\"products\":[string],\"sectors\":[string],\"emirates\":[string],\"confidence\":\"low\"|\"medium\"|\"high\"}\nsummary = 2-4 plain sentences describing the business, its core offering and strengths. services = the services they provide. products = product lines they supply (generic, no need to keep brand names). sectors = the trade categories they fit (e.g. joinery, MEP, fit-out, flooring, signage, landscaping). emirates = areas/emirates they serve if stated. Keep arrays concise (max ~12 each).`;
const SYS_CERT = `You read a supplier's CERTIFICATE or LETTER - typically an insurance policy schedule, an ISO certificate, or a manufacturer/authorised-dealer letter - and pull out the dates and identifying details so the supplier never has to type them by hand.\n\nRULES\n1. expiry_date is the date the document STOPS being valid. On insurance schedules this is the 'period of insurance' TO date. On ISO certificates it is the 'expiry' or 'valid until' date, NOT the certification or surveillance-audit date. On dealer letters it is the stated validity end, if any.\n2. If several dates appear, choose the one that governs when this document lapses. Do not return an issue date as an expiry.\n3. If NO expiry is printed anywhere, return an empty string and set confidence 'low'. Never invent or estimate a date - a wrong expiry either suspends a valid supplier or lets a lapsed one keep trading.\n4. Dates may be printed as DD/MM/YYYY, DD-MMM-YYYY or written out. Output YYYY-MM-DD.\n\nReturn STRICT JSON only:\n{\"doc_type\":\"insurance\"|\"iso\"|\"manufacturer\"|\"other\",\"issuer\":string,\"reference\":string,\"issue_date\":\"YYYY-MM-DD\",\"expiry_date\":\"YYYY-MM-DD\",\"covers\":string,\"confidence\":\"low\"|\"medium\"|\"high\"}\nissuer = the insurer, certification body, or manufacturer. reference = policy/certificate number. covers = one short line on what it covers or authorises.`;

function buildContent(mode: string, images: any[], body: any): any[] {
  const intro = mode === 'license'
    ? 'Read the attached UAE trade licence (all pages) and return the extraction JSON.'
    : mode === 'cert'
      ? 'Read the attached certificate / letter (all pages) and return the extraction JSON. The expiry date is the important field.'
      : 'Read the attached company profile / catalog pages and return the summary JSON.';
  const content: any[] = [{ type: 'text', text: intro }];
  if (Array.isArray(images) && images.length) {
    for (const im of images.slice(0, 10)) { const b = im?.b64 || im; const m = im?.mime || 'image/jpeg'; if (b) content.push({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: dataUrl(String(b), String(m)) } }); }
  } else if (body.file_b64) {
    const mime = String(body.mime || 'application/octet-stream');
    if (/^image\//.test(mime)) content.push({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: dataUrl(String(body.file_b64), mime) } });
    else content.push({ type: 'file', file: { filename: String(body.filename || 'document.pdf'), file_data: dataUrl(String(body.file_b64), mime || 'application/pdf') } });
  }
  return content;
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key'); if (!key) return J({ error: 'no ai key' }, 500);
    const mode = body.mode === 'profile' ? 'profile' : body.mode === 'cert' ? 'cert' : 'license';
    const images: any[] = Array.isArray(body.images) ? body.images : [];
    if (!images.length && !body.file_b64) return J({ error: 'no file' }, 400);
    const content = buildContent(mode, images, body);
    const sys = mode === 'license' ? SYS_LICENSE : mode === 'cert' ? SYS_CERT : SYS_PROFILE;
    let ai: any = {};
    try {
      const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${key}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ models: MODELS, max_tokens: 1500, temperature: 0.1, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: sys }, { role: 'user', content }] }) });
      const jd = await r.json();
      if (!r.ok) return J({ error: 'ai_error', detail: jd?.error?.message || JSON.stringify(jd).slice(0, 300) }, 502);
      ai = parseJson(jd?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '{}');
    } catch (e) { return J({ error: 'ai_exception', detail: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 502); }

    if (mode === 'license') {
      const emirate = normEmirate(ai.emirate || ai.city);
      const doc = {
        legal_name: String(ai.legal_name || '').trim().slice(0, 200),
        license_number: String(ai.license_number || '').trim().slice(0, 60),
        license_authority: String(ai.license_authority || '').trim().slice(0, 160),
        emirate,
        city: String(ai.city || ai.emirate || '').trim().slice(0, 80) || emirate,
        issue_date: normDate(ai.issue_date),
        expiry_date: normDate(ai.expiry_date),
        activities: Array.isArray(ai.activities) ? ai.activities.map((s: any) => String(s).slice(0, 120)).slice(0, 20) : [],
        trn: String(ai.trn || '').replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 15),
        confidence: ['low', 'medium', 'high'].includes(ai.confidence) ? ai.confidence : 'low',
      };
      return J({ ok: true, mode, doc });
    }

    if (mode === 'cert') {
      const expiry = normDate(ai.expiry_date);
      const cert = {
        doc_type: ['insurance','iso','manufacturer','other'].includes(ai.doc_type) ? ai.doc_type : 'other',
        issuer: String(ai.issuer || '').trim().slice(0, 160),
        reference: String(ai.reference || '').trim().slice(0, 80),
        issue_date: normDate(ai.issue_date),
        expiry_date: expiry,
        covers: String(ai.covers || '').trim().slice(0, 300),
        confidence: ['low', 'medium', 'high'].includes(ai.confidence) ? ai.confidence : 'low',
      };
      // The portal prefills the date field from this and leaves it editable. found_expiry=false means
      // the document genuinely had no printed expiry, so the supplier is asked rather than guessed at.
      return J({ ok: true, mode, cert, found_expiry: !!expiry });
    }

    const profile = {
      summary: String(ai.summary || '').trim().slice(0, 1200),
      services: Array.isArray(ai.services) ? ai.services.map((s: any) => String(s).slice(0, 80)).slice(0, 12) : [],
      products: Array.isArray(ai.products) ? ai.products.map((s: any) => String(s).slice(0, 80)).slice(0, 12) : [],
      sectors: Array.isArray(ai.sectors) ? ai.sectors.map((s: any) => String(s).slice(0, 60)).slice(0, 12) : [],
      emirates: Array.isArray(ai.emirates) ? ai.emirates.map((s: any) => normEmirate(s)).filter(Boolean) : [],
      confidence: ['low', 'medium', 'high'].includes(ai.confidence) ? ai.confidence : 'low',
    };
    return J({ ok: true, mode, profile });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

'+' + n : ''; } d = d.replace(/\D/g, ''); if (d.startsWith('00')) d = d.slice(2); if (d.startsWith('971')) return '+' + d; if (d.startsWith('0')) return '+971' + d.slice(1); if (d.length === 9 && d.startsWith('5')) return '+971' + d; if (d.length >= 8) return '+' + d; return ''; }
function code6() { return String(Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000)); }

// capped, so verify is limited per issued code AND per caller.

const EMAIL_VERIFY_PER_IP_HOUR = 30;

// has only 10^6 possibilities, so an unsalted SHA-256 of the code is reversible from a single
// table leak by precomputing all a million hashes. The HMAC key (app_secrets.otp_hmac_key) makes
// a leaked token_hash useless without the key; we fail closed if the key is missing rather than
// silently fall back to a weak hash.
let _otpKey: string | null = null;
async function otpKey(): Promise<string> {
  if (_otpKey) return _otpKey;
  const k = await sec('otp_hmac_key');
  if (!k) throw new Error('otp_hmac_key_missing');
  _otpKey = k; return k;
}
async function otpHash(code: string): Promise<string> {
  const ck = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(await otpKey()), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']);
  const mac = await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', ck, new TextEncoder().encode(code));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(mac)).map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}
async function twilioAuth() { const sid = await sec('twilio_api_key_sid'); const secret = await sec('twilio_api_key_secret'); const va = await sec('twilio_verify_service_sid'); if (!sid || !secret || !va) return null; return { hdr: 'Basic ' + btoa(sid + ':' + secret), va }; }
async function sendEmail(to: string, subject: string, html: string) { const key = await sec('resend_api_key'); if (!key) return false; const from = (await sec('email_from_info')) || 'QuotesDone <info@quotesdone.com>'; try { const r = await fetch('https://api.resend.com/emails', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + key, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ from, to, subject, html }) }); return r.ok; } catch { return false; } }

// SUPPRESSION BYPASS 27 Jul 2026 ----------------------------------------------------------------

// Resend has already told us rejects permanently is exactly what burns the sender reputation the

// Twilio account and SMS harassment of third parties sent in our name.
// Per-number capping alone cannot stop that, because each new victim is a fresh bucket. These add

// even if someone scripts it. A legitimate person signing up never comes close to either.

const SMS_SIGNUP_GLOBAL_HOUR = 60;
async function rl(key: string, limit: number, seconds: number): Promise<boolean> {
  try { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('rl_check', { p_key: key, p_limit: limit, p_seconds: seconds }); if (error) return true; return data !== false; }
  catch (_e) { return true; } // limiter unavailable must not lock legitimate users out of sign-in
}

}

No code was issued and no Resend call was made. If this is a real user, confirm the mailbox works and delete their email_suppressions row; do not remove this check.');

      if (!acctEmail && !allowSignup) return J({ error: "This mobile number isn't linked to a QuotesDone account yet. Please sign in with the email you registered with, or create your account first.", no_account: true }, 404);

      const ipOk = await rl('login_otp_sms_ip:' + ip, SMS_PER_IP_HOUR, 3600);
      const globalOk = (!acctEmail && allowSignup) ? await rl('login_otp_sms_signup_global', SMS_SIGNUP_GLOBAL_HOUR, 3600) : true;
      if (!ipOk || !globalOk) {

          return J({ error: 'Incorrect or expired code.' }, 400);

        const s = await mintSession(email); if (!s) return J({ error: 'Could not start your session. Please try again.' }, 500);
        return J({ ok: true, ...s, user_kind: kind, email });

      const tw = await twilioAuth(); if (!tw) return J({ error: 'SMS sign-in is not enabled yet.' }, 503);
      try {
        const r = await fetch(`https://verify.twilio.com/v2/Services/${tw.va}/VerificationCheck`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': tw.hdr, 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: new URLSearchParams({ To: e164, Code: code }) });
        const jd = await r.json(); if (jd?.status !== 'approved') return J({ error: 'Incorrect or expired code.' }, 400);
      } catch (e) { return J({ error: 'Verification failed, please try again.', detail: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 502); }
      const { data: pv } = await admin.from('phone_verifications').select('email').eq('phone', e164).not('email', 'eq', '').order('created_at', { ascending: false }).maybeSingle();
      let email = (pv as any)?.email || '';
      if (!email) email = (await resolveEmailByPhone(kind, e164)) || '';
      if (!email) return J({ error: 'No account is registered with this number. Please sign in with your email, or sign up first.' }, 404);

      await admin.from('phone_verifications').update({ used_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('phone', e164).is('used_at', null);
      const s = await mintSession(email); if (!s) return J({ error: 'Could not start your session. Please try again.' }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true, ...s, user_kind: kind, email });
    }

    return J({ error: 'Unknown action' }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
// make_pdf v6 - native delegator to pdf_native (pdf-lib). Brand letterhead is now the DEFAULT for every
// generated document (header band + logo + footer) unless the caller passes options.letterhead=false or plain=true.
// Detects a doc_render letterhead document and re-renders it natively WITH letterhead + signature + stamp; otherwise
// renders the body content in the standard QuotesDone branded format. Keeps the same {ok,url,path,bytes} response shape.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const BASE = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')! + '/functions/v1';
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
async function authed(req: Request, body: any){ if (body.__secret && body.__secret === (await sec('inbound_secret'))) return true; const jwt=(req.headers.get('Authorization')||'').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i,''); const { data:{ user } }=await admin.auth.getUser(jwt); const allow=(await sec('admin_emails')||'').split(',').map((s)=>s.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean); return !!(user?.email && allow.includes(user.email.toLowerCase())); }
function grab(re: RegExp, html: string){ const m = html.match(re); return m ? m[1].replace(/<[^>]+>/g,'').replace(/&amp;/g,'&').trim() : ''; }
function letterheadFragment(html: string){ const metaIdx = html.indexOf('class="doc-meta"'); if(metaIdx<0) return null; const closeMeta = html.indexOf('</div>', metaIdx); if(closeMeta<0) return null; const start = closeMeta + 6; const signIdx = html.indexOf('class="sign"', start); let end; if(signIdx>=0){ const wrap = html.lastIndexOf('<div', signIdx); end = wrap>start ? wrap : signIdx; } else { const ftIdx = html.indexOf('class="ft"', start); end = ftIdx>=0 ? html.lastIndexOf('<div', ftIdx) : html.length; } const frag = html.slice(start, end).trim(); return frag.length>20 ? frag : null; }
function extractTitle(html: string){ return grab(/<title[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/title>/i, html) || grab(/class="doc-title"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/div>/i, html) || grab(/<h1[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/h1>/i, html); }
function bodyInner(html: string){ let h = html.replace(/<script[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi,'').replace(/<style[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi,'').replace(/<head[\s\S]*?<\/head>/gi,''); const m = h.match(/<body[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/body>/i); if(m) h=m[1]; h=h.replace(/<h1[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/h1>/i,''); return h; }
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    if (!(await authed(req, body))) return J({ error:'forbidden' }, 403);
    let html = body.html ? String(body.html) : '';
    if (!html && body.url) { try { html = await (await fetch(String(body.url))).text(); } catch(_e){} }
    if (!html || html.length < 20) return J({ error:'html_or_url_required' }, 400);
    const isLetterhead = /class="doc-title"/.test(html) || /qd_lockup_dark/.test(html);
    let frag = '', options = body.options || {};
    if (isLetterhead){ const f = letterheadFragment(html); if(f){ frag = f; options = { letterhead:true, sign:true, stamp:true, ...(body.options||{}) }; } }
    if (!frag) frag = bodyInner(html);
    // Brand letterhead is the default for every generated document unless explicitly opted out.
    if (!body.plain && options.letterhead === undefined) options.letterhead = true;
    const secret = await sec('inbound_secret');
    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
      __secret: secret,
      title: body.title || extractTitle(html) || 'Document',
      body_html: frag,
      name: body.name || 'document',
      folder: body.folder || null,
      bucket: body.bucket || 'agent-docs',
      lang: body.lang || 'en',
      options,
      raw: !!body.raw,
    };
    const r = await fetch(`${BASE}/pdf_native`, { method:'POST', headers:{ 'Content-Type':'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
    if (body.raw){ const buf = new Uint8Array(await r.arrayBuffer()); return new Response(buf, { status: r.status, headers: { 'Content-Type':'application/pdf', ...CORS } }); }
    const jd = await r.json();
    return J(jd, r.status);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message||e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
// make_xlsx - reusable native .xlsx generator (SheetJS). Input rows or multi-sheet; stores xlsx, returns signed URL. Admin/secret only.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import * as XLSX from 'https://esm.sh/xlsx@0.18.5';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
async function authed(req: Request, body: any){ if (body.__secret && body.__secret === (await sec('inbound_secret'))) return true; const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization')||'').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i,''); const { data:{ user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt); const allow = (await sec('admin_emails')||'').split(',').map((s)=>s.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean); return !!(user?.email && allow.includes(user.email.toLowerCase())); }
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    if (!(await authed(req, body))) return J({ error:'forbidden' }, 403);
    let sheets = Array.isArray(body.sheets) ? body.sheets : null;
    if (!sheets && Array.isArray(body.rows)) sheets = [{ name: body.sheet_name || 'Sheet1', rows: body.rows }];
    if (!sheets || !sheets.length) return J({ error:'sheets_or_rows_required' }, 400);
    const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
    for (let i=0;i<sheets.length;i++){ const sh = sheets[i]; const rows = Array.isArray(sh?.rows) ? sh.rows : []; const ws = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(rows); const widths: any[] = []; for (const r of rows) { (r||[]).forEach((c:any,ci:number)=>{ const len = String(c==null?'':c).length; widths[ci] = Math.min(60, Math.max(widths[ci]||10, len+2)); }); } ws['!cols'] = widths.map((w)=>({ wch: w })); const nm = String(sh?.name||('Sheet'+(i+1))).replace(/[\\\/?*\[\]:]/g,'').slice(0,31) || ('Sheet'+(i+1)); XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, nm); }
    const out = XLSX.write(wb, { type:'array', bookType:'xlsx' });
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(out);
    const bucket = String(body.bucket||'agent-docs');
    const safe = String(body.name||'workbook').replace(/[^\w.\-]+/g,'_').slice(0,50) || 'workbook';
    const path = (body.folder? String(body.folder).replace(/[^\w\-\/]/g,'')+'/' : (new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'/')) + Date.now() + '_' + safe + '.xlsx';
    const up = await admin.storage.from(bucket).upload(path, bytes, { contentType:'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet', upsert:true });
    if (up.error) return J({ error:'store_failed', detail: up.error.message }, 500);
    const { data: signed } = await admin.storage.from(bucket).createSignedUrl(path, 7*24*3600);
    return J({ ok:true, bucket, path, url: signed?.signedUrl||null, bytes: bytes.length, sheets: sheets.length });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message||e) }, 500); }
});
```

````typescript
// marketing_draft — the Marketing department's content_draft executor (autonomous).
// Generates on-brand content for the task and SAVES it as a DRAFT (content_drafts, status='draft').
// It never publishes and never spends: content_publish and ad_spend stay gated (unwired), so nothing
// goes public or costs money without the founder. Read + draft only.
// Auth: __secret (cos_execute / cron) OR admin-email JWT.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const FN = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')! + '/functions/v1';
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
const llm = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 1100, temperature: 0.4 });
const CHANNELS = new Set(['social', 'seo', 'email', 'blog', 'whatsapp']);
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
async function authed(req: Request, body: any): Promise<boolean> {
  if (body.__secret && body.__secret === (await sec('inbound_secret'))) return true;
  const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, ''); if (!jwt) return false;
  const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
  const allow = (await sec('admin_emails') || 'management@quotesdone.com').split(',').map((s) => s.trim().toLowerCase());
  return !!(user?.email && allow.includes(user.email.toLowerCase()));
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    if (!(await authed(req, body))) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);

    let title = String(body.title || '').trim(), detail = String(body.detail || '').trim(), objectiveText = '';
    if (body.task_id) {
      const { data: t } = await admin.from('org_tasks').select('title,detail,objective_id').eq('id', body.task_id).maybeSingle();
      if (t) { title = title || t.title || ''; detail = detail || t.detail || ''; if (t.objective_id) { const { data: o } = await admin.from('org_objectives').select('objective').eq('id', t.objective_id).maybeSingle(); objectiveText = o?.objective || ''; } }
    }
    if (!title) title = 'Draft marketing content for QuotesDone';

    // Brand voice / company context (always-on distilled knowledge).
    let brain = ''; try { const { data } = await admin.rpc('fn_agent_context', { p_agent_key: 'marketing', p_max_chars: 6000 }); brain = data ? String(data) : ''; } catch (_e) {}

    // Retrieved depth: pull the most relevant chunks from the queryable UAE marketing library for THIS task
    // (regulation/PDPL, SEO, paid media, WhatsApp/lifecycle, influencer, B2B, analytics...). On-demand, not always-on.
    let libref = '';
    try {
      const q = (title + ' ' + detail + ' ' + objectiveText).slice(0, 300);
      const { data: hits } = await admin.rpc('fn_marketing_library_search', { p_query: q, p_limit: 3 });
      if (Array.isArray(hits) && hits.length) {
        libref = '\n\nUAE MARKETING REFERENCE (retrieved for this task — apply what is relevant; never quote verbatim; treat legal/regulated/paid-media specifics as verify-before-acting):\n'
          + hits.map((h: any) => ('• [' + String(h.title).slice(0, 80) + '] ' + String(h.content).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 650))).join('\n');
      }
    } catch (_e) { /* generation proceeds on the always-on knowledge alone */ }

    const sys = 'You write concise, on-brand marketing content for QuotesDone, a UAE B2B anonymous quotation marketplace (buyers post RFQs; verified suppliers quote; buyer reveals a supplier for a fee). Practical, trustworthy, pro-SME, UAE-aware. NEVER invent statistics, prices, or client names. Choose the single most appropriate channel for the task from: social, seo, email, blog, whatsapp. Return STRICT minified JSON only: {"channel":"...","title":"...","body":"...","card_headline":"...","card_eyebrow":"..."}. body is the finished content ready for review (not a description). card_headline is a punchy on-image headline of AT MOST 8 words (no hashtags, no emoji); card_eyebrow is a 2-3 word label (e.g. "How it works", "For suppliers").' + (brain ? ('\n\n' + brain) : '') + libref;
    const user = 'MARKETING TASK: ' + title + (detail ? ('\n' + detail) : '') + (objectiveText ? ('\nParent objective: ' + objectiveText) : '') + '\n\nWrite the content now and return the JSON.';
    const raw = (await llm(sys, user, 1100) || '').trim();
    if (!raw) return J({ error: 'marketing_llm_unavailable' }, 502);

    let parsed: any = null;
    try { parsed = JSON.parse(raw.replace(/^```(json)?/i, '').replace(/```$/, '').trim()); } catch (_e) { const m = raw.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (m) { try { parsed = JSON.parse(m[0]); } catch (_e2) {} } }
    const channel = CHANNELS.has(String(parsed?.channel || '').toLowerCase()) ? String(parsed.channel).toLowerCase() : 'social';
    const draftTitle = String(parsed?.title || title).slice(0, 200);
    const draftBody = String(parsed?.body || raw).slice(0, 6000);
    if (draftBody.length < 30) return J({ error: 'draft_too_short' }, 502);

    // Make a self-branded image for the post (in-house, no external image model). Non-fatal.
    let imageUrl: string | null = null;
    const cardHeadline = String(parsed?.card_headline || draftTitle).slice(0, 90);
    const cardEyebrow = String(parsed?.card_eyebrow || '').slice(0, 30);
    try {
      const ir = await fetch(FN + '/marketing_image', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: await sec('inbound_secret'), title: cardHeadline, eyebrow: cardEyebrow }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(50000) });
      const ij = await ir.json().catch(() => ({} as any)); if (ij?.ok && ij.url) imageUrl = ij.url;
    } catch (_e) { /* draft still saves without an image */ }

    const { data: ins } = await admin.from('content_drafts').insert({ channel, title: draftTitle, body: draftBody, status: 'draft', source: 'marketing', image_url: imageUrl }).select('id').maybeSingle();

    return J({ ok: true, draft_id: ins?.id || null, channel, image_url: imageUrl,
      note: 'Drafted ' + channel + ' content "' + draftTitle.slice(0, 80) + '"' + (imageUrl ? ' with a self-made branded image' : '') + ' and saved it for review (status=draft, not published). Publishing stays gated for the founder.',
      preview: draftBody.slice(0, 400) });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
````

```typescript
// marketing_image — the Marketing department's IN-HOUSE branded image maker. No external image model,
// no per-image cost: it renders a clean branded SVG card (headline + brand mark) to PNG entirely inside
// the edge runtime (resvg-wasm), uploads it to a public bucket, and returns the URL. Used for social
// posts so the agent makes its own on-brand images. Auth: __secret OR admin JWT.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { Resvg, initWasm } from 'npm:@resvg/resvg-wasm@2.6.2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
async function authed(req: Request, body: any): Promise<boolean> {
  if (body.__secret && body.__secret === (await sec('inbound_secret'))) return true;
  const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, ''); if (!jwt) return false;
  const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
  const allow = (await sec('admin_emails') || 'management@quotesdone.com').split(',').map((s) => s.trim().toLowerCase());
  return !!(user?.email && allow.includes(user.email.toLowerCase()));
}

// One-time (per cold start) WASM init + font load, cached at module scope.
let wasmReady: Promise<void> | null = null;
function ensureWasm() { if (!wasmReady) wasmReady = initWasm(fetch('https://unpkg.com/@resvg/resvg-wasm@2.6.2/index_bg.wasm')); return wasmReady; }
let fontCache: Uint8Array[] | null = null;
async function loadFonts(): Promise<Uint8Array[]> {
  if (fontCache) return fontCache;
  const urls = [
    'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/google/fonts@main/ofl/poppins/Poppins-Bold.ttf',
    'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/google/fonts@main/ofl/poppins/Poppins-Regular.ttf',
  ];
  fontCache = await Promise.all(urls.map(async (u) => new Uint8Array(await (await fetch(u)).arrayBuffer())));
  return fontCache;
}

const esc = (s: string) => s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
function wrap(text: string, maxChars: number): string[] {
  const words = String(text || '').trim().split(/\s+/); const lines: string[] = []; let cur = '';
  for (const w of words) { if ((cur + ' ' + w).trim().length > maxChars && cur) { lines.push(cur); cur = w; } else cur = (cur + ' ' + w).trim(); }
  if (cur) lines.push(cur); return lines.slice(0, 6);
}

function buildSvg(headline: string, eyebrow: string): string {
  const W = 1080, H = 1080, PAD = 96;
  const lines = wrap(headline, 20);
  const fs = lines.length <= 2 ? 88 : lines.length === 3 ? 74 : lines.length === 4 ? 62 : 52;
  const lh = Math.round(fs * 1.16);
  const blockH = lines.length * lh;
  let y = Math.round((H - blockH) / 2) + fs; // baseline of first line, vertically centred
  const tspans = lines.map((ln) => { const t = `<tspan x="${PAD}" y="${y}">${esc(ln)}</tspan>`; y += lh; return t; }).join('');
  const eb = eyebrow ? `<text x="${PAD}" y="252" font-family="Poppins" font-weight="700" font-size="30" letter-spacing="4" fill="#5EEAD4">${esc(eyebrow.toUpperCase().slice(0, 40))}</text>` : '';
  // Official QuotesDone brand system (from the brand kit): navy bg gradient, teal + gold, teal-ring/gold-check mark.
  return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${W}" height="${H}" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0.12" y1="0" x2="0.88" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#173A4B"/><stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#0C2330"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#06121B"/></linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="teal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#6EE7D4"/><stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#16B8A6"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#0B8276"/></linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="gold" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0.3" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#F6DD8C"/><stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#E3C065"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#BD8E36"/></linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="accent" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#16B8A6"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#E3C065"/></linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="${W}" height="${H}" fill="url(#bg)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="14" height="${H}" fill="url(#accent)"/>
  <g transform="translate(52,40) scale(0.36)"><g transform="translate(-256,-250)"><circle cx="400" cy="398" r="92" fill="none" stroke="url(#teal)" stroke-width="50"/><path d="M434 470 L486 524 L582 408" fill="none" stroke="url(#gold)" stroke-width="44" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></g></g>
  ${eb}
  <text font-family="Poppins" font-weight="700" font-size="${fs}" fill="#FFFFFF">${tspans}</text>
  <line x1="${PAD}" y1="${H - 150}" x2="${W - PAD}" y2="${H - 150}" stroke="#234A5C" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="${PAD}" y="${H - 96}" font-family="Poppins" font-weight="700" font-size="34" fill="#FFFFFF">QuotesDone</text>
  <text x="${W - PAD}" y="${H - 96}" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins" font-weight="400" font-size="28" fill="#8FB0C0">quotesdone.com</text>
</svg>`;
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    if (!(await authed(req, body))) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const headline = String(body.title || body.headline || '').trim();
    if (!headline) return J({ error: 'title required' }, 400);
    const eyebrow = String(body.eyebrow || body.subtitle || '').trim();

    await ensureWasm();
    const fonts = await loadFonts();
    const svg = buildSvg(headline, eyebrow);
    const resvg = new Resvg(svg, { fitTo: { mode: 'width', value: 1080 }, font: { fontBuffers: fonts, defaultFontFamily: 'Poppins', loadSystemFonts: false } });
    const png = resvg.render().asPng();

    const slug = headline.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '').slice(0, 40) || 'card';
    const path = 'cards/' + slug + '-' + Date.now() + '.png';
    const { error: upErr } = await admin.storage.from('social-media').upload(path, png, { contentType: 'image/png', upsert: true });
    if (upErr) return J({ error: 'upload_failed: ' + upErr.message, bytes: png.length }, 200);
    const { data: pub } = admin.storage.from('social-media').getPublicUrl(path);
    return J({ ok: true, url: pub.publicUrl, path, bytes: png.length });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 200); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/match/index.ts

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const cors = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'match', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
}

// SECURITY FIX 18-19 Jul 2026 --------------------------------------------------------------
// match_suppliers_kw returns supplier company_name, phone, email, whatsapp and website. This
// endpoint previously returned those rows VERBATIM to any caller holding a Supabase user JWT,
// with body.limit passed straight through unclamped.
//
//   1. limit is clamped to MAX_LIMIT.
//   2. Contact/identity columns are redacted for JWT callers. Internal callers authenticating
//      with inbound_secret (route_inquiry, dispatch_inquiry) still get full rows, because they
//      need contact details to notify a matched supplier.
//   3. FREE-TEXT SCRUB. capability_summary is LLM-generated prose that opens with the company
//      name verbatim ("Emirates Prestige Flooring LLC is a UAE-based flooring supplier...").
//      Dropping the phone/email columns while leaving that text in place still discloses
//      identity and still defeats the paid-reveal model, so free text is scrubbed too.
//
// WHY THE SCRUB MATCHES ON WORD PAIRS, NOT SINGLE WORDS:
// UAE company names routinely embed their own trade - "... Flooring LLC", "... Joinery LLC",
// "... Contracting LLC". A single-token rule therefore deletes the services/products text of
// every flooring company purely because the word "flooring" appears in it, which destroys the
// search result for no privacy gain: nobody is identified by the word "flooring". A CONSECUTIVE
// WORD PAIR from the registered name ("Prestige Flooring", "Emirates Prestige") is identifying;
// a lone trade word is not. So: scrub the full name, the name minus legal suffix, and every
// adjacent word pair; then drop the field only if a word pair somehow survives. Fail closed on
// the identifying case, stay useful on the generic one.
const MAX_LIMIT = 25;
const SAFE_FIELDS = new Set(['id', 'supplier_id', 'lead_id', 'score', 'match_score', 'similarity', 'rank', 'sector', 'category', 'emirate', 'in_emirate', 'service_emirates', 'business_role', 'rating', 'app_rating', 'reviews', 'app_reviews', 'verified', 'capability_summary', 'services', 'products']);
const FREE_TEXT_FIELDS = new Set(['capability_summary', 'services', 'products']);

function escapeRe(s: string) { return s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'); }

// Adjacent word pairs from the company name, e.g. "Emirates Prestige Flooring LLC"
// -> ["Emirates Prestige", "Prestige Flooring", "Flooring LLC"]
function namePairs(name: string): string[] {
  const toks = String(name || '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9 ]/g, ' ').split(/\s+/).filter((t) => t.length > 1);
  const pairs: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i + 1 < toks.length; i++) pairs.push(toks[i] + ' ' + toks[i + 1]);
  return pairs;
}

// Returns scrubbed text, or null if the field must be dropped (identity survived the scrub).
function scrubText(txt: unknown, companyName: string): string | null {
  if (txt === null || txt === undefined) return txt as null;
  let out = String(txt);
  const full = String(companyName || '').trim();
  if (full.length > 2) {
    const bare = full.replace(/[\s,]+(l\.?l\.?c\.?|fze|fzc|fz-llc|est\.?|establishment|co\.?|general trading|trading)\s*$/i, '').trim();
    // Longest first so the full name is consumed before its constituent pairs.
    const variants = [full, bare, ...namePairs(full)].filter((v) => v.length > 3)
      .sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length);
    for (const v of variants) out = out.replace(new RegExp(escapeRe(v), 'gi'), 'This supplier');
    // Collapse the artefact of adjacent replacements ("This supplier This supplier is ...").
    out = out.replace(/(This supplier)(\s+This supplier)+/gi, 'This supplier').replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ').trim();
    // Backstop: an identifying word pair must not survive.
    const low = out.toLowerCase();
    for (const p of namePairs(full)) if (p.length > 3 && low.includes(p.toLowerCase())) return null;
  }
  return out;
}

function redact(rows: any[]) {
  return (rows || []).map((r) => {
    const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    const company = String(r?.company_name || '');
    for (const k of Object.keys(r || {})) {
      if (!SAFE_FIELDS.has(k)) continue;
      if (FREE_TEXT_FIELDS.has(k)) {
        const scrubbed = scrubText(r[k], company);
        if (scrubbed !== null) out[k] = scrubbed; // null => drop the field entirely
      } else out[k] = r[k];
    }
    return out;
  });
}

// BUG FIX 19 Jul 2026 ----------------------------------------------------------------------
// public.match_suppliers_kw exists in TWO overloads, both with every argument defaulted:
//   (p_keywords, p_category, p_emirate, p_role, p_min_rating, p_limit)            -- 6 args
//   (p_keywords, p_category, p_emirate, p_role, p_min_rating, p_limit, p_multi)   -- 7 args
// Calling it with only the six shared names matches BOTH candidates, so PostgREST refuses with
// PGRST203 "Could not choose the best candidate function" and this endpoint returned HTTP 500 to
// every caller, including the internal route_inquiry / dispatch_inquiry path. Supplier matching
// was failing in a way that reads downstream as "no suppliers found".
// Passing p_multi explicitly disambiguates to the 7-arg overload. Do NOT remove this argument
// without first dropping one of the two overloads.
const P_MULTI_DEFAULT = false;

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: cors });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    let ok = false; let internal = false;
    const { data: s, error: secErr } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', 'inbound_secret').maybeSingle();
    if (secErr) { await logRun('error', { suppliers: 0, secret_lookup_ok: 0 }, 'match could not read the inbound_secret from app_secrets (' + String(secErr.message).slice(0, 140) + '), so secret-authenticated callers are rejected regardless of correctness. Supplier matching returns nothing for an auth-infrastructure reason, not because no supplier matches.'); }
    if (s?.value && body?.__secret === s.value) { ok = true; internal = true; }
    if (!ok) {
      const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
      if (jwt) { try { const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt); if (user) ok = true; } catch (_e) { /* */ } }
    }
    if (!ok) {
      if (body?.__secret !== undefined) { await logRun('error', { suppliers: 0, bad_secret: 1 }, 'match rejected a caller that presented a wrong inbound secret (401). Any internal component relying on this call just received zero suppliers for an authentication reason, not because no supplier matches the request — that absence will look like a genuine coverage gap.'); }
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'unauthorized' }), { status: 401, headers: cors });
    }

    const askedLimit = Number(body.limit ?? 8);
    const limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(Number.isFinite(askedLimit) ? askedLimit : 8, MAX_LIMIT));
    const clamped = Number.isFinite(askedLimit) && askedLimit > MAX_LIMIT;

    const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('match_suppliers_kw', {
      p_keywords: body.keywords ?? [],
      p_category: body.category ?? null,
      p_emirate: body.emirate ?? null,
      p_role: body.role ?? null,
      p_min_rating: body.min_rating ?? null,
      p_limit: limit,
      p_multi: body.multi ?? P_MULTI_DEFAULT,
    });
    if (error) { await logRun('error', { suppliers: 0, zero_matches_genuine: 0, rpc_ok: 0 }, 'match returned no suppliers because the match_suppliers_kw retrieval query failed (' + String(error.message).slice(0, 140) + '), not because no supplier matches — the caller sees an empty supplier set that is indistinguishable from a genuine coverage gap.'); return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error.message }), { status: 500, headers: cors }); }
    const _n = data?.length ?? 0;
    const payload = internal ? (data ?? []) : redact(data ?? []);
    const _dropped = internal ? 0 : (payload as any[]).filter((p) => !('capability_summary' in p)).length;

    if (clamped && !internal) await logRun('error', { suppliers: _n, asked_limit: askedLimit, clamped_to: MAX_LIMIT, redacted: true, summaries_dropped: _dropped }, 'A signed-in (non-internal) caller requested ' + askedLimit + ' supplier matches; clamped to ' + MAX_LIMIT + ', contact fields redacted and free text scrubbed of supplier names. A large page request from a user JWT is the shape of a supplier-list scrape - worth checking who called.');
    else await logRun('ok', { suppliers: _n, zero_matches_genuine: _n === 0 ? 1 : null, rpc_ok: 1, internal, redacted: !internal, summaries_dropped: _dropped, category: body.category ?? null, emirate: body.emirate ?? null }, _n === 0 ? 'match ran cleanly and genuinely found zero suppliers for these criteria (category=' + String(body.category ?? '-') + ', emirate=' + String(body.emirate ?? '-') + '). This is a real supply coverage gap, not a failure.' : ('match returned ' + _n + ' candidate supplier(s) for category=' + String(body.category ?? '-') + ', emirate=' + String(body.emirate ?? '-') + (internal ? ' (internal caller, full detail).' : ' (redacted: contact fields withheld; ' + _dropped + ' summary field(s) dropped because a supplier-name word pair survived scrubbing).')));
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ count: _n, suppliers: payload, redacted: !internal }), { headers: cors });
  } catch (e) {
    await logRun('error', { suppliers: 0, zero_matches_genuine: 0, unhandled_exception: 1 }, 'match threw an unhandled exception and returned 500: ' + String(e).slice(0, 200) + ' — the caller received no suppliers for an internal reason, not because no supplier matches.');
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: String(e) }), { status: 500, headers: cors });
  }
```

```typescript
// match_eval — matching-precision test harness. Seeds tagged fixture sellers across distinct trades,
// runs a fixed benchmark of realistic RFQs through the REAL adjudicator (route_inquiry), and scores
// PRECISION (wrong-trade sellers kept out) and RECALL (the right seller let in). Self-cleaning: it
// deletes its fixtures at the end. Stores each run to match_eval_runs for monitoring/regression.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'match_eval', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
}
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 28 Jul 2026 (missed by the 27 Jul sweep): sec() returns undefined/'' when the
// app_secrets read fails or the row is missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller
// posting {} matched and gained full service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The
// stored secret must now be a real value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;

// fixture sellers (distinct trades) — capability_summary is what the adjudicator judges on
const FIX = [
  { tag:'pool', name:'HARNESS_FIX Pools', cat:'swimming-pools', cap:'Builds and renovates concrete and fibreglass swimming pools for villas and hotels in Dubai: excavation, RC shell, waterproofing, tiling, filtration plant, heating and lighting. Pool maintenance contracts.' },
  { tag:'elec', name:'HARNESS_FIX Electrical', cat:'electrical', cap:'DEWA-registered electrical contractor: distribution boards, wiring, lighting, power points, cable containment, load upgrades and DEWA inspection sign-off for residential and commercial premises. No civil or pool works.' },
  { tag:'cctv', name:'HARNESS_FIX Security', cat:'cctv-security', cap:'SIRA-licensed CCTV and security systems installer: IP cameras, NVR/DVR, access control, intercoms, ANPR and structured cabling for offices, retail and warehouses. Handles SIRA-compliant retention and connectivity.' },
  { tag:'fitout', name:'HARNESS_FIX Fitout', cat:'interior-design', cap:'Turnkey interior fit-out and interior design contractor for offices, retail and F&B: space planning, partitions, false ceilings, flooring, joinery, painting and full MEP (AC, electrical, plumbing, fire) with DCD and Municipality approvals. Handles combined multi-trade renovations end to end.' },
  { tag:'land', name:'HARNESS_FIX Landscaping', cat:'landscaping', cap:'Landscaping and garden design: softscape (lawns, plants), hardscape (paving, pergolas), irrigation systems, garden lighting and water features. Not a pool contractor.' }
];

// benchmark RFQs: which fixture-trade SHOULD win, which must NOT appear
const CASES = [
  { name:'concrete pool + heating', job:{ summary:'New concrete swimming pool approx 8x4m with heating and lighting for a villa', category:'swimming-pools', emirate:'Dubai', scope_type:'single', trades:['swimming pool','concrete pool','pool heating'] }, expect:'pool', forbid:['elec','cctv','land','fitout'] },
  { name:'DB board + wiring (DEWA)', job:{ summary:'Supply and install a new distribution board and rewire an apartment, DEWA connection', category:'electrical', emirate:'Dubai', scope_type:'single', trades:['electrical','distribution board','wiring','dewa'] }, expect:'elec', forbid:['pool','cctv','land','fitout'] },
  { name:'CCTV 16 cams + NVR (SIRA)', job:{ summary:'Supply and install 16 IP CCTV cameras with NVR and 30-day retention for a warehouse, SIRA compliant', category:'cctv-security', emirate:'Dubai', scope_type:'single', trades:['cctv','ip camera','nvr','sira'] }, expect:'cctv', forbid:['pool','elec','land','fitout'] },
  { name:'full office fit-out (multi-trade)', job:{ summary:'Full turnkey fit-out of a 2000 sqft office: partitions, false ceiling, flooring, lighting, AC and fire — design and build', category:'interior-design', emirate:'Dubai', scope_type:'turnkey', trades:['fit-out','partitions','ceiling','mep','turnkey'] }, expect:'fitout', forbid:['pool','cctv'] },
  { name:'garden landscaping + irrigation', job:{ summary:'Landscape a villa garden: lawn, plants, paving, a pergola and an irrigation system', category:'landscaping', emirate:'Dubai', scope_type:'single', trades:['landscaping','irrigation','pergola','garden'] }, expect:'land', forbid:['pool','elec','cctv'] }
];

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
  const inbound = await sec('inbound_secret');
  if (!inbound) { await logRun('error', { stage:'config' }, 'inbound_secret missing from app_secrets: match_eval can never authenticate itself to route_inquiry, so the matching precision/recall benchmark never runs and match-quality regressions stay invisible'); }
  if (!secretOk(inbound) || body.__secret !== inbound) { await logRun('error', { stage:'auth', rejected:1 }, 'Rejected a call with a wrong or missing __secret; the matching benchmark did not run, so any degradation in supplier-match precision/recall goes unmeasured'); return J({ error:'forbidden' }, 403); }
  const created: number[] = []; const tagById = new Map<number,string>();
  try {
    const seedFails: string[] = [];
    // seed fixtures
    for (const f of FIX) {
      const { data, error: seedErr } = await admin.from('leads').insert({ company_name: f.name, source:'self_registered', approval_status:'approved', banned:false, matching_blocked:false, registration_submitted_at: new Date().toISOString(), categories: f.cat, emirate:'Dubai', service_emirates:['Dubai'], email:'zzz_harness_'+f.tag+'@example.com', capability_summary: f.cap }).select('id').maybeSingle();
      if (data?.id) { created.push(Number(data.id)); tagById.set(Number(data.id), f.tag); }
      else { seedFails.push(f.tag+':'+String(seedErr?.message || 'no id returned')); }
    }
    const routeFails: string[] = [];
    const detail: any[] = []; let precSum = 0, precN = 0, recHit = 0, recN = 0;
    for (const c of CASES) {
      let fits: any[] = [];
      try {
        const r = await fetch('https://htdblwldjkcgjvmqkbeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/route_inquiry', { method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: inbound, inquiry: c.job }) });
        const jd = await r.json(); fits = Array.isArray(jd.fits) ? jd.fits : [];
      } catch (_e) { routeFails.push(c.name+':'+String((_e as Error)?.message || _e)); /* treat as no fits */ }
      // only score fits that are our fixtures (ignore any incidental real seller)
      const fitTags = fits.map((x:any)=> tagById.get(Number(x.id))).filter(Boolean) as string[];
      const allowed = fitTags.filter(t => !c.forbid.includes(t));
      const forbidden = fitTags.filter(t => c.forbid.includes(t));
      const prec = fitTags.length ? allowed.length / fitTags.length : 1; // no wrong sends => precision 1
      const gotExpected = fitTags.includes(c.expect);
      precSum += prec; precN++; recN++; if (gotExpected) recHit++;
      detail.push({ case: c.name, expected: c.expect, fits: fitTags, forbidden_hit: forbidden, precision: Math.round(prec*100), recall_hit: gotExpected });
    }
    const precision_pct = precN ? Math.round((precSum/precN)*1000)/10 : null;
    const recall_pct = recN ? Math.round((recHit/recN)*1000)/10 : null;
    const { error: runErr } = await admin.from('match_eval_runs').insert({ precision_pct, recall_pct, cases_total: CASES.length, detail });
    const notes: string[] = [];
    if (seedFails.length) notes.push(seedFails.length+' of '+FIX.length+' fixture sellers failed to seed ('+seedFails.join('; ')+'); the benchmark scored against an incomplete fixture set so the precision/recall numbers do not reflect real match quality');
    if (routeFails.length) notes.push(routeFails.length+' of '+CASES.length+' benchmark RFQs could not reach route_inquiry ('+routeFails.join('; ')+'); they were scored as zero recall, so an adjudicator outage is indistinguishable from a genuine matching regression');
    if (runErr) notes.push('match_eval_runs insert failed ('+String(runErr.message)+'); this benchmark result was not persisted, leaving a silent gap in the match-quality regression history');
    if (recall_pct !== null && recall_pct < 100) notes.push('recall '+recall_pct+'%: at least one benchmark RFQ did not reach the correct trade, meaning real customers in those trades can receive no suitable supplier quotes');
    if (precision_pct !== null && precision_pct < 100) notes.push('precision '+precision_pct+'%: wrong-trade suppliers were matched, meaning customers receive irrelevant quotes and suppliers receive junk leads');
    if (!notes.length) notes.push('benchmark passed: precision '+precision_pct+'%, recall '+recall_pct+'% across '+CASES.length+' RFQs');
    await logRun((seedFails.length || routeFails.length || runErr) ? 'error' : 'ok', { precision_pct, recall_pct, cases_total: CASES.length, fixtures_seeded: created.length, seed_failures: seedFails.length, route_failures: routeFails.length, run_insert_failed: runErr ? 1 : 0 }, notes.join(' | '));
    return J({ ok:true, precision_pct, recall_pct, cases_total: CASES.length, detail });
  } catch (e) {
    await logRun('error', { stage:'run', fixtures_seeded: created.length }, 'match_eval crashed: '+String((e as Error)?.message || e)+'; no precision/recall measurement was produced for this run, so supplier-matching regressions go undetected');
    return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500);
  } finally {
    if (created.length) { try { const { error: delErr } = await admin.from('leads').delete().in('id', created); if (delErr) { await logRun('error', { stage:'cleanup', orphans: created.length }, 'Failed to delete '+created.length+' HARNESS_FIX fixture sellers: '+String(delErr.message)+'; these fake approved suppliers remain in the leads table and will be matched against real customer RFQs, polluting live supplier matching'); } } catch (_e) { await logRun('error', { stage:'cleanup', orphans: created.length }, 'Failed to delete '+created.length+' HARNESS_FIX fixture sellers: '+String((_e as Error)?.message || _e)+'; these fake approved suppliers remain in the leads table and will be matched against real customer RFQs, polluting live supplier matching'); } }
  }
});
```

```typescript
// messages_api v4 - GATED customer<->supplier chat with hardened contact detection.
// Strong disclosure (email/link/UAE mobile/messaging app/solicitation) => block + ban + AED 10,000 (T&C) + owner alert.
// Borderline (a long number that might be a quantity) => message held + owner review, NO auto-ban.
// v4: llm() iterates single model (OpenRouter 'models' plural param was rejected).
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
const clip = (v: unknown, n: number) => String(v ?? '').trim().slice(0, n);
const WARNING = 'Keep everything inside QuotesDone. Do NOT share phone numbers, emails, links, WhatsApp/social handles, or try to move the deal off-platform. Sharing contact details breaches the Terms you accepted at sign-up and triggers an immediate account ban and a AED 10,000 penalty.';
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
async function ownerEmail(){ const v = await sec('admin_emails'); return String(v || 'management@quotesdone.com').split(',')[0].trim(); }
async function notify(rows: Record<string, unknown>[]) { try { if (rows.length) await admin.from('notifications').insert(rows); } catch (_e) {} }
const llm = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 700 }); // shared OpenRouter client (Sonnet-first ladder + 25s timeout)

// Hardened detector: normalises Arabic-Indic digits, spelled-out numbers, 'at'/'dot' obfuscation and spaced digits.
function detectContact(raw: string){
  const types = new Set<string>(); const strong = new Set<string>();
  const low = String(raw || '').toLowerCase();
  const ar = '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹';
  let t = low.replace(/[٠-٩۰-۹]/g, (c) => String(ar.indexOf(c) % 10));
  const nw: Record<string,string> = { zero:'0', oh:'0', one:'1', two:'2', three:'3', four:'4', five:'5', six:'6', seven:'7', eight:'8', nine:'9' };
  const spelled = t.replace(/\b(zero|oh|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine)\b/g, (w) => nw[w]);
  const collapse = (s: string) => s.replace(/(\d)[\s.\-_()]+(?=\d)/g, '$1');
  const dt = collapse(t), ds = collapse(spelled);
  const emailObf = t.replace(/\s*[\(\[]?\s*at\s*[\)\]]?\s*/g, '@').replace(/\s*[\(\[]?\s*dot\s*[\)\]]?\s*/g, '.');
  const emailRe = /[a-z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}/;
  if (emailRe.test(t) || emailRe.test(emailObf)) { types.add('email'); strong.add('email'); }
  if (/(https?:\/\/|www\.)\S+/.test(t) || /\b[a-z0-9-]{2,}\.(com|net|ae|org|io|co|me|info|biz|app|link)\b/.test(t)) { types.add('link'); strong.add('link'); }
  const uaeRe = /(?:\+?971|00971|0)?5\d{8}/;
  if (uaeRe.test(dt) || uaeRe.test(ds)) { types.add('phone'); strong.add('phone'); }
  else if (/\d{9,}/.test(dt) || /\d{9,}/.test(ds)) { types.add('phone_generic'); } // borderline only
  if (/(whats\s*app|whatsapp|wa\.me|telegram|t\.me|viber|botim|snapchat|skype|instagram)/.test(t)) { types.add('messaging_app'); strong.add('messaging_app'); }
  if (/(call me|whatsapp me|my number|my mobile|my cell|reach me on|contact me directly|outside the platform|off[\s-]?platform|deal directly|my email|email me at|text me on|here is my number|this is my number|save my number)/.test(t)) { types.add('solicitation'); strong.add('solicitation'); }
  if (/(^|\s)@[a-z0-9_.]{3,}/.test(low)) { types.add('handle'); } // borderline (could be '@ 5pm')
  return { hit: types.size > 0, types: [...types], strong: strong.size > 0 };
}

        out.sort((a, b) => String(b.last_at || '').localeCompare(String(a.last_at || '')));
        return J({ ok: true, role: 'customer', threads: out });
      }
      return J({ ok: true, role: null, threads: [] });
    }

    const inquiry_id = String(body.inquiry_id || ''); const supplier_id = Number(body.supplier_id || 0);
    if (!inquiry_id || !supplier_id) return J({ error: 'missing inquiry_id/supplier_id' }, 400);
    const rev = await revealed(inquiry_id, supplier_id);
    let role: 'customer' | 'supplier' | null = null;
    if (supLead && supLead.id === supplier_id) role = 'supplier';
    else if (cust && rev && rev.customer_id === cust.id) role = 'customer';
    if (!role) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    if (!rev) return J({ ok: true, locked: true, messages: [], note: 'Messaging unlocks after the quote is revealed.' });
    const banned = (role === 'supplier' ? supLead?.banned : cust?.banned) === true;
    const { data: th } = await admin.from('chat_threads').select('status,reason').eq('inquiry_id', inquiry_id).eq('supplier_id', supplier_id).maybeSingle();
    const status = th?.status || 'none';

    if (action === 'request_chat') {
      const q = clip(body.question, 1500); if (!q) return J({ error: 'question required' }, 400);
      if (banned) return J({ error: 'Your account is suspended.' }, 403);
      if (status === 'open') return J({ ok: true, status: 'open', note: 'Chat is already open.' });
      if (status === 'requested') return J({ ok: true, status: 'requested', note: 'Your request is pending review.' });
      if (status === 'banned') return J({ error: 'This chat is closed due to a policy violation.' }, 403);
      const { data: inq } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('category,summary,emirate').eq('id', inquiry_id).maybeSingle();
      const cat = await resolveCat(inq?.category);
      const sys = 'You are the ' + (cat ? cat.name : 'category') + ' sales/expert agent for QuotesDone, a UAE B2B quotation marketplace. A ' + role + ' wants to ask the other party something on a revealed inquiry. Decide if THIS needs a direct human-to-human chat, or if you can answer it yourself. Generic / process / pricing-norm / scope-clarification questions: answer them. Only complex custom scoping, negotiation, scheduling/site coordination, or anything truly requiring the other party should open a chat. Reply ONLY JSON: {"needs_chat":true|false,"answer":"<your helpful answer if you can resolve it, else empty>"}.';
      const out = await llm(sys, 'Category: ' + (inq?.category || '') + '\nProject: ' + (inq?.summary || '') + (inq?.emirate ? ' (' + inq.emirate + ')' : '') + '\nAsked by: ' + role + '\nQuestion: ' + q, 700);
      let needs = true, answer = '';
      if (out) { const m = out.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (m) { try { const pj = JSON.parse(m[0]); needs = pj.needs_chat !== false; answer = String(pj.answer || ''); } catch (_e) {} } }
      if (!needs && answer) return J({ ok: true, answered: true, answer });
      await admin.from('chat_threads').upsert({ inquiry_id, supplier_id, customer_id: rev.customer_id, status: 'requested', reason: q, requested_by: role, category: inq?.category || null }, { onConflict: 'inquiry_id,supplier_id' });
      const agentKey = cat ? ('cat:' + cat.slug) : 'followup';
      try { await admin.from('agent_actions').insert({ agent: agentKey, kind: 'open_chat', status: 'pending', risk: 'low', title: 'Chat requested — ' + (cat ? cat.name : (inq?.category || 'inquiry')) + (inq?.emirate ? ' / ' + inq.emirate : ''), recommendation: 'open the chat only if a direct discussion is genuinely needed', target_table: 'chat_threads', target_id: inquiry_id + ':' + supplier_id, detail: { inquiry_id, supplier_id, by: role, category: inq?.category, question: q } }); } catch (_e) {}
      await notify([{ type: 'chat_request', to_email: await ownerEmail(), to_role: 'admin', inquiry_id, subject: 'Chat requested on QuotesDone — ' + (cat ? cat.name : (inq?.category || 'inquiry')), body: 'A ' + role + ' asked to open a direct chat on inquiry ' + inquiry_id + '.\n\nQuestion: ' + q + '\n\nThe ' + (cat ? cat.name : 'category') + ' agent judged it needs a human conversation. Approve or decline it in Admin → Agents → approvals.' }]);
      return J({ ok: true, requested: true, note: 'Sent for review. You will be notified if the chat is opened.' });
    }

    if (action === 'thread') {
      if (status !== 'open') return J({ ok: true, locked: true, chat_status: status, warning: WARNING, messages: [], note: status === 'requested' ? 'Your chat request is pending review.' : (status === 'banned' ? 'This chat is closed due to a policy violation.' : 'No chat open yet. Use the Ask / request a chat button to start.') });
      const { data: msgs } = await admin.from('messages').select('id,sender,body,created_at').eq('inquiry_id', inquiry_id).eq('supplier_id', supplier_id).eq('blocked', false).order('created_at', { ascending: true }).limit(500);
      if (role === 'customer') await admin.from('messages').update({ read_by_customer: true }).eq('inquiry_id', inquiry_id).eq('supplier_id', supplier_id).eq('sender', 'supplier').eq('read_by_customer', false);
      else await admin.from('messages').update({ read_by_supplier: true }).eq('inquiry_id', inquiry_id).eq('supplier_id', supplier_id).eq('sender', 'customer').eq('read_by_supplier', false);
      let counterpart = 'Customer'; if (role === 'customer') { const { data: lead } = await admin.from('leads').select('company_name').eq('id', supplier_id).maybeSingle(); counterpart = lead?.company_name || 'Supplier'; }
      return J({ ok: true, role, counterpart, chat_status: 'open', warning: WARNING, messages: msgs || [] });
    }

    if (action === 'send') {
      if (banned) return J({ error: 'Your account is suspended for sharing contact details off-platform.' }, 403);
      if (status !== 'open') return J({ error: 'Chat is not open. Request a chat first.', chat_status: status }, 403);
      const text = clip(body.body, 2000); if (!text) return J({ error: 'empty' }, 400);
      const det = detectContact(text);
      if (det.hit) {
        await admin.from('chat_violations').insert({ inquiry_id, supplier_id, sender_role: role, sender_email: email, matched: det.types.join(',') + (det.strong ? '' : ' (borderline)'), body: text.slice(0, 1000) });
        await admin.from('messages').insert({ inquiry_id, supplier_id, customer_id: rev.customer_id, sender: role, body: '[blocked]', redacted_body: text.slice(0, 1000), blocked: true, flagged: true, read_by_customer: true, read_by_supplier: true });
        if (det.strong) {
          await admin.from('chat_threads').update({ status: 'banned', strikes: 1, closed_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('inquiry_id', inquiry_id).eq('supplier_id', supplier_id);
          if (role === 'supplier') await admin.from('leads').update({ banned: true, banned_reason: 'Shared contact info in chat (' + det.types.join(',') + ')' }).eq('id', supplier_id);
          else await admin.from('customers').update({ banned: true, banned_reason: 'Shared contact info in chat (' + det.types.join(',') + ')' }).eq('id', rev.customer_id);
          await notify([{ type: 'chat_violation', to_email: await ownerEmail(), to_role: 'admin', inquiry_id, subject: '⚠ Contact-info disclosure blocked on QuotesDone', body: 'A ' + role + ' (' + email + ') tried to share contact info (' + det.types.join(', ') + ') on inquiry ' + inquiry_id + '. The message was blocked, the chat closed, and the account auto-suspended per the Terms (AED 10,000 penalty applies). Review in Admin.\n\nAttempted: ' + text.slice(0, 400) }]);
          return J({ ok: false, blocked: true, warning: 'Your message was blocked and your account has been suspended. ' + WARNING });
        } else {
          await notify([{ type: 'chat_review', to_email: await ownerEmail(), to_role: 'admin', inquiry_id, subject: 'Possible contact info held for review on QuotesDone', body: 'A ' + role + ' (' + email + ') sent a message on inquiry ' + inquiry_id + ' that looks like it may contain a phone number or contact detail (borderline match: ' + det.types.join(', ') + '). It was held and NOT delivered, and the account was NOT auto-suspended. Review in Admin and ban manually if it was a real disclosure attempt.\n\nMessage: ' + text.slice(0, 400) }]);
          return J({ ok: false, blocked: true, review: true, warning: 'Your message looks like it may include a phone number or contact detail, so it was held. Keep all details on QuotesDone. If that was a quantity or project number, please write it in words and resend.' });
        }
      }
      const { data: m, error } = await admin.from('messages').insert({ inquiry_id, supplier_id, customer_id: rev.customer_id, sender: role, body: text, read_by_customer: role === 'customer', read_by_supplier: role === 'supplier' }).select('id,sender,body,created_at').maybeSingle();
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      try {
        if (role === 'customer') { const { data: lead } = await admin.from('leads').select('claimed_by,company_name').eq('id', supplier_id).maybeSingle(); if (lead?.claimed_by) await notify([{ type: 'new_message', to_email: lead.claimed_by, to_role: 'supplier', inquiry_id, subject: 'New message from a customer on QuotesDone', body: 'You have a new message on an open project chat. Log in to your supplier portal to reply.' }]); }
        else { const { data: c } = await admin.from('customers').select('email').eq('id', rev.customer_id).maybeSingle(); const { data: lead } = await admin.from('leads').select('company_name').eq('id', supplier_id).maybeSingle(); if (c?.email) await notify([{ type: 'new_message', to_email: c.email, to_role: 'customer', inquiry_id, subject: 'New message from ' + (lead?.company_name || 'a supplier'), body: 'You have a new message on your open project chat. Log in to reply.' }]); }
      } catch (_e) {}
      return J({ ok: true, message: m });
    }

    return J({ error: 'unknown action' }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```
