### supabase/functions/meta_ads/index.ts

```typescript
// meta_ads v1 — platform connector for Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad campaigns.
// SAFETY: only ever creates PAUSED objects. It NEVER activates a campaign or spends budget.
// Activation stays a human action in Meta Ads Manager. Auth: __secret == inbound_secret.
// Secrets (founder adds later): meta_ad_account_id (digits only), meta_access_token (ads_management),
//   optional meta_api_version.
// Actions:
//   test          -> read the ad account (verifies token + account)
//   quick_campaign-> create a PAUSED campaign + PAUSED ad set (traffic to the site, geo UAE)
//   list          -> list recent campaigns
//   insights      -> account-level performance (last N days)
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' } });
async function sec(k: string): Promise<string | undefined> { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': '*' } });
  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
  const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
  if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
  const [token, acctRaw, ver] = await Promise.all([sec('meta_access_token'), sec('meta_ad_account_id'), sec('meta_api_version')]);
  if (!token || !acctRaw) return J({ ok: false, error: 'meta_not_configured', need: ['meta_access_token', 'meta_ad_account_id'] }, 200);
  const acct = 'act_' + String(acctRaw).replace(/^act_/, '');
  const V = ver || 'v21.0';
  const G = 'https://graph.facebook.com/' + V;
  const started = new Date().toISOString();

  const post = async (path: string, params: Record<string, string>) => {
    const form = new URLSearchParams({ ...params, access_token: token });
    const r = await fetch(G + path, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: form });
    const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); return { ok: r.ok, status: r.status, j };
  };
  const get = async (path: string, query: Record<string, string> = {}) => {
    const qs = new URLSearchParams({ ...query, access_token: token }).toString();
    const r = await fetch(G + path + '?' + qs); const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); return { ok: r.ok, status: r.status, j };
  };

  try {
    const action = String(body.action || 'test');

    if (action === 'test') {
      const r = await get('/' + acct, { fields: 'name,account_status,currency,timezone_name,amount_spent,balance' });
      return J({ ok: r.ok, status: r.status, account: r.j });
    }

    if (action === 'list') {
      const r = await get('/' + acct + '/campaigns', { fields: 'name,objective,status,effective_status,daily_budget,created_time', limit: '25' });
      return J({ ok: r.ok, campaigns: r.j?.data || r.j });
    }

    if (action === 'insights') {
      const days = Math.max(1, Math.min(90, Number(body.days) || 30));
      const r = await get('/' + acct + '/insights', { date_preset: days <= 7 ? 'last_7d' : (days <= 30 ? 'last_30d' : 'last_90d'), fields: 'spend,impressions,clicks,cpc,ctr,reach,actions' });
      return J({ ok: r.ok, insights: r.j?.data || r.j });
    }

    if (action === 'quick_campaign') {
      const name = String(body.name || 'QuotesDone Campaign').slice(0, 120);
      const objective = ['OUTCOME_TRAFFIC', 'OUTCOME_LEADS', 'OUTCOME_ENGAGEMENT', 'OUTCOME_AWARENESS', 'OUTCOME_SALES'].includes(String(body.objective)) ? String(body.objective) : 'OUTCOME_TRAFFIC';
      const dailyAed = Math.max(20, Number(body.daily_budget_aed) || 50); // Meta minimum varies; floor at AED 20
      const dailyMinor = Math.round(dailyAed * 100); // AED has 2 decimals -> fils
      const countries = Array.isArray(body.countries) && body.countries.length ? body.countries : ['AE'];

      // 1) PAUSED campaign
      const c = await post('/' + acct + '/campaigns', { name, objective, status: 'PAUSED', special_ad_categories: JSON.stringify([]) });
      if (!c.ok || !c.j?.id) { await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'meta_ads', started_at: started, finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'error', note: JSON.stringify(c.j).slice(0, 200) }); return J({ ok: false, step: 'campaign', error: c.j?.error?.message || c.j }, 200); }
      const campaign_id = c.j.id;

      // 2) PAUSED ad set — traffic/link clicks to the site, UAE, no pixel/page required
      const targeting = { geo_locations: { countries }, age_min: 18, age_max: 65 };
      const adsetParams: Record<string, string> = {
        name: name + ' — Ad set', campaign_id, daily_budget: String(dailyMinor),
        billing_event: 'IMPRESSIONS', optimization_goal: objective === 'OUTCOME_AWARENESS' ? 'REACH' : 'LINK_CLICKS',
        bid_strategy: 'LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP', targeting: JSON.stringify(targeting), status: 'PAUSED',
      };
      const a = await post('/' + acct + '/adsets', adsetParams);
      await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'meta_ads', started_at: started, finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: a.ok ? 'ok' : 'error', counts: { campaign: 1, adset: a.ok ? 1 : 0 }, note: a.ok ? null : JSON.stringify(a.j).slice(0, 200) });
      return J({ ok: a.ok, campaign_id, adset_id: a.j?.id || null, status: 'PAUSED', note: 'Created PAUSED. Add the ad creative + review targeting/budget in Meta Ads Manager, then switch it on to start spending.', adset_error: a.ok ? null : (a.j?.error?.message || a.j) });
    }

    return J({ error: 'unknown_action' }, 400);
  } catch (e) {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'meta_ads', started_at: started, finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'error', note: String(e).slice(0, 200) });
    return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 200);
  }
});
```

### supabase/functions/meta_sync/index.ts

```typescript
// meta_sync - pulls QuotesDone Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad campaign insights into public.meta_insights.
// Token-gated: requires app_secrets.meta_access_token (ads_read). Filters to campaigns whose name contains
// meta_campaign_filter (default 'QuotesDone') so the founder's DJ campaigns never enter QuotesDone's dashboards.
// Does NOT post to the GL. Returns {disabled:true} until a token is added.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'meta_sync', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
}
let INSIGHT_ERRORS = 0, EMPTY_INSIGHTS = 0, UPSERT_FAILS = 0; let LAST_ERR = '';
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string|undefined)||undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
const GV = 'v21.0';
function resultsFrom(row: any, objective: string): number {
  const acts = Array.isArray(row?.actions) ? row.actions : [];
  const pick = (t: string) => { const a = acts.find((x: any)=>x.action_type===t); return a? Number(a.value)||0 : 0; };
  if (/LEAD/i.test(objective)) return pick('lead') || pick('onsite_conversion.lead_grouped');
  if (/LINK_CLICKS|TRAFFIC/i.test(objective)) return pick('link_click') || Number(row?.clicks)||0;
  if (/ENGAGEMENT|POST_ENGAGEMENT/i.test(objective)) return pick('post_engagement');
  if (/VIDEO/i.test(objective)) return pick('video_view');
  return Number(row?.clicks)||0;
}
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) { await logRun('error', { upserts: 0 }, 'call rejected: wrong or missing inbound secret; no Meta ad campaign insights were synced'); return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403); }
    const token = await sec('meta_access_token');
    const acct = await sec('meta_ad_account_id');
    const filter = (await sec('meta_campaign_filter')) || 'QuotesDone';
    if (!token) { await logRun('skipped', { upserts: 0, campaigns: 0, disabled: 1 }, 'Meta sync is DISABLED (no meta_access_token configured) — intentional off state, not a failure. meta_insights holds no ad spend/lead data until a token is added. Add app_secrets.meta_access_token (ads_read) to enable.'); return J({ ok: true, disabled: true, note: 'Add app_secrets.meta_access_token (ads_read) to enable Meta sync.' }); }
    if (!acct) { await logRun('skipped', { upserts: 0, campaigns: 0, disabled: 1 }, 'Meta sync is DISABLED (meta_ad_account_id not set) — intentional off state, not a failure. Set app_secrets.meta_ad_account_id to enable.'); return J({ ok: true, disabled: true, note: 'meta_ad_account_id not set.' }); }
    const act = acct.startsWith('act_') ? acct : ('act_' + acct);

    // 1) campaigns filtered to the QuotesDone name
    const cf = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify([{ field: 'name', operator: 'CONTAIN', value: filter }]));
    const curl = `https://graph.facebook.com/${GV}/${act}/campaigns?fields=id,name,effective_status,objective&filtering=${cf}&limit=200&access_token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`;
    const cr = await fetch(curl); const cj = await cr.json();
    if (cj?.error) { await logRun('error', { upserts: 0, campaigns: 0 }, 'Meta Graph campaigns call FAILED (' + String(cj.error?.message || '') + '): no ad spend or lead data synced this run, meta_insights is stale and marketing reporting understates spend'); return J({ ok: false, error: 'graph_campaigns', detail: cj.error?.message }); }
    const camps = Array.isArray(cj?.data) ? cj.data.filter((c: any)=> String(c.name||'').toLowerCase().includes(filter.toLowerCase())) : [];
    let upserts = 0; const seen: string[] = [];
    for (const c of camps) {
      for (const dp of ['last_30d','maximum']) {
        const iurl = `https://graph.facebook.com/${GV}/${c.id}/insights?fields=spend,impressions,clicks,reach,ctr,cpc,actions&date_preset=${dp}&access_token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`;
        const ir = await fetch(iurl); const ij = await ir.json();
        if (ij?.error) { INSIGHT_ERRORS++; LAST_ERR = 'insights call failed for campaign ' + String(c.id) + ' (' + dp + '): ' + String(ij.error?.message || ''); }
        else if (!(Array.isArray(ij?.data) && ij.data.length)) { EMPTY_INSIGHTS++; }
        const row = Array.isArray(ij?.data) && ij.data.length ? ij.data[0] : {};
        const rec = {
          campaign_id: String(c.id), campaign_name: c.name, effective_status: c.effective_status, objective: c.objective,
          time_window: dp, spend: Number(row?.spend)||0, impressions: Number(row?.impressions)||0, clicks: Number(row?.clicks)||0,
          reach: Number(row?.reach)||0, ctr: row?.ctr!=null?Number(row.ctr):null, cpc: row?.cpc!=null?Number(row.cpc):null,
          results: resultsFrom(row, String(c.objective||'')), currency: 'AED', synced_at: new Date().toISOString(), synced_via: 'meta_sync'
        };
        const { error } = await admin.from('meta_insights').upsert(rec, { onConflict: 'campaign_id,time_window' });
        if (error) { UPSERT_FAILS++; LAST_ERR = 'meta_insights upsert failed for campaign ' + String(c.id) + ' (' + dp + '): ' + String(error?.message || ''); }
        if (!error) upserts++;
      }
      seen.push(String(c.name));
    }
    const expected = camps.length * 2;
    let note: string;
    if (camps.length === 0) { note = 'Meta returned NO campaigns matching the "' + filter + '" name filter: nothing synced, so meta_insights has no fresh ad spend/lead data and marketing dashboards will show stale or zero figures'; }
    else if (INSIGHT_ERRORS >= expected) { note = 'every insights call failed for all ' + camps.length + ' matched campaign(s): rows were written with ZERO spend, impressions and results, which silently understates Meta ad spend and lead attribution'; }
    else if (INSIGHT_ERRORS > 0 || EMPTY_INSIGHTS > 0) { note = 'synced ' + upserts + '/' + expected + ' rows for ' + camps.length + ' campaign(s), but ' + INSIGHT_ERRORS + ' insights call(s) errored and ' + EMPTY_INSIGHTS + ' returned no data — those rows were stored as zeros and understate real spend/results'; }
    else { note = 'synced ' + upserts + '/' + expected + ' insight rows for ' + camps.length + ' matched Meta campaign(s)'; }
    if (UPSERT_FAILS > 0) { note += ' | ' + UPSERT_FAILS + ' row(s) failed to write to meta_insights'; }
    if (LAST_ERR) { note += ' | last error: ' + LAST_ERR; }
    const bad = UPSERT_FAILS > 0 || INSIGHT_ERRORS > 0 || camps.length === 0;
    await logRun(bad ? 'error' : 'ok', { campaigns: camps.length, upserts, expected_rows: expected, insight_errors: INSIGHT_ERRORS, empty_insights: EMPTY_INSIGHTS, upsert_failures: UPSERT_FAILS }, note);
    return J({ ok: true, campaigns: camps.length, upserts, sample: seen.slice(0,5) });
  } catch (e) { await logRun('error', { upserts: 0, insight_errors: INSIGHT_ERRORS, upsert_failures: UPSERT_FAILS }, 'meta_sync crashed before completing; Meta ad spend and lead data was not synced this run: ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e)); return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/mobile_otp/index.ts

```typescript
// mobile_otp v3 - customer mobile verification via Twilio VERIFY API (API-key auth).
// Uses the credentials that are actually provisioned: twilio_verify_service_sid + twilio_api_key_sid/_secret
// (account uses API keys + a Verify service, not legacy auth_token+from). Twilio manages the OTP code itself.
// Actions: 'status' (reports sms_enabled + phone), 'send', 'verify', 'diag' (read-only credential check).
// Authed via the customer's Supabase JWT. verify_jwt=false (validates JWT internally).
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string|undefined)||undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
function normPhone(p: string){ let s = String(p||'').trim().replace(/[^0-9+]/g,''); if(!s) return ''; if(s.startsWith('00')) s='+'+s.slice(2); if(!s.startsWith('+')){ if(s.startsWith('0')) s='+971'+s.slice(1); else if(s.startsWith('971')) s='+'+s; else s='+'+s; } return s; }

async function verifyCreds(){ return { svc: await sec('twilio_verify_service_sid'), ks: await sec('twilio_api_key_sid'), kk: await sec('twilio_api_key_secret') }; }
function basic(ks: string, kk: string){ return 'Basic ' + btoa(ks + ':' + kk); }

async function verifySend(svc: string, ks: string, kk: string, to: string, channel: string){
  const form = new URLSearchParams({ To: to, Channel: channel });
  const r = await fetch(`https://verify.twilio.com/v2/Services/${svc}/Verifications`, { method:'POST', headers:{ 'Authorization': basic(ks,kk), 'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: form.toString() });
  const jd = await r.json().catch(()=>({})); return { ok: r.ok, status: r.status, vstatus: jd?.status || null, error: r.ok ? null : (jd?.message || ('http '+r.status)), code: jd?.code || null };
}
async function verifyCheck(svc: string, ks: string, kk: string, to: string, code: string){
  const form = new URLSearchParams({ To: to, Code: code });
  const r = await fetch(`https://verify.twilio.com/v2/Services/${svc}/VerificationCheck`, { method:'POST', headers:{ 'Authorization': basic(ks,kk), 'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: form.toString() });
  const jd = await r.json().catch(()=>({})); return { ok: r.ok, status: r.status, vstatus: jd?.status || null, error: r.ok ? null : (jd?.message || ('http '+r.status)) };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({})); const action = String(body.action || '');
    const { svc, ks, kk } = await verifyCreds();
    const smsEnabled = !!(svc && ks && kk);

    // read-only credential + service reachability check (no SMS sent). Secret-gated to avoid abuse.
    if (action === 'diag') {
      const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
      if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error:'forbidden' }, 403);
      if (!smsEnabled) return J({ ok:false, sms_enabled:false, missing:{ verify_service_sid:!svc, api_key_sid:!ks, api_key_secret:!kk } });
      const r = await fetch(`https://verify.twilio.com/v2/Services/${svc}`, { headers:{ 'Authorization': basic(ks!,kk!) } });
      const jd = await r.json().catch(()=>({}));
      return J({ ok:r.ok, sms_enabled:true, http:r.status, service_name: jd?.friendly_name || null, auth_ok: r.ok, error: r.ok?null:(jd?.message||('http '+r.status)) });
    }

    const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
    const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
    if (!user || !user.email) return J({ error: 'Not signed in' }, 401);
    const email = user.email.toLowerCase();
    let { data: cust } = await admin.from('customers').select('id,phone,phone_verified').eq('email', email).maybeSingle();
    if (!cust) { const ins = await admin.from('customers').insert({ email }).select('id,phone,phone_verified').maybeSingle(); cust = ins.data; }

    if (action === 'status') return J({ ok: true, sms_enabled: smsEnabled, phone: cust!.phone || null, phone_verified: !!cust!.phone_verified });

    if (action === 'send') {
      if (!smsEnabled) return J({ ok: false, error: 'sms_not_configured' }, 200);
      const phone = normPhone(String(body.phone || ''));
      if (!phone || phone.replace(/\D/g,'').length < 9) return J({ ok: false, error: 'bad_phone' }, 200);
      // rate-limit: max 5 sends / 10 min / customer (ledger row, no code stored - Twilio Verify holds the code)
      const tenMinAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 600e3).toISOString();
      const { count } = await admin.from('customer_phone_otps').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('customer_id', cust!.id).gte('created_at', tenMinAgo);
      if ((count || 0) >= 5) return J({ ok: false, error: 'too_many_requests' }, 200);
      const res = await verifySend(svc!, ks!, kk!, phone, 'sms');
      if (!res.ok) return J({ ok:false, error:'send_failed', detail: res.error, code: res.code }, 200);
      await admin.from('customer_phone_otps').insert({ customer_id: cust!.id, phone, code_hash: 'twilio_verify', expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 600e3).toISOString() });
      return J({ ok: true, status: res.vstatus });
    }

    if (action === 'verify') {
      if (!smsEnabled) return J({ ok: false, error: 'sms_not_configured' }, 200);
      const phone = normPhone(String(body.phone || '')); const code = String(body.code || '').trim();
      if (!phone || !/^[0-9]{4,8}$/.test(code)) return J({ ok: false, error: 'bad_input' }, 200);
      const res = await verifyCheck(svc!, ks!, kk!, phone, code);
      if (!res.ok) return J({ ok:false, error:'verify_failed', detail: res.error }, 200);
      if (res.vstatus !== 'approved') return J({ ok: false, error: 'wrong_code', status: res.vstatus }, 200);
      await admin.from('customer_phone_otps').update({ consumed: true }).eq('customer_id', cust!.id).eq('phone', phone).eq('consumed', false);
      await admin.from('customers').update({ phone, phone_verified: true }).eq('id', cust!.id);
      return J({ ok: true, phone, phone_verified: true });
    }

    return J({ error: 'unknown action' }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
// money_tests - automated invariant checks for the payment paths + security regressions.
// Runs read-only/black-box assertions; alerts the founder (admin notification) on any failure.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const T0 = Date.now();

    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'money_tests', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
}
const BASE = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
const ANON = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6Imh0ZGJsd2xkamtjZ2p2bXFrYmVoIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3ODA3ODU1NDYsImV4cCI6MjA5NjM2MTU0Nn0.cF9ZR_Qo1YBhLvhTLS8aANlYb6c9rTsuQS6kLxGw_Bo';
const J=(o:unknown,s=200)=>new Response(JSON.stringify(o,null,2),{status:s,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});
async function sec(k:string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string)||''; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
function revealFee(amount:number,cfg:any,at=new Date()){ if(!amount||amount<=0) return 0; const promo=!!cfg.promo_until&&at<=new Date(cfg.promo_until); const rate=Number(promo?cfg.promo_reveal_rate:cfg.standard_reveal_rate); const cap=Number(promo?cfg.promo_reveal_cap:cfg.standard_reveal_cap); return Math.min(Math.round(amount*rate*100)/100, cap); }
async function restGet(path:string){ const r=await fetch(`${BASE}/rest/v1/${path}`,{headers:{apikey:ANON,Authorization:'Bearer '+ANON}}); let b:any=null; try{b=await r.json();}catch(_e){} return {status:r.status, body:b}; }
async function rpc(name:string,body:any){ const r=await fetch(`${BASE}/rest/v1/rpc/${name}`,{method:'POST',headers:{apikey:ANON,Authorization:'Bearer '+ANON,'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(body)}); let b:any=null; try{b=await r.json();}catch(_e){} return {status:r.status, body:b}; }
async function fn(slug:string,body:any,auth:string|null){ const h:any={'Content-Type':'application/json'}; if(auth) h['Authorization']='Bearer '+auth; const r=await fetch(`${BASE}/functions/v1/${slug}`,{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify(body)}); let b:any=null; try{b=await r.json();}catch(_e){} return {status:r.status, body:b}; }
Deno.serve(async (req)=>{
  // H4: self-authenticate on inbound_secret. Previously unauthenticated + verify_jwt=true meant any holder of
  // the public anon key could trigger the probe suite and read which tables are exposed. The daily cron now
  // sends __secret; verify_jwt stays true as defence-in-depth.
  const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
  const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
  if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error:'forbidden' }, 403);
  const results:{name:string,pass:boolean,detail?:string}[]=[];
  const T=(name:string,pass:boolean,detail='')=>results.push({name,pass,detail:pass?undefined:detail});
  let cfgErrMsg='';
  try{
    const {data:cfg,error:cfgErr}=await admin.from('pricing_config').select('*').eq('id',1).maybeSingle();
    if(cfgErr||!cfg) cfgErrMsg='pricing_config row id=1 could not be read, so the reveal-fee maths could not be verified at all and a wrong fee could be charged to customers without any test catching it: '+String(cfgErr?.message||'no pricing_config row')+'. ';
    // 1) fee math
    T('fee(10000)=3%', revealFee(10000,cfg)===Math.round(10000*Number(cfg.standard_reveal_rate)*100)/100, 'got '+revealFee(10000,cfg));
    T('fee(0)=0', revealFee(0,cfg)===0);
    T('fee is monotonic', revealFee(50000,cfg) >= revealFee(10000,cfg));
    T('fee never exceeds cap', revealFee(1e12,cfg) <= Number(cfg.standard_reveal_cap));
    // 2) stripe config
    const sk=await sec('stripe_secret_key');
    T('stripe key is LIVE', sk.startsWith('sk_live_'), 'key_mode='+(sk.slice(0,8)));
    if(sk){ const ar=await fetch('https://api.stripe.com/v1/account',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+sk}}); const aj=await ar.json(); T('stripe charges_enabled', aj?.charges_enabled===true, JSON.stringify(aj?.charges_enabled)); }
    // 3) security regressions - sensitive tables must NOT be anon-readable
    const ri=await restGet('reveal_invoices?select=*&limit=1'); T('reveal_invoices not anon-readable', ri.status===401||ri.status===403||(ri.body&&ri.body.code==='42501')||(Array.isArray(ri.body)&&ri.body.length===0), 'status '+ri.status+' '+JSON.stringify(ri.body).slice(0,80));
    const cu=await restGet('customers?select=*&limit=1'); T('customers denied to anon', cu.status===401||cu.status===403||(cu.body&&cu.body.code==='42501'), 'status '+cu.status);
    const tx=await restGet('transactions?select=*&limit=1'); T('transactions denied to anon', tx.status===401||tx.status===403||(tx.body&&tx.body.code==='42501'), 'status '+tx.status);
    const as=await restGet('app_secrets?select=*&limit=1'); T('app_secrets denied to anon', as.status===401||as.status===403||(as.body&&as.body.code==='42501'), 'status '+as.status);
    const fm=await rpc('funnel_metrics',{days:7}); T('funnel_metrics denied to anon', fm.status===401||fm.status===403||(fm.body&&fm.body.code), 'status '+fm.status);
    // 4) money edge-function guards (must reject unauthenticated)
    const co=await fn('stripe_checkout',{quote_id:'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'},null); T('stripe_checkout rejects no-auth', co.status===401, 'status '+co.status);
    const cf=await fn('stripe_confirm',{},null); T('stripe_confirm rejects no-auth', cf.status===401, 'status '+cf.status);
    const coA=await fn('stripe_checkout',{quote_id:'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'},ANON); T('stripe_checkout rejects anon token', coA.status===401, 'status '+coA.status);
  }catch(e){ T('runner', false, String((e as Error)?.message||e)); }
  const failed=results.filter(r=>!r.pass);
  let notifyErrMsg='';
  if(failed.length){
    // Founder email: prefer founder_email secret, else first admin_emails entry (OPEN_ISSUES #5).
    const founder=(await sec('founder_email')) || ((await sec('admin_emails')).split(',')[0]||'').trim() || 'management@quotesdone.com';
    const {error:notifyErr}=await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type:'money_test_fail', to_role:'admin', to_email:founder, channel:'email', status:'queued', subject:`⚠️ QuotesDone money/security test FAILED (${failed.length})`, body:'Automated invariant checks failed:\n\n'+failed.map(f=>`- ${f.name}: ${f.detail||''}`).join('\n')+'\n\nInvestigate before taking payments.' });
    if(notifyErr) notifyErrMsg='The founder alert email could not be queued in notifications, so '+failed.length+' failing money/security invariant(s) will go completely unnoticed: '+String(notifyErr.message||notifyErr)+'. ';
  }
  const counts={ total:results.length, passed:results.length-failed.length, failed:failed.length, failing_tests:failed.map(f=>f.name), alert_queued: failed.length? (notifyErrMsg?0:1) : 0 };
  if(failed.length||notifyErrMsg||cfgErrMsg){
    await logRun('error', counts, cfgErrMsg+notifyErrMsg+(failed.length?('Money/security invariant checks failed ('+failed.length+' of '+results.length+'): '+failed.map(f=>f.name+' -> '+(f.detail||'')).join('; ')+'. Payments or data-access protections may be broken.'):''));
  } else {
    await logRun('ok', counts, '');
  }
  return J({ ok:failed.length===0, passed:results.length-failed.length, failed:failed.length, results });
});
```

```typescript
// os_api — backend for QuotesDone OS. JWT-gated; owner/admin only (or a read-only x-os-key preview bypass). + audit trail. + secretary console passthrough.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const BASE = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')! + '/functions/v1';
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type, x-os-key', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' } });
const esc = (s: string) => String(s).replace(/[&<>]/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;' } as any)[c]);
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }

async function isAdmin(email: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!email) return false;
  const em = email.toLowerCase();
  try { const { data } = await admin.rpc('fn_role_of', { p_email: em }); if (['owner', 'admin'].includes(String(data || '').toLowerCase())) return true; } catch (_e) { /* ignore */ }
  try { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', 'admin_emails').maybeSingle(); const list = String((data as any)?.value || '').toLowerCase().split(/[,;\s]+/).filter(Boolean); if (list.includes(em)) return true; } catch (_e) { /* ignore */ }
  return false;
}

const WS: Record<string, string> = {
  'ws.exec': 'fn_ws_exec', 'ws.marketplace': 'fn_ws_marketplace', 'ws.customers': 'fn_ws_customers',
  'ws.operations': 'fn_ws_operations', 'ws.ai': 'fn_ws_ai', 'ws.knowledge': 'fn_ws_knowledge',
  'ws.documents': 'fn_ws_documents', 'ws.analytics': 'fn_ws_analytics', 'ws.company': 'fn_ws_company',
  'ws.finance': 'fn_ws_finance', 'ws.agents': 'fn_ws_agents', 'ws.marketing': 'fn_ws_marketing',
  'ws.ea': 'fn_ws_ea', 'ws.reports': 'fn_ws_reports', 'ws.strategy': 'fn_ws_strategy', 'ws.governance': 'fn_ws_governance',
  'ws.fraud': 'fn_ws_fraud', 'ws.refunds': 'fn_ws_refunds',
};
const OSAPI_MUTATIONS = new Set(['inbox_send','fraud_resolve','refund_resolve','prompt_approve','prompt_rollback','prompt_gate','comment_add','review_decide','blog_publish','knowledge_dispatch','knowledge_refresh','exam_run','exam_revert']);
// Every action below that only READS. Anything not on this list is refused when the caller arrived
// through the x-os-key preview bypass (see the OS BYPASS note in Deno.serve). Derived by walking the
// action handlers in this file one by one, not by name: each RPC listed here was checked in the
// database and performs no persistent write (fn_ws_agents fills a `create temp ... on commit drop`
// table and nothing else). Deliberately NOT here, even though they read something first:
//   report_pdf     - renders and stores a PDF object in the finance-reports bucket
//   extract_doc    - reads no record; hands caller-supplied bytes to extract_text under inbound_secret
//   secretary_chat - drives the secretary agent, which acts
// and the thirteen entries of OSAPI_MUTATIONS above. An unknown action is not on the list either, so
// the bypass cannot reach a handler added later without someone deciding it is a read.
const READONLY = new Set([
  'ping','dashboard','viz','suppliers_board','rfq_board','customers_board','agents_board','activity','nav',
  'inbox','search','record','files','file','prompt_view','marketing_studio','knowledge_gaps','exam_summary','knowledge_export',
  'ws.suppliers','ws.supplier','ws.customer','ws.agent','ws.rfq',
  'ws.exec','ws.marketplace','ws.customers','ws.operations','ws.ai','ws.knowledge','ws.documents','ws.analytics',
  'ws.company','ws.finance','ws.agents','ws.marketing','ws.ea','ws.reports','ws.strategy','ws.governance','ws.fraud','ws.refunds',
]);

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return J({ ok: true });
    const authHeader = req.headers.get('Authorization') || '';
    let email = '';
    // OS BYPASS FIX 28 Jul 2026. os_ops was hardened on 27 Jul; this twin was missed. A single static
    // app_secrets.os_bypass_key in an x-os-key header skipped the entire admin identity check on a
    // function that runs with verify_jwt:false, so anyone holding that string could send from the
    // inbox, resolve a fraud case or a refund, approve or roll back a prompt, publish a blog post,
    // dispatch knowledge, run or revert an exam, comment or decide a review - and the audit row named
    // 'os-preview@quotesdone.com', a fabricated person, so the log read as if a colleague had done it.
    // Nothing reads through this key and no app_secrets row for it exists today, which is the only
    // reason the hole was inert: creating that row alone would have opened it. It is now read-only
    // (see the READONLY gate below) and it is recorded under its own name, never as an email address.
    let viaBypass = false;
    const osKey = req.headers.get('x-os-key') || '';
    if (osKey && osKey === (await sec('os_bypass_key'))) { email = 'os_bypass_key (no human identity)'; viaBypass = true; }
    else {
      const token = authHeader.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '').trim();
      if (!token) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
      const { data: u, error: uerr } = await admin.auth.getUser(token);
      email = u?.user?.email || '';
      if (uerr || !email) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
      if (!(await isAdmin(email))) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    }

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const action = (body?.action as string) || 'ping';

    // ---- audit trail for os_api mutations (never block) ----
    // A non-read action arriving on the preview key is audited here too, even when it is not one of
    // OSAPI_MUTATIONS: an attempt to mutate with the static key is exactly the event worth having on
    // record, so it is logged first and refused second.
    if (OSAPI_MUTATIONS.has(action) || (viaBypass && !READONLY.has(action))) {
      try {
        const det: any = { ...body }; delete det.action;
        const ent = String(body?.subject_type || (body?.transaction_id ? 'transactions' : '') || (body?.key ? 'prompt' : ''));
        const eid = String(body?.subject_id ?? body?.transaction_id ?? body?.id ?? body?.key ?? '');
        await admin.from('os_audit_log').insert({ actor: email, action, entity: ent || null, entity_id: eid || null, detail: det });
      } catch (_e) { /* audit must never break the operation */ }
    }
    // Deliberately after the audit insert, for the reason given above.
    if (viaBypass && !READONLY.has(action)) return J({ error: 'forbidden', hint: 'the x-os-key preview key is read-only — sign in with an admin account to make changes' }, 403);

    if (action === 'ping') return J({ ok: true, user: email });
    if (action === 'dashboard') { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_os_command'); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true, user: email, data }); }
    if (action === 'viz') { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_os_dashboard_viz'); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true, user: email, data }); }
    if (action === 'suppliers_board') { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_suppliers_board', { p_search: String(body?.search || ''), p_sector: String(body?.sector || ''), p_limit: Number(body?.limit || 60), p_offset: Number(body?.offset || 0) }); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true, user: email, data }); }
    if (action === 'rfq_board') { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_rfq_board', { p_search: String(body?.search || ''), p_limit: Number(body?.limit || 80), p_offset: Number(body?.offset || 0) }); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true, data }); }

      const jd = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); return J({ ok: true, data: jd });

      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true, data });

      const fwd = authHeader || ('Bearer ' + (await sec('os_service_jwt')));
      const r = await fetch(`${BASE}/refunds_api`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': fwd }, body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'resolve', transaction_id: body?.transaction_id, decision: String(body?.op || ''), note: body?.note || '' }) });
      const jd = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); if (!r.ok) return J({ error: jd?.error || ('refunds_api ' + r.status) }, 502); return J({ ok: true, data: jd });
    }

    if (action === 'files') { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_entity_files', { p_entity: String(body?.entity || ''), p_id: String(body?.id || '') }); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true, data }); }
    if (action === 'file') { const bucket = String(body?.bucket || 'supplier-docs'); const path = String(body?.path || '').replace(/^\/+/, ''); if (!path) return J({ error: 'path_required' }, 400); const { data, error } = await admin.storage.from(bucket).createSignedUrl(path, 300); if (error || !data?.signedUrl) return J({ error: error?.message || 'could_not_sign' }, 500); return J({ ok: true, data: { url: data.signedUrl } }); }
    if (action === 'report_pdf') {
      const id = Number(body?.id); const src = String(body?.src || 'board'); let title = 'Report'; let text = '';
      if (src === 'exec') { const { data } = await admin.from('exec_reports').select('officer,period,summary,findings,recommendations').eq('id', id).maybeSingle(); if (!data) return J({ error: 'not_found' }, 404); title = `${(data as any).officer} — ${(data as any).period}`; text = String((data as any).summary || ''); if ((data as any).findings) text += '\n\nFINDINGS\n' + JSON.stringify((data as any).findings, null, 2); if ((data as any).recommendations) text += '\n\nRECOMMENDATIONS\n' + JSON.stringify((data as any).recommendations, null, 2); }
      else { const { data } = await admin.from('board_reports').select('title,body').eq('id', id).maybeSingle(); if (!data) return J({ error: 'not_found' }, 404); title = String((data as any).title || 'Report'); text = String((data as any).body || ''); }
      let hb = ''; for (const raw of text.split('\n')) { const t = raw.replace(/\s+$/, ''); if (!t) { hb += '<div style="height:6px"></div>'; continue; } if (/^[=\-_]{3,}$/.test(t)) continue; if (t === t.toUpperCase() && /[A-Z]/.test(t) && t.length < 64) hb += `<h3>${esc(t)}</h3>`; else hb += `<p>${esc(t)}</p>`; }
      const html = `<html><head><title>${esc(title)}</title></head><body><h1>${esc(title)}</h1>${hb}</body></html>`;
      const r = await fetch(`${BASE}/make_pdf`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: await sec('inbound_secret'), html, title, name: 'report-' + id, bucket: 'finance-reports', folder: 'reports' }) });
      const jd = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); if (!jd?.url) return J({ error: jd?.error || 'render_failed' }, 500); return J({ ok: true, data: { url: jd.url, path: jd.path } });
    }

    if (action === 'prompt_view') {
      const r = await fetch(`${BASE}/prompt_gate`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: await sec('inbound_secret'), action: 'view', key: String(body?.key || ''), version: body?.version }) });
      const jd = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); return J({ ok: true, data: jd });
    }
    if (action === 'prompt_gate') {
      const p = fetch(`${BASE}/prompt_gate`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: await sec('inbound_secret'), action: 'gate', key: String(body?.key || ''), version: body?.version }) });
      try { (globalThis as any).EdgeRuntime?.waitUntil?.(p); } catch (_e) { /* ignore */ }
      return J({ ok: true, data: { queued: true } });
    }
    if (action === 'prompt_approve') { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_prompt_approve_draft', { p_key: String(body?.key || ''), p_version: Number(body?.version), p_by: email }); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true, data }); }
    if (action === 'prompt_rollback') { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_prompt_rollback', { p_key: String(body?.key || ''), p_to_version: Number(body?.to_version), p_by: email }); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true, data }); }

    if (action === 'marketing_studio') { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_marketing_studio'); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true, user: email, data }); }
    if (action === 'review_decide') { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_review_decide', { p_kind: String(body?.kind || ''), p_ref_id: Number(body?.ref_id), p_decision: String(body?.decision || ''), p_comment: String(body?.comment || ''), p_by: email }); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true, data }); }
    if (action === 'blog_publish') { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_marketing_blog_publish', { p_id: String(body?.id || ''), p_published: Boolean(body?.published), p_by: email }); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true, data }); }

    if (action === 'knowledge_gaps') { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_knowledge_gaps'); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true, user: email, data }); }
    if (action === 'knowledge_dispatch') { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_dispatch_agent_knowledge_gaps'); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true, data }); }
    if (action === 'knowledge_refresh') { const r = await fetch(`${BASE}/gen_category_knowledge`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: await sec('inbound_secret'), slug: String(body?.slug || '') }) }); const jd = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); if (!r.ok && jd?.error) return J({ error: jd.error }, 502); return J({ ok: true, data: jd }); }
    if (action === 'exam_summary') { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_knowledge_exam_summary'); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true, user: email, data }); }
    if (action === 'exam_run') { const r = await fetch(`${BASE}/knowledge_exam`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: await sec('inbound_secret'), agent_key: body?.agent_key || undefined, generate: Number(body?.generate ?? 6), answer: Number(body?.answer ?? 8) }) }); const jd = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); if (!r.ok && jd?.error) return J({ error: jd.error }, 502); return J({ ok: true, data: jd }); }
    if (action === 'exam_revert') { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_exam_revert', { p_agent_key: body?.agent_key || null }); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true, data }); }
    if (action === 'knowledge_export') {
      const ak = String(body?.agent_key || '').trim();
      let sel = admin.from('agent_knowledge').select('agent_key,topic,content,priority,updated_at').order('agent_key').order('priority', { ascending: false });
      if (ak) sel = sel.in('agent_key', ak.startsWith('cat:') ? [ak] : [ak, 'cat:' + ak]);
      const { data, error } = await sel; if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      const rows = (data as any[]) || [];
      const groups: Record<string, any[]> = {}; for (const r of rows) { (groups[r.agent_key] = groups[r.agent_key] || []).push(r); }
      let md = '# QuotesDone — Agent Knowledge Export\n\n' + (ak ? 'Agent: `' + ak + '`\n' : 'All agents\n') + 'Generated: ' + new Date().toISOString() + '\nItems: ' + rows.length + '\n';
      for (const [key, items] of Object.entries(groups)) {
        md += '\n\n---\n\n## ' + key + '  (' + items.length + ' item' + (items.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ')\n';
        for (const it of items) { md += '\n**' + (it.topic || 'general') + '**' + (String(it.topic || '').startsWith('exam:') ? ' _(exam-verified)_' : '') + '  \n' + String(it.content || '').trim() + '\n'; }
      }
      const filename = 'knowledge-' + (ak ? ak.replace(/[^a-z0-9-]+/gi, '_') : 'all-agents') + '.md';
      return J({ ok: true, data: { filename, markdown: md, count: rows.length } });
    }

    if (WS[action]) { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc(WS[action]); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true, user: email, data }); }

    return J({ error: 'unknown_action', action }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/os_automation/index.ts

```typescript
// os_automation — Phase 2 Automation Control Panel backend.
// Admin-gated (Supabase JWT -> fn_role_of / admin_emails). Lets a non-developer see,
// pause/resume, re-time, and run-now the pg_cron jobs. Every mutation is audit-logged.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { ...CORS, 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } });

async function isAdmin(email: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!email) return false; const em = email.toLowerCase();
  try { const { data } = await admin.rpc('fn_role_of', { p_email: em }); if (['owner', 'admin'].includes(String(data || '').toLowerCase())) return true; } catch (_e) { /* */ }
  try { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', 'admin_emails').maybeSingle(); const list = String((data as any)?.value || '').toLowerCase().split(/[,;\s]+/).filter(Boolean); if (list.includes(em)) return true; } catch (_e) { /* */ }
  return false;
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return J({ ok: true });
    const token = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '').trim();
    if (!token) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
    const { data: u, error: uerr } = await admin.auth.getUser(token);
    const email = u?.user?.email || '';
    if (uerr || !email) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
    if (!(await isAdmin(email))) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);

    const b = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const action = String(b?.action || '');
    const jobid = Number(b?.jobid);

    if (action === 'list') {
      const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_os_automation_list');
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true, data: { jobs: data || [] } });
    }
    if (action === 'set_active') {
      if (!Number.isFinite(jobid)) return J({ error: 'jobid_required' }, 400);
      const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_os_automation_set_active', { p_jobid: jobid, p_active: !!b.active, p_actor: email });
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true, data });
    }
    if (action === 'reschedule') {
      if (!Number.isFinite(jobid)) return J({ error: 'jobid_required' }, 400);
      const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_os_automation_reschedule', { p_jobid: jobid, p_schedule: String(b.schedule || ''), p_actor: email });
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true, data });
    }
    if (action === 'run') {
      if (!Number.isFinite(jobid)) return J({ error: 'jobid_required' }, 400);
      const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_os_automation_run', { p_jobid: jobid, p_actor: email });
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true, data });
    }
    return J({ error: 'unknown_action', action }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return J({ ok: true });
    const token = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '').trim();
    if (!token) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
    const { data: u, error: uerr } = await admin.auth.getUser(token);
    const email = u?.user?.email || '';
    if (uerr || !email) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
    if (!(await isAdmin(email))) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);

    const b = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const action = String(b?.action || '');

    if (action === 'runbooks') {
      const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_os_runbooks');
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true, data: { runbooks: data || [] } });
    }
    if (action === 'list') {
      const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_os_incident_list', { p_status: String(b.status || '') });
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true, data: { incidents: data || [] } });
    }
    if (action === 'open') {
      const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_os_incident_open', { p_title: String(b.title || ''), p_kind: String(b.kind || 'other'), p_severity: String(b.severity || 'medium'), p_detail: { description: String(b.description || '') }, p_actor: email });
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true, data });
    }
    if (action === 'resolve') {
      const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_os_incident_resolve', { p_id: Number(b.id), p_resolution: String(b.resolution || ''), p_actor: email });
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true, data });
    }
    return J({ error: 'unknown_action', action }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
    if (action === 'detail') { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_os_detail', { p_entity: String(b.entity||''), p_id: String(b.id||'') }); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true, data }); }
    if (action === 'supplier_stats') { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_supplier_stats', { p_supplier_id: Number(b.id) }); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true, data }); }

    if (action === 'customer_decide') { const op = String(b.op||''); const patch = op==='ban'?{ banned:true, banned_reason:b.note||null }:{ banned:false }; const { error } = await admin.from('customers').update(patch).eq('id', String(b.id)); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true }); }

    if (action === 'task_done') { const st = String(b.op||'done')==='reopen'?'open':'done'; const { error } = await admin.from('crm_tasks').update({ status: st, done_at: st==='done'?now():null }).eq('id', Number(b.id)); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true }); }
    if (action === 'rfq_stage') { const { error } = await admin.from('inquiries').update({ pipeline_stage: String(b.stage||''), stage_changed_at: now() }).eq('id', String(b.inquiry||'')); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true }); }
    if (action === 'rfq_outcome') { const patch: any = { outcome: String(b.outcome||'') }; if (b.lost_reason) patch.lost_reason = b.lost_reason; if (['completed','won'].includes(String(b.outcome))) patch.completed_at = now(); const { error } = await admin.from('inquiries').update(patch).eq('id', String(b.inquiry||'')); if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500); return J({ ok: true }); }

      let dr = 0, cr = 0; const clean: any[] = [];
      for (const ln of lines) {
        const acct = String(ln?.account || ln?.account_code || '').trim();
        const debit = Number(ln?.debit || 0), credit = Number(ln?.credit || 0);
        if (!acct) return J({ error: 'missing_account' }, 400);
        if (!(debit >= 0) || !(credit >= 0)) return J({ error: 'bad_amount' }, 400);
        dr += debit; cr += credit; clean.push({ account_code: acct, debit, credit, memo: ln?.memo || null });
      }
      if (Math.round((dr - cr) * 100) !== 0) return J({ error: 'out_of_balance', debits: dr, credits: cr }, 400);
      if (Math.round(dr * 100) === 0) return J({ error: 'zero_amount' }, 400);
      const codes = [...new Set(clean.map((x) => x.account_code))];
      const { data: accts } = await admin.from('gl_accounts').select('code').in('code', codes);
      const known = new Set((accts || []).map((a: any) => a.code));
      const bad = codes.filter((x) => !known.has(x));
      if (bad.length) return J({ error: 'unknown_account:' + bad.join(',') }, 400);
      const { data: jr, error: je } = await admin.from('gl_journal').insert({ entry_date: (b?.date || now().slice(0, 10)), memo: String(b?.memo || 'OS entry'), source: 'os', currency: 'AED', created_by: email, status: 'draft' }).select('id').single();
      if (je || !jr) return J({ error: je?.message || 'journal_insert_failed' }, 500);
      const jid = (jr as any).id;
      const rows = clean.map((x, i) => ({ journal_id: jid, line_no: i + 1, account_code: x.account_code, debit: x.debit, credit: x.credit, memo: x.memo }));
      const { error: le } = await admin.from('gl_journal_lines').insert(rows);
      if (le) { try { await admin.from('gl_journal').delete().eq('id', jid); } catch (_e) {} return J({ error: le.message }, 500); }
      const { error: pe } = await admin.rpc('fn_gl_post', { p_journal: jid });
      if (pe) return J({ error: pe.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true, data: { journal: jid } });
    }

    return J({ error: 'unknown_action', action }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message||e) }, 500); }
});
```

````typescript
// os_pages — in-OS Content Studio backend: legal/marketing edit + translate, generate new SEO service pages (background), and publish. Admin-gated. Audit-logged.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const FN_BASE = (Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL') || '') + '/functions/v1';
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type, x-os-key', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
async function isAdmin(email: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!email) return false; const em = email.toLowerCase();
  try { const { data } = await admin.rpc('fn_role_of', { p_email: em }); if (['owner','admin'].includes(String(data||'').toLowerCase())) return true; } catch (_e) {}
  try { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key','admin_emails').maybeSingle(); const list = String((data as any)?.value||'').toLowerCase().split(/[,;\s]+/).filter(Boolean); if (list.includes(em)) return true; } catch (_e) {}
  return false;
}
const FILES: Record<string,string> = { legal: 'src/content/legal.json', marketing: 'src/content/marketing.json' };
const SERVICES = 'src/content/services.json';
async function readPath(path: string): Promise<any> {
  const { data } = await admin.from('qd_deploy_src').select('data').eq('path', path).maybeSingle();
  if (!data) return null; try { return JSON.parse(data.data as string); } catch { return null; }
}
async function readFile(src: string){ const path = FILES[src]; if (!path) return null; return await readPath(path); }
async function orLLM(models: string[], sys: string, user: string, max = 4500): Promise<string | null> {
  const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key'); if (!key) return null;
  try {
    const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + key, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ models, max_tokens: max, temperature: 0.3, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: sys }, { role: 'user', content: user }] }) });
    const j = await r.json(); if (!r.ok) return null;
    let c = j?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || ''; c = c.replace(/^```[a-z]*\n?/i, '').replace(/```\s*$/, '').trim(); return c || null;
  } catch { return null; }
}
async function translateHtml(html: string, model?: string): Promise<string> {
  const prot = html.replace(/\{\{LOC_THE\}\}/g, '<xloct></xloct>').replace(/\{\{LOC\}\}/g, '<xloc></xloc>');
  const r = await fetch(`${FN_BASE}/translate_html`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: await sec('inbound_secret'), html: prot, model: model || 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-5' }) });
  const jd = await r.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
  if (!(jd as any)?.ok) throw new Error((jd as any)?.error || 'translate_failed');
  return String((jd as any).ar || '').replace(/<xloct><\/xloct>/g, '{{LOC_THE}}').replace(/<xloc><\/xloc>/g, '{{LOC}}');
}
function slugify(name: string){ return name.toLowerCase().replace(/&/g, ' and ').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 50); }
async function buildService(name: string, slug: string){
  try {
    const j = await readPath(SERVICES); if (!j || j[slug]) return;
    const tpl = j[Object.keys(j)[0]]?.en?.html; if (!tpl) return;
    const sys = 'You build a QuotesDone SEO service landing page by cloning an existing one. QuotesDone is a UAE B2B anonymous quotation marketplace: a customer posts a job, vetted UAE suppliers quote blind, the customer pays a 3% reveal fee only on the quote they accept. HARD RULES: (1) Keep the EXACT same HTML structure as the template — every tag, class, id, and href, in the same order. (2) Keep every {{LOC_THE}} and {{LOC}} placeholder EXACTLY as-is and in the same relative places (substituted with the emirate/UAE name at build). (3) Only rewrite the human-readable text so the page is about the NEW service, with accurate, specific, non-hyped UAE-market wording (what the service typically covers, what a customer should specify to get a firm quote, common scope). (4) Do NOT invent prices or statistics. (5) Output ONLY the HTML fragment.';
    const enHtml = await orLLM(['anthropic/claude-sonnet-5', 'openai/gpt-4o'], sys, 'NEW SERVICE NAME: ' + name + '\n\nTEMPLATE PAGE TO CLONE:\n' + tpl, 4500);
    if (!enHtml || enHtml.indexOf('{{LOC_THE}}') < 0) return;
    const tplTags = (tpl.match(/</g) || []).length; const newTags = (enHtml.match(/</g) || []).length;
    if (newTags < tplTags * 0.6) return;
    const enTitle = name + ' in {{LOC_THE}} — Get Free Quotes | QuotesDone';
    let arHtml = enHtml, arTitle = enTitle;
    try { arHtml = await translateHtml(enHtml); arTitle = await translateHtml(enTitle); } catch (_e) { /* AR falls back to EN so the page is still valid */ }
    const j2 = await readPath(SERVICES); if (!j2 || j2[slug]) return;
    j2[slug] = { en: { title: enTitle, html: enHtml }, ar: { title: arTitle, html: arHtml } };
    await admin.from('qd_deploy_src').update({ data: JSON.stringify(j2) }).eq('path', SERVICES);
  } catch (_e) { /* background best-effort */ }
}
// Every action below that only READS. Anything not on this list is refused when the caller arrived
// through the x-os-key preview bypass (see the OS BYPASS note in Deno.serve). Derived by walking the
// action handlers in this file one by one, not by name: pages_list and page_get select legal.json and
// marketing.json out of qd_deploy_src, service_list selects services.json, and '' is the empty action,
// which reaches no handler at all. Deliberately NOT here:
//   page_save, translate, service_delete - update qd_deploy_src
//   service_generate                     - spends OpenRouter credit and writes the new page back
//   publish                              - calls deploy_next_preview with target:'production', i.e.
//                                          ships whatever is in qd_deploy_src to quotesdone.com
// An unknown action is not on the list either, so the bypass cannot reach a handler added later
// without someone deciding it is a read.
const READONLY = new Set(['','pages_list','page_get','service_list']);
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return J({ ok: true });
    let email = '';
    // OS BYPASS FIX 28 Jul 2026. os_ops was hardened on 27 Jul and os_api on 28 Jul; this third twin
    // carries the same branch and was missed by both passes. A single static app_secrets.os_bypass_key
    // in an x-os-key header skipped the entire admin identity check, so anyone holding that string could
    // rewrite the legal and marketing pages, spend OpenRouter credit generating or translating service
    // pages, delete a service page and - worst - call publish, which posts to deploy_next_preview with
    // target:'production' and so publishes whatever is in qd_deploy_src to quotesdone.com. The audit row
    // then named 'os-preview@quotesdone.com', a fabricated person, so the log read as if a colleague had
    // done it. Nothing reads through os_bypass_key and app_secrets has no os_bypass_key row, which is the
    // only reason the branch is currently unreachable. Do NOT create that row to make a preview work; it
    // is a static bearer secret on an admin surface. The branch is kept only so that a key created in
    // future cannot mutate anything: it is read-only (see the READONLY gate above) and it is recorded
    // under its own name, never as an email address. os_ops and os_api carry the same gate.
    let viaBypass = false;
    const osKey = req.headers.get('x-os-key') || '';
    if (osKey && osKey === (await sec('os_bypass_key'))) { email = 'os_bypass_key (no human identity)'; viaBypass = true; }
    else {
      const token = (req.headers.get('Authorization')||'').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i,'').trim();
      if (!token) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
      const { data: u, error: uerr } = await admin.auth.getUser(token);
      email = u?.user?.email || ''; if (uerr || !email) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
      if (!(await isAdmin(email))) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    }
    const b = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const action = String(b?.action || '');

    // A non-read action arriving on the preview key is audited here too, even when it is not one of the
    // five named mutations: an attempt to mutate with the static key is exactly the event worth having
    // on record, so it is logged first and refused second.
    if (['page_save','publish','translate','service_generate','service_delete'].includes(action) || (viaBypass && !READONLY.has(action))) {
      try { const det: any = { ...b }; delete det.action; if (det.html) det.html = '[' + String(det.html).length + ' chars]'; await admin.from('os_audit_log').insert({ actor: email, action, entity: b.source || (action.startsWith('service')?'services':'site'), entity_id: b.slug || b.name || null, detail: det }); } catch (_e) {}
    }
    // Deliberately after the audit insert, for the reason given above.
    if (viaBypass && !READONLY.has(action)) return J({ error: 'forbidden', hint: 'the x-os-key preview key is read-only — sign in with an admin account to make changes' }, 403);

    if (action === 'pages_list') {
      const out: any[] = [];
      for (const src of Object.keys(FILES)) {
        const j = await readFile(src) || {};
        for (const slug of Object.keys(j)) out.push({ source: src, slug, title: (j[slug]?.en?.title) || slug, has_ar: !!(j[slug]?.ar) });
      }
      out.sort((a,b)=> (a.source+a.slug).localeCompare(b.source+b.slug));
      return J({ ok: true, data: { columns: ['source','slug','title','has_ar'], rows: out, total: out.length } });
    }
    if (action === 'page_get') {
      const j = await readFile(String(b.source)); if (!j) return J({ error: 'bad_source' }, 400);
      const loc = b.locale === 'ar' ? 'ar' : 'en'; const rec = j[b.slug]?.[loc];
      if (!rec) return J({ error: 'not_found' }, 404);
      return J({ ok: true, data: { title: rec.title || '', html: rec.html || '' } });
    }
    if (action === 'page_save') {
      const path = FILES[String(b.source)]; if (!path) return J({ error: 'bad_source' }, 400);
      const j = await readFile(String(b.source)); if (!j) return J({ error: 'file_missing' }, 404);
      const loc = b.locale === 'ar' ? 'ar' : 'en';
      if (!j[b.slug]) return J({ error: 'unknown_slug' }, 400);
      if (!j[b.slug][loc]) j[b.slug][loc] = {};
      if (typeof b.title === 'string') j[b.slug][loc].title = b.title;
      if (typeof b.html === 'string') j[b.slug][loc].html = b.html;
      const { error } = await admin.from('qd_deploy_src').update({ data: JSON.stringify(j) }).eq('path', path);
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true, data: { saved: true } });
    }
    if (action === 'translate') {
      const path = FILES[String(b.source)]; if (!path) return J({ error: 'bad_source' }, 400);
      const j = await readFile(String(b.source)); if (!j) return J({ error: 'file_missing' }, 404);
      const en = j[b.slug]?.en; if (!en) return J({ error: 'no_en_source' }, 404);
      const model = String(b.source) === 'legal' ? 'openai/gpt-4o' : 'openai/gpt-4o-mini';
      let arHtml = '', arTitle = '';
      try { arHtml = await translateHtml(en.html || '', model); arTitle = (await translateHtml('<t>' + (en.title || '') + '</t>', model)).replace(/<\/?t>/g, '').trim(); } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 502); }
      if (!j[b.slug].ar) j[b.slug].ar = {};
      j[b.slug].ar.html = arHtml; j[b.slug].ar.title = arTitle || en.title;
      const { error } = await admin.from('qd_deploy_src').update({ data: JSON.stringify(j) }).eq('path', path);
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true, data: { translated: true } });
    }

    if (action === 'service_list') {
      const j = await readPath(SERVICES) || {};
      const rows = Object.keys(j).map((slug) => ({ slug, title: String(j[slug]?.en?.title || slug).replace(/ in \{\{LOC_THE\}\}.*/, '').replace(/ —.*/, ''), has_ar: !!(j[slug]?.ar) }));
      rows.sort((a,b)=>a.slug.localeCompare(b.slug));
      return J({ ok: true, data: { columns: ['slug','title','has_ar'], rows, total: rows.length } });
    }
    if (action === 'service_generate') {
      const name = String(b.name || '').trim(); if (!name) return J({ error: 'name_required' }, 400);
      const slug = slugify(name); if (!slug) return J({ error: 'bad_name' }, 400);
      const j = await readPath(SERVICES); if (!j) return J({ error: 'services_missing' }, 404);
      if (j[slug]) return J({ error: 'already_exists', slug }, 400);
      const ER = (globalThis as any).EdgeRuntime; const p = buildService(name, slug);
      if (ER && ER.waitUntil) ER.waitUntil(p); else await p;
      return J({ ok: true, data: { queued: true, slug, note: 'Generating EN + AR in the background (~1 min). It will appear in the service list, then Publish to go live across the UAE + 7 emirates.' } });
    }
    if (action === 'service_delete') {
      const slug = String(b.slug || ''); const j = await readPath(SERVICES); if (!j || !j[slug]) return J({ error: 'not_found' }, 404);
      delete j[slug];
      const { error } = await admin.from('qd_deploy_src').update({ data: JSON.stringify(j) }).eq('path', SERVICES);
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true });
    }

    if (action === 'publish') {
      const r = await fetch(`${FN_BASE}/deploy_next_preview`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __deploy_secret: (await sec('deploy_secret')) || (await sec('inbound_secret')), target: 'production' }) });
      const jd = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!(jd as any)?.ok) return J({ error: (jd as any)?.error || 'deploy_failed' }, 502);
      return J({ ok: true, data: { id: (jd as any).id, url: (jd as any).url } });
    }
    return J({ error: 'unknown_action', action }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
````

### supabase/functions/os_settings/index.ts

```typescript
// os_settings — Phase 1 Settings & Admin console backend.
// Admin-gated (Supabase JWT -> fn_role_of / admin_emails). Isolated from os_api/os_ops.
// Business-editable settings only; secret keys are structurally unreachable (the SQL
// helpers refuse any key not in os_settings_meta). Every change is audit-logged.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { ...CORS, 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } });

async function isAdmin(email: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!email) return false; const em = email.toLowerCase();
  try { const { data } = await admin.rpc('fn_role_of', { p_email: em }); if (['owner', 'admin'].includes(String(data || '').toLowerCase())) return true; } catch (_e) { /* */ }
  try { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', 'admin_emails').maybeSingle(); const list = String((data as any)?.value || '').toLowerCase().split(/[,;\s]+/).filter(Boolean); if (list.includes(em)) return true; } catch (_e) { /* */ }
  return false;
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return J({ ok: true });
    const token = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '').trim();
    if (!token) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
    const { data: u, error: uerr } = await admin.auth.getUser(token);
    const email = u?.user?.email || '';
    if (uerr || !email) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
    if (!(await isAdmin(email))) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);

    const b = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const action = String(b?.action || '');

    if (action === 'list') {
      const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_os_settings_list');
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true, data: { settings: data || [] } });
    }
    if (action === 'set') {
      const key = String(b.key || ''); if (!key) return J({ error: 'key_required' }, 400);
      const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_os_settings_set', { p_key: key, p_value: b.value == null ? '' : String(b.value), p_actor: email, p_confirm: !!b.confirm });
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true, data });
    }
    if (action === 'history') {
      const key = String(b.key || ''); if (!key) return J({ error: 'key_required' }, 400);
      const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_os_settings_history', { p_key: key });
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true, data: { history: data || [] } });
    }
    if (action === 'revert') {
      const key = String(b.key || ''); if (!key) return J({ error: 'key_required' }, 400);
      const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_os_settings_revert', { p_key: key, p_actor: email });
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true, data });
    }
    return J({ error: 'unknown_action', action }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
async function authed(req: Request, body: any){ if (body.__secret && body.__secret === (await sec('inbound_secret'))) return true; const jwt=(req.headers.get('Authorization')||'').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i,''); const { data:{ user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt); const allow=(await sec('admin_emails')||'').split(',').map((s)=>s.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean); return !!(user?.email && allow.includes(user.email.toLowerCase())); }
const NAVY=rgb(0.047,0.137,0.188), TEAL=rgb(0.078,0.722,0.651), GOLD=rgb(0.906,0.71,0.235), INK=rgb(0.08,0.094,0.11), MUT=rgb(0.4,0.44,0.52), LINE=rgb(0.9,0.91,0.93), WHITE=rgb(1,1,1), BANDTXT=rgb(0.82,0.87,0.9);
async function fetchBytes(path: string){ try { const r = await fetch(`${ASSET}/${path}`); if(!r.ok) return null; return new Uint8Array(await r.arrayBuffer()); } catch { return null; } }
function isArCode(c:number){ return (c>=0x600&&c<=0x6FF)||(c>=0x750&&c<=0x77F)||(c>=0x8A0&&c<=0x8FF)||(c>=0xFB50&&c<=0xFDFF)||(c>=0xFE70&&c<=0xFEFF); }
function hasAr(s:any){ const t=String(s==null?'':s); for(const ch of t){ if(isArCode(ch.codePointAt(0)||0)) return true; } return false; }
const bidi:any = bidiFactory();
const MIRROR:Record<string,string>={'(' :')',')':'(','[':']',']':'[','{':'}','}':'{','<':'>','>':'<'};
function bidiRuns(s:string){ const str=String(s==null?'':s); if(!str) return [] as {t:string;rtl:boolean}[]; let levels:any; try{ levels = bidi.getEmbeddingLevels(str,'rtl').levels; }catch(_e){ return [{t:str,rtl:true}]; } const segs:{t:string;lv:number}[]=[]; let st=0; for(let i=1;i<=str.length;i++){ if(i===str.length||levels[i]!==levels[st]){ segs.push({t:str.slice(st,i),lv:levels[st]}); st=i; } } if(!segs.length) return [{t:str,rtl:true}]; let maxL=0; for(const sg of segs) if(sg.lv>maxL)maxL=sg.lv; let order=segs.map((_,i)=>i); for(let L2=maxL;L2>=1;L2--){ let i=0; while(i<order.length){ if(segs[order[i]].lv>=L2){ let j=i; while(j<order.length && segs[order[j]].lv>=L2) j++; const sl=order.slice(i,j).reverse(); for(let k=i;k<j;k++) order[k]=sl[k-i]; i=j; } else i++; } } return order.map(i=>{ const rtl=segs[i].lv%2===1; let t=segs[i].t; if(rtl){ let o=''; for(const ch of t) o+=(MIRROR[ch]||ch); t=o; } return { t, rtl }; }); }
function decodeEnt(s:string){ return String(s||'').replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi,' ').replace(/&nbsp;/g,' ').replace(/&amp;/g,'&').replace(/&lt;/g,'<').replace(/&gt;/g,'>').replace(/&quot;/g,'"').replace(/&#39;|&rsquo;|&lsquo;/g,"'").replace(/&mdash;/g,'—').replace(/&ndash;/g,'–'); }

Deno.serve(async (req) => {

    if (needAr){ const rb=await fetchBytes('qd_ar_regular.ttf'); const bb=await fetchBytes('qd_ar_bold.ttf'); if(rb) arReg=await pdf.embedFont(rb,{subset:true}); if(bb) arBold=await pdf.embedFont(bb,{subset:true}); }
    const dateEn = body.date ? String(body.date) : new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'2-digit',month:'long',year:'numeric'});
    const dateAr = body.date_ar ? String(body.date_ar) : new Date().toLocaleDateString('ar-AE',{day:'2-digit',month:'long',year:'numeric'});
    function dateFor(){ return L==='ar'?dateAr:dateEn; }
    const logoImg = await (async()=>{ const b=await fetchBytes('qd_lockup_dark.png'); return b?await pdf.embedPng(b):null; })();
    const logoLightImg = await (async()=>{ const b=await fetchBytes('qd_lockup_light.png'); return b?await pdf.embedPng(b):null; })();
```
