```typescript
    const stamp = doStamp ? await (async()=>{ const b=await fetchBytes('qd_stamp.png'); return b?await pdf.embedPng(b):null; })() : null;

    let page = pdf.addPage([PW, PH]); let y = PH - M; let pageNo = 1;
    function fontFor(s:any, b:boolean){ return hasAr(s) ? (b?arBold:arReg) : (b?bold:font); }
    function W(text:string,f:any,s:number){ try{ return f.widthOfTextAtSize(text,s); }catch(_e){ return text.length*s*0.5; } }
    function measRTL(s:string,f:any,size:number){ let w=0; for(const r of bidiRuns(s)) w+=W(r.t,f,size); return w; }
    function drawRTL(s:string,size:number,f:any,color:any,yy:number,xRight:number){ const runs=bidiRuns(s); let tot=0; const ws=runs.map(r=>{const w=W(r.t,f,size);tot+=w;return w;}); let x=xRight-tot; for(let i=0;i<runs.length;i++){ if(runs[i].t.trim()!=='') page.drawText(runs[i].t,{x,y:yy,size,font:f,color}); x+=ws[i]; } }
    function putLine(text:string, size:number, b:boolean, color:any, align:'l'|'r', yy:number, x0=M, w=CW){ const f=fontFor(text,b); if(align==='r' && hasAr(text)){ drawRTL(text,size,f,color,yy,x0+w); return measRTL(text,f,size); } const ww=W(text,f,size); const x = align==='r' ? (x0+w-ww) : x0; page.drawText(text,{x,y:yy,size,font:f,color}); return ww; }
    const footerEn = letterhead ? `${CO.name} · ${CO.licence} · ${CO.city}` : 'QuotesDone · quotesdone.com';
    const footerEn2 = letterhead ? `${CO.email} · ${CO.phone} · ${CO.web}` : '';
    function drawFooter(){ page.drawLine({ start:{x:M,y:54}, end:{x:PW-M,y:54}, thickness:0.5, color:LINE }); page.drawLine({ start:{x:M,y:54}, end:{x:M+34,y:54}, thickness:1.6, color:GOLD }); page.drawText(footerEn, { x:M, y:42, size:7.5, font, color:MUT }); if(footerEn2) page.drawText(footerEn2, { x:M, y:32, size:7.5, font, color:MUT }); page.drawText('Page '+pageNo, { x:PW-M-40, y:42, size:7.5, font, color:MUT }); }
    function headerBand(slim:boolean){ const h = slim?BANDSLIM:BAND; page.drawRectangle({ x:0, y:PH-h, width:PW, height:h, color:NAVY }); page.drawRectangle({ x:0, y:PH-h, width:PW, height:2.6, color:GOLD }); page.drawRectangle({ x:0, y:PH-h+2.6, width:PW, height:1, color:TEAL }); const lg = logoLightImg || logoImg; if (lg){ const w = slim?92:128; const hh=lg.height*(w/lg.width); page.drawImage(lg, { x:M, y:PH-(h/2)-(hh/2)+(slim?0:2), width:w, height:hh }); } if (!slim && letterhead){ const lines=[CO.name, CO.licence, CO.email+' · '+CO.phone]; let ly=PH-26; lines.forEach((ln,i)=>{ const f=i===0?bold:font; const s=i===0?11:8.5; page.drawText(ln,{ x:PW-M-(f.widthOfTextAtSize(ln,s)), y:ly-s, size:s, font:f, color:i===0?WHITE:BANDTXT }); ly-=(i===0?15:11.5); }); } return PH-h; }
    function quoteHeader(){ const by=headerBand(false); y=by-22; if(L==='ar'){ putLine('عرض أسعار', 22, true, NAVY, 'r', y-16, M, CW); if(refText) putLine('الرقم المرجعي: '+refText, 10, false, MUT, 'r', y-32, M, CW); putLine('التاريخ: '+dateFor(), 10, false, MUT, 'r', y-46, M, CW); } else { page.drawText('QUOTATION',{x:M,y:y-16,size:22,font:bold,color:NAVY}); if(refText) page.drawText('Ref: '+refText,{x:M,y:y-32,size:10,font,color:MUT}); page.drawText('Date: '+dateFor(),{x:M,y:y-46,size:10,font,color:MUT}); } y=y-64; drawFooter(); }
    function docHeader(){ const by=headerBand(false); y=by-24; const tAr=hasAr(title); putLine(title, 20, true, NAVY, tAr?'r':'l', y-18); y-=24; const meta = (L==='ar'? CO_AR.city : CO.city)+' · '+dateFor(); putLine(meta, 10, false, MUT, hasAr(meta)?'r':'l', y-10); y-=22; drawFooter(); }
    function newSection(){ page = pdf.addPage([PW,PH]); pageNo++; y=PH-M; }
    function ensure(h:number){ if (y - h < 70){ page = pdf.addPage([PW,PH]); pageNo++; const by=headerBand(true); drawFooter(); y=by-18; } }
    function wrap(t:string, f:any, s:number, w:number){ const isAr=hasAr(t); const meas=(str:string)=> isAr?measRTL(str,f,s):W(str,f,s); const words=String(t==null?'':t).split(/\s+/); const lines:string[]=[]; let cur=''; for(const wd0 of words){ const test=cur?cur+' '+wd0:wd0; if(meas(test)>w && cur){ lines.push(cur); cur=wd0; } else cur=test; } if(cur)lines.push(cur); return lines.length?lines:['']; }
    function para(t:string, s=11, b=false, color=INK, lh=1.45, x0=M, w=CW){ const isAr=hasAr(t); const f=fontFor(t,b); for(const ln of wrap(t,f,s,w)){ ensure(s*lh); if(isAr) drawRTL(ln,s,f,color,y-s,x0+w); else page.drawText(ln,{x:x0,y:y-s,size:s,font:f,color}); y-=s*lh; } }
    function bullet(t:string, s=11){ const isAr=hasAr(t); if(isAr){ para(t+' •',s,false,INK,1.4,M,CW-4); } else { para('•  '+t,s,false,INK,1.4,M+10,CW-12); } }
    function headingBi(en:string, ar:string){ ensure(28); y-=8; if(L==='ar'){ putLine(ar||en,11,true,TEAL,'r',y-11); } else { page.drawText(String(en).toUpperCase(),{x:M,y:y-11,size:11,font:bold,color:TEAL}); } y-=13; page.drawLine({start:{x:M,y},end:{x:PW-M,y},thickness:0.6,color:LINE}); page.drawLine({start:{x:M,y},end:{x:M+34,y},thickness:1.6,color:GOLD}); y-=10; }
    function headingAuto(t:string){ const isAr=hasAr(t); ensure(28); y-=8; putLine(t,11,true,TEAL,isAr?'r':'l',y-11); y-=13; page.drawLine({start:{x:M,y},end:{x:PW-M,y},thickness:0.6,color:LINE}); page.drawLine({start:{x:M,y},end:{x:M+34,y},thickness:1.6,color:GOLD}); y-=10; }

    function space(h=8){ ensure(h); y-=h; }
    function blockTable(head:string[], rows:string[][], widths:number[], rtl=false){ let H=head.slice(), R=rows.map(r=>r.slice()), Wd=widths.slice(); if(rtl){ H.reverse(); R=R.map(r=>r.slice().reverse()); Wd=Wd.slice().reverse(); } const colW=Wd.map(w=>w*CW); ensure(22); page.drawRectangle({x:M,y:y-20,width:CW,height:20,color:NAVY}); let cx=M; H.forEach((h,i)=>{ const isAr=hasAr(h); const f=isAr?arBold:bold; if(isAr) drawRTL(String(h),9,f,WHITE,y-14,cx+colW[i]-8); else page.drawText(String(h),{x:cx+8,y:y-14,size:9,font:f,color:WHITE}); cx+=colW[i]; }); y-=20; page.drawLine({start:{x:M,y},end:{x:M+CW,y},thickness:1.4,color:GOLD}); R.forEach((r)=>{ const cl=r.map((c,i)=>{ const isAr=hasAr(c); const f=isAr?arReg:font; return { isAr, f, lines: wrap(String(c==null?'':c), f, 10, colW[i]-14) }; }); const rh=Math.max(1,...cl.map(c=>c.lines.length))*13+8; ensure(rh); cx=M; r.forEach((c,i)=>{ const cell=cl[i]; let ly=y-14; for(const ln of cell.lines){ if(cell.isAr) drawRTL(ln,10,cell.f,INK,ly,cx+colW[i]-8); else page.drawText(ln,{x:cx+8,y:ly,size:10,font:cell.f,color:INK}); ly-=13; } cx+=colW[i]; }); y-=rh; page.drawLine({start:{x:M,y},end:{x:PW-M,y},thickness:0.5,color:LINE}); }); y-=2; }
    function blockKV(pairs:[string,string][]){ const colW=CW/2; const rows=Math.ceil(pairs.length/2); for(let r=0;r<rows;r++){ let maxLines=1; for(let c=0;c<2;c++){ const idx=r*2+c; if(idx>=pairs.length)continue; const vv=String(pairs[idx][1]); const vfm=hasAr(vv)?arBold:bold; const n=wrap(vv,vfm,11,colW-12).length; if(n>maxLines) maxLines=n; } const rowH=29+maxLines*13; ensure(rowH); for(let c=0;c<2;c++){ const idx=r*2+c; if(idx>=pairs.length)continue; const x=M+c*colW; const [k,v]=pairs[idx]; const kAr=hasAr(k); putLine(String(k), 8, false, MUT, kAr?'r':'l', y-12, x+4, colW-8); const vAr=hasAr(v); const vf=vAr?arBold:bold; const vlines=wrap(String(v),vf,11,colW-12); let vy=y-26; for(const ln of vlines){ if(vAr) drawRTL(ln,11,vf,NAVY,vy,x+colW-8); else page.drawText(ln,{x:x+4,y:vy,size:11,font:vf,color:NAVY}); vy-=13; } } y-=rowH; } }
    function blockTotal(value:string){ ensure(64); const bw=270, bx=PW-M-bw; const qt = L==='ar'?'القيمة المعروضة':'Quoted total'; const lab = L==='ar'?'الإجمالي':'TOTAL'; page.drawRectangle({x:bx,y:y-58,width:bw,height:58,borderColor:TEAL,borderWidth:2}); page.drawRectangle({x:bx,y:y-4,width:bw,height:4,color:GOLD}); const qf=hasAr(qt)?arReg:font; if(hasAr(qt)) drawRTL(qt,11,qf,INK,y-22,bx+bw-14); else page.drawText(qt,{x:bx+14,y:y-22,size:11,font:qf,color:INK}); page.drawText(value,{x: hasAr(qt)?(bx+14):(bx+bw-14-font.widthOfTextAtSize(value,11)),y:y-22,size:11,font,color:INK}); page.drawRectangle({x:bx,y:y-58,width:bw,height:30,color:NAVY}); const lf=hasAr(lab)?arBold:bold; if(hasAr(lab)) drawRTL(lab,13,lf,WHITE,y-49,bx+bw-14); else page.drawText(lab,{x:bx+14,y:y-49,size:13,font:lf,color:WHITE}); page.drawText(value,{x: hasAr(lab)?(bx+14):(bx+bw-14-bold.widthOfTextAtSize(value,15)),y:y-50,size:15,font:bold,color:WHITE}); y-=66; }
    function blockBadge(en:string, ar:string, subEn:string, subAr:string){ ensure(46); const lab = L==='ar'? ('الجهة مقدّمة العرض'):'QUOTING PARTY'; putLine(lab,8,false,MUT,L==='ar'?'r':'l',y-10); const txt = L==='ar'? ar : en; const tAr=hasAr(txt); const f=tAr?arBold:bold; const bw=(tAr?measRTL(txt,f,12):W(txt,f,12))+24; const bx = L==='ar' ? (PW-M-bw) : M; page.drawRectangle({x:bx,y:y-34,width:bw,height:22,color:NAVY}); if(tAr) drawRTL(txt,12,f,WHITE,y-29,bx+bw-12); else page.drawText(txt,{x:bx+12,y:y-29,size:12,font:f,color:WHITE}); const sub = L==='ar'? subAr : subEn; if(sub){ putLine(sub,9,false,MUT, L==='ar'?'r':'l', y-28, L==='ar'?M:(bx+bw+14), L==='ar'?(PW-2*M-bw-14):(CW-bw-14)); } y-=46; }
    function renderBlocks(blocks:any[]){ for(const b of blocks){ const t=b.t||b.type; if(t==='h2'||t==='heading') headingAuto(b.text||''); else if(t==='h3') h3(b.text||''); else if(t==='p'||t==='para') para(b.text||'', b.size||11, !!b.bold); else if(t==='li') bullet(b.text||''); else if(t==='kv') blockKV(b.pairs||[]); else if(t==='table'){ const rtl = hasAr((b.head||[]).join(' ')+' '+(b.rows||[]).flat().join(' ')); blockTable(b.head||[], b.rows||[], b.widths||(b.head||[]).map(()=>1/Math.max(1,(b.head||[]).length)), rtl); } else if(t==='total') blockTotal(b.value||''); else if(t==='note') para(b.text||'',9,false,MUT); else if(t==='space') space(b.h||10); } }
    const disEn="This quotation is presented in QuotesDone's standardized format from the supplier's submitted quote. Figures and scope are as quoted by the supplier; verify final details before ordering. QuotesDone charges the customer a 3% facilitation fee on the quoted value at the point of contact reveal.";
    const disAr='هذا العرض مقدّم بصيغة QuotesDone الموحّدة استناداً إلى عرض المورّد. القيم والنطاق كما وردت من المورّد؛ يُرجى التحقق من التفاصيل النهائية قبل الطلب. تتقاضى QuotesDone رسوم تيسير بنسبة 3% من قيمة العرض عند كشف بيانات التواصل.';
    function renderQuote(q:any){ const rtlT = L==='ar';
      blockBadge('Supplier '+(q.supplier_label||'1'), 'المورّد رقم '+(q.supplier_label||'1'), 'Identity revealed only after the customer pays the reveal fee.', 'تُكشف هوية المورّد فقط بعد سداد العميل رسوم الكشف.');
      headingBi('Job','بيان العمل'); para((q.job_category? q.job_category+' — ':'')+(q.job_summary||'')+(q.emirate?(' · '+q.emirate):''));
      space(2); headingBi('Scope of supply','نطاق التوريد');
      const items=Array.isArray(q.items)?q.items:[];
      if(items.length){ const head = L==='ar'?['#','الوصف','الكمية','الوحدة'] : ['#','Description','Qty','Unit']; blockTable(head, items.map((it:any,i:number)=>[String(i+1),String(it.desc||''),String(it.qty||''),String(it.unit||'')]), [0.07,0.71,0.11,0.11], rtlT); }
      else if(q.scope) para(String(q.scope));
      if(items.length && q.scope){ space(3); para(String(q.scope),10,false,rgb(0.2,0.25,0.33)); }
      headingBi('Commercial terms','الشروط التجارية');
      const TL=(en:string,ar:string)=> L==='ar'?ar:en;
      blockKV([[TL('Lead time','مدة التنفيذ'),q.lead_time||'—'],[TL('Quote validity','صلاحية العرض'),q.validity||'—'],[TL('Warranty','الضمان'),q.warranty||'—'],[TL('Payment terms','شروط الدفع'),q.payment_terms||'—']]);
      if(q.conditions){ headingBi('Conditions','الشروط'); para(String(q.conditions)); }
      if(q.exclusions){ headingBi('Exclusions','الاستثناءات'); para(String(q.exclusions)); }
      if(q.notes){ headingBi('Notes','ملاحظات'); para(String(q.notes)); }
      space(6); blockTotal('AED '+Number(q.total||0).toLocaleString('en-AE',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2}));
      space(8); para(L==='ar'?disAr:disEn,9,false,MUT);
    }

    if (isQuote){
      if (lang==='bi'){ const qEn=body.quote; const qAr=body.quote_ar||body.quote; L='en'; quoteHeader(); renderQuote(qEn); newSection(); L='ar'; quoteHeader(); renderQuote(qAr); }
      else { L=lang; quoteHeader(); renderQuote(body.quote); }
    } else {
      L = lang==='bi'?'en':lang; docHeader();
      if (body.body_html) renderBlocks(parseHtml(String(body.body_html)));
      else if (Array.isArray(body.blocks)) renderBlocks(body.blocks);
      if (doSign || doStamp){ ensure(120); y-=20; const baseY=y-58; if (sig){ const w=150, h=sig.height*(w/sig.width); page.drawImage(sig,{x:M+90,y:baseY+4,width:w,height:h}); } const sLabel= lang==='ar'?'الموقّع المعتمد':'AUTHORISED SIGNATORY'; putLine(sLabel,8,false,MUT,'l',baseY+50); page.drawLine({start:{x:M,y:baseY},end:{x:M+230,y:baseY},thickness:0.8,color:rgb(0.2,0.25,0.33)}); const nm= lang==='ar'?CO_AR.signer:CO.signer; const tt= lang==='ar'?CO_AR.title:CO.title; putLine(nm,11,true,NAVY,'l',baseY-14); putLine(tt,9.5,false,MUT,'l',baseY-27); putLine(CO.name,9.5,false,MUT,'l',baseY-39); if (stamp){ const w=110, h=stamp.height*(w/stamp.width); page.drawImage(stamp,{x:PW-M-140,y:baseY-26,width:w,height:h,opacity:0.9,rotate:{type:'degrees',angle:-8} as any}); } y=baseY-50; }
    }

    const bytes = await pdf.save();
    if (body.raw){ return new Response(bytes, { status:200, headers:{ 'Content-Type':'application/pdf', ...CORS } }); }
    const bucket=String(body.bucket||'agent-docs');
    const safe=String(body.name||title||'document').replace(/[^\w.\-]+/g,'_').slice(0,60)||'document';
    const path=(body.folder?String(body.folder).replace(/[^\w\-\/]/g,'')+'/':(new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'/'))+Date.now()+'_'+safe+'.pdf';
    const up=await admin.storage.from(bucket).upload(path, bytes, { contentType:'application/pdf', upsert:true });
    if (up.error) return J({ error:'store_failed', detail: up.error.message }, 500);
    const { data: signed } = await admin.storage.from(bucket).createSignedUrl(path, 7*24*3600);
    return J({ ok:true, bucket, path, url: signed?.signedUrl||null, bytes: bytes.length });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message||e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/pdpl_erase/index.ts

```typescript
// pdpl_erase — completes a PDPL erasure request end-to-end: deletes the user's
// uploaded files from storage (KYC docs, drawings, quote files), then runs the
// DB PII redaction (fn_pdpl_redact). Internal/admin only: __secret gated, and the
// pdpl_requests row must already be status='approved'.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
async function rm(bucket: string, paths: string[]) { const clean = [...new Set(paths.filter((p) => p && typeof p === 'string'))]; if (!clean.length) return 0; try { const { error } = await admin.storage.from(bucket).remove(clean); return error ? 0 : clean.length; } catch { return 0; } }
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const reqId = String(body.request_id || '');
    if (!reqId) return J({ error: 'request_id required' }, 400);
    const { data: pr } = await admin.from('pdpl_requests').select('id,email,status').eq('id', reqId).maybeSingle();
    if (!pr) return J({ error: 'request not found' }, 404);
    if (String(pr.status) !== 'approved') return J({ error: 'request must be approved first (current: ' + pr.status + ')' }, 409);
    const email = String(pr.email || '').toLowerCase();
    if (!email) return J({ error: 'request has no email' }, 400);

    const supDocs: string[] = [], drawings: string[] = [], quoteFiles: string[] = [];
    // supplier (lead) KYC docs
    const { data: lead } = await admin.from('leads').select('id,license_doc_path,company_profile_doc_path,catalog_doc_paths,egr_doc_path,iban_doc_path').eq('email', email).maybeSingle();
    if (lead) {
      for (const p of [lead.license_doc_path, lead.company_profile_doc_path, lead.egr_doc_path, lead.iban_doc_path]) if (p) supDocs.push(String(p));
      if (Array.isArray(lead.catalog_doc_paths)) for (const p of lead.catalog_doc_paths) if (p) supDocs.push(String(p));
      // supplier's uploaded quotation files
      const { data: qs } = await admin.from('quotes').select('original_file_path').eq('supplier_id', lead.id);
      for (const q of qs || []) if (q.original_file_path) quoteFiles.push(String(q.original_file_path));
    }
    // customer drawings (originals + redacted copies)
    const { data: cust } = await admin.from('customers').select('id').eq('email', email).maybeSingle();
    if (cust) {
      const { data: inqs } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('drawing_file_path,drawing_redacted_paths').eq('customer_id', cust.id);
      for (const i of inqs || []) { if (i.drawing_file_path) drawings.push(String(i.drawing_file_path)); if (Array.isArray(i.drawing_redacted_paths)) for (const p of i.drawing_redacted_paths) if (p) drawings.push(String(p)); }
    }
    const removed = { 'supplier-docs': await rm('supplier-docs', supDocs), 'drawing-files': await rm('drawing-files', drawings), 'quote-files': await rm('quote-files', quoteFiles) };

    // DB PII redaction (also flips request to completed + logs security_event)
    const { data: red, error: rerr } = await admin.rpc('fn_pdpl_redact', { p_request_id: reqId });
    if (rerr) return J({ ok: false, error: rerr.message, files_removed: removed }, 500);
    return J({ ok: true, subject: email, files_removed: removed, db_redaction: red });
  } catch (e) { return J({ ok: false, error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
// pdpl_request - public endpoint for UAE PDPL data export/delete requests. CORS-enabled. Rate-limited per email/day.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':'*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers':'content-type', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods':'POST, OPTIONS', 'Content-Type':'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string|undefined) || undefined; }
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    const kind = String(body.kind||'').toLowerCase();
    const email = String(body.email||'').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!['export','delete'].includes(kind)) return J({ error:'kind must be export or delete' }, 400);
    if (!/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(email)) return J({ error:'valid email required' }, 400);
    // rate limit: max 3 open requests per email
    const { count } = await admin.from('pdpl_requests').select('id',{count:'exact',head:true}).eq('email',email).gt('created_at', new Date(Date.now()-86400000).toISOString());
    if ((count||0) >= 3) return J({ error:'too many requests today' }, 429);
    const role = ['customer','supplier'].includes(String(body.role)) ? String(body.role) : null;
    const details = String(body.details||'').slice(0,1000);
    const { data, error } = await admin.from('pdpl_requests').insert({ kind, email, role, details }).select('id').maybeSingle();
    if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
    // notify founder
    const inbound = await sec('inbound_secret');
    fetch(`${Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')}/functions/v1/alert_founder`, { method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: inbound, event:'PDPL '+kind+' request', detail: email, level:'action' }) }).catch(()=>{});
    return J({ ok:true, id: data?.id, message: kind==='delete' ? 'Your deletion request has been received. We will process it within 30 days.' : 'Your data export request has been received. We will email it within 30 days.' });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message||e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
// pending_digest - daily email to admins listing suppliers awaiting approval. Secret-guarded; queues a notification (drained by send_outbox).
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
function dt(s: unknown){ if(!s) return '-'; try { return new Date(String(s)).toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{ day:'2-digit', month:'short' }); } catch { return String(s); } }
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const { data: rows } = await admin.from('leads')
      .select('id,company_name,emirate,sector,trade_license_no,license_expiry,registration_submitted_at,ai_review_notes')
      .or('claimed.eq.true,source.eq.self_registered,source.eq.email_inbound')
      .in('approval_status', ['pending','submitted'])
      .order('registration_submitted_at', { ascending: true, nullsFirst: false })
      .limit(100);
    const pending = rows || [];
    if (!pending.length) return J({ ok: true, pending: 0, sent: false, note: 'nothing to review' });
    const adminEmails = String((await sec('admin_emails')) || 'management@quotesdone.com').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const items = pending.slice(0, 40).map((l:any,i:number)=> `${i+1}. ${l.company_name||'(no name)'}${l.emirate?(' — '+l.emirate):''}${l.sector?(' · '+l.sector):''}${l.trade_license_no?(' · licence '+l.trade_license_no):''}${l.registration_submitted_at?(' · submitted '+dt(l.registration_submitted_at)):''}${l.ai_review_notes?('\n     AI: '+String(l.ai_review_notes).slice(0,160)):''}`).join('\n');
    const extra = pending.length > 40 ? `\n\n…and ${pending.length-40} more.` : '';
    const subject = `${pending.length} supplier${pending.length===1?'':'s'} awaiting approval — QuotesDone`;
    const bodyText = `Good morning. You have ${pending.length} supplier${pending.length===1?'':'s'} pending review on QuotesDone:\n\n${items}${extra}\n\nReview, approve or reject them in the OS console:\nhttps://quotesdone.com/os\n\n(You can approve several at once with the bulk action bar.)`;
    const notifs = adminEmails.map((to)=>({ type: 'pending_digest', to_email: to, to_role: 'admin', subject, body: bodyText }));
    const { error } = await admin.from('notifications').insert(notifs);
    if (error) return J({ ok:false, error: error.message }, 500);
    return J({ ok: true, pending: pending.length, sent: notifs.length });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/postiz_publish/index.ts

```typescript
// postiz_publish v2 — the platform's own Postiz connector so agents publish to social autonomously.
// Keys stay server-side (app_secrets). Auth: __secret == inbound_secret.
// Actions:
//   test    -> GET /integrations (read-only; verifies key + lists channels)
//   upload  -> body {url}: fetch an image URL and upload it to Postiz's media store; returns {id, path}
//              (Postiz requires post images to be uploads.postiz.com objects, not arbitrary URLs).
//   post    -> body {channels:[names], text, title?, type?:'now'|'schedule'|'draft', when?:ISO,
//              image?:[{id,path}], image_url?:string}. If image_url is given (any public URL) it is
//              uploaded to Postiz first and attached automatically.
//   delete  -> body {id|ids[]}
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' } });
async function sec(k: string): Promise<string | undefined> { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;

const NEEDS_MEDIA = new Set(['instagram']);
async function base(): Promise<string> { return (await sec('postiz_api_url')) || 'https://api.postiz.com/public/v1'; }

// Upload an image (by URL) to Postiz; returns the Postiz media object {id, path, ...} or null.
async function uploadToPostiz(key: string, B: string, url: string): Promise<any> {
  try {
    const ir = await fetch(url); if (!ir.ok) return null;
    const blob = await ir.blob();
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append('file', blob, (url.split('/').pop() || 'image.png').split('?')[0]);
    const r = await fetch(B + '/upload', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': key }, body: fd });
    const txt = await r.text(); let j: any; try { j = JSON.parse(txt); } catch (_e) { j = { raw: txt }; }
    if (!r.ok) return { error: j?.message || j?.error || txt, status: r.status };
    const obj = Array.isArray(j) ? j[0] : (j?.output || j?.data || j);
    return obj;
  } catch (e) { return { error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }; }
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': '*' } });
  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
  const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
  if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
  const key = await sec('postiz_api_key');
  if (!key) return J({ error: 'postiz_not_configured' }, 200);
  const B = await base();
  const H = { 'Authorization': key, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
  const started = new Date().toISOString();

  try {
    const action = String(body.action || 'post');

    if (action === 'test') {
      const r = await fetch(B + '/integrations', { headers: { 'Authorization': key } });
      const txt = await r.text(); let j: any; try { j = JSON.parse(txt); } catch (_e) { j = txt; }
      const list = Array.isArray(j) ? j.map((x: any) => ({ id: x.id, name: x.name, identifier: x.identifier, disabled: x.disabled })) : j;
      return J({ ok: r.ok, status: r.status, integrations: list });
    }

    if (action === 'upload') {
      if (!body.url) return J({ error: 'url required' }, 400);
      const obj = await uploadToPostiz(key, B, String(body.url));
      if (!obj || obj.error) return J({ ok: false, error: obj?.error || 'upload_failed', raw: obj }, 200);
      return J({ ok: true, image: { id: obj.id, path: obj.path || obj.url }, raw: obj });
    }

    if (action === 'post') {
      const text = String(body.text || '').trim();
      if (!text) return J({ error: 'empty_content' }, 400);
      const type = ['now', 'schedule', 'draft'].includes(String(body.type)) ? String(body.type) : 'now';
      const date = body.when ? new Date(body.when).toISOString() : new Date(Date.now() + 60000).toISOString();
      // Resolve the image: an already-Postiz image passes through; a plain image_url is uploaded first.
      let image: any[] = Array.isArray(body.image) ? body.image : [];
      if ((!image.length) && body.image_url) {
        const obj = await uploadToPostiz(key, B, String(body.image_url));
        if (obj && !obj.error && obj.id) image = [{ id: obj.id, path: obj.path || obj.url }];
      }
      const wanted = (Array.isArray(body.channels) ? body.channels : []).map((c: any) => String(c).toLowerCase());
      const ir = await fetch(B + '/integrations', { headers: { 'Authorization': key } });
      const integ = await ir.json().catch(() => []);
      const live = Array.isArray(integ) ? integ.filter((x: any) => !x.disabled) : [];
      const findFor = (norm: string) => live.find((x: any) => { const id = String(x.identifier || ''); if (norm === 'x') return id === 'x' || id === 'twitter'; if (norm === 'linkedin') return id.startsWith('linkedin'); if (norm === 'instagram') return id.startsWith('instagram'); if (norm === 'facebook') return id === 'facebook'; return id === norm || id.startsWith(norm); });
      const posts: any[] = []; const skipped: string[] = [];
      for (const ch of wanted) {
        const norm = ch === 'twitter' ? 'x' : ch;
        const it = findFor(norm);
        if (!it) { skipped.push(ch + ' (not connected)'); continue; }
        const ident = String(it.identifier);
        const needsMedia = ident.startsWith('instagram') || NEEDS_MEDIA.has(norm);
        if (needsMedia && !image.length) { skipped.push(ident + ' (needs an image)'); continue; }
        const settings: any = { __type: ident };
        if (ident.startsWith('instagram')) settings.post_type = 'post';
        if (ident === 'x') settings.who_can_reply_post = 'everyone';
        posts.push({ integration: { id: it.id }, value: [{ content: text, image }], settings });
      }
      if (!posts.length) return J({ error: 'no_publishable_channels', skipped }, 200);
      const payload = { type, date, shortLink: false, tags: [], posts };
      const r = await fetch(B + '/posts', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
      const txt = await r.text(); let j: any; try { j = JSON.parse(txt); } catch (_e) { j = { raw: txt }; }
      await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'postiz_publish', started_at: started, finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: r.ok ? 'ok' : 'error', counts: { channels: posts.length, skipped: skipped.length, type, image: image.length }, note: r.ok ? null : String(txt).slice(0, 200) });
      if (!r.ok) return J({ ok: false, status: r.status, error: j?.message || j?.error || txt, skipped }, 200);
      const postId = j?.[0]?.postId || j?.postId || j?.id || (Array.isArray(j) ? j[0]?.id : null);
      return J({ ok: true, type, published_to: posts.length, post_id: postId, skipped, image: image.length, result: j });
    }

    if (action === 'delete') {
      const ids = Array.isArray(body.ids) ? body.ids : (body.id ? [body.id] : []);
      const out: any[] = [];
      for (const id of ids) { const r = await fetch(B + '/posts/' + id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: { 'Authorization': key } }); out.push({ id, status: r.status }); }
      return J({ ok: true, deleted: out });
    }

    return J({ error: 'unknown_action' }, 400);
  } catch (e) {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'postiz_publish', started_at: started, finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'error', note: String(e).slice(0, 200) });
    return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 200);
  }
});
```

### supabase/functions/profile_ai/index.ts

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
const FALLBACK_MODELS = ['anthropic/claude-sonnet-5','anthropic/claude-opus-4.8'];

const CATS = ['acrylic','aluminium','carpentry','fitout','flooring','glass','gypsum','landscaping','painting','safety','scaffolding','security','signage','steel','upholstery','wallpaper'];

const SYS = `You enrich a UAE construction / fit-out / facilities supplier's company profile using their own email reply and any attached images (brochures, company profile, trade licence). Extract ONLY facts that are actually present in the email or attachments. Never invent or assume.

Return STRICT JSON only (no markdown), exact shape:
{\"description\":string|null,
 \"services\":string|null,
 \"products\":string|null,
 \"certifications\":string|null,
 \"founded_year\":number|null,
 \"company_size\":string|null,
 \"company_type\":string|null,
 \"service_emirates\":[string],
 \"trade_license_no\":string|null,
 \"contact_name\":string|null,
 \"category\":string|null,
 \"capability_summary\":string|null}

Field rules:
- description: 1-3 sentence plain description of what the company does.
- services / products: short comma-separated lists in the supplier's own terms.
- certifications: ISO, Civil Defence / SIRA / municipality approvals, etc., else null.
- company_type: one of manufacturer, contractor, supplier, trader, or a short phrase if clearly stated; else null.
- service_emirates: canonical emirate names only (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Umm Al Quwain, Fujairah). If they say \"all UAE\", \"nationwide\", or \"across the Emirates\", include all seven. If only their base city is known, include just that emirate. Use [] when truly unknown.
- category: the single best-fit trade category for this supplier, chosen ONLY from this exact list: acrylic, aluminium, carpentry, fitout, flooring, glass, gypsum, landscaping, painting, safety, scaffolding, security, signage, steel, upholstery, wallpaper. Pick the one that most closely matches their core line of work. If the company clearly spans general interior fit-out / joinery / turnkey interiors, use \"fitout\". Only return null if there is genuinely not enough information to choose. Return the value in lowercase, exactly as written in the list.
- capability_summary: one concise paragraph (no line breaks) that a matching engine reads: mention sector, key products/services, and coverage. Always try to produce this from whatever is known.
- Use null (or [] for service_emirates) for anything not stated. Do NOT output placeholders like \"N/A\" or \"unknown\".`;

function parseJson(txt: string) {
  try { return JSON.parse(txt); } catch { /* */ }
  const m = txt.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
  if (m) { try { return JSON.parse(m[0]); } catch { /* */ } }
  throw new Error('AI returned non-JSON');
}

async function callClaude(key: string, parts: { text?: string; img?: { mime: string; data: string } }[]) {
  const content: unknown[] = [];
  for (const p of parts) {
    if (p.text) content.push({ type: 'text', text: p.text });
    if (p.img) content.push({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: `data:${p.img.mime};base64,${p.img.data}` } });
  }
  const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${key}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'HTTP-Referer': 'https://quotesdone.com', 'X-Title': 'QuotesDone' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ models: FALLBACK_MODELS, max_tokens: 1100, temperature: 0.15, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: SYS }, { role: 'user', content }] }),
  });
  const d = await r.json();
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(d?.error?.message || 'openrouter error');
  return parseJson(d?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '{}');
}

const EMIRATES = ['Dubai', 'Abu Dhabi', 'Sharjah', 'Ajman', 'Ras Al Khaimah', 'Umm Al Quwain', 'Fujairah'];
function normEmirates(arr: unknown): string[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return [];
  const out = new Set<string>();
  for (const v of arr) {
    const s = String(v || '').toLowerCase();
    for (const e of EMIRATES) if (s.includes(e.toLowerCase()) || (e === 'Ras Al Khaimah' && s.includes('rak')) || (e === 'Umm Al Quwain' && s.includes('uaq'))) out.add(e);
  }
  return [...out];
}
function normCategory(v: unknown): string | null {
  if (v == null) return null;
  const s = String(v).trim().toLowerCase();
  return CATS.includes(s) ? s : null;
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    let ok = false;
    const { data: sec1 } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', 'inbound_secret').maybeSingle();
    if (sec1?.value && body.__secret === sec1.value) ok = true;
    if (!ok) { const { data: t } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', 'test_token').maybeSingle(); if (t?.value && body.__test === t.value) ok = true; }
    if (!ok) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);

    const { data: keyRow } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', 'openrouter_api_key').maybeSingle();
    if (!keyRow?.value) return J({ error: 'smart engine not configured', fallback: true }, 200);

    const parts: { text?: string; img?: { mime: string; data: string } }[] = [];
    const ctx: string[] = [];
    if (body.company_name) ctx.push('Company name: ' + body.company_name);
    if (body.sector) ctx.push('Known trade/sector: ' + body.sector);
    if (body.emirate) ctx.push('Known base emirate: ' + body.emirate);
    if (ctx.length) parts.push({ text: 'CONTEXT:\n' + ctx.join('\n') });
    if (body.text) parts.push({ text: 'SUPPLIER EMAIL / MESSAGE:\n' + String(body.text).slice(0, 8000) });
    if (Array.isArray(body.images)) { for (const im of body.images.slice(0, 6)) { if (im?.data && im?.mime) parts.push({ img: { mime: im.mime, data: im.data } }); } }
    if (parts.length === 0) return J({ error: 'Nothing to extract' }, 400);

    let ai;
    try { ai = await callClaude(keyRow.value, parts); }
    catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e), fallback: true }, 200); }
    ai.service_emirates = normEmirates(ai.service_emirates);
    ai.category = normCategory(ai.category);
    return J({ ok: true, profile: ai });
  } catch (e) {
    return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e), fallback: true }, 200);
  }
});
```

### supabase/functions/project_api/index.ts

```typescript
// project_api — Procurement Projects for customers. Groups multiple RFQs (inquiries) under a project.
// Auth: customer Supabase JWT -> email -> customers row (same model as customer_api).
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type, apikey', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });

async function customer(req: Request): Promise<{ id: string; email: string } | null> {
  const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
  if (!jwt) return null;
  const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
  if (!user?.email) return null;
  const { data: c } = await admin.from('customers').select('id,email,banned').eq('email', user.email.toLowerCase()).maybeSingle();
  if (!c || c.banned) return null;
  return { id: c.id as string, email: c.email as string };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const cust = await customer(req);
    if (!cust) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
    const action = String(body.action || '');

    if (action === 'list') {
      const { data } = await admin.from('project_summary').select('*').eq('customer_id', cust.id).order('created_at', { ascending: false });
      return J({ ok: true, projects: data || [] });
    }

    if (action === 'dashboard') {
      const cid = cust.id;
      const [{ data: inq }, { data: tx }, { data: projs }] = await Promise.all([
        admin.from('inquiries').select('id,category,status,expected_value,hired_supplier_id,created_at').eq('customer_id', cid).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(300),
        admin.from('transactions').select('supplier_id,reveal_fee,quote_amount,revealed_at').eq('customer_id', cid),
        admin.from('project_summary').select('*').eq('customer_id', cid)
      ]);
      const inqs = inq || []; const txs = tx || [];
      const closed = ['completed', 'cancelled', 'closed', 'won', 'lost'];
      const active = inqs.filter((i: any) => !closed.includes(String(i.status || ''))).length;
      const suppliers = [...new Set(txs.map((t: any) => t.supplier_id).filter(Boolean))];
      const spend = txs.reduce((a: number, t: any) => a + (Number(t.reveal_fee) || 0), 0);
      const byStatus: Record<string, number> = {}; for (const i of inqs) { const k = i.status || 'unknown'; byStatus[k] = (byStatus[k] || 0) + 1; }
      let avgResp: number | null = null; let savingsPct: number | null = null;
      try {
        const ids = inqs.map((i: any) => i.id);
        if (ids.length) {
          const { data: q } = await admin.from('quotes').select('inquiry_id,quote_amount,created_at').in('inquiry_id', ids);
          const first: Record<string, number> = {}; const byRfq: Record<string, number[]> = {};
          for (const r of (q || [])) {
            const t = +new Date((r as any).created_at); const iid = (r as any).inquiry_id;
            if (!first[iid] || t < first[iid]) first[iid] = t;
            const a = Number((r as any).quote_amount); if (a > 0) (byRfq[iid] = byRfq[iid] || []).push(a);
          }
          const created: Record<string, number> = {}; for (const i of inqs) created[i.id] = +new Date(i.created_at);
          const diffs = Object.keys(first).map((id) => (first[id] - created[id]) / 3.6e6).filter((h) => h >= 0 && h < 24 * 90);
          if (diffs.length) avgResp = Math.round(diffs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / diffs.length * 10) / 10;
          const spreads = Object.values(byRfq).filter((arr) => arr.length >= 2).map((arr) => { const hi = Math.max(...arr), lo = Math.min(...arr); return hi > 0 ? 100 * (hi - lo) / hi : 0; });
          if (spreads.length) savingsPct = Math.round(spreads.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / spreads.length * 10) / 10;
        }
      } catch (_e) { /* metrics best-effort */ }
      const recent = inqs.slice(0, 12).map((i: any) => ({ id: i.id, category: i.category, status: i.status, expected_value: i.expected_value, created_at: i.created_at }));
      return J({ ok: true, dashboard: {
        rfqs_total: inqs.length, active_rfqs: active, rfqs_by_status: byStatus,
        reveals: txs.length, fees_paid_aed: Math.round(spend), suppliers_engaged: suppliers.length,
        awarded: inqs.filter((i: any) => i.hired_supplier_id).length,
        avg_first_response_hours: avgResp, avg_savings_pct: savingsPct,
        projects: projs || [], recent
      } });
    }

    if (action === 'create') {
      const name = String(body.name || '').trim().slice(0, 160);
      if (!name) return J({ error: 'name required' }, 400);
      const row: Record<string, unknown> = { customer_id: cust.id, name,
        description: String(body.description || '').slice(0, 4000) || null,
        target_open_date: /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(body.target_open_date || '')) ? body.target_open_date : null,
        budget_total: (body.budget_total !== undefined && body.budget_total !== '') ? Number(body.budget_total) : null };
      const { data, error } = await admin.from('projects').insert(row).select('*').maybeSingle();
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true, project: data });
    }

    if (action === 'update') {
      const id = String(body.id || ''); if (!id) return J({ error: 'id required' }, 400);
      const { data: p } = await admin.from('projects').select('id').eq('id', id).eq('customer_id', cust.id).maybeSingle();
      if (!p) return J({ error: 'not_found' }, 404);
      const patch: Record<string, unknown> = { updated_at: new Date().toISOString() };
      if (body.name !== undefined) patch.name = String(body.name).slice(0, 160);
      if (body.description !== undefined) patch.description = String(body.description).slice(0, 4000);
      if (body.status !== undefined && ['active','completed','archived'].includes(String(body.status))) patch.status = body.status;
      if (body.target_open_date !== undefined) patch.target_open_date = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(body.target_open_date)) ? body.target_open_date : null;
      if (body.budget_total !== undefined) patch.budget_total = body.budget_total === '' ? null : Number(body.budget_total);
      const { error } = await admin.from('projects').update(patch).eq('id', id);
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true });
    }

    if (action === 'detail') {
      const id = String(body.id || ''); if (!id) return J({ error: 'id required' }, 400);
      const { data: p } = await admin.from('projects').select('*').eq('id', id).eq('customer_id', cust.id).maybeSingle();
      if (!p) return J({ error: 'not_found' }, 404);
      const { data: rfqs } = await admin.from('inquiries')
        .select('id,category,emirate,summary,status,pipeline_stage,budget,expected_value,hired_supplier_id,created_at')
        .eq('project_id', id).eq('customer_id', cust.id).order('created_at', { ascending: false });
      return J({ ok: true, project: p, rfqs: rfqs || [] });
    }

    if (action === 'link' || action === 'unlink') {
      const inquiry_id = String(body.inquiry_id || ''); if (!inquiry_id) return J({ error: 'inquiry_id required' }, 400);
      const { data: inq } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('id,customer_id').eq('id', inquiry_id).maybeSingle();
      if (!inq || inq.customer_id !== cust.id) return J({ error: 'rfq_not_found' }, 404);
      let project_id: string | null = null;
      if (action === 'link') {
        project_id = String(body.project_id || ''); if (!project_id) return J({ error: 'project_id required' }, 400);
        const { data: p } = await admin.from('projects').select('id').eq('id', project_id).eq('customer_id', cust.id).maybeSingle();
        if (!p) return J({ error: 'project_not_found' }, 404);
      }
      const { error } = await admin.from('inquiries').update({ project_id }).eq('id', inquiry_id);
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true });
    }

    return J({ error: 'unknown action' }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
// project_consultant — AI Project Consultant (#7) + AI Scope Builder (#8).
// Customer Supabase JWT auth (email->customers). Actions: plan, scope, create.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type, apikey', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }

const llm = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 2200, temperature: 0.3 }); // shared OpenRouter client (Sonnet-first + 25s timeout)
function parseJson(s: string): any { if (!s) return null; const m = s.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (!m) return null; try { return JSON.parse(m[0]); } catch { return null; } }

async function customer(req: Request): Promise<{ id: string; email: string } | null> {
  const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
  if (!jwt) return null;
  const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
  if (!user?.email) return null;
  const { data: c } = await admin.from('customers').select('id,email,banned').eq('email', user.email.toLowerCase()).maybeSingle();
  if (!c || c.banned) return null;
  return { id: c.id as string, email: c.email as string };
}
async function categoryList(): Promise<string> {
  const { data } = await admin.from('category_specs').select('category,label');
  return (data || []).map((r: any) => r.category + (r.label ? ' (' + r.label + ')' : '')).join(', ');
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const cust = await customer(req);
    if (!cust) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
    const action = String(body.action || 'plan');

    if (action === 'plan') {
      const desc = String(body.description || '').trim();
      if (desc.length < 8) return J({ error: 'Please describe your project.' }, 400);
      const cats = await categoryList();
      const sys = 'You are a senior procurement consultant for QuotesDone, the UAE B2B services marketplace. A business customer describes a project in plain language. Act like a seasoned consultant, not a form. Decompose the project into the distinct services (RFQs) they will need, each mapped to ONE of the platform categories below when possible. For each RFQ write a clear, supplier-quotable scope. Identify missing information and ask concise follow-up questions. Estimate a realistic AED budget range and timeline for the whole project, flag any UAE permits/approvals likely required (e.g., Dubai Municipality, Civil Defence, DEWA, free-zone approvals), and suggest optional services often forgotten. Use realistic UAE market context. Do NOT invent supplier names or exact prices as facts — give ranges.\n\nPLATFORM CATEGORIES: ' + cats + '\n\nReturn ONLY valid minified JSON with this shape: {"project":{"name":string,"summary":string,"target_open_date":string|null,"budget_range_aed":{"low":number,"high":number},"timeline":string},"rfqs":[{"category":string,"title":string,"scope":string,"est_budget_aed":{"low":number,"high":number},"priority":"high"|"medium"|"low"}],"questions":[string],"permits":[string],"optional_services":[string]}. No prose outside the JSON.';
      const raw = await llm(sys, desc, 2600);
      if (!raw) return J({ error: 'ai_unavailable', message: 'The consultant is busy — please try again in a moment.' }, 200);
      const plan = parseJson(raw);
      if (!plan || !Array.isArray(plan.rfqs)) return J({ error: 'parse_failed', raw: raw.slice(0, 500) }, 200);
      return J({ ok: true, plan });
    }

    if (action === 'scope') {
      const category = String(body.category || '').trim();
      const brief = String(body.description || body.brief || '').trim();
      if (brief.length < 4) return J({ error: 'Describe what you need.' }, 400);
      const sys = 'You are a senior ' + (category || 'services') + ' scoping expert for a UAE B2B marketplace. Turn the buyer\'s short brief into a precise, itemized, supplier-quotable scope of work: quantities, specs, materials, applicable standards, and the full delivery checklist (supply, installation, testing, commissioning, training, warranty, handover documents) as applicable to this trade. Use UAE norms. Do NOT invent prices. Return ONLY JSON: {"title":string,"items":[{"item":string,"qty":string|null,"spec":string|null}],"inclusions":[string],"exclusions":[string],"assumptions":[string]}.';
      const raw = await llm(sys, (category ? ('Category: ' + category + '\n') : '') + brief, 1900);
      const out = parseJson(raw || '');
      if (!out) return J({ error: 'ai_unavailable_or_parse', raw: (raw || '').slice(0, 400) }, 200);
      return J({ ok: true, scope: out });
    }

    if (action === 'create') {
      const plan = body.plan || {};
      const pj = plan.project || {};
      const name = String(pj.name || body.name || 'New project').slice(0, 160);
      const rfqs = Array.isArray(plan.rfqs) ? plan.rfqs.slice(0, 25) : [];
      const budget = pj?.budget_range_aed?.high ? Number(pj.budget_range_aed.high) : null;
      const { data: proj, error: pe } = await admin.from('projects').insert({
        customer_id: cust.id, name, description: String(pj.summary || '').slice(0, 4000) || null,
        target_open_date: /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(pj.target_open_date || '')) ? pj.target_open_date : null,
        budget_total: budget, meta: { source: 'project_consultant', permits: plan.permits || [], optional_services: plan.optional_services || [] }
      }).select('*').maybeSingle();
      if (pe || !proj) return J({ error: pe?.message || 'create_failed' }, 500);
      let created = 0;
      for (const r of rfqs) {
        const cat = String(r.category || '').split(' ')[0];
        const scope = String(r.scope || r.title || '').slice(0, 6000);
        const { error } = await admin.from('inquiries').insert({
          customer_id: cust.id, project_id: proj.id, category: cat || null,
          summary: String(r.title || cat || 'Service').slice(0, 300), raw_input: scope,
          spec: { scope, est_budget_aed: r.est_budget_aed || null, priority: r.priority || 'medium', from_project: proj.id },
          status: 'draft', brief_source: 'project_consultant', scope_type: 'project_rfq'
        });
        if (!error) created++;
      }
      return J({ ok: true, project_id: proj.id, rfqs_created: created });
    }

    return J({ error: 'unknown action' }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/prompt_gate/index.ts

```typescript
// prompt_gate — benchmark-scores prompt versions and decides auto-promote vs escalate.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;

const _llm = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 1200, temperature: 0 });
const llm = async (sys: string, user: string, max?: number): Promise<string> => (await _llm(sys, user, max)) ?? ''; // shared client, Sonnet-first + 25s timeout

async function contentOf(key: string, version?: number | null): Promise<{ version: number | null; content: string }> {
  if (version == null) { const { data: p } = await admin.from('prompts').select('active_version').eq('key', key).maybeSingle(); version = (p as any)?.active_version ?? null; }
  if (version == null) return { version: null, content: '' };
  const { data } = await admin.from('prompt_versions').select('content').eq('prompt_key', key).eq('version', version).maybeSingle();
  return { version, content: (data as any)?.content || '' };
}

async function scoreVersion(key: string, version: number | null, content: string) {
  const { data: cases } = await admin.from('prompt_benchmarks').select('name,input,rubric,weight').eq('prompt_key', key).eq('active', true);
  const list = cases || [];
  const detail: any[] = []; let wsum = 0, acc = 0;
  for (const c of list) {
    const answer = await llm(content, String((c as any).input), 1200);
    const judged = await llm(
      'You are a strict evaluator for a UAE B2B quotation marketplace. Given an INPUT, a RUBRIC and an ANSWER, score 0-100 how well the ANSWER satisfies the RUBRIC. Punish fabrication of prices/brands/specs and reward flagging missing detail. Reply with ONLY compact JSON: {"score": <0-100 integer>, "note": "<=15 words"}.',
      'INPUT:\n' + String((c as any).input) + '\n\nRUBRIC:\n' + String((c as any).rubric) + '\n\nANSWER:\n' + (answer || '(empty)'), 200);
    let sc = 0, note = '';
    try { const m = judged.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); const j = m ? JSON.parse(m[0]) : {}; sc = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(j.score) || 0)); note = String(j.note || ''); } catch (_e) { /* 0 */ }
    const w = Number((c as any).weight) || 1; wsum += w; acc += sc * w;
    detail.push({ case: (c as any).name, score: sc, note });
  }
  const score = wsum ? Math.round((acc / wsum) * 10) / 10 : null;
  await admin.from('prompt_eval_runs').insert({ prompt_key: key, version, score, cases_total: list.length, detail });
  if (version != null && score != null) await admin.from('prompt_versions').update({ eval_score: score }).eq('prompt_key', key).eq('version', version);
  return { score, cases_total: list.length, detail };
}

async function annotate(key: string, candV: number, patch: any) {
  try { const { data: rows } = await admin.from('agent_actions').select('id,detail').eq('kind', 'prompt_approval').eq('detail->>key', key).eq('detail->>version', String(candV)); for (const row of (rows || [])) { const nd = { ...((row as any).detail || {}), eval: patch }; await admin.from('agent_actions').update({ detail: nd }).eq('id', (row as any).id); } } catch (_e) { /* ignore */ }
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const action = String(body.action || 'gate');
    const key = String(body.key || '');
    if (!key) return J({ error: 'key_required' }, 400);

    if (action === 'view') {
      const active = await contentOf(key, null);
      const cand = body.version != null ? await contentOf(key, Number(body.version)) : { version: null, content: '' };
      const { data: runs } = await admin.from('prompt_eval_runs').select('version,score,detail,created_at').eq('prompt_key', key).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(6);
      return J({ ok: true, active, candidate: cand, recent_runs: runs || [] });
    }

    if (action === 'eval') {
      const v = body.version != null ? Number(body.version) : null;
      const c = await contentOf(key, v);
      if (!c.content) return J({ error: 'no_content' }, 400);
      const r = await scoreVersion(key, c.version, c.content);
      return J({ ok: true, key, version: c.version, ...r });
    }

    const candV = Number(body.version);
    if (!candV) return J({ error: 'version_required' }, 400);
    const active = await contentOf(key, null);
    const cand = await contentOf(key, candV);
    if (!cand.content) return J({ error: 'candidate_not_found' }, 400);
    const evA = active.content ? await scoreVersion(key, active.version, active.content) : { score: null };
    const evC = await scoreVersion(key, candV, cand.content);
    const aS = Number((evA as any).score ?? 0), cS = Number(evC.score ?? 0); const delta = Math.round((cS - aS) * 10) / 10;
    const { data: dp } = await admin.from('decision_policy').select('value').eq('key', 'prompt_sensitive_pattern').maybeSingle();
    const pat = (dp as any)?.value || 'legal|finance|complian|security|quote_review';
    const sensitive = new RegExp(String(pat), 'i').test(key);
    const MARGIN = 5, FLOOR = 60;
    let decision = 'escalate';
    if (!sensitive && delta >= MARGIN && cS >= FLOOR) {
      decision = 'auto_promoted';
      await admin.rpc('fn_prompt_approve_draft', { p_key: key, p_version: candV, p_by: 'auto:eval +' + delta });
      await admin.from('agent_actions').update({ status: 'auto_done', decided_at: new Date().toISOString(), decided_by: 'auto-promoted (benchmark +' + delta + ')' }).eq('kind', 'prompt_approval').eq('detail->>key', key).eq('detail->>version', String(candV)).in('status', ['pending', 'needs_review']);
    }
    await annotate(key, candV, { active_score: aS, candidate_score: cS, delta, sensitive, floor: FLOOR, margin: MARGIN, decision });
    return J({ ok: true, key, candidate_version: candV, active_score: aS, candidate_score: cS, delta, sensitive, decision });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/prompt_improve/index.ts

````typescript
// prompt_improve - the AI Trainer's authoring step. Takes a prompt key + why it underperforms, asks the LLM to
// rewrite the system prompt to fix it, saves the result as a DRAFT version (never touches the live active_version),
// and queues a founder approval action. The founder approves (fn_prompt_approve_draft) to roll it out. Internal.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
const MODELS = ['anthropic/claude-opus-4.8','anthropic/claude-sonnet-5'];
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const key = String(body.key||'').trim();
    if (!key) return J({ error: 'no_key' });
    const reason = String(body.reason || 'This prompt underperforms on its quality benchmark.');

    const { data: cur } = await admin.rpc('fn_prompt_get', { p_key: key });
    const current = String(cur || '').trim();
    if (!current) return J({ error: 'prompt_not_found', key });

    // gather a little real evidence: recent founder-rejected AI actions + any trainer notes
    const { data: rej } = await admin.from('agent_actions').select('title,recommendation').eq('status','rejected').order('decided_at',{ascending:false}).limit(5);
    const evidence = (rej||[]).map((r:any)=>'- '+r.title).join('\n') || '(no specific rejected examples on file)';

    const sys = 'You are an expert prompt engineer improving a production system prompt for a UAE B2B trades/quotation marketplace. Rewrite the prompt to fix the stated weakness while preserving its purpose, scope, output format and any hard rules. Keep it concise and unambiguous. Do NOT invent new tools, capabilities, or data the agent does not have. Return ONLY the improved system prompt text — no preamble, no explanation, no markdown fences.';
    const usr = 'PROMPT KEY: '+key+'\n\nWHY IT UNDERPERFORMS:\n'+reason+'\n\nRECENT ISSUES (founder-rejected agent actions):\n'+evidence+'\n\nCURRENT PROMPT:\n"""\n'+current+'\n"""\n\nRewrite it to fix the weakness. Return only the improved prompt.';

    const apiKey = await sec('openrouter_api_key'); if (!apiKey) return J({ error: 'ai_unavailable' });
    let improved = ''; let usedModel = '';
    for (const model of MODELS) {
      try {
        const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', { method:'POST', headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer '+apiKey,'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({ model, max_tokens: 2000, temperature: 0.3, messages:[{role:'system',content:sys},{role:'user',content:usr}] }) });
        const jd = await r.json(); const c = jd?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '';
        if (c && c.trim().length > 100) { improved = c.trim().replace(/^```[a-z]*\n?/i,'').replace(/```$/,'').trim(); usedModel = model; break; }
      } catch (_e) { /* try next */ }
    }
    if (!improved) return J({ error: 'llm_failed' });
    if (improved === current) return J({ ok:true, note:'no_change_suggested' });

    const { data: v } = await admin.rpc('fn_prompt_draft', { p_key: key, p_content: improved, p_by: 'ai_trainer' });
    const ver = Number(v);
    // queue founder approval (do not auto-publish)
    await admin.from('agent_actions').insert({ agent:'ai_trainer', kind:'prompt_approval', status:'pending', risk:'high',
      title:'Approve improved prompt: '+key+' (v'+ver+')',
      recommendation:'The AI Trainer drafted an improved version of the '+key+' prompt to fix: '+reason+'. Review the draft; approve to roll it out (replaces the live version) or reject to discard. The live prompt is unchanged until you approve.',
      detail: { key, version: ver, model: usedModel, reason, chars: improved.length }, target_table:'prompt_versions', target_id: key+':'+ver });
    return J({ ok:true, key, draft_version: ver, model: usedModel, chars: improved.length });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
````

### supabase/functions/public_stats/index.ts

```typescript
import "jsr:@supabase/functions-js/edge-runtime.d.ts";
const SB_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SB_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
const CORS = { "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*", "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "*", "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=300" };
async function count(query: string): Promise<number> {
  const r = await fetch(`${SB_URL}/rest/v1/${query}`, { headers: { apikey: SB_KEY, Authorization: `Bearer ${SB_KEY}`, Prefer: "count=exact", Range: "0-0" } });
  const cr = r.headers.get("content-range") || "";
  const n = parseInt(cr.split("/")[1] || "0", 10);
  return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
}
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return new Response("ok", { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const indexed = await count("leads?select=id");
    const verified = await count("leads?select=id&registration_submitted_at=not.is.null&approval_status=eq.approved");
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ suppliers_indexed: indexed, verified_suppliers: verified, categories: 30, emirates: 7 }), { headers: CORS });
  } catch (e) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ suppliers_indexed: 0, verified_suppliers: 0, error: String(e) }), { headers: CORS });
  }
});
```

### supabase/functions/push_src_to_github/index.ts

```typescript
// push_src_to_github — publishes named files from qd_deploy_src to the GitHub branch Vercel builds.
//
// WHY THIS EXISTS. quotesdone.com is NOT deployed from qd_deploy_src alone. The Vercel project is
// git-linked to ahmadmhdnabilalzain-bot/quotesdone@main, so every push to main triggers a production
// deployment. github_sync runs nightly and commits org-as-code + schema to main, which means every
// night at 04:10 Vercel rebuilds the site FROM GITHUB and silently discards anything published through
// deploy_next_preview / the OS console. That is not theoretical: an XSS fix deployed to production on
// 27 Jul 2026 was reverted by the 28 Jul nightly sync, because GitHub's src/ was still the old code.
// This function closes the loop by pushing the table's contents back into git, so a publish survives.
//
// DELIBERATELY NOT A BULK SYNC. `paths` is required. The repo and the table have genuinely diverged in
// both directions (the repo carries blog/SEO work never published; the table carried a console far
// ahead of the repo), so a blanket push would destroy whichever side happened to be behind. Name the
// files you mean.
//
// AUTH: deploy authority (__deploy_secret), because anything this writes becomes the live site.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string|undefined)||undefined; }
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;

// base64 of the UTF-8 BYTES. btoa() alone throws on any character above U+00FF, which every Arabic
// string in messages/ar.json and the content JSONs would hit.
function b64(s: string): string {
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(s);
  let bin = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) bin += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
  return btoa(bin);
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const dep = await sec('deploy_secret');
    if (!secretOk(dep) || body.__deploy_secret !== dep) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);

    const paths: string[] = Array.isArray(body.paths) ? body.paths.filter((p: unknown) => typeof p === 'string' && p) : [];
    if (!paths.length) return J({ ok: false, error: 'paths_required', note: 'Name the files to publish. A blanket push would overwrite whichever of repo/table is behind on a given file, and they have diverged in both directions.' }, 200);

    const token = await sec('github_token'); if (!token) return J({ ok: false, error: 'github_token not configured' }, 200);
    const repo = (await sec('github_repo')) || 'ahmadmhdnabilalzain-bot/quotesdone';
    const branch = (await sec('github_branch')) || 'main';
    const api = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + repo;
    const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token, Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json', 'User-Agent': 'quotesdone-push', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };

    const { data: rows } = await admin.from('qd_deploy_src').select('path,data').in('path', paths);
    const found = new Map<string, string>((rows || []).map((r: any) => [r.path as string, r.data as string]));
    const missing = paths.filter((p) => !found.has(p));
    if (missing.length) return J({ ok: false, error: 'paths_not_in_qd_deploy_src', missing }, 200);

    // 1) current head
    const refR = await fetch(api + '/git/ref/heads/' + encodeURIComponent(branch), { headers: H });
    const refJ = await refR.json();
    if (!refR.ok) return J({ ok: false, error: 'ref_failed', detail: String(refJ?.message || '').slice(0, 200) }, 200);
    const headSha = refJ?.object?.sha as string;

    const comR = await fetch(api + '/git/commits/' + headSha, { headers: H });
    const comJ = await comR.json();
    if (!comR.ok) return J({ ok: false, error: 'commit_read_failed', detail: String(comJ?.message || '').slice(0, 200) }, 200);
    const baseTree = comJ?.tree?.sha as string;

    // 2) one blob per file
    const tree: any[] = [];
    for (const p of paths) {
      const br = await fetch(api + '/git/blobs', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ content: b64(found.get(p)!), encoding: 'base64' }) });
      const bj = await br.json();
      if (!br.ok) return J({ ok: false, error: 'blob_failed', path: p, detail: String(bj?.message || '').slice(0, 200) }, 200);
      tree.push({ path: p, mode: '100644', type: 'blob', sha: bj.sha });
    }

    // 3) tree on top of the current one, so nothing else in the repo is touched
    const trR = await fetch(api + '/git/trees', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ base_tree: baseTree, tree }) });
    const trJ = await trR.json();
    if (!trR.ok) return J({ ok: false, error: 'tree_failed', detail: String(trJ?.message || '').slice(0, 200) }, 200);

    // Identical tree means the files already match the branch - do not create an empty commit, because
    // every commit to main triggers a Vercel production rebuild.
    if (trJ.sha === baseTree) return J({ ok: true, unchanged: true, note: 'files already identical on ' + branch + '; no commit created and no deploy triggered', paths }, 200);

    const cmR = await fetch(api + '/git/commits', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({
      message: String(body.message || 'publish from qd_deploy_src').slice(0, 200), tree: trJ.sha, parents: [headSha] }) });
    const cmJ = await cmR.json();
    if (!cmR.ok) return J({ ok: false, error: 'commit_failed', detail: String(cmJ?.message || '').slice(0, 200) }, 200);

    const upR = await fetch(api + '/git/refs/heads/' + encodeURIComponent(branch), { method: 'PATCH', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ sha: cmJ.sha }) });
    const upJ = await upR.json();
    if (!upR.ok) return J({ ok: false, error: 'ref_update_failed', detail: String(upJ?.message || '').slice(0, 200) }, 200);

    const counts = { files: paths.length, commit: String(cmJ.sha || '').slice(0, 12), branch };
    try {
      await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'push_src_to_github', status: 'ok', counts,
        note: 'Published ' + paths.join(', ') + ' to ' + repo + '@' + branch + '. Vercel is git-linked to this branch, so this commit triggers a production deployment.',
        started_at: new Date(t0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
    } catch (_e) { /* never block the publish on a log write */ }

    return J({ ok: true, ...counts, paths, note: 'Vercel builds this branch, so a production deploy is now in progress.' }, 200);
  } catch (e) { return J({ ok: false, error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
async function sec(k:string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
// SECURITY FIX 27 Jul 2026 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
// WHAT WAS WRONG: this writer was gated on inbound_secret - the single shared secret that 134 of the
// 187 edge functions accept. It takes ANY path and ANY string and upserts it into qd_deploy_src, and
// deploy_next_preview publishes that whole table to Vercel. So inbound_secret was never "an API key
// with some reach": one leak of it meant arbitrary code on quotesdone.com. Blast radius = the site.
// WHY THIS FIX: deploy authority now needs its OWN key - app_secrets key 'deploy_secret', sent as
// body.__deploy_secret. Until that row exists we still honour inbound_secret so publishing does not
// break before the founder creates it, but every fallback authorisation is written to agent_runs with
// status 'error' so the gap is loud, not silent. Delete the fallback once deploy_secret is live.
async function deployAuth(b:any, fn:string){
  const dep = await sec('deploy_secret');
  if (dep) return b.__deploy_secret === dep;
  const inbound = await sec('inbound_secret');
  const ok = !!inbound && (b.__deploy_secret === inbound || b.__secret === inbound);
  if (ok) { const t = new Date().toISOString(); try { await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent:'deploy_authority', started_at:t, finished_at:t, status:'error', counts:{ fallback_auth:1, fn }, note:'DEPLOY SECRET NOT SET YET: '+fn+' authorised a deploy-capable call using inbound_secret because app_secrets has no deploy_secret row. inbound_secret is accepted by 134 of 187 functions, so until deploy_secret exists anything holding it can write source and publish it to quotesdone.com. Create app_secrets key deploy_secret and have callers send __deploy_secret.' }); } catch(_e){ /* never block the deploy path on a log write */ } }
  return ok;
}
Deno.serve(async (req)=>{
  try{
    const b = await req.json().catch(()=>({}));
    if(!(await deployAuth(b,'put_src'))) return new Response(JSON.stringify({error:'forbidden'}),{status:403,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});
    if(!b.path || typeof b.data!=='string') return new Response(JSON.stringify({error:'bad_request'}),{status:400,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});
    const { error } = await admin.from('qd_deploy_src').upsert({ path:b.path, data:b.data });
    if(error) return new Response(JSON.stringify({error:error.message}),{status:500,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok:true, bytes:b.data.length }),{headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});
  }catch(e){ return new Response(JSON.stringify({error:String((e as Error)?.message||e)}),{status:500,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}}); }
});
```
