### supabase/functions/qa_api/index.ts

```typescript
// qa_api - anonymized pre-reveal Q&A between customer and supplier. Contact details stripped both ways.
// Auth: JWT -> email. Customer asks (by quote), supplier answers (by question id). No identities exchanged.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
async function notify(rows: Record<string, unknown>[]) { try { if (rows.length) await admin.from('notifications').insert(rows); } catch (_e) {} }
function stripContact(t: string){
  let s = String(t || '');
  s = s.replace(/[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+\.[\w.-]+/g, '[contact hidden]');
  s = s.replace(/\b(?:https?:\/\/|www\.)\S+/gi, '[link hidden]');
  s = s.replace(/\+?\d[\d\s\-()]{6,}\d/g, '[number hidden]');
  s = s.replace(/\b(whats\s?app|whatsapp|telegram|instagram|\bIG\b|snapchat)\b/gi, '[contact hidden]');
  return s.trim();
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
    const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
    if (!user || !user.email) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
    const email = user.email.toLowerCase();
    const { data: supLead } = await admin.from('leads').select('id').eq('claimed_by', email).maybeSingle();
    const { data: cust } = await admin.from('customers').select('id').eq('email', email).maybeSingle();
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({})); const action = String(body.action || '');

    // CUSTOMER: ask about a quote (pre-reveal only)
    if (action === 'ask') {
      if (!cust) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
      const { data: q } = await admin.from('quotes').select('id,inquiry_id,supplier_id').eq('id', String(body.quote_id||'')).maybeSingle();
      if (!q) return J({ error: 'Quote not found' }, 404);
      const { data: inq } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('id,customer_id,summary').eq('id', q.inquiry_id).maybeSingle();
      if (!inq || inq.customer_id !== cust.id) return J({ error: 'Not your inquiry' }, 403);
      const { data: tx } = await admin.from('transactions').select('id').eq('inquiry_id', q.inquiry_id).eq('supplier_id', q.supplier_id).maybeSingle();
      if (tx) return J({ error: 'You have revealed this supplier — use Messages to talk directly.' }, 400);
      const { count } = await admin.from('questions').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('inquiry_id', q.inquiry_id).eq('supplier_id', q.supplier_id).eq('customer_id', cust.id);
      if ((count || 0) >= 3) return J({ error: 'You have reached the limit of pre-reveal questions for this supplier.' }, 429);
      const question = stripContact(String(body.question||'')).slice(0, 500);
      if (!question) return J({ error: 'Empty question' }, 400);
      const { data: ins } = await admin.from('questions').insert({ inquiry_id: q.inquiry_id, supplier_id: q.supplier_id, customer_id: cust.id, question }).select('id').maybeSingle();
      const { data: lead } = await admin.from('leads').select('claimed_by').eq('id', q.supplier_id).maybeSingle();
      if (lead?.claimed_by) await notify([{ type: 'new_question', to_email: lead.claimed_by, to_role: 'supplier', inquiry_id: q.inquiry_id, subject: 'A customer asked a question about your quote', body: 'A customer has a question about a job you quoted on QuotesDone (before revealing). Log in to your supplier portal to answer — a quick reply helps win the job.' }]);
      return J({ ok: true, id: ins?.id });
    }

    // CUSTOMER: list Q&A for a quote
    if (action === 'list') {
      if (!cust) return J({ ok: true, items: [] });
      const { data: q } = await admin.from('quotes').select('id,inquiry_id,supplier_id').eq('id', String(body.quote_id||'')).maybeSingle();
      if (!q) return J({ ok: true, items: [] });
      const { data: inq } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('customer_id').eq('id', q.inquiry_id).maybeSingle();
      if (!inq || inq.customer_id !== cust.id) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
      const { data: items } = await admin.from('questions').select('id,question,answer,asked_at,answered_at').eq('inquiry_id', q.inquiry_id).eq('supplier_id', q.supplier_id).eq('customer_id', cust.id).order('asked_at', { ascending: true });
      return J({ ok: true, items: items || [] });
    }

    // SUPPLIER: inbox of questions
    if (action === 'inbox') {
      if (!supLead) return J({ ok: true, items: [] });
      const { data: qsAll } = await admin.from('questions').select('id,inquiry_id,question,answer,asked_at,answered_at').eq('supplier_id', supLead.id).order('asked_at', { ascending: false }).limit(50);
      const items: any[] = [];
      for (const x of (qsAll || [])) { const { data: inq } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('summary,category,emirate').eq('id', x.inquiry_id).maybeSingle(); items.push({ ...x, inquiry_summary: inq?.summary || inq?.category || 'Inquiry', emirate: inq?.emirate || null }); }
      return J({ ok: true, items, pending: items.filter((i)=>!i.answer).length });
    }

    // SUPPLIER: answer a question
    if (action === 'answer') {
      if (!supLead) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
      const { data: qrow } = await admin.from('questions').select('id,supplier_id,inquiry_id,customer_id').eq('id', Number(body.id||0)).maybeSingle();
      if (!qrow || qrow.supplier_id !== supLead.id) return J({ error: 'not_found' }, 404);
      const answer = stripContact(String(body.answer||'')).slice(0, 800);
      if (!answer) return J({ error: 'Empty answer' }, 400);
      await admin.from('questions').update({ answer, answered_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', qrow.id);
      const { data: c } = await admin.from('customers').select('email').eq('id', qrow.customer_id).maybeSingle();
      if (c?.email) await notify([{ type: 'question_answered', to_email: c.email, to_role: 'customer', inquiry_id: qrow.inquiry_id, subject: 'A supplier answered your question', body: 'A supplier answered your question about a job on QuotesDone. Log in to read it and decide whether to reveal their contact.' }]);
      return J({ ok: true });
    }

    return J({ error: 'unknown action' }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string|undefined)||undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    // M13 (OS audit): qa_mint creates confirmed auth users with an arbitrary email — a standing account-creation
    // primitive. Keep it OFF in production unless the founder explicitly enables it for a test session.
    if ((await sec('qa_mint_enabled')) !== 'true') return J({ error: 'qa_mint disabled (set qa_mint_enabled=true to use)' }, 403);
    const email = String(body.email||'').toLowerCase(); const password = String(body.password||'');
    if (!email || password.length < 8) return J({ error: 'bad_input' }, 400);

  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/qa_suite/index.ts

```typescript
import "jsr:@supabase/functions-js/edge-runtime.d.ts";

const SB_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SB_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;

const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await fetch(`${SB_URL}/rest/v1/agent_runs`, { method: "POST", headers: { apikey: SB_KEY, Authorization: `Bearer ${SB_KEY}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ agent: "qa_suite", status, counts, note: String(note || "").slice(0, 500), started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() }) });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
}

function json(o: unknown, s = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
}
async function secret(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const r = await fetch(`${SB_URL}/rest/v1/app_secrets?key=eq.${key}&select=value`, { headers: { apikey: SB_KEY, Authorization: `Bearer ${SB_KEY}` } });
  return (await r.json())?.[0]?.value ?? null;
}

// SUPPRESSION BYPASS 28 Jul 2026 ----------------------------------------------------------------
// The QA failure alert below built its own Resend call and never consulted email_suppressions, the
// last sender in the codebase to do so (send_outbox queries it; login_otp, kyc and contact_submit
// all check before sending). The recipient is a fixed internal address, so the case for exempting it
// is that an operator should always be told - but that argument does not survive contact: this
// mailbox sits on the same sending domain as every customer and supplier email, one hard bounce
// recorded by resend_webhook is enough to put it on the list, and re-mailing it on every QA failure
// would burn the reputation of the shared domain while STILL not reaching anybody. contact_submit
// made exactly this call for its admin notify address on 27 Jul; qa_suite follows it. Not sending is
// not the same as staying quiet: the run is already persisted in qa_results and the skipped alert is
// written loudly to agent_runs, so the failing checks remain visible where operators look.
// Fails OPEN on a lookup error - an alert that might be deliverable is worth more than a silent run.
async function isSuppressed(email: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const r = await fetch(`${SB_URL}/rest/v1/email_suppressions?email=eq.${encodeURIComponent(email.toLowerCase())}&select=email&limit=1`, { headers: { apikey: SB_KEY, Authorization: `Bearer ${SB_KEY}` } });
    if (!r.ok) return false;
    const b = await r.json().catch(() => null);
    return Array.isArray(b) && b.length > 0;
  } catch (_e) { return false; }
}

async function anonProbe(anon: string, table: string): Promise<{ leaked: boolean; detail: string }> {
  try {
    const r = await fetch(`${SB_URL}/rest/v1/${table}?select=*&limit=1`, { headers: { apikey: anon, Authorization: `Bearer ${anon}` } });
    const body = await r.json().catch(() => null);
    if (r.status === 401 || (body && body.code === "42501")) return { leaked: false, detail: "permission denied (good)" };
    if (Array.isArray(body) && body.length === 0) return { leaked: false, detail: "RLS empty (good)" };
    if (Array.isArray(body) && body.length > 0) return { leaked: true, detail: `LEAK: ${body.length} row(s) readable by anon` };
    if (r.status === 404) return { leaked: true, detail: `INCONCLUSIVE: table not found (404) - the probe list names a table that does not exist, so it has never actually been checked` };
    return { leaked: true, detail: `INCONCLUSIVE: unexpected status ${r.status} - failing closed, because a probe that cannot verify safety must not report safety` };
  } catch (e) {
    return { leaked: true, detail: "INCONCLUSIVE: probe error, failing closed: " + String(e) };
  }
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const guard = await secret("postiz_publish_key");
    const providedKey = req.headers.get("x-internal-key");
    if (!guard) { await logRun("error", { stage: "config" }, "postiz_publish_key is missing from app_secrets, so qa_suite can never authenticate and the RLS/data-leak and data-integrity checks never run: a regression that exposes customer, supplier or secret data would go completely unnoticed"); }
    else if (providedKey && providedKey !== guard) { await logRun("error", { stage: "auth", rejected: 1 }, "Rejected a call presenting a wrong x-internal-key; the QA suite did not run, so RLS leaks and data-integrity regressions stay unverified for this cycle"); }
    if (!guard || providedKey !== guard) return json({ error: "unauthorized" }, 401);
    const anon = await secret("anon_key");
    if (!anon) { await logRun("error", { stage: "config" }, "anon_key is missing from app_secrets, so qa_suite cannot probe RLS at all: a table left publicly readable (customers, leads, app_secrets, quotes) would never be detected"); return json({ error: "anon_key not configured" }, 500); }

    const results: Array<{ check: string; ok: boolean; detail: string }> = [];

    // 1) RLS / anonymity regression: sensitive tables must NOT be readable by the public key
    const sensitive = ["customers", "app_secrets", "leads", "transactions", "quotes", "inquiries", "messages", "agent_knowledge", "email_suppressions", "social_posts", "qa_results", "customer_phone_otps", "inbound_messages"];
    for (const t of sensitive) {
      const p = await anonProbe(anon, t);
      results.push({ check: `anon_cannot_read:${t}`, ok: !p.leaked, detail: p.detail });
    }

    // 2) Positive control: public category data SHOULD be reachable (proves anon key is valid, not just failing)
    try {
      const r = await fetch(`${SB_URL}/rest/v1/category_specs?select=category&limit=1`, { headers: { apikey: anon, Authorization: `Bearer ${anon}` } });
      const b = await r.json().catch(() => null);
      results.push({ check: "public_category_specs_reachable", ok: Array.isArray(b), detail: Array.isArray(b) ? `ok (${b.length})` : "unexpected: " + JSON.stringify(b).slice(0, 120) });
    } catch (e) { results.push({ check: "public_category_specs_reachable", ok: false, detail: String(e) }); }

    // 3) Data-integrity / payment invariants via existing fn_smoke (best effort)
    let smokeNote = "";
    try {
      const r = await fetch(`${SB_URL}/rest/v1/rpc/fn_smoke`, { method: "POST", headers: { apikey: SB_KEY, Authorization: `Bearer ${SB_KEY}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: "{}" });
      if (r.ok) { const sm = await r.json(); results.push({ check: "smoke_invariants", ok: true, detail: JSON.stringify(sm).slice(0, 400) }); }
      else { smokeNote = "fn_smoke skipped (HTTP " + String(r.status) + "): payment and data-integrity invariants were NOT verified this run"; }
    } catch (_) { smokeNote = "fn_smoke threw (" + String(_) + "): payment and data-integrity invariants were NOT verified this run"; /* optional */ }

    const failed = results.filter((r) => !r.ok);
    const passed = failed.length === 0;

    const qaRes = await fetch(`${SB_URL}/rest/v1/qa_results`, { method: "POST", headers: { apikey: SB_KEY, Authorization: `Bearer ${SB_KEY}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ passed, total: results.length, failed: failed.length, results }) });

    let alertSent = false; let alertNote = "";
    if (!passed) {
      const rk = await secret("resend_api_key");
      const alertTo = "management@quotesdone.com";
      if (await isSuppressed(alertTo)) {
        alertNote = "no failure alert email was sent: the alert address (" + alertTo + ") is in email_suppressions, so mail to it bounces and would damage the sending domain shared with customer and supplier email. The failing checks are in qa_results and in this run's counts - read them there, then fix the mailbox and delete its email_suppressions row";
      } else if (rk) {
        const alertRes = await fetch("https://api.resend.com/emails", { method: "POST", headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${rk}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ from: (await secret("email_from_info")) || "QuotesDone <info@quotesdone.com>", to: [alertTo], subject: `QuotesDone QA FAILED (${failed.length} check(s))`, html: `<h3>QA suite found ${failed.length} failing check(s)</h3><pre>${JSON.stringify(failed, null, 2)}</pre>` }) }).catch(() => null);
        alertSent = !!(alertRes && (alertRes as Response).ok);
        if (!alertSent) alertNote = "the failure alert email could NOT be sent, so nobody was notified of these failing checks";
      } else { alertNote = "resend_api_key is missing, so no failure alert email was sent and nobody was notified of these failing checks"; }
    }

    const leaks = failed.filter((r) => r.check.startsWith("anon_cannot_read:")).map((r) => r.check.split(":")[1]);
    const inconclusive = results.filter((r) => r.detail.startsWith("probe error:") || r.detail.startsWith("status ")).map((r) => r.check);
    const notes: string[] = [];
    if (leaks.length) notes.push("PUBLIC DATA LEAK: table(s) " + leaks.join(",") + " are readable with the anon key, exposing customer and supplier records to anyone on the internet");
    if (failed.length) notes.push(failed.length + " of " + results.length + " checks failed: " + failed.map((r) => r.check).join(","));
    if (inconclusive.length) notes.push(inconclusive.length + " probe(s) were inconclusive and were counted as PASSING (" + inconclusive.join(",") + "); a real RLS leak on those tables would be scored as a pass and stay hidden");
    if (smokeNote) notes.push(smokeNote);
    if (!qaRes.ok) notes.push("qa_results insert failed (HTTP " + String(qaRes.status) + "): this QA run was not persisted, leaving a silent gap in the QA history");
    if (alertNote) notes.push(alertNote);
    if (!notes.length) notes.push("All " + results.length + " QA checks passed: no anon-readable sensitive tables and invariants verified");
    await logRun((!passed || !qaRes.ok || smokeNote || alertNote || inconclusive.length) ? "error" : "ok", { total: results.length, failed: failed.length, leaks, inconclusive: inconclusive.length, qa_results_stored: qaRes.ok, alert_sent: alertSent, smoke_skipped: smokeNote ? 1 : 0 }, notes.join(" | "));
    return json({ passed, total: results.length, failed: failed.length, failing: failed });
  } catch (e) {
    await logRun("error", { stage: "run" }, "qa_suite crashed: " + String(e) + "; no RLS/data-leak or data-integrity verification was performed this cycle, so a regression exposing customer or supplier data would go unnoticed");
    return json({ error: String(e) }, 500);
  }
});
```

````typescript
    try { const { data: er } = await admin.rpc('fn_category_expert_ref', { p_category: inq.category }); if (er) expertRef = String(er); } catch (_e) { /* optional */ }
    try { const { data: grp } = await admin.rpc('fn_quote_spec_group', { p_category: inq.category });
      if (grp) { const { data: specs } = await admin.from('category_quote_specs').select('label').eq('spec_group', grp).eq('mandatory', true); mustSpecs = (specs || []).map((s: any) => String(s.label)); } } catch (_e) { /* optional */ }
    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { job: { summary: inq.summary, category: inq.category, emirate: inq.emirate, budget: inq.budget, requested_details: inq.raw_input || '', requested_spec: inq.spec || {}, requested_items: boqItems }, quotes: labelled };
    if (cref) payload.compliance_reference = cref;
    if (expertRef) payload.expert_reference = expertRef;
    if (mustSpecs.length) payload.must_state_specs = mustSpecs;
    const sys = SYS + (lang === 'ar' ? AR : '');
    const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key'); if (!key) { await logRun('error', { compared: 0, quotes_seen: qs.length, ai_key_present: 0 }, 'quote_compare aborted: the openrouter_api_key secret is missing, so ' + qs.length + ' real supplier quotes could not be compared. The customer is shown \'ai_unavailable\' at the exact moment they are trying to choose a supplier, and the RFQ stalls at the decision step.'); return J({ ok: false, error: 'ai_unavailable' }, 200); }
    let parsed: any = null; let lastDetail = '';
    let attempts = 0;
    for (const model of FALLBACK_MODELS) {
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2 && !parsed; attempt++) {
        try {
          attempts++;
          const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + key, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ model, max_tokens: 4200, temperature: 0.2, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: [ { type: 'text', text: sys, cache_control: { type: 'ephemeral' } } ] }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify(payload) } ] }) });
          const jd = await r.json();
          if (!r.ok) { lastDetail = 'http' + (r.status) + ':' + model + ':' + (JSON.stringify(jd?.error||'').slice(0,140)); continue; }
          const content = jd?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || jd?.choices?.[0]?.message?.reasoning || '';
          if (!content) { lastDetail = 'empty:' + model; continue; }
          const p = parseJson(content);
          if (p) { parsed = p; break; }
          lastDetail = 'parse:' + model;
        } catch (e) { lastDetail = 'exc:' + model + ':' + String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0, 100); }
      }
      if (parsed) break;
    }
    if (!parsed) { await logRun('error', { compared: 0, quotes_seen: qs.length, ai_attempts: attempts, ai_ok: 0, lang }, 'quote_compare produced NO comparison for ' + qs.length + ' real supplier quotes because every model attempt failed or returned unparseable output (' + String(lastDetail).slice(0, 120) + '). The customer reached the decision step, was given nothing to compare, and this returns HTTP 200 so it is invisible to ordinary error monitoring.'); return J({ ok: false, error: 'parse_failed', detail: lastDetail }, 200); }
    if (Array.isArray(parsed.quotes) && parsed.quotes.length > 3) parsed.quotes = parsed.quotes.slice(0, 3);
    if (Array.isArray(parsed.top3) && parsed.top3.length > 3) parsed.top3 = parsed.top3.slice(0, 3);
    if (Array.isArray(parsed.line_findings) && parsed.line_findings.length > 14) parsed.line_findings = parsed.line_findings.slice(0, 14);
    if (typeof parsed.considered !== 'number') parsed.considered = qs.length;
    parsed.total_quotes = live.length;
    parsed.shortlisted = Math.min(3, qs.length);
    parsed.itemised_quotes = labelled.filter((q: any) => q.itemised).length;
    parsed.disclaimer = (lang === 'ar') ? DISCLAIMER_AR : DISCLAIMER_EN;
    let cacheSaved = 1;
    try { const { error: cacheErr } = await admin.from('qd_compare_cache').upsert({ inquiry_id, quotes_hash: qhash, lang, analysis: parsed, created_at: new Date().toISOString() }); if (cacheErr) cacheSaved = 0; } catch (_e) { cacheSaved = 0; }
    const _top3 = Array.isArray(parsed.top3) ? parsed.top3.length : 0;
    const _shown = Array.isArray(parsed.quotes) ? parsed.quotes.length : 0;
    const _lines = Array.isArray(parsed.line_findings) ? parsed.line_findings.length : 0;
    await logRun((_top3 > 0 && _shown > 0) ? 'ok' : 'error', { compared: 1, quotes_seen: qs.length, quotes_live: live.length, itemised: parsed.itemised_quotes, line_items_sent: itemsTotal, track_records: Object.keys(trackBySupplier).length, expert_ref: expertRef ? 1 : 0, must_specs: mustSpecs.length, line_findings: _lines, shortlisted: _shown, top3: _top3, ai_attempts: attempts, ai_ok: 1, cached: 0, cache_saved: cacheSaved, lang }, (_top3 > 0 && _shown > 0) ? ('Quote comparison delivered: ' + qs.length + ' quotes evaluated (' + parsed.itemised_quotes + ' itemised, ' + itemsTotal + ' line items, ' + Object.keys(trackBySupplier).length + ' track records, expert_ref=' + (expertRef ? 'yes' : 'no') + '), ' + _shown + ' shortlisted, ' + _top3 + ' ranked recommendation(s), ' + _lines + ' line-level finding(s).' + (cacheSaved ? '' : ' NOTE: the result could not be written to qd_compare_cache, so every re-open re-runs the model at full cost.')) : ('quote_compare returned a comparison object with an EMPTY shortlist/top3 for ' + qs.length + ' real quotes — the model responded but produced no ranked recommendation, so the customer sees a blank comparison and cannot choose a supplier, while the call reports HTTP 200 success.'));
    return J({ ok: true, analysis: parsed });
  } catch (e) { await logRun('error', { compared: 0, unhandled_exception: 1 }, 'quote_compare threw an unhandled exception and returned 500: ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0, 200) + ' — the customer could not compare the quotes they received and the RFQ stalls at the decision step.'); return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
````

```typescript
// quote_extract - reads a supplier's uploaded quotation (page images and/or PDF) and returns an
// ANONYMIZED standardized quote. Masks company identity AND brand/model/identity-revealing terms.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'quote_extract', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
}
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
const FALLBACK_MODELS = ['anthropic/claude-sonnet-5','anthropic/claude-opus-4.8'];
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
function parseJson(t:string){ try{return JSON.parse(t);}catch{ const m=t.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if(m){try{return JSON.parse(m[0]);}catch{}} return {}; } }
function scrub(s: unknown): string {
  let t = String(s == null ? '' : s);
  t = t.replace(/[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+\.[\w.-]+/g, '█');
  t = t.replace(/https?:\/\/\S+|www\.[\w.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}/gi, '█');
  t = t.replace(/(?:\+?\d[\d\s().-]{6,}\d)/g, (m) => (m.replace(/\D/g,'').length >= 7 ? '█' : m));
  return t.trim();
}
const SYS = `You read a supplier's price QUOTATION for a UAE building / fit-out job and convert it into an ANONYMOUS standardized quote for QuotesDone, a marketplace where the customer must PAY to reveal the supplier. The customer must NOT be able to identify the supplier from anything you output.\n\nRead EVERY page and EVERY line item carefully. Extract all commercial figures, then REWRITE every text field so it cannot reveal who the supplier is.\n\nMASK / REMOVE:\n- Company name, logo wording, letterhead, slogan, person names, signatures, stamps.\n- Phone, email, website, address, social handles, trade-license / TRN / VAT numbers, bank details.\n- Brand names, manufacturer names, product model names or numbers, and any proprietary or exclusive product line a customer could search online to identify a specific seller (e.g. a named ceramic line, a named tap/mixer brand, a named pump model). Replace with a neutral equivalent that preserves the spec and quality tier, e.g. 'premium branded 120x60 porcelain', 'premium branded mixer', 'premium variable-speed pump'.\n- Any unusually distinctive wording that could fingerprint the supplier.\n\nKEEP (these matter for comparing quotes): amounts, currency, quantities, dimensions/sizes, generic material & spec, quality tier (standard / premium), finish, lead time, validity, payment terms, warranty, scope, conditions, exclusions.\n\nReturn STRICT JSON only, no prose:\n{\"amount\":number,\"currency\":\"AED\",\"line_items\":[{\"description\":string,\"qty\":string,\"amount\":number}],\"lead_time\":string,\"validity\":string,\"payment_terms\":string,\"warranty\":string,\"scope\":string,\"conditions\":string,\"exclusions\":string,\"notes\":string,\"description_anonymized\":string,\"masked_terms\":[string],\"confidence\":\"low\"|\"medium\"|\"high\"}\namount = the GRAND TOTAL of the whole quotation (sum / stated total), not a single line. Every string field must ALREADY be anonymized. masked_terms = the original identity-revealing strings you removed (shown ONLY to the supplier for review, never to the customer). If a value is absent, use an empty string (or [] for line_items).`;

function dataUrl(b64: string, mime: string){ return `data:${mime};base64,${String(b64).replace(/^data:[^;]+;base64,/,'')}`; }

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) { await logRun('error', { forbidden: 1, quote_extracted: 0 }, 'quote_extract rejected a caller with a missing/wrong inbound secret (403). A supplier quotation was not parsed — that supplier\'s price will be missing from the comparison the customer sees, which looks like the supplier simply never quoted.'); return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403); }
    const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key');
    if (!key) { await logRun('error', { quote_extracted: 0, ai_key_present: 0 }, 'quote_extract aborted: the openrouter_api_key secret is missing, so no supplier quotation can be read at all. Every quote uploaded while this persists is silently dropped and the customer sees fewer (or zero) quotes to compare.'); return J({ error: 'no ai key' }, 500); }
    const inq = body.inquiry || {};

    const content: any[] = [{ type: 'text', text: `Job context (for understanding only): category ${inq.category||'-'}${inq.summary?(', summary: '+inq.summary):''}. Read the attached supplier quotation (all pages) and return the anonymized standardized JSON.` }];

    const imgs: any[] = Array.isArray(body.images) ? body.images : [];
    if (imgs.length) {
      for (const im of imgs.slice(0, 8)) { const b = im?.b64 || im; const m = im?.mime || 'image/jpeg'; if (b) content.push({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: dataUrl(String(b), String(m)) } }); }
    } else if (body.file_b64) {
      const mime = String(body.mime || 'application/octet-stream');
      if (/^image\//.test(mime)) content.push({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: dataUrl(String(body.file_b64), mime) } });
      else content.push({ type: 'file', file: { filename: String(body.filename||'quotation.pdf'), file_data: dataUrl(String(body.file_b64), mime||'application/pdf') } });
    } else { await logRun('error', { quote_extracted: 0, file_present: 0 }, 'quote_extract was called with no image pages and no file payload (400). A supplier attempted to submit a quotation and nothing was extracted — their price will be absent from the customer\'s comparison as if they never responded.'); return J({ error: 'no file' }, 400); }

    let ai: any = {};
    let aiParseOk = false;
    const aiPages = imgs.length ? Math.min(imgs.length, 8) : (body.file_b64 ? 1 : 0);
    try {
      const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${key}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ models: FALLBACK_MODELS, max_tokens: 2000, temperature: 0.1, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: SYS }, { role: 'user', content }] }) });
      const jd = await r.json();
      if (!r.ok) { await logRun('error', { quote_extracted: 0, pages: aiPages, ai_ok: 0 }, 'quote_extract could not read a supplier quotation because the vision model call returned an error (' + String(jd?.error?.message || ('http ' + r.status)).slice(0, 140) + '). The supplier\'s quotation exists but produced no structured quote, so the customer\'s comparison is missing a real price.'); return J({ error: 'ai_error', detail: jd?.error?.message || JSON.stringify(jd).slice(0,300) }, 502); }
      const _rawContent = jd?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '{}';
      ai = parseJson(_rawContent);
      aiParseOk = !!(ai && typeof ai === 'object' && Object.keys(ai).length > 0);
    } catch (e) { await logRun('error', { quote_extracted: 0, pages: aiPages, ai_ok: 0 }, 'quote_extract threw while calling the vision model (' + String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0, 140) + '), so a supplier quotation was never converted into a comparable quote — the customer will see one fewer price and assume that supplier did not respond.'); return J({ error: 'ai_exception', detail: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 502); }

    const textFields = ['lead_time','validity','payment_terms','warranty','scope','conditions','exclusions','notes','description_anonymized'];
    for (const f of textFields) ai[f] = scrub(ai[f]);
    if (Array.isArray(ai.line_items)) ai.line_items = ai.line_items.map((li: any) => ({ description: scrub(li?.description), qty: String(li?.qty||''), amount: Number(li?.amount)||null }));
    else ai.line_items = [];
    ai.amount = Number(ai.amount) || null;
    ai.currency = 'AED';
    if (!Array.isArray(ai.masked_terms)) ai.masked_terms = [];
    const _amountOk = ai.amount != null;
    const _okRun = aiParseOk && _amountOk;
    let _note = '';
    if (!aiParseOk) _note = 'quote_extract returned an EMPTY quote because the model output could not be parsed as JSON, not because the quotation was blank — the supplier\'s real price is silently lost and the customer will compare quotes with this supplier missing or showing no amount.';
    else if (!_amountOk) _note = 'quote_extract parsed the model output but no grand-total amount could be read from the supplier quotation (' + ai.line_items.length + ' line items, confidence ' + String(ai.confidence || 'unknown') + '). A quote with no price cannot be ranked or compared, so this supplier effectively drops out of the customer\'s comparison.';
    else _note = 'Supplier quotation extracted and anonymized: total AED ' + String(ai.amount) + ', ' + ai.line_items.length + ' line item(s), ' + ai.masked_terms.length + ' identity-revealing term(s) masked, confidence ' + String(ai.confidence || 'unknown') + '.' + (ai.masked_terms.length === 0 ? ' NOTE: zero terms were masked — verify the anonymisation actually ran, since leaking supplier identity would let the customer bypass the paywall.' : '');
    await logRun(_okRun ? 'ok' : 'error', { quote_extracted: _okRun ? 1 : 0, parse_ok: aiParseOk ? 1 : 0, amount_present: _amountOk ? 1 : 0, line_items: ai.line_items.length, masked_terms: ai.masked_terms.length, pages: aiPages, confidence: ai.confidence || null }, _note);
    return J({ ok: true, proposal: ai });
  } catch (e) { await logRun('error', { quote_extracted: 0, unhandled_exception: 1 }, 'quote_extract threw an unhandled exception and returned 500: ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0, 200) + ' — a supplier quotation was not converted into a comparable quote and will be missing from the customer\'s comparison.'); return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
// quote_pdf - renders a branded QuotesDone-format quotation (HTML, print-to-PDF) for one quote.
// Admin-only: Authorization Bearer (email must be in admin_emails) OR { __secret }. Returns text/html.
// The supplier is shown anonymized as 'Supplier N' (our standard quotation format); a small admin band
// shows the real supplier identity for internal monitoring only.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const URL_ = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
const ASSET = URL_ + '/storage/v1/object/public/brand';
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type' };
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
function esc(s: unknown){ return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;'); }
function money(n: unknown){ const v=Number(n); return isFinite(v)&&v>0 ? 'AED '+v.toLocaleString('en-AE',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2}) : '—'; }
function fmtDate(d: unknown){ try { return new Date(String(d)).toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',year:'numeric'}); } catch { return ''; } }

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    // auth: admin JWT or shared secret
    let authed = false;
    if (body.__secret && body.__secret === (await sec('inbound_secret'))) authed = true;
    if (!authed) {
      const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization')||'').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i,'');
      const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
      const allow = (await sec('admin_emails')||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);
      if (user?.email && allow.includes(user.email.toLowerCase())) authed = true;
    }
    if (!authed) return new Response('Forbidden', { status: 403, headers: CORS });

    const quote_id = String(body.quote_id||'');
    const { data: q } = await admin.from('quotes').select('*').eq('id', quote_id).maybeSingle();
    if (!q) return new Response('Quote not found', { status: 404, headers: CORS });
    const { data: inq } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('id,summary,category,emirate,budget,raw_input,spec,scope_type,created_at,boq').eq('id', q.inquiry_id).maybeSingle();
    const { data: sup } = await admin.from('leads').select('id,company_name,emirate,phone,email').eq('id', q.supplier_id).maybeSingle();
    // Facilitation (reveal) fee % sourced live from pricing_config — single source of truth (OPEN_ISSUES #4).
    const { data: pc } = await admin.from('pricing_config').select('standard_reveal_rate').eq('id', 1).maybeSingle();
    const feePct = Math.round((Number((pc as any)?.standard_reveal_rate ?? 0.03)) * 100);
    // Supplier N = position of this quote among the inquiry's quotes (by created_at asc)
    const { data: sibs } = await admin.from('quotes').select('id,created_at').eq('inquiry_id', q.inquiry_id).order('created_at',{ascending:true});
    const idx = (sibs||[]).findIndex(s=>s.id===q.id); const supN = idx>=0 ? idx+1 : 1;
    const ref = 'QD-' + String(q.inquiry_id||'').slice(0,8).toUpperCase() + '-S' + supN;

    // Line items: prefer structured boq/line_items on the quote, else the inquiry BOQ, else the scope text.
    let items: { desc: string; qty: string; unit: string }[] = [];
    const qbo = (q as any).boq || (q as any).line_items;
    if (Array.isArray(qbo)) items = qbo.map((b:any)=>({ desc:String(b.description||b.desc||''), qty: b.qty==null?'':String(b.qty), unit:String(b.unit||'') })).filter(x=>x.desc);
    if (!items.length && inq?.boq && Array.isArray((inq.boq as any).boq)) items = (inq.boq as any).boq.map((b:any)=>({ desc:String(b.description||''), qty:b.qty==null?'':String(b.qty), unit:String(b.unit||'') })).filter((x:any)=>x.desc).slice(0,40);
    const itemRows = items.length ? items.map((it,i)=>`<tr><td class=c>${i+1}</td><td>${esc(it.desc)}</td><td class=c>${esc(it.qty)}</td><td class=c>${esc(it.unit)}</td></tr>`).join('') : `<tr><td class=c>1</td><td>${esc(q.scope||inq?.summary||'As per scope below')}</td><td class=c></td><td class=c></td></tr>`;

    const cond = String(q.conditions||''); const excl = String(q.exclusions||''); const notes = String(q.notes||''); const scope = String(q.scope||'');
    const html = `<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>${esc(ref)} — QuotesDone Quotation</title>
<style>
:root{--teal:#14B8A6;--gold:#E3C065;--navy:#0C2330;--ink:#0A0A0A;--mut:#667085;--line:#E5E7EB}

QuotesDone charges the customer a ${feePct}% facilitation fee on the quoted value at the point of contact reveal.</div>

</body></html>`;
    return new Response(html, { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', ...CORS } });
  } catch (e) { return new Response('Error: '+String((e as Error)?.message||e), { status: 500, headers: CORS }); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/quote_quality/index.ts

```typescript
// quote_quality — returns the completeness gate result for the customer's own quotes (badge in /app).
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type, apikey', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
    const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
    if (!user?.email) return J({ error: 'Not signed in' }, 401);
    const { data: cust } = await admin.from('customers').select('id').eq('email', user.email.toLowerCase()).maybeSingle();
    if (!cust) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const ids = Array.isArray(body.quote_ids) ? body.quote_ids.map((x: any) => String(x)).slice(0, 60) : [];
    if (!ids.length) return J({ ok: true, quality: {} });
    const { data: qs } = await admin.from('quotes').select('id,quality,inquiry_id').in('id', ids);
    const inqIds = [...new Set((qs || []).map((q: any) => q.inquiry_id))];
    const { data: inqs } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('id').eq('customer_id', cust.id).in('id', inqIds);
    const owned = new Set((inqs || []).map((i: any) => i.id));
    const out: Record<string, any> = {};
    for (const q of (qs || [])) {
      if (!owned.has(q.inquiry_id)) continue;
      const ql = q.quality || {};
      const miss = Array.isArray(ql.missing) ? ql.missing.filter((m: any) => m && m.mandatory).length : null;
      out[String(q.id)] = { score: ql.score ?? null, pass: ql.pass ?? null, missing_mandatory: miss };
    }
    return J({ ok: true, quality: out });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/quote_review/index.ts

```typescript
// quote_review - supplier-side quote-detailing agent. Audits an uploaded quotation's extracted line
// items, drives an agent<->supplier Q&A to capture brand/model/spec/qty/price/warranty, handles
// OUTSOURCED lines (attached sub-quote + markup %), and returns confirmed committed items + the next
// question + whether the quote is complete. Never blindly accepts a vague line. Auth: inbound_secret.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
const MODELS = ['anthropic/claude-opus-4.8', 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-5'];
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
function parseJson(t: string) { try { return JSON.parse(t); } catch { /* */ } const m = t.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (m) { try { return JSON.parse(m[0]); } catch { /* */ } } return null; }
function num(v: unknown): number | null { const n = Number(v); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null; }
function round2(n: number) { return Math.round(n * 100) / 100; }

const SYS = `You are QuotesDone's senior quotation auditor for the UAE building / fit-out / MEP market. A verified supplier has uploaded a price quotation in response to a customer job. Your job is to turn it into a DETAILED, COMPARABLE, BINDING line-item spec sheet by talking to the supplier - NOT by blindly accepting what they wrote.

Why this matters: competing suppliers' quotes are compared side by side, and the winning supplier must deliver EXACTLY what they quoted. So every priced line must name the actual brand, model, and specification - never a vague lump like "CCTV system - AED 10,000". A supplier cannot hide a cheap 2MP camera behind a round number.

For EACH line item decide if it is COMPLETE enough to be binding and comparable. A line is complete only when it has, as applicable to that trade:
- a clear description of what it is,
- the BRAND and MODEL / part reference (or an explicit generic spec if the item is genuinely unbranded, e.g. "gypsum board 12.5mm"),
- the technical SPEC that drives price and quality (e.g. camera resolution + storage/retention; tile material + size; paint type + coats; AC tonnage; cable category),
- quantity,
- unit price and/or line total (must reconcile with the line amount),
- warranty where a customer would expect one (electronics, equipment, workmanship).

OUTSOURCED lines: some trades sub-contract part of the scope (e.g. a fit-out company outsources acoustic panels or CCTV to a specialist) and add a markup. If a line looks outsourced, or the supplier says it is, mark source="outsourced" and require: (1) the attached sub-supplier quotation, and (2) the markup percent the supplier wants to add. Then compute line_amount = round(sub_cost * (1 + markup_pct/100)). Confirm the maths back to the supplier.

ANONYMITY: the customer sees these lines BEFORE paying to reveal the supplier, so nothing may identify WHO the supplier is. Commodity brands that many UAE suppliers resell (common camera, ceramic, paint, AC, cable brands) are fine to show - they do not reveal the seller. But if a brand/line is EXCLUSIVE to one distributor (sole-agent, a supplier's own private label, or wording that fingerprints the company), set hide_brand=true and write customer_description with the spec/quality tier only (e.g. "premium branded 4MP dome cameras"). Never put the supplier's company name, phone, email, website, or licence number into any field.

TONE: talk to the supplier like a sharp, respectful estimator colleague. Ask only what is genuinely missing, batched into ONE concise message (a short intro + a bullet per open line). Never re-ask something already answered in the conversation. If everything is complete, say so briefly and set status="complete". Mirror the supplier's language.

You are given: the customer job context, the raw extracted quotation, the committed items so far, the full conversation, and the supplier's latest reply (which may include extracted totals from attached sub-quotes). Merge the latest reply into the items.

Return STRICT JSON ONLY (no markdown):
{
  "status": "incomplete" | "complete",
  "message": "your next message to the supplier (their language; concise). Empty allowed only when complete.",
  "items": [
    {"seq":number,"description":string,"brand":string,"model":string,"spec":string,"qty":string,
     "unit_price":number|null,"line_amount":number|null,"warranty":string,
     "source":"own"|"outsourced","sub_cost":number|null,"markup_pct":number|null,
     "customer_description":string,"hide_brand":boolean,"confirmed":boolean}
  ],
  "total": number|null
}
Rules: include EVERY line from the quotation in items (confirmed true/false). confirmed=true only when that line meets the completeness bar above. status="complete" only when ALL lines are confirmed and the item totals reconcile to the grand total. customer_description must always be filled (anonymized). Keep brand/model/spec factual - never invent details the supplier did not give; if unknown, leave "" and keep confirmed=false.`;

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key'); if (!key) return J({ error: 'no ai key' }, 500);

    const inq = body.inquiry || {};
    const extracted = body.extracted || {};
    const committed = Array.isArray(body.committed) ? body.committed : [];
    const history = Array.isArray(body.history) ? body.history : [];
    const reply = body.supplier_reply || null;

    const ctx: string[] = [];
    ctx.push('CUSTOMER JOB: ' + [inq.category && ('category ' + inq.category), inq.summary && ('scope: ' + inq.summary)].filter(Boolean).join(' | '));
    ctx.push('RAW EXTRACTED QUOTATION (grand total ' + (extracted.amount ?? '?') + ' ' + (extracted.currency || 'AED') + '):\n' + JSON.stringify({ amount: extracted.amount, line_items: extracted.line_items || [], warranty: extracted.warranty, scope: extracted.scope, lead_time: extracted.lead_time }));
    ctx.push('COMMITTED ITEMS SO FAR:\n' + JSON.stringify(committed));
    if (history.length) ctx.push('CONVERSATION SO FAR:\n' + history.map((m: any) => (m.role === 'agent' ? 'AGENT' : 'SUPPLIER') + ': ' + String(m.body || '')).join('\n'));
    if (reply) {
      let r = 'SUPPLIER LATEST REPLY: ' + String(reply.body || '');
      if (Array.isArray(reply.sub_quotes) && reply.sub_quotes.length) r += '\nATTACHED SUB-QUOTE(S) (extracted): ' + JSON.stringify(reply.sub_quotes.map((s: any) => ({ name: s.name, total: s.total, line_items: s.line_items || [] })));
      ctx.push(r);
    } else if (!history.length) {
      ctx.push('This is the FIRST pass - audit the raw quotation and open the conversation.');
    }

    let ai: any = null;
    for (const model of MODELS) { for (let at = 0; at < 2 && !ai; at++) { try {
      const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${key}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ model, max_tokens: 2600, temperature: 0.15, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: SYS }, { role: 'user', content: ctx.join('\n\n') }] }) });
      const jd = await r.json(); const c = jd?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content; if (c) { const p = parseJson(c); if (p && Array.isArray(p.items)) { ai = p; break; } }
    } catch (_e) { /* try next */ } } if (ai) break; }
    if (!ai) return J({ error: 'ai_unavailable' }, 502);

    const items = (ai.items || []).map((it: any, i: number) => {
      const source = it.source === 'outsourced' ? 'outsourced' : 'own';
      const sub = num(it.sub_cost); const mk = num(it.markup_pct); let line = num(it.line_amount); const unit = num(it.unit_price);
      if (source === 'outsourced' && sub != null && mk != null) line = round2(sub * (1 + mk / 100));
      return {
        seq: Number(it.seq) || i + 1,
        description: String(it.description || '').slice(0, 300),
        brand: String(it.brand || '').slice(0, 120),
        model: String(it.model || '').slice(0, 120),
        spec: String(it.spec || '').slice(0, 600),
        qty: String(it.qty || '').slice(0, 60),
        unit_price: unit,
        line_amount: line,
        warranty: String(it.warranty || '').slice(0, 200),
        source,
        sub_cost: source === 'outsourced' ? sub : null,
        markup_pct: source === 'outsourced' ? mk : null,
        customer_description: String(it.customer_description || it.description || '').slice(0, 400),
        hide_brand: it.hide_brand === true,
        confirmed: it.confirmed === true,
      };
    });
    const allConfirmed = items.length > 0 && items.every((x: any) => x.confirmed);
    const status = (ai.status === 'complete' && allConfirmed) ? 'complete' : 'incomplete';
    let total = num(ai.total);
    if (total == null) { const s = items.reduce((a: number, x: any) => a + (x.line_amount || 0), 0); total = s > 0 ? round2(s) : null; }

    return J({ ok: true, status, message: String(ai.message || '').slice(0, 3000), items, total });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/rate_dims/index.ts

```typescript
// rate_dims — persists the 6 reputation dimensions onto an existing review row.
// Called by /app right after rate_supplier. Customer Supabase JWT auth.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type, apikey', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
const DIMS = ['r_communication','r_quality','r_punctuality','r_documentation','r_after_sales','r_compliance'];

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
    const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
    if (!user?.email) return J({ error: 'Not signed in' }, 401);
    const { data: cust } = await admin.from('customers').select('id').eq('email', user.email.toLowerCase()).maybeSingle();
    if (!cust) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const qid = String(body.quote_id || '');
    if (!qid) return J({ error: 'quote_id required' }, 400);
    const patch: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const d of DIMS) { const v = Number((body as any)[d]); if (v >= 1 && v <= 5) patch[d] = Math.round(v); }
    if (!Object.keys(patch).length) return J({ ok: true, updated: 0, note: 'no dimensions supplied' });
    const { data: tx } = await admin.from('transactions').select('id').eq('quote_id', qid).eq('customer_id', cust.id).maybeSingle();
    if (!tx) return J({ error: 'You can only rate a supplier you have dealt with.' }, 403);
    const { data: rev } = await admin.from('reviews').select('id').eq('transaction_id', tx.id).eq('customer_id', cust.id).maybeSingle();
    if (!rev) return J({ error: 'Submit the overall rating first.' }, 409);
    const { error } = await admin.from('reviews').update(patch).eq('id', rev.id);
    if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
    try { const { data: q } = await admin.from('quotes').select('supplier_id').eq('id', qid).maybeSingle(); if (q) await admin.rpc('recompute_supplier_rating', { p_supplier: q.supplier_id }); } catch (_e) {}
    return J({ ok: true, updated: Object.keys(patch).length });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/reflect/index.ts

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
import { makeLlm, SONNET_FIRST } from '../_shared/llm.ts';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
async function sec(k:string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
const llm = makeLlm(SONNET_FIRST, { max: 500 });
const RUNMAP:Record<string,string>={it:'it_health',security:'security',collections:'collections',docs:'docs',onboarding:'onboarding',followup:'followup',bd:'bd_outreach',marketing:'marketing',brief:'brief',cfo:'finance',bookkeeper:'finance',legal:'legal_review'};
const AGENTS=['legal','collections','cfo','bookkeeper','security','it','onboarding','docs','followup','bd','marketing','brief'];

Deno.serve(async (req)=>{
  let b:any={}; try{ b=await req.json(); }catch(_){}
  const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
  if(!secretOk(__exp) || b.__secret!==__exp) return new Response(JSON.stringify({error:'forbidden'}),{status:403,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});
  const started=new Date().toISOString();
  const ork=await sec('openrouter_api_key'); if(!ork) return new Response(JSON.stringify({error:'no key'}),{status:200,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});
  const since=new Date(Date.now()-14*864e5).toISOString();
  let added=0, processed=0;
  for(const key of AGENTS){
    try{
      const { data:acts } = await admin.from('agent_actions').select('kind,title,status,decided_by').eq('agent',key).gte('created_at',since).limit(40);
      const runName=RUNMAP[key]; let runs:any[]=[];
      if(runName){ const { data:r } = await admin.from('agent_runs').select('status,counts,finished_at').eq('agent',runName).gte('started_at',since).limit(20); runs=r||[]; }
      const decided=(acts||[]).filter((a:any)=>a.status==='approved'||a.status==='rejected');
      if((!decided||decided.length===0) && runs.length===0) continue;
      processed++;
      const sys='You are the '+key+' specialist at QuotesDone reflecting weekly to get better, like a professional reviewing their own work. Based ONLY on the outcomes provided, extract at most 2 concise, durable lessons (each <= 25 words) that will improve your future decisions or recommendations. Focus on patterns (e.g. what the founder approved vs rejected, what failed). If there is nothing genuinely useful, return an empty list. Reply STRICT JSON only: {"lessons":["..."]}';
      const user='Recent decided recommendations: '+JSON.stringify(decided).slice(0,2500)+'\nRecent run results: '+JSON.stringify(runs).slice(0,1500);
      const raw=await llm(sys,user)||''; let lessons:string[]=[];
      try{ const m=raw.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); const p=JSON.parse(m?m[0]:raw); if(Array.isArray(p.lessons)) lessons=p.lessons.map((x:any)=>String(x).trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,2); }catch(_e){}
      if(!lessons.length) continue;
      const { data:existing } = await admin.from('agent_memory').select('content').eq('agent_key',key).eq('kind','reflection').order('id',{ascending:false}).limit(30);
      const seen=new Set((existing||[]).map((e:any)=>String(e.content).toLowerCase()));
      for(const L of lessons){ if(seen.has(L.toLowerCase())) continue; await admin.from('agent_memory').insert({agent_key:key,kind:'reflection',content:L.slice(0,400),source:'auto_reflection'}); added++; }
    }catch(_e){}
  }
  await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({agent:'reflect',started_at:started,finished_at:new Date().toISOString(),status:'ok',counts:{agents_processed:processed,lessons_added:added}});
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ok:true,processed,added}),{headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});
});
```

### supabase/functions/refund_flow/index.ts

```typescript
// refund_flow - the customer side of the unresponsive-supplier escalation.
//
//   reveal paid -> 1 WORKING DAY -> customer may press "Notify supplier"
//   -> ONE email, supplier addressed, customer + management cc'd, one thread
//   -> 3 WORKING DAYS -> founder calls -> only then may a refund be approved
//
// Deliberately a separate function rather than new actions inside customer_api: that file is 64KB
// and every byte would have to be redeployed to add two endpoints. Auth is replicated exactly
// (Bearer JWT -> auth.getUser -> customers row), so it behaves identically to customer_api.
//
// All timing lives in Postgres (fn_refund_state / fn_notify_supplier / fn_add_working_days). Those
// resolve every working-day count through the single fn_is_working_day rule (Asia/Dubai, honours
// public_holidays), so this function computes no dates itself and the whole ladder shares one
// implementation of "working days".
//
// v2: accepts quote_id as well as transaction_id. customer_api.my_inquiries resolves the
//     transaction internally but does NOT expose transaction_id on the quote it returns, so the
//     portal only ever holds a quote id. Resolving here avoids redeploying 64KB for one field.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const auth = req.headers.get('Authorization') || '';
    const jwt = auth.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
    const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
    if (!user || !user.email) return J({ error: 'Not signed in' }, 401);
    const email = user.email.toLowerCase();
    const { data: cust } = await admin.from('customers').select('id').eq('email', email).maybeSingle();
    if (!cust) return J({ error: 'no_customer' }, 403);

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const action = String(body.action || 'state');

    if (action === 'list') {
      const { data: txs } = await admin.from('transactions')
        .select('id, inquiry_id, quote_id, revealed_at')
        .eq('customer_id', cust.id)
        .not('revealed_at', 'is', null)
        .order('revealed_at', { ascending: false })
        .limit(50);
      const out: any[] = [];
      for (const t of txs || []) {
        const { data: st } = await admin.rpc('fn_refund_state', { p_transaction: t.id });
        out.push({ transaction_id: t.id, inquiry_id: t.inquiry_id, quote_id: t.quote_id, ...(st || {}) });
      }
      return J({ ok: true, reveals: out });
    }

    // Accept either identifier. The portal holds a quote id; internal callers hold a transaction id.
    let txId = String(body.transaction_id || '');
    const quoteId = String(body.quote_id || '');
    if (!txId && !quoteId) return J({ error: 'transaction_id_or_quote_id_required' }, 400);

    if (!txId) {
      const { data: byQuote } = await admin.from('transactions')
        .select('id').eq('quote_id', quoteId).eq('customer_id', cust.id)
        .order('revealed_at', { ascending: false }).limit(1).maybeSingle();
      // No transaction means this quote was never revealed by this customer - nothing to escalate.
      if (!byQuote) return J({ ok: true, state: 'not_revealed', can_notify: false, refund_approvable: false });
      txId = String(byQuote.id);
    } else {
      // OWNERSHIP: a customer may only ever see or act on their own reveal. Checked here rather
      // than inside the SQL functions so those stay usable by the founder/admin side too.
      const { data: owned } = await admin.from('transactions')
        .select('id').eq('id', txId).eq('customer_id', cust.id).maybeSingle();
      if (!owned) return J({ error: 'not_found' }, 404);
    }

    if (action === 'state') {
      const { data: st, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_refund_state', { p_transaction: txId });
      if (error) return J({ error: 'state_failed', detail: error.message }, 500);
      return J({ ok: true, ...(st || {}) });
    }

    if (action === 'notify') {
      // fn_notify_supplier re-checks the working-day gate itself and is idempotent, so a double
      // click or a stale button cannot send twice or fire early.
      const { data: res, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_notify_supplier', { p_transaction: txId, p_actor: 'customer' });
      if (error) return J({ error: 'notify_failed', detail: error.message }, 500);
      return J(res);
    }

    return J({ error: 'unknown_action', allowed: ['list', 'state', 'notify'] }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```
