### supabase/functions/refunds_api/index.ts

```typescript
// refunds_api v5 — founder actions on reveal-fee complaints/refunds.
// Actions: list_pending · list_recent · resolve {transaction_id, decision:'approve'|'reject', note}
// Auth: __secret == inbound_secret OR admin-email JWT.
// v4 CORRECTNESS FIX: 'resolve' previously returned ok:true even when the transactions UPDATE failed,
//    so the founder was told a refund was applied when nothing had changed. It now returns ok:false on
//    failure AND raises a founder_alert + notification, so the failure reaches a human even if the admin
//    UI ignores the response body. HTTP stays 200 so existing UI error handling is not disturbed.
// v5 THE REFUND NOW ACTUALLY REFUNDS (27 Jul 2026). Until today approving a refund did nothing but
//    set refund_status='refunded'. No code anywhere in the repository called Stripe's refund API —
//    a source scan found only /v1/checkout/sessions and /v1/account. The customer therefore received
//    nothing, while the status change fired the DB trigger that creates supplier_dues, sets
//    matching_blocked and starts the collections_legal ladder. One click cost a customer their money,
//    a supplier their standing, and the company a chargeback.
//    Approve now calls Stripe FIRST and only writes 'refunded' once Stripe confirms. If Stripe fails,
//    NOTHING changes: no status flip, no supplier debt, no block, no collections. Fail closed.
//    Idempotency-Key is the transaction id, so a double-click or a retry cannot refund twice.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
async function sec(k: string): Promise<string | undefined> { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
async function authed(req: Request, body: any) { if (body.__secret && body.__secret === (await sec('inbound_secret'))) return true; const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, ''); if (!jwt) return false; const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt); const allow = (await sec('admin_emails') || '').split(',').map((s) => s.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean); return !!(user?.email && allow.includes(user.email.toLowerCase())); }

const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'refunds_api', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break a refund decision */ }
}
// Out-of-band escalation: does not depend on the admin UI rendering the response.
async function escalate(subject: string, detail: string) {
  try { await admin.from('founder_alerts').insert({ level: 'high', event: 'refund_action_failed', detail: String(detail).slice(0, 900), channel: 'email' }); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
  try {
    const owner = ((await sec('admin_emails')) || 'management@quotesdone.com').split(',')[0].trim();
    await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type: 'refund_action_failed', to_email: owner, to_role: 'admin', channel: 'email', subject, body: detail, status: 'queued' });
  } catch (_e) { /* */ }
}

// Ask Stripe to return the money. Returns the refund object on success, or an error string.
// payment_ref is whatever the settling function stored: stripe_webhook writes
// `s.payment_intent || s.id`, so it is normally a pi_… but can be a cs_… — handle both.
async function stripeRefund(paymentRef: string, transactionId: string): Promise<{ ok: true; refund: any } | { ok: false; error: string }> {
  const sk = await sec('stripe_secret_key');
  if (!sk) return { ok: false, error: 'stripe_secret_key missing from app_secrets - cannot issue a refund' };
  if (!paymentRef) return { ok: false, error: 'transaction has no payment_ref, so there is no Stripe charge to refund' };

  let pi = paymentRef;
  if (paymentRef.startsWith('cs_')) {
    try {
      const sr = await fetch('https://api.stripe.com/v1/checkout/sessions/' + encodeURIComponent(paymentRef), { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + sk } });
      const sj = await sr.json();
      if (!sr.ok || !sj?.payment_intent) return { ok: false, error: 'could not resolve a payment_intent from checkout session ' + paymentRef + ': ' + String(sj?.error?.message || sr.status) };
      pi = String(sj.payment_intent);
    } catch (e) { return { ok: false, error: 'error resolving checkout session: ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e) }; }
  }

  const form = new URLSearchParams();
  form.set('payment_intent', pi);
  form.set('reason', 'requested_by_customer');
  form.set('metadata[transaction_id]', transactionId);
  // No amount: refund the charge in full. The Checkout Session only ever charged the reveal fee,
  // so a full refund is exactly the fee and cannot drift from our own rounding.
  try {
    const r = await fetch('https://api.stripe.com/v1/refunds', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + sk, 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded', 'Idempotency-Key': 'qd_refund_' + transactionId },
      body: form.toString(),
    });
    const j = await r.json();
    if (!r.ok) return { ok: false, error: 'Stripe refused the refund (HTTP ' + r.status + '): ' + String(j?.error?.message || '').slice(0, 250) };
    // 'pending' is a normal terminal-ish state for some methods; 'failed'/'canceled' are not.
    if (j?.status && !['succeeded', 'pending'].includes(String(j.status))) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Stripe refund came back with status "' + j.status + '"' };
    }
    return { ok: true, refund: j };
  } catch (e) { return { ok: false, error: 'network error calling Stripe refunds: ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e) }; }
}

async function enrich(txs: any[]) {
  const sids = [...new Set(txs.map((t) => t.supplier_id).filter(Boolean))];
  const cids = [...new Set(txs.map((t) => t.customer_id).filter(Boolean))];
  const iids = [...new Set(txs.map((t) => t.inquiry_id).filter(Boolean))];
  const [{ data: leads }, { data: custs }, { data: inqs }] = await Promise.all([
    sids.length ? admin.from('leads').select('id,company_name,email,phone,rv_response_rate,rv_nonresponse_refunds,matching_blocked').in('id', sids) : Promise.resolve({ data: [] } as any),
    cids.length ? admin.from('customers').select('id,full_name,email,phone').in('id', cids) : Promise.resolve({ data: [] } as any),
    iids.length ? admin.from('inquiries').select('id,summary,category,emirate').in('id', iids) : Promise.resolve({ data: [] } as any),
  ]);
  const lm = new Map((leads || []).map((l: any) => [Number(l.id), l]));
  const cm = new Map((custs || []).map((c: any) => [String(c.id), c]));
  const im = new Map((inqs || []).map((i: any) => [String(i.id), i]));
  return txs.map((t) => { const l = lm.get(Number(t.supplier_id)) || {}; const c = cm.get(String(t.customer_id)) || {}; const i = im.get(String(t.inquiry_id)) || {}; return {
    transaction_id: t.id, inquiry_id: t.inquiry_id, reveal_fee: t.reveal_fee, quote_amount: t.quote_amount,
    revealed_at: t.revealed_at, refund_requested_at: t.refund_requested_at, refund_status: t.refund_status, refund_note: t.refund_note,
    supplier_ack_at: t.supplier_ack_at,
    supplier: { id: t.supplier_id, company: l.company_name, email: l.email, phone: l.phone, response_rate: l.rv_response_rate, prior_nonresponse: l.rv_nonresponse_refunds, blocked: l.matching_blocked },
    customer: { name: c.full_name, email: c.email, phone: c.phone },
    inquiry: { summary: i.summary, category: i.category, emirate: i.emirate },
  }; });
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    if (!(await authed(req, body))) { await logRun('error', { action: String(body?.action || '') }, 'forbidden: refund API called without valid secret or admin JWT'); return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403); }
    const action = String(body.action || '');

    if (action === 'list_pending') {
      const { data } = await admin.from('transactions').select('id,inquiry_id,supplier_id,customer_id,reveal_fee,quote_amount,revealed_at,refund_requested_at,refund_status,refund_note,supplier_ack_at').eq('refund_status', 'requested').order('refund_requested_at', { ascending: true }).limit(200);
      return J({ ok: true, rows: await enrich(data || []) });
    }
    if (action === 'list_recent') {
      const { data } = await admin.from('transactions').select('id,inquiry_id,supplier_id,customer_id,reveal_fee,quote_amount,revealed_at,refund_requested_at,refund_status,refund_note,supplier_ack_at').not('refund_status', 'is', null).order('refund_requested_at', { ascending: false }).limit(100);
      return J({ ok: true, rows: await enrich(data || []) });
    }
    if (action === 'resolve') {
      const id = String(body.transaction_id || ''); const decision = String(body.decision || ''); const note = String(body.note || '').slice(0, 500);
      if (!id || !['approve', 'reject'].includes(decision)) return J({ error: 'transaction_id and decision(approve|reject) required' }, 400);
      const { data: tx } = await admin.from('transactions').select('id,refund_status,supplier_id,reveal_fee,payment_ref,refund_stripe_id').eq('id', id).maybeSingle();
      if (!tx) { await logRun('error', { transaction_id: id, decision }, 'transaction_not_found - refund decision could not be applied'); return J({ error: 'transaction_not_found' }, 404); }
      const prevStatus = String(tx.refund_status || '');
      const newStatus = decision === 'approve' ? 'refunded' : 'rejected';

      // v5: money first, bookkeeping second. Nothing below this block runs unless Stripe
      // has actually returned the customer's money.
      const refundPatch: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      if (decision === 'approve') {
        if (prevStatus === 'refunded' && tx.refund_stripe_id) {
          await logRun('ok', { transaction_id: id, already_refunded: true, refund_stripe_id: tx.refund_stripe_id }, 'refund already issued; ignoring duplicate approval');
          return J({ ok: true, applied: false, already_refunded: true, transaction_id: id, refund_status: 'refunded', refund_stripe_id: tx.refund_stripe_id });
        }
        const sr = await stripeRefund(String(tx.payment_ref || ''), id);
        if (!sr.ok) {
          await logRun('error', { transaction_id: id, decision, supplier_id: tx.supplier_id, reveal_fee: tx.reveal_fee, payment_ref: tx.payment_ref },
            'REFUND NOT ISSUED - Stripe refund failed, nothing was changed: ' + sr.error);
          await escalate('Refund could NOT be issued: ' + id,
            'A refund was approved for transaction ' + id + ' but Stripe did not return the money, so NOTHING was changed.\n\n' +
            'The customer has NOT been refunded. The supplier has NOT been charged or blocked. The transaction still reads "' + (prevStatus || 'unknown') + '".\n\n' +
            'Reveal fee: AED ' + String(tx.reveal_fee ?? '') + '\nPayment ref: ' + String(tx.payment_ref ?? '(none)') + '\nSupplier id: ' + String(tx.supplier_id ?? '') +
            '\n\nStripe said: ' + sr.error + '\n\nResolve this in the Stripe dashboard or retry once the cause is fixed. The customer is waiting.');
          return J({ ok: false, applied: false, error: 'stripe_refund_failed', detail: sr.error, transaction_id: id, refund_status: prevStatus || null });
        }
        refundPatch.refund_stripe_id = String(sr.refund?.id || '');
        refundPatch.refund_amount_aed = Number(sr.refund?.amount || 0) / 100;
        refundPatch.refund_confirmed_at = new Date().toISOString();
      }

      // 'refunded' fires the DB trigger: creates the 3% non-response due + blocks the supplier
      const { error: uErr } = await admin.from('transactions').update({ refund_status: newStatus, refund_note: note || null, refund_resolved_at: new Date().toISOString(), ...refundPatch }).eq('id', id);
      if (uErr) {
        // v4: the caller is now told the truth, and a founder alert fires regardless of the UI.
        await logRun('error', { transaction_id: id, decision, supplier_id: tx.supplier_id, reveal_fee: tx.reveal_fee },
          'REFUND DECISION NOT APPLIED - transactions update failed: ' + uErr.message);
        const moneyMoved = decision === 'approve' && !!refundPatch.refund_stripe_id;
        await escalate((moneyMoved ? 'MONEY REFUNDED BUT NOT RECORDED: ' : 'Refund decision did NOT apply: ') + id,
          (moneyMoved
            ? 'STRIPE HAS ALREADY REFUNDED THE CUSTOMER, but the database update failed, so our records still say "' + (prevStatus || 'unknown') + '".\n\n' +
              'Stripe refund id: ' + String(refundPatch.refund_stripe_id) + ' (AED ' + String(refundPatch.refund_amount_aed) + ')\n' +
              'Do NOT approve this refund again - the money is already gone and a second approval is blocked by the idempotency key, but the record must be corrected by hand.\n\n'
            : 'A refund decision was submitted but the database update failed, so NOTHING changed.\n\n') +
          'Transaction: ' + id + '\nDecision: ' + decision + '\nCurrent status remains: ' + (prevStatus || 'unknown') +
          '\nReveal fee: ' + String(tx.reveal_fee ?? '') + '\nSupplier id: ' + String(tx.supplier_id ?? '') +
          '\n\nDatabase error: ' + uErr.message);
        return J({ ok: false, applied: false, error: 'update_failed', detail: uErr.message, transaction_id: id, refund_status: prevStatus || null, money_refunded: moneyMoved, refund_stripe_id: refundPatch.refund_stripe_id || null });
      }
      let due: any = null, blocked: boolean | null = null;
      if (decision === 'approve') {
        const { data: d } = await admin.from('supplier_dues').select('amount_due,status,due_date').eq('transaction_id', id).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).maybeSingle();
        due = d || null;
        const { data: l } = await admin.from('leads').select('matching_blocked').eq('id', tx.supplier_id).maybeSingle();
        blocked = l?.matching_blocked ?? null;
        if (!due) {
          await logRun('error', { transaction_id: id, supplier_id: tx.supplier_id }, 'refund approved but no supplier_dues row was created - the 3% non-response trigger may not have fired');
          await escalate('Refund approved but supplier was not charged: ' + id,
            'A refund was approved for transaction ' + id + ', but no supplier_dues row was created, so the 3% non-response charge may not have been applied to supplier ' + String(tx.supplier_id ?? '') + '.\n\nThe refund itself DID apply. Please check the supplier charge manually.');
        }
      }
      await logRun('ok', { transaction_id: id, decision, from_status: prevStatus, to_status: newStatus, supplier_id: tx.supplier_id, reveal_fee: tx.reveal_fee, charge_created: !!due, supplier_blocked: blocked, refund_stripe_id: refundPatch.refund_stripe_id || null, refunded_aed: refundPatch.refund_amount_aed ?? null },
        (decision === 'approve' ? ('Stripe refunded AED ' + String(refundPatch.refund_amount_aed) + ' (' + String(refundPatch.refund_stripe_id) + '). ') : '') + (note ? ('note: ' + note) : ''));
      return J({ ok: true, applied: true, transaction_id: id, refund_status: newStatus, non_response_charge: due, supplier_blocked: blocked, refund_stripe_id: refundPatch.refund_stripe_id || null, refunded_aed: refundPatch.refund_amount_aed ?? null });
    }

    await logRun('error', { action }, 'unknown_action');
    return J({ error: 'unknown_action' }, 400);
  } catch (e) { const m = String((e as Error)?.message || e); await logRun('error', {}, 'exception: ' + m); return J({ error: m }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/reg_fetch/index.ts

```typescript
// reg_fetch - downloads an official regulation/code document (direct URL) into the compliance-docs bucket,
// links it to reg_catalog + compliance_sources, and (for real PDFs) triggers indexing. Rejects HTML/portal
// stubs. Free-published authority documents only. Internal use.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const FN = (Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')||'') + '/functions/v1';
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    const secret = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(secret) || body.__secret !== secret) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const catId = body.catalog_id ? Number(body.catalog_id) : null;
    let url = body.url as string | undefined;
    let authority = body.authority as string | undefined;
    let topic = body.topic as string | undefined;
    let cat: any = null;
    if (catId) { const { data } = await admin.from('reg_catalog').select('*').eq('id', catId).maybeSingle(); cat = data; url = url || cat?.source_url; authority = authority || cat?.authority; topic = topic || cat?.code_name; }
    if (!url) return J({ error: 'no_url' });
    let resp: Response;
    try { resp = await fetch(url, { redirect: 'follow', headers: { 'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; QuotesDoneBot/1.0)' } }); }
    catch (e) { return J({ ok:false, error:'fetch_failed', detail:String((e as Error)?.message||e).slice(0,140) }); }
    if (!resp.ok) return J({ ok:false, error:'http_'+resp.status });
    const ct = (resp.headers.get('content-type')||'').toLowerCase();
    const buf = new Uint8Array(await resp.arrayBuffer());
    const isPdf = ct.includes('pdf') || (buf.length>4 && buf[0]===0x25 && buf[1]===0x50 && buf[2]===0x44 && buf[3]===0x46); // %PDF
    if (!isPdf || buf.length < 30000) {
      if (catId) await admin.from('reg_catalog').update({ status:'needs_source', notes: (cat?.notes? cat.notes+' | ':'')+'auto-fetch got '+(isPdf?'small PDF':ct||'non-pdf')+' ('+buf.length+'B) — needs a direct document URL', updated_at:new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', catId);
      return J({ ok:false, note:'not_a_document', content_type: ct, bytes: buf.length });
    }
    const path = 'catalog/'+(catId||'x')+'_'+Date.now()+'.pdf';
    const { error: uerr } = await admin.storage.from('compliance-docs').upload(path, buf, { contentType: 'application/pdf', upsert: true });
    if (uerr) return J({ ok:false, error:'upload:'+uerr.message });
    // upsert compliance_sources
    const { data: csrow, error: cerr } = await admin.from('compliance_sources').insert({ authority, topic, url, doc_path: path, doc_bytes: buf.length, doc_content_type: 'application/pdf', doc_downloaded_at: new Date().toISOString(), fetch_mode: 'reg_fetch', active: true }).select('id').single();
    if (cerr) return J({ ok:false, error:'cs_insert:'+cerr.message });
    if (catId) await admin.from('reg_catalog').update({ compliance_source_id: csrow.id, status:'downloaded', source_url: url, updated_at:new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', catId);
    // trigger indexing of this one document
    let indexed: any = null;
    try { const r = await fetch(FN+'/kb_ingest', { method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: secret, id: csrow.id }) }); indexed = await r.json(); } catch (_e) {}
    if (catId && indexed?.results?.[0]?.chunks > 0) await admin.from('reg_catalog').update({ status:'indexed', updated_at:new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', catId);
    return J({ ok:true, authority, bytes: buf.length, compliance_source_id: csrow.id, indexed: indexed?.results?.[0] || null });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/report_body/index.ts

```typescript
// report_body — returns the full text of a board/agent report for the OS reports viewer.
// Admin-only (JWT + admin_emails). report_registry.id maps 1:1 to board_reports.id.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
    const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
```

```typescript
// Webhook authenticity ------------------------------------------------------
function timingSafeEq(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
  let r = 0; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) r |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);
  return r === 0;
}
// Svix/Standard-Webhooks: base64(HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<id>.<timestamp>.<rawBody>")).
async function verifySvix(secret: string, rawBody: string, h: Headers): Promise<{ ok: boolean; reason: string }> {
  const id = h.get('svix-id') || h.get('webhook-id');
  const ts = h.get('svix-timestamp') || h.get('webhook-timestamp');
  const sigHeader = h.get('svix-signature') || h.get('webhook-signature');
  if (!id || !ts || !sigHeader) return { ok: false, reason: 'missing svix-id / svix-timestamp / svix-signature headers - not a genuine Resend delivery' };
  const skew = Math.abs(Date.now() / 1000 - Number(ts));
  if (!Number.isFinite(skew)) return { ok: false, reason: 'unparseable svix-timestamp' };
  if (skew > 300) return { ok: false, reason: 'timestamp is ' + Math.round(skew) + 's from now, outside the 5 minute replay window' };
  try {
    const b64 = secret.startsWith('whsec_') ? secret.slice(6) : secret;
    const keyBytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(b64), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
    const ck = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', keyBytes, { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']);
    const mac = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', ck, new TextEncoder().encode(id + '.' + ts + '.' + rawBody)));
    const expected = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...mac));
    for (const part of sigHeader.split(' ')) {
      const candidate = part.includes(',') ? part.split(',')[1] : part;
      if (candidate && timingSafeEq(candidate, expected)) return { ok: true, reason: 'ok' };
    }
    return { ok: false, reason: 'signature mismatch - payload was not signed with our endpoint secret' };
  } catch (e) { return { ok: false, reason: 'verification error: ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0, 120) }; }
}

          const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions',{method:'POST',headers:{'Authorization':`Bearer ${key}`,'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({model:MODEL,max_tokens:500,temperature:0.1,messages:[{role:'system',content:SYS},{role:'user',content}]})});
          const jd = await r.json(); if (r.ok) ai = { ...ai, ...parseJson(jd?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content||'{}') }; else classifyFailures++;
        } catch { classifyFailures++; }
      }
      const cat = String(ai.category||'other');
      let extracted:any = null; const fields:string[] = [];
      if (lead && inbSecret) {
        if (cat === 'trade_license') {
          const ex = await extractDoc('license', bytes, mime, fname, inbSecret);
          if (ex && ex.doc) { extracted = ex.doc; const dc = ex.doc; const u:any = { license_doc_path: path, license_doc_name: fname, doc_extracted_at: new Date().toISOString() };
            if (dc.confidence !== 'low') {
              if (dc.license_number) { u.trade_license_no = dc.license_number; fields.push('licence no '+dc.license_number); }
              if (dc.license_authority) { u.license_authority = dc.license_authority; fields.push('authority'); }
              if (dc.expiry_date) { u.license_expiry = dc.expiry_date; fields.push('expiry '+dc.expiry_date); }
              if (dc.city) u.license_city = dc.city;
              if (dc.emirate && !lead.emirate) u.emirate = dc.emirate;
              if (dc.trn && !lead.trn) { u.trn = dc.trn; fields.push('TRN'); }
            }
            await admin.from('leads').update(u).eq('id', lead.id);
          }
        } else if (cat === 'company_profile' || cat === 'catalogue') {
          const ex = await extractDoc('profile', bytes, mime, fname, inbSecret);
          const u:any = { doc_extracted_at: new Date().toISOString() };
          if (cat === 'company_profile') u.company_profile_doc_path = path;
          if (cat === 'catalogue') { const cur = Array.isArray(lead.catalog_doc_paths)?lead.catalog_doc_paths:[]; u.catalog_doc_paths = [...cur, path]; }
          if (ex && ex.profile) { extracted = ex.profile; const pr = ex.profile;
            if (pr.confidence !== 'low') {
              if (pr.summary && !lead.capability_summary) { u.capability_summary = pr.summary; fields.push('capability'); }
              if (Array.isArray(pr.services) && pr.services.length && !lead.services) u.services = pr.services;
              if (Array.isArray(pr.products) && pr.products.length && !lead.products) u.products = pr.products;
              if (Array.isArray(pr.emirates) && pr.emirates.length && !(Array.isArray(lead.service_emirates)&&lead.service_emirates.length)) u.service_emirates = pr.emirates;
            }
          }
          await admin.from('leads').update(u).eq('id', lead.id);
        }
        if (fields.length) appliedSummary.push(fname + ' → ' + fields.join(', '));
      }
      const { data: rev } = await admin.from('doc_reviews').insert({ lead_id: lead?.id||null, from_email: from, subject, file_name: fname, file_path: path, mime, ai_relevant: ai.relevant, ai_category: ai.category, ai_summary: String(ai.summary||'').slice(0,1000), ai_suggested_field: ai.suggested_field, ai_confidence: ai.confidence, status: 'pending', auto_applied: fields.length>0, extracted: extracted }).select('id').maybeSingle();
      if (rev?.id) reviews.push(rev.id);
    }
    await admin.from('inbound_messages').insert({ lead_id: lead?.id||null, from_email: from, to_email: to, subject, body: (text||'').slice(0,20000), attachments_count: stored, matched_existing: !!lead, needs_review: stored>0 && appliedSummary.length===0 });
    if (lead && appliedSummary.length) {
      try{ await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type:'supplier_doc_applied', to_email: owner, to_role:'admin', lead_id: lead.id, channel:'email', subject:`Supplier record auto-updated: ${lead.company_name||('Lead #'+lead.id)}`, body:`A document from ${from} was read and applied to ${lead.company_name||('Lead #'+lead.id)}:\n\n${appliedSummary.join('\n')}\n\nReview it in the CRM if needed.` }); }catch(_e){}
    }
    if (from && from !== 'onboarding@resend.dev' && stored>0 && lead) await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type:'doc_received', to_email: from, to_role:'supplier', lead_id: lead?.id||null, subject:'We received your document', body:`Thank you${lead?.company_name?' '+lead.company_name:''} — we received ${stored} document(s) and updated your records.`, status:'queued' });
    const counts = { from, matched_lead: lead?.id||null, attachments: atts.length, stored, lost_attachments: lostAttachments, upload_failures: uploadFailures, classify_failures: classifyFailures, applied: appliedSummary.length, signature_verified: 1 };
    if (lostAttachments || uploadFailures) await logRun('error', counts, 'INBOUND DOCUMENTS LOST - ' + lostAttachments + ' attachment(s) could not be downloaded from Resend and ' + uploadFailures + ' failed to upload to storage. Sender: ' + from + ', subject: ' + subject.slice(0, 120));
    else if (atts.length || stored) await logRun('ok', counts, appliedSummary.length ? ('applied: ' + appliedSummary.join('; ').slice(0, 300)) : (lead ? '' : 'no matching lead for sender'));
    return J({ ok: true, matched_lead: lead?.id||null, stored, reviews, applied: appliedSummary });
  } catch (e) { const m = String((e as Error)?.message || e); await logRun('error', {}, 'exception (inbound email dropped): ' + m); return J({ error: m }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/resend_webhook/index.ts

```typescript
// resend_webhook v4 - receives Resend delivery events. Hard bounce or spam complaint => add the recipient
// to email_suppressions so we never email them again (protects sender reputation + PDPL).
//
// SECURITY FIX 19 Jul 2026 ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// v3 authenticated ONLY on a shared secret in the QUERY STRING (?key=...). That is weak proof of
// origin: the full URL including the secret is stored in the Resend dashboard, appears in browser
// history and referrer headers, and is written to any proxy or access log that records request
// lines. Anyone who obtained it could forge bounce/complaint events and add ARBITRARY addresses to
// email_suppressions - permanently blocking real suppliers and customers from ever receiving mail
// from us, silently.
//
// v4 verifies the SVIX SIGNATURE that Resend actually signs each delivery with (svix-id,
// svix-timestamp, svix-signature), using the endpoint's signing secret now stored in
// app_secrets.resend_webhook_signing_secret. This is real cryptographic proof of origin and cannot
// be replayed outside a 5-minute window. The ?key= check is KEPT as a second factor, so both must
// pass - the query secret alone is no longer sufficient.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'resend_webhook', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the webhook */ }
}
function emailsOf(d: any): string[] {
  const out = new Set<string>();
  const push = (v: any) => { if (typeof v === 'string' && /@/.test(v)) out.add(v.toLowerCase().trim()); };
  if (d) { push(d.to); if (Array.isArray(d.to)) d.to.forEach(push); push(d.email); push(d.recipient); if (Array.isArray(d.recipients)) d.recipients.forEach(push); }
  return [...out];
}

// Constant-time string compare so a forger cannot time-probe toward a valid signature.
function timingSafeEq(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
  let r = 0; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) r |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);
  return r === 0;
}

// Svix/Standard-Webhooks verification: base64(HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<id>.<timestamp>.<rawBody>")).
async function verifySvix(secret: string, rawBody: string, h: Headers): Promise<{ ok: boolean; reason: string }> {
  const id = h.get('svix-id') || h.get('webhook-id');
  const ts = h.get('svix-timestamp') || h.get('webhook-timestamp');
  const sigHeader = h.get('svix-signature') || h.get('webhook-signature');
  if (!id || !ts || !sigHeader) return { ok: false, reason: 'missing svix-id / svix-timestamp / svix-signature headers - not a genuine Resend delivery' };
  const skew = Math.abs(Date.now() / 1000 - Number(ts));
  if (!Number.isFinite(skew)) return { ok: false, reason: 'unparseable svix-timestamp' };
  if (skew > 300) return { ok: false, reason: 'timestamp is ' + Math.round(skew) + 's away from now, outside the 5 minute replay window' };
  try {
    const b64 = secret.startsWith('whsec_') ? secret.slice(6) : secret;
    const keyBytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(b64), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
    const ck = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', keyBytes, { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']);
    const mac = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', ck, new TextEncoder().encode(id + '.' + ts + '.' + rawBody)));
    const expected = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...mac));
    // Header is a space-separated list of "v1,<base64sig>" - any one matching is valid (key rotation).
    for (const part of sigHeader.split(' ')) {
      const candidate = part.includes(',') ? part.split(',')[1] : part;
      if (candidate && timingSafeEq(candidate, expected)) return { ok: true, reason: 'ok' };
    }
    return { ok: false, reason: 'signature mismatch - payload was not signed with our endpoint secret' };
  } catch (e) { return { ok: false, reason: 'verification error: ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0, 120) }; }
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const url = new URL(req.url);
    const key = url.searchParams.get('key') || '';
    const wk = await sec('resend_webhook_key'); const ib = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!key || (key !== wk && key !== ib)) { await logRun('error', { authorised: 0, stage: 'query_key' }, 'resend_webhook rejected a caller whose ?key= did not match. No bounce or complaint was processed, so a genuine suppression may have been missed if this was a misconfigured endpoint URL.'); return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403); }

    // Read the body ONCE as text - the signature is over the exact bytes, so re-parsing is not enough.
    const raw = await req.text();

    const signingSecret = await sec('resend_webhook_signing_secret');
    if (!signingSecret) {
      await logRun('error', { authorised: 0, stage: 'no_signing_secret' }, 'resend_webhook could not read resend_webhook_signing_secret from app_secrets, so it cannot verify that this event genuinely came from Resend. The event was REJECTED rather than trusted on the query key alone. Bounce and complaint suppression is paused until the secret is restored.');
      return J({ error: 'signing secret unavailable' }, 503);
    }
    const v = await verifySvix(signingSecret, raw, req.headers);
    if (!v.ok) {
      await logRun('error', { authorised: 0, stage: 'signature', reason: v.reason }, 'resend_webhook REJECTED an event that failed Svix signature verification (' + v.reason + '). Until 19 Jul 2026 this endpoint trusted a secret in the query string alone, so a forged event could suppress any email address permanently. If this fires on genuine Resend traffic, check that the signing secret in app_secrets matches the one on the endpoint in the Resend dashboard.');
      return J({ error: 'invalid signature' }, 401);
    }

    let body: any = {}; try { body = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (_e) { body = {}; }
    const type = String(body?.type || body?.event || '').toLowerCase();
    const data = body?.data || body;
    const emails = emailsOf(data);
    let suppressed = 0;
    const isComplaint = type.includes('complain');
    const bounceType = String(data?.bounce?.type || data?.bounce_type || '').toLowerCase();
    const isHardBounce = type.includes('bounce') && bounceType !== 'transient' && bounceType !== 'soft';
    if ((isComplaint || isHardBounce) && emails.length) {
      const reason = isComplaint ? 'spam_complaint' : ('hard_bounce' + (bounceType ? ':' + bounceType : ''));
      for (const e of emails) {
        try { await admin.from('email_suppressions').upsert({ email: e, reason, source: 'resend_webhook' }, { onConflict: 'email' }); suppressed++; } catch (_e) {}
        try { await admin.from('leads').update({ invite_status: 'bounced' }).eq('email', e).or('invite_status.is.null,invite_status.eq.queued,invite_status.eq.sent'); } catch (_e) {}
      }
      try { await admin.from('error_events').insert({ source: 'resend_webhook', kind: reason, severity: 'low', detail: { emails, type } }); } catch (_e) {}
    }
    await logRun('ok', { authorised: 1, type, suppressed, signature_verified: 1 }, suppressed > 0 ? ('Verified Resend event "' + type + '" suppressed ' + suppressed + ' address(es) so we stop mailing them.') : ('Verified Resend event "' + type + '" required no suppression.'));
    return J({ ok: true, type, suppressed });
  } catch (e) {
    await logRun('error', { unhandled_exception: 1 }, 'resend_webhook threw an unhandled exception: ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0, 200) + ' - a bounce or complaint may not have been suppressed, so we could keep emailing a dead address and damage sender reputation.');
    return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 200);
  }
});
```

### supabase/functions/resilience_ping/index.ts

```typescript
// resilience_ping — the EXTERNAL watchdog target that survives a total pg_cron outage.
// An external scheduler (GitHub Action / uptime service) hits this every ~15min. Because it is an
// HTTP-invoked edge function, it keeps working even if the Supabase pg_cron scheduler has stopped.
// If no cron job has run in >20min (scheduler dead), it pages the founder DIRECTLY over HTTP
// (alert_founder -> WhatsApp) and force-flushes the outbox, so the alert escapes even with pg_cron down.
// Public + secretless by design (returns only liveness; pages only when genuinely down, deduped 30min)
// so any external monitor can wire it with just the URL.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const FN = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')! + '/functions/v1';
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } });
async function sec(k: string): Promise<string> { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok');
  try {
    // 1. Read cron liveness (plain SELECT; works while Postgres is up even if pg_cron stopped scheduling).
    const { data: live, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_cron_liveness');
    if (error) return J({ ok: false, error: error.message }, 200);
    const healthy = live?.healthy === true;
    const ageMin = live?.newest_run_age_min ?? null;
    if (healthy) return J({ ok: true, healthy: true, newest_run_age_min: ageMin });

    // 2. Scheduler appears DOWN. Dedupe to once per 30min via an app_secrets timestamp.
    const nowMs = Date.now();
    const lastRaw = await sec('cron_down_last_alert');
    const lastMs = lastRaw ? Date.parse(lastRaw) : 0;
    const deduped = lastMs && (nowMs - lastMs) < 30 * 60 * 1000;
    let paged = false, flushed = false;
    if (!deduped) {
      const iso = new Date(nowMs).toISOString();
      await admin.from('app_secrets').upsert({ key: 'cron_down_last_alert', value: iso }, { onConflict: 'key' });
      const secret = await sec('inbound_secret');
      const detail = 'SCHEDULER DOWN: no pg_cron job has run in ' + (ageMin ?? 'an unknown number of') + ' minutes. All scheduled automation (email, invites, matching follow-ups, autonomy sweep, daily brief) is stalled until the scheduler is restored. This alert reached you via the external watchdog.';
      // Page directly over HTTP (independent of pg_cron/pg_net). WhatsApp sends immediately inside alert_founder.
      try {
        const r = await fetch(FN + '/alert_founder', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: secret, event: 'SCHEDULER DOWN — automation stalled', level: 'critical', dedupe_key: 'cron_down', detail }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(20000) });
        paged = r.ok;
      } catch (_e) { /* fall through */ }
      // Force-flush the outbox so the alert email escapes even though pg_cron can't drain it.
      try {
        await fetch(FN + '/send_outbox', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: secret, limit: 20 }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(20000) });
        flushed = true;
      } catch (_e) { /* best effort */ }
    }
    return J({ ok: true, healthy: false, newest_run_age_min: ageMin, paged, flushed, deduped });
  } catch (e) { return J({ ok: false, error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 200); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/retention_purge/index.ts

```typescript
// retention_purge — data-minimisation job. Deletes transient customer drawing files
// (originals + redacted copies) for inquiries that concluded more than N months ago,
// then nulls their DB paths. Keeps supplier quote files (needed post-reveal) and KYC
// docs (handled by pdpl_erase). Internal only: __secret gated. Meant to run weekly.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'retention_purge', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
}
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const expectedSecret = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(expectedSecret) || body.__secret !== expectedSecret) {
      await logRun('error', { forbidden: 1, secret_configured: expectedSecret ? 1 : 0 }, expectedSecret ? 'Retention purge rejected a caller with a wrong __secret; no PDPL data-minimisation purge ran on this invocation. If this is the weekly cron, its secret is stale and expired drawing files are being retained indefinitely.' : 'Retention purge could not read inbound_secret from app_secrets, so every call including the weekly cron is rejected with 403. No customer drawing files are being purged and records past their retention window remain stored.');
      return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    }
    const months = Math.max(1, Math.min(60, Number(body.months) || 6));
    const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - months * 30 * 864e5).toISOString();
    const { data: inqs, error: inqsErr } = await admin.from('inquiries')
      .select('id,drawing_file_path,drawing_redacted_paths,status,completed_at,created_at')
      .in('status', ['completed', 'closed', 'cancelled'])
      .lt('created_at', cutoff)
      .limit(500);
    if (inqsErr) {
      await logRun('error', { months, inquiries_scanned: 0 }, 'Retention purge could not read the inquiries table, so nothing was scanned or deleted. Customer drawing files past the ' + months + '-month retention window remain stored. DB error: ' + String(inqsErr.message || inqsErr));
    }
    let filesRemoved = 0, rowsCleared = 0;
    const paths: string[] = []; const ids: string[] = [];
    for (const i of inqs || []) {
      const has = i.drawing_file_path || (Array.isArray(i.drawing_redacted_paths) && i.drawing_redacted_paths.length);
      if (!has) continue;
      if (i.completed_at && new Date(i.completed_at).toISOString() >= cutoff) continue;
      if (i.drawing_file_path) paths.push(String(i.drawing_file_path));
      if (Array.isArray(i.drawing_redacted_paths)) for (const p of i.drawing_redacted_paths) if (p) paths.push(String(p));
      ids.push(String(i.id));
    }
    let storageNote = '';
    if (paths.length) { const uniq = [...new Set(paths)]; try { const { error } = await admin.storage.from('drawing-files').remove(uniq); if (!error) filesRemoved = uniq.length; else storageNote = 'Storage delete failed for ' + uniq.length + ' drawing files in bucket drawing-files, so those customer files still exist in storage even though the job reported success: ' + String(error.message || error) + '. '; } catch (_e) { storageNote = 'Storage delete threw for ' + uniq.length + ' drawing files in bucket drawing-files, so those customer files still exist in storage even though the job reported success: ' + String((_e as Error)?.message || _e) + '. '; } }
    let updateNote = '';
    if (ids.length) { const { error } = await admin.from('inquiries').update({ drawing_file_path: null, drawing_redacted_paths: null }).in('id', ids); if (!error) rowsCleared = ids.length; else updateNote = 'Clearing drawing_file_path/drawing_redacted_paths failed for ' + ids.length + ' inquiries, so the database still points at purged files and the same rows will be re-processed every week: ' + String(error.message || error) + '. '; }
    const counts = { months, inquiries_scanned: (inqs || []).length, files_targeted: [...new Set(paths)].length, files_removed: filesRemoved, rows_targeted: ids.length, rows_cleared: rowsCleared };
    if (storageNote || updateNote) await logRun('error', counts, storageNote + updateNote);
    else if (!inqsErr) await logRun('ok', counts, '');
    return J({ ok: true, months, cutoff, inquiries_scanned: (inqs || []).length, files_removed: filesRemoved, rows_cleared: rowsCleared });
  } catch (e) { await logRun('error', {}, 'Retention purge crashed before completing, so the PDPL data-minimisation sweep did not run and expired customer drawing files remain stored: ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e)); return J({ ok: false, error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/reveal_invoice/index.ts

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const URL_ = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
async function secret(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
function esc(s: string) { return String(s || '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;'); }
function money(n: number) { return 'AED ' + Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('en-AE', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }); }
async function signedDoc(bucket: string, path: string) { try { const { data } = await admin.storage.from(bucket || 'agent-docs').createSignedUrl(path, 7 * 24 * 3600); return data?.signedUrl || null; } catch { return null; } }

// Observability: log failures and completions to agent_runs. Unauthenticated callers are not
// logged (normal browser traffic, would drown the signal); ownership violations are.
function mkLog(t0: number) {
  return async (status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) => {
    try {
      await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'reveal_invoice', status, counts,
        note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
        started_at: new Date(t0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
    } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break invoice delivery */ }
  };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  const logRun = mkLog(Date.now());
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
    const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
    if (!user || !user.email) return J({ error: 'Not signed in' }, 401);
    const { data: cust } = await admin.from('customers').select('id,email,full_name').eq('email', user.email.toLowerCase()).maybeSingle();
    if (!cust) { await logRun('error', {}, 'no_customer_profile for authenticated user'); return J({ error: 'No customer profile' }, 403); }
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const qid = String(body.quote_id || '');
    const { data: tx } = await admin.from('transactions').select('id,quote_id,inquiry_id,reveal_fee,payment_ref,revealed_at,customer_id').eq('quote_id', qid).maybeSingle();
    if (!tx) { await logRun('error', { quote_id: qid }, 'no paid reveal found for quote - customer cannot get an invoice'); return J({ error: 'No paid reveal found for this quote' }, 404); }
    if (tx.customer_id !== cust.id) { await logRun('error', { quote_id: qid, transaction_id: tx.id }, 'ownership violation: customer requested another customer transaction'); return J({ error: 'Not your transaction' }, 403); }
    const { data: cached } = await admin.from('reveal_invoices').select('bucket,path,invoice_no').eq('transaction_id', tx.id).maybeSingle();
    if (cached?.path) { const url = await signedDoc(cached.bucket, cached.path); if (url) { await logRun('ok', { quote_id: qid, cached: true, invoice_no: cached.invoice_no }, ''); return J({ ok: true, url, invoice_no: cached.invoice_no, cached: true }); } }
    const { data: inq } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('summary,category,emirate').eq('id', tx.inquiry_id).maybeSingle();
    const trn = await secret('company_trn');
    const isTax = !!trn;
    const fee = Number(tx.reveal_fee || 0);
    let subtotal = fee, vat = 0, total = fee;
    if (isTax) { total = fee; subtotal = Math.round((fee / 1.05) * 100) / 100; vat = Math.round((total - subtotal) * 100) / 100; }
    const invNo = 'QD-INV-' + String(tx.id).replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 8).toUpperCase();
    const inqRef = 'QD-' + String(tx.inquiry_id || '').replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 8).toUpperCase();
    const dateStr = new Date(tx.revealed_at || Date.now()).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
    const billTo = esc(cust.full_name ? (cust.full_name + ' (' + cust.email + ')') : cust.email);
    const desc = 'Supplier contact reveal fee — ' + esc(inq?.summary || (inq?.category || 'service request')) + ' (Ref ' + inqRef + ')';
    const title = isTax ? 'Tax Invoice' : 'Payment Receipt';
    const rows = [
      '<tr><th>Invoice No.</th><td>' + invNo + '</td><th>Date</th><td>' + dateStr + '</td></tr>',
      '<tr><th>Billed to</th><td>' + billTo + '</td><th>Payment method</th><td>Card (Stripe)</td></tr>',
      '<tr><th>Payment reference</th><td>' + esc(String(tx.payment_ref || '')) + '</td><th>Status</th><td>Paid</td></tr>'
    ].join('');
    const totalsRows = [
      '<tr><th>Subtotal</th><td>' + money(subtotal) + '</td></tr>',
      isTax ? ('<tr><th>VAT (5%)</th><td>' + money(vat) + '</td></tr>') : '',
      '<tr><th>Total paid</th><td><b>' + money(total) + '</b></td></tr>'
    ].join('');
    const note = isTax
      ? ('<p>Tax Registration Number (TRN): ' + esc(trn) + '. Amount shown is inclusive of 5% VAT.</p>')
      : ('<p>QuotesDone Technologies is not currently registered for VAT; no VAT has been charged on this amount.</p>');
    const body_html =
      '<table><tbody>' + rows + '</tbody></table>' +
      '<h2>Details</h2>' +
      '<table><thead><tr><th>Description</th><th style="text-align:right">Amount</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
      '<tr><td>' + desc + '</td><td style="text-align:right">' + money(subtotal) + '</td></tr>' +
      '</tbody></table>' +
      '<table style="width:55%;margin-left:auto"><tbody>' + totalsRows + '</tbody></table>' +
      note +
      '<p>This is the QuotesDone facilitation fee for revealing the selected supplier’s contact details. The amount payable to the supplier for the works is agreed separately and directly between the customer and the supplier.</p>';
    const inbound = await secret('inbound_secret');
    const pr = await fetch(URL_ + '/functions/v1/pdf_native', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: inbound, title, body_html, name: invNo, lang: 'en', options: { letterhead: true, sign: true, stamp: true } }) });
    const pj = await pr.json();
    if (!pj?.ok || !pj.path) { await logRun('error', { quote_id: qid, invoice_no: invNo }, 'pdf_native failed: ' + String(pj?.error || pj?.detail || '').slice(0, 200)); return J({ error: 'pdf_failed', detail: pj?.error || pj?.detail || '' }, 502); }
    const bucket = pj.bucket || 'agent-docs';
    try { await admin.from('reveal_invoices').upsert({ transaction_id: tx.id, invoice_no: invNo, bucket, path: pj.path, created_at: new Date().toISOString() }, { onConflict: 'transaction_id' }); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    const url = pj.url || await signedDoc(bucket, pj.path);
    await logRun('ok', { quote_id: qid, invoice_no: invNo, cached: false, is_tax_invoice: isTax }, '');
    return J({ ok: true, url, invoice_no: invNo });
  } catch (e) { const m = String((e as Error)?.message || e); await logRun('error', {}, 'exception: ' + m); return J({ error: m }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
// rfq_flag — lets an approved supplier flag that an RFQ's scope is unclear.
// Records a founder escalation (agent_actions) and notifies the customer so they
// can add detail (self-correcting a weak Smart Engine brief). Supplier-JWT auth.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
    const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
    if (!user || !user.email) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
    const email = user.email.toLowerCase();
    const { data: sup } = await admin.from('leads').select('id,company_name').eq('claimed_by', email).maybeSingle();
    if (!sup) return J({ error: 'claim your company first' }, 400);
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const inquiryId = String(body.inquiry_id || '');
    const note = String(body.note || '').slice(0, 500);
    if (!inquiryId) return J({ error: 'inquiry_id required' }, 400);
    // must be a real match for this supplier
    const { data: match } = await admin.from('inquiry_matches').select('id').eq('inquiry_id', inquiryId).eq('supplier_id', sup.id).maybeSingle();
    if (!match) return J({ error: 'not matched to this request' }, 403);
    const { data: inq } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('id,customer_id,category,summary').eq('id', inquiryId).maybeSingle();
    if (!inq) return J({ error: 'request not found' }, 404);

    if (!dupe) {
      await admin.from('agent_actions').insert({ agent: 'intake', kind: 'rfq_clarification', status: 'pending', risk: 'medium', title: 'Scope unclear flagged on RFQ ' + inquiryId.slice(0, 8), recommendation: 'A supplier flagged this brief as unclear' + (note ? ': ' + note : '') + '. Review the brief and, if needed, ask the customer to clarify.', detail: { supplier_id: sup.id, supplier: sup.company_name, note, category: inq.category, summary: inq.summary }, target_table: 'inquiries', target_id: inquiryId });
    }
    // notify the customer to add detail
    try { const { data: c } = await admin.from('customers').select('email,full_name').eq('id', inq.customer_id).maybeSingle(); if (c?.email && /@/.test(c.email)) { await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type: 'clarification_requested', to_email: c.email, to_role: 'customer', inquiry_id: inquiryId, channel: 'email', status: 'queued', subject: 'A supplier needs a quick clarification on your request', body: 'Hi ' + (c.full_name || 'there') + ',\n\nA supplier reviewing your request' + (inq.summary ? ' “' + inq.summary + '”' : '') + ' asked for a small clarification so they can quote accurately. Please open your request on QuotesDone and add any missing detail (scope, quantities, location or timeline).\n\nThis helps you get sharper, comparable quotes. Thank you!' }); } } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    return J({ ok: true, flagged: true });
  } catch (e) { return J({ ok: false, error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
```
