### supabase/functions/role_guard/index.ts

```typescript
// role_guard v2 - one identity per role. Tells the client if an email/phone already belongs to the
// OTHER role, before any OTP code is sent.
//
// SECURITY HARDENING 19 Jul 2026 ---------------------------------------------------------------
// This endpoint is unauthenticated BY DESIGN and must stay that way: it runs before an OTP is
// sent, when the person has no account and there is nobody to authenticate. A secret gate would
// break the sign-up flow. But v1 was a free membership oracle - anyone could POST any email or
// phone number and learn whether it was registered on QuotesDone, which:
//   - lets a scraped mailing list be validated against our user base,
//   - tells a phisher which UAE companies are our suppliers ("we know you supply via QuotesDone"),
//   - is a personal-data disclosure under PDPL with no consent and no logging.
//
// Two changes, neither of which touches the sign-up UX:
//
// 1. STOP OVER-ANSWERING. v1 returned `belongsTo` ('supplier' | 'customer' | 'both' | null) on
//    every call - a direct membership answer. The front end never used it: CustomerPortal.tsx and
//    SupplierPortal.tsx read ONLY `conflict`. So `belongsTo` was disclosure for nothing and is now
//    removed. `conflict` is still returned because the flow genuinely needs it, but it is non-null
//    only in the true cross-role case, which is the minimum needed to show the message.
//
// 2. RATE LIMIT. Bulk validation of a list is the actual threat, not a single lookup. Capped per
//    identifier and per caller IP via the existing rl_check RPC. A blocked caller gets a neutral
//    response, never a different answer, so the limiter cannot itself be used as an oracle.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type, apikey', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
function emailOk(e: string) { return /^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(String(e || '')); }
function toE164(p: string): string { let d = String(p || '').replace(/[^\d+]/g, ''); if (d.startsWith('+')) { const n = d.slice(1).replace(/\D/g, ''); return n.length >= 8 ? '+' + n : ''; } d = d.replace(/\D/g, ''); if (d.startsWith('00')) d = d.slice(2); if (d.startsWith('971')) return '+' + d; if (d.startsWith('0')) return '+971' + d.slice(1); if (d.length === 9 && d.startsWith('5')) return '+971' + d; if (d.length >= 8) return '+' + d; return ''; }
const T0 = Date.now();

async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'role_guard', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break sign-up */ }
}

async function rl(key: string, limit: number, seconds: number): Promise<boolean> {
  try { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('rl_check', { p_key: key, p_limit: limit, p_seconds: seconds }); if (error) return true; return data !== false; }
  catch (_e) { return true; } // limiter unavailable must not block genuine sign-ups
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const b = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const kind = b.user_kind === 'supplier' ? 'supplier' : 'customer';
    const idRaw = String(b.identifier || '').trim();
    if (!idRaw) return J({ ok: true, kind, conflict: null });

    const ip = (req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') || '').split(',')[0].trim() || 'unknown';
    // Per-IP cap is the anti-list-validation control; per-identifier cap stops hammering one target.
    const ipOk = await rl('role_guard_ip:' + ip, 40, 3600);
    const idOk = await rl('role_guard_id:' + idRaw.toLowerCase(), 10, 3600);
    if (!ipOk || !idOk) {
      await logRun('error', { rate_limited: 1, scope: !ipOk ? 'ip' : 'identifier' },
        'role_guard rate-limited a caller (' + (!ipOk ? 'per-IP cap' : 'per-identifier cap') + '). This endpoint is deliberately public for pre-OTP sign-up, so the cap is what stops it being used to validate a scraped email or phone list against our user base. A genuine person signing up never approaches this rate; sustained hits are worth investigating.');
      // Neutral answer - identical to "no conflict" so the limiter cannot be probed as an oracle.
      return J({ ok: true, kind, conflict: null });
    }

    let isSup = false, isCust = false;
    if (emailOk(idRaw)) {
      const email = idRaw.toLowerCase();
      const { data: s } = await admin.from('leads').select('id').eq('claimed_by', email).limit(1);
      const { data: c } = await admin.from('customers').select('id').eq('email', email).limit(1);
      isSup = !!(s && s.length); isCust = !!(c && c.length);
    } else {
      const e164 = toE164(idRaw); if (e164) { const last9 = e164.slice(-9);
        const { data: s } = await admin.from('leads').select('id').not('claimed_by', 'is', null).ilike('phone', '%' + last9).limit(1);
        const { data: c } = await admin.from('customers').select('id').ilike('phone', '%' + last9).limit(1);
        isSup = !!(s && s.length); isCust = !!(c && c.length);
      }
    }

    // Only the cross-role conflict is disclosed. `belongsTo` is deliberately NOT returned - see header.
    const conflict = (kind === 'customer' && isSup && !isCust) ? 'supplier' : ((kind === 'supplier' && isCust && !isSup) ? 'customer' : null);
    return J({ ok: true, kind, conflict });
  } catch (e) {
    await logRun('error', { unhandled_exception: 1 }, 'role_guard threw an unhandled exception: ' + String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0, 200) + ' - the sign-up flow could not check for a cross-role conflict, so a person may be allowed to register in both roles.');
    return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500);
  }
});
```

### supabase/functions/route_inquiry/index.ts

````typescript
// route_inquiry - HYBRID RETRIEVAL (vector gte-small + keyword) narrows the whole supplier base to the most
// relevant approved candidates, then an LLM adjudicates who can GENUINELY quote the exact job. Safe
// fallback to a plain approved-pull if retrieval fails.
// COST: Sonnet 5 first (Opus 4.8 only as fallback) + prompt caching on the system prompt.
// Completeness gate: an essentially-empty brief is not dispatched to suppliers (returns needs_detail).
//
// v9 STRUCTURED CAPABILITY MATCHING (decision_policy.use_capability_matching):
//   OFF (default) - behaviour is byte-for-byte the legacy path below. Nothing changes.
//   ON            - the inquiry is normalised into the controlled vocabulary (inquiry_parse), then
//                   fn_match_capability applies HARD GATES (trade intersection, role capability,
//                   declared exclusions, mandatory authority approvals, value band, supplier-confirmed
//                   scope) and a structured score. Only candidates at or above match_relevance_floor
//                   reach the LLM adjudicator, which still has the final say.
//   Zero gated candidates is a GENUINE coverage gap and is reported as such - we do NOT silently fall
//   back to keyword retrieval, because that is exactly how irrelevant inquiries reach suppliers.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'route_inquiry', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
}
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
const MODELS = ['anthropic/claude-sonnet-5', 'anthropic/claude-opus-4.8'];
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 28 Jul 2026 (missed by the 27 Jul sweep): sec() returns undefined/'' when the
// app_secrets read fails or the row is missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller
// posting {} matched and gained full service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The
// stored secret must now be a real value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
async function policyRaw(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('decision_policy').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data as any)?.value; }
async function policyBool(k: string){ const v = await policyRaw(k); return v === true || String(v) === 'true'; }
async function policyNum(k: string, dflt: number){ const n = Number(await policyRaw(k)); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : dflt; }
// Same shape as policyBool but ON unless explicitly switched off, so the taxonomy pre-filter below
// is live by default and can still be killed from decision_policy without a redeploy.
async function policyOn(k: string){ const v = await policyRaw(k); return !(v === false || String(v).toLowerCase() === 'false'); }
function parseJson(t: string){ let s=String(t||'').trim(); const f=s.match(/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i); if(f) s=f[1].trim(); try { return JSON.parse(s); } catch { const m = s.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (m) { try { return JSON.parse(m[0]); } catch { /* */ } } return null; } }
function clip(s: unknown, n: number){ return String(s == null ? '' : s).slice(0, n); }

const SYS = `You are QuotesDone's expert job-routing dispatcher for the UAE building, fit-out, MEP and home-services market. A customer posted a job. You are given candidate suppliers with their REAL capabilities (from their own company profile / catalogue). Your task: decide which suppliers — if any — can GENUINELY fulfil and price this exact job. You protect suppliers from irrelevant inquiries, so a wrong match is worse than no match.

HARD RULES:
1. Judge by the supplier's ACTUAL scope of work, not by superficial word overlap. Example: a fire-pump manufacturer must NOT receive a "steel pipe fitting" or "plumbing" job just because the words 'steel'/'pipe' appear in their catalogue. A supplier of laptops must not get a 'kitchen cabinet' job, etc.
2. Classify the job as SINGLE-TRADE or MULTI-TRADE. Multi-trade = it spans several different trades/materials or is a combined/turnkey scope (e.g. 'new flooring + redo the washroom + some decoration', a full apartment renovation, a complete fit-out). For a MULTI-TRADE job, route to ONE supplier who can handle the whole scope — a fit-out / turnkey / interior-decoration / general-contracting company. Do NOT split a combined job across several single-trade suppliers.
3. For a SINGLE simple item, route to the one correct trade, judged by material and scope. (A wooden table → carpentry/joinery or fit-out. A steel + acrylic display stand → acrylic/fabrication or fit-out. A fire pump → a fire-fighting/fire-pump supplier only.)
4. Only mark a supplier 'fit' if you are genuinely confident they can quote this specific job. If unsure, mark 'no'. It is correct to return ZERO fits if none of the candidates truly match.
5. Prefer the most specialised genuine match. Avoid returning long lists; return only the suppliers that should actually receive the inquiry (typically 1-4).

Return STRICT JSON only:
{"job_type":"single"|"multi","primary_trade":string,"reasoning":string,"matches":[{"id":number,"verdict":"fit"|"no","reason":string}]}
Include every candidate id you were given in matches, each with a verdict. reasoning = 1-2 sentences on the routing decision.`;

const SUP_COLS = 'id,company_name,sector,emirate,service_emirates,products,services,capability_summary,rating';
function approvedFilter(q: any) { return q.or('registration_submitted_at.not.is.null,source.eq.self_registered').eq('approval_status', 'approved').eq('banned', false).eq('matching_blocked', false); }
function usable(c: any) { return c && (c.capability_summary || c.products || c.services); }

async function embed(text: string): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    // deno-lint-ignore no-explicit-any
    const model = new (globalThis as any).Supabase.ai.Session('gte-small');
    const emb = await model.run(text.slice(0, 1500), { mean_pool: true, normalize: true }) as number[];
    if (Array.isArray(emb) && emb.length) return '[' + emb.join(',') + ']';
  } catch (_e) { /* */ }
  return null;
}

async function retrieve(jobText: string, inq: any, emirate: string, diag: any = {}): Promise<number[]> {
  const order: number[] = []; const seen = new Set<number>();
  const push = (id: any) => { const n = Number(id); if (n && !seen.has(n)) { seen.add(n); order.push(n); } };
  try {
    const vec = await embed(jobText);
    diag.embed_ok = vec ? 1 : 0;
    if (vec) { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('match_suppliers', { query_embedding: vec, match_count: 60, p_emirate: emirate || null, p_role: null, p_product: null, p_min_rating: 0 }); if (error) diag.vector_rpc_error = clip(error.message, 160); diag.vector_hits = (data || []).length; for (const r of (data || [])) push((r as any).id); }
  } catch (_e) { diag.vector_exception = clip((_e as Error)?.message || _e, 160); }
  try {
    const kw = Array.isArray(inq.trades) ? inq.trades.map((t: any) => String(t)).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 16) : [];
    const multi = inq.scope_type === 'multi' || inq.scope_type === 'turnkey';
    const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('match_suppliers_kw', { p_keywords: kw.length ? kw : [String(inq.category || '')], p_category: inq.category || null, p_emirate: emirate || null, p_role: null, p_min_rating: 0, p_limit: 40, p_multi: multi });
    if (error) diag.kw_rpc_error = clip(error.message, 160); diag.kw_hits = (data || []).length;
    for (const r of (data || [])) push((r as any).id);
  } catch (_e) { diag.kw_exception = clip((_e as Error)?.message || _e, 160); }
  return order;
}

// TAXONOMY PRE-FILTER 28 Jul 2026 (decision_policy.use_taxonomy_prefilter, default ON).
// The canonical catalogue (catalog_domains -> catalog_subcategories) is bridged onto the trade agents
// that actually hold category knowledge by subcategory_agent_map (sub_slug -> agent_slug), and 16309
// of the 16394 suppliers classified in lead_subcategory (99.5%) reach an agent that exists. Routing
// referenced none of it, so the adjudicator paid for up to 60-80 blurbs that the taxonomy already
// knew were the wrong trade. This resolves the inquiry's DECLARED trade signal to a set of canonical
// subcategories and reports which of the already-retrieved candidates are classified into them.
// It is a narrowing/reordering pass over the ids hybrid retrieval returned: it never adds a
// candidate, never touches the approved-supplier filter, the fallback, or the adjudicator, and it
// leaves `ids` exactly as retrieved whenever the taxonomy resolves nothing or overlaps nothing.
// The free-form summary is deliberately NOT used as input - a wrong trade guess here would narrow
// the pool towards the wrong suppliers, which is the failure mode the whole function exists to avoid.
const _norm = (s: unknown) => String(s ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
function tradeTokens(v: unknown): string[] {
  const n = _norm(v); if (!n) return [];
  return [n, n.replace(/[\s/]+/g, '-').replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/g, ''), n.replace(/[\s-]+/g, '_')].filter(Boolean);
}
async function taxonomyPrefilter(ids: number[], inq: any, inquiryId: string, diag: any): Promise<Set<number>> {
  const hit = new Set<number>();
  try {
    const tokens = new Set<string>();
    for (const t of tradeTokens(inq.category)) tokens.add(t);
    if (Array.isArray(inq.trades)) for (const t of inq.trades.slice(0, 16)) for (const x of tradeTokens(t)) tokens.add(x);
    if (inquiryId) {
      // READ ONLY. inquiry_parse is never invoked from here - that LLM call belongs to the v9
      // capability gate; this pre-filter must stay cheap enough to be unconditional.
      const { data: rq } = await admin.from('inquiry_requirement').select('trades_required').eq('inquiry_id', inquiryId).maybeSingle();
      if (rq && Array.isArray((rq as any).trades_required)) for (const t of (rq as any).trades_required) for (const x of tradeTokens(t)) tokens.add(x);
    }
    if (!tokens.size) { diag.tax_prefilter = 'no_trade_signal'; return hit; }
    // taxonomy_trade (25 rows) and lead_trade_map (24 rows) are the controlled vocabulary and its
    // agent bridge - both tiny, so they are pulled whole and matched in memory.
    const [tradesRes, mapRes] = await Promise.all([
      admin.from('taxonomy_trade').select('code,aliases'),
      admin.from('lead_trade_map').select('trade_key,catalog_slug,confidence'),
    ]);
    if (tradesRes.error || mapRes.error) { diag.tax_error = clip(tradesRes.error?.message || mapRes.error?.message, 160); return hit; }
    const codes = new Set<string>();
    for (const t of (tradesRes.data || [])) {
      const code = _norm((t as any).code); if (!code) continue;
      if (tokens.has(code)) { codes.add(code); continue; }
      for (const a of ((t as any).aliases || [])) if (tokens.has(_norm(a))) { codes.add(code); break; }
    }
    // ONLY high-confidence trade->agent rows may narrow anything. The medium/low ones are explicit
    // best-effort fudges for trades that have no agent of their own - lead_trade_map sends
    // 'landscaping' to facilities-management-companies, whose subcategories are laundry, pest control
    // and mailroom services. Narrowing a swimming-pool RFQ towards those would be worse than not
    // using the taxonomy at all, so an inquiry that only resolves through a weak row resolves to
    // nothing here and takes the untouched legacy path.
    const agents = new Set<string>();
    for (const r of (mapRes.data || [])) { const a = (r as any).catalog_slug; if (a && _norm((r as any).confidence) === 'high' && codes.has(_norm((r as any).trade_key))) agents.add(String(a)); }
    // A category that is already an agent slug (e.g. 'electrical-suppliers') maps straight through;
    // tokens that are not agent slugs simply match nothing in the bridge.
    for (const t of tokens) agents.add(t);
    const { data: sam, error: samErr } = await admin.from('subcategory_agent_map').select('sub_slug,confidence').in('agent_slug', [...agents].slice(0, 120));
    if (samErr) { diag.tax_error = clip(samErr.message, 160); return hit; }
    // Same reasoning one level down: the 'low' bridge rows are the ones whose own note says the trade
    // has no agent and it was parked on the nearest neighbour. They must not pull candidates in.
    const subs = [...new Set((sam || []).filter((r: any) => _norm(r.confidence) !== 'low').map((r: any) => String(r.sub_slug)).filter(Boolean))];
    diag.tax_trades = [...codes].join('+') || null;
    diag.tax_subcats = subs.length;
    if (!subs.length) { diag.tax_prefilter = 'no_taxonomy_match'; return hit; }
    // Bounded by the ids retrieval already produced, so this is an indexed lookup of at most ~80
    // rows - never a scan of the 25k-row classification table.
    const { data: cls, error: clsErr } = await admin.from('lead_subcategory').select('lead_id').in('sub_slug', subs.slice(0, 200)).in('lead_id', ids);
    if (clsErr) { diag.tax_error = clip(clsErr.message, 160); return hit; }
    for (const r of (cls || [])) { const n = Number((r as any).lead_id); if (n) hit.add(n); }
  } catch (e) { diag.tax_exception = clip((e as Error)?.message || e, 160); }
  return hit;
}

// v9: structured capability retrieval. Returns null when the feature is off or unusable, so the
// caller falls through to the untouched legacy path.
async function capabilityRetrieve(inquiryId: string, secret: string, diag: any): Promise<any[] | null> {
  try {
    let { data: reqRow } = await admin.from('inquiry_requirement').select('*').eq('inquiry_id', inquiryId).maybeSingle();
    if (!reqRow) {
      try {
        await fetch('https://htdblwldjkcgjvmqkbeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/inquiry_parse', {
          method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: secret, inquiry_id: inquiryId }) });
        ({ data: reqRow } = await admin.from('inquiry_requirement').select('*').eq('inquiry_id', inquiryId).maybeSingle());
      } catch (e) { diag.cap_parse_error = clip((e as Error)?.message || e, 160); }
    }
    if (!reqRow || !Array.isArray(reqRow.trades_required) || !reqRow.trades_required.length) {
      diag.cap_no_requirement = 1; return null;
    }
    diag.cap_trades = reqRow.trades_required.join('+');
    diag.cap_need = reqRow.role_required || 'executes';
    const { data: rows, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_match_capability', {
      p_trades: reqRow.trades_required,
      p_need: reqRow.role_required || 'executes',
      p_products: reqRow.products_norm || [],
      p_brands: reqRow.brands_specified || [],
      p_project_type: reqRow.project_type,
      p_value: reqRow.value_band,
      p_emirate: reqRow.emirate,
      p_limit: 12,
    });
    if (error) { diag.cap_rpc_error = clip(error.message, 160); return null; }
    const floor = await policyNum('match_relevance_floor', 35);
    const all = rows || [];
    const kept = all.filter((r: any) => Number(r.score) >= floor);
    diag.cap_gated = all.length; diag.cap_above_floor = kept.length; diag.cap_floor = floor;
    return kept;
  } catch (e) { diag.cap_exception = clip((e as Error)?.message || e, 160); return null; }
}

});

Use op=set whenever the founder expresses a goal rather than a single command.', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { op: { type: 'string', enum: ['set', 'status', 'scorecard'] }, objective: { type: 'string' }, objective_id: { type: 'number' } }, required: ['op'] } } },

NEVER answer "I do not know" about company state without querying this first.', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { topic: { type: 'string' }, args: { type: 'object' } }, required: ['topic'] } } },

Instagram needs an image (a default is attached).', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { channel: { type: 'string' }, text: { type: 'string' }, draft_id: { type: 'string' }, to: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } }, type: { type: 'string', enum: ['draft', 'schedule', 'now'] }, when: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['channel'] } } },

For subscription give next_due (YYYY-MM-DD) and cycle (monthly|annual).', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { kind: { type: 'string', enum: ['expense', 'income', 'subscription'] }, vendor: { type: 'string' }, description: { type: 'string' }, amount: { type: 'number' }, currency: { type: 'string' }, category: { type: 'string' }, next_due: { type: 'string' }, cycle: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['kind', 'amount'] } } },

async function cnt(t: string, mod?: (q: any) => any) { let q = admin.from(t).select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }); if (mod) q = mod(q); const { count } = await q; return count || 0; }
async function tool_get_status() {
  const supBase = (q: any) => q.or('claimed.eq.true,source.eq.self_registered,source.eq.email_inbound');
  const [pending_suppliers, refunds_requested, held_emails, queued_sms, inq24, q24, rev24, open_tasks] = await Promise.all([
    cnt('leads', (q) => supBase(q).in('approval_status', ['pending', 'submitted'])),
    cnt('transactions', (q) => q.eq('refund_status', 'requested')),
    cnt('notifications', (q) => q.eq('channel', 'email').eq('status', 'held')),
    cnt('notifications', (q) => q.eq('channel', 'sms').eq('status', 'queued')),
    cnt('inquiries', (q) => q.gte('created_at', dayAgo(1))),
    cnt('quotes', (q) => q.gte('created_at', dayAgo(1))),
    cnt('transactions', (q) => q.gte('revealed_at', dayAgo(1))),
    cnt('crm_tasks', (q) => q.eq('status', 'open')),
  ]);
  const { data: paid } = await admin.from('transactions').select('reveal_fee').eq('fee_status', 'paid');
  const revenue = Math.round((paid || []).reduce((a, t) => a + (Number(t.reveal_fee) || 0), 0));
  return { pending_suppliers, refunds_requested, stuck_test_emails: held_emails, stuck_test_sms: queued_sms, inquiries_24h: inq24, quotes_24h: q24, reveals_24h: rev24, open_tasks, revenue_collected_aed: revenue };
}
async function tool_objective(op: string, a: any) {
  if (op === 'scorecard') { const { data } = await admin.rpc('fn_org_scorecard'); return { departments: data ?? [] }; }
  if (op === 'set') { const objective = String(a.objective || '').trim(); if (!objective) return { error: 'need an objective' }; return await callFn('intent_router', { objective }); }
  if (op === 'status') {
    if (a.objective_id) return await callFn('intent_router', { action: 'status', objective_id: Number(a.objective_id) });
    const { data } = await admin.from('org_objectives').select('id,objective,status,created_at').in('status', ['open', 'in_progress', 'blocked']).order('id', { ascending: false }).limit(15);
    return { open_objectives: data ?? [] };
  }
  return { error: 'unknown op' };
}
async function tool_query_platform(topic: string, args: any) { const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_query_platform', { p_topic: String(topic || ''), p_args: (args && typeof args === 'object') ? args : {} }); if (error) return { error: error.message }; return data ?? {}; }
async function tool_ask_agent(agent: string, question: string) {
  const ag = String(agent || '').toLowerCase().trim(); const q = String(question || '').trim().slice(0, 2000);
  if (!ag || !q) return { error: 'need agent and question' };
  try { const sk = await sec('inbound_secret'); const r = await fetch(FN + '/agent_brain', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ __secret: sk, agent: ag, message: q }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(45000) }); const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({} as any)); if (j?.reply) return { agent: ag, reply: String(j.reply).slice(0, 4000) }; return { error: j?.error || 'no_reply', agent: ag }; } catch (e) { return { error: String((e as Error)?.message || e), agent: ag }; }
}
async function tool_lookup(entity: string, query: string) {
  const q = String(query || '').replace(/[%,()*]/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 80);
  if (entity === 'supplier') { const { data } = await admin.from('leads').select('id,company_name,email,emirate,approval_status,banned,rv_response_rate').or(`company_name.ilike.*${q}*,email.ilike.*${q}*`).limit(5); return data || []; }
  if (entity === 'customer') { const { data } = await admin.from('customers').select('id,full_name,email,phone,banned').or(`full_name.ilike.*${q}*,email.ilike.*${q}*,phone.ilike.*${q}*`).limit(5); return data || []; }
  if (entity === 'inquiry') { let r: any; if (/^[0-9a-f-]{6,}$/i.test(q)) r = await admin.from('inquiries').select('id,category,emirate,summary,status,created_at').eq('id', q).limit(5); else r = await admin.from('inquiries').select('id,category,emirate,summary,status,created_at').or(`summary.ilike.*${q}*,category.ilike.*${q}*`).limit(5); return r.data || []; }
  if (entity === 'transaction') { const { data } = await admin.from('transactions').select('id,inquiry_id,supplier_id,customer_id,reveal_fee,fee_status,refund_status,revealed_at').eq('id', q).limit(5); return data || []; }
  return [];
}
async function tool_run_maintenance(target: string) {
  if (target === 'health') return await admin.rpc('run_health_check').then((r) => r.data);
  if (target === 'smoke') { await admin.rpc('fn_smoke'); return { ran: 'smoke' }; }
  if (target === 'security') { await admin.rpc('fn_security_scan'); const { data } = await admin.from('agent_runs').select('counts').eq('agent', 'security').order('id', { ascending: false }).limit(1); return (data && data[0]?.counts) || { ran: 'security' }; }
  if (target === 'it_health') return await admin.rpc('run_agent', { p_job: 'it_health' }).then((r) => r.data).catch(() => ({ ran: 'it_health' }));
  if (target === 'recompute_response') { await admin.rpc('qd_recompute_response').catch(() => null); return { ran: 'recompute_response' }; }
  if (target === 'clear_test_queue') { const { data, error } = await admin.from('notifications').update({ status: 'cancelled' }).in('status', ['held', 'queued']).or('to_email.ilike.%.test,to_email.ilike.%@quotesdone.test,to_email.is.null').select('id'); if (error) return { error: error.message }; return { cancelled: (data || []).length }; }
  return { error: 'unknown target' };
}
async function llm(sys: string, user: string, max = 700) { const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key'); if (!key) return null; for (const model of ['anthropic/claude-sonnet-5', 'anthropic/claude-opus-4.8', 'openai/gpt-4o']) { try { const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + key, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ model, max_tokens: max, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: sys }, { role: 'user', content: user }] }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(25000) }); const j = await r.json(); const c = j?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content; if (c) return c; } catch (_e) {} } return null; }
async function tool_draft_content(channel: string, topic: string, notes: string) {
  let brain = ''; try { const { data } = await admin.rpc('fn_agent_context', { p_agent_key: 'marketing', p_max_chars: 6000 }); brain = data ? String(data) : ''; } catch (_e) {}
  const out = await llm('You write concise, on-brand content for QuotesDone, a UAE B2B anonymous quotation marketplace. Practical, trustworthy, pro-SME. No invented statistics.\n\n' + brain, 'Channel: ' + channel + '\nTopic: ' + topic + (notes ? ('\nNotes: ' + notes) : '') + '\nWrite the ' + channel + ' content now.', 900) || 'Draft unavailable (AI not reachable).';
  const { data } = await admin.from('content_drafts').insert({ channel: String(channel).slice(0, 20), title: String(topic).slice(0, 200), body: out.slice(0, 4000), status: 'draft', source: 'secretary' }).select('id').maybeSingle();
  return { draft_id: data?.id || null, preview: out.slice(0, 500) };
}
async function tool_add_task(title: string, detail: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('crm_tasks').insert({ title: String(title).slice(0, 200), detail: String(detail || '').slice(0, 2000), status: 'open', source: 'secretary' }).select('id').maybeSingle(); return { task_id: data?.id || null }; }
async function tool_send_email(to: string[], subject: string, body: string) { const rows = (to || []).filter(Boolean).map((addr) => ({ type: 'secretary_send', to_email: String(addr).slice(0, 160), to_role: 'external', channel: 'email', subject: String(subject).slice(0, 200), body: String(body).slice(0, 6000) })); if (!rows.length) return { error: 'no recipients' }; await admin.from('notifications').insert(rows); return { queued: rows.length }; }
async function tool_log_finance(a: any) { const r = await callFn('finance_ingest', { action: 'log', entry: { kind: a.kind, vendor: a.vendor || null, description: a.description || null, amount: a.amount, currency: a.currency || 'AED', category: a.category || null, next_due: a.next_due || null, cycle: a.cycle || null, source: 'secretary' } }); return r; }
async function tool_post_content(a: any) {
  let text = a.text || '';
  if (!text && a.draft_id) { const { data } = await admin.from('content_drafts').select('body').eq('id', a.draft_id).maybeSingle(); text = data?.body || ''; }
  if (!text) return { error: 'nothing to post' };
  const channel = String(a.channel || '');
  if (channel === 'email' || channel === 'whatsapp') { const to = Array.isArray(a.to) ? a.to : []; if (!to.length) return { error: 'need recipients for ' + channel }; await tool_send_email(to, a.subject || 'QuotesDone', text); if (a.draft_id) await admin.from('content_drafts').update({ status: 'posted' }).eq('id', a.draft_id); return { posted: channel, recipients: to.length }; }
  // Social publishing via the platform's Postiz connector. Default type='draft' (lands in Postiz for
  // final scheduling — safest); the founder can say 'now' or 'schedule' (with when) to go further.
  const social = ['social', 'linkedin', 'instagram', 'x', 'twitter', 'facebook'];
  if (social.includes(channel)) {
    const chans = channel === 'social' ? ['linkedin', 'x', 'facebook', 'instagram'] : [channel === 'twitter' ? 'x' : channel];
    const img = await sec('default_post_image');
    const type = ['now', 'schedule', 'draft'].includes(String(a.type)) ? String(a.type) : 'draft';
    const r = await callFn('postiz_publish', { action: 'post', text, title: a.subject || a.title, channels: chans, type, when: a.when, image: img ? [{ path: img }] : [] });
    if (a.draft_id && (r as any)?.ok) await admin.from('content_drafts').update({ status: type === 'now' ? 'posted' : 'staged' }).eq('id', a.draft_id);
    return r;
  }
  return { pending_channel: channel, note: channel + ' is not connected yet (needs its posting token). Saved as a draft.' };
}
async function tool_issue_refund(transaction_id: string, reason: string) { const { data: tx } = await admin.from('transactions').select('id,refund_status').eq('id', transaction_id).maybeSingle(); if (!tx) return { error: 'transaction_not_found' }; await admin.from('transactions').update({ refund_status: 'refunded', refund_note: String(reason || '').slice(0, 500), refund_resolved_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', transaction_id); const { data: due } = await admin.from('supplier_dues').select('amount_due,status').eq('transaction_id', transaction_id).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).maybeSingle(); return { refunded: transaction_id, supplier_charge: due || null }; }
async function tool_supplier_decision(supplier_id: string, action: string, reason: string) {
  const id = Number(supplier_id); const { data: l } = await admin.from('leads').select('id,company_name,claimed_by').eq('id', id).maybeSingle(); if (!l) return { error: 'supplier_not_found' };
  if (action === 'approve') { await admin.from('leads').update({ approval_status: 'approved', verified: true, lifecycle_stage: 'active', approved_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', id); if (l.claimed_by) await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type: 'registration_approved', to_email: l.claimed_by, to_role: 'supplier', lead_id: id, channel: 'email', subject: "You're verified on QuotesDone", body: 'Good news — ' + (l.company_name || 'your company') + ' has been approved on QuotesDone. You can now receive inquiries and quote: https://quotesdone.com/suppliers/' }); }
  else if (action === 'reject') { await admin.from('leads').update({ approval_status: 'rejected', verified: false, rejection_reason: String(reason || '').slice(0, 500) }).eq('id', id); }
  else if (action === 'ban') { await admin.from('leads').update({ banned: true, banned_reason: String(reason || 'admin action').slice(0, 300) }).eq('id', id); }
  else if (action === 'unban') { await admin.from('leads').update({ banned: false, banned_reason: null }).eq('id', id); }
  else return { error: 'bad action' };
  return { ok: true, supplier_id: id, action };
}
async function tool_delete_files(bucket: string, paths: string[], prefix: string) { const r = await callFn('asset_delete', prefix ? { bucket, prefix } : { bucket, paths }); return r; }

async function runTool(name: string, a: any) {
  try {
    if (name === 'get_status') return await tool_get_status();
    if (name === 'objective') return await tool_objective(a.op, a);
    if (name === 'query_platform') return await tool_query_platform(a.topic, a.args);
    if (name === 'ask_agent') return await tool_ask_agent(a.agent, a.question);
    if (name === 'team_roster') return await tool_team_roster();
    if (name === 'lookup') return await tool_lookup(a.entity, a.query);
    if (name === 'run_maintenance') return await tool_run_maintenance(a.target);
    if (name === 'draft_content') return await tool_draft_content(a.channel, a.topic, a.notes);
    if (name === 'add_task') return await tool_add_task(a.title, a.detail);
    if (name === 'send_email') return await tool_send_email(a.to, a.subject, a.body);
    if (name === 'log_finance') return await tool_log_finance(a);
    if (name === 'post_content') return await tool_post_content(a);
    if (name === 'issue_refund') return await tool_issue_refund(a.transaction_id, a.reason);
    if (name === 'supplier_decision') return await tool_supplier_decision(a.supplier_id, a.action, a.reason);
    if (name === 'delete_files') return await tool_delete_files(a.bucket, a.paths, a.prefix);
    return { error: 'unknown_tool' };
  } catch (e) { return { error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }; }
}
function isHigh(name: string, a: any) { if (HIGH.has(name)) return true; if (name === 'send_email' && Array.isArray(a?.to) && a.to.length > 3) return true; return false; }
function describe(name: string, a: any) {
  if (name === 'issue_refund') return 'Refund reveal fee for transaction ' + a.transaction_id + ' (this also charges the supplier the 3% non-response fee).';
  if (name === 'supplier_decision') return a.action + ' supplier #' + a.supplier_id + (a.reason ? (' — ' + a.reason) : '');
  if (name === 'delete_files') return 'Delete files from ' + a.bucket + (a.prefix ? (' under "' + a.prefix + '/"') : (' (' + ((a.paths || []).length) + ' file(s))'));
  if (name === 'post_content') { const social = ['social', 'linkedin', 'instagram', 'x', 'twitter', 'facebook'].includes(String(a.channel)); if (social) { const t = ['now', 'schedule', 'draft'].includes(String(a.type)) ? a.type : 'draft'; return 'Publish to ' + a.channel + ' via Postiz (' + t + (a.when ? (', ' + a.when) : '') + (t === 'draft' ? ' — stages in Postiz, not live' : '') + ')'; } return 'Publish to ' + a.channel + (Array.isArray(a.to) ? (' — ' + a.to.length + ' recipient(s)') : ''); }
  if (name === 'send_email') return 'Send email "' + (a.subject || '') + '" to ' + ((a.to || []).length) + ' recipient(s)';
  return name;
}

  { name: 'Security Engineer', duty: 'file scanning, contact-leak + intrusion monitoring' },

  { name: 'Document Controller', duty: 'supplier trade-licence expiry tracking' },

async function teamRoster() {
  let cats: any[] = [];
  try { const { data } = await admin.from('category_agents').select('name').eq('active', true).order('name'); cats = data || []; } catch (_e) {}
  return { founder: 'Ahmad (human — founder & owner)', role_agents: ROLE_AGENTS, category_sales_desks: { count: cats.length, examples: cats.slice(0, 14).map((c: any) => c.name) }, total_ai_agents: ROLE_AGENTS.length + cats.length };
}
async function tool_team_roster() { return await teamRoster(); }

const SYS = `You are the Secretary — the founder's Chief of Staff for QuotesDone, a UAE B2B anonymous quotation marketplace run as an AI-native company of DEPARTMENTS (Finance, Legal & Compliance, Marketing, Security, IT & Engineering, Supplier Success, Customer Success, Knowledge, Analytics, Procurement) that YOU coordinate. QuotesDone is owned by Ahmad (the CEO you report to). You are capable and decisive: when the founder gives an instruction, USE YOUR TOOLS to do it, then report crisply in 1-4 sentences.

Rules:
- When the founder expresses a business OUTCOME or GOAL ("improve SEO", "reduce our AI cost", "grow HVAC supply", "fix the supplier portal", "get us more customers"), use the objective tool with op=set. The org will decompose it into department tasks at the right authority tier — autonomous work starts immediately, gated work waits for the founder. Then report the plan: what's already moving vs what needs the founder's approval. Use op=status to track an objective and op=scorecard for the whole-company view.
- For a single concrete command, just do it with the specific tool.
- You have a live window onto EVERY department: query_platform. For ANY question about company state, call it FIRST (topic=topics lists everything). Never answer "I don't know" about company state without querying.
- Consult any specialist synchronously with ask_agent. Delegate domain questions to the owning department, then relay their answer with your own judgement.
- If the founder attaches a document, READ it and act (e.g. log_finance for an invoice), then summarise what you recorded.
- For team/staff/headcount questions use team_roster — NEVER say we have "no staff".
- High-stakes actions (refunds/money, sending to many, publishing publicly, deleting data, banning/approving suppliers) will pause for a one-line founder confirmation — expected; still call the tool.
- Concise and practical. Money in AED. If a channel isn't connected yet, say so plainly. Never invent operational data.`;

async function orChat(messages: any[]) {
  const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key'); if (!key) return { error: 'no ai key' };
  for (const model of ['anthropic/claude-sonnet-5', 'anthropic/claude-opus-4.8', 'openai/gpt-4o']) {
    try { const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + key, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ model, max_tokens: 1200, temperature: 0.2, tools: TOOLS, messages }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(30000) }); const j = await r.json(); const m = j?.choices?.[0]?.message; if (m) return { message: m }; } catch (_e) {}
  }
  return { error: 'ai_unreachable' };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const actor = await whoami(req, body); if (!actor) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);

    if (body.confirm_token) {
      const { data: p } = await admin.from('agent_pending_actions').select('*').eq('token', body.confirm_token).maybeSingle();
      if (!p || p.status !== 'pending') return J({ error: 'nothing_to_confirm' });
      if (body.decision === 'cancel') { await admin.from('agent_pending_actions').update({ status: 'cancelled' }).eq('token', body.confirm_token); return J({ ok: true, reply: 'Cancelled — I did not do it.' }); }
      const results: any[] = [];
      for (const act of (p.actions || [])) { results.push({ action: describe(act.tool, act.args), result: await runTool(act.tool, act.args) }); }
      await admin.from('agent_pending_actions').update({ status: 'done' }).eq('token', body.confirm_token);
      await admin.from('agent_command_log').insert({ agent: 'secretary', actor, command: '[confirm] ' + (p.summary || ''), did: results });
      return J({ ok: true, reply: 'Done. ' + results.map((r) => r.action).join('; '), results });
    }

    const message = String(body.message || '').trim(); if (!message) return J({ error: 'empty message' });
    const attachments = Array.isArray(body.attachments) ? body.attachments.slice(0, 5) : [];
    const attachBlock = attachments.filter((a: any) => a && a.text).map((a: any) => 'ATTACHED DOCUMENT "' + String(a.name || 'file').slice(0, 120) + '":\n' + String(a.text).slice(0, 12000)).join('\n\n---\n\n');
    const userContent = message + (attachBlock ? ('\n\n' + attachBlock) : '');
    const history = Array.isArray(body.history) ? body.history.slice(-8) : [];
    let brain = ''; try { const { data: bc } = await admin.rpc('fn_agent_context', { p_agent_key: 'secretary', p_max_chars: 8000 }); brain = bc ? String(bc) : ''; } catch (_e) {}
    let teamBlock = ''; try { const roster = await teamRoster(); teamBlock = 'YOUR TEAM (the AI departments you coordinate, plus the founder):\n- Founder: ' + roster.founder + '\n- Role agents (' + roster.role_agents.length + '): ' + roster.role_agents.map((r) => r.name + ' — ' + r.duty).join('; ') + '\n- Category sales desks: ' + roster.category_sales_desks.count + ' live\n- Headcount: ' + roster.total_ai_agents + ' AI specialist agents + 1 human founder (you).'; } catch (_e) {}
    const messages: any[] = [{ role: 'system', content: SYS + (teamBlock ? ('\n\n' + teamBlock) : '') + (brain ? ('\n\n' + brain) : '') }, ...history, { role: 'user', content: userContent }];
    const did: any[] = []; const pending: any[] = [];

    for (let step = 0; step < 5; step++) {
      const resp = await orChat(messages); if ((resp as any).error) return J({ error: (resp as any).error }, 502);
      const m = (resp as any).message; messages.push(m);
      const calls = m.tool_calls || [];
      if (!calls.length) { await admin.from('agent_command_log').insert({ agent: 'secretary', actor, command: message, did }); return J({ ok: true, reply: m.content || 'Done.', did }); }
      for (const c of calls) {
        let args: any = {}; try { args = JSON.parse(c.function.arguments || '{}'); } catch (_e) {}
        if (isHigh(c.function.name, args)) { pending.push({ tool: c.function.name, args }); messages.push({ role: 'tool', tool_call_id: c.id, content: JSON.stringify({ status: 'awaiting_founder_confirmation', note: 'queued; will run once the founder confirms' }) }); }
        else { const out = await runTool(c.function.name, args); did.push({ tool: c.function.name, result: out }); const lim = (c.function.name === 'query_platform' || c.function.name === 'ask_agent' || c.function.name === 'objective') ? 9000 : 4000; messages.push({ role: 'tool', tool_call_id: c.id, content: JSON.stringify(out).slice(0, lim) }); }
      }
      if (pending.length) {
        const summary = pending.map((p) => describe(p.tool, p.args)).join(' AND ');
        const { data: tok } = await admin.from('agent_pending_actions').insert({ created_by: actor, summary, actions: pending }).select('token').maybeSingle();
        return J({ ok: true, needs_confirmation: true, confirm_token: tok?.token || null, reply: 'I am about to: ' + summary + '. Confirm?', did });
      }
    }
    await admin.from('agent_command_log').insert({ agent: 'secretary', actor, command: message, did });
    return J({ ok: true, reply: 'Done (reached step limit).', did });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});

### supabase/functions/send_outbox/index.ts

```typescript
// send_outbox - flushes queued EMAIL notifications via Resend. Honors email_suppressions, daily cap, unsubscribe, supplier-send gate + stale guard.
// v14: internal/admin emails now get a structured, branded HTML template (headings, bullets, links) + internal footer. Added ?preview mode. Retries up to 3, then dead-letter. verify_jwt=false (secret-gated).
// v16: agent_runs instrumentation. This runs every 2 minutes and previously returned ok:true no matter what,
//      so 'email_enabled=false', a missing Resend key, or a hit daily cap looked identical to a healthy flush
//      while mail silently piled up. Recurring config states are throttled to one row per hour so the
//      2-minute cadence cannot bury the signal; idle runs with no work are not logged at all.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const FN_BASE = (Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL') || '') + '/functions/v1';
const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3;
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string | undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 28 Jul 2026 (missed by the 27 Jul sweep): sec() returns undefined/'' when the
// app_secrets read fails or the row is missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller
// posting {} matched and gained full service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The
// stored secret must now be a real value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
async function tmplRow(n: string) { try { const { data } = await admin.from('templates').select('content').eq('name', n).maybeSingle(); return (data?.content as string) || ''; } catch { return ''; } }
function esc(s: string) { return (s||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;'); }
function linkify(s: string) { return s.replace(/(https?:\/\/[^\s<]+)/g, '<a href="$1" style="color:#0d9488">$1</a>'); }

// Observability -------------------------------------------------------------
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'send_outbox', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging block the mail queue */ }
}
// Recurring config problems (email disabled, cap reached) would otherwise write a row every
// 2 minutes. Emit at most one per window, keyed on counts->>signal.
async function logThrottled(signal: string, minutes: number, status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    const since = new Date(Date.now() - minutes * 60000).toISOString();
    const { data } = await admin.from('agent_runs').select('id').eq('agent', 'send_outbox')
      .gte('started_at', since).eq('counts->>signal', signal).limit(1);
    if (data && data.length) return;
  } catch (_e) { /* if the check fails, fall through and log */ }
  await logRun(status, { ...counts, signal }, note);
}

// Turn a plain-text agent body into structured HTML: ALL-CAPS short lines -> headings, -/• lines -> bullets, URLs -> links.
function renderBody(raw: string) {
  const lines = String(raw || '').split('\n'); let html = ''; let inList = false;
  const closeList = () => { if (inList) { html += '</ul>'; inList = false; } };
  for (const line of lines) {
    const t = line.replace(/\s+$/, '');
    if (!t) { closeList(); html += '<div style="height:8px"></div>'; continue; }
    if (/^[=\-_]{3,}$/.test(t)) { continue; }
    if (/^\s*[-•*]\s+/.test(t)) { if (!inList) { html += '<ul style="margin:6px 0 6px 18px;padding:0">'; inList = true; } html += '<li style="margin:3px 0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.55">' + linkify(esc(t.replace(/^\s*[-•*]\s+/, ''))) + '</li>'; continue; }
    closeList();
    if (t === t.toUpperCase() && /[A-Z]/.test(t) && t.length <= 64) { html += '<h3 style="margin:18px 0 6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#0d9488;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em">' + esc(t) + '</h3>'; continue; }
    html += '<p style="margin:0 0 9px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;color:#1f2937">' + linkify(esc(t)) + '</p>';
  }
  closeList();
  return html;
}
function tmpl(opts: { body: string; logo: string; name: string; title: string; channelEmail: string; unsub: string; wrapper?: string; internal?: boolean; subject?: string }) {
  const { body, logo, name, title, channelEmail, unsub, wrapper, internal, subject } = opts;
  const logoTag = logo ? `<img src="${logo}" width="34" height="34" alt="QuotesDone" style="border-radius:8px;display:block"/>` : '';
  const unsubLine = unsub ? `<br><a href="${unsub}" style="color:#9ca3af">Unsubscribe</a> &middot; or reply to this email to be removed.` : '';
  if (wrapper && wrapper.indexOf('{{BODY}}') >= 0) {
    return wrapper.split('{{LOGO}}').join(logoTag).split('{{BODY}}').join(esc(body)).split('{{NAME}}').join(esc(name)).split('{{TITLE}}').join(esc(title)).split('{{REPLY}}').join(esc(channelEmail)).split('{{UNSUB}}').join(unsubLine);
  }
  const header = `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:6px">${logoTag}<div style="font-weight:800;font-size:18px;color:#0d9488">Quotes<span style="color:#111827">Done</span></div>${internal ? '<div style="margin-left:auto;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#6b7280;background:#f1f5f4;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px">INTERNAL</div>' : ''}</div>`;
  const titleBlock = (internal && subject) ? `<h2 style="margin:14px 0 12px;font-size:19px;line-height:1.3;color:#0f172a">${esc(subject)}</h2>` : '';
  const content = internal ? renderBody(body) : `<div style="font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;white-space:pre-wrap">${esc(body)}</div>`;
  const sig = `<div style="margin-top:24px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid #eef0f2;font-size:13px;color:#374151;line-height:1.55"><div style="font-weight:700;color:#111827">${esc(name)}</div><div>${esc(title)}, QuotesDone</div><div style="color:#6b7280;margin-top:2px">${esc(channelEmail)} &middot; <a href="https://quotesdone.com" style="color:#0d9488;text-decoration:none">quotesdone.com</a></div></div>`;
  const footer = internal
    ? `<div style="text-align:center;color:#9ca3af;font-size:12px;margin-top:14px">QuotesDone OS &middot; internal operations report &middot; Dubai, UAE<br>You're receiving this because you're an administrator of QuotesDone.</div>`
    : `<div style="text-align:center;color:#9ca3af;font-size:12px;margin-top:14px">QuotesDone &middot; Dubai, UAE<br>You're receiving this because your business is publicly listed and may match clients sourcing on QuotesDone.${unsubLine}</div>`;
  return `<!doctype html><html><body style="margin:0;background:#f6f7f9;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;color:#1f2937"><div style="max-width:600px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px"><div style="background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:12px;padding:28px">${header}${titleBlock}${content}${sig}</div>${footer}</div></body></html>`;
}
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const inbound = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(inbound) || body.__secret !== inbound) { await logThrottled('forbidden', 60, 'error', {}, 'send_outbox called without the inbound secret'); return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403); }
    // Preview mode: render the internal/branded template for a sample body without sending.
    if (body.preview) {
      const logo = (await sec('email_logo_url')) || '';
      const sigName = (await sec('email_signature_name')) || 'Ahmad Alzain';
      const sigTitle = (await sec('email_signature_title')) || 'Founder';
      const html = tmpl({ body: String(body.sample || 'SUMMARY\nAll systems healthy.\n\nFINDINGS\n- Uptime 99.9%\n- 2 alerts auto-resolved\n\nNext review at https://quotesdone.com/os'), logo, name: sigName, title: sigTitle, channelEmail: 'info@quotesdone.com', unsub: '', internal: body.internal !== false, subject: String(body.subject || 'Daily operations report') });
      return J({ ok: true, html });
    }
    const enabled = (await sec('email_enabled')) === 'true';
    const supEnabled = (await sec('supplier_emails_enabled')) === 'true';
    const staleH = parseInt((await sec('email_stale_hours')) || '72', 10);
    const key = await sec('resend_api_key');
    const fromSup = (await sec('email_from_supplier')) || 'QuotesDone <supplier@quotesdone.com>';
    const fromInfo = (await sec('email_from_info')) || 'QuotesDone <info@quotesdone.com>';
    const replySup = (await sec('email_reply_supplier')) || 'supplier@quotesdone.com';
    const replyDocs = (await sec('email_reply_supplier_docs')) || 'docs@mail.quotesdone.com';
    const replyInfo = (await sec('email_reply_info')) || 'info@quotesdone.com';
    const logo = (await sec('email_logo_url')) || '';
    const sigName = (await sec('email_signature_name')) || 'Ahmad Alzain';
    const sigTitle = (await sec('email_signature_title')) || 'Founder';
    const tplSup = await tmplRow('email_supplier'); const tplCust = await tmplRow('email_customer');
    const cap = parseInt((await sec('daily_send_cap')) || '80', 10);
    const since = new Date(); since.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const { count: sentToday } = await admin.from('notifications').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('status', 'sent').gte('sent_at', since.toISOString());
    const remaining = Math.max(0, cap - (sentToday || 0));
    const { data: q } = await admin.from('notifications').select('*').or('status.eq.queued,status.eq.pending,status.is.null').order('created_at', { ascending: true }).limit(Number(body.limit) || 40);
    const rows = q || [];
    // Previously a silent ok:true - mail just accumulated with no signal anywhere.
    if (!enabled || !key) { await logThrottled('email_disabled', 60, 'error', { pending: rows.length, email_enabled: enabled, has_resend_key: !!key }, 'EMAIL NOT SENDING - ' + (!enabled ? 'email_enabled is not true' : 'resend_api_key missing') + '; ' + rows.length + ' notification(s) waiting'); return J({ ok: true, pending: rows.length, sent: 0, note: 'email disabled or resend_api_key missing - queued and will flush once enabled' }); }
    if (remaining <= 0) { await logThrottled('cap_reached', 60, 'error', { pending: rows.length, cap, sent_today: sentToday || 0 }, 'daily send cap reached - ' + rows.length + ' notification(s) held until tomorrow'); return J({ ok: true, sent: 0, pending: rows.length, note: 'daily send cap reached', cap, sent_today: sentToday || 0 }); }
    const toEmails = [...new Set(rows.map((r: any) => r.to_email).filter(Boolean))];
    let supSet = new Set<string>();
    if (toEmails.length) { const { data: sup } = await admin.from('email_suppressions').select('email').in('email', toEmails); supSet = new Set((sup || []).map((s: any) => s.email)); }
    let sent = 0, failed = 0, retried = 0, deadlettered = 0, skipped = 0, suppressed = 0, held = 0;
    const failNote = async (n: any, msg: string) => {
      const att = (Number(n.attempts) || 0) + 1;
      const dead = att >= MAX_ATTEMPTS;
      await admin.from('notifications').update({ status: dead ? 'failed' : 'queued', attempts: att, last_error: String(msg).slice(0, 500) }).eq('id', n.id);
      failed++; if (dead) deadlettered++; else retried++;
    };
    let lastErr = '';
    for (const n of rows) {
      // WHATSAPP ROWS EATEN 27 Jul 2026 - the select above pulls every queued row of EVERY channel but
      // this line excluded only 'sms', and the next line marks any row with no to_email as 'skipped'.
      // WhatsApp notifications carry to_phone and never to_email, so each one this poller reached was
      // flipped to 'skipped' before send_whatsapp (which drains channel='whatsapp' AND status='queued')
      // could see it. Running every 2 minutes, this poller almost always won the race - the WhatsApp
      // message was destroyed, not delayed. Exclude 'whatsapp' exactly as 'sms' is excluded: leave the
      // row untouched at 'queued' so its own sender can drain it.
      if (n.channel === 'sms' || n.channel === 'whatsapp') { skipped++; continue; }
      if (!n.to_email) { await admin.from('notifications').update({ status: 'skipped' }).eq('id', n.id); continue; }
      if (supSet.has(n.to_email)) { await admin.from('notifications').update({ status: 'suppressed' }).eq('id', n.id); suppressed++; continue; }
      const ageH = (Date.now() - new Date(n.created_at).getTime()) / 3.6e6;
      if (ageH > staleH) { await admin.from('notifications').update({ status: 'held' }).eq('id', n.id); held++; continue; }
      const supplierSide = n.to_role === 'supplier';
      const internal = n.to_role === 'admin' || n.to_role === 'founder';
      const docReq = supplierSide && isDocRequest(n.type);
      if (supplierSide && !supEnabled && !docReq) { await admin.from('notifications').update({ status: 'held' }).eq('id', n.id); held++; continue; }
      if (sent >= remaining) break;
      const from = supplierSide ? fromSup : fromInfo;
      const reply = supplierSide ? (docReq ? replyDocs : replySup) : replyInfo;
      const unsub = (supplierSide && inbound) ? `${FN_BASE}/unsubscribe?e=${encodeURIComponent(n.to_email)}&t=${await unsubTok(n.to_email, inbound)}` : '';
      const wrapper = supplierSide ? tplSup : (internal ? '' : tplCust);
      const htmlBody = tmpl({ body: n.body || '', logo, name: sigName, title: sigTitle, channelEmail: reply, unsub, wrapper, internal, subject: n.subject || '' });
      try {
        const mail: Record<string, unknown> = { from, to: [n.to_email], reply_to: reply, subject: n.subject || 'QuotesDone', html: htmlBody };
        if (unsub) mail.headers = { 'List-Unsubscribe': `<${unsub}>, <mailto:${reply}?subject=unsubscribe>`, 'List-Unsubscribe-Post': 'List-Unsubscribe=One-Click' };
        const r = await fetch('https://api.resend.com/emails', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${key}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(mail) });
        if (r.ok) { await admin.from('notifications').update({ status: 'sent', sent_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', n.id); sent++; }
        else { const t = await r.text(); lastErr = String(t).slice(0, 200); await failNote(n, t); console.error('resend fail', n.id, t); }
      } catch (e) { lastErr = String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0, 200); await failNote(n, String((e as Error)?.message || e)); console.error(e); }
    }
    // Only log runs that did something. Idle polls (nothing queued) stay out of agent_runs
    // so a real event is never buried under 720 empty rows a day.
    const didWork = sent || failed || suppressed || held || skipped;
    if (deadlettered) await logRun('error', { sent, failed, retried, deadlettered, suppressed, held, skipped, pending: rows.length }, deadlettered + ' email(s) permanently dead-lettered after ' + MAX_ATTEMPTS + ' attempts and will never be delivered. Last error: ' + lastErr);
    else if (failed) await logRun('error', { sent, failed, retried, suppressed, held, skipped, pending: rows.length }, 'Resend rejected ' + failed + ' email(s), will retry. Last error: ' + lastErr);
    else if (didWork) await logRun('ok', { sent, suppressed, held, skipped, pending: rows.length, remaining_today: Math.max(0, remaining - sent) }, held ? (held + ' held (supplier sending gate or stale)') : '');
    return J({ ok: true, sent, failed, retried, deadlettered, skipped, suppressed, held, pending: rows.length, cap, remaining_today: Math.max(0, remaining - sent) });
  } catch (e) { const m = String((e as Error)?.message || e); await logRun('error', {}, 'exception: ' + m); return J({ error: m }, 500); }
});
function isDocRequest(type: string) { return /licen[cs]e|renew|expir|doc[_-]?request|document[_-]?request|upload[_-]?doc/i.test(String(type || '')); }
async function unsubTok(email: string, secret: string) {
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(secret), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']);
  const sig = await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', key, new TextEncoder().encode(email.toLowerCase()));
  return [...new Uint8Array(sig)].map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('').slice(0, 20);
}

// send_sms v3 - sends SMS via Twilio using API-KEY auth (account uses API keys, not auth_token).
// Two modes: single ({to, body}) or flush (drains queued channel='sms' notifications).
// Secret-guarded (inbound_secret). Reads twilio_account_sid (URL) + twilio_api_key_sid/_secret (auth) + twilio_from (sender).
// Graceful: if not configured, returns { ok:false, error:'sms_not_configured' } and changes nothing.
// v3: agent_runs instrumentation. Runs every 2 minutes and always returned 200, so 'sms_not_configured'
//     and Twilio rejections were indistinguishable from a healthy idle flush. Recurring config states are
//     throttled to one row per hour; idle runs with nothing queued are not logged at all.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string|undefined) || undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
function normPhone(p: string){ let s = String(p||'').trim().replace(/[^0-9+]/g,''); if(!s) return ''; if(s.startsWith('00')) s='+'+s.slice(2); if(!s.startsWith('+')){ if(s.startsWith('0')) s='+971'+s.slice(1); else if(s.startsWith('971')) s='+'+s; else s='+'+s; } return s; }

// Observability -------------------------------------------------------------
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'send_sms', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging block sending */ }
}
async function logThrottled(signal: string, minutes: number, status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    const since = new Date(Date.now() - minutes * 60000).toISOString();
    const { data } = await admin.from('agent_runs').select('id').eq('agent', 'send_sms')
      .gte('started_at', since).eq('counts->>signal', signal).limit(1);
    if (data && data.length) return;
  } catch (_e) { /* if the check fails, fall through and log */ }
  await logRun(status, { ...counts, signal }, note);
}

async function twilioSend(acct: string, ks: string, kk: string, from: string, to: string, body: string){
  const auth = btoa(ks + ':' + kk);
  const form = new URLSearchParams({ To: to, From: from, Body: body });
  const r = await fetch(`https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/${acct}/Messages.json`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Basic ' + auth, 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: form.toString() });
  const jd = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
  return { ok: r.ok, status: r.status, sid: jd?.sid || null, error: r.ok ? null : (jd?.message || ('http ' + r.status)) };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || body.__secret !== __exp) { await logThrottled('forbidden', 60, 'error', {}, 'send_sms called without the inbound secret'); return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403); }
    const acct = await sec('twilio_account_sid'); const ks = await sec('twilio_api_key_sid'); const kk = await sec('twilio_api_key_secret'); const from = await sec('twilio_from');
    if (!acct || !ks || !kk || !from) { await logThrottled('not_configured', 60, 'error', {}, 'SMS NOT SENDING - missing twilio_account_sid / api_key_sid / api_key_secret / twilio_from'); return J({ ok: false, error: 'sms_not_configured' }, 200); }

    // Single send
    if (body.to && body.body) {
      const to = normPhone(String(body.to)); if (!to || to.length < 8) { await logRun('error', { direct: true }, 'bad_phone on direct send: ' + String(body.to || '').slice(0, 40)); return J({ ok: false, error: 'bad_phone' }, 200); }
      const res = await twilioSend(acct, ks, kk, from, to, String(body.body).slice(0, 600));
      if (!res.ok) await logRun('error', { direct: true, http: res.status }, 'direct SMS rejected by Twilio: ' + String(res.error || '').slice(0, 200));
      return J({ ok: res.ok, sid: res.sid, error: res.error });
    }

    // Flush queued SMS notifications
    const { data: rows } = await admin.from('notifications').select('id,to_phone,body').eq('channel', 'sms').eq('status', 'queued').not('to_phone', 'is', null).order('created_at', { ascending: true }).limit(25);
    let sent = 0, failed = 0, badPhone = 0; let lastErr = '';
    for (const n of (rows || [])) {
      const to = normPhone(String(n.to_phone || '')); if (!to) { await admin.from('notifications').update({ status: 'failed' }).eq('id', n.id); failed++; badPhone++; continue; }
      const res = await twilioSend(acct, ks, kk, from, to, String(n.body || '').slice(0, 600));
      await admin.from('notifications').update({ status: res.ok ? 'sent' : 'failed', sent_at: res.ok ? new Date().toISOString() : null, last_error: res.ok ? null : String(res.error).slice(0,300) }).eq('id', n.id);
      if (res.ok) sent++; else { failed++; lastErr = String(res.error || '').slice(0, 200); }
    }
    // Idle polls (nothing queued) stay out of agent_runs so real events are not buried.
    if (failed) await logRun('error', { sent, failed, bad_phone: badPhone }, failed + ' SMS failed and are marked failed with no retry. Last error: ' + (lastErr || 'unroutable phone number'));
    else if (sent) await logRun('ok', { sent, failed }, '');
    return J({ ok: true, sent, failed });
  } catch (e) { const m = String((e as Error)?.message || e); await logRun('error', {}, 'exception: ' + m); return J({ error: m }, 500); }
});
