### supabase/functions/stripe_webhook/index.ts

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const TOLERANCE_SECONDS = 600; // reject events whose signature timestamp is older/newer than this (replay guard)
async function secret(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
function toHex(buf: ArrayBuffer) { return [...new Uint8Array(buf)].map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(''); }

// Observability: every exit path leaves a row in agent_runs so a payment that lands but
// records nothing is visible instead of silent. Fire-and-forget so it can never fail the webhook.
function mkLog(t0: number) {
  return async (status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) => {
    try {
      await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'stripe_webhook', status, counts,
        note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
        started_at: new Date(t0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
    } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break payment handling */ }
  };
}

async function verifySig(sigHeader: string, payload: string, key: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const parts: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const kv of String(sigHeader || '').split(',')) { const i = kv.indexOf('='); if (i > 0) parts[kv.slice(0, i).trim()] = kv.slice(i + 1).trim(); }
  const t = parts['t']; const v1 = parts['v1'];
  if (!t || !v1) return false;
  // Replay / timestamp-tolerance check. Stripe re-signs every delivery attempt with a fresh `t`,
  // so a generous window is safe across retries while still rejecting captured/stale replays.
  const ts = parseInt(t, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(ts)) return false;
  const nowSec = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  if (Math.abs(nowSec - ts) > TOLERANCE_SECONDS) return false;
  const enc = new TextEncoder();
  const ck = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', enc.encode(key), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']);
  const mac = await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', ck, enc.encode(t + '.' + payload));
  const expected = toHex(mac);
  if (expected.length !== v1.length) return false;
  let diff = 0; for (let i = 0; i < expected.length; i++) diff |= expected.charCodeAt(i) ^ v1.charCodeAt(i);
  return diff === 0;
}
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  const logRun = mkLog(Date.now());
  if (req.method !== 'POST') return new Response('POST only', { status: 405 });
  const raw = await req.text();
  const sig = req.headers.get('Stripe-Signature') || '';
  const whsec = await secret('stripe_webhook_secret');
  if (!whsec) { await logRun('error', {}, 'not_configured: stripe_webhook_secret missing'); return new Response('not_configured', { status: 400 }); }
  if (!(await verifySig(sig, raw, whsec))) { await logRun('error', {}, 'bad_signature (rejected before parsing)'); return new Response('bad signature', { status: 400 }); }
  let event: any; try { event = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { await logRun('error', {}, 'bad_json from Stripe'); return new Response('bad json', { status: 400 }); }
  // Ledger (Finding 7): record every signature-verified delivery for audit + reconciliation and
  // count retries. Best-effort and non-blocking — correctness is still enforced by the conditional
  // updates below, so a ledger failure can never drop a payment.
  try {
    const evId = String(event?.id || '');
    if (evId) await admin.rpc('fn_stripe_event_seen', { p_event_id: evId, p_type: String(event?.type || ''), p_status: String(event?.data?.object?.payment_status || '') });
  } catch (_e) { /* ledger is best-effort */ }
  try {
    if (event.type === 'checkout.session.completed') {
      const s = event.data?.object || {};
      if (s.payment_status === 'paid') {
        const md = s.metadata || {};

        // ---- SUPPLIER COMMISSION SETTLEMENT (added 19 Jul 2026) ----------------------------
        // This is the ONLY place supplier_dues.paid_at is ever written. supplier_pay merely
        // creates the Checkout Session; a due is settled only once Stripe confirms payment on a
        // signature-verified event, so a supplier cannot clear their own debt by calling our API.
        if (String(md.kind || '') === 'supplier_dues') {
          const ids = String(md.due_ids || '').split(',').map((x) => Number(x.trim())).filter((n) => Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0);
          const payRef = String(s.payment_intent || s.id);
          const paidAmount = Number(s.amount_total ? s.amount_total / 100 : 0);
          if (!ids.length) { await logRun('error', { kind: 'supplier_dues', amount_total: s.amount_total, session: String(s.id || '') }, 'SUPPLIER PAID BUT NOTHING SETTLED - a supplier_dues checkout session completed with no metadata.due_ids, so no due could be marked paid. The money is with Stripe but the supplier still shows as owing it, and will keep receiving overdue reminders and legal escalation. Reconcile manually against session ' + String(s.id || '')); return new Response(JSON.stringify({ received: true }), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }); }

          // Only settle rows that are genuinely still outstanding - makes duplicate deliveries a no-op.
          const { data: settled, error: uErr } = await admin.from('supplier_dues')
            .update({ status: 'paid', paid_at: new Date().toISOString(), payment_ref: payRef })
            .in('id', ids).is('paid_at', null).select('id,amount_due,supplier_id');

          if (uErr) { await logRun('error', { kind: 'supplier_dues', due_ids: ids, amount: paidAmount }, 'SUPPLIER PAID BUT NOT RECORDED - failed to mark supplier_dues paid (' + uErr.message + '). Payment ref ' + payRef + '. The supplier has been charged and will still be chased for the debt until this is reconciled by hand.'); return new Response('due update failed: ' + uErr.message, { status: 500 }); }

          const n = (settled || []).length;
          if (n === 0) { await logRun('ok', { kind: 'supplier_dues', duplicate: true, due_ids: ids }, 'Duplicate Stripe delivery for supplier dues ignored - those dues were already settled.'); }
          else {
            // Push the collection straight into the ledger rather than waiting for the next cron.
            let posted = 0; try { const { data: gp } = await admin.rpc('fn_gl_sync_business'); posted = Number(gp || 0); } catch (_e) { /* cron will catch up */ }
            try {
              const supId = (settled || [])[0]?.supplier_id;
              const { data: sup } = await admin.from('leads').select('email,company_name').eq('id', supId).maybeSingle();
              if (sup?.email && /@/.test(sup.email)) await admin.from('notifications').insert([{ type: 'dues_paid', to_email: sup.email, to_role: 'supplier', lead_id: supId, subject: 'Payment received - thank you', body: 'We have received your payment of AED ' + paidAmount.toFixed(2) + ' settling ' + n + ' commission item(s). Your account is now up to date.' }]);
            } catch (_e) { /* */ }
            await logRun('ok', { kind: 'supplier_dues', settled: n, amount: paidAmount, gl_entries_posted: posted }, 'Supplier settled ' + n + ' commission due(s) totalling AED ' + paidAmount.toFixed(2) + ' via Stripe (ref ' + payRef + ').');
          }
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ received: true }), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
        }

        // ---- SUPPLIER REGISTRATION FEE (added 21 Jul 2026) --------------------------------
        // This is the ONLY place leads.registration_status is set to 'paid'.
        // supplier_api.pay_registration previously wrote it directly, with no payment taken and
        // no Stripe involved, so any supplier with a valid JWT could clear their own AED 1,000
        // fee with a single POST. That endpoint now only creates a Checkout Session; settlement
        // happens here on a signature-verified event, exactly as it does for supplier_dues.
        if (String(md.kind || '') === 'supplier_registration') {
          const supId = Number(md.supplier_id || 0);
          const payRef = String(s.payment_intent || s.id);
          const paidAmount = Number(s.amount_total ? s.amount_total / 100 : 0);
          if (!supId) { await logRun('error', { kind: 'supplier_registration', amount_total: s.amount_total, session: String(s.id || '') }, 'SUPPLIER PAID BUT NOTHING RECORDED - a supplier_registration checkout session completed with no metadata.supplier_id, so no lead could be marked registered. The money is with Stripe but the supplier still shows the fee as outstanding. Reconcile manually against session ' + String(s.id || '')); return new Response(JSON.stringify({ received: true }), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }); }

          // Only settle a lead that is genuinely still unpaid. This makes duplicate deliveries a
          // no-op, and stops a repeat webhook silently pushing the expiry out by another year.
          const YEAR_MS = 365 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
          const { data: settled, error: rErr } = await admin.from('leads')
            .update({ registration_status: 'paid', registration_fee_due: 0, registration_paid_at: new Date().toISOString(), registration_expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + YEAR_MS).toISOString() })
            .eq('id', supId).neq('registration_status', 'paid').select('id,email,company_name');

          if (rErr) { await logRun('error', { kind: 'supplier_registration', supplier_id: supId, amount: paidAmount }, 'SUPPLIER PAID BUT NOT RECORDED - failed to mark registration paid (' + rErr.message + '). Payment ref ' + payRef + '. The supplier has been charged and still shows as unregistered, so they may be blocked from quoting until this is reconciled by hand.'); return new Response('registration update failed: ' + rErr.message, { status: 500 }); }

          const n = (settled || []).length;
          if (n === 0) { await logRun('ok', { kind: 'supplier_registration', duplicate: true, supplier_id: supId }, 'Duplicate Stripe delivery for supplier registration ignored - that supplier was already marked paid.'); }
          else {
            try { const sup = (settled || [])[0]; if (sup?.email && /@/.test(sup.email)) await admin.from('notifications').insert([{ type: 'registration_paid', to_email: sup.email, to_role: 'supplier', lead_id: supId, subject: 'Registration confirmed - thank you', body: 'We have received your registration payment of AED ' + paidAmount.toFixed(2) + '. Your QuotesDone supplier account is registered for the next 12 months.' }]); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
            await logRun('ok', { kind: 'supplier_registration', supplier_id: supId, amount: paidAmount }, 'Supplier ' + supId + ' paid the registration fee of AED ' + paidAmount.toFixed(2) + ' via Stripe (ref ' + payRef + ').');
          }
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ received: true }), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
        }

        // ---- CUSTOMER REVEAL FEE (existing behaviour) ---------------------------------------
        const qid = String(md.quote_id || '');
        if (qid) {
          const { data: existing } = await admin.from('transactions').select('id').eq('quote_id', qid).maybeSingle();
          if (!existing) {
            const { data: q } = await admin.from('quotes').select('id,inquiry_id,supplier_id,quote_amount').eq('id', qid).maybeSingle();
            if (q) {
              const { data: inq } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('customer_id,summary').eq('id', q.inquiry_id).maybeSingle();
              const { data: cfg } = await admin.from('pricing_config').select('refund_window_working_days').eq('id', 1).maybeSingle();
              const { data: dl } = await admin.rpc('fn_add_working_days', { p_from: new Date().toISOString(), p_days: cfg?.refund_window_working_days ?? 3 });
              const fee = Number(md.reveal_fee || (s.amount_total ? s.amount_total / 100 : 0));
              const amount = Number(md.quote_amount || q.quote_amount);
              const payRef = String(s.payment_intent || s.id);
              await admin.from('quotes').update({ status: 'revealed' }).eq('id', qid);
              await admin.from('inquiries').update({ status: 'revealed' }).eq('id', q.inquiry_id);
              const { error: e2 } = await admin.from('transactions').insert({ quote_id: qid, inquiry_id: q.inquiry_id, supplier_id: q.supplier_id, customer_id: inq?.customer_id || md.customer_id || null, quote_amount: amount, reveal_fee: fee, app_fee: fee, customer_price: amount, paid_by: 'customer', payment_ref: payRef, fee_status: 'paid', revealed_at: new Date().toISOString(), refund_deadline: dl });
              if (e2) { await logRun('error', { quote_id: qid, reveal_fee: fee }, 'PAID BUT NOT RECORDED - transaction insert failed: ' + e2.message + ' | payment_ref: ' + payRef); return new Response('insert failed: ' + e2.message, { status: 500 }); }
              let notified = false;
              try { const { data: sup } = await admin.from('leads').select('email').eq('id', q.supplier_id).maybeSingle(); if (sup?.email && /@/.test(sup.email)) { await admin.from('notifications').insert([{ type: 'quote_accepted', to_email: sup.email, to_role: 'supplier', lead_id: q.supplier_id, inquiry_id: q.inquiry_id, quote_id: qid, subject: 'A customer revealed your quote on QuotesDone', body: 'A customer paid to reveal your contact for: ' + ((inq?.summary) || '') + '. Please respond promptly — if you do not respond within 3 working days the customer may be refunded.' }]); notified = true; } } catch (_e) { /* */ }
              await logRun('ok', { quote_id: qid, reveal_fee: fee, quote_amount: amount, supplier_notified: notified }, notified ? '' : 'transaction recorded but supplier email not sent');
            } else {
              // Money taken at Stripe but the quote row is gone - previously silent.
              await logRun('error', { quote_id: qid, amount_total: s.amount_total }, 'PAID BUT NOT RECORDED - quote_id not found in quotes: ' + qid);
            }
          } else {
            await logRun('ok', { quote_id: qid, duplicate: true }, 'duplicate delivery ignored (transaction already exists)');
          }
        } else {
          // Paid session with no quote_id and no supplier_dues marker - previously silent.
          await logRun('error', { amount_total: s.amount_total, session: String(s.id || '') }, 'PAID BUT NOT RECORDED - checkout session has neither metadata.quote_id nor metadata.kind=supplier_dues');
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (e) { const m = String((e as Error)?.message || e); await logRun('error', {}, 'exception: ' + m); return new Response('handler error: ' + m, { status: 500 }); }
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ received: true }), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
});
```

### supabase/functions/sup_dob/index.ts

```typescript
// sup_dob — persist supplier owner date-of-birth (KYC) for the caller's claimed company.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: CORS });
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
    const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
    if (!user || !user.email) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
    const b = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const dob = String(b.owner_dob || '').slice(0, 10);
    if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dob)) return J({ error: 'bad_date' }, 400);
    const { error } = await admin.from('leads').update({ owner_dob: dob }).eq('claimed_by', user.email.toLowerCase());
    if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
    return J({ ok: true });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

```typescript
// supplier_ack v1 — one-click 'I have contacted the customer' from the nudge email.
// GET ?tx=<transaction_id>&token=<ack_token> -> sets transactions.supplier_ack_at, stops nudges.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const NAVY = '#0c2330';
function page(title: string, msg: string, ok: boolean){
  return `<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>${title} · QuotesDone</title>
<style>body{margin:0;font-family:-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;background:#0a1a24;color:#eaf2f6;display:flex;min-height:100vh;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.card{max-width:460px;margin:20px;background:#0f2735;border:1px solid #1d3a4a;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
.hd{background:${NAVY};padding:22px 26px;border-bottom:2px solid #17b3a6}.hd b{font-size:19px;letter-spacing:.3px}
.bd{padding:24px 26px;line-height:1.6}.ic{font-size:40px;margin-bottom:8px}.mut{color:#9fb4c0;font-size:13px;margin-top:16px}
a{color:#2DD4BF}</style></head><body><div class="card"><div class="hd"><b>QuotesDone</b></div>
<div class="bd"><div class="ic">${ok?'✅':'⚠️'}</div><div style="font-size:17px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px">${title}</div><div>${msg}</div>
<div class="mut">If you have any issue, email <a href="mailto:supplier@quotesdone.com">supplier@quotesdone.com</a>.</div></div></div></body></html>`;
}
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const tx = (url.searchParams.get('tx') || '').trim();
  const token = (url.searchParams.get('token') || '').trim();
  const H = { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8' };
  const uuidRe = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
  if (!tx || !uuidRe.test(token)) return new Response(page('Link not valid','This confirmation link is incomplete or has expired. Please use the link from your latest QuotesDone reminder email.',false), { status: 400, headers: H });
  try {
    const { data: t } = await admin.from('transactions').select('id,supplier_ack_at,ack_token,inquiry_id').eq('id', tx).maybeSingle();
    if (!t || String(t.ack_token) !== token) return new Response(page('Link not valid','We could not match this confirmation link. Please use the link from your latest QuotesDone reminder email.',false), { status: 404, headers: H });
    if (!t.supplier_ack_at) {
      await admin.from('transactions').update({ supplier_ack_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', tx);
      try { await admin.from('notifications').insert({ type:'supplier_ack', to_role:'admin', inquiry_id: t.inquiry_id, subject:'Supplier confirmed they contacted the customer', body:'A supplier clicked the confirmation link for a revealed inquiry, confirming they have contacted the paying customer. No further nudges will be sent for this reveal.' }); } catch(_e) {}
    }
    return new Response(page('Thank you — noted','We have recorded that you have contacted this customer. You will not receive further reminders for this inquiry. Please continue the conversation with the customer to win the job.',true), { headers: H });
  } catch (_e) {
    return new Response(page('Something went wrong','We could not record your confirmation right now. Please try again shortly, or reply to the reminder email.',false), { status: 500, headers: H });
  }
});
```

```typescript
// supplier_pay v2 - lets a supplier settle what they owe, by Stripe.
//
// WHAT A SUPPLIER OWES (corrected 19 Jul 2026). v1 called this "commission", which was wrong and
// appeared on the customer-facing Stripe receipt. Suppliers pay NO commission on jobs they win.
// A balance arises in exactly two situations:
//
//   1. REFUND CLAWBACK - a customer was refunded because the supplier did not respond. QuotesDone
//      pays that refund out of its own balance immediately so the customer is not left waiting,
//      then recovers it from the supplier: the 3% reveal fee + a AED 250 admin fee, plus monthly
//      interest once past due. Unpaid for 90 days -> ban + legal escalation.
//   2. ANNUAL SUBSCRIPTION - AED 1,000/year from 1 Aug 2027, except the first 1,000 registrants,
//      who are exempt permanently. Handled by fn_subscription_billing_run, not by this endpoint.
//
// AUTH: supplier JWT only (signed-in email must match leads.claimed_by), same as
// supplier_api/supplier_portal. Due ids in the request are re-checked against the caller's own
// supplier_id before pricing, so passing another supplier's id cannot create a session for it.
//
// MONEY SAFETY: this endpoint only CREATES a Stripe Checkout Session. It never marks anything
// paid. supplier_dues is settled solely by stripe_webhook once Stripe confirms payment on a
// signature-verified event, so a supplier cannot clear their own debt by calling the API.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
async function secret(k: string) { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || ''; }
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'supplier_pay', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging block a payment */ }
}
// Everything a supplier owes on one due: the refunded reveal fee + admin fee + accrued interest
// (+ any legacy fine_amount). These are separate GL lines, so they are kept separate here too.
function owed(d: any): number {
  return Math.round((Number(d.amount_due || 0) + Number(d.admin_fee || 0)
    + Number(d.interest_amount || 0) + Number(d.fine_amount || 0)) * 100) / 100;
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
    const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
    if (!user || !user.email) return J({ error: 'Not signed in' }, 401);
    const email = user.email.toLowerCase();

    const { data: lead } = await admin.from('leads').select('id,company_name,email').eq('claimed_by', email).maybeSingle();
    if (!lead) { await logRun('error', { authorised: 0 }, 'supplier_pay called by ' + email + ' but no lead is claimed by that address, so their balance could not be looked up. If this is a real supplier they cannot pay - check leads.claimed_by.'); return J({ error: 'No supplier profile for this account' }, 403); }

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const action = String(body.action || 'list');

    const { data: dues, error: dErr } = await admin.from('supplier_dues')
      .select('id,amount_due,admin_fee,interest_amount,fine_amount,currency,status,due_date,paid_at,quote_id,reveal_date,legal_stage')
      .eq('supplier_id', lead.id)
      .not('status', 'in', '("paid","settled","waived","cancelled")')
      .is('paid_at', null)
      .order('due_date', { ascending: true });
    if (dErr) { await logRun('error', { supplier_id: lead.id }, 'supplier_pay could not read supplier_dues (' + String(dErr.message).slice(0,140) + '). The supplier was shown no outstanding balance, which looks identical to owing nothing - they may believe they are settled when they are not, and keep accruing interest.'); return J({ error: 'temporarily_unavailable' }, 503); }

    const outstanding = (dues || []).filter((d) => owed(d) > 0);
    const totalOwed = Math.round(outstanding.reduce((s, d) => s + owed(d), 0) * 100) / 100;

    if (action === 'list') {
      await logRun('ok', { supplier_id: lead.id, outstanding: outstanding.length, total_owed: totalOwed }, '');
      return J({ ok: true, company: lead.company_name, currency: 'AED', total_owed: totalOwed,
        dues: outstanding.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, amount: owed(d),
          refunded_fee: Number(d.amount_due || 0),
          admin_fee: Number(d.admin_fee || 0),
          interest: Number(d.interest_amount || 0) + Number(d.fine_amount || 0),
          due_date: d.due_date, status: d.status, in_legal: d.legal_stage ? true : false })) });
    }

    if (action !== 'checkout') return J({ error: 'unknown action' }, 400);
    if (!outstanding.length) return J({ ok: true, nothing_to_pay: true, total_owed: 0 });

    let selected = outstanding;
    if (Array.isArray(body.due_ids) && body.due_ids.length) {
      const want = new Set(body.due_ids.map((x: unknown) => Number(x)));
      selected = outstanding.filter((d) => want.has(Number(d.id)));
      if (selected.length !== want.size) {
        await logRun('error', { supplier_id: lead.id, requested: want.size, allowed: selected.length }, 'supplier_pay was asked to bill due ids that are not outstanding for this supplier. Only their own unpaid dues were included. This is the shape of a caller trying to pay (or probe) another supplier balance.');
      }
      if (!selected.length) return J({ error: 'no payable dues in selection' }, 400);
    }

    const amount = Math.round(selected.reduce((s, d) => s + owed(d), 0) * 100) / 100;
    if (!(amount > 0)) return J({ ok: true, nothing_to_pay: true, total_owed: 0 });

    const sk = await secret('stripe_secret_key');
    if (!sk) { await logRun('error', { supplier_id: lead.id, amount }, 'SUPPLIER PAYMENT BLOCKED - stripe_secret_key missing from app_secrets, so no supplier can settle. Balances will keep accruing interest and ageing toward the 90-day ban for a configuration reason, not because the supplier refused to pay.'); return J({ error: 'stripe_not_configured' }, 503); }

    const ids = selected.map((d) => Number(d.id));
    const fils = Math.round(amount * 100);
    const base = String(body.return_url || 'https://quotesdone.com').replace(/\/+$/, '');
    const form = new URLSearchParams();
    form.set('mode', 'payment');
    form.set('success_url', base + '/portal?dues_paid={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}');
    form.set('cancel_url', base + '/portal');
    form.set('client_reference_id', 'dues:' + lead.id);
    if (lead.email && /@/.test(String(lead.email))) form.set('customer_email', String(lead.email));
    form.set('line_items[0][quantity]', '1');
    form.set('line_items[0][price_data][currency]', 'aed');
    form.set('line_items[0][price_data][unit_amount]', String(fils));
    // Wording matters: this is a refund the customer already received, recovered under the supplier
    // terms - NOT commission. Suppliers keep 100% of the value of jobs they win.
    form.set('line_items[0][price_data][product_data][name]', 'QuotesDone account settlement');
    form.set('line_items[0][price_data][product_data][description]', 'Settlement of ' + ids.length + ' outstanding charge(s): refunded reveal fee, administration fee and any accrued interest');
    form.set('metadata[due_ids]', ids.join(','));
    form.set('metadata[supplier_id]', String(lead.id));
    form.set('metadata[kind]', 'supplier_dues');
    form.set('payment_intent_data[metadata][due_ids]', ids.join(','));
    form.set('payment_intent_data[metadata][kind]', 'supplier_dues');

    const r = await fetch('https://api.stripe.com/v1/checkout/sessions', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + sk, 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: form.toString() });
    const sj = await r.json();
    if (!r.ok) { await logRun('error', { supplier_id: lead.id, amount, http: r.status }, 'Stripe session create failed for a supplier trying to settle: ' + String(sj?.error?.message || '').slice(0, 200) + '. The supplier cannot pay right now and interest keeps accruing.'); return J({ error: 'stripe_error', detail: String(sj?.error?.message || '').slice(0, 300) }, 502); }

    try { await admin.from('supplier_dues').update({ stripe_session_id: String(sj.id) }).in('id', ids); } catch (_e) { /* non-fatal */ }

    await logRun('ok', { supplier_id: lead.id, amount, dues: ids.length, session: String(sj?.id || '') }, 'Supplier ' + (lead.company_name || lead.id) + ' started checkout for ' + amount + ' AED across ' + ids.length + ' outstanding charge(s). Nothing is marked paid until stripe_webhook confirms.');
    return J({ ok: true, url: sj.url, amount, currency: 'AED', dues: ids.length });
  } catch (e) {
    const m = String((e as Error)?.message || e);
    await logRun('error', { unhandled_exception: 1 }, 'supplier_pay threw: ' + m.slice(0, 200));
    return J({ error: m }, 500);
  }
});
```

```typescript
// supplier_portal v5 — advanced supplier dashboard API. Supplier-authed (own leads row via claimed_by).
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const cors = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: cors });
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const SUPA_URL = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
function b64ToBytes(b64:string){ const bin=atob(String(b64).replace(/^data:[^;]+;base64,/,'')); const a=new Uint8Array(bin.length); for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)a[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i); return a; }
async function sign(bucket:string, path:string|null){ if(!path) return null; try{ const { data } = await admin.storage.from(bucket).createSignedUrl(path, 3600); return data?.signedUrl || null; }catch{ return null; } }
// Every document a supplier can hold, in the order the portal shows them.
//
// Until v4 this map contained ONLY `iso`, which meant save_documents could write an ISO
// certificate and nothing else. The documents tab rendered the trade licence and company
// profile as read-only, and VAT / insurance / manufacturer authorisation had no UI at all.
// The effect was a dead end: fn_supplier_expiries raises "Insurance has expired - upload a
// renewed copy" and routes the supplier to a tab with no insurance field. Worse, an
// established supplier could never replace an expired trade licence, because the only
// licence upload lives in ProfileForm, which renders only while the account still has no
// company. Driving both read and write off one map closes that.
//
// `folder` keeps storage tidy and mirrors what save_profile already writes.
const DOC_KINDS: Record<string, { pathCol: string; nameCol?: string; expCol: string | null; label: string; folder: string; hint: string }> = {
  license:      { pathCol:'license_doc_path',           nameCol:'license_doc_name', expCol:'license_expiry',            label:'Trade licence',              folder:'licence',   hint:'Required. Your current DED / free-zone trade licence.' },
  profile:      { pathCol:'company_profile_doc_path',                               expCol:null,                        label:'Company profile',            folder:'profile',   hint:'Your company introduction deck or PDF. Shown to customers after a reveal.' },
  vat:          { pathCol:'vat_doc_path',                                           expCol:null,                        label:'VAT certificate',            folder:'certs',     hint:'Your TRN certificate. Needed before you can invoice with VAT.' },
  insurance:    { pathCol:'insurance_doc_path',                                     expCol:'insurance_expiry',          label:'Insurance',                  folder:'certs',     hint:'Public liability or contractor all-risk cover.' },
  iso:          { pathCol:'iso_doc_path',                                           expCol:'iso_expiry',                label:'ISO certification',          folder:'certs',     hint:'Any ISO certificate you hold. Strengthens your capability score.' },
  manufacturer: { pathCol:'manufacturer_auth_doc_path',                             expCol:'manufacturer_auth_expiry',  label:'Manufacturer authorisation', folder:'certs',     hint:'Authorised-dealer letters from the brands you carry.' },
  egr:          { pathCol:'egr_doc_path',               nameCol:'egr_doc_name',     expCol:null,                        label:'Establishment card',         folder:'certs',     hint:'Your immigration establishment card (EGR).' },
  iban:         { pathCol:'iban_doc_path',              nameCol:'iban_doc_name',    expCol:null,                        label:'Bank details (IBAN)',        folder:'certs',     hint:'Bank letter confirming your IBAN. Used to pay you.' },
};
const DOC_ORDER = ['license','profile','catalogs','vat','insurance','iso','manufacturer','egr','iban'];

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: cors });
  try {
    const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace('Bearer ', '');
    const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
    if (!user || !user.email) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
    const email = user.email.toLowerCase();
    const { data: sup } = await admin.from('leads').select('id,company_name,approval_status,registration_status,license_expiry,name_corrected_from').eq('claimed_by', email).maybeSingle();
    if (!sup) return J({ error: 'no_company', hint: 'claim your company first' }, 400);
    const b = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const action = b.action;

    async function buildAlerts(){
      const out: any[] = [];
      const { data: exp } = await admin.rpc('fn_supplier_expiries', { p_supplier_id: sup.id });
      for (const e of (exp || [])) {
        if (e.status === 'expired' || e.status === 'expiring') {
          out.push({ kind:'doc_expiry', severity: e.status==='expired'?'high':'medium',
            title: e.doc + (e.status==='expired'?' has expired':' expires soon'),
            detail: 'Expiry ' + e.expiry + ' — ' + (e.days_left<0?('overdue by '+Math.abs(e.days_left)+' days'):(e.days_left+' days left')) + '. Upload a renewed copy to stay eligible.',
            action:'documents' });
        }
      }
      const { data: matches } = await admin.from('inquiry_matches').select('inquiry_id').eq('supplier_id', sup.id);
      const mids = [...new Set((matches || []).map((m:any)=>m.inquiry_id))];
      if (mids.length) {
        const { data: myq } = await admin.from('quotes').select('inquiry_id').eq('supplier_id', sup.id);
        const quoted = new Set((myq || []).map((x:any)=>x.inquiry_id));
        const { data: openInq } = await admin.from('inquiries').select('id').in('id', mids).in('status', ['sent','open','active','collecting','live','quoted']);
        const openIds = (openInq || []).map((x:any)=>x.id).filter((id:any)=>!quoted.has(id));
        if (openIds.length) out.push({ kind:'new_rfq', severity:'medium', count: openIds.length, title: openIds.length+' new RFQ'+(openIds.length>1?'s':'')+' waiting for your quote', detail:'Open requests matched to your capabilities that you have not quoted yet.', action:'inbox' });
      }
      const { count: drafts } = await admin.from('quotes').select('id',{count:'exact',head:true}).eq('supplier_id', sup.id).eq('status','draft');
      if (drafts) out.push({ kind:'draft_quote', severity:'low', count: drafts, title: drafts+' draft quote'+(drafts>1?'s':'')+' to complete', detail:'Add the missing details so we can send them to customers.', action:'inbox' });
      return out;
    }

    if (action === 'overview') {
      const { data: stats, error } = await admin.rpc('fn_supplier_stats', { p_supplier_id: sup.id });
      if (error) return J({ error: error.message }, 500);
      const [{ count: activeMatches }, alerts] = await Promise.all([
        admin.from('inquiry_matches').select('id', { count:'exact', head:true }).eq('supplier_id', sup.id),
        buildAlerts(),
      ]);
      return J({ ok:true, supplier:{ id:sup.id, company_name:sup.company_name, approval_status:sup.approval_status, registration_status:sup.registration_status, license_expiry: sup.license_expiry || null, name_corrected: !!sup.name_corrected_from }, stats, active_matches: activeMatches || 0, alerts, alerts_count: alerts.length });
    }

    if (action === 'documents') {
      // Column list is derived from DOC_KINDS so adding a document type here needs no edit below.
      const cols = new Set<string>(['catalog_doc_paths']);
      for (const k of Object.values(DOC_KINDS)) { cols.add(k.pathCol); if (k.nameCol) cols.add(k.nameCol); if (k.expCol) cols.add(k.expCol); }
      const { data: l } = await admin.from('leads').select([...cols].join(',')).eq('id', sup.id).maybeSingle();
      const row = (l || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;

      const cats: string[] = Array.isArray(row.catalog_doc_paths) ? (row.catalog_doc_paths as string[]) : [];
      const catalogues: { path: string; name: string; url: string | null }[] = [];
      for (const p of cats.slice(0, 20)) {
        catalogues.push({ path: p, name: String(p).split('/').pop() || 'Catalogue', url: await sign('supplier-docs', p) });
      }

      const today = new Date(); today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      const docs: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
      for (const key of DOC_ORDER) {
        if (key === 'catalogs') {
          docs.push({ key:'catalogs', label:'Catalogues', hint:'Product or project catalogues. Upload as many as you like - new files are added, never replaced.',
            path: cats.length ? 'catalogs' : null, expiry:null, url:null, name:null, required:false,
            count: cats.length, urls: catalogues.map((c) => c.url).filter(Boolean), items: catalogues,
            status: cats.length ? 'on_file' : 'missing' });
          continue;
        }
        const k = DOC_KINDS[key]; if (!k) continue;
        const path = (row[k.pathCol] as string) || null;
        const expiry = k.expCol ? ((row[k.expCol] as string) || null) : null;
        // Filename falls back to the stored path's tail so the supplier always sees which file is on record.
        const name = (k.nameCol ? (row[k.nameCol] as string) : null) || (path ? String(path).split('/').pop() : null) || null;
        let status = 'missing';
        if (path) {
          status = 'on_file';
          if (expiry) {
            const d = Math.round((new Date(expiry).getTime() - today.getTime()) / 864e5);
            status = d < 0 ? 'expired' : d <= 30 ? 'expiring' : 'valid';
          }
        }
        docs.push({ key, label: k.label, hint: k.hint, path, name, expiry, has_expiry: !!k.expCol,
          required: key === 'license', status, url: await sign('supplier-docs', path) });
      }

      const required = docs.filter((d) => d.required);
      const complete = docs.filter((d) => d.status !== 'missing').length;
      const expiries = await admin.rpc('fn_supplier_expiries', { p_supplier_id: sup.id });
      return J({ ok:true, documents: docs, expiries: expiries.data || [],
        summary: { total: docs.length, on_file: complete, missing: docs.length - complete,
          required_missing: required.filter((d) => d.status === 'missing').length,
          attention: docs.filter((d) => d.status === 'expired' || d.status === 'expiring').length } });
    }

    if (action === 'save_documents') {
      const items = Array.isArray(b.items) ? b.items : [];
      const upd: Record<string, unknown> = { portal_updated_at: new Date().toISOString() };
      const saved: string[] = [];
      const failed: { kind: string; reason: string }[] = [];
      const { data: _isec } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', 'inbound_secret').maybeSingle();
      const INBOUND_SECRET = (_isec?.value as string) || '';
      let catAppend: string[] = [];
      for (const it of items) {
        const kindStr = String(it.kind || '');
        if (kindStr === 'catalogs') {
          if (it.original_b64) {
            try {
              const u8 = b64ToBytes(String(it.original_b64));
              const fn = String(it.filename || 'catalog').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9._-]/g, '_').slice(0, 120);
              const p = `catalogs/${sup.id}/${Date.now()}_${fn}`;
              const { error: upErr } = await admin.storage.from('supplier-docs').upload(p, u8, { contentType: it.mime || 'application/octet-stream', upsert: true });
              if (upErr) { failed.push({ kind: 'catalogs', reason: upErr.message }); continue; }
              catAppend.push(p); saved.push('catalogs');
            } catch (e) { failed.push({ kind: 'catalogs', reason: String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0, 200) }); }
          }
          continue;
        }
        const kind = DOC_KINDS[kindStr]; if (!kind) continue;
        if (it.original_b64) {

          // storage write had failed. Failures are now returned to the caller.
          try {
            const u8 = b64ToBytes(String(it.original_b64));
            const clean = String(it.filename || kindStr).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9._-]/g, '_').slice(0, 120);
            const p = `${kind.folder}/${sup.id}/${Date.now()}_${clean}`;
            const { error: upErr } = await admin.storage.from('supplier-docs').upload(p, u8, { contentType: it.mime || 'application/octet-stream', upsert: true });
            if (upErr) { failed.push({ kind: kindStr, reason: upErr.message }); continue; }
            upd[kind.pathCol] = p;
            if (kind.nameCol) upd[kind.nameCol] = String(it.filename || clean).slice(0, 200);
          } catch (e) { failed.push({ kind: kindStr, reason: String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0, 200) }); continue; }
        }

        // uploaded document, so the expiry gate can't be bypassed with a self-typed date. The typed
        // value is used only as a fallback when extraction fails or the document has no clear date.
        let licExpiryFromDoc = false;
        if (kindStr === 'license' && it.original_b64 && INBOUND_SECRET) {
          try {
            const isImg = /^image\//.test(String(it.mime || ''));
            const payload: Record<string, unknown> = isImg
              ? { __secret: INBOUND_SECRET, mode: 'license', images: [{ b64: String(it.original_b64), mime: it.mime }] }
              : { __secret: INBOUND_SECRET, mode: 'license', file_b64: String(it.original_b64), mime: it.mime, filename: it.filename };
            const r = await fetch(`${SUPA_URL}/functions/v1/license_extract`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
            const jd = await r.json();
            if (jd?.ok && jd.doc) {
              const d = jd.doc;
              if (d.expiry_date) { upd.license_expiry = d.expiry_date; licExpiryFromDoc = true; }
              if (d.license_number) upd.trade_license_no = d.license_number;
              if (d.license_authority) upd.license_authority = d.license_authority;
              if (d.city) upd.license_city = d.city;
              upd.doc_extracted_at = new Date().toISOString();
            }
          } catch (_e) { /* fall back to the typed value below */ }
        }
        // LICENCE EXPIRY FIX 27 Jul 2026. The fallback above ran whenever extraction had not produced
        // a date - including when NO document was attached at all, since the extraction block requires
        // it.original_b64. A supplier could therefore POST { kind:'license', expiry:'2030-01-01' } with

        // them is read server-side and none of them is self-asserted against an automatic suspension.
        if (kindStr === 'license') {

              ? { kind: kindStr, reason: 'Your trade licence file was saved, but we could not read the expiry date from it, so the expiry on file is unchanged. Please upload a clear copy of the full licence page (PDF or a sharp photo).' }
              : { kind: kindStr, reason: 'A trade licence document is required. The licence expiry is read from the licence itself and cannot be entered by hand — please attach your current trade licence.' });
            if (!it.original_b64) continue;
          }
        } else if (kind.expCol && it.expiry) upd[kind.expCol] = String(it.expiry).slice(0, 10);
        saved.push(kindStr);
      }
      if (catAppend.length) {
        const { data: cur } = await admin.from('leads').select('catalog_doc_paths').eq('id', sup.id).maybeSingle();
        const existing: string[] = Array.isArray(cur?.catalog_doc_paths) ? (cur!.catalog_doc_paths as string[]) : [];
        upd.catalog_doc_paths = [...existing, ...catAppend].slice(0, 20);
      }

    }

    // Why am I not being matched?
    //
    // Every check below mirrors a real clause in match_suppliers_kw. Nothing here is
    // advisory dressed up as a rule, and nothing that genuinely gates matching is omitted,
    // because a supplier acting on this will conclude they have done everything needed.
    //
    // On document expiry: match_suppliers_kw itself has no expiry clause, so reading only that
    // function suggests expiry is irrelevant. It is not. fn_reconcile_doc_blocks runs daily and
    // sets matching_blocked with matching_block_reason when a trade licence or insurance lapses,
    // and match_suppliers_kw does exclude matching_blocked. Expiry therefore genuinely stops
    // matching - one indirection away - which is why it is reported as blocking below.
    if (action === 'eligibility') {
      const { data: l } = await admin.from('leads')
        .select('id,company_name,sector,categories,products,services,capability_summary,emirate,service_emirates,permanently_closed,banned,matching_blocked,matching_block_reason,license_expiry,insurance_expiry,registration_submitted_at,source,approval_status,license_doc_path,phone,email')
        .eq('id', sup.id).maybeSingle();
      const r = (l || {}) as Record<string, any>;
      const has = (v: unknown) => !!(v != null && String(v).trim() !== '');

      const blocking: any[] = [];
      if (r.permanently_closed === true) blocking.push({ code:'permanently_closed', title:'Your listing is marked permanently closed', detail:'We will not send you requests while this is set. Contact us if this is wrong.', fix:'contact' });
      if (r.banned === true) blocking.push({ code:'banned', title:'Your account is suspended', detail:'Suspended accounts are excluded from all matching. Contact us to resolve it.', fix:'contact' });
      if (r.matching_blocked === true) {
        // The reason matters. fn_reconcile_doc_blocks suspends automatically on an expired trade
        // licence or insurance and restores automatically on renewal, so telling that supplier the
        // block was "set manually by our team" would send them to support for something they can
        // fix themselves in two minutes - and would be false.
        const reason = String(r.matching_block_reason || '');
        if (reason === 'licence_expired') {
          blocking.push({ code:'licence_expired', title:'Your account is paused - trade licence expired',
            detail:'Your trade licence expired on ' + (r.license_expiry || 'an earlier date') + '. Upload a valid copy and your account is restored automatically, usually within a day. There is no fee.',
            fix:'documents' });
        } else if (reason === 'insurance_expired') {
          blocking.push({ code:'insurance_expired', title:'Your account is paused - insurance expired',
            detail:'Your insurance certificate expired on ' + (r.insurance_expiry || 'an earlier date') + '. Upload a valid copy and your account is restored automatically. There is no fee.',
            fix:'documents' });
        } else {
          blocking.push({ code:'matching_blocked', title:'Matching is switched off for your account',
            detail:'This was set by our team rather than automatically. Contact us to have it reviewed.', fix:'contact' });
        }
      }
      const registered = !!r.registration_submitted_at || r.source === 'self_registered' || String(r.approval_status || '') === 'approved';
      if (!registered) blocking.push({ code:'not_registered', title:'Your registration is not submitted', detail:'Only registered suppliers receive requests. Complete your company profile to submit it.', fix:'profile' });

      // Discoverability: the query matches on sector OR keywords across these four columns.
      // With all of them empty a supplier is unreachable no matter how many requests come in.
      const kwCols = ['products','services','categories','capability_summary'];
      const kwFilled = kwCols.filter((c) => has(r[c]));
      if (!has(r.sector) && kwFilled.length === 0) {
        blocking.push({ code:'undiscoverable', title:'Nothing describes what you supply', detail:'Requests are matched on your sector, products, services and categories. All of these are empty, so no request can reach you.', fix:'profile' });
      }

      const improving: any[] = [];
      if (!has(r.sector)) improving.push({ code:'no_sector', title:'Set your sector', detail:'A matching sector adds 2 points to your score on every request in that category, which decides who makes the shortlist.', fix:'profile' });
      for (const c of kwCols) if (!has(r[c])) improving.push({ code:'empty_' + c, title:'Add your ' + c.replace('_', ' '), detail:'Each keyword found here raises your match score. Empty fields cannot match anything.', fix:'profile' });
      if (!has(r.emirate) && !(Array.isArray(r.service_emirates) && r.service_emirates.length)) {
        improving.push({ code:'no_emirate', title:'Set the emirates you serve', detail:'Suppliers in the customer’s emirate are ranked above everyone else, so this is the single strongest ranking signal.', fix:'profile' });
      }
      if (!has(r.license_doc_path)) improving.push({ code:'no_licence', title:'Upload your trade licence', detail:'Required before your account can be approved.', fix:'documents' });
      // #86: surface the capability agent's scope questions so the supplier can confirm or correct what
      // we understood they do. Precise scope = only relevant inquiries, which is what keeps suppliers here.
      try {
        const { data: cc } = await admin.from('supplier_capability_confirmation')
          .select('proposed').eq('supplier_id', sup.id).is('confirmed_at', null)
          .order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(1).maybeSingle();
        const pr = (cc?.proposed || {}) as Record<string, any>;
        const qs = Array.isArray(pr.confirm_questions) ? pr.confirm_questions.filter(Boolean).map((q: unknown) => String(q)) : [];
        if (pr.confirm_summary || qs.length) {
          improving.push({ code:'confirm_scope', title:'Confirm what your company does',
            detail: (pr.confirm_summary ? String(pr.confirm_summary) + ' ' : '') +
                    (qs.length ? 'Please confirm or correct this, and it helps us to know: ' + qs.join('  ') : 'Please confirm or correct this so we only send you relevant requests.'),
            fix:'profile', questions: qs });
        }
      } catch (_e) { /* non-blocking */ }
      // Warn while it is still fixable, not after the account has already been paused.
      for (const [col, label] of [['license_expiry','trade licence'], ['insurance_expiry','insurance certificate']] as [string,string][]) {
        const v = r[col]; if (!v) continue;
        const days = Math.round((new Date(v).getTime() - Date.now()) / 864e5);
        if (days >= 0 && days <= 30) improving.push({ code: 'expiring_' + col, title: 'Your ' + label + ' expires in ' + days + ' day' + (days === 1 ? '' : 's'),
          detail: 'Once it expires your account is paused automatically and you stop receiving requests. Upload a renewed copy now to avoid that.', fix:'documents' });
      }
      if (!has(r.phone)) improving.push({ code:'no_phone', title:'Add a contact number', detail:'Customers cannot reach you after a reveal without one.', fix:'profile' });

      // Reach so far, measured rather than asserted.
      const [{ count: matched }, { count: quoted }] = await Promise.all([
        admin.from('inquiry_matches').select('id', { count:'exact', head:true }).eq('supplier_id', sup.id),
        admin.from('quotes').select('id', { count:'exact', head:true }).eq('supplier_id', sup.id),
      ]);

      return J({ ok:true,
        eligible: blocking.length === 0,
        blocking, improving,
        reach: { matched_requests: matched || 0, quotes_sent: quoted || 0, shortlist_size: 8 },
        note: 'Each request goes to a shortlist of up to 8 suppliers, ranked first by whether you serve the customer’s emirate, then by how well your listing matches what they asked for.' });
    }

    return J({ error: 'unknown_action', action }, 400);
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/supplier_review/index.ts

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
const CLAUDE_MODELS = ['anthropic/claude-sonnet-5','anthropic/claude-opus-4.8'];

const SYS = `You are a data-quality reviewer for QuotesDone, a UAE supplier marketplace. A supplier has just submitted their registration. Your job is to catch obvious mistakes BEFORE a human admin reviews it, so the admin's job is easy.

Check the provided fields for problems such as:
- Spelling mistakes or garbled text in the company name, services, or products.
- Placeholder / junk values (e.g. 'asdf', 'test', 'N/A', 'none', '123', random characters).
- Format issues: UAE TRN (VAT) should be 15 digits; UAE IBAN should start with 'AE' and be 23 characters; UAE mobile usually starts +9715 / 05; trade licence numbers are typically numeric.
- Mismatches: services/products that don't match the stated trade/sector; emirate that isn't a real UAE emirate.
- Missing critical info for matching (no services/products described).
- Anything that looks copy-pasted wrong or internally inconsistent.

Be practical, not pedantic — minor stylistic things are fine. Only flag things a human should actually look at or fix.

Return STRICT JSON only (no markdown), exact shape:
{"ok": boolean,                      // true if the registration looks clean enough to approve
 "severity": "clean"|"minor"|"review",  // clean = no issues, minor = small fixable issues, review = needs human attention
 "issues": [ {"field": string, "note": string} ],   // each problem found, empty array if none
 "summary": string }                  // one short sentence an admin reads at a glance`;

function parseJson(txt: string) { try { return JSON.parse(txt); } catch { const m = txt.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (m) { try { return JSON.parse(m[0]); } catch { /* */ } } throw new Error('AI returned non-JSON'); } }

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const { data: sec } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', 'inbound_secret').maybeSingle();
    if (!sec?.value || body.__secret !== sec.value) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
    const { data: keyRow } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', 'openrouter_api_key').maybeSingle();
    if (!keyRow?.value) return J({ ok: true, severity: 'clean', issues: [], summary: 'AI review unavailable (not configured).', fallback: true });

    const p = body.profile || {};
    const fields = ['company_name','sector','emirate','service_emirates','contact_name','signatory_name','phone','services','products','description','trade_license_no','license_authority','license_expiry','trn','egr_number','bank_name','bank_account_name','bank_iban'];
    const lines = fields.filter((f) => p[f] !== undefined && p[f] !== null && String(p[f]).trim() !== '').map((f) => `${f}: ${Array.isArray(p[f]) ? p[f].join(', ') : p[f]}`);
    const userMsg = 'SUPPLIER REGISTRATION TO REVIEW:\n' + lines.join('\n');

    const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${keyRow.value}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'HTTP-Referer': 'https://quotesdone.com', 'X-Title': 'QuotesDone' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ models: CLAUDE_MODELS, max_tokens: 800, temperature: 0.1, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: SYS }, { role: 'user', content: userMsg }] }),
    });
    const d = await r.json();
    if (!r.ok) return J({ ok: true, severity: 'clean', issues: [], summary: 'AI review failed; manual check advised.', fallback: true });
    let review;
    try { review = parseJson(d?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '{}'); }
    catch { return J({ ok: true, severity: 'clean', issues: [], summary: 'AI review unreadable; manual check advised.', fallback: true }); }
    if (!Array.isArray(review.issues)) review.issues = [];
    return J({ ok: review.ok !== false, severity: review.severity || (review.issues.length ? 'review' : 'clean'), issues: review.issues, summary: review.summary || '' });
  } catch (e) {
    return J({ ok: true, severity: 'clean', issues: [], summary: 'AI review error; manual check advised.', error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) });
  }
});
```

### supabase/functions/sync_src_from_github/index.ts

```typescript
// sync_src_from_github — makes the git repo the single source of truth for the deployed site.
//
// WHY THIS EXISTS. quotesdone.com is built by deploy_next_preview from the qd_deploy_src table, while
// the app is developed in git. The two drifted into different applications: the repo carried a blog,
// MobileNav, lib/seo.ts and newer portals that had never shipped, while the table carried a console
// far ahead of the repo (OsxShell 272KB vs 67KB) plus Content Studio edits written straight to the
// table. Publishing either side over the other destroyed work. After a one-off reconciliation the repo
// now holds the correct union, and this function keeps the table derived FROM the repo instead of
// beside it. Run it after every push; the table stops being a place anyone edits by hand.
//
// NOT A DELETER. It only inserts and updates. Rows in qd_deploy_src that are absent from the repo are
// reported in `extra` and left alone — losing a Content Studio page to a sync would be the exact
// failure this whole exercise was about.
//
// AUTH. This publishes source that becomes the live site, so it takes deploy authority
// (__deploy_secret / app_secrets 'deploy_secret'), not the general inbound secret.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string|undefined)||undefined; }
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;

// The deploy set. Everything under these prefixes, plus these exact root files. Anything else in the
// repo (supabase/functions, docs, scripts, graphify-out, node_modules, .next) is not part of the site
// build and must never reach Vercel.
const PREFIXES = ['src/', 'messages/'];
const ROOT_FILES = ['package.json', 'next.config.mjs', 'postcss.config.mjs', 'tailwind.config.ts', 'tsconfig.json', 'next-env.d.ts'];
const EXCLUDE = new Set<string>([]);

function wanted(p: string): boolean {
  if (EXCLUDE.has(p)) return false;
  if (ROOT_FILES.includes(p)) return true;
  return PREFIXES.some((pre) => p.startsWith(pre));
}

// GitHub blobs come back base64 of the RAW BYTES. Decoding with atob alone yields latin-1 and would
// corrupt every Arabic string in messages/ar.json and the content JSONs, so the bytes are rebuilt and
// decoded as UTF-8 explicitly.
function b64utf8(b64: string): string {
  const bin = atob(String(b64).replace(/\s+/g, ''));
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
  return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(bytes);
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
    const dep = await sec('deploy_secret');
    if (!secretOk(dep) || body.__deploy_secret !== dep) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);

    const token = await sec('github_token'); if (!token) return J({ ok: false, error: 'github_token not configured' }, 200);
    const repo = (await sec('github_repo')) || 'ahmadmhdnabilalzain-bot/quotesdone';
    const branch = (await sec('github_branch')) || 'main';
    const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token, Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json', 'User-Agent': 'quotesdone-sync' };
    const api = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + repo;

    const tr = await fetch(api + '/git/trees/' + encodeURIComponent(branch) + '?recursive=1', { headers: H });
    const tj = await tr.json();
    if (!tr.ok) return J({ ok: false, error: 'tree_failed', status: tr.status, detail: String(tj?.message || '').slice(0, 200) }, 200);
    // A truncated tree would silently sync a PARTIAL site, which is worse than not syncing at all.
    if (tj?.truncated) return J({ ok: false, error: 'tree_truncated', note: 'GitHub truncated the recursive tree; sync aborted rather than publish a partial file set' }, 200);

    const blobs = (tj.tree || []).filter((n: any) => n.type === 'blob' && wanted(String(n.path)));
    if (!blobs.length) return J({ ok: false, error: 'no_matching_files', tree_size: (tj.tree || []).length }, 200);

    const { data: existingRows } = await admin.from('qd_deploy_src').select('path,data');
    const existing = new Map<string, string>((existingRows || []).map((r: any) => [r.path as string, r.data as string]));

    const changed: string[] = []; const added: string[] = []; const failed: any[] = []; const shrank: any[] = [];
    let unchanged = 0;

    for (const n of blobs) {
      const path = String(n.path);
      try {
        const br = await fetch(api + '/git/blobs/' + n.sha, { headers: H });
        const bj = await br.json();
        if (!br.ok) { failed.push({ path, status: br.status, detail: String(bj?.message || '').slice(0, 120) }); continue; }
        const text = bj.encoding === 'base64' ? b64utf8(bj.content) : String(bj.content ?? '');
        const prev = existing.get(path);
        if (prev === text) { unchanged++; continue; }
        // SHRINK GUARD. The whole hazard of a repo->table sync is publishing a STALE branch over a
        // file the live side is ahead on. That is not hypothetical: at the time this was written the
        // repo's OsxShell.tsx was 66,920 bytes against the live console's 272,001, so one sync from an
        // unpushed branch would have destroyed the console. A file collapsing to under half its
        // current size is the signature of that mistake, never of a normal edit, so it is refused and
        // reported rather than written. Pass allow_shrink:true to override deliberately.
        if (prev !== undefined && prev.length > 2000 && text.length < prev.length * 0.5 && !body.allow_shrink) {
          shrank.push({ path, from: prev.length, to: text.length });
          continue;
        }
        if (!body.dry_run) {
          if (prev === undefined) {
            const { error } = await admin.from('qd_deploy_src').insert({ path, data: text });
            if (error) { failed.push({ path, detail: error.message }); continue; }
          } else {
            const { error } = await admin.from('qd_deploy_src').update({ data: text }).eq('path', path);
            if (error) { failed.push({ path, detail: error.message }); continue; }
          }
        }
        (prev === undefined ? added : changed).push(path);
      } catch (e) { failed.push({ path, detail: String((e as Error)?.message || e).slice(0, 120) }); }
    }

    const repoPaths = new Set(blobs.map((n: any) => String(n.path)));
    const extra = [...existing.keys()].filter((p) => !repoPaths.has(p));

    const counts = { matched: blobs.length, added: added.length, changed: changed.length, unchanged, failed: failed.length, refused_shrink: shrank.length, extra: extra.length, dry_run: !!body.dry_run };
    try {
      await admin.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'sync_src_from_github', status: (failed.length || shrank.length) ? 'error' : 'ok', counts,
        note: (shrank.length ? 'REFUSED to shrink ' + shrank.length + ' file(s) by more than half - this is the signature of syncing a stale branch over a file the live side is ahead on, so those files were left untouched and the rest of the sync completed: ' + shrank.map((x: any) => x.path + ' ' + x.from + '->' + x.to).join('; ') + '. ' : '') +
              (failed.length ? 'Some files failed to sync, so qd_deploy_src is a PARTIAL mix of repo and previous state — do not publish until this is resolved. ' : '') +
              (extra.length ? 'Rows present in qd_deploy_src but absent from the repo were left untouched: ' + extra.join(', ') : ''),
        started_at: new Date(t0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
    } catch (_e) { /* never block the sync on a log write */ }

    return J({ ok: failed.length === 0 && shrank.length === 0, ...counts, added, changed, shrank, extra, failed, branch, repo }, 200);
  } catch (e) { return J({ ok: false, error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/transcribe/index.ts

```typescript
// transcribe — server-side speech-to-text via OpenRouter audio models (funded key that powers the agents).
// Replaces the browser Web Speech API (broke on Safari/iOS, poor with UAE Arabic/English mixed speech).
// Client records WAV. Prompt is NEUTRAL + anti-hallucination (no domain priming) so silence/noise returns empty. Auth-gated.
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const CORS = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type, apikey', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' };
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS } });
async function sec(k: string): Promise<string | null> { const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string) || null; }
const PROMPT = 'Transcribe the spoken words in this audio EXACTLY as spoken, word for word. The speaker may talk in Arabic, English, or a mix of both (United Arab Emirates). Output ONLY the transcribed words and nothing else. Do NOT translate, summarise, correct, complete, punctuate creatively, or invent anything. Keep numbers, measurements and units as spoken. If the audio contains no clear human speech - for example silence, background noise, music, or a tone - output an empty string only, and never guess or fabricate any sentence.';

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  try {
    const jwt = (req.headers.get('Authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
    const { data: { user } } = await admin.auth.getUser(jwt);
    if (!user) return J({ error: 'Not signed in' }, 401);
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    let b64 = String(body.audio_b64 || body.audio || '');
    b64 = b64.replace(/^data:[^;,]*;base64,/, '').replace(/^data:[^,]*,/, '');
    const mime = String(body.mime || 'audio/wav').toLowerCase();
    const format = mime.includes('mp3') || mime.includes('mpeg') ? 'mp3' : 'wav';
    if (!b64 || b64.length < 100) return J({ error: 'empty_audio' }, 400);
    if (b64.length > 22_000_000) return J({ error: 'Audio too long. Please keep it under about 2 minutes.' }, 413);
    const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key'); if (!key) return J({ error: 'transcription_not_configured' }, 500);

    const payload = { messages: [{ role: 'user', content: [ { type: 'text', text: PROMPT }, { type: 'input_audio', input_audio: { data: b64, format } } ] }], temperature: 0, max_tokens: 1024 };
    let text: string | null = null; let lastErr = '';
    for (const model of ['google/gemini-2.5-flash', 'google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite', 'google/gemini-2.5-pro']) {
      try {
        const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + key, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ model, ...payload }) });
        const j = await r.json();
        if (!r.ok) { lastErr = JSON.stringify(j?.error || j).slice(0, 220); continue; }
        const c = j?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content;
        let t = (typeof c === 'string' ? c : Array.isArray(c) ? c.map((p: any) => p?.text || '').join('') : '').trim();
        // strip common non-speech placeholders a model might emit
        if (/^(\(|\[)?\s*(no (clear )?(human )?speech|silence|inaudible|no audio|blank|empty)\s*(\)|\])?\.?$/i.test(t)) t = '';
        text = t; break;
      } catch (e) { lastErr = String((e as Error)?.message || e); }
    }
    if (text === null) return J({ error: 'transcription_failed', detail: lastErr }, 502);
    return J({ ok: true, text });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/translate_html/index.ts

````typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const {data}=await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string|undefined)||undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
const SYS = `You are a professional English→Arabic translator for a UAE B2B quotation marketplace called QuotesDone.
Translate the VISIBLE TEXT of the given HTML fragment into natural, fluent Modern Standard Arabic (فصحى) appropriate for UAE business users.
HARD RULES:
1. Preserve ALL HTML tags, attributes, class names, ids, hrefs and overall structure EXACTLY as-is. Do not add, remove, or reorder tags.
2. Do NOT translate: the brand name "QuotesDone", any URL/href/src, email addresses, numbers, dates, currency codes (AED), or code.
3. Translate human-readable text between tags, and the VALUE of placeholder/title/aria-label/alt attributes when present.
4. Keep it accurate and professional. For legal text, translate faithfully and precisely.
5. Output ONLY the translated HTML fragment — no explanations, no markdown fences.`;
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const b = await req.json().catch(()=>({} as any));
    const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
    if (!secretOk(__exp) || b.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error:'forbidden' }, 403);
    const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key'); if(!key) return J({ error:'no_key' }, 500);
    const html = String(b.html||''); if(!html) return J({ error:'no_html' }, 400);
    // Primary model + automatic fallbacks (retired slugs like claude-3.5-sonnet 404 on this account).
    const model = b.model || 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-5';
    const models = [model, 'openai/gpt-4o', 'openai/gpt-4o-mini'].filter((v,i,a)=>a.indexOf(v)===i);
    const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', { method:'POST', headers:{ 'Authorization':'Bearer '+key, 'Content-Type':'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ models, temperature:0.2, max_tokens:8000, messages:[{role:'system',content:SYS},{role:'user',content:html}] }) });
    const jd = await r.json();
    if(!r.ok) return J({ error:'llm_failed', status:r.status, detail: JSON.stringify(jd).slice(0,400) }, 200);
    let out = jd?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '';
    out = out.replace(/^```[a-z]*\n?/i,'').replace(/```\s*$/,'').trim();
    return J({ ok:true, ar: out, model: jd?.model || model, usage: jd?.usage||null });
  } catch (e) { return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 500); }
});
````

````typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
async function sec(k: string){ const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key', k).maybeSingle(); return (data?.value as string | undefined) || undefined; }
// FAIL-CLOSED 27 Jul 2026: sec() returns undefined/'' when the app_secrets read fails or the row is
// missing, and the guard below compared strictly, so a caller posting {} matched and gained full
// service-role authority on a function that requires no JWT. The stored secret must now be a real
// value before any caller value can equal it.
const secretOk = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length >= 24;
const SYS = 'You are a professional English to Arabic translator for a UAE B2B quotation marketplace called QuotesDone. Translate the VISIBLE TEXT of the given HTML fragment into natural, fluent Modern Standard Arabic for UAE business users. The fragment may have unbalanced tags (a slice of a larger document) - that is fine, keep tags exactly. HARD RULES: 1) Preserve ALL HTML tags, attributes, classes, ids, hrefs and structure EXACTLY, even if unbalanced. 2) Do NOT translate: brand name QuotesDone, URLs/href/src, emails, numbers, dates, AED, code. 3) Preserve any placeholder tokens of the form {{...}} EXACTLY as-is (for example {{LOC_THE}} and {{LOC}}) - never translate, alter, space, or remove them. 4) Translate text between tags and placeholder/title/aria-label/alt attribute VALUES. 5) Faithful and precise, including legal text. 6) Output ONLY the translated HTML fragment, no fences, no notes.';
function chunk(html: string, size = 4500): string[] {
  if (html.length <= size) return [html];
  const parts = html.split(/(<[^>]+>)/); const chunks: string[] = []; let buf = '';
  for (const p of parts) { buf += p; if (p.startsWith('</') && buf.length >= size) { chunks.push(buf); buf = ''; } }
  if (buf.trim()) chunks.push(buf); return chunks;
}
async function llm(key: string, model: string, html: string): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const r = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + key, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ model, temperature: 0.2, max_tokens: 8000, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: SYS }, { role: 'user', content: html }] }) });
    const jd = await r.json(); if (!r.ok) return null;
    let out = jd?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || ''; out = out.replace(/^```[a-z]*\n?/i, '').replace(/```\s*$/, '').trim(); return out || null;
  } catch (_e) { return null; }
}
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  const b = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
  const __exp = await sec('inbound_secret');
  if (!secretOk(__exp) || b.__secret !== __exp) return J({ error: 'forbidden' }, 403);
  const key = await sec('openrouter_api_key'); if (!key) return J({ error: 'no_key' }, 500);
  const source = String(b.source || ''); const slug = String(b.slug || ''); const model = b.model || 'openai/gpt-4o-mini'; const limit = Math.min(Number(b.limit || 5), 8);
  const { data: row } = await admin.from('qd_deploy_src').select('data').eq('path', 'src/content/' + source + '.json').maybeSingle();
  if (!row) return J({ error: 'no_source' }, 404);
  let data: any; try { data = JSON.parse((row as any).data); } catch (_e) { return J({ error: 'bad_json' }, 500); }
  const d = data[slug]; if (!d) return J({ error: 'no_slug' }, 404);
  const cs = chunk(d.html); const total = cs.length;
  const { data: have } = await admin.from('qd_i18n_chunks').select('idx').eq('source', source).eq('slug', slug);
  const haveSet = new Set((have || []).map((x: any) => x.idx));
  const missing: number[] = []; for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) if (!haveSet.has(i)) missing.push(i);
  const work = async () => {
    let n = 0;
    for (const i of missing) { if (n >= limit) break; const ar = await llm(key, model, cs[i]); if (ar != null) { await admin.from('qd_i18n_chunks').upsert({ source, slug, idx: i, ar }); n++; } }
    const { data: nowHave } = await admin.from('qd_i18n_chunks').select('idx, ar').eq('source', source).eq('slug', slug);
    if ((nowHave || []).length >= total) {
      const byIdx = new Map((nowHave || []).map((x: any) => [x.idx, x.ar]));
      const full = Array.from({ length: total }, (_, i) => byIdx.get(i) || '').join('');
      let at = await llm(key, 'openai/gpt-4o-mini', '<h1>' + d.title + '</h1>'); at = (at || d.title).replace(/<\/?h1>/g, '').trim();
      await admin.from('qd_i18n').upsert({ source, slug, title: at, html: full, status: 'done', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() });
    }
  };
  const ER = (globalThis as any).EdgeRuntime; if (ER && ER.waitUntil) ER.waitUntil(work()); else await work();
  return J({ ok: true, source, slug, total, have: haveSet.size, missing: missing.length });
});
````
