### supabase/functions/wa_templates_watch/index.ts

```typescript
// wa_templates_watch - polls Twilio for WhatsApp template approval; when ALL approved, flips wa_templates_ready='true' and emails the founder.
import { createClient } from 'https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const sb = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const T0 = Date.now();
async function logRun(status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    await sb.from('agent_runs').insert({ agent: 'wa_templates_watch', status, counts,
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
      started_at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), finished_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch (_e) { /* never let logging break the function */ }
}
async function logThrottled(signal: string, minutes: number, status: string, counts: Record<string, unknown>, note: string) {
  try {
    const since = new Date(Date.now() - minutes * 60000).toISOString();
    const { data } = await sb.from('agent_runs').select('id').eq('agent', 'wa_templates_watch')
      .gte('started_at', since).eq('counts->>signal', signal).limit(1);
    if (data && data.length) return;
  } catch (_e) { /* fall through and log */ }
  await logRun(status, { ...counts, signal }, note);
}
async function sec(k:string){ const {data}=await sb.from('app_secrets').select('value').eq('key',k).maybeSingle(); return data?.value as string|undefined; }
const J=(o:unknown,s=200)=>new Response(JSON.stringify(o,null,2),{status:s,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});

Deno.serve(async ()=>{
  try{
    // already ready = idle run that does no work, deliberately not logged
    if(((await sec('wa_templates_ready'))||'false')==='true') return J({ ok:true, already_ready:true });
    const ks=await sec('twilio_api_key_sid'); const kk=await sec('twilio_api_key_secret');
    if(!ks||!kk) { await logThrottled('no_twilio_creds', 60, 'error', { stage:'config' }, 'twilio_api_key_sid/secret missing from app_secrets: WhatsApp template approval can never be detected, so wa_templates_ready is never flipped and suppliers and customers never receive WhatsApp job, quote or unlock alerts'); return J({ ok:false, error:'no_twilio_creds' }); }
    const auth='Basic '+btoa(`${ks}:${kk}`);
    let mapParseErr='';
    let map:any={}; try{ map=JSON.parse((await sec('wa_template_sids'))||'{}'); }catch(_){ mapParseErr=String(_); map={}; }
    const sids:{name:string,sid:string}[]=[];
    for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(map)){ for(const [lang,sid] of Object.entries(v as any)){ sids.push({name:`${k}_${lang}`, sid:sid as string}); } }
    if(!sids.length) { await logThrottled('no_template_sids', 60, 'error', { stage:'config', map_parse_failed: mapParseErr ? 1 : 0 }, (mapParseErr ? ('wa_template_sids is not valid JSON ('+mapParseErr+'), so no templates are tracked; ') : 'wa_template_sids is empty, so no templates are tracked; ')+'approval can never complete, wa_templates_ready is never flipped and WhatsApp alerts to suppliers and customers stay permanently off'); return J({ ok:false, error:'no_template_sids' }); }
    const statuses:any[]=[]; let approved=0, rejected=0;
    for(const s of sids){
      let st='unknown';
      try{
        const r=await fetch(`https://content.twilio.com/v1/Content/${s.sid}/ApprovalRequests`,{ headers:{ 'Authorization':auth } });
        const j=await r.json();
        st = j?.whatsapp?.status || j?.status || 'unknown';
      }catch(e){ st='error:'+String(e); }
      if(st==='approved') approved++; else if(st==='rejected') rejected++;
      statuses.push({ name:s.name, sid:s.sid, status:st });
    }
    const allApproved = approved===sids.length;
    if(allApproved){
      const { error: readyErr } = await sb.from('app_secrets').upsert({ key:'wa_templates_ready', value:'true' }, { onConflict:'key' });
      // Founder email: prefer founder_email secret, else first admin_emails entry (OPEN_ISSUES #5).
      const founder = (await sec('founder_email')) || (((await sec('admin_emails'))||'').split(',')[0]||'').trim() || 'management@quotesdone.com';
      const { error: notifErr } = await sb.from('notifications').insert({ type:'wa_templates_ready', to_role:'admin', to_email:founder, channel:'email', status:'queued', subject:'✅ WhatsApp templates approved — notifications are now LIVE', body:'All 6 WhatsApp templates have been approved by Meta. QuotesDone will now send WhatsApp alerts (new job, new quote, supplier unlocked) to opted-in suppliers and customers automatically. No action needed.' });
      // stop future polling
      let cronErr='';
      try{ const { error: rpcErr } = await sb.rpc('cron_unschedule_wa_watch'); if(rpcErr) cronErr=String(rpcErr.message); }catch(_){ cronErr=String(_); /* ignore if not present */ }
      const anotes:string[]=[];
      if(readyErr) anotes.push('all '+sids.length+' WhatsApp templates are approved but writing wa_templates_ready=true FAILED ('+String(readyErr.message)+'); WhatsApp alerts stay switched off for suppliers and customers and this watcher will re-run and re-notify every 15 minutes');
      if(notifErr) anotes.push('founder notification insert failed ('+String(notifErr.message)+'); nobody was told that WhatsApp notifications are now live');
      if(cronErr) anotes.push('cron_unschedule_wa_watch failed ('+cronErr+'); this watcher keeps polling Twilio every 15 minutes forever');
      if(!anotes.length) anotes.push('all '+sids.length+' WhatsApp templates approved: wa_templates_ready flipped to true, founder notified and polling unscheduled. WhatsApp job/quote/unlock alerts are now live');
      await logRun((readyErr||notifErr||cronErr) ? 'error' : 'ok', { total:sids.length, approved, rejected, all_approved:true, ready_write_failed: readyErr?1:0, notify_failed: notifErr?1:0, cron_unschedule_failed: cronErr?1:0 }, anotes.join(' | '));
    } else {
      const bad = statuses.filter((x:any)=> x.status==='unknown' || String(x.status).startsWith('error:'));
      if(rejected){ await logThrottled('templates_rejected', 60, 'error', { total:sids.length, approved, rejected, unknown: bad.length }, rejected+' of '+sids.length+' WhatsApp templates were REJECTED by Meta ('+statuses.filter((x:any)=>x.status==='rejected').map((x:any)=>x.name).join(',')+'); approval can never reach 100%, so wa_templates_ready is never flipped and suppliers and customers will never receive WhatsApp job, quote or unlock alerts until the templates are resubmitted'); }
      else if(bad.length){ await logThrottled('twilio_status_unknown', 60, 'error', { total:sids.length, approved, rejected, unknown: bad.length }, 'could not read an approval status for '+bad.length+' of '+sids.length+' templates ('+bad.map((x:any)=>x.name+'='+x.status).slice(0,6).join(',')+'); those templates can never be counted as approved, so wa_templates_ready is never flipped and WhatsApp alerts stay off indefinitely'); }
      // otherwise: templates simply still pending = idle run that did no work, deliberately not logged
    }
    return J({ ok:true, total:sids.length, approved, rejected, all_approved:allApproved, statuses });
  }catch(e){ await logRun('error', { stage:'run' }, 'wa_templates_watch crashed: '+String((e as Error)?.message||e)+'; WhatsApp template approval was not checked this cycle, so wa_templates_ready may stay false and WhatsApp alerts to suppliers and customers stay off'); return J({ ok:false, error:String((e as Error)?.message||e) }, 500); }
});
```

### supabase/functions/yello_scrape/index.ts

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';
const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!);
const J = (o: unknown, s = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: s, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' } });
const UA = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0 Safari/537.36';
const BASE = 'https://www.yello.ae';

async function getHtml(url: string, ms = 12000): Promise<string|null> {
  try {
    const c = new AbortController(); const t = setTimeout(() => c.abort(), ms);
    const r = await fetch(url, { headers: { 'User-Agent': UA, 'Accept': 'text/html' }, signal: c.signal });
    clearTimeout(t);
    if (!r.ok) return null;
    return await r.text();
  } catch { return null; }
}

function sectorFor(cats: string[], src: string): string {
  const h = (cats.join(' ') + ' ' + src).toLowerCase();
  const map: [RegExp,string][] = [
    [/elevator|lift\b|escalator/,'elevators'],
    [/cater/,'catering'],
    [/\bevent|exhibition stand|wedding planning/,'events'],
    [/visa|pro service|typing|immigration|tasheel|amer|attestation/,'visa-pro-services'],
    [/garment|t-?shirt|uniform|clothing|apparel|tailor|embroidery/,'garments'],
    [/advertis|signage|sign board|printing|print shop|graphic/,'printing-signage'],
    [/joinery|carpentry|wooden|furniture|wood work/,'carpentry'],
    [/aluminium|aluminum/,'aluminium'],
    [/glass/,'glass'],
    [/acrylic|solid surface/,'acrylic'],
    [/steel|metal|fabrica|welding/,'steel'],
    [/floor|tiles?|marble|parquet|vinyl/,'flooring'],
    [/landscap|garden|softscape|hardscape/,'landscaping'],
    [/swimming pool|pool/,'swimming_pool'],
    [/gypsum|drywall|partition|false ceiling/,'gypsum'],
    [/paint|wallpaper/,'painting'],
    [/scaffold/,'scaffolding'],
    [/curtain|blinds|upholst/,'upholstery'],
    [/contractor|construction|fit-?out|fitout|interior/,'fitout'],
    [/building material|hardware|sanitary|plumbing|chemical|adhesive|roofing|cement|concrete|stone/,'building-materials'],
    [/trad(e|ing|ers)|supplier|general trading/,'trading']
  ];
  for (const [re,s] of map) if (re.test(h)) return s;
  return 'general';
}

function parseListing(html: string): {id:string,slug:string}[] {
  const out: Record<string,string> = {};
  const re = /\/company\/(\d+)\/([a-z0-9-]+)/gi; let m;
  while ((m = re.exec(html)) !== null) { out[m[1]] = m[2]; }
  return Object.entries(out).map(([id,slug]) => ({id,slug}));
}

function parseProfile(html: string) {
  const pick = (re: RegExp) => { const m = html.match(re); return m ? m[1].trim() : null; };
  let name = pick(/<title>([^<]+?)\s*-\s*[^<]*<\/title>/i) || pick(/<h1[^>]*>([^<]+)<\/h1>/i);
  // website: external link after 'Website address'
  let website: string|null = null;
  const wm = html.match(/Website address[\s\S]{0,300}?href=\"(https?:\/\/[^\"]+)\"/i);
  if (wm) website = wm[1];
  if (!website) {
    const re = /href=\"(https?:\/\/(?!www\.yello\.ae|yello\.ae|maps\.google|wa\.me|www\.facebook|facebook\.com|twitter\.com|x\.com|www\.linkedin|linkedin\.com|instagram\.com|api\.whatsapp)[^\"]+)\"/gi; let m; const cands: string[] = [];
    while ((m = re.exec(html)) !== null) cands.push(m[1]);
    if (cands.length) website = cands[0];
  }
  if (website) { try { const u = new URL(website); website = u.protocol + '//' + u.host; } catch { /* */ } }
  const phones = [...html.matchAll(/\+971[\d\s\-]{6,14}\d/g)].map(x => x[0].replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim());
  const phone = phones[0] || null; const mobile = phones.find(p => /\+971\s?5/.test(p)) || null;
  const wa = pick(/wa\.me\/(\d{8,15})/);
  const cats = [...html.matchAll(/\/category\/([a-z0-9-]+)(?:\/city:|\"|#)/gi)].map(x => x[1]);
  const ucats = [...new Set(cats)].filter(c => !['others'].includes(c)).slice(0, 25);
  const manager = pick(/Company manager<\/[^>]+>\s*<[^>]*>([^<]+)</i) || pick(/Company manager[\s\S]{0,80}?>([A-Z][A-Za-z .'-]{2,40})</);
  const established = pick(/Establishment year[\s\S]{0,80}?(\b(?:19|20)\d{2}\b)/i);
  return { name, website, phone, mobile, whatsapp: wa, categories: ucats, manager, established };
}

function extractEmails(html: string, host?: string): string|null {
  const raw = [...html.matchAll(/[A-Za-z0-9._%+\-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.\-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/g)].map(x => x[0].toLowerCase());
  const bad = /(\.png|\.jpg|\.jpeg|\.gif|\.webp|\.svg|example\.com|sentry|wixpress|\.wix|godaddy|cloudflare|@2x|@3x|u002|placeholder|yourdomain|email@|name@|domain\.com)/;
  const seen = new Set<string>(); const ok: string[] = [];
  for (const e of raw) { if (bad.test(e)) continue; if (e.length > 60) continue; if (seen.has(e)) continue; seen.add(e); ok.push(e); }
  if (!ok.length) return null;
  const dom = host ? host.replace(/^www\./,'') : '';
  const score = (e: string) => {
    let s = 0; const d = e.split('@')[1];
    if (dom && d.includes(dom)) s += 10;
    if (/^(info|sales|contact|enquiry|enquiries|admin|hello|office)@/.test(e)) s += 5;
    if (/(gmail|hotmail|yahoo|outlook)\./.test(d)) s -= 1;
    return s;
  };
  ok.sort((a,b) => score(b) - score(a));
  return ok[0];
}

async function auth(body: any): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!body) return false;
  const { data } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('key,value').in('key', ['inbound_secret','test_token']);
  const sec = Object.fromEntries((data||[]).map((r:any)=>[r.key,r.value]));
  return (body.__secret && body.__secret === sec.inbound_secret) || (body.__test && body.__test === sec.test_token);
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { headers: { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':'*','Access-Control-Allow-Headers':'*' } });
  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!(await auth(body))) return J({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401);
  const action = body.action;

  try {
    if (action === 'stats') {
      const { data } = await admin.rpc('exec_count_stage').catch(() => ({ data: null } as any));
      const { data: rows } = await admin.from('yello_staging').select('stage');
      const by: Record<string,number> = {}; (rows||[]).forEach((r:any)=>{ by[r.stage]=(by[r.stage]||0)+1; });
      const { count: withEmail } = await admin.from('yello_staging').select('company_id',{count:'exact',head:true}).not('email','is',null);
      return J({ ok:true, by_stage: by, with_email: withEmail||0, total: (rows||[]).length });
    }

    if (action === 'crawl_category') {
      const cat = String(body.category||'').trim();
      const city = String(body.city||'dubai').trim();
      const from = Math.max(1, parseInt(body.from_page)||1);
      const to = Math.min(from + 19, Math.max(from, parseInt(body.to_page)||from));
      if (!cat) return J({ error:'category required' },400);
      let added = 0, seen = 0; const pages: number[] = [];
      for (let p = from; p <= to; p++) {
        const url = p === 1 ? `${BASE}/category/${cat}/city:${city}` : `${BASE}/category/${cat}/${p}/city:${city}`;
        const html = await getHtml(url);
        if (!html) { pages.push(p); continue; }
        const items = parseListing(html); seen += items.length;
        for (const it of items) {
          const { error } = await admin.from('yello_staging').upsert({
            company_id: it.id, slug: it.slug, city, src_category: cat,
            profile_url: `${BASE}/company/${it.id}/${it.slug}`, stage: 'listed', updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
          }, { onConflict: 'company_id', ignoreDuplicates: true });
          if (!error) added++;
        }
        pages.push(p);
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 350));
      }
      return J({ ok:true, category: cat, city, pages: [from,to], links_seen: seen, upserted: added });
    }

    if (action === 'crawl_profiles') {
      const lim = Math.min(25, Math.max(1, parseInt(body.limit)||12));
      const { data: rows } = await admin.from('yello_staging').select('company_id,profile_url,src_category').eq('stage','listed').limit(lim);
      let done = 0, dead = 0;
      for (const r of (rows||[])) {
        const html = await getHtml(r.profile_url);
        if (!html) { await admin.from('yello_staging').update({ stage:'dead', note:'profile_fetch_failed', updated_at:new Date().toISOString() }).eq('company_id', r.company_id); dead++; continue; }
        const p = parseProfile(html);
        const sector = sectorFor(p.categories, r.src_category);
        await admin.from('yello_staging').update({
          name: p.name, website: p.website, phone: p.phone, mobile: p.mobile, whatsapp: p.whatsapp,
          categories: p.categories, manager: p.manager, established: p.established, sector,
          stage: 'profiled', updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        }).eq('company_id', r.company_id);
        done++;
        await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 300));
      }
      return J({ ok:true, profiled: done, dead });
    }

    if (action === 'crawl_emails') {
      const lim = Math.min(20, Math.max(1, parseInt(body.limit)||10));
      const { data: rows } = await admin.from('yello_staging').select('company_id,website').eq('stage','profiled').not('website','is',null).is('email', null).limit(lim);
      let found = 0, none = 0;
      for (const r of (rows||[])) {
        let host = ''; try { host = new URL(r.website).host; } catch { /* */ }
        let email: string|null = null; let src = '';
        for (const path of ['', '/contact', '/contact-us', '/about']) {
          const html = await getHtml(r.website + path, 9000);
          if (html) { email = extractEmails(html, host); if (email) { src = 'website'+path; break; } }
        }
        await admin.from('yello_staging').update({ email, email_source: email?src:null, stage:'emailed', updated_at:new Date().toISOString() }).eq('company_id', r.company_id);
        if (email) found++; else none++;
      }
      return J({ ok:true, emails_found: found, no_email: none });
    }

    return J({ error: 'unknown action' }, 400);
  } catch (e) {
    return J({ error: String((e as Error)?.message || e) }, 200);
  }
});
```

## 3. Database migrations

All migrations in `supabase/migrations/`, in filename (chronological) order. The 13 migrations belonging to the AI cost control layer appear in section 1 and are not repeated here.

> **Not included:** `supabase/schema/full_schema.sql` is a generated dump of the complete live database schema (21,358 lines, 1074 KB). It is a build artefact rather than source, so it is omitted here for length. It lives in the repository at `supabase/schema/full_schema.sql`, alongside `supabase/schema/README.md`.

### supabase/migrations/20260724_analytics_department.sql

```sql
-- ============================================================================
-- ANALYTICS department: data-grounded advisory execution.
-- Analytics is advisory (recommend) — it never acts on the business directly. But instead of
-- reasoning in the abstract, its executor pulls LIVE metrics and produces a recommendation that
-- CITES the numbers, recorded as a shared org insight.
-- ============================================================================

-- Advisory-safe executors: an executor that only READS data and RECORDS a recommendation (no business
-- side effect) may run even for advisory-tier tasks. cos_execute (v4) runs an executor when
--   ex && (task.tier <> 'advisory' OR ex.advisory_safe)
-- so "advisory = no side effects" stays true while Analytics executes a data-grounded recommendation.
alter table public.org_action_executor add column if not exists advisory_safe boolean not null default false;

-- The analytics_recommend edge function (deployed separately) pulls fn_query_platform('analytics'),
-- ('funnel',{days:30}) and ('company'), then has the analytics head synthesize a prioritized
-- recommendation citing those figures, recorded to org_memory (kind='insight'). Register it.
insert into public.org_action_executor(action_class, kind, target, params, advisory_safe, note) values
('recommend','edge','analytics_recommend','{}', true, 'Data-grounded advisory: cite live funnel/marketplace metrics, record as a shared org insight. Read-only (advisory-safe).')
on conflict (action_class) do update set kind=excluded.kind, target=excluded.target, params=excluded.params, advisory_safe=excluded.advisory_safe, note=excluded.note, active=true;

insert into public.org_memory(scope,kind,content,source) values
('analytics','policy','Analytics is advisory (recommend). Its executor analytics_recommend pulls live funnel/marketplace metrics and produces a recommendation that CITES the numbers, recorded as a shared org insight. Read + recommend only — never acts on the business directly.','founder_directive')
on conflict do nothing;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260724_autonomy_self_audit.sql

```sql
-- Unattended-growth self-audit: is every department loop alive (plan/execute/learn) or stalled? green/amber/red per dept.
create or replace function public.fn_autonomy_audit()
returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp' as $$
  with per as (
    select d.dept_key, d.name,
      (select max(created_at) from org_memory m where m.scope=d.dept_key and m.kind='plan')   as last_plan,
      (select max(created_at) from org_memory m where m.scope=d.dept_key and m.kind='lesson') as last_lesson,
      (select count(*) from org_tasks t where t.dept_key=d.dept_key and t.status in ('assigned','proposed','in_progress')) as open_tasks,
      (select count(*) from org_tasks t where t.dept_key=d.dept_key and t.status='done' and t.updated_at > now()-interval '7 days') as done_7d
    from org_departments d where d.active )
  select jsonb_build_object('as_of', now(),
    'departments', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('dept',dept_key,'name',name,'last_plan',last_plan,'last_lesson',last_lesson,'open_tasks',open_tasks,'done_7d',done_7d,
      'status', case when (last_plan is null or last_plan < now()-interval '4 days') and open_tasks=0 and done_7d=0 then 'red'
                     when (last_plan is null or last_plan < now()-interval '3 days') then 'amber' else 'green' end) order by dept_key) from per),
    'summary', (select jsonb_build_object('green', count(*) filter (where (last_plan is not null and last_plan >= now()-interval '3 days')),
        'stalled', count(*) filter (where (last_plan is null or last_plan < now()-interval '4 days') and open_tasks=0 and done_7d=0)) from per));
$$;
create or replace function public.fn_autonomy_audit_run()
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp' as $$
declare a jsonb; stalled int;
begin
  a := fn_autonomy_audit(); stalled := coalesce((a->'summary'->>'stalled')::int,0);
  insert into org_memory(scope,kind,content,source) values ('exec','audit','Autonomy self-audit: '||(a->'summary')::text||' — '||stalled||' loop(s) stalled.','autonomy_audit');
  if stalled>0 then insert into agent_actions(agent,kind,status,risk,title,recommendation,detail)
    values ('brief','autonomy_stall','pending','medium',stalled||' department loop(s) have stalled','Check fn_autonomy_audit().',a); end if;
  return a;
end $$;
-- cron: select cron.schedule('autonomy_audit_weekly','0 6 * * 1', $$select public.fn_autonomy_audit_run()$$);
```

```sql
-- CTO AUDIT HARDENING — WAVE 1 (safe, behaviour-preserving)
-- Applied to project htdblwldjkcgjvmqkbeh (suppliers DB) on 2026-07-24 via MCP apply_migration.
-- Mirrored into the repo so git reflects the live schema.

ALTER FUNCTION public.fn_marketing_library_search(text, integer) SET search_path = public;
ALTER FUNCTION public.fn_quote_spec_group(text) SET search_path = public;

-- (B) Finding 7: Stripe event ledger (audit trail + reconciliation). Additive only.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.stripe_events (
  event_id        text PRIMARY KEY,
  type            text,
  payment_status  text,
  first_seen_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  last_seen_at    timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  delivery_count  integer     NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  note            text
);
ALTER TABLE public.stripe_events ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON public.stripe_events FROM anon, authenticated;

-- (C) Finding 10: index the unindexed FK on org_agents.
DO $$
DECLARE colnames text;
BEGIN
  SELECT string_agg(quote_ident(a.attname), ', ' ORDER BY k.ord)
    INTO colnames
  FROM pg_constraint con
  JOIN unnest(con.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, ord) ON true
  JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = con.conrelid AND a.attnum = k.attnum
  WHERE con.conname = 'org_agents_department_fkey' AND con.contype = 'f';
  IF colnames IS NOT NULL THEN
    EXECUTE format('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_org_agents_department ON public.org_agents (%s)', colnames);
  END IF;
END $$;

-- (D) Finding 10: add primary keys to the four PK-less tables.
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.rl_hits'::regclass AND contype='p') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.rl_hits ADD COLUMN _pk bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY;
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.content_drafts_backup_20260724'::regclass AND contype='p') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.content_drafts_backup_20260724 ADD COLUMN _pk bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY;
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.escalations_archive_20260724'::regclass AND contype='p') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.escalations_archive_20260724 ADD COLUMN _pk bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY;
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.org_reset_backup_20260724'::regclass AND contype='p') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.org_reset_backup_20260724 ADD COLUMN _pk bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY;
  END IF;
END $$;

### supabase/migrations/20260724_dept_library_store.sql

```sql
-- Generic queryable knowledge store for every department (two-layer pattern, generalized from marketing_library).
-- The 4 UAE libraries (IT/CS→it, Finance→finance, Engineering→procurement, general/law→legal) were chunked
-- (1420 chunks) and loaded as DATA via the REST API; source zips are in knowledge/. Distilled always-on rows
-- (47) were loaded into agent_knowledge (agent_key it/cfo/legal + _global trade rows). This file is the schema.
create table if not exists public.dept_library (
  id bigserial primary key, department text not null, category text, domain text,
  title text not null, content text not null, tags text, source_file text,
  tsv tsvector generated always as (to_tsvector('english', coalesce(title,'')||' '||coalesce(tags,'')||' '||coalesce(content,''))) stored,
  created_at timestamptz default now()
);
create index if not exists idx_dept_library_tsv on public.dept_library using gin(tsv);
create index if not exists idx_dept_library_dept on public.dept_library(department);
alter table public.dept_library enable row level security;
create or replace function public.fn_dept_library_search(p_dept text, p_query text, p_limit int default 5)
returns table(id bigint, department text, title text, content text, rank real)
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp' as $$
declare q_or tsquery; words text[];
begin
  words := array(select w from unnest(regexp_split_to_array(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_query,''),'[^a-z0-9 ]',' ','g')),'\s+')) w where length(w)>2);
  if array_length(words,1) is null then return; end if;
  begin q_or := to_tsquery('english', array_to_string(words,' | ')); exception when others then return; end;
  return query select l.id,l.department,l.title,l.content, ts_rank(l.tsv,q_or) as rank from dept_library l
    where (p_dept is null or l.department=p_dept) and l.tsv @@ q_or order by ts_rank(l.tsv,q_or) desc, l.id
    limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit,5),20));
end $$;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260724_fn_agent_context_fairpack.sql

```sql
-- fn_agent_context hardening (found while verifying knowledge injection):
--  BUG 1: the loop EXITED on the first over-cap row, so one large _global row starved everything after it
--         (even agents' own knowledge). Fixed: SKIP an over-cap row and keep packing.
--  BUG 2: the shared "critical" _global band grew large and crowded out each agent's OWN expertise and
--         newer rules (e.g. writing:human_voice, canon). Fixed: reserve a guaranteed slice for the agent's
--         own knowledge (pass 1), then critical globals (pass 2), then the rest (pass 3); raise the cap floor.
--  (A pre-existing junk row "Company FAQ (canonical answers)" is ~198KB — always skipped, harmless, but worth trimming later.)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_agent_context(p_agent_key text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_max_chars integer DEFAULT 9000)
 RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public','pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare out text := ''; r record; piece text; cap int; own_cap int;
begin
  cap := greatest(coalesce(p_max_chars,9000), 22000);
  own_cap := least(cap/2, 6000);
  if p_agent_key is not null then
    for r in select topic,content from agent_knowledge where agent_key=p_agent_key order by priority desc nulls last, updated_at desc loop
      piece := '## '||coalesce(r.topic,'')||E'\n'||coalesce(r.content,'')||E'\n\n';
      if length(out)+length(piece) <= own_cap then out := out||piece; end if;
    end loop;
  end if;
  for r in select topic,content from agent_knowledge where agent_key='_global' and coalesce(priority,0)>=90 order by priority desc nulls last, updated_at desc loop
    piece := '## '||coalesce(r.topic,'')||E'\n'||coalesce(r.content,'')||E'\n\n';
    if length(out)+length(piece) <= cap then out := out||piece; end if;
  end loop;
  for r in select topic,content from agent_knowledge where agent_key='_global' and coalesce(priority,0)<90 order by priority desc nulls last, updated_at desc loop
    piece := '## '||coalesce(r.topic,'')||E'\n'||coalesce(r.content,'')||E'\n\n';
    if length(out)+length(piece) <= cap then out := out||piece; end if;
  end loop;
  return 'COMPANY & ROLE KNOWLEDGE (authoritative — follow this; pricing marked LIVE overrides any other figure):'||E'\n\n'||out;
end $function$;
-- writing:human_voice promoted to the critical band (92); the 8 always-on canon rows consolidated to 3 dense ones.
```

### supabase/migrations/20260724_fn_query_platform.sql

```sql
-- Phase A (agent network): one read-only window onto the whole company for AI employees.
-- Routes a topic to the existing fn_ws_* workspace layer (extend/connect, no replacement).
-- Consumed by secretary_act's query_platform tool and available to any agent via service_role.
create or replace function public.fn_query_platform(p_topic text, p_args jsonb default '{}'::jsonb)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare v jsonb;
begin
  case lower(coalesce(p_topic,''))
    when 'topics' then
      v := jsonb_build_object('topics', jsonb_build_array(
        'knowledge','agents','agent_ops','ai','analytics','company','customers','documents',
        'ea','exec','finance','fraud','governance','marketing','marketplace','operations',
        'refunds','reports','strategy','suppliers','supplier_360','customer_360','rfq_360','funnel'));
    when 'knowledge'   then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_knowledge());
    when 'agents'      then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_agents());
    when 'agent_ops'   then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_agent_ops(coalesce(p_args->>'agent','')));
    when 'ai'          then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_ai());
    when 'analytics'   then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_analytics());
    when 'company'     then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_company());
    when 'customers'   then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_customers());
    when 'documents'   then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_documents());
    when 'ea'          then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_ea());
    when 'exec'        then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_exec());
    when 'finance'     then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_finance());
    when 'fraud'       then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_fraud());
    when 'governance'  then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_governance());
    when 'marketing'   then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_marketing());
    when 'marketplace' then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_marketplace());
    when 'operations'  then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_operations());
    when 'refunds'     then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_refunds());
    when 'reports'     then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_reports());
    when 'strategy'    then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_strategy());
    when 'suppliers'   then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_suppliers(coalesce(p_args,'{}'::jsonb)));
    when 'supplier_360' then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_supplier_360((p_args->>'id')::bigint));
    when 'customer_360' then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_customer_360((p_args->>'id')::uuid));
    when 'rfq_360'      then v := to_jsonb(fn_ws_rfq_360((p_args->>'id')::uuid));
    when 'funnel'       then v := to_jsonb(funnel_metrics(coalesce((p_args->>'days')::int,30)));
    else v := jsonb_build_object('error','unknown_topic','hint','call with topic=topics to list valid topics');
  end case;
  return coalesce(v,'{}'::jsonb);
exception when others then
  return jsonb_build_object('error','query_failed','topic',p_topic,'detail',sqlerrm);
end $$;

-- await the founder into DECISIONS NEEDED. Full CREATE OR REPLACE (source of truth in production).

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_founder_brief()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_owner text; v_run bigint;
  v_reg int; v_cust int; v_inq7 int; v_q7 int; v_deals int; v_rev numeric;
  v_pend int; v_kyc int; v_refunds int; v_reviews int;
  v_hot int; v_gap int; v_newsup int; v_newcust int;
  v_bd_q int; v_bd_sent int; v_chat_open int; v_viol int;
  v_officer text; v_health jsonb;
  v_topcats text; v_qpr numeric; v_conv numeric;
  v_expired int; v_crit int; v_decisions text; v_dn int := 0;

  v_obj_open int := 0; v_obj_await int := 0; v_obj_done24 int := 0; v_task_done24 int := 0; v_obj_line text;  -- Org-foundation additions
begin
  select split_part(coalesce(value,'management@quotesdone.com'),',',1) into v_owner from app_secrets where key='admin_emails';
  if v_owner is null then v_owner := 'management@quotesdone.com'; end if;
  insert into agent_runs(agent, started_at) values ('brief', now()) returning id into v_run;

  begin select coalesce(registered_supplier_count(),0) into v_reg; exception when others then v_reg := 0; end;
  select count(*) into v_cust from customers;
  select count(*) into v_inq7 from inquiries where created_at >= now()-interval '7 days';
  select count(*) into v_q7 from quotes where created_at >= now()-interval '7 days';
  select count(*) into v_deals from transactions;
  select coalesce(sum(coalesce(reveal_fee,app_fee,0)),0) into v_rev from transactions where coalesce(fee_status,'')<>'refunded' and coalesce(refund_status,'')<>'approved';
  select count(*) into v_pend from agent_actions where status in ('pending','held_for_review','proposed','open','needs_review');
  select count(*) into v_kyc from leads where approval_status='pending';
  select count(*) into v_refunds from transactions where refund_status='requested';
  select count(*) into v_reviews from inbound_messages where needs_review=true;
  select count(distinct i.id) into v_hot from inquiries i join quotes q on q.inquiry_id=i.id left join transactions t on t.inquiry_id=i.id where t.id is null and i.status not in ('completed','accepted','closed','cancelled');
  select count(*) into v_gap from inquiries i where i.status not in ('completed','accepted','closed','cancelled') and not exists (select 1 from inquiry_matches m where m.inquiry_id=i.id);
  select count(*) into v_newsup from leads where registration_submitted_at >= now()-interval '7 days';
  select count(*) into v_newcust from customers where created_at >= now()-interval '7 days';
  select count(*) into v_bd_q from outreach where status='queued';
  select count(*) into v_bd_sent from outreach where status='sent';
  select count(*) into v_chat_open from chat_threads where status='open';
  select count(*) into v_viol from chat_violations where created_at >= now()-interval '7 days';

  begin select public.fn_health_index() into v_health; exception when others then v_health := null; end;

  begin
    select string_agg(cat,', ') into v_topcats from (
      select coalesce(nullif(category,''),'(uncategorized)') cat, count(*) n
      from inquiries where created_at>=now()-interval '7 days'
      group by 1 order by n desc limit 3) z;
  exception when others then v_topcats := null; end;

  begin
    select round(avg(qc),1) into v_qpr from (
      select count(*) qc from quotes q join inquiries i on i.id=q.inquiry_id
      where i.created_at>=now()-interval '30 days' group by q.inquiry_id) z;
  exception when others then v_qpr := null; end;
  begin
    select round(100.0*count(distinct t.inquiry_id)/nullif(count(distinct i.id),0),1) into v_conv
    from inquiries i left join transactions t on t.inquiry_id=i.id
    where i.created_at>=now()-interval '30 days';
  exception when others then v_conv := null; end;

  begin select count(*) into v_expired from leads where license_expiry is not null and license_expiry < current_date and coalesce(approval_status,'')='approved'; exception when others then v_expired:=0; end;
  select count(*) into v_crit from founder_alerts where level='critical' and created_at>=now()-interval '24 hours';

  begin
    select string_agg('- ['||label||'] '||act, E'\n')
    into v_officer
    from (
      select case er.officer
               when 'strategy' then 'Strategy' when 'operations' then 'Ops'
               when 'procurement_quality' then 'Quality' when 'data_science' then 'Data'
               when 'product_ux' then 'Product' when 'competitive' then 'Compete' else er.officer end as label,
             left(coalesce(rec->>'action',''),160) as act,
             case lower(coalesce(rec->>'impact','')) when 'high' then 0 when 'medium' then 1 else 2 end as ord
      from (select distinct on (officer) officer, recommendations, created_at from exec_reports order by officer, created_at desc) er,
           lateral jsonb_array_elements(er.recommendations) rec
      where coalesce(rec->>'action','') <> ''
      order by ord, label limit 5
    ) z;
  exception when others then v_officer := null; end;

  -- Phase B: what the Chief of Staff handled autonomously in the last 24h.
  select count(*) into v_auto_cleared from agent_actions
    where decided_by='chief_of_staff (auto)' and decided_at >= now()-interval '24 hours';
  begin
    select count(*) into v_auto_appr from leads
      where approval_decided_by='chief_of_staff (auto)' and approved_at >= now()-interval '24 hours';
  exception when others then v_auto_appr := 0; end;
  begin
    select string_agg('- '||type||': '||n, E'\n' order by n desc)
      into v_handled
    from (select type, count(*) n from notifications
          where status='digest' and created_at >= now()-interval '24 hours'
          group by type) z;
  exception when others then v_handled := null; end;

  -- Org foundation: the founder's objectives and how the organization is executing them.
  begin
    select count(*) into v_obj_open from org_objectives where status in ('open','in_progress','blocked');
    select count(*) into v_obj_done24 from org_objectives where status='done' and closed_at >= now()-interval '24 hours';
    select count(*) into v_task_done24 from org_tasks where status='done' and updated_at >= now()-interval '24 hours';
    select count(*) into v_obj_await from org_tasks t
      where t.status in ('proposed','escalated')
        and exists (select 1 from org_objectives o where o.id=t.objective_id and o.status in ('open','in_progress','blocked'));

        (select count(*) from org_tasks t where t.objective_id=o.id and t.status='done')||'/'||
        (select count(*) from org_tasks t where t.objective_id=o.id)||' tasks done'||
        case when (select count(*) from org_tasks t where t.objective_id=o.id and t.status in ('proposed','escalated'))>0
             then ', '||(select count(*) from org_tasks t where t.objective_id=o.id and t.status in ('proposed','escalated'))||' awaiting you'
             else '' end,

      into v_obj_line from org_objectives o where o.status in ('open','in_progress','blocked');
  exception when others then v_obj_open:=0; v_obj_await:=0; v_obj_done24:=0; v_task_done24:=0; v_obj_line:=null; end;

  v_decisions := '';
  if v_kyc > 0 then v_dn:=v_dn+1; v_decisions := v_decisions||v_dn||'. Approve/deny '||v_kyc||' supplier KYC application(s)'||E'\n'; end if;
  if v_refunds > 0 then v_dn:=v_dn+1; v_decisions := v_decisions||v_dn||'. Resolve '||v_refunds||' refund request(s)'||E'\n'; end if;
  if v_obj_await > 0 then v_dn:=v_dn+1; v_decisions := v_decisions||v_dn||'. '||v_obj_await||' objective step(s) awaiting your approval/input'||E'\n'; end if;
  if v_expired > 0 then v_dn:=v_dn+1; v_decisions := v_decisions||v_dn||'. Review '||v_expired||' supplier(s) with EXPIRED trade licence'||E'\n'; end if;
  if v_crit > 0 then v_dn:=v_dn+1; v_decisions := v_decisions||v_dn||'. Address '||v_crit||' critical alert(s) raised in last 24h'||E'\n'; end if;
  if v_dn = 0 then v_decisions := 'None outstanding.'||E'\n'; end if;

  v_subj := 'QuotesDone daily brief — '||to_char(now() at time zone 'Asia/Dubai','Dy DD Mon');
  v_body :=
    'Good morning. Here is your QuotesDone snapshot.'||E'\n\n'||

      case when v_obj_line is not null and v_obj_line<>'' then v_obj_line||E'\n' else '' end||E'\n'||
    'NEEDS YOU TODAY'||E'\n'||
    '- Approvals waiting: '||v_pend||' (incl. '||v_kyc||' supplier KYC)'||E'\n'||
    '- Refund requests: '||v_refunds||E'\n'||
    '- Inbound emails to review: '||v_reviews||E'\n'||
    '- Hot leads (quotes in, not revealed): '||v_hot||E'\n'||
    '- Supply gaps (demand, no supplier matched): '||v_gap||E'\n'||
    '- Chat: '||v_chat_open||' open, '||v_viol||' policy flag(s) this week'||E'\n\n'||
    'THIS WEEK'||E'\n'||
    '- New inquiries: '||v_inq7||'  ·  quotes: '||v_q7||E'\n'||
    '- Avg quotes/RFQ (30d): '||coalesce(v_qpr::text,'—')||'  ·  Conversion (30d): '||coalesce(v_conv::text,'—')||'%'||E'\n'||
    '- New customers: '||v_newcust||'  ·  new supplier registrations: '||v_newsup||E'\n'||
    '- Deals (reveals) all-time: '||v_deals||'  ·  revenue recognized: AED '||round(v_rev)||E'\n'||
    '- Top categories (7d): '||coalesce(v_topcats,'—')||E'\n\n'||
    'GROWTH'||E'\n'||
    '- Suppliers registered: '||v_reg||'  ·  BD invites queued: '||v_bd_q||'  ·  sent: '||v_bd_sent||E'\n'||
    case when v_officer is not null and v_officer <> '' then E'\n'||'OFFICER PRIORITIES (from weekly analysis)'||E'\n'||v_officer||E'\n' else '' end ||
    E'\n'||'DECISIONS NEEDED'||E'\n'||v_decisions||
    E'\n'||'Open your dashboard: https://quotesdone.com/os  (Ops for live status; Governance for officer reports).';

  insert into notifications(type,to_email,to_role,channel,subject,body) values ('founder_brief',v_owner,'admin','email',v_subj,v_body);

### supabase/migrations/20260724_founder_review_gates.sql

```sql
-- ============================================================================
-- AUTONOMY ENGINE · FOUNDER REVIEW — exactly three gates, nothing else.
-- The founder reviews only: (1) marketing posts, (2) boost budgets, (3) refunds.
-- Everything else the staff ships automatically within the constitutional gates.
-- approve → ships; comment → back to the department to revise; reject → drop.
-- ============================================================================

alter table public.content_drafts add column if not exists review_status text default 'pending';
alter table public.content_drafts add column if not exists founder_comment text;
alter table public.content_drafts add column if not exists reviewed_at timestamptz;
update public.content_drafts set review_status='pending' where review_status is null and status='draft';

create table if not exists public.review_queue (
  id bigserial primary key,
  kind text not null, dept_key text, title text not null, summary text, payload jsonb,
  status text not null default 'pending', founder_comment text,
  created_at timestamptz default now(), decided_at timestamptz, decided_by text
);
alter table public.review_queue enable row level security;

insert into public.decision_policy(key, value, description) values
('founder_review_gates', '["marketing_post","boost_budget","refund"]'::jsonb, 'The ONLY work that requires founder review. Everything else the departments ship automatically within the constitutional gates.')
on conflict (key) do update set value=excluded.value, description=excluded.description, updated_at=now();

-- fn_review_pending(): unified founder review surface, computed live from the real sources.
create or replace function public.fn_review_pending()
returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp' as $$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'marketing_posts', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','marketing_post','ref_id',c.id,'title',c.title,'channel',c.channel,'body',c.body,'image_url',c.image_url,'created_at',c.created_at) order by c.created_at desc)
      from content_drafts c where c.status='draft' and coalesce(c.review_status,'pending')='pending'), '[]'::jsonb),
    'refunds', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','refund','ref_id',t.id,'customer_id',t.customer_id,'reason',t.refund_reason,'requested_at',t.refund_requested_at) order by t.refund_requested_at desc)
      from transactions t where t.refund_status='requested'), '[]'::jsonb),
    'boost_budgets', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','boost_budget','ref_id',r.id,'title',r.title,'summary',r.summary,'payload',r.payload,'created_at',r.created_at) order by r.created_at desc)
      from review_queue r where r.kind='boost_budget' and r.status='pending'), '[]'::jsonb)
  );
$$;

-- fn_review_decide(kind, ref_id, decision, comment): approve | changes | reject → acts on the right source.
create or replace function public.fn_review_decide(p_kind text, p_ref_id bigint, p_decision text, p_comment text default null, p_by text default 'founder')
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp' as $$
declare dec text := lower(coalesce(p_decision,'')); ok boolean := false;
begin
  if dec not in ('approve','changes','reject') then return jsonb_build_object('error','decision must be approve|changes|reject'); end if;
  if p_kind = 'marketing_post' then
    update content_drafts set review_status = case dec when 'approve' then 'approved' when 'changes' then 'changes_requested' else 'rejected' end,
      founder_comment = coalesce(p_comment, founder_comment), reviewed_at = now() where id = p_ref_id and status='draft'; ok := found;
  elsif p_kind = 'refund' then
    update transactions set refund_status = case dec when 'approve' then 'approved' when 'reject' then 'declined' else 'requested' end,
      refund_note = coalesce(p_comment, refund_note), refund_resolved_at = case when dec in ('approve','reject') then now() else refund_resolved_at end
      where id = p_ref_id and refund_status='requested'; ok := found;
  elsif p_kind = 'boost_budget' then
    update review_queue set status = case dec when 'approve' then 'approved' when 'changes' then 'changes_requested' else 'rejected' end,
      founder_comment = coalesce(p_comment, founder_comment), decided_at = now(), decided_by = p_by where id = p_ref_id and status='pending'; ok := found;
  else return jsonb_build_object('error','unknown kind '||p_kind); end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', ok, 'kind', p_kind, 'ref_id', p_ref_id, 'decision', dec);
end $$;
revoke all on function public.fn_review_decide(text,bigint,text,text,text) from public, anon;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260724_knowledge_department.sql

```sql
-- ============================================================================
-- KNOWLEDGE department: self-healing taxonomy reconciliation + real gap-fill executor.
-- Wires knowledge_fill (supervised) onto the action-executor registry.
-- ============================================================================

-- fn_kb_reconcile: idempotent, safe normalizer of kb_chunks.category so knowledge stays visible to
-- category-filtered retrieval. Runs daily (cron kb_reconcile_daily @ 03:05) AND inline on every
-- knowledge_fill, so the taxonomy never drifts. Only provably-safe moves:
--   1. strip 'cat:' prefix where the bare slug is a real category (0 orphans created)
--   2. apply ONLY 1:1 curated aliases (skips 1:many composites like combined-mep)
-- Deliberately leaves truly-uncategorized chunks as global knowledge (still semantically retrievable).
create or replace function public.fn_kb_reconcile()
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_catalog'
as $function$
declare v_stripped int:=0; v_aliased int:=0; v_uncat int; v_noncanon int;
begin
  with upd as (
    update public.kb_chunks c set category = substring(c.category from 5)
    where c.category like 'cat:%'
      and ( substring(c.category from 5) in (select slug from public.category_agents where active)
         or substring(c.category from 5) in (select category from public.category_specs) )
    returning 1
  ) select count(*) into v_stripped from upd;

  with oneone as (
    select category, min(maps_to) as target
    from public.kb_category_aliases group by category having count(distinct maps_to)=1
  ), upd2 as (
    update public.kb_chunks c set category = o.target
    from oneone o where c.category = o.category and c.category <> o.target
    returning 1
  ) select count(*) into v_aliased from upd2;

  select count(*) into v_uncat from public.kb_chunks where category is null or category='';
  select count(distinct category) into v_noncanon from public.kb_chunks
    where category is not null and category<>'' and category not like 'cat:%'
      and category not in (select slug from public.category_agents where active)
      and category not in (select category from public.category_specs);

  return jsonb_build_object('cat_prefix_stripped',v_stripped,'alias_remapped',v_aliased,
    'uncategorized_left',v_uncat,'noncanonical_categories_left',v_noncanon,
    'note','Normalized kb_chunks categories: stripped '||v_stripped||' cat: prefix(es), remapped '||v_aliased||' via curated 1:1 aliases. '||v_uncat||' chunk(s) remain uncategorized (global knowledge — still semantically retrievable).');
end $function$;
revoke execute on function public.fn_kb_reconcile() from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.fn_kb_reconcile() to service_role;

-- knowledge_fill executor wrapper: fast + honest. Reconciles the taxonomy inline (self-heal on every
-- run), then triggers the slow gap-generator in the BACKGROUND (kb_autofill_gaps via net.http_post, its
-- own 280s timeout, logs to agent_runs) so the coordinator never blocks. Returns immediately.
create or replace function public.fn_org_exec_knowledge_fill(p_limit int default 5)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_catalog'
as $function$
declare v_gaps int; v_req bigint; v_recon jsonb;
begin
  v_recon := public.fn_kb_reconcile();
  select count(*) into v_gaps from public.category_specs s
    where not exists (select 1 from public.kb_chunks k where k.category = s.category);
  select net.http_post(
    url:='https://htdblwldjkcgjvmqkbeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/kb_autofill_gaps',
    headers:='{"Content-Type":"application/json"}'::jsonb,
    body:=jsonb_build_object('__secret',(select value from public.app_secrets where key='inbound_secret'),'limit',greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,5),5))),
    timeout_milliseconds:=280000
  ) into v_req;
  return jsonb_build_object('empty_categories', v_gaps, 'autofill_triggered', true, 'reconcile', v_recon,
    'note', case when v_gaps=0 then 'Knowledge base complete: 0 empty categories. Taxonomy reconciled ('||coalesce(v_recon->>'cat_prefix_stripped','0')||' prefixes stripped, '||coalesce(v_recon->>'alias_remapped','0')||' aliased).'
                 else 'Triggered background gap-fill for '||v_gaps||' empty category(ies); taxonomy reconciled. Generation runs in the background and logs to agent_runs.' end);
end $function$;
revoke execute on function public.fn_org_exec_knowledge_fill(int) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.fn_org_exec_knowledge_fill(int) to service_role;

-- Register the Knowledge executor.
insert into public.org_action_executor(action_class, kind, target, params, note) values
('knowledge_fill','rpc','fn_org_exec_knowledge_fill','{}','Reconcile taxonomy + trigger background gap-fill (kb_autofill_gaps). Fast/non-blocking.')
on conflict (action_class) do update set kind=excluded.kind, target=excluded.target, params=excluded.params, note=excluded.note, active=true;

insert into public.org_memory(scope,kind,content,source) values
('knowledge','policy','Knowledge executes real work: knowledge_fill (supervised) reconciles the taxonomy then triggers background generation for categories with zero chunks (kb_autofill_gaps). fn_kb_reconcile also runs daily to self-heal the taxonomy (strip cat: prefixes, apply 1:1 aliases). Truly-uncategorized chunks are kept as global knowledge, still semantically retrievable.','founder_directive')
on conflict do nothing;

-- Cron: daily self-healing reconciliation.

### supabase/migrations/20260724_layer2_cron_liveness_rpc.sql

```sql
-- Layer 2 external watchdog: liveness of the pg_cron scheduler itself.
-- Read-only; works as long as Postgres is up even if pg_cron has stopped scheduling.
-- Called by the resilience_ping edge function (which an EXTERNAL scheduler hits), so a total
-- pg_cron outage is detectable from outside the database.
create or replace function public.fn_cron_liveness()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path to 'public','pg_catalog','cron'
as $function$
declare v_age numeric; v_last timestamptz;
begin
  select max(start_time) into v_last from cron.job_run_details;
  if v_last is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('healthy', false, 'newest_run_age_min', null, 'note', 'no cron run history');
  end if;
  v_age := extract(epoch from (now() - v_last))/60.0;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'healthy', v_age <= 20,               -- crons run every few minutes; >20min silence = scheduler down
    'newest_run_age_min', round(v_age,1),
    'checked_at', now());
exception when others then
  return jsonb_build_object('healthy', null, 'error', sqlerrm);
end $function$;

revoke execute on function public.fn_cron_liveness() from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.fn_cron_liveness() to service_role;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260724_layer2_resilience_watch.sql

```sql
-- Layer 2 (resilience): pipeline-liveness watchdog with self-heal + immediate escalation.
-- Complements fn_ops_watch (abuse/cost/error detection) — this watches that the company's
-- critical pipelines are actually ALIVE, heals the safe ones, and pages the founder the moment
-- something would genuinely stop the business (so a week-long absence never hides an outage).
-- Heartbeats use ops_watch/ai_health (which log unconditionally); send_outbox/email_cron are
-- silent-when-idle so email LIVENESS is measured by backlog, not by a heartbeat.
create or replace function public.fn_resilience_watch()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $function$
declare
  v_run bigint; v_owner text; v_secret text;
  v_base text := 'https://htdblwldjkcgjvmqkbeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/';
  v_email_backlog int := 0; v_prev_backlog int; v_flushed boolean := false;
  v_email_on text; v_stripe text; v_kill text;
  v_last_ops timestamptz; v_last_ai timestamptz; v_match_stuck int := 0;
  v_missing text[] := '{}'; k text; v_issues text := ''; v_heals int := 0; v_alerts int := 0;
  v_deduped boolean;
begin
  select value into v_secret from app_secrets where key='inbound_secret';
  select split_part(coalesce(value,'management@quotesdone.com'),',',1) into v_owner from app_secrets where key='admin_emails';
  v_owner := coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_owner),''),'management@quotesdone.com');
  insert into agent_runs(agent,started_at) values('resilience_watch',clock_timestamp()) returning id into v_run;

  -- 1. EMAIL PIPELINE liveness + safe self-heal (idempotent flush; respects cap/suppressions).
  select value into v_email_on from app_secrets where key='email_enabled';
  select count(*) into v_email_backlog from notifications
    where channel='email' and coalesce(status,'queued') in ('queued','pending') and created_at < now()-interval '15 minutes';
  if v_email_backlog>0 and coalesce(v_email_on,'')='true' and v_secret is not null then
    perform net.http_post(url:=v_base||'send_outbox',
      headers:='{"Content-Type":"application/json"}'::jsonb,
      body:=jsonb_build_object('__secret',v_secret,'limit',50), timeout_milliseconds:=20000);
    v_flushed := true; v_heals := v_heals+1;
    select (counts->>'email_backlog')::int into v_prev_backlog from agent_runs
      where agent='resilience_watch' and id<>v_run order by id desc limit 1;
    if coalesce(v_prev_backlog,0)>0 then
      v_issues := v_issues||'- Email pipeline STUCK: '||v_email_backlog||' message(s) undelivered >15min despite auto-flush.'||E'\n';
    end if;
  end if;

  -- 2. CRITICAL credentials present (a missing one silently kills a whole flow).
  foreach k in array array['openrouter_api_key','resend_api_key','stripe_secret_key','inbound_secret'] loop
    if not exists(select 1 from app_secrets where key=k and value is not null and length(btrim(value))>0) then
      v_missing := array_append(v_missing,k);
    end if;
  end loop;
  if array_length(v_missing,1)>0 then
    v_issues := v_issues||'- CRITICAL credential(s) MISSING: '||array_to_string(v_missing,', ')||' — dependent flows are down.'||E'\n';
  end if;
  select left(value,8) into v_stripe from app_secrets where key='stripe_secret_key';
  if v_stripe is not null and v_stripe not like 'sk_live_%' then
    v_issues := v_issues||'- Stripe key is NOT live mode — payments will not settle.'||E'\n';
  end if;
  select value into v_kill from app_secrets where key='ai_kill_switch';
  if coalesce(v_kill,'')='true' then
    v_issues := v_issues||'- AI kill-switch is ON — every AI agent is paused.'||E'\n';
  end if;

  -- 3. SCHEDULER heartbeat via always-logging agents (catches a degraded pg_cron while it still partly runs).
  select max(started_at) into v_last_ops from agent_runs where agent='ops_watch' and started_at>now()-interval '4 hours';
  select max(started_at) into v_last_ai  from agent_runs where agent='ai_health' and started_at>now()-interval '4 hours';
  if v_last_ops is null or v_last_ops < now()-interval '90 minutes' then
    v_issues := v_issues||'- Ops-watch heartbeat stale (>90min) — the scheduler may be degraded.'||E'\n';
  end if;
  if v_last_ai is null or v_last_ai < now()-interval '45 minutes' then
    v_issues := v_issues||'- AI-health heartbeat stale (>45min) — the scheduler or AI monitor may be down.'||E'\n';
  end if;

  -- 4. MATCHING liveness: open inquiries with no shortlist after 6h.
  select count(*) into v_match_stuck from inquiries i
    where i.created_at between now()-interval '24 hours' and now()-interval '6 hours'
      and i.status not in ('completed','accepted','closed','cancelled','draft')
      and not exists(select 1 from inquiry_matches m where m.inquiry_id=i.id);
  if v_match_stuck>0 then
    v_issues := v_issues||'- '||v_match_stuck||' inquiry(ies) unmatched for >6h — the matcher may be stuck.'||E'\n';
  end if;

  -- ESCALATE: resilience failures would actually STOP the business, so page immediately
  -- (bypasses the Phase-B digest) — deduped to once per 3h via a silent marker row.
  if v_issues<>'' then
    select exists(select 1 from notifications where type='resilience_alert' and created_at>now()-interval '3 hours') into v_deduped;
    if not v_deduped and v_secret is not null then
      perform net.http_post(url:=v_base||'alert_founder',
        headers:='{"Content-Type":"application/json"}'::jsonb,
        body:=jsonb_build_object('__secret',v_secret,'event','Resilience: the platform needs attention',
          'level','critical','dedupe_key','resilience',
          'detail','The self-healing watchdog found issues it could not auto-fix:'||E'\n'||v_issues),
        timeout_milliseconds:=20000);
      insert into notifications(type,to_email,to_role,channel,subject,body,status)
        values('resilience_alert',v_owner,'admin','email','QuotesDone resilience: action needed',v_issues,'digested');
      v_alerts := v_alerts+1;
    end if;
  end if;

  update agent_runs set finished_at=clock_timestamp(),
    status=case when v_issues<>'' then 'error' else 'ok' end,
    counts=jsonb_build_object('email_backlog',v_email_backlog,'flushed',v_flushed,'heals',v_heals,'alerts',v_alerts,'has_issues',(v_issues<>'')),
    note=coalesce(nullif(v_issues,''),'all critical pipelines healthy')
    where id=v_run;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'email_backlog',v_email_backlog,'flushed',v_flushed,'issues',nullif(v_issues,''),'alerts',v_alerts);
end $function$;

revoke execute on function public.fn_resilience_watch() from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.fn_resilience_watch() to service_role;

-- schedule every 10 minutes (idempotent: drop any prior definition of the same job first)
do $$ begin perform cron.unschedule('resilience_watch_10min'); exception when others then null; end $$;
select cron.schedule('resilience_watch_10min', '*/10 * * * *', 'select public.fn_resilience_watch()');
```

### supabase/migrations/20260724_marketing_knowledge_library.sql

```sql
-- ============================================================================
-- MARKETING KNOWLEDGE — UAE marketing library, two layers.
--   Layer 1 (always-on): distilled QuotesDone-specific rows in agent_knowledge, loaded every run.
--   Layer 2 (on-demand): the full library as searchable chunks in marketing_library, retrieved per
--            task via fn_marketing_library_search and injected by marketing_draft. Keeps depth
--            available without paying the context cost of loading 340KB on every generation.
-- Source: UAE_Marketing_Knowledge_Library (18 domains; e-commerce Domain 12 intentionally excluded
--         as low-relevance for a services RFQ marketplace).
-- NOTE: the 317 library chunks are DATA loaded via the REST API (see project doc), not this DDL.
--       This migration recreates the SCHEMA, the search function, and the always-on rows.
-- ============================================================================

-- Layer 2 store -------------------------------------------------------------
create table if not exists public.marketing_library (
  id          bigserial primary key,
  category    text not null,
  domain      text,
  title       text not null,
  content     text not null,
  tags        text,
  source_file text,
  tsv tsvector generated always as (
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(title,'') || ' ' || coalesce(tags,'') || ' ' || coalesce(content,''))
  ) stored,
  created_at  timestamptz default now()
);
create index if not exists idx_marketing_library_tsv on public.marketing_library using gin(tsv);
create index if not exists idx_marketing_library_category on public.marketing_library(category);
alter table public.marketing_library enable row level security;  -- service_role (edge fns) bypasses; no public access

-- Retrieval: OR-ranked full-text search (chunks matching more query terms rank higher).
create or replace function public.fn_marketing_library_search(p_query text, p_limit int default 5)
returns table(id bigint, category text, title text, content text, rank real)
language plpgsql stable as $$
declare q_or tsquery; words text[];
begin
  words := array(
    select w from unnest(
      regexp_split_to_array(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_query,''),'[^a-z0-9 ]',' ','g')), '\s+')
    ) w where length(w) > 2);
  if array_length(words,1) is null then return; end if;
  begin
    q_or := to_tsquery('english', array_to_string(words, ' | '));
  exception when others then return; end;
  return query
    select l.id, l.category, l.title, l.content, ts_rank(l.tsv, q_or) as rank
    from public.marketing_library l
    where l.tsv @@ q_or
    order by ts_rank(l.tsv, q_or) desc, l.id
    limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit,5), 20));
end;
$$;

-- Layer 1 always-on distilled rows (idempotent) -----------------------------

Design RTL now (mirrored layout, right-aligned forms, swapped nav) so retrofit is cheap. Code-switching suits younger users. Keep UTMs/tags Latin regardless of content language.'),

### supabase/migrations/20260724_org_foundation.sql

```sql
-- ORG FOUNDATION: the shared substrate that turns the agent fleet into a company.
-- Additive only. Internal OS tables (service-role/SECURITY DEFINER only).
-- Kernel (org_departments) + Permissions (org_authority + fn_dept_authority w/ constitutional caps)
-- + Objective/Task ledger (org_objectives/org_tasks) + Organizational memory (org_memory)
-- + fn_org_scorecard (whole-company view). Consumed by intent_router and secretary_act (Chief of Staff).

-- 1. DEPARTMENT KERNEL (as data)
create table if not exists public.org_departments (
  dept_key text primary key, name text not null, charter text not null,
  north_star text, health_fn text, lead_agent text,
  active boolean not null default true, sort int not null default 100
);

-- 2. PERMISSIONS
create table if not exists public.org_authority (
  dept_key text not null references public.org_departments(dept_key) on delete cascade,
  action_class text not null,
  max_tier text not null check (max_tier in ('advisory','gated','supervised','autonomous')),
  threshold_aed numeric, note text,
  primary key (dept_key, action_class)
);

-- 3. OBJECTIVE / TASK LEDGER
create table if not exists public.org_objectives (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  objective text not null, raw_input text, created_by text default 'founder',
  status text not null default 'open' check (status in ('open','in_progress','blocked','done','cancelled')),
  priority text not null default 'normal',
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(), updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  closed_at timestamptz, outcome text
);
create table if not exists public.org_tasks (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  objective_id bigint references public.org_objectives(id) on delete cascade,
  dept_key text references public.org_departments(dept_key),
  title text not null, detail text, action_class text,
  status text not null default 'proposed' check (status in ('proposed','assigned','in_progress','blocked','done','failed','escalated')),
  tier text check (tier in ('advisory','gated','supervised','autonomous')),
  needs_founder boolean not null default false, result jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(), updated_at timestamptz not null default now(), decided_by text
);
create index if not exists ix_org_tasks_objective on public.org_tasks(objective_id);
create index if not exists ix_org_tasks_dept_status on public.org_tasks(dept_key, status);

-- 4. ORGANIZATIONAL MEMORY (shared, cross-department)
create table if not exists public.org_memory (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  scope text not null default 'global', kind text not null default 'note',
  content text not null, source text, active boolean not null default true,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists ix_org_memory_scope on public.org_memory(scope) where active;

alter table public.org_departments enable row level security;
alter table public.org_authority   enable row level security;
alter table public.org_objectives  enable row level security;
alter table public.org_tasks        enable row level security;
alter table public.org_memory       enable row level security;

-- fn_dept_authority: effective control tier for (department, action_class), with constitutional HARD CAPS.
create or replace function public.fn_dept_authority(p_dept text, p_action_class text)
returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_catalog'
as $function$
declare v_tier text; v_thr numeric; v_cap text; v_tier_rk int; v_cap_rk int;
begin
  select max_tier, threshold_aed into v_tier, v_thr from public.org_authority where dept_key=p_dept and action_class=p_action_class;
  if v_tier is null then v_tier := 'gated'; end if;
  if p_action_class ~* 'money|payout|payment|gl_|data_delete|delete|purge|secret|auth|password|code_deploy|supplier_ban|ban' then v_cap := 'gated';
  elsif p_action_class ~* 'legal_review|recommend' then v_cap := 'advisory'; end if;
  v_tier_rk := case v_tier when 'advisory' then 0 when 'gated' then 1 when 'supervised' then 2 when 'autonomous' then 3 else 1 end;
  if v_cap is not null then
    v_cap_rk := case v_cap when 'advisory' then 0 when 'gated' then 1 when 'supervised' then 2 else 3 end;
    if v_tier_rk > v_cap_rk then v_tier := v_cap; end if;
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('dept',p_dept,'action_class',p_action_class,'tier',v_tier,'threshold_aed',v_thr,'capped', v_cap is not null);
end $function$;
revoke execute on function public.fn_dept_authority(text,text) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.fn_dept_authority(text,text) to service_role;

-- fn_org_scorecard: whole-company view for the Chief of Staff brief + OS.
create or replace function public.fn_org_scorecard()
returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_catalog'
as $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(x) order by x.sort),'[]'::jsonb) from (
    select d.dept_key, d.name, d.north_star, d.lead_agent, d.sort,
      (select count(*) from public.org_tasks t where t.dept_key=d.dept_key and t.status in ('proposed','assigned','in_progress','blocked')) as open_tasks,
      (select count(*) from public.org_tasks t where t.dept_key=d.dept_key and (t.needs_founder or t.status='escalated') and t.status not in ('done','failed')) as escalations,
      (select count(*) from public.agent_actions a where a.status in ('pending','needs_review','open') and (
          (d.dept_key='finance' and a.kind ~* 'finance|refund|dues') or
          (d.dept_key='legal' and a.kind ~* 'legal|compliance') or
          (d.dept_key='supplier_success' and a.kind ~* 'supplier|approve|licence|kyc') or
          (d.dept_key='customer_success' and a.kind ~* 'customer|refund|escalation') or
          (d.dept_key='it' and a.kind ~* 'incident|security') or
          (d.dept_key='marketing' and a.kind ~* 'market|content') or
          (d.dept_key='knowledge' and a.kind ~* 'knowledge|coverage')
        )) as dept_queue
    from public.org_departments d where d.active
  ) x;
$function$;
revoke execute on function public.fn_org_scorecard() from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.fn_org_scorecard() to service_role;
