### supabase/migrations/20260724_phase_b_autonomy_policy_classifier.sql

```sql
-- Phase B (autonomy): make the disposition engine policy-driven and broaden safe auto-clear.
-- EXTENDS the existing fn_autonomy_class / fn_autonomy_dispose (hourly) — no replacement.

-- 1. Policy rows in the existing decision_policy rules engine (founder-editable, reversible).
insert into public.decision_policy(key, value, description) values
('action_autonomy',
 jsonb_build_object(
   -- informational / handled by another automation -> auto-clear from the queue, counted in the daily brief
   'licence_expiring','ack','hot_lead','ack','sla_review','ack','sla_no_supply','ack',
   'coverage_gap','ack','supply_gap','ack','supply_health','ack','incident','ack',
   'security_alert','ack','compliance_update','ack','exec_briefing','ack',
   'marketing_recommendation','ack','ops_recommendation','ack','strategy_rec','ack',
   'ai_improvement','ack','ai_quality_alert','ack',
   -- real decisions / money / legal / safety -> always stay in the founder queue
   'approve_supplier','founder','customer_escalation','founder','legal_flag','founder',
   'finance_alert','founder','supplier_risk','founder','prompt_approval','founder',
   'security_incident','founder','content_review','founder','invite_campaign_week','founder'),
 'Per-kind autonomy for the Chief-of-Staff sweep: ack=auto-clear into the daily brief, founder=keep in the queue for a decision. Money/refund/delete/supplier-approval are hard-railed in fn_autonomy_class and cannot be ack-ed here.')
on conflict (key) do update set value=excluded.value, description=excluded.description, updated_at=now();

insert into public.decision_policy(key, value, description) values
('alert_digest_types',
 jsonb_build_array('health_alert','smoke_alert','exception_alert','ops_alert','supply_health',
   'agent_silence','uptime_alert','rfq_sla_breach','ai_quality_alert','doc_expiry',
   'expense_logged','agent_created','policy_inconsistency'),
 'Routine ops-alert notification types folded into the daily brief instead of emailed individually (parked status=digest by trg_notifications_digest). Money/security/legal/critical/founder_alert are hard-excluded regardless.')
on conflict (key) do update set value=excluded.value, description=excluded.description, updated_at=now();

-- 2. Policy-driven classifier. Hard safety rails first (unchanged intent), then policy, then legacy fallback.
create or replace function public.fn_autonomy_class(p_kind text, p_target_table text, p_recommendation text)
returns text
language plpgsql
stable
set search_path to 'public','pg_catalog'
as $function$
declare pol jsonb; d text;
begin
  -- HARD RAILS: money, destructive, and supplier approval can never be auto-cleared by policy.
  if p_kind ~* 'refund|payout|payment|withdraw|transfer|invoice_pay|money|charge' then return 'founder'; end if;
  if p_kind ~* 'delete|purge|remove_record' and coalesce(p_target_table,'') in ('leads','customers') then return 'founder'; end if;
  if p_kind='approve_supplier' and coalesce(p_recommendation,'')='approve' then return 'clean_supplier'; end if;
  if p_kind='approve_supplier' then return 'founder'; end if;
  -- POLICY: founder-editable per-kind disposition.
  select value into pol from public.decision_policy where key='action_autonomy';
  d := pol->>p_kind;
  if d in ('ack','founder','keep') then return d; end if;
  -- LEGACY FALLBACK (kinds not in policy): the original auto-clear set.
  if p_kind in ('security_alert','compliance_update','incident','supply_health','sla_no_supply') then return 'ack'; end if;
  return 'keep';
end $function$;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260724_phase_b_digest_trigger_and_brief.sql

```sql
-- Phase B: (a) park routine ops-alert emails into the daily brief instead of drip-emailing;
--          (b) enrich the single morning brief with an autonomy headline + "handled for you".

-- (a) BEFORE INSERT gate on notifications. Exception-safe: never blocks an insert.
create or replace function public.fn_notifications_digest()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $function$
declare types jsonb;
begin
  if coalesce(NEW.channel,'email') <> 'email' then return NEW; end if;
  if NEW.status is not null and NEW.status not in ('queued','pending') then return NEW; end if;
  if coalesce(NEW.to_role,'') not in ('admin','founder','owner') then return NEW; end if;
  -- HARD EXCLUSIONS: these always send immediately regardless of policy.
  if coalesce(NEW.type,'') ~* 'money|refund|security|legal|fraud|critical|founder_alert|chief_of_staff|founder_brief|verify|otp|reset|password' then return NEW; end if;
  if coalesce(NEW.subject,'') ~* 'critical|urgent|fraud|breach|\mdown\M|failed|failure' then return NEW; end if;
  -- POLICY allowlist of routine types to fold into the brief.
  select value into types from public.decision_policy where key='alert_digest_types';
  if types is not null and types ? coalesce(NEW.type,'') then
    NEW.status := 'digest';
  end if;
  return NEW;
exception when others then
  return NEW;  -- a classifier error must never block a notification insert
end $function$;

drop trigger if exists trg_notifications_digest on public.notifications;
create trigger trg_notifications_digest before insert on public.notifications
  for each row execute function public.fn_notifications_digest();

-- (b) Enriched single morning brief: original content + autonomy headline + handled-for-you drain.
create or replace function public.fn_founder_brief()
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $function$
declare
  v_owner text; v_run bigint;
  v_reg int; v_cust int; v_inq7 int; v_q7 int; v_deals int; v_rev numeric;
  v_pend int; v_kyc int; v_refunds int; v_reviews int;
  v_hot int; v_gap int; v_newsup int; v_newcust int;
  v_bd_q int; v_bd_sent int; v_chat_open int; v_viol int;
  v_officer text; v_health jsonb;
  v_topcats text; v_qpr numeric; v_conv numeric;
  v_expired int; v_crit int; v_decisions text; v_dn int := 0;
  v_body text; v_subj text;
  v_auto_cleared int; v_auto_appr int; v_handled text;   -- Phase B additions
begin
  select split_part(coalesce(value,'management@quotesdone.com'),',',1) into v_owner from app_secrets where key='admin_emails';
  if v_owner is null then v_owner := 'management@quotesdone.com'; end if;
  insert into agent_runs(agent, started_at) values ('brief', now()) returning id into v_run;

  begin select coalesce(registered_supplier_count(),0) into v_reg; exception when others then v_reg := 0; end;
  select count(*) into v_cust from customers;
  select count(*) into v_inq7 from inquiries where created_at >= now()-interval '7 days';
  select count(*) into v_q7 from quotes where created_at >= now()-interval '7 days';
  select count(*) into v_deals from transactions;
  select coalesce(sum(coalesce(reveal_fee,app_fee,0)),0) into v_rev from transactions where coalesce(fee_status,'')<>'refunded' and coalesce(refund_status,'')<>'approved';
  select count(*) into v_pend from agent_actions where status in ('pending','held_for_review','proposed','open','needs_review');
  select count(*) into v_kyc from leads where approval_status='pending';
  select count(*) into v_refunds from transactions where refund_status='requested';
  select count(*) into v_reviews from inbound_messages where needs_review=true;
  select count(distinct i.id) into v_hot from inquiries i join quotes q on q.inquiry_id=i.id left join transactions t on t.inquiry_id=i.id where t.id is null and i.status not in ('completed','accepted','closed','cancelled');
  select count(*) into v_gap from inquiries i where i.status not in ('completed','accepted','closed','cancelled') and not exists (select 1 from inquiry_matches m where m.inquiry_id=i.id);
  select count(*) into v_newsup from leads where registration_submitted_at >= now()-interval '7 days';
  select count(*) into v_newcust from customers where created_at >= now()-interval '7 days';
  select count(*) into v_bd_q from outreach where status='queued';
  select count(*) into v_bd_sent from outreach where status='sent';
  select count(*) into v_chat_open from chat_threads where status='open';
  select count(*) into v_viol from chat_violations where created_at >= now()-interval '7 days';

  begin select public.fn_health_index() into v_health; exception when others then v_health := null; end;

  begin
    select string_agg(cat,', ') into v_topcats from (
      select coalesce(nullif(category,''),'(uncategorized)') cat, count(*) n
      from inquiries where created_at>=now()-interval '7 days'
      group by 1 order by n desc limit 3) z;
  exception when others then v_topcats := null; end;

  begin
    select round(avg(qc),1) into v_qpr from (
      select count(*) qc from quotes q join inquiries i on i.id=q.inquiry_id
      where i.created_at>=now()-interval '30 days' group by q.inquiry_id) z;
  exception when others then v_qpr := null; end;
  begin
    select round(100.0*count(distinct t.inquiry_id)/nullif(count(distinct i.id),0),1) into v_conv
    from inquiries i left join transactions t on t.inquiry_id=i.id
    where i.created_at>=now()-interval '30 days';
  exception when others then v_conv := null; end;

  begin select count(*) into v_expired from leads where license_expiry is not null and license_expiry < current_date and coalesce(approval_status,'')='approved'; exception when others then v_expired:=0; end;
  select count(*) into v_crit from founder_alerts where level='critical' and created_at>=now()-interval '24 hours';

  begin
    select string_agg('- ['||label||'] '||act, E'\n')
    into v_officer
    from (
      select case er.officer
               when 'strategy' then 'Strategy' when 'operations' then 'Ops'
               when 'procurement_quality' then 'Quality' when 'data_science' then 'Data'
               when 'product_ux' then 'Product' when 'competitive' then 'Compete' else er.officer end as label,
             left(coalesce(rec->>'action',''),160) as act,
             case lower(coalesce(rec->>'impact','')) when 'high' then 0 when 'medium' then 1 else 2 end as ord
      from (select distinct on (officer) officer, recommendations, created_at from exec_reports order by officer, created_at desc) er,
           lateral jsonb_array_elements(er.recommendations) rec
      where coalesce(rec->>'action','') <> ''
      order by ord, label limit 5
    ) z;
  exception when others then v_officer := null; end;

  -- Phase B: what the Chief of Staff handled autonomously in the last 24h.
  select count(*) into v_auto_cleared from agent_actions
    where decided_by='chief_of_staff (auto)' and decided_at >= now()-interval '24 hours';
  begin
    select count(*) into v_auto_appr from leads
      where approval_decided_by='chief_of_staff (auto)' and approved_at >= now()-interval '24 hours';
  exception when others then v_auto_appr := 0; end;
  begin
    select string_agg('- '||type||': '||n, E'\n' order by n desc)
      into v_handled
    from (select type, count(*) n from notifications
          where status='digest' and created_at >= now()-interval '24 hours'
          group by type) z;
  exception when others then v_handled := null; end;

  v_decisions := '';
  if v_kyc > 0 then v_dn:=v_dn+1; v_decisions := v_decisions||v_dn||'. Approve/deny '||v_kyc||' supplier KYC application(s)'||E'\n'; end if;
  if v_refunds > 0 then v_dn:=v_dn+1; v_decisions := v_decisions||v_dn||'. Resolve '||v_refunds||' refund request(s)'||E'\n'; end if;
  if v_expired > 0 then v_dn:=v_dn+1; v_decisions := v_decisions||v_dn||'. Review '||v_expired||' supplier(s) with EXPIRED trade licence'||E'\n'; end if;
  if v_crit > 0 then v_dn:=v_dn+1; v_decisions := v_decisions||v_dn||'. Address '||v_crit||' critical alert(s) raised in last 24h'||E'\n'; end if;
  if v_dn = 0 then v_decisions := 'None outstanding.'||E'\n'; end if;

  v_subj := 'QuotesDone daily brief — '||to_char(now() at time zone 'Asia/Dubai','Dy DD Mon');
  v_body :=
    'Good morning. Here is your QuotesDone snapshot.'||E'\n\n'||
    'HANDLED FOR YOU (last 24h): auto-cleared '||v_auto_cleared||' routine item(s)'||
      case when v_auto_appr>0 then ', auto-approved '||v_auto_appr||' licence-clean supplier(s)' else '' end||'.'||
      case when v_handled is not null then E'\n'||v_handled else '' end||E'\n\n'||
    'MARKETPLACE HEALTH: '||coalesce(v_health->>'index','—')||'/100 ('||coalesce(v_health->>'band','no data')||')'||
      case when coalesce(v_health->>'note','')<>'' then '  — '||(v_health->>'note') else '' end||E'\n\n'||
    'NEEDS YOU TODAY'||E'\n'||
    '- Approvals waiting: '||v_pend||' (incl. '||v_kyc||' supplier KYC)'||E'\n'||
    '- Refund requests: '||v_refunds||E'\n'||
    '- Inbound emails to review: '||v_reviews||E'\n'||
    '- Hot leads (quotes in, not revealed): '||v_hot||E'\n'||
    '- Supply gaps (demand, no supplier matched): '||v_gap||E'\n'||
    '- Chat: '||v_chat_open||' open, '||v_viol||' policy flag(s) this week'||E'\n\n'||
    'THIS WEEK'||E'\n'||
    '- New inquiries: '||v_inq7||'  ·  quotes: '||v_q7||E'\n'||
    '- Avg quotes/RFQ (30d): '||coalesce(v_qpr::text,'—')||'  ·  Conversion (30d): '||coalesce(v_conv::text,'—')||'%'||E'\n'||
    '- New customers: '||v_newcust||'  ·  new supplier registrations: '||v_newsup||E'\n'||
    '- Deals (reveals) all-time: '||v_deals||'  ·  revenue recognized: AED '||round(v_rev)||E'\n'||
    '- Top categories (7d): '||coalesce(v_topcats,'—')||E'\n\n'||
    'GROWTH'||E'\n'||
    '- Suppliers registered: '||v_reg||'  ·  BD invites queued: '||v_bd_q||'  ·  sent: '||v_bd_sent||E'\n'||
    case when v_officer is not null and v_officer <> '' then E'\n'||'OFFICER PRIORITIES (from weekly analysis)'||E'\n'||v_officer||E'\n' else '' end ||
    E'\n'||'DECISIONS NEEDED'||E'\n'||v_decisions||
    E'\n'||'Open your dashboard: https://quotesdone.com/os  (Ops for live status; Governance for officer reports).';

  insert into notifications(type,to_email,to_role,channel,subject,body) values ('founder_brief',v_owner,'admin','email',v_subj,v_body);

  -- drain the parked ops-alerts now that they are reported in this brief
  update notifications set status='digested' where status='digest' and created_at <= now();

  update agent_runs set finished_at=now(), status='ok', counts=jsonb_build_object('approvals',v_pend,'hot',v_hot,'gaps',v_gap,'bd_queued',v_bd_q,'kyc',v_kyc,'health',(v_health->>'index'),'decisions',v_dn,'auto_cleared_24h',v_auto_cleared) where id=v_run;
end;$function$;

-- (c) One morning brief: retire the redundant second daily digest email.
-- fn_autonomy_dispose still runs hourly (autonomy_dispose_hourly); fn_chief_of_staff stays callable on demand.
select cron.unschedule('chief_of_staff_daily');
```

### supabase/migrations/20260724_supplier_success_executors.sql

```sql
-- ============================================================================
-- ACTION-EXECUTOR REGISTRY + SUPPLIER SUCCESS executors.
-- The general mechanism that turns a department's ledger task into a REAL side
-- effect: cos_execute (v3) consults org_action_executor — an action_class with
-- an active executor is EXECUTED (mode:'executed'), otherwise the advisory
-- deliverable path runs (mode:'prepared'/'delivered'). Every future department
-- wires its real executors here by INSERT — no code edits.
-- ============================================================================
create table if not exists public.org_action_executor (
  action_class text primary key,
  kind text not null check (kind in ('rpc','edge')),
  target text not null,                 -- rpc: function name; edge: function slug
  params jsonb not null default '{}',   -- static args passed to the executor
  active boolean not null default true,
  note text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
alter table public.org_action_executor enable row level security;

-- Supplier Success executor #1: send the next batch of invites, safely.
-- Thin jsonb wrapper over enqueue_supplier_invites (self-limits to the daily cap,
-- targets under-served trades, auto-pauses on bounce). Honest when the campaign is off.
create or replace function public.fn_org_exec_invite(p_cap int default null)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_catalog'
as $function$
declare v_enabled boolean; v_cap int; v_sent int;
begin
  v_enabled := coalesce((select value from app_secrets where key='invite_enabled'),'false')='true';
  v_cap := coalesce((select nullif(value,'')::int from app_secrets where key='invite_daily_cap'), 10);
  select public.enqueue_supplier_invites(p_cap) into v_sent;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'invited', coalesce(v_sent,0),
    'campaign_enabled', v_enabled,
    'daily_cap', v_cap,
    'note', case when not v_enabled then 'Invite campaign is not enabled yet — 0 sent. It starts on its scheduled date; the deliverability-gated ramp will then send within the daily cap.'
                 else 'Enqueued '||coalesce(v_sent,0)||' invite(s) this run, within the daily cap of '||v_cap||' and bounce-rate guard.' end
  );
end $function$;
revoke execute on function public.fn_org_exec_invite(int) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.fn_org_exec_invite(int) to service_role;

-- Supplier Success executor #2: auto-approve ONLY licence-OCR-clean suppliers (supervised — founder
-- audits; approval_decided_by tags each row and the daily brief counts 'chief_of_staff (auto)').
-- STRICT clean criteria; anything not fully clean is left for manual review, never rejected.
create or replace function public.fn_supplier_autoapprove_clean(p_limit int default 25)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_catalog'
as $function$
declare v_ids bigint[]; v_approved int := 0; v_scanned int; r record;
begin
  select count(*) into v_scanned from leads
    where approval_status in ('pending','submitted') and coalesce(banned,false)=false;

  select array_agg(id) into v_ids from (
    select id from leads
    where approval_status in ('pending','submitted')
      and coalesce(banned,false) = false
      and registration_submitted_at is not null
      and license_doc_path is not null
      and doc_extracted_at is not null
      and trade_license_no is not null and length(trade_license_no) > 3
      and license_expiry is not null and license_expiry > current_date + 30
      and coalesce(owner_email_verified,false) = true
    order by registration_submitted_at
    limit greatest(1, coalesce(p_limit,25))
  ) z;

  if v_ids is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('approved',0,'candidates_scanned',v_scanned,'note','No licence-OCR-clean applicants to auto-approve; any remaining applicants need manual review.');
  end if;

  for r in select id, company_name, coalesce(claimed_by,email) as contact from leads where id = any(v_ids) loop
    update leads set approval_status='approved', verified=true, verification_status='verified',
      lifecycle_stage='active', approved_at=now(), approval_decided_by='chief_of_staff (auto)'
      where id = r.id;
    if r.contact is not null then
      insert into notifications(type,to_email,to_role,lead_id,channel,subject,body)
      values('registration_approved', r.contact, 'supplier', r.id, 'email',
        'You''re verified on QuotesDone',
        'Good news — '||coalesce(r.company_name,'your company')||' has been verified on QuotesDone (trade licence checks passed). You can now receive inquiries and quote: https://quotesdone.com/suppliers/');
    end if;
    v_approved := v_approved + 1;
  end loop;

  return jsonb_build_object('approved',v_approved,'candidates_scanned',v_scanned,'approved_ids',v_ids,
    'note','Auto-approved '||v_approved||' licence-OCR-clean supplier(s); '||(v_scanned - v_approved)||' applicant(s) left for manual review.');
end $function$;
revoke execute on function public.fn_supplier_autoapprove_clean(int) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.fn_supplier_autoapprove_clean(int) to service_role;

-- Seed the registry for Supplier Success.
insert into public.org_action_executor(action_class, kind, target, params, note) values
('invite','rpc','fn_org_exec_invite','{}','Send the next batch of supplier invites within the deliverability-gated daily ramp.'),
('supplier_approve_clean','rpc','fn_supplier_autoapprove_clean','{}','Auto-approve only licence-OCR-clean suppliers; leave the rest for manual review (founder audits).')
on conflict (action_class) do update set kind=excluded.kind, target=excluded.target, params=excluded.params, note=excluded.note, active=true;

insert into public.org_memory(scope,kind,content,source) values
('supplier_success','policy','Supplier Success executes real actions via the action registry: invite (autonomous) sends within the deliverability-gated ramp; supplier_approve_clean (supervised) auto-approves ONLY licence-OCR-clean suppliers (licence uploaded + OCR''d + licence number + valid 30+ day expiry + verified owner email + not banned), leaving anything else for manual review. Every auto-approval is tagged chief_of_staff (auto) and surfaced in the founder brief.','founder_directive')
on conflict do nothing;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728080133_lead_category_taxonomy.sql

```sql
-- Two genuine holes in the 84-category catalogue, confirmed against the lead data and already
-- flagged by lead_trade_map ("NO CATALOGUE CATEGORY"). 496 signage + 104 printing + 86 lift leads had
-- nowhere to sit, which means any buyer asking for a shopfront sign or a lift service contract would
-- have received zero quotes.
insert into catalog_supplier_categories (slug, num, name, regulated, sort) values
  ('signage-and-printing-suppliers', 85, 'Signage & Printing Suppliers', false, 85),
  ('lifts-and-escalator-suppliers',  86, 'Lifts & Escalator Suppliers',  true,  86)
on conflict (slug) do nothing;

-- The lexicon. Classification is deterministic and auditable: every assignment can be traced back to
-- the exact patterns that fired. Deliberately NOT an LLM pass - 20,464 leads through a model is real
-- money for a job that keyword evidence does better and repeatably.
create table if not exists category_keyword (
  id bigserial primary key,
  slug text not null references catalog_supplier_categories(slug) on delete cascade,
  pattern text not null,          -- lowercase; matched on word boundaries against the normalised haystack
  weight int not null default 2,  -- 3 decisive, 2 strong, 1 weak/supporting
  negative boolean not null default false,  -- fires against the slug instead of for it
  note text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create unique index if not exists category_keyword_uidx on category_keyword (slug, pattern);
create index if not exists category_keyword_slug_idx on category_keyword (slug);

-- Many-to-many, because a real electromechanical contractor serves electrical AND plumbing AND HVAC.
-- leads.sector is deliberately left untouched: route_inquiry and the invite system read it today, so
-- this lands as a pure addition that cannot break matching while it is being validated.
create table if not exists lead_category (
  lead_id bigint not null references leads(id) on delete cascade,
  slug text not null references catalog_supplier_categories(slug) on delete cascade,
  score int not null default 0,
  is_primary boolean not null default false,
  method text not null default 'keyword_v1',
  evidence text,                  -- the patterns that fired, so a wrong assignment is diagnosable
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (lead_id, slug)
);
create index if not exists lead_category_slug_idx on lead_category (slug);
create unique index if not exists lead_category_primary_uidx on lead_category (lead_id) where is_primary;

alter table category_keyword enable row level security;
alter table lead_category   enable row level security;
revoke all on category_keyword from anon, authenticated;
revoke all on lead_category   from anon, authenticated;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728080201_lead_haystack_view.sql

```sql
-- One canonical normalised text per lead. Everything that classifies a lead reads THIS, so a pattern
-- authored against it behaves identically at test time and at run time.
-- Notes on the normalisation, each earned from the actual data:
--   * the scrape stored HTML entities, so "&#038;" and "&amp;" become " and " before anything else;
--   * for ~5,144 leads the categories/services/capability_summary columns are literally the company
--     name echoed back, so company_name has to be part of the haystack or those leads have no signal;
--   * the string is space-padded at both ends so a pattern can be matched as ' word ' and never fire
--     on a substring (otherwise 'ac' hits 'placard' and 'it' hits 'furniture').
create or replace view v_lead_text as
select l.id,
       ' ' || regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                  lower(regexp_replace(
                    concat_ws(' ',
                      l.sector, l.sub_type, l.categories, l.services, l.products,
                      l.description, l.company_name, l.capability_summary),
                    '&#0?38;|&amp;', ' and ', 'g')),
                  '[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', 'g'),
                '\s+', ' ', 'g') || ' ' as hay
from leads l;

revoke all on v_lead_text from anon, authenticated;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728090728_contracting_domain_and_lead_subcategory_v3.sql

```sql
-- WHY DOMAIN 67 EXISTS. Domain 16 (construction-civil-and-building-materials) deliberately lists only
-- MATERIALS - steel, cement, aggregates, formwork, roofing, road materials. Nothing in any of the
-- three taxonomies covers a firm that actually EXECUTES construction, yet 2,613 leads (12.8% of the
-- base) are exactly that, and "build my villa extension" or "renovate this floor" is an ordinary RFQ
-- for a UAE quote marketplace. Without this domain those requests match nobody and receive no quotes.
insert into catalog_domains (slug, num, name, sort) values
  ('general-contracting-and-civil-works', 67, 'General Contracting & Civil Works', 67)
on conflict (slug) do nothing;

insert into catalog_subcategories (domain_slug, name, slug, sort) values
  ('general-contracting-and-civil-works', 'General building contracting',           'general-building-contracting',            1),
  ('general-contracting-and-civil-works', 'Villa & residential construction',       'villa-and-residential-construction',      2),
  ('general-contracting-and-civil-works', 'Commercial & industrial construction',   'commercial-and-industrial-construction',  3),
  ('general-contracting-and-civil-works', 'Renovation & refurbishment',             'renovation-and-refurbishment',            4),
  ('general-contracting-and-civil-works', 'Demolition & dismantling',               'demolition-and-dismantling',              5),
  ('general-contracting-and-civil-works', 'Civil & infrastructure works',           'civil-and-infrastructure-works',          6),
  ('general-contracting-and-civil-works', 'Earthworks, excavation & piling',        'earthworks-excavation-and-piling',        7),
  ('general-contracting-and-civil-works', 'Road works, asphalt & paving',           'road-works-asphalt-and-paving',           8),
  ('general-contracting-and-civil-works', 'Steel structure erection',               'steel-structure-erection',                9),
  ('general-contracting-and-civil-works', 'Handyman & small works',                 'handyman-and-small-works',               10),
  ('general-contracting-and-civil-works', 'Electromechanical contracting',          'electromechanical-contracting',          11)
on conflict do nothing;

-- Lifts and escalators are missing from all three taxonomies as well: the only near match anywhere is
-- "Lifting equipment inspection", which is a TIC service, not a lift supplier. 86 leads, and a trade
-- every multi-storey building in the UAE has to procure.
insert into catalog_subcategories (domain_slug, name, slug, sort) values
  ('mep-mechanical-electrical-plumbing', 'Lifts, elevators & escalators', 'lifts-elevators-and-escalators', 900)
on conflict do nothing;

-- slug was already unique across all 456 rows but was never constrained, so nothing could reference it.

alter table catalog_subcategories drop constraint if exists catalog_subcategories_slug_key;
alter table catalog_subcategories add constraint catalog_subcategories_slug_key unique using index catalog_subcategories_slug_uidx;

-- Classification now targets the CANONICAL taxonomy. The earlier lead_category table pointed at
-- catalog_supplier_categories, which no production function reads; it is retained only so the two
-- runs can be compared, and is superseded by this one.
create table if not exists lead_subcategory (
  lead_id bigint not null references leads(id) on delete cascade,
  sub_slug text not null references catalog_subcategories(slug) on delete cascade,
  domain_slug text not null,

  method text not null default 'keyword_v2',

  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),

create index if not exists lead_subcategory_sub_idx    on lead_subcategory (sub_slug);
create index if not exists lead_subcategory_domain_idx on lead_subcategory (domain_slug);
create unique index if not exists lead_subcategory_primary_uidx on lead_subcategory (lead_id) where is_primary;

create table if not exists subcategory_keyword (
  id bigserial primary key,
  sub_slug text not null references catalog_subcategories(slug) on delete cascade,
  pattern text not null,
  weight int not null default 2,
  negative boolean not null default false,

  created_at timestamptz not null default now()

create unique index if not exists subcategory_keyword_uidx on subcategory_keyword (sub_slug, pattern);
create index if not exists subcategory_keyword_slug_idx on subcategory_keyword (sub_slug);

alter table lead_subcategory    enable row level security;
alter table subcategory_keyword enable row level security;
revoke all on lead_subcategory, subcategory_keyword from anon, authenticated;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728103435_invite_balance_across_canonical_categories.sql

```sql
-- WHY. enqueue_supplier_invites already round-robins across trades, but it balanced over
-- taxonomy_trade - 25 coarse codes - and read each lead's trades from leads.invite_trades, which was
-- populated for only 9,685 of 20,464 leads. Every one of the other 10,779 fell into the single
-- '~none' bucket, so the round-robin had nothing to rotate over and a run could spend the whole daily
-- cap inside one trade. That is the "a whole day of emailing only fit-out suppliers" failure.
--
-- WHAT CHANGES. Balancing now runs over catalog_domains (67), the canonical taxonomy, using the
-- lead_subcategory classification, which covers 80.1% of leads instead of 47%. Everything protecting
-- deliverability is untouched: the bounce-rate pause, the absolute hard-bounce rule, fn_email_sendable,
-- and the max-5-per-recipient-domain rule all behave exactly as before.

-- Keep invite_trades populated too, so the column stays meaningful for anything else reading it
-- (backup, resend_webhook) and so a human can see a lead's categories without a join.
update leads l
set invite_trades = sub.domains
from (
  select lead_id, array_agg(distinct domain_slug order by domain_slug) as domains
  from lead_subcategory group by lead_id
) sub
where sub.lead_id = l.id
  and (l.invite_trades is distinct from sub.domains);

create or replace function public.enqueue_supplier_invites(p_cap integer default null)
returns integer
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path to 'public'
as $function$
declare
  v_today date := (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date;
  v_planned int; v_used int; v_remaining int; v_subj text; v_body text; v_count int;
  v_inv_recent int; v_bounced_recent int; v_rate numeric; v_max_rate numeric; v_target int; v_cap int;
  v_pause boolean := false; v_why text;
begin
  if coalesce((select value from app_secrets where key='invite_enabled'),'false') <> 'true' then return 0; end if;

  v_cap := coalesce((select nullif(value,'')::int from app_secrets where key='invite_daily_cap'), 10);
  insert into invite_schedule(day, planned, status) values (v_today, v_cap, 'approved')
    on conflict (day) do update set planned = excluded.planned, status = 'approved';
  v_planned := least(coalesce(p_cap, v_cap), v_cap);
  if v_planned <= 0 then return 0; end if;

  v_max_rate := coalesce((select nullif(value,'')::numeric from app_secrets where key='invite_max_bounce_rate'), 0.08);
  select count(*) into v_inv_recent from leads where invited_at > now() - interval '3 days';
  select count(*) into v_bounced_recent from leads where invite_status='bounced' and invited_at > now() - interval '3 days';
  v_rate := round(v_bounced_recent::numeric / greatest(v_inv_recent,1), 3);

  if v_inv_recent >= 15 and v_rate > v_max_rate then
    v_pause := true;
    v_why := 'bounce rate '||(v_rate*100)||'% over 3 days ('||v_bounced_recent||'/'||v_inv_recent||') exceeds the '||(v_max_rate*100)||'% limit';
  end if;
  if not v_pause and v_bounced_recent >= 5 then
    v_pause := true;
    v_why := v_bounced_recent||' hard bounces in 3 days. Regardless of rate, that is a list-quality problem';
  end if;

  if v_pause then
    update app_secrets set value='false' where key='invite_enabled';
    if not exists (select 1 from founder_alerts where event='invite_paused_bounce' and created_at > now()-interval '24 hours') then
      insert into founder_alerts(level,event,detail,channel)
        values('crit','invite_paused_bounce','Supplier invites AUTO-PAUSED: '||v_why||'. Clean the list before resuming.','system');
      insert into notifications(type,to_email,to_role,channel,subject,body,status)
        values('invite_paused_bounce', coalesce((select split_part(value,',',1) from app_secrets where key='admin_emails'),'management@quotesdone.com'),'admin','email','Supplier invites paused - deliverability risk','Invites were auto-paused: '||v_why||'. Validate the list, then re-enable.','queued');
    end if;
    return 0;
  end if;

  select value into v_subj from app_secrets where key='invite_subject';
  select value into v_body from app_secrets where key='invite_body';
  select count(*) into v_used from notifications where type='supplier_invite' and (created_at at time zone 'UTC')::date = v_today;
  v_remaining := greatest(0, v_planned - v_used);
  if v_remaining <= 0 then return 0; end if;

  -- How many REGISTERED suppliers we want per category before that category stops being prioritised.
  v_target := coalesce((select nullif(value,'')::int from app_secrets where key='invite_target_per_category'),
                       (select nullif(value,'')::int from app_secrets where key='invite_target_per_trade'), 10);

  with activated as (
    -- suppliers who actually came on board, counted per canonical domain
    select ls.domain_slug, count(distinct l.id) ct
    from leads l join lead_subcategory ls on ls.lead_id = l.id
    where coalesce(l.claimed,false) = true
    group by ls.domain_slug
  ),
  under as (
    select d.slug as domain_slug, coalesce(a.ct,0) as have
    from catalog_domains d left join activated a on a.domain_slug = d.slug
    where coalesce(a.ct,0) < v_target
  ),
  cand as (
    select distinct on (lower(l.email)) l.id, l.email, l.company_name, l.email_domain, l.email_verified
    from leads l
    where l.email is not null and l.email <> '' and l.invite_status is null
      and coalesce(l.source,'') <> 'self_registered' and coalesce(l.claimed,false) = false
      and (public.fn_email_sendable(l.email)->>'ok')::boolean
    order by lower(l.email), l.id
  ),
  prio as (
    select c.id, c.email, c.company_name, c.email_domain,
      -- the lead's own most under-served category; emptiest category first so coverage evens out
      coalesce((select u.domain_slug from lead_subcategory ls join under u on u.domain_slug = ls.domain_slug
                 where ls.lead_id = c.id order by u.have asc, ls.score desc limit 1), '~none') as pdomain,
      case when c.email_verified in ('verified','true') then 0 else 1 end as unverified_rank
    from cand c
  ),
  elig as (
    select id, email, company_name from (
      select id, email, company_name, pdomain, unverified_rank,
        case when pdomain='~none' then 1 else 0 end as is_none,
        -- rk cycles: taking rk=1 from every category before any rk=2 is what spreads a run
        row_number() over (partition by pdomain order by unverified_rank, id) as rk,
        row_number() over (partition by coalesce(email_domain, split_part(email,'@',2)) order by unverified_rank, id) as domain_rk
      from prio
    ) r
    where domain_rk <= 5
    -- unclassified leads ('~none') come last: never spend the cap on a lead whose trade we do not know
    order by is_none, rk, unverified_rank, pdomain
    limit v_remaining
  ),
  ins as (
    insert into notifications(type,to_email,to_role,lead_id,subject,body,status,created_at)
    select 'supplier_invite', email, 'supplier', id, v_subj,
           replace(v_body, '{{company}}', coalesce(nullif(btrim(company_name),''), 'there')), 'queued', now()
    from elig returning to_email
  )
  update leads set invite_status='queued', invited_at=now()
  where invite_status is null and lower(email) in (select lower(to_email) from ins);
  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  update invite_schedule set sent = sent + v_count where day = v_today;
  return v_count;
end; $function$;

insert into app_secrets (key, value) values ('invite_target_per_category','10')
on conflict (key) do update set value = excluded.value;

select (select count(*) from leads where invite_trades is not null and cardinality(invite_trades)>0) leads_with_categories,
       (select count(distinct d) from leads l, lateral unnest(l.invite_trades) d) distinct_categories_in_play;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728103523_subcategory_agent_bridge.sql

```sql
-- THE ALIGNMENT GAP, stated as a number: of 470 canonical subcategories, ZERO share a slug with any of
-- the 106 trade agents. So the taxonomy suppliers and RFQs are classified into had no relationship to
-- the agents that hold the category knowledge and answer the inquiry. This table is that bridge:
-- subcategory -> the agent whose knowledge covers it. With it, one join takes an inquiry from detected
-- subcategory to the right agent, and from that agent to the suppliers grouped under it.
create table if not exists subcategory_agent_map (
  sub_slug text primary key references catalog_subcategories(slug) on delete cascade,
  agent_slug text not null,
  confidence text not null default 'medium',   -- high | medium | low | none
  note text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists subcategory_agent_map_agent_idx on subcategory_agent_map (agent_slug);
alter table subcategory_agent_map enable row level security;
revoke all on subcategory_agent_map from anon, authenticated;

-- One place that answers "who handles this supplier, and does that agent actually know the trade?"
create or replace view v_supplier_alignment as
select l.id                as lead_id,
       l.company_name,
       l.email,
       l.emirate,
       ls.sub_slug,
       cs.name            as subcategory_name,
       ls.domain_slug,
       cd.name            as domain_name,
       ls.is_primary,
       ls.score,
       m.agent_slug,
       m.confidence       as mapping_confidence,
       (ca.slug is not null)                          as agent_exists,
       (ak.modules is not null and ak.modules > 0)    as agent_has_knowledge,
       coalesce(ak.modules, 0)                        as knowledge_modules
from leads l
join lead_subcategory ls        on ls.lead_id = l.id
join catalog_subcategories cs   on cs.slug = ls.sub_slug
join catalog_domains cd         on cd.slug = ls.domain_slug
left join subcategory_agent_map m on m.sub_slug = ls.sub_slug
left join category_agents ca      on ca.slug = m.agent_slug and ca.folded_into is null
left join (select replace(agent_key,'cat:','') slug, count(*) modules
             from agent_knowledge where agent_key like 'cat:%' group by 1) ak
       on ak.slug = m.agent_slug;

revoke all on v_supplier_alignment from anon, authenticated;
```

```sql
  when 'Share of published items passing brand review first time' then
    $q$select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where decision='approve')/nullif(count(*),0),2) from review_chain where dept_key='marketing' and created_at > now()-interval '30 days'$q$

  when 'Drafts returned for brand-voice revision' then
    $q$select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where decision<>'approve')/nullif(count(*),0),2) from review_chain where dept_key='marketing' and created_at > now()-interval '30 days'$q$
  when 'Creatives returned for brand-asset breach' then
    $q$select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where decision<>'approve')/nullif(count(*),0),2) from review_chain where dept_key='marketing' and created_at > now()-interval '30 days'$q$

  when 'Quality gate pass rate before ship' then
    $q$select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where passed)/nullif(count(*),0),2) from qa_results where run_at > now()-interval '7 days'$q$

  when 'Compliance checks completed before deadline' then
    $q$select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where present)/nullif(count(*),0),2) from legal_checklist$q$

  when 'Reporting and controls completed on time' then

  when 'Qualified pipeline created against plan' then
    $q$select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where rfq_ready)/nullif(count(*),0),2) from inquiries where created_at > now()-interval '30 days'$q$

  when 'Employees with complete KPI, authority and knowledge binding' then

  when 'Company goals with active work and no red status' then
    $q$select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where exists(select 1 from org_tasks t where t.dept_key=g.owner_dept and t.status<>'done'))/nullif(count(*),0),2) from company_goals g where g.active$q$
  when 'Goals having at least one open initiative' then
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728165658_fn_kpi_scoreboard_close_the_accountability_loop.sql

```sql
create or replace function public.fn_kpi_scoreboard()
returns table (
  kpi_id       bigint,
  agent_key    text,
  department   text,
  kpi          text,
  metric       text,
  cadence      text,
  serves_goal  text,
  target       numeric,
  unit         text,
  actual       numeric,
  attainment   numeric,
  verdict      text
)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path to 'public', 'pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare
  r record;
  v numeric;
  t numeric;
begin
  for r in
    select k.id, k.agent_key, a.department, k.kpi, k.metric, k.cadence,
           k.serves_goal, k.target_value, k.unit, k.measure_sql
    from employee_kpi k
    left join org_agents a on a.agent_key = k.agent_key
    where k.active
    order by a.department nulls last, k.agent_key, k.id
  loop
    v := null;
    begin
      if r.measure_sql is not null then
        execute r.measure_sql into v;
      end if;
    exception when others then
      v := null;   -- a broken metric must not break the scoreboard
    end;

    t := nullif(regexp_replace(coalesce(r.target_value,''), '[^0-9.\-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric;

    kpi_id      := r.id;
    agent_key   := r.agent_key;
    department  := r.department;
    kpi         := r.kpi;
    metric      := r.metric;
    cadence     := r.cadence;
    serves_goal := r.serves_goal;
    target      := t;
    unit        := r.unit;
    actual      := v;

    if v is null or t is null or t = 0 then
      attainment := null;
    elsif r.unit = 'percent_max' then
      -- lower is better: full attainment at or below target
      attainment := round(least(100.0, 100.0 * t / nullif(v,0)), 1);
    else
      attainment := round(100.0 * v / t, 1);
    end if;

    verdict := case
      when v is null then 'NO DATA'
      when attainment is null then 'NO TARGET'
      when attainment >= 100 then 'MET'
      when attainment >= 90  then 'NEAR'
      else 'MISSED'
    end;

    return next;
  end loop;
end
$fn$;

revoke execute on function public.fn_kpi_scoreboard() from public;
revoke execute on function public.fn_kpi_scoreboard() from anon;
revoke execute on function public.fn_kpi_scoreboard() from authenticated;

comment on function public.fn_kpi_scoreboard() is
  'Evaluates every active employee_kpi.measure_sql and returns actual vs target with a verdict. Service-role only. A metric that throws yields NO DATA rather than breaking the run.';
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728170742_agent_identity_resolution_autonomy_from_30_jul.sql

```sql
-- THE BUG: trg_action_gate calls fn_authorize(NEW.agent, ...) passing an AGENT KEY
-- ('it', 'onboarding', 'knowledge_curator') into a parameter named p_email.
-- fn_role_of() only ever looked in user_roles / admin_emails / leads / customers,
-- all keyed by email, so every employee resolved to 'guest'. Role 'guest' holds no
-- permissions, so 810 of 811 decisions in the system's life were held_for_review
-- with: role "guest" lacks permission "run_agent_action".
--
-- The authority model was never the problem. Role 'agent' already exists with a
-- deliberately conservative envelope: route_inquiry, send_message, and
-- run_agent_action capped at max_amount_aed = 0. It grants NO approve_supplier,
-- NO issue_refund, NO edit_pricing, NO publish_content. Employees simply never
-- reached it.
--
-- Two new switches, both plain rows you can flip without a deploy:
--   agent_autonomy_from    - date autonomy begins (set to 30 Jul 2026)
--   agent_autonomy_enabled - kill switch; set to false to park everything again

insert into app_secrets (key, value)
select 'agent_autonomy_from', '2026-07-30'
where not exists (select 1 from app_secrets where key = 'agent_autonomy_from');

insert into app_secrets (key, value)
select 'agent_autonomy_enabled', 'true'
where not exists (select 1 from app_secrets where key = 'agent_autonomy_enabled');

create or replace function public.fn_role_of(p_email text)
returns text
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path to 'public', 'pg_temp'
as $function$
declare
  e text := lower(trim(coalesce(p_email,'')));
  v_role text;
  v_from date;
  v_on boolean;
begin
  if e = '' then return 'guest'; end if;

  -- Human identities first: unchanged behaviour, still wins over everything.
  select ur.role into v_role from user_roles ur
   where ur.email = e
   order by array_position(array['owner','admin','ops','finance','support','agent'], ur.role)
   limit 1;
  if v_role is not null then return v_role; end if;

  if e = any (string_to_array(lower(coalesce((select value from app_secrets where key='admin_emails'),'')), ','))
    then return 'owner'; end if;

  -- AGENT IDENTITY. Only for values that are not email addresses, so a real
  -- person can never be mistaken for an employee record.
  if position('@' in e) = 0 then
    if exists (select 1 from org_agents where lower(agent_key) = e and active) then
      v_on := lower(coalesce((select value from app_secrets where key='agent_autonomy_enabled'),'true')) = 'true';
      begin
        v_from := coalesce((select value from app_secrets where key='agent_autonomy_from'),'2026-07-30')::date;
      exception when others then v_from := date '2026-07-30';
      end;
      if v_on and current_date >= v_from then
        return 'agent';
      else
        return 'guest';   -- pre-arming: behaviour identical to today
      end if;
    end if;
  end if;

  if exists (select 1 from leads where lower(coalesce(claimed_by,'')) = e) then return 'supplier'; end if;
  if exists (select 1 from customers where lower(coalesce(email,'')) = e) then return 'customer'; end if;
  return 'guest';
end
$function$;

comment on function public.fn_role_of(text) is
  'Resolves an identity to a role. Accepts an email OR an org_agents.agent_key. Agent keys resolve to role "agent" only when agent_autonomy_enabled is true AND current_date >= agent_autonomy_from; otherwise "guest", which reproduces pre-30-Jul-2026 behaviour exactly.';
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728171053_fn_kpi_review_weekly_turn_missed_kpis_into_work.sql

```sql
-- A measurement nobody reads is not management. fn_kpi_scoreboard() was built today
-- but no scheduled job consumed it. This turns a missed KPI into actual work on the
-- owning department's list, which is what a real manager does at a weekly review.
create or replace function public.fn_kpi_review()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path to 'public', 'pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare
  r record;
  v_opened int := 0;
  v_missed int := 0;
  v_nodata int := 0;
  v_title  text;
begin
  for r in select * from fn_kpi_scoreboard() loop

    if r.verdict = 'NO DATA' then
      v_nodata := v_nodata + 1;
      continue;
    end if;

    if r.verdict <> 'MISSED' then
      continue;
    end if;

    v_missed := v_missed + 1;
    v_title := 'KPI missed: ' || r.metric || ' (' || r.agent_key || ')';

    -- idempotent: never stack duplicates of an unresolved item
    if exists (
      select 1 from org_tasks
      where title = v_title and status <> 'done'
    ) then
      continue;
    end if;

    insert into org_tasks (dept_key, title, detail, status, tier, needs_founder, action_class)
    values (
      coalesce(r.department, 'exec'),
      v_title,
      'Owner: ' || r.agent_key ||
      '. Target ' || coalesce(r.target::text,'?') || ' ' || coalesce(r.unit,'') ||
      ', actual ' || coalesce(r.actual::text,'?') ||
      ' (' || coalesce(r.attainment::text,'?') || '% of target), cadence ' || coalesce(r.cadence,'?') ||
      '. Serves company goal: ' || coalesce(r.serves_goal,'unassigned') ||
      '. Diagnose the cause and either close the gap or propose a revised target with evidence.',
      'proposed',
      'advisory',
      false,
      'recommend'
    );
    v_opened := v_opened + 1;
  end loop;

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('kpi_review', now(), now(),
          case when v_missed > 0 and v_opened = 0 then 'ok' else 'ok' end,
          jsonb_build_object('missed', v_missed, 'opened', v_opened, 'no_data', v_nodata),
          'Weekly KPI review: ' || v_missed || ' KPI(s) missing target, ' || v_opened ||
          ' new task(s) opened, ' || v_nodata || ' KPI(s) had no data in the measurement window.');

  return jsonb_build_object('missed', v_missed, 'opened', v_opened, 'no_data', v_nodata);
end
$fn$;

revoke execute on function public.fn_kpi_review() from public, anon, authenticated;

comment on function public.fn_kpi_review() is
  'Weekly. Evaluates every KPI and opens an org_task against the owning department for each MISSED target. Idempotent: will not duplicate an unresolved task.';
```

```sql
create table if not exists public.outcome_record (
  id              bigserial primary key,
  actor           text not null,
  dept_key        text,
  subject_type    text not null,
  subject_id      text,
  decision        text not null,
  rationale       text,
  evidence        jsonb default '[]'::jsonb,
  expected_kpi_id bigint references employee_kpi(id),
  expected_metric text,
  expected_direction text not null default 'up' check (expected_direction in ('up','down')),
  baseline_value  numeric,
  baseline_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
  measure_after   interval not null default '14 days',
  due_at          timestamptz not null default (now() + interval '14 days'),
  observed_value  numeric,
  observed_at     timestamptz,
  delta           numeric,
  verdict         text not null default 'pending'
                  check (verdict in ('pending','improved','no_change','worse','unmeasurable')),
  promoted        boolean not null default false,
  rolled_back     boolean not null default false,
  rollback_reason text,
  lesson          text,
  closed_at       timestamptz,
  created_at      timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists outcome_record_due_idx on public.outcome_record (due_at) where verdict='pending';
create index if not exists outcome_record_actor_idx on public.outcome_record (actor);
create index if not exists outcome_record_subject_idx on public.outcome_record (subject_type, subject_id);
alter table public.outcome_record enable row level security;

comment on table public.outcome_record is
  'One row per autonomous decision that claims it will improve something. Records the claim and the baseline BEFORE execution, then grades it against reality after measure_after. A change that made things worse is marked worse and flagged for rollback. Turns execution into proof.';

create or replace function public.fn_outcome_open(
  p_actor text, p_decision text,
  p_subject_type text default 'manual', p_subject_id text default null,
  p_expected_kpi_id bigint default null, p_rationale text default null,
  p_evidence jsonb default '[]'::jsonb, p_direction text default 'up',
  p_measure_after interval default '14 days'
) returns bigint
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare v_sql text; v_base numeric; v_metric text; v_dept text; v_id bigint;
begin
  if p_expected_kpi_id is not null then
    select measure_sql, metric into v_sql, v_metric from employee_kpi where id = p_expected_kpi_id;
    begin
      if v_sql is not null then execute v_sql into v_base; end if;
    exception when others then v_base := null; end;
  end if;

  select a.department into v_dept from org_agents a where a.agent_key = p_actor;

  insert into outcome_record (actor, dept_key, subject_type, subject_id, decision, rationale,
                              evidence, expected_kpi_id, expected_metric, expected_direction,
                              baseline_value, measure_after, due_at)
  values (p_actor, v_dept, p_subject_type, p_subject_id, p_decision, p_rationale,
          coalesce(p_evidence,'[]'::jsonb), p_expected_kpi_id, v_metric,
          coalesce(p_direction,'up'), v_base, coalesce(p_measure_after, interval '14 days'),
          now() + coalesce(p_measure_after, interval '14 days'))
  returning id into v_id;
  return v_id;
end $fn$;

revoke execute on function public.fn_outcome_open(text,text,text,text,bigint,text,jsonb,text,interval)
  from public, anon, authenticated;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728172404_fn_outcome_evaluate_grade_and_retire.sql

```sql
-- Grades every due outcome against its own claim, writes the lesson into organisational
-- memory, and flags anything that made things worse for reversal. This is the half of the
-- loop that did not exist: measure -> compare to baseline -> promote or roll back -> learn.
create or replace function public.fn_outcome_evaluate()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare
  r record; v_sql text; v_now numeric; v_delta numeric; v_verdict text; v_lesson text;
  n_improved int := 0; n_worse int := 0; n_flat int := 0; n_unmeasurable int := 0;
begin
  for r in
    select o.*, k.measure_sql
    from outcome_record o
    left join employee_kpi k on k.id = o.expected_kpi_id
    where o.verdict = 'pending' and o.due_at <= now()
  loop
    v_now := null;
    begin
      if r.measure_sql is not null then execute r.measure_sql into v_now; end if;
    exception when others then v_now := null; end;

    if v_now is null or r.baseline_value is null then
      v_verdict := 'unmeasurable'; v_delta := null;
      v_lesson := 'Could not be graded: no measurable KPI attached, or no reading available in the window. '
               || 'A change nobody can measure cannot be proven to have helped.';
      n_unmeasurable := n_unmeasurable + 1;
    else
      v_delta := v_now - r.baseline_value;
      if r.expected_direction = 'down' then v_delta := -v_delta; end if;

      if v_delta > 0 then
        v_verdict := 'improved';
        v_lesson := r.decision || ' -> ' || r.expected_metric || ' moved from ' || r.baseline_value
                 || ' to ' || v_now || ' as predicted. Promote to standard practice.';
        n_improved := n_improved + 1;
      elsif v_delta < 0 then
        v_verdict := 'worse';
        v_lesson := r.decision || ' -> ' || r.expected_metric || ' moved the WRONG WAY, from '
                 || r.baseline_value || ' to ' || v_now || '. Reverse this change and do not repeat it.';
        n_worse := n_worse + 1;
      else
        v_verdict := 'no_change';
        v_lesson := r.decision || ' -> ' || r.expected_metric || ' unchanged at ' || v_now
                 || '. The action was not the lever. Look elsewhere before spending more on this.';
        n_flat := n_flat + 1;
      end if;
    end if;

    update outcome_record
       set observed_value = v_now, observed_at = now(), delta = v_delta,
           verdict = v_verdict, lesson = v_lesson,
           promoted = (v_verdict = 'improved'),
           rollback_reason = case when v_verdict = 'worse'
                                  then 'Graded worse than baseline on ' || to_char(now(),'DD Mon YYYY')
                                  else null end,
           closed_at = now()
     where id = r.id;

    -- Every graded outcome becomes organisational memory, not just the successes.
    begin
      insert into institutional_memory (topic, lesson, source, dept_key, created_at)
      values ('outcome:' || coalesce(r.expected_metric, r.subject_type),
              v_lesson, 'outcome_record#' || r.id, r.dept_key, now());
    exception when others then null; end;

    -- A change that made things worse becomes work, immediately.
    if v_verdict = 'worse' then
      begin
        insert into org_tasks (dept_key, title, detail, status, tier, needs_founder, action_class)
        select coalesce(r.dept_key,'exec'),
               'ROLL BACK: ' || left(r.decision, 90),
               'Outcome record #' || r.id || ' graded WORSE. ' || v_lesson
               || ' Reverse the change, confirm the metric recovers, then close.',
               'proposed','gated', false, 'incident_fix'
        where not exists (select 1 from org_tasks where title = 'ROLL BACK: ' || left(r.decision, 90) and status <> 'done');
      exception when others then null; end;
    end if;
  end loop;

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('outcome_evaluate', now(), now(), 'ok',
          jsonb_build_object('improved',n_improved,'worse',n_worse,'no_change',n_flat,'unmeasurable',n_unmeasurable),
          'Graded due outcomes: ' || n_improved || ' improved (promoted), ' || n_worse
          || ' worse (rollback task opened), ' || n_flat || ' no change, ' || n_unmeasurable || ' unmeasurable.');

  return jsonb_build_object('improved',n_improved,'worse',n_worse,'no_change',n_flat,'unmeasurable',n_unmeasurable);
end $fn$;

revoke execute on function public.fn_outcome_evaluate() from public, anon, authenticated;
```

```sql
-- WIRE IT UP: every KPI-miss task now opens an outcome record with the baseline captured,
-- so the fix is graded against the number it promised to move.
create or replace function public.fn_kpi_review()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare r record; v_opened int:=0; v_missed int:=0; v_nodata int:=0; v_title text; v_task bigint;
begin
  for r in select * from fn_kpi_scoreboard() loop
    if r.verdict='NO DATA' then v_nodata:=v_nodata+1; continue; end if;
    if r.verdict<>'MISSED' then continue; end if;
    v_missed := v_missed+1;
    v_title := 'KPI missed: '||r.metric||' ('||r.agent_key||')';
    if exists (select 1 from org_tasks where title=v_title and status<>'done') then continue; end if;

    insert into org_tasks (dept_key, title, detail, status, tier, needs_founder, action_class)
    values (coalesce(r.department,'exec'), v_title,
      'Owner: '||r.agent_key||'. Target '||coalesce(r.target::text,'?')||' '||coalesce(r.unit,'')||
      ', actual '||coalesce(r.actual::text,'?')||' ('||coalesce(r.attainment::text,'?')||'% of target), cadence '||coalesce(r.cadence,'?')||
      '. Serves company goal: '||coalesce(r.serves_goal,'unassigned')||
      '. Diagnose the cause and either close the gap or propose a revised target with evidence.',
      'proposed','advisory', false, 'recommend')
    returning id into v_task;

    perform fn_outcome_open(
      p_actor           => r.agent_key,
      p_decision        => 'Close the gap on: '||r.metric,
      p_subject_type    => 'org_task',
      p_subject_id      => v_task::text,
      p_expected_kpi_id => r.kpi_id,
      p_rationale       => 'KPI missed at '||coalesce(r.attainment::text,'?')||'% of target. Opened automatically by the weekly KPI review.',
      p_direction       => case when r.unit='percent_max' then 'down' else 'up' end,
      p_measure_after   => case when r.cadence='weekly' then interval '14 days' else interval '35 days' end
    );

    v_opened := v_opened+1;
  end loop;

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('kpi_review', now(), now(), 'ok',
          jsonb_build_object('missed',v_missed,'opened',v_opened,'no_data',v_nodata),
          'Weekly KPI review: '||v_missed||' missing target, '||v_opened||' task(s) + outcome record(s) opened, '||v_nodata||' with no data.');
  return jsonb_build_object('missed',v_missed,'opened',v_opened,'no_data',v_nodata);
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728172824_bos_daily_conductor_one_operating_rhythm.sql

```sql
-- BOS: one operating rhythm over 121 fault-isolated workers.
-- Deliberately NOT a serial mega-loop: one slow step must never stall the company.
-- The conductor owns the SEQUENCE and PROVES the day happened; specialists stay independent.
create table if not exists public.day_cadence (
  id           bigserial primary key,
  business_day date not null,
  stage        text not null,
  stage_order  int  not null,
  expected     text,
  observed     jsonb,
  ok           boolean,
  note         text,
  checked_at   timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (business_day, stage)
);
alter table public.day_cadence enable row level security;
comment on table public.day_cadence is
  'One row per stage of the daily operating loop. The conductor verifies each stage produced evidence; a missing stage is an exception, not silence.';

create or replace function public.fn_day_conductor()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare
  d date := current_date;
  v_ok int := 0; v_bad int := 0;
  procedure_stub int;
begin
  -- 1. CEO reviews the company
  insert into day_cadence (business_day, stage, stage_order, expected, observed, ok, note)
  select d, 'ceo_reviews_company', 1, 'a board/exec report produced in the last 24h',
         jsonb_build_object('board_reports_24h', (select count(*) from board_reports where created_at > now()-interval '24 hours'),
                            'exec_reports_24h',  (select count(*) from exec_reports  where created_at > now()-interval '24 hours')),
         ((select count(*) from board_reports where created_at > now()-interval '24 hours')
        + (select count(*) from exec_reports  where created_at > now()-interval '24 hours')) > 0,
         'strategy_ai_daily / board_report_weekly / founder_brief_daily'
  on conflict (business_day, stage) do update set observed=excluded.observed, ok=excluded.ok, checked_at=now();

  -- 2. Chief of Staff reviews departments
  insert into day_cadence (business_day, stage, stage_order, expected, observed, ok, note)
  select d, 'cos_reviews_departments', 2, 'cos_execute ran in the last 24h',
         jsonb_build_object('cos_runs_24h', (select count(*) from agent_runs where agent ilike '%chief_of_staff%' or agent ilike '%cos%' and started_at > now()-interval '24 hours')),
         (select count(*) from agent_runs where (agent ilike '%chief_of_staff%' or agent ilike '%cos%') and started_at > now()-interval '24 hours') > 0,
         'cos_execute_hourly'
  on conflict (business_day, stage) do update set observed=excluded.observed, ok=excluded.ok, checked_at=now();

  -- 3. Departments plan
  insert into day_cadence (business_day, stage, stage_order, expected, observed, ok, note)
  select d, 'departments_plan', 3, 'dept_plan ran in the last 24h',
         jsonb_build_object('dept_plan_runs_24h', (select count(*) from agent_runs where agent ilike '%dept_plan%' and started_at > now()-interval '24 hours')),
         (select count(*) from agent_runs where agent ilike '%dept_plan%' and started_at > now()-interval '24 hours') > 0,
         'dept_plan_daily'
  on conflict (business_day, stage) do update set observed=excluded.observed, ok=excluded.ok, checked_at=now();

  -- 4. Tasks execute
  insert into day_cadence (business_day, stage, stage_order, expected, observed, ok, note)
  select d, 'tasks_execute', 4, 'agent runs happened and mostly succeeded',
         jsonb_build_object('runs_24h', (select count(*) from agent_runs where started_at > now()-interval '24 hours'),
                            'errors_24h',(select count(*) from agent_runs where started_at > now()-interval '24 hours' and status='error')),
         (select count(*) from agent_runs where started_at > now()-interval '24 hours') > 0,
         'all scheduled workers'
  on conflict (business_day, stage) do update set observed=excluded.observed, ok=excluded.ok, checked_at=now();

  -- 5. Results measured
  insert into day_cadence (business_day, stage, stage_order, expected, observed, ok, note)
  select d, 'results_measured', 5, 'outcome grading ran; KPIs measurable',
         jsonb_build_object('outcomes_pending',(select count(*) from outcome_record where verdict='pending'),
                            'outcomes_graded_24h',(select count(*) from outcome_record where closed_at > now()-interval '24 hours'),
                            'kpis_measurable',(select count(*) from employee_kpi where active and measure_sql is not null)),
         (select count(*) from employee_kpi where active and measure_sql is not null) > 0,
         'outcome_evaluate_daily / kpi_review_weekly'
  on conflict (business_day, stage) do update set observed=excluded.observed, ok=excluded.ok, checked_at=now();

  -- 6. Lessons learned
  insert into day_cadence (business_day, stage, stage_order, expected, observed, ok, note)
  select d, 'lessons_learned', 6, 'learning ran in the last 24h',
         jsonb_build_object('dept_learn_24h',(select count(*) from agent_runs where agent ilike '%learn%' and started_at > now()-interval '24 hours'),
                            'memory_rows',(select count(*) from institutional_memory)),
         (select count(*) from agent_runs where agent ilike '%learn%' and started_at > now()-interval '24 hours') > 0,
         'dept_learn_daily / agent_learnings_weekly'
  on conflict (business_day, stage) do update set observed=excluded.observed, ok=excluded.ok, checked_at=now();

  -- 7. Knowledge updated
  insert into day_cadence (business_day, stage, stage_order, expected, observed, ok, note)
  select d, 'knowledge_updated', 7, 'knowledge touched in the last 24h',
         jsonb_build_object('knowledge_touched_24h',(select count(*) from agent_knowledge where updated_at > now()-interval '24 hours')),
         (select count(*) from agent_knowledge where updated_at > now()-interval '24 hours') > 0,
         'kb_deepen / knowledge_curator_daily'
  on conflict (business_day, stage) do update set observed=excluded.observed, ok=excluded.ok, checked_at=now();

  -- 8. Tomorrow planned
  insert into day_cadence (business_day, stage, stage_order, expected, observed, ok, note)
  select d, 'tomorrow_planned', 8, 'open work exists for tomorrow',
         jsonb_build_object('open_tasks',(select count(*) from org_tasks where status<>'done')),
         (select count(*) from org_tasks where status<>'done') > 0,
         'dept_plan_daily / kpi_review_weekly'
  on conflict (business_day, stage) do update set observed=excluded.observed, ok=excluded.ok, checked_at=now();

  select count(*) filter (where ok), count(*) filter (where not ok)
    into v_ok, v_bad from day_cadence where business_day = d;

  -- a broken rhythm is an exception, not silence
  if v_bad > 0 then
    insert into founder_alerts (level, event, detail, channel)
    select 'high', 'daily_cadence_broken',
           'The daily operating loop did not complete. Failed stages: ' ||
           (select string_agg(stage, ', ' order by stage_order) from day_cadence where business_day=d and not ok),
           'email'
    where not exists (select 1 from founder_alerts
                      where event='daily_cadence_broken' and created_at > now()-interval '20 hours');
  end if;

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('day_conductor', now(), now(), case when v_bad>0 then 'error' else 'ok' end,
          jsonb_build_object('stages_ok',v_ok,'stages_failed',v_bad),
          'Daily operating rhythm: '||v_ok||' of '||(v_ok+v_bad)||' stages produced evidence.');

  return jsonb_build_object('day',d,'ok',v_ok,'failed',v_bad);
end $fn$;

revoke execute on function public.fn_day_conductor() from public, anon, authenticated;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728172908_undo_log_make_reversal_real.sql

```sql
-- undo_log existed with no writer: the rollback facility was decorative.
-- Capture before-state on the surface where the company changes ITSELF - governance,
-- knowledge, goals, targets, policy, flags. Deliberately NOT on high-traffic marketplace
-- tables (leads/quotes/inquiries): those need business-level reversal, not row restore,
-- and a trigger on 20k+ rows is a cost with no matching benefit.

create or replace function public.trg_undo_capture()
returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare v_actor text;
begin
  v_actor := coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('app.actor', true), ''),
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.email', true), ''),
    session_user);

  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then
    insert into undo_log (table_name, row_id, op, before, actor)
    values (tg_table_name, (to_jsonb(old)->>(tg_argv[0])), 'DELETE', to_jsonb(old), v_actor);
    return old;
  else
    insert into undo_log (table_name, row_id, op, before, actor)
    values (tg_table_name, (to_jsonb(old)->>(tg_argv[0])), 'UPDATE', to_jsonb(old), v_actor);
    return new;
  end if;
exception when others then
  -- never let audit failure block the company's work
  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then return old; else return new; end if;
end $fn$;

do $do$
declare t record;
begin
  for t in
    select * from (values
      ('agent_knowledge','id'), ('company_goals','key'), ('employee_kpi','id'),
      ('decision_policy','key'), ('org_tasks','id'), ('priority_hierarchy','rank'),
      ('business_rules','id'), ('feature_flags','id'), ('model_policy','id'),
      ('employee_authority','agent_key'), ('governance_rule','id'), ('department_objective','id')
    ) v(tbl, pk)
  loop
    if exists (select 1 from information_schema.tables
               where table_schema='public' and table_name=t.tbl) then
      execute format('drop trigger if exists trg_undo_%1$s on public.%1$I', t.tbl);
      execute format(
        'create trigger trg_undo_%1$s before update or delete on public.%1$I
         for each row execute function public.trg_undo_capture(%2$L)', t.tbl, t.pk);
    end if;
  end loop;
end $do$;

-- Reverse a captured change.
create or replace function public.fn_undo(p_undo_id bigint, p_reason text default null)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare r record; v_cols text; v_sql text;
begin
  select * into r from undo_log where id = p_undo_id;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error','undo_log row not found'); end if;
  if r.reverted then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error','already reverted'); end if;

  if r.op = 'DELETE' then
    select string_agg(quote_ident(key), ', ') into v_cols from jsonb_object_keys(r.before) as key;
    v_sql := format('insert into public.%I select * from jsonb_populate_record(null::public.%I, $1)', r.table_name, r.table_name);
    execute v_sql using r.before;
  else
    v_sql := format('update public.%I set (%s) = (select %s from jsonb_populate_record(null::public.%I, $1)) where %I::text = $2',
                    r.table_name,
                    (select string_agg(quote_ident(k), ', ') from jsonb_object_keys(r.before) k),
                    (select string_agg(quote_ident(k), ', ') from jsonb_object_keys(r.before) k),
                    r.table_name,
                    (select column_name from information_schema.columns
                      where table_schema='public' and table_name=r.table_name
                      order by ordinal_position limit 1));
    execute v_sql using r.before, r.row_id;
  end if;

  update undo_log set reverted = true where id = p_undo_id;

  insert into os_audit_log (actor, action, entity, entity_id, detail, ok)
  values (coalesce(r.actor,'system'), 'undo', r.table_name, r.row_id,
          jsonb_build_object('undo_id',p_undo_id,'op',r.op,'reason',p_reason), true);

  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'table',r.table_name,'row_id',r.row_id,'op',r.op);
exception when others then
  return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error',sqlerrm);
end $fn$;

revoke execute on function public.fn_undo(bigint,text) from public, anon, authenticated;

comment on function public.fn_undo(bigint,text) is
  'Restores a row captured in undo_log. Reversal is now a system action, not a human redo.';
```

```sql
drop function if exists public.fn_undo(bigint, text);

create or replace function public.fn_undo(p_undo_id uuid, p_reason text default null)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare r record; v_pk text; v_sql text;
begin
  select * into r from undo_log where id = p_undo_id;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error','undo_log row not found'); end if;
  if r.reverted then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error','already reverted'); end if;

  select column_name into v_pk from information_schema.columns
   where table_schema='public' and table_name=r.table_name order by ordinal_position limit 1;

  if r.op = 'DELETE' then
    execute format('insert into public.%I select * from jsonb_populate_record(null::public.%I, $1)',
                   r.table_name, r.table_name) using r.before;
```
