### supabase/migrations/20260728173008_audit_every_agent_action.sql

```sql
-- os_audit_log held 27 rows against 11,262 agent runs: only OS-UI actions were audited,
-- no agent work at all. From now every agent run lands in the audit trail, so autonomous
-- work is reconstructable after the fact - the precondition for leaving it alone.
create or replace function public.trg_audit_agent_run()
returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
begin
  insert into os_audit_log (actor, action, entity, entity_id, detail, ok, err)
  values (
    coalesce(new.agent,'unknown_agent'),
    'agent_run',
    'agent_runs',
    new.id::text,
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'status',  new.status,
      'counts',  new.counts,
      'note',    left(coalesce(new.note,''), 600),
      'started', new.started_at,
      'seconds', case when new.finished_at is not null and new.started_at is not null
                      then round(extract(epoch from (new.finished_at - new.started_at))::numeric, 2)
                      else null end)),
    coalesce(new.status,'ok') <> 'error',
    case when new.status = 'error' then left(coalesce(new.note,'error'), 400) else null end
  );
  return new;
exception when others then
  return new;   -- audit must never break the work it is recording
end $fn$;

drop trigger if exists trg_audit_agent_run on public.agent_runs;
create trigger trg_audit_agent_run
  after insert on public.agent_runs
  for each row execute function public.trg_audit_agent_run();

create index if not exists os_audit_log_at_idx    on public.os_audit_log (at desc);
create index if not exists os_audit_log_actor_idx on public.os_audit_log (actor, at desc);
create index if not exists os_audit_log_action_idx on public.os_audit_log (action, at desc);

-- Keep it bounded: agent-run audit is high volume, so retain 180 days.
-- Everything else (settings, incidents, undo, catalogue changes) is retained indefinitely.
create or replace function public.fn_audit_prune()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare n int;
begin
  delete from os_audit_log
   where action = 'agent_run' and at < now() - interval '180 days';
  get diagnostics n = row_count;
  return jsonb_build_object('pruned', n);
end $fn$;

revoke execute on function public.fn_audit_prune() from public, anon, authenticated;

comment on function public.trg_audit_agent_run() is
  'Every agent run writes an audit row: who acted, what happened, how long it took, and whether it failed. Fails open - auditing never blocks the work.';
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728173045_ceo_cascade_and_department_kpi_tracking.sql

```sql
-- Q8: department_objective had no link to company_goals, so a CEO reprioritisation had
-- nothing to cascade through and superseded objectives were orphaned undetectably.
alter table public.department_objective
  add column if not exists goal_key text references company_goals(key),
  add column if not exists status text not null default 'active'
      check (status in ('active','superseded','achieved','dropped')),
  add column if not exists superseded_by bigint,
  add column if not exists updated_at timestamptz not null default now();

create index if not exists department_objective_goal_idx on public.department_objective (goal_key);

-- Best-effort auto-link: match each objective to a goal owned by the same department.
update department_objective o
set goal_key = g.key
from (
  select distinct on (owner_dept) owner_dept, key
  from company_goals where active and owner_dept is not null
  order by owner_dept, sort nulls last, key
) g
where o.goal_key is null and o.dept_key = g.owner_dept;

-- Cascade: when a company goal is deactivated, every objective serving it is marked
-- superseded and the owning department gets work to re-plan. No more orphans.
create or replace function public.trg_goal_cascade()
returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
begin
  if old.active is true and new.active is false then
    update department_objective
       set status='superseded', updated_at=now()
     where goal_key = new.key and status='active';

    insert into org_tasks (dept_key, title, detail, status, tier, needs_founder, action_class)
    select distinct o.dept_key,
           'Re-plan after goal retired: '||new.key,
           'Company goal "'||coalesce(new.goal,new.key)||'" was retired. Objectives serving it are now superseded. Propose replacement objectives that serve an active goal.',
           'proposed','advisory', false, 'coordinate'
      from department_objective o
     where o.goal_key = new.key and o.status='superseded'
       and not exists (select 1 from org_tasks t where t.title='Re-plan after goal retired: '||new.key and t.status<>'done');

    begin
      perform fn_emit_event('goal.retired','company_goals',new.key,'ceo',
                            jsonb_build_object('goal',new.key));
    exception when others then null; end;
  end if;
  return new;
end $fn$;

drop trigger if exists trg_goal_cascade on public.company_goals;
create trigger trg_goal_cascade after update on public.company_goals
  for each row execute function public.trg_goal_cascade();

-- Q9: goal_period had 183 rows, 0 actual values and no writer. Department-level
-- measurement was a table nobody filled. Fill it from the live goal measures.
create or replace function public.fn_goal_period_refresh()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare r record; v numeric; n int := 0;
begin
  for r in
    select gp.id, gp.goal_key, gp.target_value, g.measure_sql, g.direction
    from goal_period gp join company_goals g on g.key = gp.goal_key
    where g.active and g.measure_sql is not null
  loop
    v := null;
    begin execute r.measure_sql into v; exception when others then v := null; end;
    if v is not null then
      update goal_period
         set actual_value = v,
             status = case
               when r.target_value is null or r.target_value = 0 then 'tracking'
               when coalesce(r.direction,'up') = 'down'
                 then case when v <= r.target_value then 'on_track' else 'at_risk' end
                 else case when v >= r.target_value then 'on_track'
                           when v >= r.target_value * 0.9 then 'near' else 'at_risk' end
             end,
             updated_at = now()
       where id = r.id;
      n := n + 1;
    end if;
  end loop;

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('goal_period_refresh', now(), now(), 'ok', jsonb_build_object('updated', n),
          'Department/company goal periods refreshed from live measures: '||n||' rows updated.');
  return jsonb_build_object('updated', n);
end $fn$;

revoke execute on function public.fn_goal_period_refresh() from public, anon, authenticated;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728173145_ai_economy_attribute_spend_and_enforce_budgets.sql

```sql
-- ai_cost_log recorded 132 calls with agent_key and dept_key NULL on every row, so
-- department_budget (with degrade_at_pct / halt_at_pct already designed) could never fire.
-- fn_llm_log accepts p_dept and p_agent; callers pass null. Rather than wait for every
-- call site to be edited, derive the department from the function name - as data, not code.

create table if not exists public.ai_cost_fn_map (
  fn        text primary key,
  dept_key  text not null,
  agent_key text,
  note      text
);
alter table public.ai_cost_fn_map enable row level security;

insert into ai_cost_fn_map (fn, dept_key, agent_key, note) values
  ('agent_brain','exec','ceo','employee runtime'),
  ('agents','exec','ceo','agent roster runtime'),
  ('cos_execute','exec','brief','chief of staff execution'),
  ('dept_plan','exec','brief','daily department planning'),
  ('exec_agents','exec','ceo','executive agents'),
  ('canon_eval','knowledge','knowledge_curator','canon evaluation'),
  ('dept_learn','knowledge','knowledge_curator','daily learning'),
  ('gen_category_knowledge','knowledge','knowledge_curator','category knowledge generation'),
  ('knowledge_exam','knowledge','ai_trainer','auto-learning exams'),
  ('category_provision','knowledge','knowledge_curator','category provisioning'),
  ('enrich_capability','procurement','onboarding','supplier capability enrichment')
on conflict (fn) do nothing;

-- Attribute on the way in, so no call site has to change.
create or replace function public.trg_ai_cost_attribute()
returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare m record;
begin
  if new.dept_key is null or new.agent_key is null then
    select * into m from ai_cost_fn_map where fn = new.fn;
    if found then
      new.dept_key  := coalesce(new.dept_key,  m.dept_key);
      new.agent_key := coalesce(new.agent_key, m.agent_key);
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
exception when others then return new;
end $fn$;

drop trigger if exists trg_ai_cost_attribute on public.ai_cost_log;
create trigger trg_ai_cost_attribute before insert on public.ai_cost_log
  for each row execute function public.trg_ai_cost_attribute();

-- Backfill the 132 unattributed rows.
update ai_cost_log c set dept_key = m.dept_key, agent_key = coalesce(c.agent_key, m.agent_key)
from ai_cost_fn_map m where c.fn = m.fn and c.dept_key is null;

-- Roll spend into the budget and let the degrade/halt thresholds actually fire.
create or replace function public.fn_budget_rollup()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare v_period text := to_char(current_date,'YYYY-MM'); n int := 0; v_degraded int := 0; v_halted int := 0; r record;
begin
  update department_budget b
     set spent_aed = coalesce(s.total,0), period_label = v_period, updated_at = now()
  from (
    select dept_key, sum(cost_aed) total
    from ai_cost_log
    where dept_key is not null and occurred_at >= date_trunc('month', now())
    group by dept_key
  ) s
  where b.dept_key = s.dept_key;
  get diagnostics n = row_count;

  for r in
    select dept_key, monthly_aed, spent_aed, degrade_at_pct, halt_at_pct,
           round(100.0*spent_aed/nullif(monthly_aed,0),1) as pct
    from department_budget
    where monthly_aed > 0 and spent_aed is not null
  loop
    if r.pct >= r.halt_at_pct then
      v_halted := v_halted + 1;
      insert into founder_alerts (level, event, detail, channel)
      select 'high','ai_budget_halt', r.dept_key||' has spent '||r.pct||'% of its monthly AI budget ('||r.spent_aed||' of '||r.monthly_aed||' AED). Halt threshold '||r.halt_at_pct||'% reached.','email'
      where not exists (select 1 from founder_alerts where event='ai_budget_halt' and detail like r.dept_key||'%' and created_at > now()-interval '24 hours');
    elsif r.pct >= r.degrade_at_pct then
      v_degraded := v_degraded + 1;
      insert into org_tasks (dept_key, title, detail, status, tier, needs_founder, action_class)
      select r.dept_key, 'AI budget degrade threshold: '||r.dept_key,
             r.dept_key||' has spent '||r.pct||'% of its monthly AI budget. Move non-critical work to the cheaper model tier and enable response caching before the halt threshold at '||r.halt_at_pct||'%.',
             'proposed','gated', false, 'recommend'
      where not exists (select 1 from org_tasks where title='AI budget degrade threshold: '||r.dept_key and status<>'done');
    end if;
  end loop;

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('budget_rollup', now(), now(), 'ok',
          jsonb_build_object('depts_updated',n,'degraded',v_degraded,'halted',v_halted),
          'AI spend rolled into department budgets: '||n||' departments, '||v_degraded||' past degrade threshold, '||v_halted||' past halt.');
  return jsonb_build_object('updated',n,'degraded',v_degraded,'halted',v_halted);
end $fn$;

revoke execute on function public.fn_budget_rollup() from public, anon, authenticated;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728173424_weekly_executive_meeting_and_ceo_self_questioning.sql

```sql
-- Individual reports existed; a convened meeting that runs one agenda across departments
-- and assigns tracked actions out of it did not.
create or replace function public.fn_exec_meeting()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare
  m jsonb; findings jsonb := '[]'::jsonb; actions int := 0; v_id bigint;
  v_rev numeric; v_spend numeric; v_kpi numeric; v_sup int; v_open int; v_risk int; v_inc int; v_avail numeric;
begin
  select coalesce(sum(coalesce(reveal_fee, app_fee, 0)),0) into v_rev from transactions where revealed_at > now()-interval '7 days';
  select coalesce(sum(cost_aed),0) into v_spend from ai_cost_log where occurred_at > now()-interval '7 days';
  select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where verdict in ('MET','NEAR'))/nullif(count(*) filter (where verdict<>'NO DATA'),0),1)
    into v_kpi from fn_kpi_scoreboard();
  select count(*) into v_sup from leads where claimed and approval_status='approved';
  select count(*) into v_open from org_tasks where status<>'done';
  select count(*) into v_risk from risk_register;
  select count(*) into v_inc from os_incidents where created_at > now()-interval '7 days';
  select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where ok)/nullif(count(*),0),1) into v_avail
    from health_checks where created_at > now()-interval '7 days';

  m := jsonb_build_object(
    'revenue_7d_aed', v_rev,
    'ai_spend_7d_aed', round(coalesce(v_spend,0),2),
    'kpi_attainment_pct', v_kpi,
    'onboarded_suppliers', v_sup,
    'open_tasks', v_open,
    'open_risks', v_risk,
    'incidents_7d', v_inc,
    'platform_availability_pct', v_avail);

  -- AGENDA: each item either passes or becomes a finding with an owner
  if coalesce(v_rev,0) = 0 then
    findings := findings || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('item','Revenue','owner','cfo','finding','No revenue recognised in the last 7 days.'));
  end if;
  if coalesce(v_kpi,0) < 70 then
    findings := findings || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('item','KPIs','owner','cpo','finding','KPI attainment at '||coalesce(v_kpi,0)||'%, below the 70% floor.'));
  end if;
  if coalesce(v_sup,0) = 0 then
    findings := findings || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('item','Supplier Success','owner','onboarding','finding','Zero onboarded suppliers. Every downstream marketplace metric is gated on this.'));
  end if;
  if coalesce(v_avail,100) < 99.5 then
    findings := findings || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('item','Technology','owner','it','finding','Platform availability '||coalesce(v_avail,0)||'% against a 99.5% target.'));
  end if;
  if v_inc > 0 then
    findings := findings || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('item','Operations','owner','ops_director','finding',v_inc||' incident(s) opened this week.'));
  end if;
  if v_open > 60 then
    findings := findings || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('item','Chief of Staff','owner','brief','finding',v_open||' open tasks. Work is accumulating faster than it closes.'));
  end if;

  -- Assign an action per finding, tracked to completion
  for v_id in
    select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(findings)
  loop null; end loop;

  insert into org_tasks (dept_key, title, detail, status, tier, needs_founder, action_class)
  select coalesce((select department from org_agents where agent_key = f->>'owner'),'exec'),
         'Exec meeting action: '||(f->>'item'),
         (f->>'finding')||' Owner: '||(f->>'owner')||'. Raised at the weekly executive meeting on '||to_char(now(),'DD Mon YYYY')||'. Diagnose the cause and close it, or bring evidence that the target is wrong.',
         'proposed','advisory', false, 'coordinate'
  from jsonb_array_elements(findings) f
  where not exists (
    select 1 from org_tasks t
    where t.title = 'Exec meeting action: '||(f->>'item') and t.status <> 'done');
  get diagnostics actions = row_count;

  insert into exec_reports (officer, period, summary, findings, recommendations, metrics, status)
  values ('ceo', to_char(now(),'IYYY-"W"IW'),
          'Weekly executive meeting. '||jsonb_array_length(findings)||' finding(s), '||actions||' action(s) assigned.',
          findings::text,
          case when jsonb_array_length(findings)=0
               then 'All agenda items within tolerance. Hold current priorities.'
               else 'Close the assigned actions before next Monday; each is owned and tracked.' end,
          m::text, 'open');

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('exec_meeting', now(), now(), 'ok',
          jsonb_build_object('findings',jsonb_array_length(findings),'actions',actions),
          'Weekly executive meeting held: '||jsonb_array_length(findings)||' findings, '||actions||' actions assigned.');

  return jsonb_build_object('findings',jsonb_array_length(findings),'actions',actions,'metrics',m);
end $fn$;

-- Every question in the system was answered; none was asked. The CEO now asks its own.
create or replace function public.fn_ceo_questions()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare qs text[] := '{}'; n int := 0; q text;
  v_rev numeric; v_sup int; v_inq int; v_worst text; v_cost numeric; v_prev numeric;
begin
  select coalesce(sum(coalesce(reveal_fee,app_fee,0)),0) into v_rev from transactions where revealed_at > now()-interval '30 days';
  select count(*) into v_sup from leads where claimed and approval_status='approved';
  select count(*) into v_inq from inquiries where created_at > now()-interval '30 days';
  select department into v_worst from fn_kpi_scoreboard() where verdict='MISSED' and department is not null
    group by department order by count(*) desc limit 1;
  select coalesce(sum(cost_aed),0) into v_cost from ai_cost_log where occurred_at > now()-interval '7 days';
  select coalesce(sum(cost_aed),0) into v_prev from ai_cost_log where occurred_at between now()-interval '14 days' and now()-interval '7 days';

  if v_rev = 0 then qs := qs || ('Why are we not growing? Revenue is zero over 30 days with '||v_sup||' onboarded suppliers and '||v_inq||' inquiries. What is the single binding constraint, and what would remove it?'); end if;
  if v_sup = 0 then qs := qs || 'We have 86 fully briefed category experts and no onboarded suppliers. Are we building capability ahead of demand, and is that still the right sequence?'; end if;
  if v_worst is not null then qs := qs || ('Why is '||v_worst||' missing more targets than any other department this week? Is it capability, capacity, or a target that was never realistic?'); end if;
  if v_prev > 0 and v_cost > v_prev * 1.25 then qs := qs || ('AI cost rose from '||round(v_prev,2)||' to '||round(v_cost,2)||' AED week on week. What drove it and did it buy anything?'); end if;
  qs := qs || 'Which workflow wastes the most employee time, and what would automating it be worth?';
  qs := qs || 'Which department produced the highest return on its AI spend this month, and what are the others not copying?';
  qs := qs || 'What are we doing today only because we have always done it?';

  foreach q in array qs loop
    insert into org_tasks (dept_key, title, detail, status, tier, needs_founder, action_class)
    select 'exec', 'CEO question: '||left(q,80), q||E'\n\nAnswer with evidence from company data, not opinion. If the answer implies a change, open it as an initiative with a named metric and a baseline so it can be graded.',
           'proposed','advisory', false, 'recommend'
    where not exists (select 1 from org_tasks where title='CEO question: '||left(q,80) and status<>'done');
    if found then n := n + 1; end if;
  end loop;

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('ceo_questions', now(), now(), 'ok', jsonb_build_object('asked',n),
          'CEO self-questioning: '||n||' strategic question(s) raised from live company data.');
  return jsonb_build_object('asked',n);
end $fn$;

revoke execute on function public.fn_exec_meeting() from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke execute on function public.fn_ceo_questions() from public, anon, authenticated;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728174103_activate_knowledge_decay.sql

```sql
-- 786 of 1,789 knowledge rows carried confidence and review_due; the rest had no expiry at
-- all, so stale knowledge was indistinguishable from fresh. Backfill, then let it decay.

update agent_knowledge
   set confidence = coalesce(confidence, 0.7),
       review_due = coalesce(review_due, coalesce(updated_at, created_at, now()) + interval '90 days'),
       validation_status = coalesce(validation_status, 'unreviewed')
 where confidence is null or review_due is null or validation_status is null;

-- Decay: past its review date, confidence falls. Below 0.35 the item is quarantined and
-- stops being served, rather than being quietly wrong forever.
create or replace function public.fn_knowledge_decay()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare n_decayed int; n_quarantined int; n_tasks int := 0;
begin
  update agent_knowledge
     set confidence = greatest(0.10, round((confidence - (0.05 * greatest(1, floor(extract(epoch from (now() - review_due))/(30*86400)))))::numeric, 2)),
         validation_status = 'stale'
   where review_due < now()
     and coalesce(validation_status,'') <> 'quarantined'
     and confidence > 0.10;
  get diagnostics n_decayed = row_count;

  update agent_knowledge
     set validation_status = 'quarantined'
   where confidence < 0.35 and coalesce(validation_status,'') <> 'quarantined';
  get diagnostics n_quarantined = row_count;

  -- a quarantined expert is a capability gap, so it becomes work
  insert into org_tasks (dept_key, title, detail, status, tier, needs_founder, action_class)
  select 'knowledge',
         'Knowledge quarantined: '||agent_key,
         count(*)||' knowledge item(s) for '||agent_key||' fell below the confidence floor and are no longer served. '
         ||'Refresh from source and re-validate, or retire the topic.',
         'proposed','advisory', false, 'knowledge_fill'
    from agent_knowledge
   where validation_status='quarantined'
   group by agent_key
  having not exists (select 1 from org_tasks t where t.title='Knowledge quarantined: '||agent_knowledge.agent_key and t.status<>'done');
  get diagnostics n_tasks = row_count;

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('knowledge_decay', now(), now(), 'ok',
          jsonb_build_object('decayed',n_decayed,'quarantined',n_quarantined,'tasks',n_tasks),
          'Knowledge decay: '||n_decayed||' item(s) past review lost confidence, '||n_quarantined
          ||' quarantined below the floor, '||n_tasks||' refresh task(s) opened.');

  return jsonb_build_object('decayed',n_decayed,'quarantined',n_quarantined,'tasks',n_tasks);
end $fn$;

revoke execute on function public.fn_knowledge_decay() from public, anon, authenticated;

create index if not exists agent_knowledge_review_due_idx on public.agent_knowledge (review_due)
  where validation_status <> 'quarantined';
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728174323_fix_availability_metric_watchdog_was_structurally_zero.sql

```sql
-- "Platform availability 80%" was wrong and it mattered: it was averaging two different
-- things. Over 7 days, check_kind 'http' is 100.0% across 672 checks. check_kind
-- 'agent_runs' is 0.0% across 168 - because that watchdog writes ok=false whenever ANY
-- agent errored in the window, so it can never read anything but zero. Averaging a real
-- uptime probe with a structurally-zero meta-check produced a fictional 80%.
--
-- Availability now measures availability. Agent reliability gets its own honest metric.

update employee_kpi
   set measure_sql = $q$select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where ok)/nullif(count(*),0),2) from health_checks where check_kind='http' and created_at > now()-interval '7 days'$q$
 where metric = 'Platform availability' and active;

insert into employee_kpi (agent_key, kpi, metric, target_value, unit, cadence, serves_goal, measure_sql, active)
select 'it','Agent run reliability','Scheduled agent runs completing without error', 97::numeric,'percent','weekly','customer_satisfaction',
  $q$select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status<>'error')/nullif(count(*),0),2) from agent_runs where started_at > now()-interval '7 days'$q$, true
where not exists (select 1 from employee_kpi where kpi='Agent run reliability');

 'health_checks.check_kind=''agent_runs'' has written ok=false on 168 of 168 rows over 7 days because it flags the whole window whenever any single agent errors. Give it a threshold (for example: not-ok only when the error rate exceeds 5% of runs in the window) so it produces signal instead of a constant.',
 'proposed','advisory', false, 'incident_fix'
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728175015_undo_log_retention.sql

```sql
-- The knowledge-decay backfill alone wrote 1,003 undo rows, so this table will grow fast.
-- 90 days is well beyond any realistic "undo that change" window; unreverted rows older
-- than that are history, not a reverse gear.
create or replace function public.fn_audit_prune()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare n_audit int; n_undo int;
begin
  delete from os_audit_log where action='agent_run' and at < now() - interval '180 days';
  get diagnostics n_audit = row_count;

  delete from undo_log where created_at < now() - interval '90 days';
  get diagnostics n_undo = row_count;

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('audit_prune', now(), now(), 'ok',
          jsonb_build_object('audit_pruned',n_audit,'undo_pruned',n_undo),
          'Retention: '||n_audit||' agent-run audit rows and '||n_undo||' undo rows older than their window removed.');

  return jsonb_build_object('audit_pruned',n_audit,'undo_pruned',n_undo);
end $fn$;
revoke execute on function public.fn_audit_prune() from public, anon, authenticated;
create index if not exists undo_log_created_idx on public.undo_log (created_at);
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728190150_conductor_check_cron_history_not_agent_runs.sql

```sql
-- FALSE ALARM CORRECTED. The conductor flagged departments_plan and lessons_learned as
-- broken because it looked for an agent_runs row. cron.job_run_details shows dept_plan_daily
-- and dept_learn_daily both ran and SUCCEEDED (4 runs each in 7 days, last today 01:00 and
-- 00:30) - those functions simply do not always write an agent_runs row. A monitor that
-- raises a false alarm every morning is worse than no monitor, so the check now reads the
-- authoritative source: did the scheduled job actually fire and succeed.

create or replace function public.fn_cron_ran(p_jobname text, p_within interval default '26 hours')
returns boolean
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path to 'cron','public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare v boolean;
begin
  select exists (
    select 1 from cron.job j
    join cron.job_run_details d on d.jobid = j.jobid
    where j.jobname = p_jobname
      and d.start_time > now() - p_within
      and d.status = 'succeeded'
  ) into v;
  return coalesce(v,false);
exception when others then
  return true;  -- if the history is unreadable, do not raise a false alarm
end $fn$;

create or replace function public.fn_day_conductor()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare d date := current_date; v_ok int := 0; v_bad int := 0;
begin
  insert into day_cadence (business_day, stage, stage_order, expected, observed, ok, note)
  select d,'ceo_reviews_company',1,'an exec or board report in the last 24h',
    jsonb_build_object('board_reports_24h',(select count(*) from board_reports where created_at>now()-interval '24 hours'),
                       'exec_reports_24h',(select count(*) from exec_reports where created_at>now()-interval '24 hours')),
    ((select count(*) from board_reports where created_at>now()-interval '24 hours')
   + (select count(*) from exec_reports where created_at>now()-interval '24 hours'))>0,
    'strategy_ai_daily / board_report_weekly / exec_meeting_weekly'
  on conflict (business_day,stage) do update set observed=excluded.observed, ok=excluded.ok, checked_at=now();

  insert into day_cadence (business_day, stage, stage_order, expected, observed, ok, note)
  select d,'cos_reviews_departments',2,'cos_execute_hourly fired and succeeded',
    jsonb_build_object('cron_ok',fn_cron_ran('cos_execute_hourly','3 hours'),
                       'runs_24h',(select count(*) from agent_runs where agent='chief_of_staff' and started_at>now()-interval '24 hours')),
    fn_cron_ran('cos_execute_hourly','3 hours'),'cos_execute_hourly'
  on conflict (business_day,stage) do update set observed=excluded.observed, ok=excluded.ok, checked_at=now();

  insert into day_cadence (business_day, stage, stage_order, expected, observed, ok, note)
  select d,'departments_plan',3,'dept_plan_daily fired and succeeded',
    jsonb_build_object('cron_ok',fn_cron_ran('dept_plan_daily')),
    fn_cron_ran('dept_plan_daily'),'dept_plan_daily (does not always write agent_runs)'
  on conflict (business_day,stage) do update set observed=excluded.observed, ok=excluded.ok, checked_at=now();

  insert into day_cadence (business_day, stage, stage_order, expected, observed, ok, note)
  select d,'tasks_execute',4,'agent runs happened',
    jsonb_build_object('runs_24h',(select count(*) from agent_runs where started_at>now()-interval '24 hours'),
                       'errors_24h',(select count(*) from agent_runs where started_at>now()-interval '24 hours' and status='error')),
    (select count(*) from agent_runs where started_at>now()-interval '24 hours')>0,'all scheduled workers'
  on conflict (business_day,stage) do update set observed=excluded.observed, ok=excluded.ok, checked_at=now();

  insert into day_cadence (business_day, stage, stage_order, expected, observed, ok, note)
  select d,'results_measured',5,'outcomes gradeable and KPIs measurable',
    jsonb_build_object('outcomes_pending',(select count(*) from outcome_record where verdict='pending'),
                       'kpis_measurable',(select count(*) from employee_kpi where active and measure_sql is not null)),
    (select count(*) from employee_kpi where active and measure_sql is not null)>0,'outcome_evaluate_daily / kpi_review_weekly'
  on conflict (business_day,stage) do update set observed=excluded.observed, ok=excluded.ok, checked_at=now();

  insert into day_cadence (business_day, stage, stage_order, expected, observed, ok, note)
  select d,'lessons_learned',6,'dept_learn_daily fired and succeeded',
    jsonb_build_object('cron_ok',fn_cron_ran('dept_learn_daily'),
                       'memory_rows',(select count(*) from institutional_memory)),
    fn_cron_ran('dept_learn_daily'),'dept_learn_daily (does not always write agent_runs)'
  on conflict (business_day,stage) do update set observed=excluded.observed, ok=excluded.ok, checked_at=now();

  insert into day_cadence (business_day, stage, stage_order, expected, observed, ok, note)
  select d,'knowledge_updated',7,'knowledge touched in the last 24h',
    jsonb_build_object('touched_24h',(select count(*) from agent_knowledge where updated_at>now()-interval '24 hours')),
    (select count(*) from agent_knowledge where updated_at>now()-interval '24 hours')>0,'kb_deepen / knowledge_curator_daily'
  on conflict (business_day,stage) do update set observed=excluded.observed, ok=excluded.ok, checked_at=now();

  insert into day_cadence (business_day, stage, stage_order, expected, observed, ok, note)
  select d,'tomorrow_planned',8,'open work exists',
    jsonb_build_object('open_tasks',(select count(*) from org_tasks where status<>'done')),
    (select count(*) from org_tasks where status<>'done')>0,'dept_plan_daily / kpi_review_weekly'
  on conflict (business_day,stage) do update set observed=excluded.observed, ok=excluded.ok, checked_at=now();

  select count(*) filter (where ok), count(*) filter (where not ok) into v_ok, v_bad
    from day_cadence where business_day=d;

  if v_bad>0 then
    insert into founder_alerts (level,event,detail,channel)
    select 'high','daily_cadence_broken',
      'The daily operating loop did not complete. Failed stages: '||
      (select string_agg(stage,', ' order by stage_order) from day_cadence where business_day=d and not ok),'email'
    where not exists (select 1 from founder_alerts where event='daily_cadence_broken' and created_at>now()-interval '20 hours');
  end if;

  insert into agent_runs (agent,started_at,finished_at,status,counts,note)
  values ('day_conductor',now(),now(),case when v_bad>0 then 'error' else 'ok' end,
    jsonb_build_object('stages_ok',v_ok,'stages_failed',v_bad),
    'Daily operating rhythm: '||v_ok||' of '||(v_ok+v_bad)||' stages verified.');

  return jsonb_build_object('day',d,'ok',v_ok,'failed',v_bad);
end $fn$;

revoke execute on function public.fn_day_conductor() from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke execute on function public.fn_cron_ran(text,interval) from public, anon, authenticated;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728190701_supplier_supply_gap_engine.sql

```sql
-- For the next 2-3 months the ONLY product is supplier acquisition. The goal is 10 approved
-- suppliers in each of 86 categories = 860 approved. At a realistic 5% cold-invite-to-approved
-- conversion that needs ~200 sendable leads per category. Today only 25 of 86 categories have
-- 200+, 3 have ZERO, and only 3 new leads were scraped in the last 30 days.
-- The binding constraint is NOT invite speed. It is lead supply. This makes the company
-- measure that, and fix it without being asked.

create or replace view public.v_supply_gap as
with pool as (
  select c.slug, c.name, c.num,
    count(distinct lc.lead_id) filter (where l.email is not null and l.email<>'' and coalesce(l.banned,false)=false) as sendable,
    count(distinct lc.lead_id) filter (where l.invite_status is not null)                                            as invited,
    count(distinct lc.lead_id) filter (where l.claimed)                                                              as claimed,
    count(distinct lc.lead_id) filter (where l.approval_status='approved')                                           as approved
  from catalog_supplier_categories c
  left join lead_category lc on lc.slug = c.slug
  left join leads l on l.id = lc.lead_id
  group by c.slug, c.name, c.num
)
select slug, name, num, sendable, invited, claimed, approved,
       greatest(0, 10 - approved)                       as gap_to_target,
       ceil(greatest(0, 10 - approved) / 0.05)::int     as sendable_needed_at_5pct,
       greatest(0, ceil(greatest(0, 10 - approved) / 0.05)::int - sendable) as sendable_shortfall,
       case
         when approved >= 10                                                   then 'TARGET MET'
         when sendable = 0                                                     then 'NO POOL - must source from scratch'
         when sendable < ceil(greatest(0,10-approved)/0.05)::int               then 'POOL TOO THIN - scrape more'
         when invited = 0                                                      then 'READY - not yet invited'
         else 'IN PROGRESS'
       end as status
from pool;

comment on view public.v_supply_gap is
  'Per category: how much supplier supply exists, how much is needed to reach 10 approved at a 5% conversion assumption, and what the blocking condition is.';

create or replace function public.fn_supply_gap_scan()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare r record; n_scrape int:=0; n_invite int:=0; n_source int:=0; v_uncat int; v_met int; v_total int;
begin
  select count(*) into v_total from v_supply_gap;
  select count(*) into v_met   from v_supply_gap where status='TARGET MET';

  -- 1. Categories that cannot reach the target from the existing pool
  for r in select * from v_supply_gap where status in ('POOL TOO THIN - scrape more','NO POOL - must source from scratch') order by sendable asc limit 25
  loop
    insert into org_tasks (dept_key, title, detail, status, tier, needs_founder, action_class)
    select 'procurement',
           'Supply gap: '||r.slug,
           r.name||' has '||r.sendable||' sendable lead(s) but needs about '||r.sendable_needed_at_5pct
           ||' to reach 10 approved suppliers at a 5% conversion assumption (shortfall '||r.sendable_shortfall||'). '
           ||'Source more UAE suppliers in this category before inviting - inviting a thin pool burns it without reaching the target.',
           'proposed','advisory', false, 'knowledge_acquire'
    where not exists (select 1 from org_tasks t where t.title='Supply gap: '||r.slug and t.status<>'done');
    if found then if r.sendable=0 then n_source:=n_source+1; else n_scrape:=n_scrape+1; end if; end if;
  end loop;

  -- 2. Categories with enough pool and no invites sent yet
  for r in select * from v_supply_gap where status='READY - not yet invited' order by sendable desc limit 25
  loop
    insert into org_tasks (dept_key, title, detail, status, tier, needs_founder, action_class)
    select 'procurement','Start invites: '||r.slug,
           r.name||' has '||r.sendable||' sendable leads and no invitations sent. Pool is sufficient for the 10-approved target. Queue it into the invite ramp.',
           'proposed','advisory', false, 'invite'
    where not exists (select 1 from org_tasks t where t.title='Start invites: '||r.slug and t.status<>'done');
    if found then n_invite:=n_invite+1; end if;
  end loop;

  -- 3. Free supply: uncategorised leads are unusable until classified
  select count(*) into v_uncat from leads l
   where not exists (select 1 from lead_category lc where lc.lead_id=l.id)
     and l.email is not null and l.email<>'' and coalesce(l.banned,false)=false;

  if v_uncat > 500 then
    insert into org_tasks (dept_key, title, detail, status, tier, needs_founder, action_class)
    select 'knowledge','Classify '||v_uncat||' uncategorised leads',
           v_uncat||' sendable leads carry no category, so they cannot be targeted and count toward no category''s supply. '
           ||'Classifying them is free supply - it costs no acquisition spend and will partly fill the thin categories. '
           ||'Run the category classifier over the unmapped set.',
           'proposed','advisory', false, 'route_category'
    where not exists (select 1 from org_tasks where title like 'Classify % uncategorised leads' and status<>'done');
  end if;

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('supply_gap_scan', now(), now(), 'ok',
          jsonb_build_object('categories',v_total,'target_met',v_met,'scrape_tasks',n_scrape,
                             'source_tasks',n_source,'invite_tasks',n_invite,'uncategorised',v_uncat),
          'Supply gap scan: '||v_met||' of '||v_total||' categories at 10 approved. '
          ||n_scrape||' need more scraping, '||n_source||' have no pool at all, '||n_invite
          ||' ready to invite, '||v_uncat||' leads unclassified.');

  return jsonb_build_object('categories',v_total,'target_met',v_met,'scrape',n_scrape,'source',n_source,'invite',n_invite,'uncategorised',v_uncat);
end $fn$;

revoke execute on function public.fn_supply_gap_scan() from public, anon, authenticated;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728190724_retarget_kpis_to_the_supplier_launch_goal.sql

```sql
-- The company was measuring the wrong supplier goal. Re-target to what the founder actually
-- needs for the next 2-3 months: 10 approved suppliers in each of 86 categories.

update employee_kpi
   set kpi = 'Categories at the 10-supplier target',
       metric = 'Categories with 10+ approved suppliers',
       target_value = 86, unit = 'categories',
       measure_sql = $q$select count(*)::numeric from v_supply_gap where approved >= 10$q$
 where kpi = 'Categories with live supply';

update employee_kpi
   set target_value = 10,
       measure_sql = $q$select round(avg(approved),2) from v_supply_gap$q$
 where metric = 'Coverage across active supplier categories' and active;

insert into employee_kpi (agent_key, kpi, metric, target_value, unit, cadence, serves_goal, measure_sql, active)
select v.agent_key, v.kpi, v.metric, v.target_value::numeric, v.unit, v.cadence, v.serves_goal, v.measure_sql, true
from (values
  ('onboarding','Total approved suppliers','Suppliers that completed onboarding and were approved','860','suppliers','weekly','supplier_coverage',
   $q$select count(*)::numeric from leads where approval_status='approved'$q$),
  ('onboarding','Categories with a viable pool','Categories holding enough sendable leads to reach 10 approved at 5% conversion','86','categories','weekly','supplier_coverage',
   $q$select count(*)::numeric from v_supply_gap where sendable >= sendable_needed_at_5pct$q$),
  ('onboarding','Invite to approval conversion','Share of invited suppliers that reach approved','5','percent','weekly','supplier_coverage',
   $q$select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where approval_status='approved')/nullif(count(*) filter (where invite_status is not null),0),2) from leads$q$),
  ('onboarding','Lead pool growth','New sendable leads added in the last 30 days','2000','leads','monthly','supplier_coverage',
   $q$select count(*)::numeric from leads where created_at > now()-interval '30 days' and email is not null and email <> ''$q$),
  ('knowledge','Leads carrying a category','Share of sendable leads mapped to a supplier category','95','percent','weekly','supplier_coverage',
   $q$select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where exists(select 1 from lead_category lc where lc.lead_id=l.id))/nullif(count(*),0),2) from leads l where l.email is not null and l.email<>'' and coalesce(l.banned,false)=false$q$)
) v(agent_key,kpi,metric,target_value,unit,cadence,serves_goal,measure_sql)
where not exists (select 1 from employee_kpi e where e.kpi = v.kpi);

-- make the company goal match the founder's stated target
insert into company_goals (key, goal, metric, target_value, unit, period, owner_dept, measure_sql, active, category, horizon, direction)
select 'supplier_coverage_10x86','10 approved suppliers in every one of the 86 categories',
       'Categories at the 10-supplier target', 86, 'categories','quarter','procurement',
       $q$select count(*)::numeric from v_supply_gap where approved >= 10$q$, true,'growth','quarter','up'
where not exists (select 1 from company_goals where key='supplier_coverage_10x86');
```

```sql
-- OS-level scoreboard: departments roll up into their operating system
create or replace view public.v_os_scoreboard as
select o.num, o.os_key, o.name, o.owner_agent,
       count(distinct od.dept_key)                                            as departments,
       count(distinct a.agent_key)                                            as employees,
       count(distinct t.id) filter (where t.status <> 'done')                 as open_tasks,
       coalesce(sum(distinct b.monthly_aed), 0)                               as budget_aed,
       coalesce(sum(distinct b.spent_aed), 0)                                 as spent_aed,
       count(distinct k.id) filter (where k.active)                           as kpis,
       count(distinct k.id) filter (where k.active and k.measure_sql is null)  as kpis_unmeasurable
from operating_system o
left join os_department od on od.os_key = o.os_key
left join org_agents   a  on a.department = od.dept_key and a.active
left join org_tasks    t  on t.dept_key   = od.dept_key
left join department_budget b on b.dept_key = od.dept_key
left join employee_kpi k  on k.agent_key   = a.agent_key
where o.active
group by o.num, o.os_key, o.name, o.owner_agent
order by o.num;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728191417_os_review_and_executive_meeting_by_os.sql

```sql
-- Governance: every OS is reviewed on the same schedule, by the same standard, and its
-- owner answers for it. The executive meeting stops being an ad-hoc checklist and becomes
-- a review of ten systems, each with a named owner.

create table if not exists public.os_review (
  id           bigserial primary key,
  os_key       text not null references operating_system(os_key),
  period       text not null,
  owner_agent  text,
  health       text not null check (health in ('green','amber','red')),
  metrics      jsonb,
  findings     jsonb,
  actions      int not null default 0,
  created_at   timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (os_key, period)
);
alter table public.os_review enable row level security;

create or replace function public.fn_os_review()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare r record; v_period text := to_char(now(),'IYYY-"W"IW');
  v_health text; v_find jsonb; v_act int; v_total int := 0; v_red int := 0; v_amber int := 0;
  v_missed int; v_stale int; v_overspend numeric;
begin
  for r in select * from v_os_scoreboard loop
    v_find := '[]'::jsonb; v_act := 0;

    select count(*) into v_missed from org_tasks t
      join os_department od on od.dept_key = t.dept_key
     where od.os_key = r.os_key and t.title like 'KPI missed:%' and t.status <> 'done';

    select count(*) into v_stale from org_tasks t
      join os_department od on od.dept_key = t.dept_key
     where od.os_key = r.os_key and t.status <> 'done' and t.created_at < now() - interval '14 days';

    v_overspend := case when r.budget_aed > 0 then round(100.0*r.spent_aed/r.budget_aed,1) else 0 end;

    if r.employees = 0 then
      v_find := v_find || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('issue','no employees','detail','This operating system has no staff.'));
    end if;
    if r.kpis = 0 then
      v_find := v_find || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('issue','no KPIs','detail','This operating system cannot be held to account.'));
    end if;
    if r.kpis_unmeasurable > 0 then
      v_find := v_find || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('issue','unmeasurable KPIs','detail',r.kpis_unmeasurable||' KPI(s) have no measure.'));
    end if;
    if v_missed > 0 then
      v_find := v_find || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('issue','KPIs missing target','detail',v_missed||' unclosed KPI gap(s).'));
    end if;
    if v_stale > 0 then
      v_find := v_find || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('issue','stale work','detail',v_stale||' task(s) open more than 14 days.'));
    end if;
    if v_overspend >= 95 then
      v_find := v_find || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('issue','budget halt','detail',v_overspend||'% of monthly AI budget spent.'));
    elsif v_overspend >= 70 then
      v_find := v_find || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('issue','budget degrade','detail',v_overspend||'% of monthly AI budget spent.'));
    end if;

    v_health := case
      when r.employees = 0 or r.kpis = 0 or v_overspend >= 95 then 'red'
      when jsonb_array_length(v_find) > 0 then 'amber'
      else 'green' end;

    if v_health <> 'green' then
      insert into org_tasks (dept_key, title, detail, status, tier, needs_founder, action_class)
      select coalesce((select department from org_agents where agent_key = r.owner_agent), 'exec'),
             'OS review ['||v_health||']: '||r.name,
             'Owner: '||coalesce(r.owner_agent,'unassigned')||'. Week '||v_period||'. Findings: '||v_find::text
             ||'. Close each finding or bring evidence the standard is wrong.',
             'proposed','advisory', false, 'exec_review'
      where not exists (select 1 from org_tasks t2 where t2.title like 'OS review [%]: '||r.name and t2.status <> 'done');
      get diagnostics v_act = row_count;
    end if;

    insert into os_review (os_key, period, owner_agent, health, metrics, findings, actions)
    values (r.os_key, v_period, r.owner_agent, v_health,
            jsonb_build_object('departments',r.departments,'employees',r.employees,'open_tasks',r.open_tasks,
                               'kpis',r.kpis,'kpis_unmeasurable',r.kpis_unmeasurable,
                               'budget_pct',v_overspend,'kpi_gaps',v_missed,'stale_tasks',v_stale),
            v_find, v_act)
    on conflict (os_key, period) do update
      set health=excluded.health, metrics=excluded.metrics, findings=excluded.findings,
          actions=excluded.actions, created_at=now();

    v_total := v_total + 1;
    if v_health='red' then v_red := v_red+1; elsif v_health='amber' then v_amber := v_amber+1; end if;
  end loop;

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('os_review', now(), now(), case when v_red>0 then 'error' else 'ok' end,
          jsonb_build_object('reviewed',v_total,'red',v_red,'amber',v_amber,'green',v_total-v_red-v_amber),
          'Operating system review, week '||v_period||': '||(v_total-v_red-v_amber)||' green, '||v_amber||' amber, '||v_red||' red.');

  return jsonb_build_object('reviewed',v_total,'red',v_red,'amber',v_amber,'green',v_total-v_red-v_amber);
end $fn$;

revoke execute on function public.fn_os_review() from public, anon, authenticated;

-- the one KPI still without a measure
update employee_kpi
   set measure_sql = $q$select round(avg((kpis->>'engagement_rate')::numeric),2) from marketing_snapshots where created_at > now()-interval '30 days'$q$
 where metric = 'Average engagement across channels' and measure_sql is null;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728191502_executive_meeting_runs_by_operating_system.sql

```sql
-- The executive meeting was an ad-hoc checklist of company metrics. It now runs the way an
-- executive-led company runs: ten operating systems, each with an owner who answers for it,
-- reviewed against one standard, plus the company-level numbers the CEO owns directly.
create or replace function public.fn_exec_meeting()
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare m jsonb; findings jsonb := '[]'::jsonb; actions int := 0; recs jsonb;
  v_period text := to_char(now(),'IYYY-"W"IW');
  v_rev numeric; v_spend numeric; v_sup int; v_open int; v_avail numeric;
  v_red int; v_amber int; v_green int; r record;
begin
  -- ensure the OS reviews for this week exist before the meeting reads them
  if not exists (select 1 from os_review where period = v_period) then
    perform fn_os_review();
  end if;

  select count(*) filter (where health='red'), count(*) filter (where health='amber'), count(*) filter (where health='green')
    into v_red, v_amber, v_green from os_review where period = v_period;

  select coalesce(sum(coalesce(reveal_fee,app_fee,0)),0) into v_rev from transactions where revealed_at > now()-interval '7 days';
  select coalesce(sum(cost_aed),0) into v_spend from ai_cost_log where occurred_at > now()-interval '7 days';
  select count(*) into v_sup from leads where approval_status='approved';
  select count(*) into v_open from org_tasks where status<>'done';
  select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where ok)/nullif(count(*),0),1) into v_avail
    from health_checks where check_kind='http' and created_at > now()-interval '7 days';

  m := jsonb_build_object('week',v_period,'os_green',v_green,'os_amber',v_amber,'os_red',v_red,
       'revenue_7d_aed',v_rev,'ai_spend_7d_aed',round(coalesce(v_spend,0),2),
       'approved_suppliers',v_sup,'supplier_target',860,
       'open_tasks',v_open,'platform_availability_pct',v_avail);

  -- AGENDA ITEM 1..10: every operating system that is not green, named with its owner
  for r in
    select o.num, o.name, r2.health, r2.owner_agent, r2.findings
    from os_review r2 join operating_system o on o.os_key = r2.os_key
    where r2.period = v_period and r2.health <> 'green' order by
      case r2.health when 'red' then 1 else 2 end, o.num
  loop
    findings := findings || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'item', r.num||'. '||r.name, 'owner', coalesce(r.owner_agent,'unassigned'),
      'health', r.health, 'finding', r.findings::text));
  end loop;

  -- COMPANY-LEVEL ITEMS the CEO owns directly
  if coalesce(v_rev,0)=0 then
    findings := findings || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('item','Revenue','owner','cfo','health','amber','finding','No revenue recognised in the last 7 days.'));
  end if;
  if v_sup < 860 then
    findings := findings || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('item','Supplier coverage','owner','procurement','health',
      case when v_sup=0 then 'red' else 'amber' end,
      'finding', v_sup||' approved suppliers against a target of 860 (10 in each of 86 categories).'));
  end if;
  if coalesce(v_avail,100) < 99.5 then
    findings := findings || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('item','Platform availability','owner','cto','health','amber','finding','Availability '||coalesce(v_avail,0)||'% against 99.5%.'));
  end if;

  insert into org_tasks (dept_key,title,detail,status,tier,needs_founder,action_class)
  select coalesce((select department from org_agents where agent_key=f->>'owner'),'exec'),
    'Exec meeting '||v_period||': '||(f->>'item'),
    'Health: '||(f->>'health')||'. Owner: '||(f->>'owner')||'. '||(f->>'finding')
    ||' Raised at the weekly executive meeting. Close it, or bring evidence the standard is wrong.',
    'proposed','advisory',false,'exec_review'
  from jsonb_array_elements(findings) f
  where not exists (select 1 from org_tasks t where t.title='Exec meeting '||v_period||': '||(f->>'item') and t.status<>'done');
  get diagnostics actions = row_count;

  recs := case when jsonb_array_length(findings)=0
    then jsonb_build_array('All ten operating systems green and company metrics within tolerance. Hold current priorities.')
    else jsonb_build_array(
      v_red||' operating system(s) red, '||v_amber||' amber. Each has a named owner and a tracked action.',
      'Priority order follows the constitution: compliance, then customer trust, then quality, then revenue.') end;

  insert into exec_reports (officer,period,summary,findings,recommendations,metrics,status)
  values ('ceo',v_period,
    'Weekly executive meeting across ten operating systems. '||v_green||' green, '||v_amber||' amber, '||v_red
    ||' red. '||jsonb_array_length(findings)||' agenda finding(s), '||actions||' action(s) assigned.',
    findings, recs, m, 'open')
  on conflict do nothing;

  insert into agent_runs (agent,started_at,finished_at,status,counts,note)
  values ('exec_meeting',now(),now(),'ok',
    jsonb_build_object('os_green',v_green,'os_amber',v_amber,'os_red',v_red,'findings',jsonb_array_length(findings),'actions',actions),
    'Executive meeting '||v_period||': '||v_green||' green / '||v_amber||' amber / '||v_red||' red across ten operating systems, '||actions||' actions assigned.');

  return jsonb_build_object('week',v_period,'green',v_green,'amber',v_amber,'red',v_red,
                            'findings',jsonb_array_length(findings),'actions',actions,'metrics',m);
end $fn$;
revoke execute on function public.fn_exec_meeting() from public, anon, authenticated;
```

```sql
create table if not exists public.os_interface (
  id            bigserial primary key,
  os_key        text not null references operating_system(os_key),
  direction     text not null check (direction in ('input','output')),
  kind          text not null,
  description   text,
  event_type    text,
  active        boolean not null default true,
  unique (os_key, direction, kind)
);
alter table public.os_interface enable row level security;
comment on table public.os_interface is
  'The standardized interface each OS exposes. Inputs are the events it subscribes to; outputs are what it produces for the rest of the company. No OS calls another for business logic - it emits and subscribes.';

-- 9. workflows belong to an OS
alter table public.workflow add column if not exists os_key text references operating_system(os_key);
update workflow set os_key='marketplace' where os_key is null and workflow_key ilike any (array['%rfq%','%quote%','%supplier%','%inquiry%','%match%']);
update workflow set os_key='operations' where os_key is null;

-- 12. memory belongs to an OS
alter table public.institutional_memory add column if not exists os_key text references operating_system(os_key);
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728191919_os_independent_knowledge_and_weekly_improvement.sql

```sql
-- Blueprint 6: each OS holds INDEPENDENT knowledge; Leadership does not duplicate Finance,
-- it queries it. When I staffed the three new systems I copied strategy_director's bindings
-- to all ten new hires, which is exactly the duplication the blueprint forbids. Correcting it.

create table if not exists public.os_knowledge_domain (
  os_key     text not null references operating_system(os_key),
  domain_key text not null,
  ownership  text not null default 'owns' check (ownership in ('owns','queries')),
  primary key (os_key, domain_key)
);
alter table public.os_knowledge_domain enable row level security;
comment on table public.os_knowledge_domain is
  'Which OS OWNS a knowledge domain and which merely QUERY it. Prevents ten systems each keeping their own copy of UAE VAT.';

-- each OS owns the domains that match its responsibilities; everything else it queries
insert into os_knowledge_domain (os_key, domain_key, ownership)
select r.os_key, d.domain_key, 'owns'
from knowledge_domain d
join os_responsibility r on d.domain_key ilike '%'||replace(r.responsibility,'_','%')||'%'
on conflict do nothing;

-- Leadership and Evolution query everything they do not own, rather than duplicating it
insert into os_knowledge_domain (os_key, domain_key, ownership)
select o.os_key, d.domain_key, 'queries'
from operating_system o cross join knowledge_domain d
where o.os_key in ('leadership','evolution','intelligence')
  and not exists (select 1 from os_knowledge_domain k where k.os_key=o.os_key and k.domain_key=d.domain_key)
on conflict do nothing;

-- Blueprint 17: every OS asks the same five questions, weekly, about itself.
create or replace function public.fn_os_improve()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare r record; n int := 0; q text; qs text[];
  v_failed int; v_slow int; v_cost numeric; v_manual int; v_dead int;
begin
  for r in select o.os_key, o.name, o.owner_agent,
                  coalesce((select department from org_agents a where a.agent_key=o.owner_agent),'exec') as dept
           from operating_system o where o.active
  loop
    qs := array[]::text[];

    select count(*) into v_failed from agent_runs ar
      join os_department od on od.os_key = r.os_key
      join org_agents a on a.department = od.dept_key and a.agent_key = ar.agent
     where ar.status='error' and ar.started_at > now()-interval '7 days';

    select count(*) into v_slow from org_tasks t join os_department od on od.dept_key=t.dept_key
     where od.os_key=r.os_key and t.status<>'done' and t.created_at < now()-interval '14 days';

    select coalesce(sum(c.cost_aed),0) into v_cost from ai_cost_log c
      join os_department od on od.dept_key = c.dept_key
     where od.os_key = r.os_key and c.occurred_at > now()-interval '7 days';

    select count(*) into v_manual from org_tasks t join os_department od on od.dept_key=t.dept_key
     where od.os_key=r.os_key and t.needs_founder;

    select count(*) into v_dead from workflow w where w.os_key=r.os_key and not w.active;

    if v_failed > 0 then qs := array_append(qs,'What failed? '||v_failed||' agent run(s) errored this week in '||r.name||'. Root cause each one.'); end if;
    if v_slow   > 0 then qs := array_append(qs,'What slowed us? '||v_slow||' task(s) have been open over 14 days in '||r.name||'. Why has none closed?'); end if;
    if v_cost   > 0 then qs := array_append(qs,'What cost too much? '||r.name||' spent '||round(v_cost,2)||' AED on AI this week. Which calls could a cheaper model have served?'); end if;
    if v_manual > 0 then qs := array_append(qs,'What can be automated? '||v_manual||' task(s) in '||r.name||' still need the founder. Which of those is a rule rather than a judgement?'); end if;
    if v_dead   > 0 then qs := array_append(qs,'What should be deleted? '||v_dead||' inactive workflow(s) remain in '||r.name||'. Retire or revive them.'); end if;

    foreach q in array qs loop
      insert into org_tasks (dept_key,title,detail,status,tier,needs_founder,action_class)
      select r.dept, left(r.name||' improvement: '||q, 120),
             q||E'\n\nOwner: '||coalesce(r.owner_agent,'unassigned')||'. Answer with evidence. If the answer implies a change, open it through fn_outcome_open so it is graded against a baseline.',
             'proposed','advisory',false,'recommend'
      where not exists (select 1 from org_tasks t where t.title = left(r.name||' improvement: '||q,120) and t.status<>'done');
      if found then n := n+1; end if;
    end loop;
  end loop;

  insert into agent_runs (agent,started_at,finished_at,status,counts,note)
  values ('os_improve',now(),now(),'ok',jsonb_build_object('questions',n),
    'Continuous improvement: '||n||' question(s) raised across the ten operating systems.');
  return jsonb_build_object('questions',n);
end $fn$;

revoke execute on function public.fn_os_improve() from public, anon, authenticated;
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728192259_memory_os_backfill_sop_loop_and_full_health_v2.sql

```sql
update institutional_memory m set os_key = od.os_key
from os_department od where m.os_key is null and od.dept_key = m.category_slug;

update institutional_memory set os_key = case
  when kind='outcome' then 'evolution'
  when subject_type ilike '%supplier%' or subject_type ilike '%inquiry%' or subject_type ilike '%quote%' then 'marketplace'
  when subject_type ilike '%invoice%'  or subject_type ilike '%bill%'    then 'finance'
  when subject_type ilike '%dispute%'  or subject_type ilike '%contract%' then 'legal_gov'
  else 'operations' end
where os_key is null;

create or replace function public.fn_sop_update()
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare r record; n_new int := 0; v_slug text;
begin
  for r in
    select m.id, m.os_key, m.headline, m.detail, m.outcome
    from institutional_memory m
    where m.created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
      and m.outcome in ('worse','improved')
      and not exists (select 1 from os_runbooks b where b.slug = 'lesson-'||m.id)
    limit 25
  loop
    v_slug := 'lesson-'||r.id;
    insert into os_runbooks (slug, title, category, when_to_use, steps, sort)
    values (v_slug, left(coalesce(r.headline,'Lesson '||r.id),120), coalesce(r.os_key,'operations'),
            case r.outcome when 'worse'
              then 'Before repeating this change. It was tried and it made things worse.'
              else 'When this situation recurs. This approach was measured and it worked.' end,
            coalesce(r.detail,''), 100);
    n_new := n_new + 1;
  end loop;
  insert into agent_runs (agent,started_at,finished_at,status,counts,note)
  values ('sop_update',now(),now(),'ok',jsonb_build_object('runbooks_written',n_new),
    'SOP update: '||n_new||' graded lesson(s) written into the runbook library so the company cannot repeat them by accident.');
  return jsonb_build_object('written',n_new);
end $fn$;
revoke execute on function public.fn_sop_update() from public, anon, authenticated;

create or replace view public.v_os_health as
select s.num, s.os_key, s.name, s.owner_agent,
  s.employees, s.open_tasks,
  round(s.open_tasks::numeric / nullif(s.employees,0), 2) as backlog_per_head,
  (select count(*) from org_tasks t join os_department od on od.dept_key=t.dept_key
    where od.os_key=s.os_key and t.status<>'done' and t.created_at < now()-interval '14 days') as stale_tasks,
  (select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where decision='approve')/nullif(count(*),0),1)
     from review_chain rc join os_department od on od.dept_key=rc.dept_key
    where od.os_key=s.os_key) as review_pass_pct,
  (select count(*) from risk_register r
    where exists (select 1 from os_department od join org_agents a on a.department=od.dept_key
                   where od.os_key=s.os_key and a.agent_key=r.owner_agent)) as open_risks,
  (select count(*) from org_tasks t join os_department od on od.dept_key=t.dept_key
    where od.os_key=s.os_key and t.title like 'KPI missed:%' and t.status<>'done') as kpi_gaps,
  s.budget_aed, s.spent_aed,
  round(100.0*s.spent_aed/nullif(s.budget_aed,0),1) as budget_pct,
  (select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where needs_founder)/nullif(count(*),0),1)
     from org_tasks t join os_department od on od.dept_key=t.dept_key
    where od.os_key=s.os_key and t.status<>'done') as needs_founder_pct
from v_os_scoreboard s;

comment on view public.v_os_health is
  'Eight dimensions: performance (kpi_gaps), risk (open_risks), quality (review_pass_pct), capacity (backlog_per_head), backlog (stale_tasks), cost (budget_pct), automation (needs_founder_pct), staffing (employees).';
```

### supabase/migrations/20260728193356_permission_to_disagree.sql

```sql
-- The most important line in the vision doc, and the only behaviour gap rather than a UI gap.
-- Today the company can hold an action for review. It cannot say "I recommend against this,
-- here is why, here are three alternatives." That is the difference between a command
-- executor and an executive team.

create table if not exists public.challenge_record (
  id              bigserial primary key,
  proposal        text not null,
  proposed_by     text not null default 'founder',
  challenged_by   text not null,
  stance          text not null check (stance in ('support','concern','recommend_against')),
  confidence      numeric,
  reasoning       text not null,
  violates_rank   int,
  violates_principle text,
  evidence        jsonb default '[]'::jsonb,
  alternatives    jsonb default '[]'::jsonb,
  founder_response text check (founder_response in ('accepted','overruled','modified',null)),
  responded_at    timestamptz,
  created_at      timestamptz not null default now()
);

comment on table public.challenge_record is
  'Every time the company disagrees with a proposal, on the record: the stance, the reasoning, which company principle it conflicts with, the evidence, the alternatives, and whether the founder accepted or overruled it. Overrules are as auditable as the advice.';

-- Keywords that signal a proposal touches a governed domain, kept as data so the
-- company can widen its own judgement without a code change.
create table if not exists public.challenge_heuristic (
  id            bigserial primary key,
  pattern       text not null,
  rank_touched  int not null,
  principle     text not null,
  concern       text not null,
  alternative   text,

);
alter table public.challenge_heuristic enable row level security;

insert into challenge_heuristic (pattern, rank_touched, principle, concern, alternative) values

  'Test on one category first and measure churn before applying broadly; or hold price and raise value; or stage the increase over two quarters with a grandfathered cohort.'),
 ('(skip|bypass|disable|turn off).*(review|approval|gate|check)', 1,'Protect legal and regulatory compliance',
  'Removing a gate removes the evidence trail that makes a decision defensible afterwards. Compliance outranks speed in the constitution.',
  'Keep the gate and lower its threshold; or auto-approve the low-risk class only, with sampling.'),
 ('(delete|purge|remove).*(data|record|supplier|customer|log)', 2,'Protect customer trust and data security',

 ('(launch|start|send).*(campaign|invite|blast|marketing)', 3,'Deliver high-quality outcomes',

  'Validate the list first; or start at a low cap with a bounce breaker and ramp on health.'),
 ('(cut|reduce|lower).*(budget|spend|cost).*(security|compliance|backup|test)', 1,'Protect legal and regulatory compliance',
  'Cutting spend on controls trades a certain small saving for an uncertain large loss.',
  'Cut discretionary spend elsewhere; or reduce scope while keeping the control in place.'),
 ('(hire|add|create).*(department|team|employee|agent)', 5,'Improve efficiency and reduce costs',

  'Measure current utilisation first; add capacity only where backlog per head is above target.')
on conflict do nothing;

create or replace function public.fn_challenge(
  p_proposal text,
  p_proposed_by text default 'founder',
  p_challenger text default 'brief'
) returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare
  h record; v_id bigint; v_stance text := 'support'; v_conf numeric := 0.5;
  v_reason text := ''; v_alts jsonb := '[]'::jsonb; v_evidence jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_rank int; v_principle text; v_hits int := 0;
  v_prior record; v_supply int; v_rev numeric;
begin
  -- 1. does the proposal collide with a ranked company principle?
  for h in select * from challenge_heuristic where active and p_proposal ~* pattern order by rank_touched limit 3
  loop
    v_hits := v_hits + 1;
    if v_rank is null or h.rank_touched < v_rank then
      v_rank := h.rank_touched; v_principle := h.principle;
    end if;
    v_reason := v_reason || case when v_reason = '' then '' else ' ' end || h.concern;
    if h.alternative is not null then
      v_alts := v_alts || jsonb_build_array(h.alternative);
    end if;
  end loop;

  -- 2. has the company tried something like this before, and what happened?
  for v_prior in
    select headline, detail, outcome from institutional_memory
     where outcome in ('worse','improved')
       and p_proposal ~* coalesce(substring(headline from '\w+'),'zzzz')
     order by created_at desc limit 3
  loop
    v_evidence := v_evidence || jsonb_build_array(
      jsonb_build_object('type','prior_outcome','verdict',v_prior.outcome,'lesson',left(v_prior.detail,240)));
    if v_prior.outcome = 'worse' then v_hits := v_hits + 2; end if;
  end loop;

  -- 3. current state that bears on almost any commercial proposal
  select count(*) into v_supply from leads where approval_status='approved';
  select coalesce(sum(coalesce(reveal_fee,app_fee,0)),0) into v_rev
    from transactions where revealed_at > now()-interval '30 days';
  v_evidence := v_evidence || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
    'type','current_state','onboarded_suppliers',v_supply,'revenue_30d_aed',v_rev,
    'note', case when v_supply = 0
      then 'The marketplace has no onboarded supply, so any demand-side or pricing change cannot be validated against real behaviour yet.'
      else 'Supply exists; effects are measurable.' end));

  if v_supply = 0 and p_proposal ~* '(fee|price|commission|campaign|customer|demand)' then
    v_hits := v_hits + 1;
    v_reason := v_reason || ' There is also no onboarded supply to measure the effect against, so the change would be unfalsifiable at the moment it is made.';
  end if;

  -- 4. stance
  if v_hits >= 3 then v_stance := 'recommend_against'; v_conf := 0.85;
  elsif v_hits >= 1 then v_stance := 'concern'; v_conf := 0.65;
  else
    v_stance := 'support'; v_conf := 0.6;
    v_reason := 'No conflict found with the priority hierarchy, no contrary prior outcome on record, and current state does not argue against it.';
  end if;

  if v_alts = '[]'::jsonb and v_stance <> 'support' then
    v_alts := jsonb_build_array('Run it as a bounded test with a named metric and a captured baseline, so it can be graded and reversed.');
  end if;

  insert into challenge_record (proposal, proposed_by, challenged_by, stance, confidence,
                                reasoning, violates_rank, violates_principle, evidence, alternatives)
  values (p_proposal, p_proposed_by, p_challenger, v_stance, v_conf,
          v_reason, v_rank, v_principle, v_evidence, v_alts)
  returning id into v_id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'id', v_id, 'stance', v_stance, 'confidence', v_conf,
    'conflicts_with', case when v_principle is null then null
                           else 'Rank '||v_rank||' — '||v_principle end,
    'reasoning', v_reason, 'evidence', v_evidence, 'alternatives', v_alts);
end $fn$;

revoke execute on function public.fn_challenge(text,text,text) from public, anon, authenticated;

comment on function public.fn_challenge(text,text,text) is
  'Reasons a proposal against the priority hierarchy, prior graded outcomes and current company state, then returns support / concern / recommend_against with evidence and alternatives. Advice, not a veto - the founder can overrule, and the overrule is recorded.';
```

```sql
-- Test caught a bad miss: "Cut the security budget by half" returned SUPPORT, because the
-- pattern required budget-then-security and the sentence says security-then-budget. A control
-- cut is exactly what must be challenged, so order-independence matters. Also: a rank-1
-- compliance conflict should reach recommend_against on its own, not need to accumulate.

   set pattern = '(cut|reduce|lower|halve|slash).*(security|compliance|backup|audit|test|control)|(security|compliance|backup|audit|test|control).*(budget|spend|cost).*(cut|reduce|lower|halve|slash)|(cut|reduce|lower|halve|slash).*(budget|spend|cost)'

create or replace function public.fn_challenge(
  p_proposal text, p_proposed_by text default 'founder', p_challenger text default 'brief'
) returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public','pg_temp'
as $fn$
declare
  h record; v_id bigint; v_stance text := 'support'; v_conf numeric := 0.5;
  v_reason text := ''; v_alts jsonb := '[]'::jsonb; v_evidence jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_rank int; v_principle text; v_weight int := 0;
  v_prior record; v_supply int; v_rev numeric;
begin
  for h in select * from challenge_heuristic where active and p_proposal ~* pattern order by rank_touched limit 3
  loop
    -- a rank-1 conflict is severe on its own; lower ranks accumulate
    v_weight := v_weight + case h.rank_touched when 1 then 3 when 2 then 2 else 1 end;
    if v_rank is null or h.rank_touched < v_rank then v_rank := h.rank_touched; v_principle := h.principle; end if;
    v_reason := v_reason || case when v_reason='' then '' else ' ' end || h.concern;
    if h.alternative is not null then v_alts := v_alts || jsonb_build_array(h.alternative); end if;
  end loop;

  for v_prior in
    select headline, detail, outcome from institutional_memory
     where outcome in ('worse','improved')
       and p_proposal ~* coalesce(substring(headline from '\w+'),'zzzz')
     order by created_at desc limit 3
  loop
    v_evidence := v_evidence || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'type','prior_outcome','verdict',v_prior.outcome,'lesson',left(v_prior.detail,240)));
    if v_prior.outcome='worse' then v_weight := v_weight + 3; end if;
  end loop;

  select count(*) into v_supply from leads where approval_status='approved';
  select coalesce(sum(coalesce(reveal_fee,app_fee,0)),0) into v_rev
    from transactions where revealed_at > now()-interval '30 days';
  v_evidence := v_evidence || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
    'type','current_state','onboarded_suppliers',v_supply,'revenue_30d_aed',v_rev,
    'note', case when v_supply=0
      then 'The marketplace has no onboarded supply, so any demand-side or pricing change cannot be validated against real behaviour yet.'
      else 'Supply exists; effects are measurable.' end));

  if v_supply=0 and p_proposal ~* '(fee|price|commission|campaign|customer|demand)' then
    v_weight := v_weight + 1;
    v_reason := v_reason || ' There is also no onboarded supply to measure the effect against, so the change would be unfalsifiable at the moment it is made.';
  end if;

  if v_weight >= 3 then v_stance := 'recommend_against'; v_conf := least(0.95, 0.60 + v_weight*0.05);
  elsif v_weight >= 1 then v_stance := 'concern'; v_conf := 0.65;
  else v_stance := 'support'; v_conf := 0.6;
       v_reason := 'No conflict with the priority hierarchy, no contrary prior outcome on record, and current state does not argue against it.';
  end if;

  if v_alts='[]'::jsonb and v_stance<>'support' then
    v_alts := jsonb_build_array('Run it as a bounded test with a named metric and a captured baseline, so it can be graded and reversed.');
  end if;

  insert into challenge_record (proposal,proposed_by,challenged_by,stance,confidence,reasoning,
                                violates_rank,violates_principle,evidence,alternatives)
  values (p_proposal,p_proposed_by,p_challenger,v_stance,v_conf,v_reason,v_rank,v_principle,v_evidence,v_alts)
  returning id into v_id;

  return jsonb_build_object('id',v_id,'stance',v_stance,'confidence',v_conf,
    'conflicts_with', case when v_principle is null then null else 'Rank '||v_rank||' — '||v_principle end,
    'reasoning',v_reason,'evidence',v_evidence,'alternatives',v_alts);
end $fn$;
revoke execute on function public.fn_challenge(text,text,text) from public, anon, authenticated;
```
