### src/components/WhyAnonymous.tsx

```tsx
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';

type Item = { title: string; body: string };

export function WhyAnonymous() {
  const t = useTranslations('why');
  const items = t.raw('items') as Item[];
  return (
    <section id="why" className="py-beat-s md:py-beat">
      <div className="container-x">
        <div className="reveal grid gap-6 border-t border-[var(--line)] pt-10 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1fr)] md:gap-14">
          <h2 className="max-w-[15ch] text-balance font-head text-[clamp(28px,3.4vw,44px)] font-semibold leading-[1.08] tracking-[-0.035em] text-white">
            {t('title')}
          </h2>
          <div className="self-end">
            <p className="text-[13px] font-medium text-teal-light">{t('eyebrow')}</p>
            <p className="mt-3 max-w-[56ch] text-pretty text-[16.5px] leading-relaxed text-muted">{t('sub')}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Asymmetric: the first claim gets the weight, the rest sit as a measured column. */}
        <div className="mt-12 grid gap-10 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.05fr)_minmax(0,.95fr)] md:gap-16">
          {items.slice(0, 1).map((it) => (
            <article key={it.title} className="reveal surface relative overflow-hidden rounded-[22px] p-8 md:p-10">
              <div className="mb-7 flex items-center gap-2" aria-hidden>
                <span className="redact redact-sq" />
                <span className="redact redact-bar w-28" />
                <span className="redact redact-sq !w-3" />
              </div>
              <h3 className="max-w-[18ch] text-balance font-head text-[clamp(21px,2.2vw,27px)] font-semibold leading-[1.16] tracking-[-0.025em] text-white">
                {it.title}
              </h3>
              <p className="mt-4 max-w-[46ch] text-pretty text-[15.5px] leading-relaxed text-muted">{it.body}</p>
            </article>
          ))}
          <div className="flex flex-col justify-center">
            {items.slice(1).map((it, i) => (
              <article
                key={it.title}
                className="reveal border-b border-[var(--line)] py-7 first:border-t"
                style={{ transitionDelay: `${i * 80}ms` }}
              >
                <h3 className="font-head text-[17.5px] font-semibold leading-snug tracking-[-0.015em] text-white">
                  {it.title}
                </h3>
                <p className="mt-2.5 max-w-[52ch] text-pretty text-[14.5px] leading-relaxed text-muted">{it.body}</p>
              </article>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

### src/i18n/request.ts

```typescript
import { getRequestConfig } from 'next-intl/server';
import { routing } from './routing';

export default getRequestConfig(async ({ requestLocale }) => {
  let locale = await requestLocale;
  if (!locale || !routing.locales.includes(locale as any)) locale = routing.defaultLocale;
  return { locale, messages: (await import(`../../messages/${locale}.json`)).default };
});
```

### src/i18n/routing.ts

```typescript
import { defineRouting } from 'next-intl/routing';
import { createNavigation } from 'next-intl/navigation';

// ONE source of truth for locales. Add a language here and every page gets it —
// no duplicated pages. 'en' is the default (served at /), 'ar' served at /ar.
export const routing = defineRouting({
  locales: ['en', 'ar'],
  defaultLocale: 'en',
  localePrefix: 'as-needed'
});

export const { Link, usePathname, useRouter } = createNavigation(routing);
```

'use client';
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
export const SUPA_URL = 'https://htdblwldjkcgjvmqkbeh.supabase.co';
export const SUPA_ANON = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6Imh0ZGJsd2xkamtjZ2p2bXFrYmVoIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3ODA3ODU1NDYsImV4cCI6MjA5NjM2MTU0Nn0.cF9ZR_Qo1YBhLvhTLS8aANlYb6c9rTsuQS6kLxGw_Bo';
export const supa = createClient(SUPA_URL, SUPA_ANON, { auth: { persistSession: true, autoRefreshToken: true } });
// LLM-backed actions can legitimately take a while (agent reasoning on Opus, question generation,
// knowledge regeneration). Give those a long budget so a working-but-slow call isn't killed at 25s;
// keep plain reads snappy. (The backend agent chain can run 45–120s across model retries.)
const SLOW_ACTION = /secretary_chat|exam_run|knowledge_refresh|knowledge_dispatch|extract_doc|report_pdf/;
export async function osApi(action: string, body: Record<string, any> = {}) {
  const { data: { session } } = await supa.auth.getSession();
  const token = session?.access_token;
  const ctl = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => ctl.abort(), SLOW_ACTION.test(action) ? 120000 : 30000);
  let r: Response;
  try {
    r = await fetch(SUPA_URL + '/functions/v1/os_api', { method: 'POST', signal: ctl.signal, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(token ? { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token } : {}) }, body: JSON.stringify({ action, ...body }) });
  } catch (e: any) {
    throw new Error(e?.name === 'AbortError' ? 'The agent is taking longer than usual — your work is saved; please retry' : (e?.message || 'Network error'));
  } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
  const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
  if (r.status === 401) throw new Error('Session expired');
  if (r.status === 403) throw new Error('Not authorized (admin only)');
  if (j.error) throw new Error(j.error);
  return j.data;
}

### src/lib/seo.ts

```typescript
import type { Metadata } from 'next';

const SITE = 'https://quotesdone.com';
const BRAND = 'QuotesDone';

/** Trim a description to a length search engines actually render (~155 chars). */
function clampDesc(s: string, max = 158): string {
  const t = s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (t.length <= max) return t;
  const cut = t.slice(0, max);
  const i = cut.lastIndexOf(' ');
  return (i > 60 ? cut.slice(0, i) : cut).replace(/[,;:.\-–—]$/, '') + '…';
}

/** Strip tags/entities from a content blob to derive a description. */
export function textFromHtml(html: string): string {
  return html
    .replace(/<(script|style)[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/\1>/gi, ' ')
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ')
    .replace(/&nbsp;/g, ' ').replace(/&amp;/g, '&')
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"').replace(/&#39;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&[a-z]+;/gi, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

/**
 * One place that builds every page's metadata: title, description, canonical,
 * hreflang alternates and social cards. `path` is the locale-less route
 * ('' for home, '/terms', '/blog/x'). Locale prefixing is applied here so the
 * canonical and the en/ar alternates always agree.
 */
export function buildMeta(opts: {
  locale: string;
  path: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  type?: 'website' | 'article';
  publishedTime?: string | null;
  /** set false for pages that exist in one language only */
  bilingual?: boolean;
}): Metadata {
  const { locale, path, title, description, type = 'website', publishedTime, bilingual = true } = opts;
  const clean = path === '/' ? '' : path.replace(/\/$/, '');
  const en = `${SITE}${clean}`;
  const ar = `${SITE}/ar${clean}`;
  const canonical = locale === 'ar' ? ar : en;
  const desc = description ? clampDesc(description) : undefined;

  const languages: Record<string, string> = { 'en-AE': en, en };
  if (bilingual) { languages['ar-AE'] = ar; languages['ar'] = ar; }
  languages['x-default'] = en;

  return {
    metadataBase: new URL(SITE),
    title,
    description: desc,
    alternates: { canonical, languages },
    openGraph: {
      type,
      siteName: BRAND,
      locale: locale === 'ar' ? 'ar_AE' : 'en_AE',
      url: canonical,
      title,
      description: desc,
      ...(publishedTime ? { publishedTime } : {}),
    },
    twitter: { card: 'summary_large_image', title, description: desc },
    robots: { index: true, follow: true },
  };
}
```

import createMiddleware from 'next-intl/middleware';
import { routing } from './i18n/routing';
export default createMiddleware(routing);
export const config = {
  // Only the surfaces migrated to Next.js run through locale routing.
  // NOTE: individual blog posts (/blog/:slug) are now native pages, so they
  // must be listed here. Without the :path* entry they bypass locale routing
  // and fall through to the legacy catch-all rewrite.
  matcher: [
    '/', '/(ar|en)',
    '/(ar|en)/os', '/os', '/(ar|en)/console', '/console', '/(ar|en)/portal', '/portal', '/(ar|en)/me', '/me', '/(ar|en)/supplier', '/supplier',
    '/terms', '/(ar|en)/terms', '/privacy', '/(ar|en)/privacy', '/cookie-policy', '/(ar|en)/cookie-policy', '/refund-policy', '/(ar|en)/refund-policy', '/supplier-agreement', '/(ar|en)/supplier-agreement', '/acceptable-use', '/(ar|en)/acceptable-use', '/disclaimer', '/(ar|en)/disclaimer', '/complaints', '/(ar|en)/complaints',
    '/about', '/(ar|en)/about', '/contact', '/(ar|en)/contact', '/faq', '/(ar|en)/faq', '/services', '/(ar|en)/services', '/blog', '/(ar|en)/blog',
    '/services/:path*', '/(ar|en)/services/:path*',
    '/blog/:path*', '/(ar|en)/blog/:path*'
  ]
};

### next.config.mjs

```javascript
import createNextIntlPlugin from 'next-intl/plugin';
const withNextIntl = createNextIntlPlugin('./src/i18n/request.ts');

/**
 * The legacy HTML host (qd-site) has been retired. Everything it used to serve
 * is now native:
 *   /blog/:slug   -> src/app/[locale]/blog/[slug]        (from src/content/blog.json)
 *   /robots.txt   -> src/app/robots.txt/route.ts
 *   /ar/app       -> redirect to /ar/me
 * The old catch-all rewrite is gone; unmatched paths now return a normal 404
 * instead of proxying to a host that no longer exists.
 *
 * Still parked in the database and NOT served: /preview, /workspace,
 * /setup-stripe, /llms.txt. Nothing on the site links to them.
 */

/** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */
const nextConfig = {
  async redirects() {
    return [
      { source: '/app', destination: '/me', permanent: false },
      { source: '/app/:path*', destination: '/me', permanent: false },
      { source: '/ar/app', destination: '/ar/me', permanent: false },
      { source: '/ar/app/:path*', destination: '/ar/me', permanent: false },
      // /customer was a second route rendering the identical CustomerPortal — a
      // pure duplicate. The route file is gone; /me is the single canonical URL.
      { source: '/customer', destination: '/me', permanent: false },
      { source: '/customer/:path*', destination: '/me', permanent: false },
      { source: '/ar/customer', destination: '/ar/me', permanent: false },
      { source: '/ar/customer/:path*', destination: '/ar/me', permanent: false },
      { source: '/suppliers', destination: '/portal', permanent: false },
      { source: '/suppliers/:path*', destination: '/portal', permanent: false },
      { source: '/os2', destination: '/os', permanent: false },
      { source: '/os2/:path*', destination: '/os', permanent: false },
      { source: '/os3', destination: '/os', permanent: false },
      { source: '/os3/:path*', destination: '/os', permanent: false },
      { source: '/crm', destination: '/os', permanent: false },
      { source: '/crm/:path*', destination: '/os', permanent: false },
      { source: '/admin', destination: '/os', permanent: false },
      { source: '/admin/:path*', destination: '/os', permanent: false },
    ];
  },
};

export default withNextIntl(nextConfig);
```
